        s.Restore(s.MaxHp, true, 0);                                   // full hull, whatever the bar just did to it
        await Wait(0.3);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) H.SpawnRaider(spot + Vector2.Right.Rotated(i * 2.1f) * 320f);
        H.SpawnRaider(spot + new Vector2(0, 760), Enemies.Gunship);
        double hull0 = s.Hp;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double lost = hull0 - s.Hp;
        Note($"{cd.Name}: 12 s under three webifiers and a gunship -- lost {lost:0} of {s.MaxHp:0} hull, {(s.Alive ? "alive" : "DEAD")}");
        if (lost <= 0) Issue($"{cd.Name}: a whole wave on it for 12 s took nothing off its hull -- nothing could reach it");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.3);
        if (!s.Alive) { s.Restore(s.MaxHp, true, 0); await Wait(0.4); }

        _table.Add($"{cd.Name,-12} {top,7:0} ({want:0})      {(turnT < 0 ? "  --  " : $"{turnT,5:0.0}s")}   {dps,7:0.0} ({S.MainDps:0.0})     {lost,5:0} of {s.MaxHp:0}{(s.Alive ? "" : "  DEAD")}");
    }

    // ── A REFIT COSTS A LEVEL AND UNDOES THE LAST POINT ──────────────────────────────────────
    // The file records the ORDER points were spent in now, because `Bought` only ever said how
    // many of each a pilot owned -- so "undo the most recent" had nothing to read and a refit
    // could only ever have taken the dearest. Both paths are proved: a pilot with an order, and a
    // file from before there was one.
    // ── THE RANGE TO THE TARGET, under it and on the HUD line ────────────────────────────────
    // The HUD named what was selected and nothing anywhere said how far off it was, which is the
    // figure that decides whether a weapon reaches at all.
    async Task RangeChecks()
    {
        var far = H.Raiders.FirstOrDefault();
        if (far == null) { Check(false, "range readout: no raider to select"); return; }
        H.SelectTarget(far);
        // TWO frames: the first may resume before the Hub's own _Process has run, and the line
        // would then still be the one written for the previous target.
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        // Whatever is selected when the line is WRITTEN, not what this asked for: a tutorial hint
        // and the ship's own acquisition both pick targets, and the check is about the readout.
        var shown = H.Selected ?? far;
        double want = Me.Position.DistanceTo(shown.Position);
        var line = Nodes<Label>().Select(l => l.Text).FirstOrDefault(t => t != null && t.Contains("target: "));
        // Read the figure back rather than matching the string: the raider is under way, so the
        // line was written a frame before this measured it and the two round a unit apart.
        var said = line == null ? null : System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Match(line, @"\((\d+) u\)");
        Check(said is { Success: true } && line.Contains(shown.Label) && Math.Abs(double.Parse(said.Groups[1].Value) - want) < 30,
              $"the HUD names the target AND says how far off it is: {shown.Label} at {said?.Groups[1].Value ?? "nothing"} u, measured {want:0} u");
        H.ClearSelection();
    }

    // ══ LANE A · COMBAT CORE (docs/plans/kits_v31.md §8) ═══════════════════════════════════════
    // Each slice's checks live in methods of their own, named for the mechanism, and are called
    // from the moment of Solo that has the world they need.

    // THE BURN CLOCK (fix B). A beam's burn is judged every Tick, and the judgement's clock was SET
    // back to Tick each time, throwing the frame it overshot by away: at 60 fps the judgements came
    // 16 frames apart, not 15, and through a ship's 0.52 s gap a pilot sitting in the line took 6
    // hits 0.53 s apart (300). Added, it is 13 judgements in the 3 s and 5 hits 0.75 s apart: 250.
    // The 13th falls AT 3 s, so the burn COUNTS its judgements (BossMove.Judgements) instead of
    // racing a second clock to that instant -- and nothing here is read on an edge: the hits are
    // counted over a window that runs 0.4 s PAST the burn's end (and nothing lands in it), each gap
    // and the burn's length are frame counts with a frame's play either side, all from the first hit.
    // Three hand-started beams, every other move held, the pilot kept in the line at a seeded
    // bearing, reach and offset -- the line re-read every frame, so nothing is picked stale.
    async Task LaneABurnClockChecks(Boss boss, PlayerShip me)
    {
        var held = boss.Type.Moves.ToDictionary(m => m.Id, m => boss.S(m.Id).Due);
        foreach (var m in boss.Type.Moves) { boss.S(m.Id).Due = 999; boss.S(m.Id).At = Boss.Phase.Idle; }
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r);            // the fight's adds out of the way
        var beam = boss.S("beam");
        await Wait(0.6);                                        // past the 0.52 s gap of any earlier burn
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            boss.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            float reach = Vary(350f, 900f), off = Vary(-15f, 15f);   // the line is 70 u wide: well inside it
            double was = me.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:beam"), last = was;
            var hitsAt = new List<int>();
            int endAt = -1; bool burned = false;
            beam.At = Boss.Phase.Winding; beam.T = 0.01;         // the wind-up ends on its next tick and the burn lands
            for (int f = 0; f < 60 * 6 && (endAt < 0 || f <= endAt + 24); f++)
            {
                var (la, lb) = boss.Segment("beam");
                var dir = (lb - la).Normalized();
                me.Position = la + dir * reach + dir.Orthogonal() * off; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double now = me.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:beam");
                if (now > last + 1e-9) { hitsAt.Add(f); last = now; }
                burned |= beam.At == Boss.Phase.Firing;
                if (endAt < 0 && burned && beam.At == Boss.Phase.Idle) endAt = f;
            }
            var gaps = hitsAt.Zip(hitsAt.Skip(1), (x, y) => (y - x) / 60.0).ToList();
            double burnFor = endAt < 0 || hitsAt.Count == 0 ? -1 : (endAt - hitsAt[0]) / 60.0;
            bool nothingAfter = endAt >= 0 && hitsAt.All(h => h <= endAt);
            Check(endAt >= 0 && nothingAfter && Math.Abs(burnFor - 3.0) < 0.02 && Math.Abs(last - was - 250) < 1e-6 && hitsAt.Count == 5 && gaps.All(g => Math.Abs(g - 0.75) < 0.02),
                  $"the burn clock: a pilot {reach:0} u down a live beam and {off:0} u off its line (bearing {Mathf.RadToDeg(boss.Rotation):0} deg) takes the whole 3 s burn as 5 hits of 50, 0.75 s apart: 250, and nothing in the 0.4 s after it (took {last - was:0} in {hitsAt.Count}, {string.Join("/", gaps.Select(g => g.ToString("0.000")))} s apart; burned {burnFor:0.000} s from the first hit; after it: {(nothingAfter ? "nothing" : "MORE")})");
            await Wait(0.6);
        }
        foreach (var m in boss.Type.Moves) boss.S(m.Id).Due = held[m.Id];
    }

    // THE HOLD (F2, with F1's share rule). A row's Hold of x0 roots the hull: a share taken after the
    // lifts, on the whole helm (Status.Disabled would also silence its guns and its keys). The Sniper's
    // is its ANCHOR (kits6c: the railgun's locked charge is gone; the Anchor row lands in kits6c-J8).
    // From three seeded headings, a different pair of keys held each time, the anchored hull neither
    // moves nor turns; weighed, W moves it again.
    async Task LaneAHoldChecks(PlayerShip sn)
    {
        var pairs = new[] { (global::Godot.Key.W, global::Godot.Key.A), (global::Godot.Key.S, global::Godot.Key.D), (global::Godot.Key.W, global::Godot.Key.D) };
        foreach (var (k1, k2) in pairs)
        {
            sn.Rotation = VaryAngle(); sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
            await SniperAnchor(sn, true);
            var at = sn.Position; float rot = sn.Rotation;               // from the first frame the Anchor runs
            KeyDown(k1); KeyDown(k2); await Wait(0.6);
            float moved = sn.Position.DistanceTo(at), turned = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, sn.Rotation));
            bool rooted = sn.Held == 0f && sn.Sl("anchor").Left > 0;
            KeyUp(k1); KeyUp(k2);
            await SniperAnchor(sn, false);                               // weighed: the release runs out
            var free = sn.Position;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); await Wait(0.8); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
            float after = sn.Position.DistanceTo(free);
            Check(rooted && moved < 1f && turned < 0.005f && sn.Held == 1f && after > 5f,
                  $"the Anchor is a hold of x0 on the whole helm: {k1}+{k2} held 0.6 s at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg move it {moved:0.00} u and turn it {Mathf.RadToDeg(turned):0.00} deg; weighed, W moves it {after:0} u");
            sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
    }

    // DISABLED ON A PILOT (F2): the capitals' warp overshoot will be its one cause. It stops the helm,
    // the main guns and every key; point defence, a wing and turrets already out are not presses and
    // fight on. A warden (point defence always on, a main gun, hunters on a key) is disabled three
    // times at a seeded heading, a light raider held at a seeded spot inside its 420 u point-defence
    // reach; then, the status cleared, the same keys fire and move it (so the check can fail).
    // Each time it is TURNING when it is disabled -- W and a seeded rudder for a seeded 0.4-0.8 s,
    // then stopped dead with the yaw still on it -- because the rate a hull carries in turned it
    // on: zeroed only on the turning circle, a hull at pivot speed coasted it down (7.92 deg).
    async Task LaneADisabledChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        var wd = Me; wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
        var gun = Abilities.KeyFor(wd.Class, "guns");
        bool portFirst = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            wd.Rotation = VaryAngle(); wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var rudderKey = (run % 2 == 0) == portFirst ? global::Godot.Key.A : global::Godot.Key.D;
            // THE YAW IT CARRIES IN, read off the hull, never off the keys: each frame's turn is taken
            // from one frame's start to the next's -- across exactly one _process (a read begun after
            // a Wait, which ends a frame, spans none, and read 0) -- for a seeded 0.4-0.8 s AND until
            // it turns faster than 25 deg/s. Keys up and Disabled go on in the same breath, before
            // its next frame: that frame is its first disabled one, with this yaw on it.
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyDown(rudderKey);
            double turnFor = Vary(0.4f, 0.8f), turned0 = 0; float spin = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && (turned0 < turnFor || spin < Mathf.DegToRad(25f)); i++)
            {
                float r0 = wd.Rotation;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                spin = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(r0, wd.Rotation)) / (float)GetProcessDeltaTime();
                turned0 += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            }
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyUp(rudderKey);
            wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var prey = H.SpawnRaider(VaryNear(wd.Position, 300f), Enemies.Webifier);
            prey.Hp = 9000; prey.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            wd.Sl("hunters").Left = 0; wd.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
            wd.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 3.0);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var at = wd.Position; float rot = wd.Rotation;
            var seen = new HashSet<Shot>(Nodes<Shot>());
            int shellsHeld = 0, shellsFree = 0; bool pdOn = false;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.A); KeyDown(gun);
            wd.UseAbility("hunters", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 36; i++)
            {
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                foreach (var x in Nodes<Shot>()) if (seen.Add(x) && !x.HostileFire && !x.IsMissile) shellsHeld++;
                pdOn |= wd.PdTurrets.Any(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, prey));
            }
            float moved = wd.Position.DistanceTo(at), turned = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, wd.Rotation));
            bool noHunters = wd.Sl("hunters").Cool <= 0 && wd.Sl("hunters").Left <= 0;
            wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            var freeAt = wd.Position;
            for (int i = 0; i < 48; i++)
            {
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                foreach (var x in Nodes<Shot>()) if (seen.Add(x) && !x.HostileFire && !x.IsMissile) shellsFree++;
            }
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.A); KeyUp(gun);
            float freeMoved = wd.Position.DistanceTo(freeAt);
            Check(spin > Mathf.DegToRad(20f) && moved < 1f && turned < 0.005f && shellsHeld == 0 && noHunters && pdOn && shellsFree > 0 && freeMoved > 5f,
                  $"a DISABLED warden at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg, turning at {Mathf.RadToDeg(spin):0} deg/s on {rudderKey} when it is disabled: W+A move it {moved:0.00} u and turn it {Mathf.RadToDeg(turned):0.00} deg, its held trigger fires {shellsHeld} shells, its hunters key starts nothing ({noHunters}), and its point defence still takes the raider {prey.Position.DistanceTo(wd.Position):0} u off ({pdOn}); cleared, the same keys fire {shellsFree} and move it {freeMoved:0} u");
            prey.TakeDamage(99999);
            wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
        }
    }

    // HARDENED TAKES ITS SHARE FROM WHOEVER APPLIED IT (F2): a taunt's 0.67 lets 67 of a 100 blow
    // through; a second, harder application while it runs (0.5) is the one that holds; an applier
    // that names none gets the row's half. Each from a seeded side.
    async Task LaneAHardenedShareChecks(PlayerShip gd)
    {
        var runs = new[] { (first: 0.67, second: double.NaN, want: 67.0), (first: 0.67, second: 0.5, want: 50.0), (first: double.NaN, second: double.NaN, want: 50.0) };
        for (int run = 0; run < runs.Length; run++)
        {
            var (first, second, want) = runs[run];
            gd.ApplyStatus(Status.Hardened, 0.4, first);
            if (!double.IsNaN(second)) gd.ApplyStatus(Status.Hardened, 0.4, second);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double hp0 = gd.Hp;
            gd.Hit(100, gd.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 400f), $"test:share{run}");
            Check(gd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened) && Math.Abs(hp0 - gd.Hp - want) < 1e-6,
                  $"Hardened at the applier's share: applied at {first}{(double.IsNaN(second) ? "" : $" then {second}")}, a 100 blow lands for {hp0 - gd.Hp:0} (want {want:0})");
            await Wait(0.6);
        }
    }

    // ── LANE G (raids v2) READABILITY (§1e, N19's logic; the frames are Shots 49a/49b/49c): what every
    // peer draws of a squad reads SquadSight -- the radar's "1+3" label and bracket, the victim's
    // "GANK: GUNSHIP + 3 WEBIFIER" line, and each row's name under its hull for 3 s when the squad
    // comes into view and again at its commit; plus the adds' EXP in the TIO line and the hints ──
    async Task RaidsSightChecks()
    {
        var me = Me; var keepPos = me.Position; double keepMax = me.MaxHp;
        double pdKeep = PdReachOff(me);
        me.MaxHp = 5000; me.TakeDamage(-(me.MaxHp - me.Hp));
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        void Clear() { foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r); }
        bool InView(Node2D n) => n.GetViewportRect().HasPoint(n.GetGlobalTransformWithCanvas().Origin);
        List<Raider> MakeSquad(Vector2 at, float heading, params int[] kinds)
        {
            var sq = H.FormSquad(Squads.Gank, at, heading);
            return kinds.Select((k, i) => H.SpawnRaider(at + new Vector2(70f * (i - (kinds.Length - 1) / 2f), 40f * (i % 2)).Rotated(heading), k, sq)).ToList();
        }

        // THE WORDS, by literal: the TIO line from the rows (L6 light 6, heavy 18 at PL 6 / 3, 9 at
        // PL 12 / 3, 9 at L39 PL 78), and the two hints that now name the adds
        Check(TioWindow.AddsLine(6, 6) == "Adds: 6 EXP a light, 18 a heavy, the first time they come."
              && TioWindow.AddsLine(6, 12) == "Adds: 3 EXP a light, 9 a heavy, the first time they come."
              && TioWindow.AddsLine(39, 78) == "Adds: 3 EXP a light, 9 a heavy, the first time they come.",
              $"the TIO line names what the adds pay this pilot, from the rows ({TioWindow.AddsLine(6, 6)} | {TioWindow.AddsLine(6, 12)} | {TioWindow.AddsLine(39, 78)})");
        Check(Hints.All["pilot"].Body.Contains("their adds the first time they come") && Hints.All["boss"].Body.Contains("kill the webifiers"),
              "the pilot and boss hints name the adds: they pay EXP the first time they come, and their webs hold you for the beam");

        // THE LABEL AND THE CREW by composition, three squads apart: H+3L, 2 lights, a heavy and 2 pods
        {
            me.Position = Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(Vary(5200f, 6200f), Vary(3800f, 4800f)); me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var far = me.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(4400f, 5200f);
            var a = MakeSquad(far, VaryAngle(), Enemies.Gunship, Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Webifier);
            var b = MakeSquad(far + new Vector2(0, 900f), VaryAngle(), Enemies.Talon, Enemies.Talon);
            var c = MakeSquad(far - new Vector2(0, 900f), VaryAngle(), Enemies.Cross, Enemies.Pod, Enemies.Pod);
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            var groups = SquadSight.Groups(H.Raiders);
            List<Raider> G(List<Raider> sq) => groups.FirstOrDefault(g => g.Contains(sq[0])) ?? new List<Raider>();
            Check(groups.Count == 3 && SquadSight.Label(G(a)) == "1+3" && SquadSight.Label(G(b)) == "2" && SquadSight.Label(G(c)) == "1+2"
                  && SquadSight.Crew(G(a)) == "GUNSHIP + 3 WEBIFIER" && SquadSight.Crew(G(b)) == "2 TALON" && SquadSight.Crew(G(c)) == "CROSS + 2 POD"
                  && SquadSight.InFormation(G(a)) && SquadSight.InFormation(G(b)) && SquadSight.InFormation(G(c)),
                  $"squads read by id and tag, not type: {groups.Count} squads, labels {SquadSight.Label(G(a))} / {SquadSight.Label(G(b))} / {SquadSight.Label(G(c))} (1+3 / 2 / 1+2), crews '{SquadSight.Crew(G(a))}' / '{SquadSight.Crew(G(b))}' / '{SquadSight.Crew(G(c))}', all in formation");
            Clear(); await Wait(0.2);
        }

        // THE NAMES AND THE LINE on a live gank at this ship, in three situations, each from a seeded
        // bearing and range: still; crossing the approach at 60 u/s; running from a squad that comes up
        // astern (off dead astern by a seeded angle, closing at its 100 less this 60, so from nearer).
        // In each: named at the first frame the squad is in view and again at its commit; the victim's
        // line through the burn, and none once every member holds its line
        foreach (var (how, near, far) in new[] { ("still", 2600f, 3400f), ("crossing", 2200f, 2800f), ("from astern", 1750f, 2050f) })
        {
            me.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); me.TakeDamage(-(me.MaxHp - me.Hp));
            me.Position = Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(Vary(5200f, 6200f), Vary(3800f, 4800f)); me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.5);                                        // the camera settles on the ship
            var toSquad = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var at = me.Position + toSquad * Vary(near, far);
            float side = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f;
            var run = how switch
            {
                "crossing" => toSquad.Rotated(side * Mathf.Pi / 2f) * 60f,
                "from astern" => (-toSquad).Rotated(side * Vary(0.15f, 0.45f)) * 60f,
                _ => Vector2.Zero,
            };
            if (run != Vector2.Zero) me.Rotation = Aim.Along(run);
            var ms = MakeSquad(at, Aim.Face(at, me.Position), Enemies.Gunship, Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Webifier);
            async Task Step() { me.Velocity = me.Pinned ? Vector2.Zero : run; await Frame(); }
            double viewNames = -1, lockName = -1; float drop = -1; string burnLine = null, heldLine = "unread";
            bool formedFirst = SquadSight.InFormation(ms), formedInBurn = true;
            for (int f = 0; f < 60 * 30 && (viewNames < 0 || lockName < 0 || burnLine == null); f++)
            {
                if (viewNames < 0 && ms.Any(InView))
                {   // the first frame the squad shows: every member named, the ones off the screen too
                    await Step(); await Step();
                    viewNames = ms.Min(r => r.NameLeft); drop = ms.Min(r => r.LabelDrop);
                }
                var locker = ms.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Locking);
                if (lockName < 0 && locker != null)
                {   // the member that committed, read again after the wait: named afresh
                    await Step(); await Step();
                    lockName = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(locker) ? locker.NameLeft : 0;
                }
                if (burnLine == null && ms.Any(r => r.Locking))
                {
                    burnLine = SquadSight.GankLine(H.Raiders, H.Ships, me);
                    formedInBurn = SquadSight.InFormation(ms);
                }
                await Step();
            }
            for (int f = 0; f < 60 * 12 && ms.Any(r => r.Locking); f++) await Step();
            if (!ms.Any(r => r.Locking)) heldLine = SquadSight.GankLine(H.Raiders, H.Ships, me);
            Check(viewNames > 3.0 - 0.25 && viewNames <= 3.0 && Math.Abs(drop - 35f) < 1e-3,
                  $"{how}: a squad coming into view is named, every member for 3 s ({viewNames:0.00} s left two frames on), the range label dropped 35 under the name ({drop})");
            Check(lockName > 3.0 - 0.25 && lockName <= 3.0,
                  $"{how}: and named again as it commits ({lockName:0.00} s of 3 left two frames on)");
            Check(formedFirst && !formedInBurn && burnLine == "GANK: GUNSHIP + 3 WEBIFIER" && heldLine == null,
                  $"{how}: the victim's HUD line through the burn: '{burnLine}' (GANK: GUNSHIP + 3 WEBIFIER); in formation before it {formedFirst}, not during {!formedInBurn}; once all hold their lines, none ('{heldLine}')");
            Clear(); await Wait(0.3);
        }
        me.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
        me.MaxHp = keepMax; me.TakeDamage(-(me.MaxHp - me.Hp));
        me.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", pdKeep);
        me.Position = keepPos; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // POINT DEFENCE CANNOT BE SWITCHED OFF (F16), so a check that needs a hull's point defence out
    // of the way takes its reach to 0 for the while (test only) and gives the base back after.
    double PdReachOff(PlayerShip s)
    {
        double was = s.Stats.All.First(x => x.Id == "pd_range").Base;
        s.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", 0);
        return was;
    }

    // POINT DEFENCE IS PASSIVE (F16): no key, no window, no recharge -- it fires whenever its ship is
    // alive. Every hull that mounts it, each at a seeded spot, heading and reach: a light raider held
    // inside every mount's reach is taken by every mount with NOTHING pressed, at the row's rate --
    // 0.5 a shot every 0.5 s, 1 DPS a mount (the warden's one mount too: README ruling, hv-R6c-1).
    // Counted over 1.9 s from the first shot after all its mounts hold it: 3 or 4 shots a
    // mount, never a shot on the window's edge.
    async Task LaneAPassivePdChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var want = new Dictionary<ShipClass, (int mounts, double shot, float reach)> {
            [ShipClass.Battleship] = (2, 0.5, 460f), [ShipClass.Carrier] = (2, 0.5, 460f), [ShipClass.Destroyer] = (2, 0.5, 460f),
            [ShipClass.FreightHauler] = (2, 0.5, 460f), [ShipClass.FreightTender] = (2, 0.5, 460f), [ShipClass.FreightBastion] = (2, 0.5, 460f),
            [ShipClass.HeavyWarden] = (1, 0.5, 420f),
        };
        var pdHulls = Classes.All.Where(c => c.Ready && c.Has(Fit.Pd)).Select(c => c.Id).ToList();
        Check(pdHulls.Count == want.Count && pdHulls.All(want.ContainsKey),
              $"every hull that mounts point defence is in the passive-PD table ({pdHulls.Count} hulls, {want.Count} rows)");
        foreach (var dpl in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dpl);
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.2);
        foreach (var c in pdHulls.Where(want.ContainsKey))
        {
            await SetClass(c);
            var (mounts, shot, reach) = want[c];
            var s = Me; var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            await Wait(0.2);
            var prey = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * reach * Vary(0.25f, 0.5f));
            prey.Hp = 9000; prey.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var pds = s.PdTurrets;
            // on it AND swung onto it (inside the 8 degree cone a mount fires in): a slow battleship
            // mount can take 1.5 s to come round, and the window must not start while one is swinging
            bool OnAndAimed(Turret t) => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, prey)
                && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(t.GlobalRotation, (prey.Position - t.GlobalPosition).Angle())) < Mathf.DegToRad(4f);
            for (int i = 0; i < 240 && !pds.All(OnAndAimed); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool allOn = pds.Count == mounts && pds.All(OnAndAimed);
            double was = prey.Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && prey.Hp >= was; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double hp0 = prey.Hp;                                          // the clock starts on a shot
            for (int i = 0; i < 114; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double got = hp0 - prey.Hp, nominal = mounts * shot / 0.5 * 1.9;
            Check(allOn && hp0 < was && s.PdOnline && Abilities.Find(c, "pd") == null && Math.Abs(got - nominal) <= mounts * shot + 1e-9,
                  $"{Classes.NameOf(c)}: point defence with nothing pressed and no key for it -- {pds.Count} mounts on a light raider {prey.Position.DistanceTo(s.Position):0} u off at {Mathf.RadToDeg(s.Rotation):0} deg take {got:0.0} in 1.9 s ({mounts} x {shot} every 0.5 s: {nominal:0.0}, a shot a mount either way)");
            prey.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // A MOUNT THAT HOLDS GIVES WAY TO SOMETHING FREE THAT BETTERS IT (Turret.Acquire's `held`).
    // Passive point defence never starts a fresh pick, so a mount keeps what it holds -- until a
    // free one of its target's rank comes into reach while a sibling shares that target (it
    // spreads), or a free one of a LOWER rank does (a missile over a light). A battleship, a
    // carrier and a destroyer, each at a seeded spot, heading and side: every mount on one light;
    // a second light abeam on the other side; then a cruise missile standing still. Held for as
    // long as it lived (the old rule), every mount stays on the first light through both.
    async Task LaneAPdRepickChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.2);
        foreach (var hull in new[] { ShipClass.Battleship, ShipClass.Carrier, ShipClass.Destroyer })
        {
            await SetClass(hull);
            var s = Me; var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            // abeam, clear of the hull (110 u and more off the keel) and inside every mount's 460 u
            // reach (a mount sits within half the 378 u battleship of its centre)
            var fwd = Vector2.Up.Rotated(head);
            var abeam = new Vector2(-fwd.Y, fwd.X) * (Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? 1f : -1f);
            Raider Light(Vector2 p) { var l = H.SpawnRaider(p); l.Hp = 9000; l.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30); return l; }
            var pds = s.PdTurrets;
            var first = Light(at + abeam * Vary(110f, 170f) + fwd * Vary(-60f, 0f));
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && !pds.All(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, first)); i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            bool doubled = pds.Count >= 2 && pds.All(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, first));
            var second = Light(at - abeam * Vary(110f, 170f) + fwd * Vary(-60f, 60f));
            int spreadIn = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && spreadIn < 0; i++)
            {
                Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                if (pds.Any(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, first)) && pds.Any(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, second))) spreadIn = i + 1;
            }
            var cm = Combat.Fire(Shots.Cruise, at + abeam * Vary(110f, 170f) + fwd * Vary(90f, 150f), Vector2.Down, 0.001f, 4000f, 1, size: 3f, hull: 30);
            int missileIn = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && missileIn < 0; i++)
            {
                Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                if (pds.Any(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, cm))) missileIn = i + 1;
            }
            bool noneIdle = pds.All(t => t.Target != null);
            Check(doubled && spreadIn > 0 && missileIn > 0 && noneIdle,
                  $"{Classes.NameOf(hull)}: a point-defence mount gives way to something free that betters what it holds -- {pds.Count} mounts all on one light ({doubled}); a second light {at.DistanceTo(second.Position):0} u off: spread in {spreadIn} frames; a cruise missile {at.DistanceTo(cm.Position):0} u off: taken in {missileIn} frames, over the light that mount held; none left idle ({noneIdle})");
            first.TakeDamage(1e12); second.TakeDamage(1e12); cm.Intercept();
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // THE OUTGOING DOOR (F17): every hostile blow is scaled by the OutGuards row of each status on
    // whatever deals it, and a launcher's throw waits while one holds it. The table against the
    // sign-off's literals once (kits_v2 §5); then, from three seeded spots, three webifiers latched
    // on one pilot, each given a different one of the three statuses (a different one at each spot)
    // the frame after a blow of 1 lands, the hull each takes over the next 3.5 s read (its next
    // three blows, the window's end half a second from the fourth); then a gunship at a seeded edge,
    // its throw due as Suppressed goes on for a seeded 0.6-1.4 s: nothing thrown while it holds, the
    // throw the frame it lapses (a frame or two of play).
    async Task LaneAOutDoorChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var rows = StatusSet.OutGuards.ToDictionary(g => g.Status);
        bool Row(Status s, double gun, double move, double super, bool holds, Tag spares) =>
            rows.TryGetValue(s, out var g) && g.Gun == gun && g.Move == move && g.Super == super && g.HoldsThrow == holds && g.Spares == spares;
        var two = new StatusSet(); two.Apply(Status.Pinned, 1); two.Apply(Status.Suppressed, 1);
        var four = new StatusSet(); foreach (var s in new[] { Status.Pinned, Status.Suppressed, Status.Dazzled, Status.Jammed }) four.Apply(s, 1);
        Check(rows.Count == 3 && Row(Status.Suppressed, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, true, Tag.None) && Row(Status.Dazzled, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, true, Tag.Boss)
              && Row(Status.Jammed, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, true, Tag.Boss)
              && (int)Status.Suppressed == 64 && (int)Status.Dazzled == 128 && (int)Status.Jammed == 256 && two.Bits == 1 && four.Bits == 1,
              $"the outgoing door's table: Suppressed x0.5 guns, x0.7 a boss's move, x1.0 its super; Dazzled x1.0, Jammed x0 -- all three hold a throw, neither of the last two reaches a boss; 64 / 128 / 256 and host-only (Pinned + Suppressed on the wire: {two.Bits}; all four: {four.Bits})");

        var me = Me; double reach = PdReachOff(me);                     // the RAIDERS on trial, not the pilot's point defence
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.3);
        var shares = new[] { (st: Status.Suppressed, share: 0.5), (st: Status.Jammed, share: 0.0), (st: Status.Dazzled, share: 1.0) };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            await Wait(0.1);
            var webs = new List<Raider>();
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) { var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f)); w.Quarry = me; webs.Add(w); }
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !webs.All(w => w.Latched); i++) { me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double Dealt(Raider w) => me.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault($"raider:{w.NetId}");
            var last = webs.Select(Dealt).ToArray();
            var anchor = new[] { -1, -1, -1 }; var blow0 = new double[3]; var start = new double[3]; var got = new double[3];
            for (int f = 0; f < 60 * 8 && anchor.Any(a => a < 0 || f <= a + 210); f++)
            {
                me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                {
                    double now = Dealt(webs[k]);
                    if (anchor[k] < 0 && now > last[k] + 1e-9)
                    {   // a blow just landed: its status goes on now, a whole second before the next
                        anchor[k] = f; blow0[k] = now - last[k]; start[k] = now;
                        webs[k].ApplyStatus(shares[(k + run) % 3].st, 6.0);
                    }
                    else if (anchor[k] >= 0 && f == anchor[k] + 210) got[k] = now - start[k];
                    last[k] = now;
                }
            }
            bool ok = true; var said = new List<string>();
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                var (st, share) = shares[(k + run) % 3];
                // a jammed one has let go of its web as well (kits5-J9, the F17 latch columns); the others hold theirs
                bool one = anchor[k] >= 0 && Math.Abs(blow0[k] - 1.0) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(got[k] - 3 * share) < 1e-6
                           && webs[k].Latched == (st != Status.Jammed) && webs[k].Statuses.Has(st);
                ok &= one;
                said.Add($"{st} {webs[k].Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off: {got[k]:0.00} (want {3 * share:0.0}{(one ? "" : $"; first blow {blow0[k]:0.00}, latched {webs[k].Latched}")})");
            }
            Check(ok, $"a webifier's laser goes out through the door: three latched on a pilot, each after a blow of 1, land over their next 3 blows (a jammed one lets go of its web too) -- {string.Join("; ", said)}");
            foreach (var w in webs) w.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }

        var cdField = typeof(Raider).GetField("_missileCd", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        List<FxNode> Rings() => Nodes<FxNode>().Where(t => t.Id == Fx.WarnZone && Math.Abs(t.Radius - Raider.BlastRadius) < 0.1f).ToList();
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            // the pilot just outside the raid's edge at a seeded bearing, the gunship on the edge
            // spot nearest it -- where an unpinned target keeps it -- 300 to 450 u off: inside its 500
            var spot = Hub.BasePos + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * (Hub.RaidEdge + Vary(300f, 450f));
            void HoldPilot() { me.Position = spot; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
            HoldPilot(); me.Rotation = VaryAngle(); await Wait(0.1); HoldPilot();
            var hv = H.SpawnRaider(Raider.EdgeSpot(spot), Enemies.Gunship); hv.Quarry = me;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && hv.Target != me; i++) { HoldPilot(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double hold = Vary(0.6f, 1.4f);
            var seen = Rings().ToHashSet();
            // F20: the missile only throws at a PINNED target now -- pin the pilot directly (a
            // heavy that closes in while pinned stays well inside its own 500 u missile reach, so
            // the timing this checks is unaffected). Cleared after the run so it never outlives it.
            me.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 4.0);
            cdField.SetValue(hv, 0.0); hv.ApplyStatus(Status.Suppressed, hold);
            double t0 = me.Clock, lapsedAt = -1, thrownAt = -1;
            int lapse = -1, thrown = -1; bool whileHeld = false;
            for (int f = 0; f < 60 * 3 && thrown < 0; f++)
            {
                HoldPilot();
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                bool on = hv.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed);
                if (lapse < 0 && !on) { lapse = f; lapsedAt = me.Clock - t0; }
                if (Rings().Any(x => !seen.Contains(x))) { thrown = f; thrownAt = me.Clock - t0; whileHeld = on; }
            }
            Check(lapse >= 0 && thrown >= lapse && thrown - lapse <= 2 && !whileHeld && lapsedAt >= hold - 0.05,
                  $"a Suppressed gunship {hv.Position.DistanceTo(me.Position):0} u off holds its missile, due, for its {hold:0.00} s -- lapsed at {lapsedAt:0.00} s, thrown at {thrownAt:0.00} s ({thrown - lapse} frames after; {(whileHeld ? "THROWN WHILE HELD" : "nothing while held")})");
            hv.TakeDamage(1e12);
            me.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        me.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", reach);
    }

    // THE OUTGOING DOOR ON A BOSS (F17): Suppressed takes its moves to x0.7 and leaves its supers
    // whole; Dazzled and Jammed never reach it. Every clock held, three times: the pilot at a
    // seeded spot inside the Lancer's shockwave (33.5, not a super) and at a seeded reach and offset
    // down its beam (50 a judgement, a super), each started by hand and read off the hull it takes.
    async Task LaneAOutDoorBossChecks(Boss boss, PlayerShip me)
    {
        Check(StatusSet.Reaches(Status.Suppressed, Tag.Boss) && !StatusSet.Reaches(Status.Dazzled, Tag.Boss) && !StatusSet.Reaches(Status.Jammed, Tag.Boss)
              && StatusSet.Reaches(Status.Jammed, Tag.Light) && StatusSet.Reaches(Status.Dazzled, Tag.Heavy) && StatusSet.Reaches(Status.Jammed, Tag.Structure),
              "Suppressed reaches a boss; Dazzled and Jammed reach craft and structures, never a boss");
        var held = boss.Type.Moves.ToDictionary(m => m.Id, m => boss.S(m.Id).Due);
        foreach (var m in boss.Type.Moves) { boss.S(m.Id).Due = 999; boss.S(m.Id).At = Boss.Phase.Idle; }
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r);            // the fight's adds out of the way
        me.Hp = me.MaxHp;                                                 // three runs take about 380
        var wave = boss.S("wave"); var beam = boss.S("beam");
        await Wait(0.6);
        double Took(string source) => me.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault(source);
        async Task<double> WaveLands(Vector2 at)
        {
            double was = Took(wave.M.Source);
            wave.Due = 0.01;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && wave.At != Boss.Phase.Winding; i++) { me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            wave.T = 0.01;                                                // its ring is up: it lands on its next tick
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && Took(wave.M.Source) <= was + 1e-9; i++) { me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            wave.Due = 999;
            return Took(wave.M.Source) - was;
        }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            boss.ApplyStatus(Status.Suppressed, Vary(4f, 6f));
            var waveAt = boss.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 280f);
            double sWave = await WaveLands(waveAt);
            await Wait(0.6);
            boss.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            float reach = Vary(350f, 900f), off = Vary(-15f, 15f);
            double was = Took(beam.M.Source), sBeam = 0;
            beam.At = Boss.Phase.Winding; beam.T = 0.01;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && sBeam <= 0; i++)
            {
                var (la, lb) = boss.Segment("beam"); var dir = (lb - la).Normalized();
                me.Position = la + dir * reach + dir.Orthogonal() * off; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                sBeam = Took(beam.M.Source) - was;
            }
            beam.At = Boss.Phase.Idle;                                    // one judgement is all this reads
            bool suppressed = boss.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed);
            boss.Statuses.Clear(Status.Suppressed);
            await Wait(0.6);
            boss.ApplyStatus(Status.Dazzled, Vary(4f, 6f)); boss.ApplyStatus(Status.Jammed, Vary(4f, 6f));
            bool refused = !boss.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled) && !boss.Statuses.Has(Status.Jammed);
            var plainAt = boss.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 280f);
            double pWave = await WaveLands(plainAt);
            Check(suppressed && refused && Math.Abs(sWave - 23.45) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(sBeam - 50) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(pWave - 33.5) < 1e-6,
                  $"a Suppressed boss: its shockwave on a pilot {waveAt.DistanceTo(boss.Position):0} u off lands {sWave:0.00} (33.5 x 0.7 = 23.45), its beam (a super) {reach:0} u down the line {sBeam:0.0} (50); Dazzled and Jammed put on nothing ({refused}), and the next shockwave {plainAt.DistanceTo(boss.Position):0} u off lands {pWave:0.0} (33.5)");
            await Wait(0.6);
        }
        foreach (var m in boss.Type.Moves) boss.S(m.Id).Due = held[m.Id];
    }

    // THE OUTGOING DOOR ON A STRUCTURE (F17): the pirate base's launcher, Suppressed, fires a round
    // that carries half its level-3 damage (126 x the level's scale). From three seeded bearings in
    // reach, any warning up spent first, its clock made due by hand; read off the round as it leaves.
    async Task LaneAOutDoorBaseChecks(Emplacement pbase, PlayerShip bs)
    {
        var lf = BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance;
        var cd = typeof(Emplacement).GetField("_cd", lf); var marked = typeof(Emplacement).GetField("_marked", lf);
        var fired = new List<Shot>(); var hook = Combat.ShotFired;
        Combat.ShotFired = s => { hook?.Invoke(s); if (s.Kind == Shots.Cruise && s.HostileFire && s.Position.DistanceTo(pbase.Position) < 400f) fired.Add(s); };
        double full = 126 * Missions.DamageMult(3, 1);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = pbase.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1700f, 2300f);
            void HoldAt() { foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r); bs.Position = at; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
            foreach (var c in Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Cruise && x.Alive).ToList()) c.Intercept();
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && (int)marked.GetValue(pbase) != 0; i++) { HoldAt(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            fired.Clear();
            pbase.ApplyStatus(Status.Suppressed, Vary(4f, 6f)); cd.SetValue(pbase, 0.0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && fired.Count == 0; i++) { HoldAt(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            var round = fired.FirstOrDefault();
            Check(round != null && Math.Abs(round.Damage - full * 0.5) < 1e-6 && pbase.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed),
                  $"a Suppressed base's launcher, the pilot {at.DistanceTo(pbase.Position):0} u off: its round carries {round?.Damage ?? -1:0.00} (126 x {Missions.DamageMult(3, 1):0.000} x 0.5 = {full * 0.5:0.00})");
            round?.Intercept();
            pbase.Statuses.Clear(Status.Suppressed);
        }
        Combat.ShotFired = hook;
    }

    // THE HOSTILE DAMAGE DOOR (F4 + F18, D17): every player-side blow now goes through Dealt.Deal,
    // which deals the damage then credits the shooter by a weapon id (PlayerShip.DealtBy). Proved as
    // an EQUALITY over one window -- never a hit count or a DPS, so there is no knife edge in how
    // many shots land in it: what the target lost across the window must be exactly what
    // DealtBy[weapon] grew by in it. From three varied spots each: the BB's main guns ("shell") and
    // its own point defence ("pd") together, a freighter's dropped turret ("turret", credited to its
    // OWNER, never the turret itself), the railgun ("rail") and the warden's hunters, a torpedo
    // ("torpedo"). The echo's own storage and blast are unchanged plumbing and stay proved by its
    // existing checks above (what it remembers, and puts down where the last of it landed).
    async Task LaneADamageDoorChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        {
            var bs = Me;
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                bs.Position = at; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bs.Rotation = VaryAngle();
                // ONE TARGET AT A TIME: a main-gun shell travels in a straight line to its aim
                // point, so a light spawned at some independent random angle could sit in that
                // line (or a PD tick could reach a heavy placed close enough) and take a stray
                // hit credited to the OTHER weapon -- a knife edge in the geometry, not the door.
                // Isolating each weapon's target removes the chance of it rather than dodging it.
                var mainSpot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f);
                var mainTgt = H.SpawnRaider(mainSpot, Enemies.Gunship);
                mainTgt.Hp = 1e9;                                        // a heavy: point defence never picks it
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double mainHp0 = mainTgt.Hp, mainDealt0 = bs.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell");
                // a real Space hold, not the field set directly: LocalFlight polls the keyboard
                // itself every frame and would otherwise zero Trigger right back on the next one.
                // HELD IN PLACE: unpinned, a heavy's own AI heads for the map's edge nearest its
                // target (TickHeavy) -- at 700% boost that is well out of gun range inside a
                // couple of seconds, which is the geometry this check hit, not the door.
                AimWorld(mainTgt.Position); KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Space);
                for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++)
                {
                    mainTgt.Position = mainSpot;
                    AimWorld(mainTgt.Position);
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                }
                KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space);
                double mainLost = mainHp0 - mainTgt.Hp, mainCredited = bs.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell") - mainDealt0;
                Check(mainLost > 0 && Math.Abs(mainLost - mainCredited) < 1e-6,
                      $"the BB's main guns, the pilot {at.DistanceTo(mainTgt.Position):0} u off: DealtBy[\"shell\"] grew {mainCredited:0.0}, the target lost {mainLost:0.0}");
                mainTgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
                {
                    double before = bs.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell"); int heard = 0;
                    void Hear(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (t == mainTgt) heard++; }
                    Dealt.Landed += Hear;
                    Dealt.Deal(mainTgt, Vary(20f, 80f), bs, "shell");
                    Dealt.Landed -= Hear;
                    Check(!mainTgt.Alive && Math.Abs(bs.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell") - before) < 1e-9 && heard == 0,
                          $"a blow on a target already dead credits nothing and is not announced (D17): DealtBy[\"shell\"] moved {bs.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell") - before:0.0}, Landed heard {heard}");
                }
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);

                var pdTgt = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 250f), Enemies.Webifier);
                pdTgt.Hp = 1e9;                                          // a light: point defence's alone here
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double pdHp0 = pdTgt.Hp, pdDealt0 = bs.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("pd");
                for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double pdLost = pdHp0 - pdTgt.Hp, pdCredited = bs.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("pd") - pdDealt0;
                Check(pdLost > 0 && Math.Abs(pdLost - pdCredited) < 1e-6,
                      $"the same BB's point defence, {at.DistanceTo(pdTgt.Position):0} u off: DealtBy[\"pd\"] grew {pdCredited:0.0}, the target lost {pdLost:0.0}");
                pdTgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            }
        }

        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var fr = Me; var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                fr.Position = at; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0; SentryAt(fr, at); await Wait(0.9);   // thrown at its own spot: 0.8 s in flight
                var gun = H.Deployed.FirstOrDefault(t => t.OwnerId == fr.OwnerId);
                var centre = gun?.Position ?? at;
                var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(centre + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 300f), Enemies.Gunship);
                tgt.Hp = 1e9;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double hp0 = tgt.Hp, dealt0 = fr.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("turret");
                for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double lost = hp0 - tgt.Hp, credited = fr.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("turret") - dealt0;
                Check(lost > 0 && Math.Abs(lost - credited) < 1e-6 && gun != null,
                      $"a freighter's thrown sentry, {centre.DistanceTo(tgt.Position):0} u off: DealtBy[\"turret\"] on its OWNER (not the turret) grew {credited:0.0}, the target lost {lost:0.0}");
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
                gun?.TakeDamage(1e9);                                    // clear it before the next run's FirstOrDefault
            }
        }

        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        {
            var sn = Me;
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                sn.Position = at; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sn.Rotation = VaryAngle();
                var dir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(sn.Rotation);               // the railgun fires along the hull's heading
                var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(at + dir * Vary(200f, 400f), Enemies.Gunship);
                tgt.Hp = 1e9;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double hp0 = tgt.Hp, dealt0 = sn.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("rail");
                await RailFire(sn);                                      // a full charge on Space, let go
                await Wait(0.1);
                double lost = hp0 - tgt.Hp, credited = sn.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("rail") - dealt0;
                Check(lost > 0 && Math.Abs(lost - credited) < 1e-6,
                      $"the railgun, the pilot {at.DistanceTo(tgt.Position):0} u off along its heading: DealtBy[\"rail\"] grew {credited:0.0}, the target lost {lost:0.0}");
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            }
        }

        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        {
            var wd = Me;
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 350f), Enemies.Gunship);
                tgt.Hp = 1e9;
                wd.Sl("hunters").Left = 0; wd.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double hp0 = tgt.Hp, dealt0 = wd.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("torpedo");
                wd.UseAbility("hunters", 0);
                for (int i = 0; i < 180; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double lost = hp0 - tgt.Hp, credited = wd.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("torpedo") - dealt0;
                Check(lost > 0 && Math.Abs(lost - credited) < 1e-6,
                      $"a torpedo, the warden's hunters {at.DistanceTo(tgt.Position):0} u off: DealtBy[\"torpedo\"] grew {credited:0.0}, the target lost {lost:0.0}");
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
                wd.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
            }
        }

        // THE BASE'S LASER GOES THROUGH THE DOOR TOO: no ship dealt it, so no NoteDealt hears it, but
        // Dealt.Landed hears every blow the door lands -- and over the window it must hear exactly what
        // the base's own laser tally (LaserDealt) grew by, under the base's weapon id. From three
        // varied spots inside the laser's 300 u, a light held there.
        {
            var bdn = H.GetNode<BaseDefense>("BaseDefense");
            double heard = 0; int blows = 0;
            System.Action<IHittable, double, string> ear = (t, d, w) => { if (w == Dealt.Base) { heard += d; blows++; } };
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var spot = Hub.BasePos + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(120f, 260f);
                var bt = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Webifier); bt.Hp = 1e9;
                heard = 0; blows = 0; double laser0 = bdn.LaserDealt;
                Dealt.Landed += ear;
                for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) { bt.Position = spot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                Dealt.Landed -= ear;
                double laser = bdn.LaserDealt - laser0;
                Check(blows > 0 && Math.Abs(heard - laser) < 1e-9,
                      $"the base's laser, a light {spot.DistanceTo(Hub.BasePos):0} u from the base: {blows} blows through the door as \"base\" ({heard:0.0}), what its laser dealt ({laser:0.0})");
                bt.TakeDamage(1e12);
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
        }

        // THE ECHO STORES EXACTLY WHAT WAS DEALT WHILE IT RUNS, AND NOTHING AFTER (D17): a real hit
        // through the door while it runs is stored; the frame its Left ends it detonates, and that
        // blast (DealtBy["reverb"]) stores nothing; a real hit after it is credited (DealtBy["shell"])
        // and stores nothing either. From three varied spots, a heavy held still (never point
        // defence's pick).
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        {
            var ec = Me;
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(120f, 200f);
                var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Gunship); tgt.Hp = 1e9;
                ec.Sl("reverb").Left = 0; ec.Sl("reverb").Cool = 0; ec.Sl("reverb").Own = 0;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                ec.UseAbility("reverb", 0);
                for (int i = 0; i < 30 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left <= 0; i++) { tgt.Position = spot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                Dealt.Deal(tgt, 40, ec, "shell");
                double stored = ec.Sl("reverb").Own;
                ec.Sl("reverb").Left = 0.3;
                double echo0 = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Reverb);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left > 0; i++) { tgt.Position = spot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                double ownAtEnd = ec.Sl("reverb").Own, blast = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Reverb) - echo0;
                double shell0 = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell");
                Dealt.Deal(tgt, 25, ec, "shell");
                double ownAfterHit = ec.Sl("reverb").Own;
                for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) { tgt.Position = spot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                Dealt.Deal(tgt, 25, ec, "shell");
                double ownLater = ec.Sl("reverb").Own, shellAfter = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell") - shell0;
                Check(Math.Abs(stored - 40) < 1e-9 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left <= 0 && blast > 0 && ownAtEnd == 0 && ownAfterHit == 0 && ownLater == 0 && Math.Abs(shellAfter - 50) < 1e-9,
                      $"the echo, a heavy {at.DistanceTo(spot):0} u off: stores the 40 dealt while it runs ({stored:0}); its end and its own {blast:0.0} blast store {ownAtEnd:0}; two 25 hits after it are credited ({shellAfter:0}) and store {ownAfterHit:0} / {ownLater:0}");
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
                ec.Sl("reverb").Cool = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // F1'S RAMP (D18): the pure step, proved directly (RampSpec.Step) before any row carries it --
    // v3 3.6's own future numbers for the Dart's Ramjet (build 0.10, cap 0.50, bleed 0.20) on a
    // 260 u/s sheet, so the mechanism is proved with the SAME numbers 6d will actually use. Varied
    // by frame rate (1/30, 1/60, 1/144 s: 30, 60 and 144 Hz), never by the literals asserted --
    // proves the accumulation itself is frame-rate independent, not merely correct once.
    void LaneARampChecks()
    {
        const double sheet = 260, build = 0.10, cap = 0.50, bleed = 0.20;
        double[] marks = { 1, 3, 5, 7 };
        double[] wantTop = { 286, 338, 390, 390 };
        foreach (double dt in new[] { 1.0 / 30, 1.0 / 60, 1.0 / 144 })
        {
            double own = 0;
            int stepsSoFar = 0;
            for (int m = 0; m < marks.Length; m++)
            {
                int stepsTo = (int)Math.Round(marks[m] / dt);
                for (; stepsSoFar < stepsTo; stepsSoFar++)
                    own = RampSpec.Step(own, build, cap, bleed, holding: true, condHolds: true, yawShare: 0, dt);
                double top = sheet * (1 + own);
                Check(Math.Abs(top - wantTop[m]) < 3,
                      $"at {1 / dt:0} Hz: the ramp after {marks[m]:0} s straight at full throttle -- top {top:0.0} u/s (want {wantTop[m]:0})");
            }
            // 1 s of full rudder: still running (holding), still at full throttle (condHolds), the
            // yaw at the hull's own turn rate (yawShare 1) -- build and bleed both apply, net -0.10/s.
            int turnSteps = (int)Math.Round(1.0 / dt);
            for (int i = 0; i < turnSteps; i++)
                own = RampSpec.Step(own, build, cap, bleed, holding: true, condHolds: true, yawShare: 1, dt);
            double topTurned = sheet * (1 + own);
            Check(Math.Abs(topTurned - 364) < 3,
                  $"at {1 / dt:0} Hz: 1 s of full rudder bleeds the ramp -- top {topTurned:0.0} u/s (want 364)");
            // released (not holding): drains toward 0 at cap a second, so a full second empties it
            // whatever it started at -- 0 by 9.0 s of TOTAL elapsed (7 s straight + 1 s turning + this).
            int drainSteps = (int)Math.Round(1.0 / dt);
            for (int i = 0; i < drainSteps; i++)
                own = RampSpec.Step(own, build, cap, bleed, holding: false, condHolds: false, yawShare: 0, dt);
            Check(own < 1e-9,
                  $"at {1 / dt:0} Hz: released, the ramp drains to {sheet * own:0.000} u/s of top within 1 s (0 by 9.0 s total)");
        }
    }

    // A TEST-ONLY RAMP ROW (never in the catalogue), put IN PLACE of the class's last open slot under
    // that slot's own id, so every copy of the ship already has its slot (no refit; host and guest
    // keep the same slot count, so the host's report reaches it). The Dart's own numbers (v3 3.6:
    // build 0.10, cap 0.50, bleed 0.20) and a flat add of 60 u/s, on stat ids GiveRampStats puts on
    // one ship's sheet; it builds on the throttle (W). Returns the open row, for PutBackOpenRow.
    AbilityDef PutTestRampRow(ShipClass c)
    {
        var rows = Abilities.For(c);
        int k = Array.FindIndex(rows, a => a.Id == "open6");
        var kept = rows[k];
        rows[k] = new AbilityDef { Id = kept.Id, Name = kept.Name, Short = kept.Short, Open = true, Default = kept.Default, Blurb = kept.Blurb,
                                   SpeedAdd = "test_ramp_add",
                                   Ramp = new RampSpec { Build = "test_ramp_build", Cap = "test_ramp_cap", Bleed = "test_ramp_bleed",
                                                         Condition = _ => Input.IsKeyPressed(global::Godot.Key.W) } };
        return kept;
    }
    void PutBackOpenRow(ShipClass c, AbilityDef kept)
    {
        var rows = Abilities.For(c);
        rows[Array.FindIndex(rows, a => a.Id == kept.Id)] = kept;
    }
    void GiveRampStats(PlayerShip s)
    {
        var byId = (Dictionary<string, Stat>)typeof(ShipStats).GetField("_byId", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(s.Stats);
        foreach (var (id, v) in new[] { ("test_ramp_build", 0.10), ("test_ramp_cap", 0.50), ("test_ramp_bleed", 0.20), ("test_ramp_add", 60.0) })
            byId[id] = new Stat { Id = id, Label = id, Unit = "", Group = "Test", Base = v };
    }
    // THE HOST'S REPORT of this ship, as a guest's own ship receives it: every slot field from the
    // host's copy, whose ramp is never stepped there (Own 0 -- the host has no helm to read).
    void ApplyHostReport(PlayerShip s)
    {
        var rows = Abilities.For(s.Class);
        int n = rows.Length + 1;
        var left = new float[n]; var cool = new float[n]; var own = new float[n]; var cnt = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < rows.Length; i++)
        {
            var sl = s.Sl(rows[i].Id);
            left[i + 1] = (float)sl.Left; cool[i + 1] = (float)sl.Cool; cnt[i + 1] = sl.N;
            own[i + 1] = rows[i].Ramp != null ? 0f : (float)sl.Own;
        }
        s.ApplyHostState(s.Hp, s.MaxHp, s.Alive, 0, s.Statuses.Bits, 0, left, cool, own, cnt, 0, 0,
                         Array.Empty<Vector2>(), Array.Empty<float>(), Array.Empty<int>(), Array.Empty<float>());
    }

    // F1'S RAMP, WIRED (D18): a test-only Ramp row on the hull (PutTestRampRow). Its 1 + Own is a
    // lift (Lifts -> SpeedMult); TickAbilities steps it from the helm every frame (+0.10 a second
    // straight on the throttle; minus 0.20 x the yaw share on a turn, the yaw read from THIS frame's
    // Steer); its SpeedAdd reaches Steer's cap; and a host report (ApplyHostReport) does not reset it
    // on the owner's own ship. From 3 varied turn rates (the speed the turn starts at) and rudders.
    async Task LaneARampWiringChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var me = Me; var cls = me.Class;
        var kept = PutTestRampRow(cls);
        GiveRampStats(me);
        var yawF = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_yawRate", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        double turnRate = me.Stats["turn_rate"];
        var rudders = new[] { global::Godot.Key.A, global::Godot.Key.D, global::Godot.Key.A };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            me.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle(); me.AutopilotTo = null;
            yawF.SetValue(me, 0f);
            me.Sl("open6").Own = 0; me.Sl("open6").Left = 600;
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            // STRAIGHT, on the throttle: the clock starts on the first frame the ramp shows, never on the key
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && me.Sl("open6").Own <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double o0 = me.Sl("open6").Own, c0 = me.Clock;
            for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double o1 = me.Sl("open6").Own, took = me.Clock - c0;
            float lift = me.SpeedMult;
            ApplyHostReport(me);
            double kept1 = me.Sl("open6").Own;
            Check(o0 > 0 && Math.Abs((o1 - o0) - 0.10 * took) < 1e-3 && Math.Abs(lift - (1 + o1)) < 1e-4 && kept1 == o1,
                  $"a ramp row on the hull, {took:0.00} s straight on the throttle: +{o1 - o0:0.000} (0.10 a second: {0.10 * took:0.000}), a lift of x{lift:0.000} (1 + {o1:0.000}), and the host's report leaves the owner's {kept1:0.000}");
            // ITS SpeedAdd, INTO Steer's CAP: driven far past it, the hull is held to sheet x (1 + Own) + 60
            double ownPrev = me.Sl("open6").Own;
            me.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(me.Rotation) * 3000f;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double wantTop = me.Stats["max_speed"] * (1 + ownPrev) + 60;
            Check(Math.Abs(me.SpeedAhead - wantTop) < 1.5,
                  $"...and its flat add reaches the helm's cap: {me.SpeedAhead:0.0} u/s (sheet {me.Stats["max_speed"]:0} x {1 + ownPrev:0.000} + 60 = {wantTop:0.0})");
            // A TURN, begun at a varied speed (so at a varied rate), on the throttle still: each frame
            // steps +0.10 - 0.20 x |yaw| / the rudder limit, with that frame's yaw
            float v0 = Vary(0.4f, 0.9f) * (float)(me.Stats["turn_radius"] * turnRate);
            me.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(me.Rotation) * v0;
            KeyDown(rudders[run]);
            double want = me.Sl("open6").Own, clock = me.Clock, shareSum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++)
            {
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double dt = me.Clock - clock; clock = me.Clock;
                double share = Math.Min(1, Math.Abs((float)yawF.GetValue(me)) / turnRate);
                shareSum += share * dt;
                want = Math.Clamp(want + (0.10 - 0.20 * share) * dt, 0, 0.50);
            }
            ApplyHostReport(me);
            double got = me.Sl("open6").Own;
            KeyUp(rudders[run]); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
            Check(shareSum > 0.2 && Math.Abs(got - want) < 1e-3,
                  $"...then a turn begun at {v0:0} u/s (a yaw share of {shareSum:0.00} over the second): the ramp reads {got:0.0000}, its frames' own sum {want:0.0000}, and the host's report left it");
        }
        me.Sl("open6").Own = 0; me.Sl("open6").Left = 0; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        PutBackOpenRow(cls, kept);
    }

    // F1'S ADD (D18): the pure formula, PlayerShip.TopSpeed -- sheet x lift (already Scale(shares))
    // plus every running row's flat add, then the hold on the whole. Three varied tuples, one of
    // them the plan's own literal (v31 3.4); the third proves the hold takes Add too, not just the
    // lift.
    void LaneASpeedAddChecks()
    {
        var cases = new (float sheet, float lift, double add, float hold, float want)[]
        {
            (260f, 1.5f, 100, 1f, 490f),
            (200f, 1.2f, 50, 1f, 290f),
            (300f, 1.0f, 60, 0.5f, 180f),
        };
        foreach (var (sheet, lift, add, hold, want) in cases)
        {
            float top = PlayerShip.TopSpeed(sheet, lift, add, hold);
            Check(Math.Abs(top - want) < 1e-3,
                  $"Add: {sheet:0} x {lift:0.00} + {add:0} = {top:0.0} at a hold of x{hold:0.00} (want {want:0})");
        }
    }

    // ── LANE B · F22 HELM ROWS (kits_v31 §3.5) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The capitals are cut (BB 88, CV 99, DD 117) and the freighters raised to 120, each thrust
    // moved with its top so every hull reaches its top in the time it did. The literals are the
    // request's; "today's" pairs are the sheet before F22 (BB 104/56, CV 116.48/58.24, DD 130/70,
    // freighters 85/45), and the time to 95% of top is worked from them with the sheet's own drag.
    // Then flown: three changed hulls from rest at seeded headings, the clock started on the first
    // frame the hull moves (never on the key), to 95% of its top.
    static double T95(double top, double thrust, double drag) => -Math.Log(1 - 0.95 * top * drag / thrust) / drag;
    async Task LaneBHelmChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        bool N9(double a, double b) => Math.Abs(a - b) < 1e-9;
        var bb = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship); var cv = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Carrier); var dd = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var frs = new[] { ShipClass.FreightHauler, ShipClass.FreightTender, ShipClass.FreightBastion }.Select(c => new ShipStats(c)).ToList();
        Check(N9(bb["max_speed"], 88) && N9(cv["max_speed"], 99) && N9(dd["max_speed"], 117)
              && frs.All(f => N9(f["max_speed"], 120) && N9(f["thrust"], 63.5) && N9(f["reverse_thrust"], 28.2) && N9(f["reverse_speed"], 42.4)
                              && N9(f["turn_rate"], 0.85) && N9(f["turn_radius"], 150))
              && dd["max_speed"] > cv["max_speed"] && cv["max_speed"] > bb["max_speed"] && N9(cv["thrust"], 49.5),
              $"F22: tops BB 88, CV 99, DD 117 (DD > CV > BB) and the three freighters 120 (thrust 63.5, astern 28.2 / 42.4, turning unchanged); the carrier's thrust 49.5 ({bb["max_speed"]:0}/{cv["max_speed"]:0}/{dd["max_speed"]:0}/{frs[0]["max_speed"]:0})");
        double drag = bb["water_drag"];
        var today = new (string name, ShipStats now, double top, double thrust)[]
        {
            ("battleship", bb, 104, 56), ("carrier", cv, 116.48, 58.24), ("destroyer", dd, 130, 70),
            ("freighter", frs[0], 85, 45), ("tender", frs[1], 85, 45), ("bastion", frs[2], 85, 45),
        };
        foreach (var (name, now, top, thrust) in today)
        {
            double was = T95(top, thrust, drag), is_ = T95(now["max_speed"], now["thrust"], now["water_drag"]);
            Check(Math.Abs(is_ - was) < 0.05, $"F22: the {name} reaches 95% of its top in {is_:0.000} s, today's {was:0.000} s (within 0.05)");
        }
        // flown: the battleship, the carrier and a freighter, each from rest at a seeded heading
        foreach (var (cls, top, thrust) in new[] { (ShipClass.Battleship, 104.0, 56.0), (ShipClass.Carrier, 116.48, 58.24), (ShipClass.FreightHauler, 85.0, 45.0) })
        {
            await SetClass(cls);
            var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
            s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
            double t = 0; bool moving = false; float want = 0.95f * (float)s.Stats["max_speed"];
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && s.SpeedAhead < want; i++)
            {
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                if (!moving && s.SpeedAhead > 0.01f) moving = true;       // the first frame it moves
                else if (moving) t += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            }
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
            double was = T95(top, thrust, s.Stats["water_drag"]);
            Check(s.SpeedAhead >= want && Math.Abs(t - was) < 0.1,
                  $"F22 flown: a {cls} at {Mathf.RadToDeg(s.Rotation):0} deg reaches 95% of its {s.Stats["max_speed"]:0} u/s in {t:0.00} s from its first frame under way, today's {was:0.00} s (within 0.1: a frame's step)");
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── LANE B · F24 THE STRAFE HELM (kits_v31 §3.4, decision 1) ───────────────────────────────
    // Shift + A/D slide the nine sideways at half their top (lights 130, heavies 95, freighters 60;
    // full slide in 0.25 s, 0.25 s and 0.5 s), the nose holding its heading. The capitals carry
    // strafe_speed 0 and pivot as they always did. A web or Disabled leaves no slide; a hold of x0
    // (the Sniper's Anchor) roots it. The share rule on the pure figure:
    // buffs add, holds multiply after the sum.
    async Task<(float across, float turned, float ahead)> Slide(PlayerShip s, global::Godot.Key side, double secs)
    {
        float rot = s.Rotation;
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyDown(side);
        await Wait(secs);
        float across = s.SpeedAcross, turned = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, s.Rotation)), ahead = s.SpeedAhead;
        KeyUp(side); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Shift);
        return (across, turned, ahead);
    }
    async Task LaneBStrafeChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        Check(Mathf.IsEqualApprox(PlayerShip.StrafeTop(130f, 1f, 1f), 130f) && Mathf.IsEqualApprox(PlayerShip.StrafeTop(130f, 1.5f, 1f), 195f)
              && Mathf.IsEqualApprox(PlayerShip.StrafeTop(95f, 1.5f, 0.5f), 71.25f) && PlayerShip.StrafeTop(95f, 1.5f, 0f) == 0f,
              "F24 share rule on the slide: 130 stock, 195 lifted x1.5, a x0.5 hold after the lifted sum 71.25 (not 95), a x0 hold 0");
        bool N9(double a, double b) => Math.Abs(a - b) < 1e-9;
        Check(new[] { ShipClass.Battleship, ShipClass.Carrier, ShipClass.Destroyer }.All(c => new ShipStats(c)["strafe_speed"] == 0)
              && new[] { ShipClass.LightDart, ShipClass.LightEcho, ShipClass.LightWraith }.All(c => N9(new ShipStats(c)["strafe_speed"], 130) && N9(new ShipStats(c)["strafe_thrust"], 520))
              && new[] { ShipClass.HeavySniper, ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, ShipClass.HeavyWarden }.All(c => N9(new ShipStats(c)["strafe_speed"], 95) && N9(new ShipStats(c)["strafe_thrust"], 380))
              && new[] { ShipClass.FreightHauler, ShipClass.FreightTender, ShipClass.FreightBastion }.All(c => N9(new ShipStats(c)["strafe_speed"], 60) && N9(new ShipStats(c)["strafe_thrust"], 120)),
              "F24 rows: the capitals 0 (they never slide); lights 130 at 520, heavies 95 at 380, freighters 60 at 120");
        Check(Abilities.Reserved.Contains(global::Godot.Key.Shift) && Abilities.Bind(ShipClass.LightDart, "guns", global::Godot.Key.Shift) != null,
              "Shift is a fixed control: it cannot be bound to anything");
        // a light, a heavy and a freighter, from rest at seeded headings, each to a seeded side
        foreach (var (cls, want) in new[] { (ShipClass.LightDart, 130f), (ShipClass.HeavyWarden, 95f), (ShipClass.FreightHauler, 60f) })
        {
            await SetClass(cls);
            var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
            s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            bool starboard = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f;
            var (across, turned, ahead) = await Slide(s, starboard ? global::Godot.Key.D : global::Godot.Key.A, 1.0);
            float signed = starboard ? across : -across;
            Check(Math.Abs(signed - want) < 3f && Mathf.RadToDeg(turned) < 0.5f && Math.Abs(ahead) < 1f,
                  $"F24: a {cls} at {Mathf.RadToDeg(s.Rotation):0} deg, Shift + {(starboard ? "D" : "A")} from rest: it slides {signed:0.0} u/s to {(starboard ? "starboard" : "port")} (want {want:0} ±3), the nose moves {Mathf.RadToDeg(turned):0.00} deg (under 0.5), {ahead:0.0} u/s ahead");
            await Wait(1.0);
            Check(Math.Abs(s.SpeedAcross) < 3f, $"F24: Shift released, the keel takes the slide back off ({s.SpeedAcross:0.0} u/s a second later)");
            // WEBBED: no slide, as no rudder
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 3.0); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var (acrossPinned, _, _) = await Slide(s, starboard ? global::Godot.Key.A : global::Godot.Key.D, 0.8);
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            Check(Math.Abs(acrossPinned) < 1f, $"F24: webbed, Shift + A/D slides a {cls} at {acrossPinned:0.00} u/s: none");
            // DISABLED: no slide
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 3.0); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var at = s.Position;
            var (acrossOff, _, _) = await Slide(s, starboard ? global::Godot.Key.D : global::Godot.Key.A, 0.8);
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            Check(Math.Abs(acrossOff) < 1f && s.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 1f, $"F24: disabled, Shift + A/D slides a {cls} at {acrossOff:0.00} u/s ({s.Position.DistanceTo(at):0.00} u moved): none");
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
        }
        // ROOTED: the sniper's Anchor is a hold of x0 -- Shift + A/D moves it nowhere
        {
            await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
            var sn = Me; sn.AutopilotTo = null;
            sn.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); sn.Rotation = VaryAngle(); sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
            await SniperAnchor(sn, true);
            var at = sn.Position; double secs = Math.Min(1.0, sn.Sl("anchor").Left - 0.1);
            bool held = sn.Held == 0f;
            var (acrossHeld, _, _) = await Slide(sn, Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? global::Godot.Key.D : global::Godot.Key.A, secs);
            Check(held && Math.Abs(acrossHeld) < 0.01f && sn.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 0.5f,
                  $"F24: held at x0 (the Anchor), Shift + A/D moves the sniper {sn.Position.DistanceTo(at):0.00} u in {secs:0.0} s at {acrossHeld:0.00} u/s: none");
            await SniperAnchor(sn, false);
            sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        // A CAPITAL: Shift + A/D is the rudder; dead in the water it pivots and never slides
        {
            await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
            var dd = Me; dd.AutopilotTo = null;
            dd.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dd.Rotation = VaryAngle(); dd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3); dd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var at = dd.Position;
            var (acrossCap, turnedCap, _) = await Slide(dd, Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? global::Godot.Key.D : global::Godot.Key.A, 1.5);
            Check(Math.Abs(acrossCap) < 0.5f && dd.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 1f && Mathf.RadToDeg(turnedCap) > 8f,
                  $"F24: a destroyer (strafe_speed 0) with Shift + A/D pivots {Mathf.RadToDeg(turnedCap):0.0} deg and never slides ({acrossCap:0.00} u/s, {dd.Position.DistanceTo(at):0.00} u)");
        }
    }

    // ── LANE B · F21 THE DRIVES (kits_v31 §3.4; kits_v3 §3.9) ─────────────────────────────────
