            Check(moved != build && back == build,
                  $"the build's fingerprint reads {what}: moved, {moved:x8} against the build's {build:x8}; put back, {back:x8}");
        }
        var parts = FingerprintParts();
        var named = new[] { "NetIds.Widths=", "Spawns.All=", "Hints.All=", "Sfx._gap=", "Abilities.Reserved=" };
        var missing = named.Where(n => !parts.Any(p => p.StartsWith(n, StringComparison.Ordinal))).ToList();
        Check(missing.Count == 0, $"the build's fingerprint has a part for each collection table ({(missing.Count == 0 ? "all five" : "missing " + string.Join(", ", missing))})");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            // a Dictionary<int, int>: one space's width
            var wk = widths.Keys.ElementAt(Rng.RandiRange(0, widths.Count - 1));
            int wv = widths[wk];
            Pair($"NetIds.Widths (space {wk} {wv} -> {wv + run + 1})", Moved(() => widths[wk] = wv + run + 1, () => widths[wk] = wv));
            // a Dictionary<string, double>: one sound's gap
            var gk = gap.Keys.ElementAt(Rng.RandiRange(0, gap.Count - 1));
            double gv = gap[gk], gTo = gv * Vary(1.5f, 3f);
            Pair($"Sfx._gap ({gk} {gv:0.000} -> {gTo:0.000} s)", Moved(() => gap[gk] = gTo, () => gap[gk] = gv));
            // a Dictionary<string, (string, string)>: one hint's title
            var hk = Hints.All.Keys.ElementAt(Rng.RandiRange(0, Hints.All.Count - 1));
            var hv = Hints.All[hk];
            Pair($"Hints.All ({hk}'s title)", Moved(() => Hints.All[hk] = (hv.Title + " " + run, hv.Body), () => Hints.All[hk] = hv));
            // a List<SpawnKind>: one kind's burst, and the ORDER (the index is the kind on the wire)
            int si = Rng.RandiRange(0, Spawns.All.Count - 1);
            var sk = Spawns.All[si];
            float sb = sk.Burst, sTo = sb + Vary(1f, 20f);
            Pair($"Spawns.All ({sk.Id}'s burst {sb:0} -> {sTo:0})", Moved(() => sk.Burst = sTo, () => sk.Burst = sb));
            int sj = (si + 1 + Rng.RandiRange(0, Spawns.All.Count - 2)) % Spawns.All.Count;
            var sOther = Spawns.All[sj];
            Pair($"Spawns.All (kinds {si} and {sj} swapped)",
                 Moved(() => { Spawns.All[si] = sOther; Spawns.All[sj] = sk; }, () => { Spawns.All[si] = sk; Spawns.All[sj] = sOther; }));
            // a HashSet<Key>: one more reserved key
            var free = Enumerable.Range(0, 10).Select(i => global::Godot.Key.F1 + i).Where(k => !Abilities.Reserved.Contains(k)).ToArray();
            var rk = free[Rng.RandiRange(0, free.Length - 1)];
            Pair($"Abilities.Reserved (+{rk})", Moved(() => Abilities.Reserved.Add(rk), () => Abilities.Reserved.Remove(rk)));
        }
        // KEY ORDER, NOT INSERTION ORDER: a dictionary and a set rebuilt in reverse hash the same
        var gapWas = gap.ToList(); var resWas = Abilities.Reserved.ToList();
        int reversed;
        try
        {
            gap.Clear(); foreach (var kv in Enumerable.Reverse(gapWas)) gap[kv.Key] = kv.Value;
            Abilities.Reserved.Clear(); foreach (var k in Enumerable.Reverse(resWas)) Abilities.Reserved.Add(k);
            reversed = FingerprintNow();
        }
        finally
        {
            gap.Clear(); foreach (var kv in gapWas) gap[kv.Key] = kv.Value;
            Abilities.Reserved.Clear(); foreach (var k in resWas) Abilities.Reserved.Add(k);
        }
        Check(reversed == build, $"a dictionary and a set filled in the reverse order hash the same ({reversed:x8}, the build's {build:x8})");
        // THE GUARD: every static readonly System.Collections.Generic field is hashed or [Live] -- a new
        // table cannot go unhashed, and nothing a run fills in is ever part of the build
        var neither = new List<string>(); var both = new List<string>();
        foreach (var t in typeof(Net).Assembly.GetTypes().Where(t => t.Namespace == null && !t.Name.StartsWith("_") && !t.ContainsGenericParameters))
            foreach (var f in t.GetFields(st | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly).Where(f => f.IsInitOnly && f.FieldType.IsGenericType && f.FieldType.Namespace == "System.Collections.Generic"))
            {
                bool live = f.GetCustomAttribute<LiveAttribute>() != null;
                bool hashed = parts.Any(p => p.StartsWith($"{t.Name}.{f.Name}=", StringComparison.Ordinal));
                if (!live && !hashed) neither.Add($"{t.Name}.{f.Name}");
                if (live && hashed) both.Add($"{t.Name}.{f.Name}");
            }
        Check(neither.Count == 0 && both.Count == 0,
              $"every static readonly collection is a hashed table or [Live] (neither: {(neither.Count == 0 ? "none" : string.Join(", ", neither))}; both: {(both.Count == 0 ? "none" : string.Join(", ", both))})");
    }

    // ── F11 · THE PRISM (lane A slice 5, kits5-J2) ────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Pure (Prism.Resolve): theta is the asserted input (kits_v2 Warrior card): {0, 14, 16, 45, 59, 61, 120, 180}
    // gives SQUARE, SQUARE, SLANT, SLANT, SLANT, OPEN, OPEN, OPEN, from 3 varied guards, the light coming in
    // on either side of the guard.
    void LaneAPrismBandChecks()
    {
        float[] thetas = { 0f, 14f, 16f, 45f, 59f, 61f, 120f, 180f };
        int[] want = { 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, -1, -1, -1 };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float gAng = VaryAngle(); var g = Vector2.Right.Rotated(gAng);
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var got = thetas.Select(t => Prism.Resolve(g, -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(t))).Band).ToArray();
            Check(got.SequenceEqual(want) && Prism.Bands[0].Id == "square" && Prism.Bands[1].Id == "slant",
                  $"a guard at {Mathf.RadToDeg(gAng):0} deg, the light {(sign > 0 ? "left" : "right")} of it at theta 0/14/16/45/59/61/120/180: SQUARE, SQUARE, SLANT, SLANT, SLANT, OPEN, OPEN, OPEN ({string.Join(",", got)})");
        }
    }

    // Pure (Prism.Resolve): SQUARE sends 75% back along g and lets 25% straight on; SLANT at 40 deg
    // mirrors 50% at 80 deg off the line back to the source and bends 50% by 20 deg, to the other side of
    // the light from the mirror (the card's "SLANT at 40 deg mirrors 25 at 80 deg and bends 25 by 20 deg"),
    // from 3 varied guards and both sides.
    void LaneAPrismResolveChecks()
    {
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var g = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var uSq = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(1f, 13f)));
            var sq = Prism.Resolve(g, uSq);
            Check(sq.Band == 0 && sq.Out.DistanceTo(g) < 1e-4f && sq.Through.DistanceTo(uSq) < 1e-4f
                  && Math.Abs(sq.OutShare - 0.75) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sq.ThroughShare - 0.25) < 1e-9,
                  $"SQUARE at theta {sq.Theta:0.0}: 0.75 back along the guard, 0.25 straight on ({sq.OutShare} / {sq.ThroughShare})");
            var u = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(40f));
            var sl = Prism.Resolve(g, u);
            float mirrorOff = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(sl.Out.AngleTo(-u))), bend = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(u.AngleTo(sl.Through)));
            bool otherSide = Mathf.Sign(u.Cross(sl.Out)) != Mathf.Sign(u.Cross(sl.Through));
            Check(sl.Band == 1 && Mathf.Abs(mirrorOff - 80f) < 0.01f && Mathf.Abs(bend - 20f) < 0.01f && otherSide
                  && Math.Abs(sl.OutShare - 0.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sl.ThroughShare - 0.5) < 1e-9,
                  $"SLANT at 40 deg ({(sign > 0 ? "left" : "right")}): half mirrored at 80 deg ({mirrorOff:0.00}), half bent 20 deg ({bend:0.00}) to the other side of the light ({otherSide})");
        }
    }

    // World (Prism.Catch, host): the pilot Parrying, its guard on its nose, a 50 beam tick from a source
    // 400-1500 u off. SQUARE (theta 1-12 deg): a gunship on the guard 300-900 u out loses 37.5, credited
    // "prism". SLANT at 40 deg: a gunship on the mirror loses 25. OPEN (theta 65-170) and a ring: not caught.
    // A RAY reaches 900 u, a beam 1500: a gunship 1000-1400 u out on the guard is untouched by a caught ray.
    // The pilot's hull never moves. 3 varied spots and headings, the light from either side.
    async Task LaneAPrismSplitChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot;
            pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp; pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Parrying, 5.0);
            var g = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var uSq = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(1f, 12f)));
            var uSl = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(40f));
            var mirror = (uSl - 2f * uSl.Dot(g) * g).Normalized();
            var spots = new[] { at + g * Vary(300f, 900f), at + mirror * Vary(300f, 1400f), at + g * Vary(1000f, 1400f) };
            var foes = spots.Select(s => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(s, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            void Place() { for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k]; pm.Position = at; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.AimPoint = at + g * 600f; }
            double hull0 = pm.Hp;

            Place(); var hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt0 = pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(Dealt.Prism, out var dv) ? dv : 0;
            bool sq = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Beam, at - uSq * Vary(400f, 1500f), at + uSq * Vary(300f, 800f), 50, $"test:beam#{run}a");
            double credited = (pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(Dealt.Prism, out var dv2) ? dv2 : 0) - dealt0;
            double sqLost = hp[0] - foes[0].Hp;
            Check(sq && Math.Abs(sqLost - 37.5) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(credited - 37.5) < 1e-6,
                  $"a Parrying pilot at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg catches a 50 beam tick SQUARE: the gunship on its guard loses 37.5 ({sqLost:0.##}), credited as \"prism\" ({credited:0.##})");

            Place(); hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            bool sl = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Beam, at - uSl * Vary(400f, 1500f), at + uSl * Vary(300f, 800f), 50, $"test:beam#{run}b");
            double slLost = hp[1] - foes[1].Hp;
            Check(sl && Math.Abs(slLost - 25) < 1e-6,
                  $"...and a SLANT tick at 40 deg: the gunship on the mirror, {spots[1].DistanceTo(at):0} u out, loses 25 ({slLost:0.##})");

            Place(); hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            var uOpen = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(65f, 170f)));
            bool open = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Beam, at - uOpen * 800f, at + uOpen * 500f, 50, $"test:beam#{run}c");
            bool ring = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Area, at - uSq * 800f, at + uSq * 500f, 50, $"test:ring#{run}");
            Check(!open && !ring && Enumerable.Range(0, 3).All(k => hp[k] == foes[k].Hp),
                  $"...an OPEN tick (theta past 60) and a ring are not caught, and nothing is split ({open} / {ring})");

            Place(); hp = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            bool ray = Prism.Catch(pm, BlowKind.Ray, at - uSq * 600f, at, 10, $"test:ray#{run}");
            double rayNear = hp[0] - foes[0].Hp, rayFar = hp[2] - foes[2].Hp;
            Check(ray && Math.Abs(rayNear - 7.5) < 1e-6 && rayFar == 0,
                  $"...a caught ray (10) reaches 900 u: the gunship on the guard {spots[0].DistanceTo(at):0} u out takes 7.5 ({rayNear:0.##}), the one {spots[2].DistanceTo(at):0} u out nothing ({rayFar:0.##})");
            Check(pm.Hp == hull0, $"...and the catcher's own hull never moves ({hull0:0.#} -> {pm.Hp:0.#})");

            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying);
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // World (Prism.Walk, what Boss.Burn judges a beam with): a 50 tick down a 60 u segment through the
    // pilot, from 3 varied bearings. Not Parrying, the pilot loses 50. Parrying with its guard on the
    // source, it loses nothing and the gunship on its guard loses 37.5: the walk stopped at the catcher.
    async Task LaneAPrismWalkChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var g = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var u = -g.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-10f, 10f)));
            var a = at - u * Vary(500f, 1200f); var b = at + u * Vary(300f, 900f);
            var spot = at + g * Vary(300f, 900f);
            var foe = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Gunship); foe.Hp = 1e9;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            foe.Position = spot; pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.AimPoint = at + g * 600f;
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            double h0 = pm.Hp;
            Prism.Walk(a, b, 30f, 50, a, $"test:walk#{run}a", new[] { pm });
            double bare = h0 - pm.Hp;
            pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp; pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Parrying, 5.0);
            double f0 = foe.Hp; h0 = pm.Hp;
            Prism.Walk(a, b, 30f, 50, a, $"test:walk#{run}b", new[] { pm });
            Check(Math.Abs(bare - 50) < 1e-6 && pm.Hp == h0 && Math.Abs(f0 - foe.Hp - 37.5) < 1e-6,
                  $"a 50 beam tick walked through the pilot from {Mathf.RadToDeg(u.Angle()):0} deg: bare it lands 50 ({bare:0.##}); Parrying it lands 0 and the gunship on the guard loses 37.5 ({f0 - foe.Hp:0.##})");
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── F11 · ROUNDS REFLECT, RAYS SPLIT (lane A slice 5, kits5-J3) ────────────────────────────
    // World (Shot.Strike): a Parrying pilot (a display ship for the check, so its guard stays on its nose)
    // meets a hostile slug (20, 400 u/s) from 250-400 u, 3 varied headings. SQUARE (theta 1-12): a Reflect
    // round leaves along the guard at 600 u/s (x1.5) and the held gunship 250-500 u out on the guard loses
    // 20; SLANT (theta 25-45): along the mirror at 400 u/s (x1.0) into the gunship on the mirror; OPEN
    // (theta 70-85) lands 20 on the pilot. A cruise missile (never Reflectable) lands at theta 1-12.
    async Task LaneAPrismReflectChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me; bool demo = pm.Demo; pm.Demo = true;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var g = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            foreach (var (band, theta) in new[] { ("square", Vary(1f, 12f)), ("slant", Vary(25f, 45f)), ("open", Vary(70f, 85f)), ("cruise", Vary(1f, 12f)) })
            {
                var u = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(theta));
                var mirror = (u - 2f * u.Dot(g) * g).Normalized();
                var outDir = band == "slant" ? mirror : g;
                var spot = at + outDir * Vary(250f, 500f);
                var foe = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Gunship); foe.Hp = 1e9; foe.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
                pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.AimPoint = at + g * 600f;
                pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp; pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Parrying, 10.0);
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double f0 = foe.Hp, h0 = pm.Hp;
                bool cruise = band == "cruise";
                Combat.Fire(cruise ? Shots.Cruise : Shots.Slug, at - u * Vary(250f, 400f), u, 400f, 1500f, 20, radius: 6f,
                            hitSource: $"test:{band}#{run}", hull: cruise ? 1e6 : 0);
                Shot back = null;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && foe.Hp == f0 && pm.Hp == h0; i++)
                {
                    pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.AimPoint = at + g * 600f; foe.Position = spot;
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    back ??= Combat.World.GetChildren().OfType<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.Kind == Shots.Reflect && s.Alive);
                }
                double lost = f0 - foe.Hp, took = h0 - pm.Hp;
                if (band == "square" || band == "slant")
                {
                    float want = band == "square" ? 600f : 400f;
                    Check(back != null && Mathf.Abs(back.Speed - want) < 0.01f && back.Dir.DistanceTo(outDir) < 1e-3f && Math.Abs(lost - 20) < 1e-6 && took == 0,
                          $"a slug caught {band.ToUpper()} at theta {theta:0} deg ({(sign > 0 ? "left" : "right")}): it goes back {(band == "square" ? "along the guard at x1.5" : "along the mirror at x1.0")} ({back?.Speed:0} u/s), the gunship {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u out loses its 20 ({lost:0.##}), the pilot nothing ({took:0.##})");
                }
                else
                    Check(Math.Abs(took - 20) < 1e-6 && lost == 0,
                          band == "open" ? $"a slug at theta {theta:0} deg (OPEN) lands its 20 on the Parrying pilot ({took:0.##})"
                                         : $"a cruise missile (never Reflectable) caught square at theta {theta:0} deg lands its 20 ({took:0.##})");
                pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
                foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
                await Wait(0.3);
            }
        }
        pm.Demo = demo; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // World (Raider.Strike through Prism.Catch): a webifier latched on the pilot, 250-400 u off at a varied
    // bearing. The pilot Parrying with its guard on the webifier: over 2 s its laser never lands on the
    // hull and the split credits the pilot "prism" (the light goes back into the webifier). The guard
    // turned away (cursor behind: clamped to 90 deg, the light OPEN): its laser lands again. 3 bearings.
    async Task LaneAPrismRayChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me; bool demo = pm.Demo; pm.Demo = true;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.3);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f)); w.Quarry = pm; w.Hp = 1e9;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !w.Latched; i++) { pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            async Task<(double took, double split)> Hold(bool facing)
            {
                double h0 = pm.Hp, d0 = pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(Dealt.Prism, out var v) ? v : 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++)
                {
                    var toW = (w.Position - at).Normalized();
                    pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot;
                    pm.AimPoint = at + (facing ? toW : -toW) * 500f;
                    pm.ApplyStatus(Status.Parrying, 1.0);
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                }
                return (h0 - pm.Hp, (pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(Dealt.Prism, out var v2) ? v2 : 0) - d0);
            }
            var (tookFacing, split) = await Hold(true);
            var (tookAway, _) = await Hold(false);
            Check(w.Latched && tookFacing == 0 && split > 0 && tookAway > 0,
                  $"a webifier latched {w.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off: with the guard on it, its laser splits ({split:0.00} credited \"prism\") and lands nothing ({tookFacing:0.00}); with the guard turned away it lands ({tookAway:0.00})");
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying); pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            w.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        pm.Demo = demo; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── F14 · THE PAINT FIRST (lane A slice 5, kits5-J4) ──────────────────────────────────────
    // World (Turret.Acquire / the hold rule through DeployedTurret.Prefer): a freighter's sentry (650 u)
    // 1800-2200 u from the pilot, a held gunship 540-630 u from it and a still seeker (a hulled one, so a
    // shot does not bring it down) 200-400 u from it, at varied bearings, 3 runs (kits_v31 3.1's sentry
    // lines). Unpainted it takes the seeker (rank 0). The gunship painted: it turns to it within 2 frames,
    // though the seeker is nearer and outranks it. The paint lapsing: it goes back to the seeker although
    // the gunship is still in reach. A gunship painted 700-780 u off (past the 650) does not take the gun;
    // moved to 560-620 u, still painted, it does within 2 frames.
    async Task LaneASentryPreferChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);                 // the paint lives in the spotter's slot (kits6b D33)
        var pm = Me;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.2);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var spot = yonder + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1800f, 2200f);
            var sentry = H.Drop(pm, spot, 1e9);
            var gSpot = spot + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(540f, 630f);
            var gun = H.SpawnRaider(gSpot, Enemies.Gunship); gun.Hp = 1e9; gun.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var sSpot = spot + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 400f);
            var seeker = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, sSpot, Vector2.Right, 0.01f, 1e6f, 0, hull: 1e9);
            async Task Frames(int n)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { gun.Position = gSpot; seeker.GlobalPosition = sSpot; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            }
            await Frames(20);
            bool onSeeker = ReferenceEquals(sentry.Aimed, seeker);
            pm.PaintOn(gun, Vary(0.8f, 1.2f));
            await Frames(2);
            bool turned = ReferenceEquals(sentry.Aimed, gun);
            Check(onSeeker && turned,
                  $"a sentry on an unpainted seeker {sSpot.DistanceTo(spot):0} u off ({onSeeker}) turns to a paint raised on a gunship {gSpot.DistanceTo(spot):0} u off within 2 frames ({turned}): the paint beats a nearer seeker");
            await Frames(90);
            bool back = ReferenceEquals(sentry.Aimed, seeker) && pm.Painted == null && gun.Alive;
            Check(back, $"...and when the paint lapses it goes back to the seeker, though the gunship is still in reach ({(sentry.Aimed as Node2D)?.Name})");
            // fr-R6b-5 THE PAINT ONLY WITHIN 650 u: a second held gunship painted 700-780 u off the sentry leaves
            // the gun on the nearer unpainted seeker; moved to 560-620 u (the paint still on it) it takes the gun
            // within 2 frames
            var fSpot = spot + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(700f, 780f);
            var far = H.SpawnRaider(fSpot, Enemies.Gunship); far.Hp = 1e9; far.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            async Task FarFrames(int n)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { far.Position = fSpot; gun.Position = gSpot; seeker.GlobalPosition = sSpot; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            }
            await FarFrames(2);
            pm.PaintOn(far, 5);
            await FarFrames(2);
            bool heldSeeker = ReferenceEquals(sentry.Aimed, seeker) && ReferenceEquals(pm.Painted, far);
            float farWas = fSpot.DistanceTo(spot);
            fSpot = spot + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(560f, 620f);
            await FarFrames(2);
            bool tookFar = ReferenceEquals(sentry.Aimed, far) && ReferenceEquals(pm.Painted, far);
            Check(heldSeeker && tookFar,
                  $"a gunship painted {farWas:0} u off the sentry (past its 650) leaves it on the seeker ({heldSeeker}); moved to {fSpot.DistanceTo(spot):0} u, still painted, it takes the gun within 2 frames ({tookFar})");
            pm.PaintOn(null, 0); far.TakeDamage(1e12);
            seeker.Intercept(); gun.TakeDamage(1e12); H.DeployedTaken(sentry);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE FREIGHTER'S SPOTTER: a hit paints (lane A slice 6b, kits6b-J1, D33/D34) ─────────────
    // World, host, 3 runs at varied bearings and range bands inside its 800 u (300-420, 480-600,
    // 660-760 u). The sheet is proved against the request's literals once (31.25 a round every 1.25 s,
    // 800 u, 560 u/s, paint 5 s); the world runs read the pilot's live sheet. Per run: the spotter's
    // first rounds on gunship A are credited "spotter", 1.25 s apart, and paint A by id; a round on
    // gunship B moves the paint (one target, the latest hit) and it is fresh at 5 s (timed from the
    // frame B's hit shows); with the trigger up the paint still holds 4.7 s after B's hit and is gone
    // by 5.3 s, though B lives. The paint is the guns slot's (N = the target's NetId): what rides the wire.
    async Task LaneA6bSpotterChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var fr = Me; fr.AutopilotTo = null;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["main_damage"] - 31.25) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["main_interval"] - 1.25) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["main_range"] - 800) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["shell_speed"] - 560) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["paint_time"] - 5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["hull"] - 450) < 1e-9
              && Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightHauler).Shot == Shots.Spotter && Shots.Of(Shots.Spotter).Paint == "paint_time"
              && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightHauler, "firemode") == null,
              $"the freighter's spotter: 31.25 every 1.25 s (25 DPS) to 800 u at 560 u/s, a hit paints 5 s, on a 450 hull, no fire mode ({sheet["main_damage"]}/{sheet["main_interval"]}/{sheet["paint_time"]})");
        var bands = new[] { (300f, 420f), (480f, 600f), (660f, 760f) };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.2);
            fr.PaintOn(null, 0);
            fr.Position = yonder; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            float bear = VaryAngle();
            var aSpot = yonder + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bear) * Vary(bands[run].Item1, bands[run].Item2);
            var bSpot = yonder + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bear + Vary(1.2f, 2.0f)) * Vary(bands[run].Item1, bands[run].Item2);
            var a = H.SpawnRaider(aSpot, Enemies.Gunship); a.Hp = 1e9; a.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 40);
            var b = H.SpawnRaider(bSpot, Enemies.Gunship); b.Hp = 1e9; b.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 40);
            double dealt = fr.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("spotter");
            var hits = new List<(double clock, double d)>();
            async Task Hold(Raider on, int frames, Func<bool> done)
            {
                KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Space);
                for (int i = 0; i < frames && !done(); i++)
                {
                    a.Position = aSpot; b.Position = bSpot; fr.Position = yonder; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    AimWorld(on.Position);
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    double now = fr.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("spotter");
                    if (now > dealt + 1e-9) { hits.Add((fr.Clock, now - dealt)); dealt = now; }
                }
                KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space);
            }
            await Hold(a, 600, () => hits.Count >= 2);
            bool firstPaints = hits.Count >= 2 && ReferenceEquals(fr.Painted, a) && fr.Sl(PlayerShip.PaintSlot).N == a.NetId;
            bool perRound = hits.Count >= 2 && hits.Take(2).All(h => Math.Abs(h.d - fr.Stats["main_damage"]) < 1e-6);
            double gap = hits.Count >= 2 ? hits[1].clock - hits[0].clock : -1;
            Check(firstPaints && perRound && Math.Abs(gap - fr.Stats["main_interval"]) < 0.06,
                  $"spotter run {run}, gunship A {aSpot.DistanceTo(yonder):0} u off: each round credited \"spotter\" at {fr.Stats["main_damage"]:0.00} ({perRound}), {gap:0.00} s apart, and A is painted by id ({firstPaints})");
            int had = hits.Count;
            await Hold(b, 600, () => hits.Count > had && ReferenceEquals(fr.Painted, b));
            double hitB = hits.Count > had ? hits[^1].clock : -1;
            bool moved = hits.Count > had && ReferenceEquals(fr.Painted, b) && fr.Sl(PlayerShip.PaintSlot).Left > fr.Stats["paint_time"] - 0.1;
            Check(moved, $"...a round on gunship B {bSpot.DistanceTo(yonder):0} u off moves the paint to B, fresh at {fr.Stats["paint_time"]:0.0} s: one target, the latest hit ({(fr.Painted as Node2D)?.Name})");
            while (hitB > 0 && fr.Clock - hitB < 4.7) { a.Position = aSpot; b.Position = bSpot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            bool held = ReferenceEquals(fr.Painted, b);
            while (hitB > 0 && fr.Clock - hitB < 5.3) { a.Position = aSpot; b.Position = bSpot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            Check(hitB > 0 && held && fr.Painted == null && b.Alive,
                  $"...the paint on B holds at 4.7 s after its hit ({held}) and has lapsed by 5.3 s, B still alive ({fr.Painted == null})");
            a.TakeDamage(1e12); b.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        fr.Position = yonder; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · TIME ON TARGET (lane A slice 6b, kits6b-J2, D36) ─────────────────────────────────────
    // The sheet against the request's literals once (40 a line, 14 u wide, guns join within 1500 u, cd
    // 16, F = ability 1: learned at level 1). World, host, 3 runs at varied bearings: a gunship 300-700 u
    // off, painted with 0.1-0.4 s of its 5 s left (age 4.6-4.9: fires). {0, 1, 3} landed sentries
    // 1440-1490 u from it, 0.4-1.3 rad off the hull's bearing; two more on one ray 52-69 deg off the hull's side, 900-1100 u and
    // 650-750 u out (the outer's line runs over the inner), and a battleship pilot on that ray 380-480 u out under
    // both lines (allies never hit, fr-R6b-6); one more at 1510-1570 u (silent); in runs 0 and 1 a throw
    // still in flight toward it (silent: no gun until it lands); a light raider on the spotter's line
    // 35-65% of the way. The gunship MOVING straight on a varied heading at {0, 130, 260} u/s (kits_v31 3.1's
    // Proves line; the kits6b gate fix): moved every frame for 0.25 s along its line, arriving on its spot the
    // frame of the press, so no sentry's range is on a knife edge. One press: the gunship takes {3, 4, 6} lines
    // of exactly 40 -- 40 x (k + 3) in all, 240 with five sentries -- all inside that one call (the same tick); the light across the spotter's line 40; the pilot credited "tot" for
    // every one; no sentry of its own touched. A second press: COOLING, the clock at the sheet's 16
    // (the pilot's cooling share). The paint let lapse (0.05-0.15 s left, then 0.3 s): NO PAINT, nothing
    // lands, nothing cools.
    async Task LaneA6bTotChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var fr = Me; fr.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = fr.Demo; fr.Demo = true;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var row = Lines.Of(Lines.Tot);
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["tot_damage"] - 40) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["tot_width"] - 14) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["tot_reach"] - 1500) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["tot_cooldown"] - 16) < 1e-9
              && row.Id == "tot" && row.AtTarget && row.Stops == 0 && row.Side == LineSide.Hostiles
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.FreightHauler, 1) == Ab.Tot && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightHauler, "tot") == global::Godot.Key.F,
              $"time on target: 40 a line, 14 u wide, every gun within 1500 u, cooldown 16 s, on F as ability 1 ({sheet["tot_damage"]}/{sheet["tot_width"]}/{sheet["tot_reach"]}/{sheet["tot_cooldown"]})");
        var blows = new List<(IHittable t, double d)>();
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == Dealt.Tot) blows.Add((t, d)); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        var ks = new[] { 0, 1, 3 };
        var speeds = new[] { 0f, 130f, 260f };
        var mate = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.Battleship, 5, yonder + new Vector2(0, 3400));   // fr-R6b-6: a pilot on a line
        var mateAt = mate.Position;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
            await Wait(0.2);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f);
            var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var tSpot = home + dir * Vary(300f, 700f);
            float rot = dir.Angle() + Mathf.Pi / 2;              // the spotter's mount ahead, on the line to the gunship
            fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = rot;
            var gun = H.SpawnRaider(tSpot, Enemies.Gunship); gun.Hp = 1e9; gun.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var cross = H.SpawnRaider(home + dir * (tSpot.DistanceTo(home) * Vary(0.35f, 0.65f))); cross.Hp = 1e9; cross.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var mine = new List<DeployedTurret>();
            float back = dir.Angle() + Mathf.Pi;                  // the far side of the gunship from the hull
            for (int i = 0; i < ks[run]; i++)
                mine.Add(H.Drop(fr, tSpot + Vector2.Right.Rotated(back + (i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * Vary(0.4f, 1.3f)) * Vary(1440f, 1490f), 1e9));
            mine.Add(H.Drop(fr, tSpot + Vector2.Right.Rotated(back + Vary(-1.3f, 1.3f)) * Vary(1510f, 1570f), 1e9));
            // fr-R6b-6 ALLIES NEVER HIT: two more of its own sentries (guns: within 1500 u) on one ray from the gunship
            // 52-69 deg off the hull's side, 900-1100 u and 650-750 u out, so the outer one's line runs over the inner
            // one; a battleship pilot on the same ray 380-480 u out, under both lines
            // (dropped after the in-flight throw below: a Drop passes the 3-out cap, a throw does not)
            var ray = dir.Rotated((run % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * Vary(0.9f, 1.2f));
            var outerAt = tSpot + ray * Vary(900f, 1100f);
            var innerAt = tSpot + ray * Vary(650f, 750f);
            mateAt = tSpot + ray * Vary(380f, 480f);
            double mateHp = mate.Hp;
            // the gunship on the move: straight along `heading` at speeds[run] u/s, 0.25 s back along its line to start,
            // its place each frame read off the clock, so it reaches tSpot on the frame of the press (the press follows
            // the last step with no frame between)
            var heading = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * speeds[run];
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
            {
                gun.Position = tSpot - heading * 0.25f; fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = rot; fr.AimPoint = tSpot; LaneA6bHold(mate, mateAt);
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            double moveEnd = fr.Clock + 0.25;
            var gunFrom = gun.Position; int moveFrames = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 120 && fr.Clock < moveEnd; i++, moveFrames++)
            {
                gun.Position = tSpot - heading * (float)Math.Max(0, moveEnd - fr.Clock);
                fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = rot; fr.AimPoint = tSpot; LaneA6bHold(mate, mateAt);
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            gun.Position = tSpot; LaneA6bHold(mate, mateAt); mateHp = mate.Hp; fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = rot; fr.AimPoint = tSpot;
            float travelled = gunFrom.DistanceTo(tSpot);
            bool moving = moveFrames >= 2 && Math.Abs(travelled - speeds[run] * 0.25f) < 0.5f;
            bool flying = false;
            if (run < 2)
            {
                fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0; int out0 = fr.TurretsOut;
                fr.AimPoint = home + dir * Vary(250f, 350f) + dir.Orthogonal() * Vary(80f, 140f);
                fr.UseAbility("deploy", 0);
                flying = fr.TurretsOut == out0 + 1 && H.Deployed.Count(t => t.OwnerId == fr.OwnerId) == mine.Count;
            }
            mine.Add(H.Drop(fr, outerAt, 1e9)); mine.Add(H.Drop(fr, innerAt, 1e9));
            // the paint, stale but alive: 4.6-4.9 s of its 5 gone
            fr.PaintOn(gun, 5); fr.Sl(PlayerShip.PaintSlot).Left = Vary(0.1f, 0.4f);
            fr.Sl("tot").Cool = 0;
            blows.Clear();
            double credit0 = fr.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Tot);
            fr.UseAbility("tot", 0);
            int onGun = blows.Count(b => ReferenceEquals(b.t, gun));
            bool each40 = blows.All(b => Math.Abs(b.d - 40) < 1e-9);
            int onCross = blows.Count(b => ReferenceEquals(b.t, cross));
            double credited = fr.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Tot) - credit0;
            double onGunAll = blows.Where(b => ReferenceEquals(b.t, gun)).Sum(b => b.d);
            bool mineWhole = mine.All(t => t.Hp >= 1e9 - 1e-6);
            bool mateWhole = Math.Abs(mate.Hp - mateHp) < 1e-9 && blows.All(b => !ReferenceEquals(b.t, mate) && !mine.Contains(b.t as DeployedTurret));
            Check(onGun == ks[run] + 3 && each40 && Math.Abs(onGunAll - 40 * (ks[run] + 3)) < 1e-6 && moving
                  && onCross == 1 && Math.Abs(credited - 40 * (ks[run] + 4)) < 1e-6 && mineWhole && mateWhole && (run == 2 || flying),
                  $"time on target run {run}: the gunship moving at {speeds[run]:0} u/s ({moving}: {travelled:0} u over {moveFrames} frames) took {onGunAll:0} in all (want {40 * (ks[run] + 3)}); {ks[run]} sentries 1440-1490 u off, two on one ray 650-1100 u off, one 1510-1570 u off{(run < 2 ? ", one in flight" : "")} -- the painted gunship {tSpot.DistanceTo(home):0} u off takes {onGun} lines (want {ks[run] + 3}) of 40 ({each40}) in the one press, the light across the spotter's line {onCross} (want 1), {credited:0} credited \"tot\", its own sentries untouched though one lies under another's line ({mineWhole}), the battleship pilot under both lines untouched ({mate.Hp:0} of {mateHp:0}: {mateWhole})");
            fr.UseAbility("tot", 0);
            double cool = fr.Sl("tot").Cool;
            Check(fr.FailNote("tot") == "COOLING" && Math.Abs(cool - fr.Cooling(fr.Stats["tot_cooldown"])) < 0.05 && fr.Stats["tot_cooldown"] == 16
                  && blows.Count == ks[run] + 4,
                  $"...a second press is refused COOLING ({fr.FailNote("tot")}), the clock at {cool:0.0} s of the sheet's 16, nothing more landing ({blows.Count})");
            fr.Sl("tot").Cool = 0;
            fr.Sl(PlayerShip.PaintSlot).Left = Vary(0.05f, 0.15f);
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) { gun.Position = tSpot; fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            blows.Clear();
            fr.UseAbility("tot", 0);
            Check(fr.Painted == null && gun.Alive && fr.FailNote("tot") == "NO PAINT" && blows.Count == 0 && fr.Sl("tot").Cool == 0,
                  $"...the paint lapsed (the gunship alive): NO PAINT ({fr.FailNote("tot")}), nothing lands ({blows.Count}), nothing cools ({fr.Sl("tot").Cool:0.0})");
            await Wait(1.0);                                     // the throw lands before the world is cleared
            gun.TakeDamage(1e12); cross.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        mate.QueueFree();
        foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
        fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0; fr.Sl("tot").Cool = 0; fr.Demo = demo;
        fr.Position = yonder; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE BUBBLE OVER EVERY FRIENDLY HULL (kits6b-J3) ─────────────────────────────────────
    // World, host, 3 runs at varied bearings: a fresh 400 bubble (260 u). One of its own sentries 240-255 u
    // off and one 265-285 u off; a blow of 20-60 into each: the inner one's hull is untouched and the pool
    // pays exactly the blow, the outer one's hull pays and the pool nothing. The same for a miner of the
    // base's fleet, the freighter parked 240-255 u and then 265-285 u from it. Nothing sits on 260 u.
    async Task LaneA6bBubbleCoverChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var fr = Me; fr.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = fr.Demo; fr.Demo = true;
        var mn = H.Yard.Gatherers.FirstOrDefault(g => g.Kind == GatherKind.Miner && g.InReach);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f);
            fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.1);
            var inner = H.Drop(fr, home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(240f, 255f), 120);
            var outer = H.Drop(fr, home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(265f, 285f), 120);
            fr.Sl("bubble").Cool = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Left = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Own = 0;
            fr.UseAbility("bubble", 0);
            double pool0 = fr.BubbleLeft, x1 = Vary(20f, 60f), x2 = Vary(20f, 60f);
            inner.TakeDamage(x1);
            double poolA = fr.BubbleLeft;
            outer.TakeDamage(x2);
            double poolB = fr.BubbleLeft;
            Check(Math.Abs(pool0 - 400) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(inner.Hp - 120) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(pool0 - poolA - x1) < 1e-9
                  && Math.Abs(outer.Hp - (120 - x2)) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(poolB - poolA) < 1e-9,
                  $"bubble run {run}: its own sentry {inner.Position.DistanceTo(home):0} u off takes {x1:0.0} out of the pool ({pool0:0} -> {poolA:0.0}, hull {inner.Hp:0}); one {outer.Position.DistanceTo(home):0} u off takes it on its hull ({outer.Hp:0.0}), the pool untouched ({poolB:0.0})");
            if (mn == null) { Check(false, "bubble: a miner of the base's fleet out in the field to cover"); continue; }
            mn.Hull = mn.MaxHull;
            double m0 = mn.Hull, x3 = Vary(20f, 60f), x4 = Vary(20f, 60f);
            fr.Position = mn.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(240f, 255f);
            double poolC = fr.BubbleLeft; mn.TakeDamage(x3);
            double inHull = mn.Hull, poolD = fr.BubbleLeft;
            fr.Position = mn.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(265f, 285f);
            mn.TakeDamage(x4);
            Check(Math.Abs(inHull - m0) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(poolC - poolD - x3) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(mn.Hull - (m0 - x4)) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(fr.BubbleLeft - poolD) < 1e-9,
                  $"...a miner inside it takes {x3:0.0} out of the pool ({poolC:0.0} -> {poolD:0.0}, hull {inHull:0}); outside, {x4:0.0} on its hull ({mn.Hull:0.0} of {m0:0})");
            mn.Hull = mn.MaxHull;
        }
        foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
        fr.Sl("bubble").Left = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Own = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Cool = 0; fr.Demo = demo;
        fr.Position = yonder; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · REDEPLOY (kits6b-J3, D41) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The sheet against the request once (a 150 u ring, 1.0 s, cd 20, on E as ability 3). World, host,
    // 3 runs: {1, 2, 3} sentries standing 300-900 u off at varied bearings, each with its own 40-110 of
    // 120 hull, the hull at a varied heading. E: none standing at once, all still out (in flight); they
    // land 1.0 s later (+- 0.05, timed from the press), each 150 u from where the hull stood, spaced
    // 120 deg from the bow, carrying the hulls they had. A second press: COOLING at the sheet's 20. With
    // none standing -- one throw only in flight -- NONE OUT, nothing cools.
    async Task LaneA6bRedeployChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var fr = Me; fr.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = fr.Demo; fr.Demo = true;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["redeploy_ring"] - 150) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["redeploy_flight"] - 1.0) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["redeploy_cooldown"] - 20) < 1e-9 && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.FreightHauler, 3) == Ab.Redeploy
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.FreightHauler, 2) == Ab.Bubble && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightHauler, "redeploy") == global::Godot.Key.E
              && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightHauler, "bubble") == global::Godot.Key.Q,
              $"redeploy: a 150 u ring, 1.0 s, cooldown 20, on E as ability 3 (the bubble on Q as ability 2) ({sheet["redeploy_ring"]}/{sheet["redeploy_flight"]}/{sheet["redeploy_cooldown"]})");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = rot;
            await Wait(0.1);
            int n = run + 1;
            var hulls = new List<double>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                double hp = Vary(40f, 110f); hulls.Add(hp);
                H.Drop(fr, home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 900f), hp, 120);
            }
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = rot;
            fr.Sl("redeploy").Cool = 0;
            fr.UseAbility("redeploy", 0);
            double pressed = fr.Clock;
            bool folded = fr.OwnLanded().Count == 0 && fr.TurretsOut == n;
            double landedAt = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && landedAt < 0; i++)
            {
                fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = rot;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                if (fr.OwnLanded().Count == n) landedAt = fr.Clock - pressed;
            }
            var bow = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var got = fr.OwnLanded();
            bool onRing = got.All(t => Math.Abs(t.Position.DistanceTo(home) - 150f) < 3f);
            // bearings from the bow wrapped into [-60, 300): the first slot sits ON the bow, so float noise puts it a
            // hair either side of 0 -- a [0, 360) wrap would send a -1e-6 to 359.99 and sort it last (kits6b gate fix)
            var slots = got.Select(t => Mathf.Wrap(Mathf.RadToDeg(bow.AngleTo(t.Position - home)), -60f, 300f)).OrderBy(a => a).ToList();
            bool spaced = slots.Select((a, k) => Math.Abs(a - 120 * k) < 2).All(x => x);
            bool kept = got.Select(t => t.Hp).OrderBy(x => x).Zip(hulls.OrderBy(x => x), (a, c) => Math.Abs(a - c) < 1e-6).All(x => x) && got.All(t => Math.Abs(t.MaxHp - 120) < 1e-9);
            Check(folded && Math.Abs(landedAt - 1.0) < 0.05 && got.Count == n && onRing && spaced && kept,
                  $"redeploy run {run}: {n} standing fold at once ({folded}) and land {landedAt:0.00} s later, 150 u round the hull ({onRing}) at {string.Join("/", slots.Select(a => a.ToString("0")))} deg from the bow ({spaced}), each with its own hull ({kept})");
            fr.UseAbility("redeploy", 0);
            Check(fr.FailNote("redeploy") == "COOLING" && Math.Abs(fr.Sl("redeploy").Cool - fr.Cooling(20)) < 1.2,
                  $"...a second press is refused COOLING ({fr.FailNote("redeploy")}), {fr.Sl("redeploy").Cool:0.0} s of the sheet's 20");
        }
        foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
        await Wait(0.1);
        fr.Sl("redeploy").Cool = 0; fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0;
        fr.AimPoint = fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 400f);
        fr.UseAbility("deploy", 0);
        fr.UseAbility("redeploy", 0);
        Check(fr.TurretsOut == 1 && fr.FailNote("redeploy") == "NONE OUT" && fr.Sl("redeploy").Cool == 0,
              $"redeploy with one throw in flight and none standing: NONE OUT ({fr.FailNote("redeploy")}), nothing cools");
        await Wait(1.0);
        foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
        fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0; fr.Demo = demo;
        fr.Position = yonder; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE BASTION'S SIEGE MORTAR (kits6b-J4, a Lob primary) ───────────────────────────────
    // The sheet against the request once (58.75 every 2.35 s = 25 DPS, 150-1100 u, 1.4 s, 110 u, hull 420,
    // no fire mode, no sentries). World, host, 3 runs at varied bearings and headings, Space held on a
    // cursor 60-120 u off (lands at 150), 400-900 u off (at the cursor) and 1150-1400 u off (at 1100): the
    // blast is marked on the cursor's bearing at that distance; it lands 1.4 s (+- 0.05) after the frame
    // its mark shows; three lights bunched 10-60 u round the point take 58.75 each, a gunship whose centre
    // is outside 110 u but whose bow, turned onto the point, is inside it takes 58.75, a light whose edge
    // is 60-120 u beyond the blast nothing; the pilot is credited "mortar" for the four, and its own hull
    // (the 150 u run lands on it) takes nothing.
    async Task LaneA6bMortarChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var bn = Me; bn.AutopilotTo = null;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var cd = Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["main_damage"] - 58.75) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["main_interval"] - 2.35) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["main_range"] - 1100) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["mortar_min"] - 150) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["mortar_flight"] - 1.4) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["mortar_blast"] - 110) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["hull"] - 420) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet.SustainedDps - (25 + 2 * sheet["pd_damage"] / sheet["pd_interval"])) < 1e-6
              && cd.Primary == Primary.Lob && cd.LobSide == Missiles.Mortar && !cd.Has(Fit.Deploy)
              && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightBastion, "firemode") == null && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightBastion, "deploy") == null,
              $"the bastion's mortar: 58.75 every 2.35 s (25 DPS) lobbed 150-1100 u, 1.4 s in the air, 110 u; hull 420; no fire mode, no sentries ({sheet["main_damage"]}/{sheet["main_interval"]}/{sheet["main_range"]}/{sheet["hull"]})");
        var blows = new List<(IHittable t, double d, double at)>();
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == Dealt.Mortar) blows.Add((t, d, bn.Clock)); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        var bands = new[] { (60f, 120f), (400f, 900f), (1150f, 1400f) };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            bn.Position = home; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bn.Rotation = rot; bn.Hp = bn.MaxHp;
            var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float cursorD = Vary(bands[run].Item1, bands[run].Item2);
            var cursor = home + way * cursorD;
            float wantD = Mathf.Clamp(cursorD, 150f, 1100f);
            var land = home + way * wantD;
            var lights = new List<Raider>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            {
                var l = H.SpawnRaider(land + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(10f, 60f)); l.Hp = 1e9; l.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30); lights.Add(l);
            }
            var side = way.Orthogonal() * (run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f);
            var gunship = H.SpawnRaider(land + side.Rotated(Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f)) * 200f, Enemies.Gunship); gunship.Hp = 1e9; gunship.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var outside = H.SpawnRaider(land - side * 400f, Enemies.Webifier); outside.Hp = 1e9; outside.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            // the gunship bow-on to the point, its centre out past 110 u and its bow inside it
            var gDir = (gunship.Position - land).Normalized();
            gunship.Rotation = (-gDir).Angle() + Mathf.Pi / 2;
            float gExt = land.DistanceTo(gunship.Position) - Raider.Gap(land, gunship);
            var gSpot = land + gDir * (110f + gExt * Vary(0.3f, 0.7f));
            var oDir = (outside.Position - land).Normalized();
            float oExt = land.DistanceTo(outside.Position) - Raider.Gap(land, outside);
            var oSpot = land + oDir * (110f + oExt + Vary(60f, 120f));
            float gRot = gunship.Rotation;
            void Hold() { bn.Position = home; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bn.Rotation = rot; gunship.Position = gSpot; gunship.Rotation = gRot; outside.Position = oSpot; }
            Hold();
            int pending0 = H.BlastsPending;
            blows.Clear();
            double credit0 = bn.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Mortar), hull0 = bn.Hp;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Space);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && H.BlastsPending == pending0; i++) { Hold(); AimWorld(cursor); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space);
            double marked = bn.Clock;
            var thrown = H.Blasts.LastOrDefault();
            bool placed = thrown.side == Missiles.Mortar && Math.Abs(thrown.at.DistanceTo(home) - wantD) < 1.5f && thrown.at.DistanceTo(land) < 1.5f
                          && Nodes<FxNode>().Any(f => f.Id == Fx.AimZone && f.Position.DistanceTo(land) < 1.5f);
            float gGap = Raider.Gap(land, gunship);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && blows.Count == 0; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double flew = blows.Count > 0 ? blows[0].at - marked : -1;
            int onLights = lights.Count(l => blows.Count(b => ReferenceEquals(b.t, l) && Math.Abs(b.d - 58.75) < 1e-9) == 1);
            bool gHit = blows.Count(b => ReferenceEquals(b.t, gunship) && Math.Abs(b.d - 58.75) < 1e-9) == 1;
            bool oMissed = !blows.Any(b => ReferenceEquals(b.t, outside));
            double credited = bn.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Mortar) - credit0;
            Check(placed && Math.Abs(flew - 1.4) < 0.05 && onLights == 3 && gHit && gSpot.DistanceTo(land) > 110f && gGap < 110f && oMissed
                  && Math.Abs(credited - 4 * 58.75) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(bn.Hp - hull0) < 1e-9,
                  $"mortar run {run}: a cursor {cursorD:0} u off lands the blast {thrown.at.DistanceTo(home):0} u out on its bearing ({placed}), {flew:0.00} s after its mark; 3 bunched lights take 58.75 each ({onLights}), a gunship {gSpot.DistanceTo(land):0} u off with its bow {gGap:0} u in takes it ({gHit}), a light past the blast nothing ({oMissed}); {credited:0.00} credited \"mortar\", its own hull untouched ({bn.Hp - hull0:0.0})");
            foreach (var l in lights) l.TakeDamage(1e12);
            gunship.TakeDamage(1e12); outside.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(2.4);                                     // the reload before the next run's first round
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        bn.Position = yonder; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE BUNKER BUSTER, PRESSED (kits6b-J5) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    // World, host, a fresh BASTION. Its sheet: 180 a round, 380 u/s, 1400 u, 12 s; F is the buster and Q the
    // shockwave. Three runs from varied spots and bearings, the first light 250-500, 600-900 and 1000-1300 u
    // down the line: F with the cursor on it throws ONE round from the main barrel that reaches it at 380 u/s
    // (+-0.1 s of its gap / 380), lands 180 on it (credited "buster"), and stops there -- a second light
    // 120-200 u behind it on the same line takes nothing. The clock is 12 and a second press is refused
    // (COOLING). Then, the clock cleared, a round down a fresh bearing at a light whose near edge is 1440-1500
    // u off the muzzle lands nothing and is gone by 1400 u.
    async Task LaneA6bBusterChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var bn = Me; bn.AutopilotTo = null;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var own = Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightBastion).Abilities.Where(a => !a.Weapon).Select(a => a.Id).ToList();
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["buster_damage"] - 180) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["buster_speed"] - 380) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["buster_range"] - 1400) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["buster_cooldown"] - 12) < 1e-9
              && own.Count >= 2 && own[0] == "buster" && own[1] == "shockwave"
              && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightBastion, "buster") == global::Godot.Key.F
              && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightBastion, "shockwave") == global::Godot.Key.Q,
              $"the bastion's bunker buster: 180 a round at 380 u/s out to 1400 u, every 12 s; ability 1 on F, the shockwave ability 2 on Q ({string.Join(", ", own)})");
        var blows = new List<(IHittable t, double d, double at)>();
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == "buster") blows.Add((t, d, bn.Clock)); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        var bands = new[] { (250f, 500f), (600f, 900f), (1000f, 1300f) };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float dA = Vary(bands[run].Item1, bands[run].Item2);
            var aAt = home + way * dA; var bAt = home + way * (dA + Vary(120f, 200f));
            var a = H.SpawnRaider(aAt); a.Hp = 1e9; a.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var b = H.SpawnRaider(bAt); b.Hp = 1e9; b.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            void Hold() { bn.Position = home; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bn.Rotation = rot; a.Position = aAt; b.Position = bAt; }
            Hold();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Hold();
            blows.Clear();
            double credit0 = bn.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("buster");
            bn.Sl("buster").Cool = 0;
            bn.AimPoint = aAt; bn.UseAbility("buster", 0);
            double pressed = bn.Clock;
            var round = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Buster && ReferenceEquals(x.Source, bn));
            var start = round?.Position ?? home;
            float gap = Raider.Gap(start, a);
            double cool = bn.Sl("buster").Cool;
            string refused = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightBastion, "buster").Refuse(bn, null);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && blows.Count == 0; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            await Wait(0.3);
            double flew = blows.Count > 0 ? blows[0].at - pressed : -1;
            bool onA = blows.Count(x => ReferenceEquals(x.t, a) && Math.Abs(x.d - 180) < 1e-9) == 1, onB = blows.Any(x => ReferenceEquals(x.t, b));
            double credited = bn.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("buster") - credit0;
            Check(round != null && start.DistanceTo(home) < 120f && onA && !onB && Math.Abs(flew - gap / 380f) < 0.1
                  && Math.Abs(credited - 180) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(cool - bn.Cooling(12)) < 1e-6 && refused == "COOLING",
                  $"buster run {run}: one round from the main barrel ({(round != null)}) reaches the light {gap:0} u off in {flew:0.00} s (want {gap / 380f:0.00} at 380 u/s), lands 180 on it ({onA}) and stops -- the light behind it takes {(onB ? "a blow" : "nothing")}; {credited:0} credited \"buster\"; its clock {cool:0.0} s (the sheet's 12: {bn.Cooling(12):0.0}), a second press {refused ?? "ALLOWED"}");
            // the reach: a fresh bearing, a light just past 1400 u of the muzzle
            a.TakeDamage(1e12); b.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.2);
            var far = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var farAt = home + far * 1600f;
            var c = H.SpawnRaider(farAt); c.Hp = 1e9; c.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            void HoldC() { bn.Position = home; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bn.Rotation = rot; c.Position = farAt; }
            HoldC();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            blows.Clear();
            bn.Sl("buster").Cool = 0;
            bn.AimPoint = farAt; bn.UseAbility("buster", 0);
            var longRound = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Buster && ReferenceEquals(x.Source, bn) && x.Alive);
            var from = longRound?.Position ?? home;
            var dirC = (farAt - from).Normalized();
            float want = Vary(1440f, 1500f);
            farAt = from + dirC * (want + (from.DistanceTo(farAt) - Raider.Gap(from, c)));    // its near edge `want` u off the muzzle
            HoldC();
            float edge = Raider.Gap(from, c);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && longRound != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(longRound) && longRound.Alive; i++) { HoldC(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            await Wait(0.2);
            bool gone = longRound == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(longRound) || !longRound.Alive;
            Check(longRound != null && gone && blows.Count == 0 && edge > 1400f,
                  $"buster run {run}: a round at a light whose edge is {edge:0} u off the muzzle lands nothing ({blows.Count} blows) and is gone at 1400 u ({gone})");
            c.TakeDamage(1e12);
            bn.Sl("buster").Cool = 0;
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        bn.Position = yonder; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE BUNKER BUSTER ON A BOSS (kits6b-J5, D42) ────────────────────────────────────────
    // In the boss fight, the boss held where it stands and its clocks held: three rounds of the Buster row
    // (180, as the press sends it) fired at it from 500-900 u past its edge on varied bearings each land 360 (x2 on a
    // boss) -- the rule is the row's, so the pilot's own class does not matter. A fourth with a light craft
    // 150-300 u short of the boss on its line lands 180 on the light (a craft is no boss) and nothing on
    // the boss: it stops on the first body.
    async Task LaneA6bBusterBossChecks(Boss boss, PlayerShip me)
    {
        var dues = boss.Type.Moves.ToDictionary(m => m.Id, m => boss.S(m.Id).Due);
        foreach (var m in boss.Type.Moves) boss.S(m.Id).Due = 999;
        var blows = new List<(IHittable t, double d)>();
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == "buster") blows.Add((t, d)); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        var bossAt = boss.Position;
        for (int run = 0; run < 4; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r);
            me.Hp = me.MaxHp;
            var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var from = bossAt + dir * (boss.HitRadius + Vary(500f, 900f));
            Raider light = null; Vector2 lightAt = default;
            if (run == 3)
            {
                lightAt = bossAt + dir * (boss.HitRadius + Raider.LightLength * 0.5f + Vary(150f, 300f));
                light = H.SpawnRaider(lightAt); light.Hp = 1e9; light.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            }
            void Hold() { boss.Position = bossAt; if (light != null) light.Position = lightAt; }
            Hold();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double hp0 = boss.Hp;
            blows.Clear();
            Combat.Fire(Shots.Buster, from, bossAt - from, 380f, 1400f, 180);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && blows.Count == 0; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            await Wait(0.2);
            boss.Hp = hp0;
            int onBoss = blows.Count(x => ReferenceEquals(x.t, boss) && Math.Abs(x.d - 360) < 1e-9);
            if (run < 3)
                Check(onBoss == 1 && blows.Count == 1,
                      $"buster on a boss, run {run}: a 180 round from {from.DistanceTo(bossAt):0} u lands {string.Join("/", blows.Select(x => $"{x.d:0}"))} on the boss (want one 360: x2 on a boss)");
            else
                Check(blows.Count == 1 && ReferenceEquals(blows[0].t, light) && Math.Abs(blows[0].d - 180) < 1e-9,
                      $"buster with a light craft {lightAt.DistanceTo(bossAt):0} u short of the boss on its line: the light takes {(blows.Count > 0 ? $"{blows[0].d:0}" : "nothing")} (want 180, a craft is no boss) and the boss nothing ({onBoss})");
            light?.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        foreach (var m in boss.Type.Moves) boss.S(m.Id).Due = dues[m.Id];
    }

    // ── 6b · THE BASTION AT A SIEGE (kits6b-J5) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The four pylons up, a fresh BASTION: (1) three pylons, each from 500-1000 u outside it on a varied
    // bearing: F on it lands 360 (x2 on a structure) and its hull drops 360. (2) the SHIELDED base from
    // 600-1000 u along a varied axis between the pylons: F lands 90 (a quarter of 360 through the shield)
    // and its hull drops 90, where any other blow is stopped. (3) Q from 400-700 u off the base on three
    // axes: nothing that holds a spot moves (base, pylons), every one of them inside 980 u is HELD 3 s, none
    // past 1020 u is, and a light 300-600 u off is thrown clear. Every hull and hold is put back after.
    // (1b) the DD's grapnel rip (1% of the pylon's maximum + 10) then F on three pylons: both add (fr-R6b-8).
    async Task LaneA6bSiegeChecks(Emplacement pbase, List<Emplacement> pylons)
    {
        var cls0 = Character.Class; var at0 = Me.Position; double max0 = Me.MaxHp;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var bs = Me; bs.AutopilotTo = null; bs.MaxHp = max0;      // the siege's pilot is kept alive the same way
        var blows = new List<(IHittable t, double d)>();
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == "buster") blows.Add((t, d)); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        async Task<(List<(IHittable t, double d)> got, double took)> Bust(Emplacement at, Vector2 home, System.Action before = null)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r);
            bs.Hp = bs.MaxHp;
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { bs.Position = home; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bs.Rotation = rot; }
            Hold();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Hold();
            double hp0 = at.Hp;
            blows.Clear();
            before?.Invoke();
            bs.Sl("buster").Cool = 0;
            bs.AimPoint = at.Position; bs.UseAbility("buster", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && blows.Count == 0; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            await Wait(0.2);
            double took = hp0 - at.Hp;
            at.Hp = hp0;
            return (blows.ToList(), took);
        }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var p = pylons[run];
            var outward = (p.Position - pbase.Position).Normalized().Rotated(Vary(-0.6f, 0.6f));
            var (got, took) = await Bust(p, p.Position + outward * Vary(500f, 1000f));
            Check(got.Count == 1 && ReferenceEquals(got[0].t, p) && Math.Abs(got[0].d - 360) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(took - 360) < 1e-6,
                  $"buster on pylon {run}: {string.Join("/", got.Select(x => $"{x.d:0}"))} landed, its hull down {took:0} (want 360: x2 on a structure)");
        }
        // fr-R6b-8 (b) DD RIP + BUNKER BUSTER ON ONE STRUCTURE (bastion.md Interactions: accepted, both add): the
        // grapnel's rip (1% of the pylon's maximum hull + 10, through the damage door as the DD's cast-off lands it)
        // and then the 360 buster, three pylons from varied spots: the hull drops by both, nothing taken off either
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var p = pylons[run];
            var outward = (p.Position - pbase.Position).Normalized().Rotated(Vary(-0.6f, 0.6f));
            double rip = 0.01 * p.MaxHp + 10;
            var (got, took) = await Bust(p, p.Position + outward * Vary(500f, 1000f), () => Dealt.Deal(p, rip, bs, "grapnel"));
            Check(got.Count == 1 && ReferenceEquals(got[0].t, p) && Math.Abs(got[0].d - 360) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(took - (360 + rip)) < 1e-6,
                  $"rip then buster on pylon {run}: the rip {rip:0.#} (1% of {p.MaxHp:0} + 10) and the buster {string.Join("/", got.Select(x => $"{x.d:0}"))}, its hull down {took:0.#} (want {360 + rip:0.#}: both add)");
        }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var axis = Vector2.Right.Rotated(Mathf.Pi / 2 * run + Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f));
            bool shielded = pbase.Shielded;
            var (got, took) = await Bust(pbase, pbase.Position + axis * Vary(600f, 1000f));
            Check(shielded && got.Count == 1 && ReferenceEquals(got[0].t, pbase) && Math.Abs(got[0].d - 90) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(took - 90) < 1e-6,
                  $"buster on the shielded base, run {run} (shield up: {shielded}): {string.Join("/", got.Select(x => $"{x.d:0}"))} landed, its hull down {took:0} (want 90: a quarter of 360 through the shield)");
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        var spots = H.Emplacements.ToList();
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r);
            foreach (var e in spots) e.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            var axis = Vector2.Right.Rotated(Mathf.Pi / 2 * run + Vary(-0.3f, 0.3f));      // between two pylons
            var home = pbase.Position + axis * Vary(400f, 700f);
            bs.Position = home; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bs.Hp = bs.MaxHp;
            var lt = H.SpawnRaider(home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 600f)); lt.Hp = 1e9; lt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bs.Position = home; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var was = spots.ToDictionary(e => e, e => e.Position);
            float ltWas = lt.Position.DistanceTo(home);
            bs.Sl("shockwave").Cool = 0;
            bs.UseAbility("shockwave", 0);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            int moved = spots.Count(e => e.Position.DistanceTo(was[e]) > 1f);
            var inside = spots.Where(e => was[e].DistanceTo(home) <= 980f).ToList();
            var outside = spots.Where(e => was[e].DistanceTo(home) > 1020f).ToList();
            int heldIn = inside.Count(e => Math.Abs(e.Statuses.Left(Status.Disabled) - 3) < 0.1);
            int heldOut = outside.Count(e => e.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled));
            float thrown = lt.Position.DistanceTo(home) - ltWas;
            Check(moved == 0 && inside.Count >= 1 && heldIn == inside.Count && heldOut == 0 && thrown > 900f,
                  $"shockwave at the siege, run {run}: nothing that holds a spot moved ({moved} of {spots.Count}), {heldIn} of the {inside.Count} inside 1000 u held 3 s, {heldOut} of the {outside.Count} past it held, and the light beside it thrown {thrown:0} u");
            lt.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
        foreach (var e in spots) e.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
        // (4) E on the base and on two pylons, from 400-700 u outside each: the structure under the well
        // never moves, and a held light 120-220 u from its centre is dragged at least 90 u in 0.5 s (kits6b-J6)
        var wellOn = new[] { pbase, pylons[0], pylons[1] };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r);
            LaneA6bWellsClear();
            var e = wellOn[run];
            var outward = run == 0 ? Vector2.Right.Rotated(Mathf.Pi / 2 * run + Vary(-0.3f, 0.3f)) : (e.Position - pbase.Position).Normalized().Rotated(Vary(-0.5f, 0.5f));
            var home = e.Position + outward * Vary(400f, 700f);
            bs.Position = home; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bs.Hp = bs.MaxHp;
            var lt = H.SpawnRaider(e.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(120f, 220f)); lt.Hp = 1e9; lt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bs.Position = home; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var eWas = e.Position; float ltWas = lt.Position.DistanceTo(e.Position);
            bs.Sl("well").Cool = 0;
            bs.AimPoint = e.Position; bs.UseAbility("well", 0);
            double t0 = bs.Clock;
            while (bs.Clock - t0 < 0.5) { bs.Position = home; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            float dragged = ltWas - lt.Position.DistanceTo(eWas), moved = e.Position.DistanceTo(eWas);
            Check(LaneA6bWells().Count == 1 && moved < 1f && dragged > 90f,
                  $"gravity well on the {(run == 0 ? "base" : "pylon")}, run {run}: the structure moved {moved:0.0} u (want none), a light {ltWas:0} u from its centre dragged {dragged:0} u in 0.5 s");
            lt.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
        LaneA6bWellsClear();
        await SetClass(cls0);
        if (Me is { } back) { back.MaxHp = max0; back.Hp = max0; back.Position = at0; back.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
    }

    // THE GRAVITY WELLS DOWN: the zones of row Zones.Well (Zones.cs), and all of them taken up.
    List<ZoneNode> LaneA6bWells() => H.Laid.Where(z => z.Row == Zones.Well).ToList();
    void LaneA6bWellsClear() { foreach (var z in LaneA6bWells()) H.Down(Spawns.Zone, z, burst: false, float.NaN); }

    // ── 6b · THE GRAVITY WELL (kits6b-J6; a Zones.All row since the gate fix, kits6b-J11) ─────────────
    // World, host, a fresh BASTION. Its zone row: cast up to 900 u, 280 u, 6 s, what Targeting.Pullable lets
    // it, pulling at the sheet's well_light / well_heavy; its sheet: 200 u/s on a light, 100 on a heavy,
    // 22 s; E is ability 3, laying the row. What moves is a raiding craft and nothing that holds a spot or flies
    // (Targeting.Pullable). Three runs from varied spots, the cursor 300-600, 700-880 and 1000-1300 u off
    // (the last clamped to 900 on its bearing): the well goes down there and is drawn there at 280 u; a
    // held light 150-250 u in is dragged at 200 u/s and a held gunship 150-250 u in at 100 u/s (timed from
    // the first frame either moves, over 0.5 s), a light 300-380 u out stays where it is; the clock is 22
    // and a second press is refused (COOLING); the well is gone 6 s after it went down. Then a webifier
    // LATCHED on the bastion, the well 80-180 u from it: it stays latched and is not dragged.
    async Task LaneA6bWellChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var bn = Me; bn.AutopilotTo = null;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var own = Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightBastion).Abilities.Where(a => !a.Weapon).Select(a => a.Id).ToList();
        var wz = Zones.Of(Zones.Well);
        Check(wz.Id == "well" && Zones.RowOf(wz) == Zones.Well && wz.Far == 900f && wz.Near == 0f && wz.Reach == 280f && wz.Length == 0f && wz.Life == 6.0
              && wz.Arm == 0 && wz.Prey.Equals(Targeting.Pullable) && wz.Light == "well_light" && wz.Heavy == "well_heavy" && wz.Holds == Status.None && wz.First == null
              && Ab.Well.Lays == wz && Ab.Well.Cooldown == "well_cooldown"
              && Math.Abs(sheet["well_light"] - 200) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["well_heavy"] - 100) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["well_cooldown"] - 22) < 1e-9
              && own.Count == 3 && own[2] == "well" && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightBastion, "well") == global::Godot.Key.E
              && Targeting.Pullable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Light }) && Targeting.Pullable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Heavy })
              && !Targeting.Pullable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Boss | Tag.Heavy }) && !Targeting.Pullable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Structure })
              && !Targeting.Pullable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Dummy | Tag.Light }) && !Targeting.Pullable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Missile })
              && !Targeting.Pullable.Hits(new S2Tagged { Tags = Tag.Hulled }),
              $"the bastion's gravity well: up to 900 u off, 280 u across its centre, 6 s, a light dragged 200 u/s and a heavy 100, every 22 s, ability 3 on E; it drags craft and never a boss, a structure, a dummy or anything in flight ({string.Join(", ", own)})");
        var bands = new[] { (300f, 600f), (700f, 880f), (1000f, 1300f) };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            LaneA6bWellsClear();
            await Wait(0.3);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float cursorD = Vary(bands[run].Item1, bands[run].Item2);
            var cursor = home + way * cursorD;
            var centre = home + way * Mathf.Min(cursorD, 900f);
            void Hold() { bn.Position = home; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bn.Rotation = rot; }
            Raider Held(Vector2 at, int kind) { var r = H.SpawnRaider(at, kind); r.Hp = 1e9; r.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30); return r; }
            var l = Held(centre + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 250f), Enemies.Webifier);
            var g = Held(centre + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 250f), Enemies.Gunship);
            var o = Held(centre + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 380f), Enemies.Webifier);
            Hold();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Hold();
            var oWas = o.Position;
            bn.Sl("well").Cool = 0;
            bn.AimPoint = cursor; bn.UseAbility("well", 0);
            double pressed = bn.Clock, cool = bn.Sl("well").Cool;
            string refused = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightBastion, "well").Refuse(bn, null);
            var laid = LaneA6bWells();
            bool placed = laid.Count == 1 && laid[0].At.DistanceTo(centre) < 1.5f;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
