            bool drawn = Nodes<ZoneNode>().Any(z => z.Row == Zones.Well && z.IsInsideTree() && z.Position.DistanceTo(centre) < 1.5f && z.Def.Reach == 280f);
            float lWas = l.Position.DistanceTo(centre), gWas = g.Position.DistanceTo(centre);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && l.Position.DistanceTo(centre) > lWas - 0.5f; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double t1 = bn.Clock; float l1 = l.Position.DistanceTo(centre), g1 = g.Position.DistanceTo(centre);
            while (bn.Clock - t1 < 0.5) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double span = bn.Clock - t1;
            double lRate = (l1 - l.Position.DistanceTo(centre)) / span, gRate = (g1 - g.Position.DistanceTo(centre)) / span;
            float oMoved = o.Position.DistanceTo(oWas);
            Check(placed && drawn && Math.Abs(lRate - 200) < 6 && Math.Abs(gRate - 100) < 4 && oMoved < 1f
                  && Math.Abs(cool - bn.Cooling(22)) < 1e-6 && refused == "COOLING",
                  $"well run {run}: a cursor {cursorD:0} u off puts it {(laid.Count > 0 ? laid[0].At.DistanceTo(home) : -1):0} u out ({placed}), drawn there at 280 u ({drawn}); a light {lWas:0} u in dragged {lRate:0.0} u/s (want 200), a gunship {gWas:0} u in {gRate:0.0} u/s (want 100), a light {oWas.DistanceTo(centre):0} u out moved {oMoved:0.0} u; its clock {cool:0.0} s (the sheet's 22: {bn.Cooling(22):0.0}), a second press {refused ?? "ALLOWED"}");
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && LaneA6bWells().Count > 0; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double lasted = bn.Clock - pressed;
            Check(LaneA6bWells().Count == 0 && Math.Abs(lasted - 6) < 0.1,
                  $"well run {run}: gone {lasted:0.00} s after it went down (want 6)");
            foreach (var r in new[] { l, g, o }) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            // the latched: a webifier on the bastion's hull, the well dropped 80-180 u from it
            var w = H.SpawnRaider(home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f)); w.Quarry = bn; w.Hp = 1e9;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !w.Latched; i++) { Hold(); bn.Hp = bn.MaxHp; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            bool latched0 = w.Latched;
            var wAt = w.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(80f, 180f);
            float wWas = w.Position.DistanceTo(wAt);
            bn.Sl("well").Cool = 0;
            bn.AimPoint = wAt; bn.UseAbility("well", 0);
            double tw = bn.Clock; bool stayed = true;
            while (bn.Clock - tw < 1.0) { Hold(); bn.Hp = bn.MaxHp; stayed &= w.Latched; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            float wDrag = wWas - w.Position.DistanceTo(wAt);
            Check(latched0 && stayed && LaneA6bWells().Count == 1 && wDrag < 10f,
                  $"well run {run}: a webifier latched on the hull ({latched0}) with the well {wWas:0} u off stays latched ({stayed}) and is not dragged ({wDrag:0.0} u toward it in 1 s; a loose light would come 200)");
            // fr-R6b-8 (a) THE BASTION'S ANSWER TO A WEB (bastion.md Interactions): Q with the webber still latched throws
            // it off -- unlatched the next frame, 900+ u from the hull -- and its hold on the hull (the row's Cc, 0.25 s a
            // touch) is gone within 0.3 s of the frame it let go
            LaneA6bWellsClear();
            var cc = w.Def.Cc ?? Status.Pinned;
            bool latched1 = w.Latched, heldBy = bn.Statuses.Has(cc);
            bn.Sl("shockwave").Cool = 0;
            bn.UseAbility("shockwave", 0);
            Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool off = !w.Latched; float thrownTo = w.Position.DistanceTo(bn.Position);
            double tOff = bn.Clock, freeAfter = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && freeAfter < 0; i++)
            {
                if (!bn.Statuses.Has(cc)) freeAfter = bn.Clock - tOff;
                else { Hold(); bn.Hp = bn.MaxHp; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            }
            Check(latched1 && heldBy && off && thrownTo > 900f && freeAfter >= 0 && freeAfter <= 0.3,
                  $"well run {run}: Q with the webifier latched ({latched1}, holding the hull {heldBy}) throws it off -- unlatched the next frame ({off}), {thrownTo:0} u from the hull (900+), its hold gone {freeAfter:0.00} s after (0.3)");
            bn.Sl("shockwave").Cool = 0;
            w.TakeDamage(1e12);
            LaneA6bWellsClear();
            bn.Sl("well").Cool = 0;
        }
        bn.Position = yonder; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE MENDING LANCE (kits6b-J7, D43, D44) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // World, host, a fresh TENDER. Its sheet once, against the card: hull 380; the lance 4 a tick every 0.1 s
    // (40 DPS on a foe) out to 650 u, 0.8 a tick on a friend (8 HP/s), the barrel round at 90 deg/s; a Beam
    // primary on Space; no sentries and no fire mode. Three runs from varied spots down varied bearings, one
    // tick of the lance along a drawn bore at a time (LanceTick, the host's own):
    //   FIRST BODY: a held light 150-300 u down the line and a sentry 350-500 u (hull 60-100 of 120): the light
    //   takes 4 ("lance"), the sentry nothing, the slot BURNING that far; the two swapped, the sentry gains 0.8
    //   and the light nothing, the slot MENDING, credited 0.8 mended.
    //   IN FLIGHT: a seeker 60-120 u short of the light on the line changes nothing: the light takes 4.
    //   REACH: a light whose near edge stands 15-60 u past 650 takes nothing, the slot reaching 650; one
    //   560-620 u out takes 4.
    //   FULL: a sentry at its full hull still stops the beam -- the light behind it takes nothing -- and
    //   nothing is credited mended.
    // Then Mend's kinds (D43): a miner of the base's fleet below its hull is mended through the same door by
    // 0.8, and a miner at its full hull takes nothing.
    async Task LaneA6bLanceChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var td = Me; td.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = td.Demo; td.Demo = true;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var cdef = Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["hull"] - 380) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["main_damage"] - 4) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["main_interval"] - 0.1) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["main_range"] - 650) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["lance_heal"] - 0.8) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["main_turn"] - Mathf.DegToRad(90f)) < 1e-6 && cdef.Primary == Primary.Beam
              && cdef.Abilities[0] == Ab.Lance && Abilities.TriggerOf(ShipClass.FreightTender) == Ab.Lance
              && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightTender, "lance") == global::Godot.Key.Space
              && !cdef.Has(Fit.Deploy) && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightTender, "firemode") == null && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightTender, "deploy") == null
              && Math.Abs(sheet["main_damage"] / sheet["main_interval"] - 40) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["lance_heal"] / sheet["main_interval"] - 8) < 1e-9,
              $"the tender: hull {sheet["hull"]:0} (380), the lance {sheet["main_damage"]:0.#} every {sheet["main_interval"]:0.##} s to {sheet["main_range"]:0} u (40 DPS), {sheet["lance_heal"]:0.#} a tick on a friend (8 HP/s), the barrel at {Mathf.RadToDeg((float)sheet["main_turn"]):0} deg/s; Space, no sentries, no fire mode");
        var hurt = new List<(IHittable t, double d)>();
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == Dealt.Lance) hurt.Add((t, d)); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
            await Wait(0.2);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f);
            td.Position = home; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; td.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var from = home + dir * Vary(0f, 30f);
            float dLight = Vary(150f, 300f), dPost = Vary(350f, 500f);
            var light = H.SpawnRaider(from + dir * dLight); light.Hp = 1e9; light.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            double sHull = Vary(60f, 100f);
            var post = H.Drop(td, from + dir * dPost, sHull, 120);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            // FIRST BODY: the light nearer
            hurt.Clear(); double lHp = light.Hp, pHp = post.Hp;
            int n1 = td.LanceTick(from, dir);
            var s1 = td.Sl("lance");
            bool burnOk = n1 == PlayerShip.LanceBurn && hurt.Count == 1 && ReferenceEquals(hurt[0].t, light) && Math.Abs(hurt[0].d - 4) < 1e-9
                          && Math.Abs(lHp - light.Hp - 4) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(post.Hp - pHp) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(s1.Own - dLight) < light.HitRadius + 1f
                          && s1.Left > 0 && Ab.Lance.State(td, null).Line == "BURNING";
            // ...swapped: the sentry nearer
            light.Position = from + dir * dPost; post.Position = from + dir * dLight;
            hurt.Clear(); lHp = light.Hp; pHp = post.Hp;
            double mended0 = td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Lance);
            int n2 = td.LanceTick(from, dir);
            var s2 = td.Sl("lance");
            bool mendOk = n2 == PlayerShip.LanceMend && hurt.Count == 0 && Math.Abs(post.Hp - pHp - 0.8) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(light.Hp - lHp) < 1e-9
                          && Math.Abs(td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Lance) - mended0 - 0.8) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(s2.Own - dLight) < DeployedTurret.Radius + 1f
                          && Ab.Lance.State(td, null).Line == "MENDING";
            Check(burnOk && mendOk,
                  $"lance run {run}: a light {dLight:0} u down the line with a sentry behind it at {dPost:0} u -- the light takes 4 ({lHp - light.Hp:0.#} on the swap, {hurt.Count} blows), the sentry nothing (BURNING {burnOk}); swapped, the sentry gains 0.8 ({post.Hp - pHp:0.##}) and the light nothing (MENDING {mendOk})");
            // IN FLIGHT: a seeker between the barrel and the light
            light.Position = from + dir * dLight; post.Position = from - dir * 800f;          // the sentry well behind the barrel
            var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, from + dir * (dLight - Vary(60f, 120f)), dir, 0.01f, 1e6f, 0, hull: 1e9);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            sk.GlobalPosition = from + dir * (dLight - Vary(60f, 120f));
            hurt.Clear(); lHp = light.Hp; double skHull = sk.Hull;
            int n3 = td.LanceTick(from, dir);
            Check(n3 == PlayerShip.LanceBurn && hurt.Count == 1 && ReferenceEquals(hurt[0].t, light) && Math.Abs(sk.Hull - skHull) < 1e-9,
                  $"lance run {run}: a seeker {from.DistanceTo(sk.GlobalPosition):0} u out on the line is passed through ({skHull - sk.Hull:0.#} taken) and the light behind it at {dLight:0} u still takes 4 ({hurt.Count} blows)");
            sk.Intercept();
            // REACH: past 650 nothing; inside, the light
            var reachDir = dir.Rotated(Vary(0.6f, 1.2f));
            light.Position = from + reachDir * (650f + light.HitRadius + Vary(15f, 60f));
            hurt.Clear();
            int n4 = td.LanceTick(from, reachDir);
            double reached = td.Sl("lance").Own;
            light.Position = from + reachDir * Vary(560f, 620f);
            int n5 = td.LanceTick(from, reachDir);
            Check(n4 == PlayerShip.LanceNone && Math.Abs(reached - 650) < 1e-3 && n5 == PlayerShip.LanceBurn && hurt.Count == 1,
                  $"lance run {run}: a light whose edge is past 650 u takes nothing (the beam reaching {reached:0} u), one {from.DistanceTo(light.Position):0} u out takes 4 ({hurt.Count} blows)");
            // FULL: a sentry at its full hull still stops it
            post.Hp = post.MaxHp; post.Position = from + reachDir * Vary(150f, 300f);
            hurt.Clear(); mended0 = td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Lance);
            int n6 = td.LanceTick(from, reachDir);
            Check(n6 == PlayerShip.LanceMend && hurt.Count == 0 && Math.Abs(post.Hp - 120) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Lance) - mended0) < 1e-12,
                  $"lance run {run}: a sentry at its full 120 in front of the light stops the beam ({hurt.Count} blows behind it) and nothing is credited mended");
            light.TakeDamage(1e12); H.DeployedTaken(post);
        }
        // MEND'S KINDS (D43): a ship of the base's fleet is a friendly hull like any other
        var mn = H.Yard.Gatherers.FirstOrDefault(g => g.Kind == GatherKind.Miner && g.InReach);
        if (mn == null) Check(false, "mend: a miner of the base's fleet out in the field to mend");
        else
        {
            mn.Hull = mn.MaxHull - Vary(10f, 40f);
            double m0 = mn.Hull;
            double got = Mend.Give(mn, 0.8, td, Dealt.Lance), m1 = mn.Hull;
            mn.Hull = mn.MaxHull;
            double full = Mend.Give(mn, 0.8, td, Dealt.Lance);
            Check(Math.Abs(got - 0.8) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(m1 - m0 - 0.8) < 1e-9 && full == 0 && Math.Abs(mn.Hull - mn.MaxHull) < 1e-9
                  && Mend.Friendlies(H).Contains(mn) && Mend.Friendlies(H).Contains(td),
                  $"mend: a miner {mn.MaxHull - m0:0} under its hull is mended {got:0.##} (0.8) through the one door, one at its full hull {full:0.##}; the fleet and the pilot are both friendly hulls to it");
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        td.Demo = demo; td.Position = yonder; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        await LaneA6bLanceTriggerChecks(yonder);
    }

    // ── 6b · THE LANCE ON THE TRIGGER (kits6b-J7) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Three runs: the tender held at a varied spot and heading, Space held with the cursor on empty water
    // until the barrel has settled on it, then the cursor put on a held light 300-500 u off on a bearing
    // 60-120 deg round from the barrel. The barrel comes round at 90 deg/s, so the first tick on the light
    // lands when the beam first sweeps within its radius, that angle / 90 deg/s after the move (up to a 0.1 s
    // tick and a frame later); then, held 1.5 s more, the ticks land every 0.1 s (the mean gap within 0.01), 4 each, and the
    // slot's line reads BURNING. Let go, the slot's time runs out within 0.3 s and nothing more lands.
    async Task LaneA6bLanceTriggerChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var td = Me; bool demo = td.Demo; td.Demo = true; td.AutopilotTo = null;
        var key = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightTender, "lance");
        var ticks = new List<double>();
        IHittable on = null;
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == Dealt.Lance && ReferenceEquals(t, on) && Math.Abs(d - 4) < 1e-9) ticks.Add(td.Clock); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.2);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { td.Position = home; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; td.Rotation = rot; }
            Hold();
            var (_, bore0) = td.MainBore;
            float empty = bore0.Angle() + Vary(-0.3f, 0.3f);
            td.AimPoint = home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(empty) * 400f;
            KeyDown(key);
            for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            var (muzzle, bore) = td.MainBore;
            float turn = Vary(Mathf.DegToRad(60f), Mathf.DegToRad(120f)) * (run % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1);
            float dist = Vary(300f, 500f);
            var lAt = muzzle + bore.Rotated(turn) * dist;
            var light = H.SpawnRaider(lAt); light.Hp = 1e9; light.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            on = light; ticks.Clear();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            light.Position = lAt; Hold();
            // WHEN THE BEAM FIRST TOUCHES IT: the barrel swung from where it points toward the light about its
            // pivot at 90 deg/s, the beam out of the muzzle 650 u along it, the first angle it passes within the
            // light's radius
            var (m2, b2) = td.MainBore;
            float barrel = td.MyArt.MainBarrel;
            var pivot = m2 - b2 * barrel;
            float a0 = b2.Angle(), sweep = Mathf.Wrap((lAt - pivot).Angle() - a0, -Mathf.Pi, Mathf.Pi), angle = Mathf.Abs(sweep);
            double want = -1;
            for (int k = 0; k <= 720 && want < 0; k++)
            {
                var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(a0 + sweep * k / 720f); var mz = pivot + way * barrel;
                if (Combat.DistToSegment(lAt, mz, mz + way * 650f) <= light.HitRadius) want = angle * k / 720f / Mathf.DegToRad(90f);
            }
            double moved = td.Clock;
            td.AimPoint = lAt;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && ticks.Count == 0; i++) { Hold(); light.Position = lAt; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double first = ticks.Count > 0 ? ticks[0] - moved : -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++) { Hold(); light.Position = lAt; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            string line = Ab.Lance.State(td, null).Line;
            var held = ticks.ToList();
            KeyUp(key);
            double gap = held.Count > 1 ? (held[^1] - held[0]) / (held.Count - 1) : 99;
            await Wait(0.3);
            int after = ticks.Count - held.Count;
            await Wait(0.3);
            int later = ticks.Count - held.Count;
            Check(first >= 0 && want >= 0 && first - want > -0.03 && first - want < 0.14 && held.Count >= 12 && Math.Abs(gap - 0.1) < 0.01 && line == "BURNING"
                  && later == after && after <= 1 && td.Sl("lance").Left <= 0,
                  $"lance trigger run {run}: the cursor moved {Mathf.RadToDeg(angle):0} deg round, the first tick on the light {dist:0} u off lands {first:0.00} s later (want {want:0.00} at 90 deg/s, then a tick of 0.1 at most), then {held.Count} ticks {gap:0.000} s apart (0.1), BURNING ({line}); let go, nothing more ({after}, {later}) and the beam is down");
            light.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        td.Demo = demo; td.Position = yonder; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE TENDER'S FIELDS: second pilots beside it (kits6b-J8) ─────────────────────────────────
    // A MATE: a pilot of `c` added to the hub by hand (as LaneA6cTauntEmplacementChecks does), in Combat.Players
    // like any other, with its own seat id; LaneA6bHold keeps it exactly where it is put (it is not this peer's).
    PlayerShip LaneA6bMate(ShipClass c, int seat, Vector2 at)
    {
        var mate = new PlayerShip { Name = $"TenderMate{seat}" };
        H.AddChild(mate);
        mate.Init(seat, at);
        mate.SetIdentity($"Mate{seat}", Colors.Gray, Colors.Gray, c);
        mate.Hp = mate.MaxHp;
        return mate;
    }
    void LaneA6bHold(PlayerShip p, Vector2 at)
    {
        var lf = BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance;
        p.Position = at; p.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netPos", lf)?.SetValue(p, at);
        typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netVel", lf)?.SetValue(p, Vector2.Zero);
    }

    // ── 6b · THE OVERDRIVE FIELD (kits6b-J8, D38) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The sheet once (x1.5, 8 s, cd 24, 500 u, F, ability 1). Three runs, the tender at a varied spot, a
    // battleship pilot on a varied bearing: F -- the tender fires x1.5 and so does the battleship 300-480 u
    // off (its gun's own interval / 1.5), and not once it stands 520-700 u off; moved back in, lifted again;
    // the field's time run out (its Left cut to 0.05-0.15 s), both x1 again while the cooldown runs on.
    // Run 1 adds a freighter pilot 300-480 u off with a sentry of its own: its sentry's gun fires x1.5 (the
    // sentry is lifted through its pilot, D38). Run 2 adds a second tender 300-480 u off with ITS field up:
    // each stands in the other's, and each fires x2.0 -- 1 + 0.5 + 0.5, the fields add, never x2.25.
    async Task LaneA6bOverdriveFieldChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var td = Me; td.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = td.Demo; td.Demo = true;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var own = Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightTender).Abilities.Where(a => !a.Weapon).Select(a => a.Id).ToList();
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["overdrive_mult"] - 1.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["overdrive_time"] - 8) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["overdrive_cooldown"] - 24) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(sheet["field_radius"] - 500) < 1e-9 && Ab.Overdrive.Aura == "field_radius" && own.Count == 3 && own[0] == "overdrive"
              && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightTender, "overdrive") == global::Godot.Key.F,
              $"the overdrive field: x{sheet["overdrive_mult"]:0.#} for {sheet["overdrive_time"]:0} s every {sheet["overdrive_cooldown"]:0} s over {sheet["field_radius"]:0} u; ability 1 on F ({string.Join(", ", own)})");
        var bb = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.Battleship, 2, yonder + new Vector2(0, 3000));
        PlayerShip fr = null, tw = null; DeployedTurret frPost = null;
        async Task Frame(Vector2 home, Vector2 bbAt, Vector2 frAt, Vector2 twAt)
        {
            td.Position = home; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            LaneA6bHold(bb, bbAt);
            if (fr != null) LaneA6bHold(fr, frAt);
            if (tw != null) LaneA6bHold(tw, twAt);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f);
            var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var inAt = home + way * Vary(300f, 480f);
            var outAt = home + way.Rotated(Vary(-0.5f, 0.5f)) * Vary(520f, 700f);
            var frAt = home + way.Rotated(Vary(1.5f, 2.5f)) * Vary(300f, 480f);
            var twAt = home + way.Rotated(Mathf.Pi + Vary(-0.3f, 0.3f)) * Vary(300f, 480f);   // opposite the battleship: never inside both fields
            if (run == 1)
            {
                fr = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.FreightHauler, 3, frAt);
                frPost = H.Drop(fr, frAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(700f, 900f), 120);
            }
            if (run == 2) tw = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.FreightTender, 4, twAt);
            td.Sl("overdrive").Left = 0; td.Sl("overdrive").Cool = 0;
            await Frame(home, inAt, frAt, twAt); await Frame(home, inAt, frAt, twAt);
            double bbGun = bb.Stats["main_interval"];
            bool before = Math.Abs(bb.FireRate - 1f) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(td.FireRate - 1f) < 1e-6;
            td.UseAbility("overdrive", 0);
            if (tw != null) { tw.Sl("overdrive").Cool = 0; tw.StartOverdrive(); }
            await Frame(home, inAt, frAt, twAt);
            float want = run == 2 ? 2f : 1.5f, tdR = td.FireRate, bbR = bb.FireRate;
            bool lifted = Math.Abs(td.FireRate - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(bb.FireRate - 1.5f) < 1e-6
                          && Math.Abs(bb.Cadence("main_interval") - bbGun / 1.5) < 1e-9;
            bool sentry = run != 1 || (frPost != null && Math.Abs(fr.FireRate - 1.5f) < 1e-6
                                       && Math.Abs(frPost.Spec(true).Interval - fr.Stats["deploy_interval"] / 1.5) < 1e-9);
            bool twin = run != 2 || Math.Abs(tw.FireRate - 2f) < 1e-6;
            await Frame(home, outAt, frAt, twAt);
            bool outside = Math.Abs(bb.FireRate - 1f) < 1e-6 && bb.Position.DistanceTo(home) > 500f;
            await Frame(home, inAt, frAt, twAt);
            bool back = Math.Abs(bb.FireRate - 1.5f) < 1e-6;
            Check(before && lifted && sentry && twin && outside && back,
                  $"overdrive field run {run}: the tender x{tdR:0.##} (want x{want:0.#}), a battleship {inAt.DistanceTo(home):0} u off x{bbR:0.##} (its gun {bbGun:0.00} -> {bbGun / 1.5:0.000} s), "
                  + $"at {outAt.DistanceTo(home):0} u x1 ({outside}), back in x1.5 ({back})"
                  + (run == 1 ? $"; a freighter pilot {frAt.DistanceTo(home):0} u off x1.5 and its sentry's gun too ({sentry})" : "")
                  + (run == 2 ? $"; a second tender {twAt.DistanceTo(home):0} u off with its own field up: both x2.0, the fields added ({td.FireRate:0.##}, {tw.FireRate:0.##})" : ""));
            td.Sl("overdrive").Left = Vary(0.05f, 0.15f);
            if (tw != null) tw.Sl("overdrive").Left = 0.05;
            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) await Frame(home, inAt, frAt, twAt);
            Check(Math.Abs(td.FireRate - 1f) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(bb.FireRate - 1f) < 1e-6 && td.Sl("overdrive").Cool > 20,
                  $"overdrive field run {run}: its time out, the tender and the battleship beside it are x1 again ({td.FireRate:0.##}, {bb.FireRate:0.##}) and the cooldown runs on ({td.Sl("overdrive").Cool:0.0} s)");
        }
        if (frPost != null) H.DeployedTaken(frPost);
        foreach (var m in new[] { bb, fr, tw }) if (m != null) m.QueueFree();
        await Wait(0.1);
        td.Sl("overdrive").Left = 0; td.Sl("overdrive").Cool = 0;
        td.Demo = demo; td.Position = yonder; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE REPAIR FIELD (kits6b-J8) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The sheet once (2% of a full hull a second, 8 s, cd 30, 500 u, Q, ability 2). Three runs, the tender at a
    // varied spot at 40-60% of its hull, a battleship pilot 300-480 u off at 50%, a sentry 250-450 u off at 40-80
    // of 120, one 530-700 u off at 40-80, and one 100-300 u off at 119 of 120. Q, timed from the first frame the
    // field is up: run 0 holds the whole 8 s -- the near sentry gains exactly 19.2 (120 x 2% x 8), the far one
    // nothing, the one at 119 stops at 120; the pilot and the tender each gain at least 16% of theirs (their own
    // regeneration on top), and "repair" is credited what landed. Runs 1 and 2 hold 2.0 s: the near sentry gains
    // 2.4 a second (+-0.05), the far one nothing; then the second press is refused COOLING at 30.
    // NEVER A WRECK (the Tender card; the kits6b gate fix): in every run a destroyer pilot in stasis (a wreck)
    // lies 150-450 u off, inside the 500 u: its hull stays 0 through the field, the door (Mend.Give) lands and
    // credits nothing on it, while the near sentry still gains.
    async Task LaneA6bRepairFieldChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var td = Me; td.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = td.Demo; td.Demo = true;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var own = Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightTender).Abilities.Where(a => !a.Weapon).Select(a => a.Id).ToList();
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["repair_share"] - 0.02) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["repair_time"] - 8) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["repair_cooldown"] - 30) < 1e-9
              && own.Count == 3 && own[1] == "repair" && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightTender, "repair") == global::Godot.Key.Q && Ab.Repair.Tick != null,
              $"the repair field: {sheet["repair_share"] * 100:0.#}% of a full hull a second for {sheet["repair_time"]:0} s every {sheet["repair_cooldown"]:0} s; ability 2 on Q ({string.Join(", ", own)})");
        var bb = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.Battleship, 2, yonder + new Vector2(0, 3200));
        var wreck = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.Destroyer, 3, yonder + new Vector2(0, 3600));
        wreck.Restore(0, false, 60);                              // a wreck, its stasis outlasting the three runs
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f);
            var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var bbAt = home + way * Vary(300f, 480f);
            var wreckAt = home + way.Rotated(Vary(-1.0f, -0.4f)) * Vary(150f, 450f);
            td.Position = home; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            td.Hp = td.MaxHp * Vary(0.4f, 0.6f);
            bb.Hp = bb.MaxHp * 0.5;
            var near = H.Drop(td, home + way.Rotated(Vary(1.2f, 2.0f)) * Vary(250f, 450f), Vary(40f, 80f), 120);
            var far = H.Drop(td, home + way.Rotated(Vary(-2.0f, -1.2f)) * Vary(530f, 700f), Vary(40f, 80f), 120);
            var full = H.Drop(td, home + way.Rotated(Vary(2.6f, 3.4f)) * Vary(100f, 300f), 119, 120);
            async Task Frame() { td.Position = home; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; LaneA6bHold(bb, bbAt); LaneA6bHold(wreck, wreckAt); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            td.Sl("repair").Left = 0; td.Sl("repair").Cool = 0;
            double credit0 = td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault("repair"), wn0 = near.Hp;
            bool wrecked0 = wreck.Hp == 0 && !wreck.Alive;
            td.UseAbility("repair", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && td.Sl("repair").Left <= 0; i++) await Frame();
            // the first frame it is up: its first frame's share has already landed, so the clock starts there
            double n0 = near.Hp, f0 = far.Hp, t0 = td.Clock, bb0 = bb.Hp, td0 = td.Hp, left0 = td.Sl("repair").Left;
            if (run == 0)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && td.Sl("repair").Left > 0; i++) await Frame();
                await Frame();
                double gained = near.Hp - n0, landedLast = 120 * 0.02 * left0;
                double credited = td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault("repair") - credit0;
                Check(Math.Abs(gained - landedLast) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(far.Hp - f0) < 1e-12 && Math.Abs(full.Hp - 120) < 1e-9
                      && bb.Hp - bb0 >= bb.MaxHp * 0.02 * left0 - 1e-6 && td.Hp - td0 >= td.MaxHp * 0.02 * left0 - 1e-6 && credited > gained,
                      $"repair field run {run}: over its whole time the near sentry gains {gained:0.00} of 120 (want {landedLast:0.00}: 2% x {left0:0.00} s left after its first frame, 19.2 in all), the far one {far.Hp - f0:0.00}, the one at 119 stops at {full.Hp:0.00}; "
                      + $"the battleship +{(bb.Hp - bb0) / bb.MaxHp * 100:0.0}% and the tender +{(td.Hp - td0) / td.MaxHp * 100:0.0}% (each at least 2% a second), {credited:0.0} credited");
            }
            else
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++) await Frame();
                double dt = td.Clock - t0, rate = (near.Hp - n0) / dt;
                Check(Math.Abs(rate - 2.4) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(far.Hp - f0) < 1e-12 && td.Sl("repair").Cool > td.Cooling(30) - 3
                      && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightTender, "repair").Refuse(td, null) == "COOLING",
                      $"repair field run {run}: the near sentry {near.Position.DistanceTo(home):0} u off gains {rate:0.00} a second (2.4, of its 120), the one {far.Position.DistanceTo(home):0} u off nothing; a second press COOLING");
            }
            // the wreck through the whole run: its hull still 0, and the door gives it nothing and credits nothing
            double probe0 = td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault("repair");
            double onWreck = Mend.Give(wreck, 50, td, "repair");
            Check(wrecked0 && wreck.Hp == 0 && !wreck.Alive && !((IMendable)wreck).Mendable && onWreck == 0
                  && td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault("repair") == probe0 && near.Hp - wn0 > 1.0,
                  $"repair field run {run}: a wreck {wreck.Position.DistanceTo(home):0} u off (inside 500) keeps a hull of {wreck.Hp:0.00} (want 0), a heal handed it lands {onWreck:0.00} and credits {td.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault("repair") - probe0:0.00}, while the near sentry gained {near.Hp - wn0:0.00}");
            foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
            td.Sl("repair").Left = 0; td.Sl("repair").Cool = 0;
        }
        wreck.QueueFree();
        bb.QueueFree();
        await Wait(0.1);
        td.Hp = td.MaxHp;
        td.Demo = demo; td.Position = yonder; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · RESUPPLY (kits6b-J8, D45) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The sheet once (8 s, cd 30, E, ability 3 -- the walls read overdrive, repair, resupply in that order).
    // Nothing cooling anywhere: E is refused NOTHING COOLING, and the press spends nothing. Three runs, the
    // tender at a varied spot, a sniper pilot 300-480 u off, a battleship pilot 520-700 u off:
    //   the tender's overdrive cooling 10-20 s ends 8 s less, its repair field cooling 1-7 s is ready, its
    //   drive's cooldown (5-15 s) is where it was; the sniper's anchor cooling 10-12 s ends 8 s less and its
    //   tether, both charges spent and 2-6 s from the first back, has one back and the next recharging
    //   (its tether_recharge); the battleship's broadside cooling 15-20 s is untouched. Resupply's own cooldown
    //   is 30 and a second press is refused COOLING. A second TENDER pilot 300-480 u off: with only its
    //   resupply cooling, E is still NOTHING COOLING; pressed, its resupply is untouched (never Resupply
    //   itself, on any pilot) and its overdrive ends 8 s less.
    async Task LaneA6bResupplyChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var td = Me; td.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = td.Demo; td.Demo = true;
        var sheet = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var own = Classes.Of(ShipClass.FreightTender).Abilities.Where(a => !a.Weapon).Select(a => a.Id).ToList();
        Check(Math.Abs(sheet["resupply_cut"] - 8) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(sheet["resupply_cooldown"] - 30) < 1e-9
              && string.Join(",", own) == "overdrive,repair,resupply" && Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.FreightTender, "resupply") == global::Godot.Key.E
              && Ab.Resupply.Cuts == "resupply_cut" && Ab.Resupply.Aura == "field_radius",
              $"resupply: {sheet["resupply_cut"]:0} s off every cooldown in {sheet["field_radius"]:0} u, every {sheet["resupply_cooldown"]:0} s; ability 3 on E, the walls reading {string.Join(", ", own)}");
        var sn = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.HeavySniper, 2, yonder + new Vector2(0, 3000));
        var bb = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.Battleship, 3, yonder + new Vector2(0, -3000));
        var t2 = LaneA6bMate(ShipClass.FreightTender, 4, yonder + new Vector2(3000, 0));   // fr-R6b-7: a second tender in reach
        string drive = Drives.RowOf(ShipClass.FreightTender).Select(d => d.Id).FirstOrDefault();
        var row = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightTender, "resupply");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 200f);
            var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var snAt = home + way * Vary(300f, 480f);
            var bbAt = home + way.Rotated(Vary(1.5f, 3.0f)) * Vary(520f, 700f);
            var t2At = home + way.Rotated(-Vary(1.0f, 2.0f)) * Vary(300f, 480f);
            async Task Frame() { td.Position = home; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; LaneA6bHold(sn, snAt); LaneA6bHold(bb, bbAt); LaneA6bHold(t2, t2At); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            foreach (var p in new[] { td, sn, bb, t2 })
                foreach (var ab in Abilities.For(p.Class)) { p.Sl(ab.Id).Cool = 0; p.Sl(ab.Id).Left = 0; p.Sl(ab.Id).N = 0; }
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            double t2Only = Vary(12f, 18f);
            t2.Sl("resupply").Cool = t2Only;                       // only ANOTHER tender's resupply cooling: still nothing to cut
            string nothing = row.Refuse(td, null);
            td.UseAbility("resupply", 0); await Frame();
            bool free = nothing == "NOTHING COOLING" && td.Sl("resupply").Cool == 0 && t2.Sl("resupply").Cool > t2Only - 0.1;
            double od = Vary(10f, 20f), rp = Vary(1f, 7f), dv = Vary(5f, 15f), an = Vary(10f, 12f), te = Vary(2f, 6f), bs = Vary(15f, 20f);
            td.Sl("overdrive").Cool = od; td.Sl("repair").Cool = rp;
            if (drive != null) td.Sl(drive).Cool = dv;
            sn.Sl("anchor").Cool = an; sn.Sl("tether").N = 2; sn.Sl("tether").Cool = te;
            bb.Sl("broadside").Cool = bs;
            double r2 = Vary(10f, 20f), od2 = Vary(10f, 20f);
            t2.Sl("resupply").Cool = r2; t2.Sl("overdrive").Cool = od2;
            double c0 = td.Clock;
            td.UseAbility("resupply", 0);
            double el = td.Clock - c0;       // the press lands this frame, before any clock has run
            bool mine = Math.Abs(td.Sl("overdrive").Cool - (od - 8)) < 1e-6 && td.Sl("repair").Cool == 0
                        && (drive == null || Math.Abs(td.Sl(drive).Cool - dv) < 1e-6);
            bool his = Math.Abs(sn.Sl("anchor").Cool - (an - 8)) < 1e-6 && sn.Sl("tether").N == 1
                       && Math.Abs(sn.Sl("tether").Cool - sn.Cooling(sn.Stats["tether_recharge"])) < 1e-6;
            bool farOff = Math.Abs(bb.Sl("broadside").Cool - bs) < 1e-6;
            bool other = Math.Abs(t2.Sl("resupply").Cool - r2) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(t2.Sl("overdrive").Cool - (od2 - 8)) < 1e-6;
            bool spent = Math.Abs(td.Sl("resupply").Cool - td.Cooling(30)) < 1e-6 && row.Refuse(td, null) == "COOLING";
            Check(free && mine && his && farOff && other && spent && el == 0 && drive != null,
                  $"resupply run {run}: nothing cooling, E refused {nothing} and free ({free}); then its overdrive {od:0.0} -> {td.Sl("overdrive").Cool:0.0}, its repair {rp:0.0} -> {td.Sl("repair").Cool:0.0}, its drive ({drive}) {dv:0.0} untouched ({mine}); "
                  + $"the sniper {snAt.DistanceTo(home):0} u off: anchor {an:0.0} -> {sn.Sl("anchor").Cool:0.0}, tether a charge back ({sn.Sl("tether").N} spent, {sn.Sl("tether").Cool:0.0} s to the next) ({his}); "
                  + $"the battleship {bbAt.DistanceTo(home):0} u off untouched ({farOff}); a second tender {t2At.DistanceTo(home):0} u off: its resupply {r2:0.0} -> {t2.Sl("resupply").Cool:0.0} (never Resupply itself), its overdrive {od2:0.0} -> {t2.Sl("overdrive").Cool:0.0} ({other}); resupply cooling {td.Sl("resupply").Cool:0.0} and refused again ({spent})");
            await Frame();
        }
        foreach (var p in new[] { td, sn, bb, t2 })
            foreach (var ab in Abilities.For(p.Class)) { p.Sl(ab.Id).Cool = 0; p.Sl(ab.Id).Left = 0; p.Sl(ab.Id).N = 0; }
        sn.QueueFree(); bb.QueueFree(); t2.QueueFree();
        await Wait(0.1);
        td.Demo = demo; td.Position = yonder; td.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── 6b · THE TENDER'S FIELDS ACROSS THE WIRE (kits6b-J8, rung 5) ─────────────────────────────────
    // HOST: the guest's destroyer (its class settled) at 50-60% of its hull with its first ability cooling
    // 18-22 s -- given a second to reach the guest -- and the host flying a TENDER 250-420 u from it on a
    // host-varied bearing presses F, Q and E. The host's copy of the guest: its cooldown exactly 8 s lower at
    // once, its rate of fire x1.5, and its hull mended at least 2% of its maximum a second over 1.5 s.
    async Task LaneA6bFieldsHost()
    {
        await RealTime(() => H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is { Class: ShipClass.Destroyer }, Wan ? 20 : 12);
        var g = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine && s.Class == ShipClass.Destroyer);
        if (g == null) { Check(false, "arena host: the guest's destroyer, for the tender's fields"); return; }
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var te = Me; te.AutopilotTo = null;
        te.Position = g.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 420f); te.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        string cut = Classes.Of(ShipClass.Destroyer).Abilities.Where(a => !a.Weapon).Select(a => a.Id).First();
        g.Hp = g.MaxHp * Vary(0.5f, 0.6f);
        g.Sl(cut).Cool = Vary(18f, 22f);
        foreach (var id in new[] { "overdrive", "repair", "resupply" }) { te.Sl(id).Cool = 0; te.Sl(id).Left = 0; }
        // fr-R6b-4 THE LANCE ON THE WIRE: a held gunship 300-420 u off the tender, on the side away from the guest;
        // Space held with the cursor on it (the barrel at 90 deg/s) for 2.5 s: the tender's lance slot BURNS, its
        // length the muzzle's distance to the gunship within the gunship's radius (the guest reads the same slot)
        bool teDemo = te.Demo; te.Demo = true;
        var tePos = te.Position;
        var lanceAt = tePos + Vector2.Right.Rotated((tePos - g.Position).Angle() + Vary(-1.0f, 1.0f)) * Vary(300f, 420f);
        var lanceGun = H.SpawnRaider(lanceAt, Enemies.Gunship); lanceGun.Hp = 1e9; lanceGun.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
        te.AimPoint = lanceAt;
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Space);
        for (double t0 = te.Clock; te.Clock - t0 < 2.5;)
        { te.Position = tePos; te.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; lanceGun.Position = lanceAt; te.AimPoint = lanceAt; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        var (lanceMuzzle, _) = te.MainBore;
        float lanceGap = lanceMuzzle.DistanceTo(lanceAt);
        Check(te.Sl("lance").N == PlayerShip.LanceBurn && Math.Abs(te.Sl("lance").Own - lanceGap) < lanceGun.HitRadius + 1f,
              $"arena host: the tender's lance held on a gunship {lanceGap:0} u from its muzzle BURNS (N {te.Sl("lance").N}) and reaches {te.Sl("lance").Own:0} u (within its {lanceGun.HitRadius:0} u radius)");
        await Wait(Wan ? 2.0 : 1.0);                               // the cooldown in the guest's hands before it is cut
        double coolBefore = g.Sl(cut).Cool, hp0 = g.Hp, c0 = te.Clock;
        te.UseAbility("overdrive", 0); te.UseAbility("repair", 0); te.UseAbility("resupply", 0);
        double coolAfter = g.Sl(cut).Cool;
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        float rate = g.FireRate; float apart = g.Position.DistanceTo(te.Position);
        await Wait(1.5);
        double gain = (g.Hp - hp0) / g.MaxHp / Math.Max(1e-6, te.Clock - c0);
        Check(Math.Abs(coolBefore - coolAfter - 8) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(rate - 1.5f) < 1e-6 && gain >= 0.02 - 1e-3 && te.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault("repair") > 0,
              $"arena host: the tender {apart:0} u from the guest's destroyer -- its {cut} cooldown {coolBefore:0.0} -> {coolAfter:0.0} s (8 off), its rate x{rate:0.##} (1.5), its hull +{gain * 100:0.00}% a second (2%)");
        foreach (var id in new[] { "overdrive", "repair" }) te.Sl(id).Left = 0;
        KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space); te.Demo = teDemo;
        lanceGun.TakeDamage(1e12);
    }

    // GUEST: this pilot's destroyer beside the host's tender. What it sees is the host's word: its ability's
    // cooldown falls 7.5 s or more between two frames (the cut, in the host's report); the tender's copy here
    // draws both of its 500 u rings (Fields.Up: the overdrive and the repair field); and while they are up its
    // own hull climbs 1.5% of its maximum a second or more (the host's repair, over a second at least).
    async Task LaneA6bFieldsGuest()
    {
        string cut = Classes.Of(ShipClass.Destroyer).Abilities.Where(a => !a.Weapon).Select(a => a.Id).First();
        bool sawCut = false, sawRings = false, sawBeam = false; double hpAt = -1, clockAt = 0, climb = 0, lastCool = -1, biggest = 0;
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            var m = Me; if (m == null) return false;
            double c = m.Sl(cut).Cool;
            if (lastCool >= 0) { biggest = Math.Max(biggest, lastCool - c); if (lastCool - c >= 7.5) sawCut = true; }
            lastCool = c;
            var te = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine && s.Class == ShipClass.FreightTender);
            if (te == null) return false;
            var up = Fields.Up(te).ToList();
            // fr-R6b-4: the host's lance, drawn here from the tender's slot -- BURNING, and as long as the tender's
            // copy is from a gunship copy (within its radius and the barrel's length)
            var sl = te.Sl("lance");
            if (sl.N == PlayerShip.LanceBurn && up.Any(f => f.Row.Id == "lance")
                && H.Raiders.Any(r => Math.Abs(te.Position.DistanceTo(r.Position) - sl.Own) < r.HitRadius + te.MyArt.MainBarrel + 25f))
                sawBeam = true;
            if (up.Any(f => f.Row.Id == "overdrive" && Math.Abs(f.Radius - 500f) < 1e-3) && up.Any(f => f.Row.Id == "repair" && Math.Abs(f.Radius - 500f) < 1e-3))
            {
                sawRings = true;
                if (hpAt < 0) { hpAt = m.Hp; clockAt = m.Clock; }
                else if (m.Clock - clockAt >= 1.0) climb = Math.Max(climb, (m.Hp - hpAt) / m.MaxHp / (m.Clock - clockAt));
            }
            return false;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        await RealTime(() => sawCut && sawRings && sawBeam && climb >= 0.015, Wan ? 20 : 12);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(sawBeam, "arena guest: the host's tender's lance is drawn here -- its slot BURNING, the lance row up, its length the tender copy's distance to a gunship copy");
        Check(sawCut && sawRings && climb >= 0.015,
              $"arena guest: beside the host's tender its {cut} cooldown fell {biggest:0.0} s in one step (8 cut), both 500 u rings drawn here ({sawRings}), and its hull climbed {climb * 100:0.00}% a second under the repair field (2%)");
    }

    // ── 6b · TIME ON TARGET ACROSS THE WIRE (kits6b-J2, rung 5; kits_v31 8's second run) ─────────
    // HOST: the guest's freighter (three sentries standing 0-600 u off it) paints the held gunship
    // 560-700 u off (host-varied spots); the guest presses F. Every line is the host's: the gunship
    // takes exactly one "tot" blow of 40 per gun within 1500 u of it -- the spotter and the three
    // sentries, four -- and the guest's clock is set to its 16.
    async Task LaneA6bTotHost(PlayerShip fg, Raider paintGun)
    {
        fg.PaintOn(paintGun, 30);
        int want = H.Deployed.Count(t => t.OwnerId == fg.OwnerId && t.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(paintGun.Position) <= 1500f) + 1;
        var blows = new List<(IHittable t, double d)>();
        void Heard(IHittable t, double d, string w) { if (w == Dealt.Tot) blows.Add((t, d)); }
        Dealt.Landed += Heard;
        await RealTime(() => blows.Count > 0 && fg.Sl("tot").Cool > 0, Wan ? 25 : 15);
        await Wait(0.2);
        Dealt.Landed -= Heard;
        var onGun = blows.Where(b => ReferenceEquals(b.t, paintGun)).ToList();
        Check(want == 4 && onGun.Count == want && onGun.All(b => Math.Abs(b.d - 40) < 1e-9) && fg.Sl("tot").Cool > 15 && fg.Sl("tot").Cool <= 16.001,
              $"arena host: the guest's F threw time on target from the host -- {onGun.Count} lines of 40 on the painted gunship (want 4: the spotter and 3 sentries), its clock {fg.Sl("tot").Cool:0.0} s of 16");
    }

    // GUEST: it presses F (again every 0.5 s until the host's clock comes back: a press the host
    // refused is re-asked, never assumed). It draws every line the host threw -- four, each from one
    // of its own sentry copies (within 20 u) or its own hull's spotter (within 150 u of the hull) to the
    // painted gunship's copy (within 20 u) -- and reads the host's 16 s clock in its own slot.
    async Task LaneA6bTotGuest(PlayerShip fgm)
    {
        await RealTime(() => fgm.Painted != null && H.Deployed.Count(t => t.OwnerId == fgm.OwnerId) == 3, Wan ? 25 : 15);
        var paint = fgm.Painted as Node2D;
        var posts = H.Deployed.Where(t => t.OwnerId == fgm.OwnerId).Select(t => t.GlobalPosition).ToList();
        var seen = new Dictionary<FxNode, (Vector2 a, Vector2 b)>();
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () => { foreach (var f in Nodes<FxNode>()) if (f.Id == Fx.Tot) seen[f] = (f.Position, f.To); return false; } };
        AddChild(watch);
        double asked = -1;
        await RealTime(() =>
        {
            if (fgm.Sl("tot").Cool > 0) return seen.Count >= 4;
            if (fgm.Painted != null && fgm.Clock - asked > 0.5) { asked = fgm.Clock; fgm.UseAbility("tot", 0); }
            return false;
        }, Wan ? 25 : 15);
        await Wait(0.3);
        watch.QueueFree();
        double cool = fgm.Sl("tot").Cool;
        var ends = seen.Values.ToList();
        bool allToPaint = paint != null && ends.All(l => l.b.DistanceTo(paint.Position) < 20f);
        int fromPosts = posts.Count(p => ends.Count(l => l.a.DistanceTo(p) < 20f) == 1);
        int fromHull = ends.Count(l => l.a.DistanceTo(fgm.Position) < 150f);
        Check(ends.Count == 4 && allToPaint && fromPosts == 3 && fromHull == 1 && cool > 14 && cool <= 16.001,
              $"arena guest: time on target drawn here -- {ends.Count} lines (want 4), every one ending on the painted gunship's copy within 20 u ({allToPaint}), one from each of its 3 sentry copies ({fromPosts}) and one from its spotter ({fromHull}); the host's clock {cool:0.0} s of 16 in its slot");
    }

    // ── fr-R6b-1 · THE PRESS'S POINT ACROSS THE WIRE (Buster and Well take a point, F8; rung 5) ─────
    // HOST: the guest's BASTION presses F (the buster) and E (the well), its cursor moved 300+ u off the
    // press's point the frame after each press. The first buster round of the guest's leaves along the point
    // its press carried (its slot's At, within 0.05 rad) and the well is laid on it (within 10 u); the
    // guest's reported cursor, read 0.3 s after each landed, is 250+ u off / 0.3+ rad off it.
    async Task LaneA6bPointHost()
    {
        PlayerShip g = null; Shot bShot = null; ZoneNode wz = null;
        Vector2 bDir = default, bFrom = default, bAt = default, wPos = default, wAt = default;
        Vector2? bAim = null, wAim = null; ulong bMs = 0, wMs = 0;
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            g ??= H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine && s.Class == ShipClass.FreightBastion);
            if (g == null) return false;
            ulong now = Time.GetTicksMsec();
            if (bShot == null && Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Buster && ReferenceEquals(x.Source, g)) is { } s)
            { bShot = s; bDir = s.Dir; bFrom = s.Position; bAt = g.Sl("buster").At; bMs = now; }
            if (wz == null && H.Laid.FirstOrDefault(z => z.OwnerId == g.OwnerId && z.Row == Zones.Well) is { } z)
            { wz = z; wPos = z.Position; wAt = g.Sl("well").At; wMs = now; }
            if (bShot != null && bAim == null && now - bMs >= 300) bAim = g.AimPoint;
            if (wz != null && wAim == null && now - wMs >= 300) wAim = g.AimPoint;
            return bAim != null && wAim != null;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        await RealTime(() => bAim != null && wAim != null, Wan ? 40 : 25);
        watch.QueueFree();
        float bOn = bShot != null ? Mathf.Abs(bDir.AngleTo(bAt - bFrom)) : 9f, bOff = bAim is { } ba ? Mathf.Abs(bDir.AngleTo(ba - bFrom)) : 0f;
        float wOn = wz != null ? wPos.DistanceTo(wAt) : 1e9f, wOff = wAim is { } wa ? wPos.DistanceTo(wa) : 0f;
        Check(g != null && bOn < 0.05f && bOff > 0.3f,
              $"arena host: the guest's buster left {bOn:0.000} rad off the point its press carried (0.05) and {bOff:0.00} rad off its reported cursor (more than 0.3)");
        Check(g != null && wOn < 10f && wOff > 250f,
              $"arena host: the guest's well was laid {wOn:0.0} u from the point its press carried (10) and {wOff:0} u from its reported cursor (more than 250)");
        await Wait(0.3);
    }

    // GUEST: this pilot's BASTION. For F (the buster) then E (the well): the cursor held 300-500 u out on one
    // side long enough for the host to have it, the press at a point 300-500 u out on the far side (a varied
    // bearing), and the frame after the press the cursor moves 300-450 u out square to it; re-asked every
    // 0.9 s until the host's word comes back. The host's buster round (its copy here) flies at the press's
    // point (within 0.05 rad) and not at the moved cursor; the host's well (its copy here) lies within 10 u of it.
    async Task LaneA6bPointGuest()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
        var bn = Me; bn.AutopilotTo = null; bn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bool demo = bn.Demo; bn.Demo = true;
        var shots0 = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Buster).ToHashSet();
        var zones0 = H.Laid.ToHashSet();
        Shot seenShot = null; Vector2 shotDir = default, shotAt = default;
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seenShot == null && Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Buster && !shots0.Contains(x)) is { } s)
            { seenShot = s; shotDir = s.Dir; shotAt = s.Position; }
            return seenShot != null;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        async Task<(Vector2 press, Vector2 moved, bool got)> Aim(string id, System.Func<bool> landed)
        {
            Vector2 press = default, moved = default; double until = Time.GetTicksMsec() + (Wan ? 30000.0 : 20000.0);
            while (!landed() && Time.GetTicksMsec() < until)
            {
                // the host took a press already (its clock is back in this slot): its word is on the way, the point kept
                if (press != default && bn.Sl(id).Cool > 0) { await RealTime(landed, 3); continue; }
                float bear = VaryAngle();
                bn.AimPoint = bn.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bear + Mathf.Pi + Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f)) * Vary(300f, 500f);
                await Wait(0.3);
                if (landed()) break;
                press = bn.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bear) * Vary(300f, 500f);
                bn.AimPoint = press; bn.UseAbility(id, 0);
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                moved = bn.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bear + Mathf.Pi / 2f + Vary(-0.3f, 0.3f)) * Vary(300f, 450f);
                bn.AimPoint = moved;
                await RealTime(landed, 0.9);
            }
            return (press, moved, landed());
        }
        var (bPress, bMoved, bGot) = await Aim("buster", () => seenShot != null);
        watch.QueueFree();
        await Wait(0.6);                                           // the moved cursor held while the host reads it
        ZoneNode well = null;
        var (wPress, wMoved, wGot) = await Aim("well", () => (well = H.Laid.FirstOrDefault(z => !zones0.Contains(z) && z.Row == Zones.Well)) != null);
        var wellAt = well?.Position ?? Vector2.Zero;
        await Wait(0.6);
        float bOn = bGot ? Mathf.Abs(shotDir.AngleTo(bPress - shotAt)) : 9f, bOff = bGot ? Mathf.Abs(shotDir.AngleTo(bMoved - shotAt)) : 0f;
        Check(bGot && bOn < 0.05f && bOff > 0.3f,
              $"arena guest: its buster (the host's round, its copy here) flies {bOn:0.000} rad off the point its press carried (0.05), {bOff:0.00} rad off the cursor it moved to the frame after (more than 0.3)");
        Check(wGot && wellAt.DistanceTo(wPress) < 10f && wellAt.DistanceTo(wMoved) > 250f,
              $"arena guest: its well (the host's, its copy here) lies {wellAt.DistanceTo(wPress):0.0} u from the point its press carried (10), {wellAt.DistanceTo(wMoved):0} u from the moved cursor");
        bn.Demo = demo;
    }

    // ── F14 · THE SENTRY THROW AND RECALL (lane A slice 5, kits5-J5) ──────────────────────────
    // World, host (the deploy row through PlayerShip.DeployTurret), kits_v3 3.3's lines, 3 runs from
    // varied spots. Cursors 150-250 u, 560-595 u and 700-900 u off the hull at varied bearings: each
    // sentry lands within 10 u of its point (the 600 u clamp on the same bearing for the far one), 0.8
    // +- 0.05 s after the press, and is no body before (it counts as out; nothing stands). The landing
    // is marked (Fx.AimZone). A 4th throw with 3 out is refused (ALL OUT). A cursor 10-50 u from one
    // recalls it inside the 6 s clock (never refused): it leaves the world at once and flies home 0.8 s
    // (+- 0.05, still out: a throw meanwhile is refused ALL OUT); a throw on open space inside the clock
    // is then refused (RELOADING). A cursor 65-90 u from every sentry throws a new one, and it lands with the hull the
    // recalled one had (kept, not refilled). Nothing sits exactly on 60 u or 600 u.
    async Task LaneASentryThrowChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var cls0 = Character.Class;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var fr = Me; bool demo = fr.Demo; fr.Demo = true;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
            var home = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; fr.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            await Wait(0.1);
            int Own() => H.Deployed.Count(t => t.OwnerId == fr.OwnerId);
            var dists = new[] { Vary(150f, 250f), Vary(560f, 595f), Vary(700f, 900f) };
            var landed = new List<DeployedTurret>();
            foreach (float dist in dists)
            {
                var cursor = home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * dist;
                var want = home + (cursor - home).LimitLength(600f);
                int stood = Own(), outBefore = fr.TurretsOut, marks0 = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(n => n.Id == Fx.AimZone);
                fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0;
                SentryAt(fr, cursor);
                double t0 = fr.Clock;
                bool inFlight = fr.TurretsOut == outBefore + 1 && Own() == stood;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                bool marked = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(n => n.Id == Fx.AimZone) > marks0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 120 && Own() == stood; i++)
                { fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                double flew = fr.Clock - t0;
                var got = H.Deployed.FirstOrDefault(t => t.OwnerId == fr.OwnerId && !landed.Contains(t));
                if (got != null) landed.Add(got);
                Check(inFlight && marked && got != null && got.Position.DistanceTo(want) < 10f && Math.Abs(flew - 0.8) < 0.05
                      && want.DistanceTo(home) < 600.5f,
                      $"R at a cursor {dist:0} u off lands a sentry {got?.Position.DistanceTo(want):0.0} u from {(dist > 600f ? "the 600 u clamp" : "the cursor")} after {flew:0.00} s (0.8), out but no body in flight ({inFlight}), its landing marked ({marked})");
            }
            fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0;
            SentryAt(fr, home);                                  // the hull's own spot: 150 u+ from every sentry
            Check(fr.TurretsOut == 3 && fr.FailNote("deploy") == "ALL OUT", $"a 4th throw with 3 out is refused, ALL OUT ({fr.TurretsOut})");
            if (landed.Count < 3) continue;

            var back = landed[0];
            double hurt = back.MaxHp * Vary(0.3f, 0.7f);
            back.Hp = hurt;
            fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 6.0;
            SentryAt(fr, back.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(10f, 50f));
            double r0 = fr.Clock;                                // the recall leaves the world in the press itself (host)
            bool left = !H.Deployed.Contains(back), homeOut = fr.TurretsOut == 3;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            SentryAt(fr, home);                                  // open space while it flies home: still three out
            string flyingNo = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.FreightHauler, "deploy").Refuse(fr, null);
            bool flying = fr.TurretsOut == 3 && flyingNo == "ALL OUT" && !H.Deployed.Contains(back);
            for (int i = 0; i < 120 && fr.TurretsOut == 3; i++)
            { fr.Position = home; fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double flewHome = fr.Clock - r0;
            bool recalled = left && homeOut && flying && fr.TurretsOut == 2 && Math.Abs(flewHome - 0.8) < 0.05;
            SentryAt(fr, home);
            Check(recalled && fr.TurretsOut == 2 && fr.FailNote("deploy") == "RELOADING",
                  $"R within 60 u of one recalls it inside the 6 s clock: it leaves at once ({left}), flies home still out (3 out {homeOut}, a throw meanwhile refused {flyingNo}; ALL OUT) and is stowed {flewHome:0.00} s after the press (0.8); R on open space inside the clock is refused, RELOADING ({fr.FailNote("deploy")})");

            // 65-90 u off one of the two left, on the side furthest from both
            var near = landed[1];
            var other = landed[2];
            Vector2 best = near.Position; float bestGap = -1f;
            for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++)
            {
                var c = near.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(k * Mathf.Tau / 8f) * Vary(65f, 90f);
                float gap = Math.Min(c.DistanceTo(near.Position), c.DistanceTo(other.Position));
                if (c.DistanceTo(home) < 590f && gap > bestGap) { bestGap = gap; best = c; }
            }
            fr.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0;
            SentryAt(fr, best);
            bool threw = fr.TurretsOut == 3 && H.Deployed.Contains(near);
            await Wait(0.9);
            var again = H.Deployed.FirstOrDefault(t => t.OwnerId == fr.OwnerId && !landed.Contains(t));
            Check(bestGap > 60f && threw && again != null && Math.Abs(again.Hp - hurt) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(again.MaxHp - 120) < 1e-6,
                  $"R {bestGap:0} u from the nearest sentry throws a new one, recalling none ({threw}); it lands with the recalled one's hull, {again?.Hp:0} of {again?.MaxHp:0} (kept {hurt:0})");
        }
        foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
        fr.Demo = demo;
        await SetClass(cls0);
    }

    // ── F14 · RAIDER.CALL (lane A slice 5, kits5-J6) ────────────────────────────────────────────
    // World, host (Squad.Call through Raider.Call; Taunt's override, kits_v2 Beacon / kits_v3 3.5): a
    // webifier hunting the pilot (its Quarry) from 250-400 u at a varied bearing, and a sentry of the
    // pilot's 450-700 u out at another. Run 0 calls it on the way in, runs 1-2 once it is latched on the
    // pilot. Called onto the sentry for 8-10 s: within 2 frames its target is the sentry, CalledBy says
    // so, a latched webber lets go, and its Quarry is still the pilot; it posts and latches on the sentry
    // inside the call. Called again for 0.5-0.8 s (a new call replaces the clock): 0.2-0.4 s past that
    // lapse it is back on its Quarry, CalledBy is empty and the Quarry was never touched.
    async Task LaneARaiderCallChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var cls0 = Character.Class;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var pm = Me; bool demo = pm.Demo; pm.Demo = true;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        foreach (var dp in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dp);
        await Wait(0.3);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = VaryAngle(); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            float wWay = VaryAngle();
            var sentry = H.Drop(pm, at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(wWay + Vary(1.6f, 4.6f)) * Vary(450f, 700f), 1e9);
            var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(wWay) * Vary(250f, 400f)); w.Quarry = pm; w.Hp = 1e9;
            async Task Frames(int n, Func<bool> until = null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < n && !(until?.Invoke() ?? false); i++)
                { pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            }
            await Frames(2);
            if (run > 0) await Frames(60 * 6, () => w.Latched);
            bool wasLatched = w.Latched;
            w.Call(sentry, Vary(8f, 10f));
            await Frames(2);
            bool took = ReferenceEquals(w.Target, sentry) && ReferenceEquals(w.CalledBy, sentry) && ReferenceEquals(w.Quarry, pm) && !w.Latched;
            await Frames(60 * 7, () => w.Latched && ReferenceEquals(w.Target, sentry));
            bool posted = w.Latched && ReferenceEquals(w.Target, sentry) && ReferenceEquals(w.CalledBy, sentry);
            Check(took && posted && (run == 0 || wasLatched),
                  $"{(run == 0 ? "on its way in" : "latched on the pilot")}, a called webifier takes the caller within 2 frames, lets go and keeps its quarry ({took}), and posts on the caller inside the call ({posted})");
            double again = Vary(0.5f, 0.8f);
            w.Call(sentry, again);
            double t0 = pm.Clock;
            await Frames(90, () => pm.Clock - t0 >= again + Vary(0.2f, 0.4f));
            bool back = ReferenceEquals(w.Target, pm) && w.CalledBy == null && ReferenceEquals(w.Quarry, pm);
            Check(back, $"a {again:0.00} s call lapses and it is back on its quarry, the pilot ({(w.Target as Node2D)?.Name}, called by {(w.CalledBy as Node2D)?.Name ?? "none"})");
            w.TakeDamage(1e12); H.DeployedTaken(sentry);
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        pm.Demo = demo; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
        await SetClass(cls0);
    }

    // ── F14 · DECOYS: THE FLARES ROW, NETDECOY, POINT GUIDANCE AND THE DAZZLE (lane A slice 5, kits5-J7) ──
    // Pure: the row's literals (kits_v2's Sniper card: 6 flares, 180 u, 0.6 s out, 5 s, lure 500, mark 300
    // with 1.0 s left, dazzle 150 for 4 s); 3 salvos at varied rotations: 6 points 180 +- 5 u out, 60 deg
    // apart, the first dead astern; a probe 490 u straight out from a point is lured onto it, one 510 u out
    // is not. World, host, 3 runs from varied spots and rotations: a seeker (25) launched at the pilot
    // 700-900 u off, the salvo popped 0-0.4 s later: it is lured and bursts on a flare, the pilot takes 0;
    // a raid missile marked on the pilot (180 u from every flare, 2-3 s up) moves onto a flare; one marked
    // 315-400 u beyond every flare stays; one within 300 u of a flare with 0.6-0.9 s left stays; one thrown
    // 4.2-4.5 s after the pop (1.5-2.5 s up) moves and still lands there after the salvo is gone; the salvo
    // stands at 4.9 s and is gone at 5.1 s. Dazzle, 3 runs: a held webifier 149 u out from a flare is
    // DAZZLED, one 151 u out is not; taken 400 u clear it is still dazzled 3.6-3.8 s later and not 4.2-4.4 s later.
    async Task LaneADecoyChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var fl = Decoys.Of(Decoys.Flares);
        Check(fl.Count == 6 && Math.Abs(fl.Ring - 180f) < 1e-4f && Math.Abs(fl.Coast - 0.6) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(fl.Life - 5) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(fl.Lure - 500f) < 1e-4f && Math.Abs(fl.Mark - 300f) < 1e-4f && Math.Abs(fl.MarkLeft - 1.0) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(fl.Dazzle - 150f) < 1e-4f && Math.Abs(fl.DazzleFor - 4) < 1e-9 && Shots.Of(Shots.Seeker).Decoyable
              && !Shots.Of(Shots.Cruise).Decoyable && Missiles.Of(Missiles.Raid).Decoyable && !Missiles.Of(Missiles.Outpost).Decoyable,
              "the flares row is kits_v2's card: 6 flares 180 u out in 0.6 s for 5 s, lure 500 u, mark 300 u with 1.0 s left, dazzle 150 u for 4 s; the seeker and the raid's missile are decoyable, the cruise missile and the outpost's are not");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var c = new Vector2(Vary(-3000f, 3000f), Vary(-3000f, 3000f));
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            var pts = Decoys.Points(fl, c, rot, fl.Coast + Vary(0.1f, 4f));
            bool ring = pts.Length == 6 && pts.All(p => Math.Abs(p.DistanceTo(c) - 180f) < 5f)
                        && Enumerable.Range(0, 6).All(i => Math.Abs(Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference((pts[i] - c).Angle(), (pts[(i + 1) % 6] - c).Angle()))) - 60f) < 1f)
                        && (pts[0] - c).Normalized().Dot(Vector2.Down.Rotated(rot)) > 0.999f;
            int k = (int)Vary(0f, 5.99f);
            var outward = (pts[k] - c).Normalized();
            bool near = Decoys.Nearest(pts, pts[k] + outward * 490f, fl.Lure) is { } got && got.DistanceTo(pts[k]) < 0.01f;
            bool far = Decoys.Nearest(pts, pts[k] + outward * 510f, fl.Lure) == null;
            Check(ring && near && far,
                  $"a salvo at rotation {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: 6 points 180 u out, 60 deg apart, the first dead astern ({ring}); 490 u out from one is lured onto it ({near}), 510 u is not ({far})");
        }

        var cls0 = Character.Class;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);                   // 120 u long: a flare's blast 180 u off never reaches it
        var pm = Me; bool demo = pm.Demo; pm.Demo = true;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        foreach (var sv in H.Salvos.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Decoy, sv, burst: false, float.NaN);
        await Wait(0.3);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = VaryAngle(); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            double hp0 = pm.Hp, low = pm.Hp;
            var from = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(700f, 900f);
            var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, from, at - from, 135f, 4000f, 25, targetId: pm.NetId, turnRate: 2f, hull: 1e9);
            Vector2 skEnd = from;
            async Task Frames(double seconds)
            {
                double t = pm.Clock + seconds;
                while (pm.Clock < t)
                {
                    if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(sk) && sk.Alive) skEnd = sk.GlobalPosition;
                    pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; low = Math.Min(low, pm.Hp);
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                }
            }
            await Frames(Vary(0f, 0.4f));
            var salvo = H.Flares(pm.Position, pm.Rotation);
            double pop = pm.Clock;
            var rest = salvo.Resting;
            await Frames(0.7);
            MissileSpec Spec(double flight) => new() { Side = Missiles.Raid, Damage = 42, Blast = 90f, Flight = flight };
            var far0 = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 1500f;
            int j = (int)Vary(0f, 5.99f);
            var outJ = (rest[j] - at).Normalized();
            var onPilot = at;
            var beyond = rest[j] + outJ * Vary(315f, 400f);
            var late = rest[(j + 3) % 6] + (rest[(j + 3) % 6] - at).Normalized() * Vary(100f, 200f);
            int m1 = H.ThrowMissile(Spec(Vary(2f, 3f)), far0, onPilot, 0);
            int m2 = H.ThrowMissile(Spec(Vary(2f, 3f)), far0, beyond, 0);
            int m3 = H.ThrowMissile(Spec(Vary(0.6f, 0.9f)), far0, late, 0);
            await Frames(0.05);
            Vector2 AtOf(int id) => H.Blasts.Where(b => b.id == id).Select(b => b.at).DefaultIfEmpty(new Vector2(float.NaN, float.NaN)).First();
            bool moved = rest.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(AtOf(m1)) < 1f)
                         && Nodes<MissileVisual>().Any(mv => mv.NetId == m1 && rest.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(mv.To) < 1f));
            bool stayed = AtOf(m2).DistanceTo(beyond) < 0.01f && AtOf(m3).DistanceTo(late) < 0.01f;
            Check(moved && stayed,
                  $"a raid missile marked on the pilot, 180 u from every flare, is pulled onto one, its missile too ({moved}); one {rest.Min(p => p.DistanceTo(beyond)):0} u from the nearest flare and one {late.DistanceTo(rest[(j + 3) % 6]):0} u off with under 1.0 s left stay ({stayed})");
            await Frames(pop + Vary(4.2f, 4.5f) - pm.Clock);
            int m4 = H.ThrowMissile(Spec(Vary(1.5f, 2.5f)), far0, onPilot, 0);
            await Frames(0.05);
            bool lateMoved = rest.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(AtOf(m4)) < 1f);
            await Frames(pop + 4.9 - pm.Clock);
            bool standing = H.Salvos.Contains(salvo);
            await Frames(pop + 5.1 - pm.Clock);
            bool gone = !H.Salvos.Contains(salvo);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && (sk.Alive || H.BlastsPending > 0); i++)
            {
                if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(sk) && sk.Alive) skEnd = sk.GlobalPosition;
                pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; low = Math.Min(low, pm.Hp);
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            bool lured = !sk.Alive && sk.DecoyPoint is { } lp && rest.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(lp) < 1f) && skEnd.DistanceTo(lp) < 60f;
            Check(lured && low >= hp0 - 1e-6 && lateMoved && standing && gone && H.BlastsPending == 0,
                  $"a seeker launched {from.DistanceTo(at):0} u off is lured onto a flare and bursts there ({lured}); a mark thrown 4.2-4.5 s after the pop moves too ({lateMoved}) and lands on its flare after the salvo is gone (standing at 4.9 s {standing}, gone at 5.1 s {gone}); the pilot took {hp0 - low:0.0} (0)");
        }

        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var c = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1200f, 1400f);
            var salvo = H.Flares(c, VaryAngle());
            var rest = salvo.Resting;
            await Wait(0.7);
            int k = (int)Vary(0f, 5.99f);
            Raider Held(Vector2 spot) { var w = H.SpawnRaider(spot); w.Hp = 1e9; w.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30); return w; }
            var inR = Held(rest[k] + (rest[k] - c).Normalized() * 149f);
            var outR = Held(rest[(k + 3) % 6] + (rest[(k + 3) % 6] - c).Normalized() * 151f);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool dz = inR.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled), notDz = !outR.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled);
            inR.Position = c + (rest[k] - c).Normalized() * (180f + 400f + 150f);
            double left = Vary(3.6f, 3.8f);
            await Wait(left);
            bool still = inR.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled);
            await Wait(Vary(4.2f, 4.4f) - left);
            bool lapsed = !inR.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled);
            Check(dz && notDz && still && lapsed,
                  $"a held webifier 149 u from a flare is dazzled ({dz}), one 151 u out is not ({notDz}); taken clear it stays dazzled {left:0.0} s later ({still}) and not past 4 s ({lapsed})");
            inR.TakeDamage(1e12); outR.TakeDamage(1e12);
            foreach (var sv in H.Salvos.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Decoy, sv, burst: false, float.NaN);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        pm.Demo = demo; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
        await SetClass(cls0);
    }

    // ── F14 · NETDECOY ON THE WIRE (lane A slice 5, kits5-J7), rung 5 ────────────────────────────
    // Host: a flare salvo 1400-1600 u off its own hull at a varied rotation (clear of both pilots), and a
    // raid missile (no damage) marked 200-260 u from its centre, 2.5-3 s up: on the host the mark goes onto
    // a flare within 2 frames. Guest (LaneADecoyGuestChecks): the salvo stands at the host's spots (each of
    // its 6 points derived here from the one seed), and the missile's mark arrives moved onto one of them.
    async Task LaneADecoyHostChecks(PlayerShip hw)
    {
        var c = hw.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1400f, 1600f);
        var salvo = H.Flares(c, VaryAngle());
        var mark = c + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 260f);
        int id = H.ThrowMissile(new MissileSpec { Side = Missiles.Raid, Damage = 0, Blast = 90f, Flight = Vary(2.5f, 3f) },
                                c + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 1200f, mark, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var landAt = H.Blasts.Where(b => b.id == id).Select(b => b.at).FirstOrDefault();
        Check(salvo != null && salvo.Resting.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(landAt) < 1f),
              $"arena host: a raid missile marked {mark.DistanceTo(c):0} u from a salvo's centre is pulled onto a flare here, {salvo?.Resting.Min(p => p.DistanceTo(landAt)):0.0} u off one");
    }
    async Task LaneADecoyGuestChecks()
    {
        await RealTime(() => H.Salvos.Count > 0 && Nodes<MissileVisual>().Any(mv => H.Salvos[0].Resting.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(mv.To) < 1f)), Wan ? 20 : 12);
        var salvo = H.Salvos.FirstOrDefault();
        var mine = salvo == null ? null : Decoys.Points(salvo.Def, salvo.At, salvo.Rot, salvo.Def.Coast);
        bool pulled = salvo != null && Nodes<MissileVisual>().Any(mv => salvo.Resting.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(mv.To) < 1f));
        bool circle = salvo != null && Fx.Warnings.Any(w => w.Id == Missiles.Of(Missiles.Raid).Mark && salvo.Resting.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(w.Position) < 1f));
        Check(salvo != null && mine.Length == 6 && pulled && circle,
              $"arena guest: the host's flare salvo stands here at the 6 spots its seed gives ({salvo != null}), and the raid missile's mark arrives pulled onto one of them, its missile ({pulled}) and its red circle ({circle})");
    }

    // ── F19 · TOW AND HURL (lane A slice 5, kits5-J8) ────────────────────────────────────────────
    // The row is kits_v3 3.2's TOW / HURL: 160 u off the bow, reeled in 0.5 s, hauled up to 3 s, hurled at
    // 600 u/s up to 900 u, 60 to each body (120 when a heavy is thrown). Immovable takes a practice dummy,
    // never a raider. World, host (Towing.Tow / Step through Raider's Towed state), 3 runs, a {webifier,
    // gunship, talon} hooked at VaryNear {150, 400, 699} u, the pilot at a varied rotation: 0.5 s + 2 frames
    // after the hook it is 160 +- 10 u off the bow, and while hauled it never latches and the pilot takes
    // nothing. Then: run 0 is hurled at once down the bow at a held webifier 300 u further on: both lose 60
    // (a light thrown) and the pilot's DealtBy["hurl"] grows 120; run 1 (the gunship, a heavy) the same at
    // 120 each; run 2 is left to the haul's end: thrown at 3.0 +- 0.05 s after the hook, it strikes nothing
    // and flies 900 +- 12 u.
    async Task LaneATowChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var tw = Towing.Of(Towing.Grapnel);
        var dummy = H.GetNodeOrNull<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
        Check(Math.Abs(tw.Offset - 160f) < 1e-4f && Math.Abs(tw.Reel - 0.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(tw.Haul - 3) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(tw.Speed - 600f) < 1e-4f && Math.Abs(tw.Reach - 900f) < 1e-4f
              && Math.Abs(Towing.Impact(tw, false) - 60) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Towing.Impact(tw, true) - 120) < 1e-9
              && dummy != null && Targeting.Immovable.Hits(dummy),
              "the tow row is the card's: 160 u off the bow in 0.5 s, 3 s hauled, 600 u/s to 900 u, 60 a body and 120 when a heavy is thrown; a practice dummy is immovable (a hook swings round it)");
        var pm = Me; bool demo = pm.Demo; pm.Demo = true;
        // what the hurl lands, body by body, counted at the door (a gun of the pilot's may also be firing)
        var hurled = new Dictionary<IHittable, double>();
        void OnLanded(IHittable h, double d, string w) { if (w == tw.Id) hurled[h] = hurled.GetValueOrDefault(h) + d; }
        Dealt.Landed += OnLanded;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.3);
        var kinds = new[] { Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Gunship, Enemies.Talon };
