        var dists = new[] { 150f, 400f, 699f };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            double low = pm.Hp;
            var c = H.SpawnRaider(VaryNear(at, dists[run]), kinds[run]); c.Hp = 1e9;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool immovable = Targeting.Immovable.Hits(c);
            bool hooked = Towing.Tow(c, pm, pm);
            double t0 = pm.Clock;
            bool latched = false;
            async Task Hold(double until)
            {
                while (pm.Clock - t0 < until)
                {
                    pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; low = Math.Min(low, pm.Hp); latched |= c.Latched;
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                }
            }
            await Hold(0.5 + 2.0 / 60);
            float off = c.Position.DistanceTo(Towing.Bow(pm, 160f));
            Check(hooked && !immovable && off < 10f && c.Towed != null,
                  $"a {c.Def.Id} hooked {dists[run]:0} u off is held 160 u off the bow 0.5 s later ({off:0.0} u from the spot), and a raider is never immovable ({immovable})");
            if (run < 2)
            {
                var fwd = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
                var victim = H.SpawnRaider(Towing.Bow(pm, 160f) + fwd * 300f); victim.Hp = 1e9; victim.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
                await Hold(0.7);
                hurled.Clear(); double dealt0 = pm.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("hurl");
                Towing.Hurl(c);
                for (int i = 0; i < 120 && c.Towed != null; i++) { pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; low = Math.Min(low, pm.Hp); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                double want = c.Heavy ? 120 : 60;
                double cLost = hurled.GetValueOrDefault(c), vLost = hurled.GetValueOrDefault(victim), credited = pm.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("hurl") - dealt0;
                Check(c.Towed == null && Math.Abs(cLost - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(vLost - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(credited - 2 * want) < 1e-6
                      && !latched && low >= pm.MaxHp - 1e-6,
                      $"hurled down the bow, the {(c.Heavy ? "heavy" : "light")} {c.Def.Id} strikes the raider 300 u on: each takes {want} ({cLost:0}, {vLost:0}), the pilot is credited {credited:0} as \"hurl\"; while hauled it never webbed and the pilot took nothing ({!latched}, {pm.MaxHp - low:0.0})");
                victim.TakeDamage(1e12);
            }
            else
            {
                double hurledAt = double.NaN; Vector2 start = c.Position; hurled.Clear();
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && c.Towed != null; i++)
                {
                    if (double.IsNaN(hurledAt) && c.Towed is { Flung: true }) { hurledAt = pm.Clock - t0; start = Towing.Bow(pm, 160f); }
                    pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; latched |= c.Latched;
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                }
                float flew = start.DistanceTo(c.Position);
                Check(Math.Abs(hurledAt - 3.0) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(flew - 900f) < 12f && hurled.Count == 0 && !latched,
                      $"left to the haul's end it is thrown {hurledAt:0.00} s after the hook (3.0) and, striking nothing, flies {flew:0} u (900) and takes nothing");
            }
            c.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        Dealt.Landed -= OnLanded;
        pm.Demo = demo; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── F17 · THE LATCH GATES (lane A slice 5, kits5-J9) ─────────────────────────────────────────
    // The OutGuards rows are kits_v2's F17 table: Suppressed takes latches and keeps them, Dazzled takes no
    // new one and keeps what it holds, Jammed takes none and drops the one it holds. World, host, a webifier
    // hunting the pilot from 250-400 u at a varied bearing, 3 runs: (0) DAZZLED before it posts: in 4 s it
    // never latches and the pilot is never Pinned; the dazzle cleared, it latches within 6 s. (1) the
    // interaction with the flares (Decoys.cs): a salvo popped on the pilot as the webifier comes in -- its
    // posts are inside a flare's 150 u -- and it never latches while they burn. (2) latched first, then
    // DAZZLED: it keeps its web for 2 s; then JAMMED: it lets go within 2 frames and the pilot's Pinned lapses
    // within 0.5 s, and it does not latch again while jammed.
    async Task LaneALatchGateChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        OutGuard Row(Status st) => StatusSet.OutGuards.First(g => g.Status == st);
        Check(!Row(Status.Suppressed).BlocksLatch && !Row(Status.Suppressed).DropsLatch
              && Row(Status.Dazzled).BlocksLatch && !Row(Status.Dazzled).DropsLatch
              && Row(Status.Jammed).BlocksLatch && Row(Status.Jammed).DropsLatch,
              "the latch columns of the F17 table: Suppressed takes and keeps a latch, Dazzled takes no new one and keeps its own, Jammed takes none and drops its own");
        var pm = Me; bool demo = pm.Demo; pm.Demo = true;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        foreach (var sv in H.Salvos.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Decoy, sv, burst: false, float.NaN);
        await Wait(0.3);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = VaryAngle(); pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f)); w.Quarry = pm; w.Hp = 1e9;
            bool latched = false, pinned = false;
            async Task Frames(double seconds, Func<bool> until = null)
            {
                double t = pm.Clock + seconds;
                while (pm.Clock < t && !(until?.Invoke() ?? false))
                {
                    pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; latched |= w.Latched; pinned |= pm.Statuses.Has(Status.Pinned);
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                }
            }
            if (run == 0)
            {
                w.ApplyStatus(Status.Dazzled, 30);
                await Frames(4.0);
                bool blocked = !latched && !pinned;
                w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Dazzled);
                await Frames(6.0, () => w.Latched);
                Check(blocked && w.Latched, $"a dazzled webifier never latches in 4 s and the pilot is never pinned ({blocked}); the dazzle cleared, it latches ({w.Latched})");
            }
            else if (run == 1)
            {
                H.Flares(pm.Position, pm.Rotation);
                await Frames(4.2);
                Check(!latched && !pinned && w.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled),
                      $"flares popped on the pilot: the webifier posting on it is dazzled ({w.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled)}) and never latches while they burn ({!latched}); the pilot is never pinned ({!pinned})");
            }
            else
            {
                await Frames(6.0, () => w.Latched);
                bool had = w.Latched;
                w.ApplyStatus(Status.Dazzled, 30);
                bool kept = true;
                double t = pm.Clock + 2.0;
                while (pm.Clock < t) { kept &= w.Latched; pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                w.ApplyStatus(Status.Jammed, 30);
                for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                bool dropped = !w.Latched;
                await Frames(0.5);
                bool freed = !pm.Statuses.Has(Status.Pinned);
                latched = false;
                await Frames(3.0);
                Check(had && kept && dropped && freed && !latched,
                      $"a webifier latched before it is dazzled keeps its web for 2 s ({had}, {kept}); jammed, it lets go within 2 frames ({dropped}), the pin lapses ({freed}) and it takes no new latch while jammed ({!latched})");
            }
            w.TakeDamage(1e12);
            foreach (var sv in H.Salvos.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Decoy, sv, burst: false, float.NaN);
            pm.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        pm.Demo = demo; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── F12 · THE MELEE ARC AND THE GUARD CLAMP (lane A slice 5, kits5-J1) ─────────────────────
    // Pure (Melee.Pick, Melee.Guard): the blade's literals (160 u, ±55°, kits_v2 Warrior card) and the
    // whirlwind's (210 u, all round) from 3 varied spots and facings. A body well inside the wedge and one
    // whose rim just reaches in are struck; one 2-25° outside the wedge, one past the reach and one
    // behind are not; Stops 1 takes the nearest. The guard follows the cursor to ±90° off the nose and no
    // further (the prism's clamp), from 3 varied noses; nothing is exactly on 55° or 90°.
    void LaneAMeleeArcChecks()
    {
        const float reach = 160f, half = 55f;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var from = new Vector2(Vary(-3000f, 3000f), Vary(-3000f, 3000f));
            float facing = VaryAngle();
            Vector2 At(float bearingDeg, float dist) => from + Vector2.Right.Rotated(facing + Mathf.DegToRad(bearingDeg)) * dist;
            var pool = new List<(string name, Vector2 at, float r)>();
            float r0 = Vary(8f, 20f), r1 = Vary(8f, 20f), r2 = Vary(8f, 20f), r3 = Vary(8f, 20f), r4 = Vary(8f, 20f);
            pool.Add(("inside", At(Vary(-45f, 45f), Vary(40f, 90f)), r0));
            pool.Add(("rim", At(Vary(-40f, 40f), reach + r1 - Vary(2f, 10f)), r1));
            pool.Add(("wide", At((run % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1) * Vary(57f, 80f), Vary(60f, 140f)), r2));
            pool.Add(("far", At(Vary(-30f, 30f), reach + r3 + Vary(10f, 60f)), r3));
            pool.Add(("behind", At(180f + Vary(-60f, 60f), Vary(40f, 140f)), r4));
            var shuffled = pool.OrderBy(_ => Rng.Randi()).ToList();
            string Names(List<(string name, Vector2 at, float r)> l) => string.Join(",", l.Select(t => t.name).OrderBy(n => n));
            var blade = Melee.Pick(from, facing, reach, Mathf.DegToRad(half), 0, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            var first = Melee.Pick(from, facing, reach, Mathf.DegToRad(half), 1, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            var whirl = Melee.Pick(from, facing, 210f, Mathf.Pi, 0, shuffled, t => t.at, t => t.r);
            Check(Names(blade) == "inside,rim" && first.Count == 1 && first[0].name == "inside"
                  && new[] { "inside", "rim", "wide", "behind" }.All(n => whirl.Any(t => t.name == n)),
                  $"a 160 u x +-55 deg arc facing {Mathf.RadToDeg(facing):0} deg strikes the body inside and the one whose rim reaches in, never one outside the wedge, past the reach or behind ({Names(blade)}); Stops 1 takes the nearest ({string.Join(",", first.Select(t => t.name))}); a 210 u whirl all round takes the one behind and the wide one ({Names(whirl)})");

            float nose = VaryAngle();
            float wideR = Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(95f, 175f)), wideL = -Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(95f, 175f)), inR = Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(5f, 85f));
            float gR = Mathf.AngleDifference(nose, Melee.Guard(nose, nose + wideR, Mathf.Pi / 2f));
            float gL = Mathf.AngleDifference(nose, Melee.Guard(nose, nose + wideL, Mathf.Pi / 2f));
            float gI = Mathf.AngleDifference(nose, Melee.Guard(nose, nose + inR, Mathf.Pi / 2f));
            Check(Mathf.Abs(gR - Mathf.Pi / 2f) < 1e-4f && Mathf.Abs(gL + Mathf.Pi / 2f) < 1e-4f && Mathf.Abs(gI - inR) < 1e-4f,
                  $"the guard clamp, nose {Mathf.RadToDeg(nose):0} deg: a cursor {Mathf.RadToDeg(wideR):0} deg right clamps to 90 ({Mathf.RadToDeg(gR):0.0}), {Mathf.RadToDeg(-wideL):0} deg left to -90 ({Mathf.RadToDeg(gL):0.0}), {Mathf.RadToDeg(inR):0} deg is followed ({Mathf.RadToDeg(gI):0.0})");
        }
    }

    // World (Melee.Strike, host): the pilot swings a test row (reach its own main_range, +-55 deg, the
    // blade's 26 a blow) from 3 varied spots and headings, with a gunship in front inside its reach, one
    // behind and one just past the reach. Only the one in front loses 26, once, and the pilot's
    // DealtBy["melee_test"] grows by 26: the door credits the row's id.
    async Task LaneAMeleeStrikeChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var pm = Me;
        var row = new MeleeDef { Id = "melee_test", Reach = "main_range", Arc = 55f, Stops = 0 };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot;
            float reach = (float)pm.Stats[row.Reach];
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var spots = new[] { at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-40f, 40f))) * reach * Vary(0.3f, 0.7f),
                                at - nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-50f, 50f))) * reach * Vary(0.3f, 0.7f),
                                at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-30f, 30f))) * (reach + Vary(150f, 300f)) };
            var foes = spots.Select(s => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(s, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k];
            pm.Position = at; pm.Rotation = rot;
            var hp0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt0 = pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(row.Id, out var dv) ? dv : 0;
            var hit = Melee.Strike(row, pm, 26);
            var lost = Enumerable.Range(0, 3).Select(k => hp0[k] - foes[k].Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt = (pm.DealtBy.TryGetValue(row.Id, out var dv2) ? dv2 : 0) - dealt0;
            Check(Math.Abs(lost[0] - 26) < 1e-6 && lost[1] == 0 && lost[2] == 0 && hit.Count == 1 && Math.Abs(dealt - 26) < 1e-6,
                  $"a {reach:0} u +-55 deg arc swung at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: the gunship in front loses 26, the one behind and the one past the reach nothing ({string.Join(" / ", lost.Select(l => l.ToString("0.##")))}), and DealtBy[\"melee_test\"] grows 26 ({dealt:0.##})");
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE WARRIOR'S BLADE (kits_v2 Warrior card: 160 u, ±55°, 26 every 0.40 s = 65 DPS) ──
    // 1 the sheet: the row's literals, hull 300, no guns, 65 DPS in the K window, the blade in the items'
    //   primary roles. 2 the swing, held on Space, from 3 varied spots and headings: a gunship inside the
    //   arc loses exactly 3 x 26 in the first 1.0 s after its first blow (timed from that blow), while one
    //   behind, one past 160 u and one 65-80 deg off the nose lose nothing; DealtBy["blade"] grows the same.
    // 3 the interactions: released, it swings no more; DISABLED, it swings no more.
    // ── SLICE 6a · THE BATTLESHIP'S MAIN BATTERY ARCS (v1 card, A6a-1) ─────────────────────────────
    // The fore pair never fires within 30 deg of the stern, the aft pair never within 30 deg of the bow:
    // all four bear 30-150 deg off the bow, two inside 30 deg of bow or stern. The table proved against
    // the card's bearings as literals, then the live guns at three VaryAngle headings, one bearing drawn
    // clear of each edge on either side (the barrel sits off the centre, so never ON 30 or 150).
    async Task LaneA6aArcChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var art = Classes.Of(ShipClass.Battleship).Art;
        int Bear(float b) => art.MainBears.Count(r => Turret.InArc(b, r));
        var bearings = new[] { 0f, 29f, 31f, 90f, 149f, 151f, 180f };
        var want = new[] { 2, 2, 4, 4, 4, 2, 2 };
        Check(art.MainBears.Length == 4 && art.Mains.Length == 4 && bearings.Select(Bear).SequenceEqual(want),
              $"the battleship's arcs: at 0 / 29 / 31 / 90 / 149 / 151 / 180 deg off the bow, 2 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 4 / 2 / 2 main guns bear ({string.Join(" / ", bearings.Select(Bear))})");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me; s.Staggered = false;
        var gunKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Battleship, "guns");
        var cases = new[] { (lo: 45f, hi: 135f, n: 4, what: "abeam"), (lo: 2f, hi: 18f, n: 2, what: "on the bow"), (lo: 162f, hi: 178f, n: 2, what: "on the stern") };
        foreach (var c in cases)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(), b = Vary(c.lo, c.hi), side = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f;
            Vector2 AimAt() => s.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(s.Rotation).Rotated(side * Mathf.DegToRad(b)) * 700f;
            void Pose() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = rot; AimWorld(AimAt()); }
            for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }   // 2.5 s: every barrel round
            var mains = Nodes<Turret>(s).Where(t => !t.PointDefense).ToList();
            int bearing = mains.Count(t => t.Bearing);
            var seen = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<Shot>(Shells());
            int salvo = 0; double t0 = -1;
            KeyDown(gunKey);
            for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++)
            {
                Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                int fresh = Shells().Count(x => seen.Add(x));
                if (fresh > 0 && t0 < 0) t0 = s.Clock;                     // timed from the first shell, not the key
                if (t0 >= 0) { salvo += fresh; if (s.Clock - t0 > 0.1) break; }
            }
            KeyUp(gunKey);
            Check(salvo == c.n && bearing == c.n,
                  $"a battleship at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg, the cursor {b:0} deg off the bow {(side > 0 ? "to one side" : "to the other")} ({c.what}): {bearing} barrels bear and the salvo is {salvo} shells ({c.n})");
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a · THE BROADSIDE ON THE v1 NUMBERS (A6a-1) ──────────────────────────────────────────
    // 0.5 s wind-up, 6 volleys x 4 guns 0.25 s apart at x1.25 = 375 side-on (187.5 bow-on: the arcs hold
    // the aft pair), 12 s cooldown: 27.3 DPS over a 13.75 s cycle. From the turrets aimed {0, 90, 180} deg
    // away from the cursor, with the ship {still, full ahead, turning}, a side-on broadside is exactly 24
    // shells; one bow-on is 12; one pressed mid warp charge still fires (kits_v31 §3.4).
    async Task LaneA6aBroadsideChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var bs = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship);
        Check(bs["broadside_volleys"] == 6 && bs["broadside_mult"] == 1.25 && bs["broadside_windup"] == 0.5 && bs["broadside_gap"] == 0.25
              && bs["broadside_cooldown"] == 12 && bs["main_damage"] == 12.5 && bs["main_count"] == 4 && bs["main_interval"] == 2.0 && bs["hull"] == 500
              && Math.Abs(bs.BroadsideDamage - 375) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(bs.BroadsideCycle - 13.75) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(bs.BroadsideDps - 375 / 13.75) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(bs.MainDps - 25) < 1e-9,
              $"the battleship's sheet (v1): hull {bs["hull"]:0} (500), guns 4 x 12.5 every 2 s = {bs.MainDps:0.00} DPS (25), a broadside of 6 x 4 x 12.5 x 1.25 = {bs.BroadsideDamage:0.0} (375) every {bs.BroadsideCycle:0.00} s (13.75) = {bs.BroadsideDps:0.00} DPS (27.27)");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me; var fKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Battleship, "broadside");
        var runs = new[] { (away: 0f, move: 0, lo: 60f, hi: 120f, n: 24, warp: false), (away: 90f, move: 1, lo: 60f, hi: 120f, n: 24, warp: false),
                           (away: 180f, move: 2, lo: 60f, hi: 120f, n: 24, warp: false), (away: 90f, move: 0, lo: 2f, hi: 14f, n: 12, warp: false),
                           (away: 0f, move: 0, lo: 60f, hi: 120f, n: 24, warp: true) };
        foreach (var r in runs)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(), b = Vary(r.lo, r.hi), side = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f;
            s.Sl("broadside").Cool = 0; s.Sl("broadside").Left = 0; s.Sl("broadside").N = 0;
            s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = rot;
            Vector2 AimAt(float off) => s.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(s.Rotation).Rotated(side * Mathf.DegToRad(b + off)) * 700f;
            for (int i = 0; i < 180; i++) { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = rot; AimWorld(AimAt(r.away)); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            if (r.move >= 1) { KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); s.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * 80f; }
            if (r.move == 2) KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.D);
            if (r.warp) { s.DriveHeld = true; s.PressDrive(); await Wait(0.2); }
            bool chargingAtFire = false;
            var seen = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<Shot>(Shells());
            int shells = 0, volleys = 0; double cdAfter = -1;
            AimWorld(AimAt(0f)); Key(fKey);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3; i++)
            {
                AimWorld(AimAt(0f)); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                int fresh = Shells().Count(x => seen.Add(x));
                if (fresh == 0) continue;
                if (volleys == 0) chargingAtFire = s.Charging;
                shells += fresh; volleys++;
                if (volleys == 6) cdAfter = s.Sl("broadside").Cool;
            }
            if (r.warp) { s.DriveHeld = false; for (int i = 0; i < 20 && s.Charging; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.D); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            Check(shells == r.n && volleys == 6 && cdAfter > 11.9 && cdAfter <= 12.0 && (!r.warp || chargingAtFire),
                  $"a broadside {b:0} deg off the bow, turrets {r.away:0} deg away at the press, {(r.move == 0 ? "still" : r.move == 1 ? "full ahead" : "turning")}{(r.warp ? ", mid warp charge (" + chargingAtFire + ")" : "")}: "
                  + $"{volleys} volleys (6), {shells} shells ({r.n}), cooling {cdAfter:0.00} s after the last (12)");
            s.Sl("broadside").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE BRACE (the Battleship's Q, v1: x0.35 taken for 3 s at half speed, 25 s from the press) ──
    // Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading; still / full ahead from rest / turning): blows of 250, 30
    // and 12 at VaryNear bearings -- whole before the press, x0.35 inside it (0.5-2.9 s after the frame the guard
    // shows), whole again 3.1-3.4 s after; the hold 0.5 and a full-ahead hull under 44 u/s (88 x 0.5); the
    // cooldown 25.0 from the press, and a second Q refused COOLING. The bar reads BRACED while it runs.
    async Task LaneA6aBraceChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var bs = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship);
        Check(bs["brace_time"] == 3 && bs["brace_share"] == 0.35 && bs["brace_cooldown"] == 25 && Ab.Brace.Hold == 0.5
              && Ab.Brace.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Battleship, 1) == Ab.Broadside
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Battleship, 2) == Ab.Brace && new ShipStats(ShipClass.Destroyer)["brace_share"] == 0,
              $"the Brace's rows: {bs["brace_time"]:0} s (3), x{bs["brace_share"]:0.00} taken (0.35), hold x{Ab.Brace.Hold:0.0} (0.5), {bs["brace_cooldown"]:0} s (25); Q; the battleship's ability 2 ({Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Battleship, 2)?.Name})");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me; var q = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Battleship, "brace");
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            s.Sl("brace").Left = 0; s.Sl("brace").Cool = 0; s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened); s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
            s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            await Frame();
            double Blow(double amt, string tag) { double h0 = s.Hp; s.Hit(amt, s.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 400f), $"brace_probe:{tag}{run}"); double took = h0 - s.Hp; s.Hp = s.MaxHp; return took; }
            double pre = Blow(250, "pre");
            if (run >= 1) KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
            if (run == 2) KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.D);
            Key(q);
            int frames = 0;
            for (; frames < 6 && !s.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened); frames++) await Frame();
            double t0 = s.Clock, cool = s.Sl("brace").Cool;
            string line = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Battleship, "brace").State(s, null).Line;
            async Task Until(double t) { while (s.Clock < t) await Frame(); }
            await Until(t0 + Vary(0.5f, 1.2f));
            double a = Blow(250, "a"), b = Blow(30, "b");
            Key(q); await Frame(); await Frame();
            string again = s.FailNote("brace");
            await Until(t0 + Vary(2.5f, 2.9f));
            double c = Blow(12, "c"), held = s.Held, speed = s.Velocity.Length();
            await Until(t0 + Vary(3.1f, 3.4f));
            double after = Blow(250, "after");
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.D); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            Check(Math.Abs(pre - 250) < 1e-6 && frames <= 3 && Math.Abs(a - 87.5) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(b - 10.5) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(c - 4.2) < 1e-6
                  && Math.Abs(after - 250) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(held - 0.5) < 1e-6 && (run == 0 ? speed < 1 : speed > 30 && speed <= 44.5)
                  && Math.Abs(cool - 25.0) < 0.1 && again == "COOLING" && line.StartsWith("BRACED"),
                  $"brace run {run} ({(run == 0 ? "still" : run == 1 ? "full ahead" : "turning")}): 250 before takes {pre:0.0}; braced 250 -> {a:0.00} (87.5), 30 -> {b:0.00} (10.5), 12 -> {c:0.00} (4.2); after 3 s 250 -> {after:0.0}; "
                  + $"hold {held:0.00} (0.5), {speed:0.0} u/s ({(run == 0 ? "0" : "<= 44")}); cooldown {cool:0.00} (25); Q again {again} (COOLING); the bar '{line}' (BRACED)");
            s.Sl("brace").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE BRACE AND THE WARP (kits_v31 §3.4: "the charge and the jump are unaffected, and the guard keeps
    // running through a jump") -- three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, the brace pressed just before the
    // charge or 0.05-0.6 s into it): the charge runs (Charging), the jump lands within 10% of ChargeReach taken the
    // frame before the release, and on the far side the brace still runs and a 100 blow takes 35.
    async Task LaneA6aBraceWarpChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            s.Sl("brace").Left = 0; s.Sl("brace").Cool = 0; s.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened); s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
            s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            await Frame();
            if (run == 0) { s.UseAbility("brace", 0); await Frame(); }
            s.DriveHeld = true; s.PressDrive();
            await Wait(Vary(0.05f, 0.6f));
            if (run > 0) { s.UseAbility("brace", 0); await Frame(); }
            bool braced = s.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened), charging = s.Charging;
            await Wait(Vary(0.3f, 0.6f));
            float reach = s.ChargeReach; var from = s.Position;
            s.DriveHeld = false;
            float moved = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 40 && moved < 50f; i++) { await Frame(); moved = s.Position.DistanceTo(from); }
            await Frame();
            double h0 = s.Hp; s.Hit(100, s.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 300f, $"brace_warp:{run}"); double took = h0 - s.Hp; s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
            Check(braced && charging && reach > 50f && Math.Abs(moved - reach) <= reach * 0.1f + 10f && s.Sl("brace").Left > 0 && Math.Abs(took - 35) < 1e-6,
                  $"brace + warp run {run}: braced {braced}, charging {charging}; the jump went {moved:0} u against a reach of {reach:0} (within 10%); after it the guard runs ({s.Sl("brace").Left:0.00} s left) and 100 takes {took:0.00} (35)");
            for (int i = 0; i < 20 && s.Charging; i++) await Frame();
            s.Sl("brace").Left = 0; s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened); s.Sl("warp").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE BRACE BESIDE THE OTHER GUARDS (kits_v3 §5, kept by kits_v31 §7: "WD Taunt's guard vs BB Brace --
    // split by depth": Brace deep and short, x0.35 for 3 s at half speed; Taunt shallow and long, x0.67 for 6 s, no hold)
    // and timed for a super: the rows keep the split, the broadside fires its whole 24 shells while braced, and a second
    // guard on the same hull (D9: the stronger kept while both run) never weakens the Brace nor is weakened by it --
    // three varied runs, the other guard (0.67, 0.5 or 0.2) applied before or after the press at a VaryNear spot.
    async Task LaneA6aBraceSplitChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var bs = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship); var wd = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        Check(bs["brace_share"] < wd["taunt_guard"] && bs["brace_time"] < wd["taunt_time"] && Ab.Brace.Hold == 0.5 && Ab.Taunt.Hold == 1
              && wd["taunt_guard"] == 0.67 && wd["taunt_time"] == 6 && bs["brace_share"] == 0.35 && bs["brace_time"] == 3
              && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, "brace") == null && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Battleship, "taunt") == null,
              $"the Brace and the Taunt split by depth: the Brace x{bs["brace_share"]:0.00} for {bs["brace_time"]:0} s at hold x{Ab.Brace.Hold:0.0}, the Taunt x{wd["taunt_guard"]:0.00} for {wd["taunt_time"]:0} s at no hold; neither class carries the other");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me; var fKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Battleship, "broadside");
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var others = new[] { 0.67, 0.5, 0.2 };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(), side = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f, b = Vary(70f, 110f);
            s.Sl("brace").Left = 0; s.Sl("brace").Cool = 0; s.Sl("broadside").Cool = 0; s.Sl("broadside").Left = 0; s.Sl("broadside").N = 0;
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened); s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
            Vector2 Aim() => s.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(s.Rotation).Rotated(side * Mathf.DegToRad(b)) * 700f;
            for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++) { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = rot; AimWorld(Aim()); await Frame(); }
            if (run != 1) s.ApplyStatus(Status.Hardened, 6, others[run]);
            s.UseAbility("brace", 0); await Frame();
            if (run == 1) s.ApplyStatus(Status.Hardened, 6, others[run]);
            var seen = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<Shot>(Shells());
            AimWorld(Aim()); Key(fKey);
            int shells = 0; double took = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 132; i++)
            {
                s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = rot; AimWorld(Aim()); await Frame();
                shells += Shells().Count(x => seen.Add(x));
                if (i == 60) { double h0 = s.Hp; s.Hit(100, s.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 300f, $"brace_split:{run}"); took = h0 - s.Hp; s.Hp = s.MaxHp; }
            }
            double want = Math.Min(0.35, others[run]) * 100;
            Check(shells == 24 && Math.Abs(took - want) < 1e-6,
                  $"brace + broadside run {run}, a second guard x{others[run]:0.00} {(run == 1 ? "after" : "before")} the press: {shells} shells while braced (24), a 100 blow takes {took:0.00} ({want:0.00}: the stronger kept)");
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened); s.Sl("brace").Left = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: CIWS (the Battleship's E, v1: both PD mounts x8 rate and x3 damage for 6 s, 20 s from the press) ──
    // Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, the light raider 0.25-0.5 of the 460 u reach at a VaryAngle
    // bearing): E, then both mounts on it and aimed; from the first blow after that, 1.0 s takes 48 (2 x 1.5 every
    // 0.0625 s) +- one shot a mount; the PD spec reads 1.5 and 0.0625 while the MAIN guns keep 2.0 s (scoped); the
    // cooldown 20.0 from the press and a second E refused COOLING; 6.2-6.5 s after the press the spec is back to 0.5
    // every 0.5 s. The bar reads CIWS while it runs.
    async Task LaneA6aCiwsChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var bs = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship);
        Check(bs["ciws_time"] == 6 && bs["ciws_rate"] == 8 && bs["ciws_damage"] == 3 && bs["ciws_cooldown"] == 20 && bs["pd_range"] == 460
              && bs["pd_damage"] == 0.5 && bs["pd_interval"] == 0.5 && Ab.Ciws.Default == global::Godot.Key.E && Ab.Ciws.RateOn == "pd_interval"
              && Ab.Ciws.DamageOn == "pd_damage" && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Battleship, 3) == Ab.Ciws,
              $"CIWS's rows: {bs["ciws_time"]:0} s (6), x{bs["ciws_rate"]:0} rate (8) and x{bs["ciws_damage"]:0} damage (3) on the PD alone, {bs["ciws_cooldown"]:0} s (20), PD {bs["pd_range"]:0} u; E; the battleship's ability 3 ({Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Battleship, 3)?.Name})");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me; var e = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Battleship, "ciws");
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
            s.Sl("ciws").Left = 0; s.Sl("ciws").Cool = 0;
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var prey = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 460f * Vary(0.25f, 0.5f));
            prey.Hp = 9000; prey.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var pds = s.PdTurrets;
            bool OnAndAimed(Turret t) => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, prey)
                && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(t.GlobalRotation, (prey.Position - t.GlobalPosition).Angle())) < Mathf.DegToRad(4f);
            for (int i = 0; i < 240 && !pds.All(OnAndAimed); i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            Key(e); await Frame(); Hold();
            double tp = s.Clock, cool = s.Sl("ciws").Cool;
            Key(e); await Frame(); await Frame();
            string again = s.FailNote("ciws"), line = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Battleship, "ciws").State(s, null).Line;
            double pdDmg = s.Spec(true).Damage, pdGap = s.Spec(true).Interval, mainGap = s.Spec(false).Interval;
            double was = prey.Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && prey.Hp >= was; i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double hp0 = prey.Hp, c0 = s.Clock;                                    // timed from a blow, not the key
            while (s.Clock - c0 < 1.0) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double got = hp0 - prey.Hp;
            while (s.Clock < tp + Vary(6.2f, 6.5f)) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double endDmg = s.Spec(true).Damage, endGap = s.Spec(true).Interval;
            Check(pds.Count == 2 && Math.Abs(pdDmg - 1.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(pdGap - 0.0625) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(mainGap - 2.0) < 1e-9
                  && Math.Abs(got - 48) <= 3 + 1e-9 && Math.Abs(cool - 20) < 0.1 && again == "COOLING" && line.StartsWith("CIWS")
                  && Math.Abs(endDmg - 0.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(endGap - 0.5) < 1e-9,
                  $"CIWS run {run}: a light raider {prey.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(head):0} deg takes {got:0.0} in 1.0 s from the first blow (48 +- 3); the PD {pdDmg:0.00} every {pdGap:0.0000} s (1.5 / 0.0625), the main guns every {mainGap:0.00} s (2.0); "
                  + $"cooldown {cool:0.00} (20), E again {again} (COOLING), the bar '{line}'; after 6 s {endDmg:0.00} every {endGap:0.00} s (0.5 / 0.5)");
            prey.TakeDamage(1e12);
            s.Sl("ciws").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: CIWS UNDER AN OVERSHOOT (kits_v31 decision 13, default: the overshoot disables CIWS -- it is a gun --
    // while the plain PD keeps firing). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, Disabled for 1.0-1.5 s
    // applied 0.5-1.5 s into the run): while Disabled the PD spec reads 0.5 every 0.5 s and a light raider still takes
    // blows (> 0, <= 2 x 0.5 x 3 in 1.0 s); once it clears, inside the 6 s, the spec is 1.5 every 0.0625 s again.
    async Task LaneA6aCiwsDisableChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
            s.Sl("ciws").Left = 0; s.Sl("ciws").Cool = 0; s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var prey = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 460f * Vary(0.25f, 0.45f));
            prey.Hp = 9000; prey.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            for (int i = 0; i < 240 && !s.PdTurrets.All(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, prey)); i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            s.UseAbility("ciws", 0); await Frame();
            double tp = s.Clock;
            while (s.Clock < tp + Vary(0.5f, 1.5f)) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            float off = Vary(1.0f, 1.5f);
            s.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, off);
            await Frame(); Hold();
            double dDmg = s.Spec(true).Damage, dGap = s.Spec(true).Interval, h0 = prey.Hp, c0 = s.Clock;
            while (s.Clock - c0 < 0.9) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double tookOff = h0 - prey.Hp;
            while (s.Disabled) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            await Frame();
            double bDmg = s.Spec(true).Damage, bGap = s.Spec(true).Interval, left = s.Sl("ciws").Left;
            Check(Math.Abs(dDmg - 0.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(dGap - 0.5) < 1e-9 && tookOff > 0 && tookOff <= 3.0 + 1e-9
                  && left > 0 && Math.Abs(bDmg - 1.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(bGap - 0.0625) < 1e-9,
                  $"CIWS + overshoot run {run} (Disabled {off:0.00} s): the PD {dDmg:0.00} every {dGap:0.00} s while disabled (0.5 / 0.5) and still firing ({tookOff:0.0} in 0.9 s, > 0 and <= 3); "
                  + $"cleared with {left:0.0} s of CIWS left: {bDmg:0.00} every {bGap:0.0000} s (1.5 / 0.0625)");
            prey.TakeDamage(1e12);
            s.Sl("ciws").Left = 0; s.Sl("ciws").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: CIWS KEEPS POINT DEFENCE'S PREY AND RANK (kits_v31 §7: "CV patrol vs BB CIWS vs FR sentries vs PD --
    // all rank by one Turret.Rank"; A6a-3: never a heavy, a boss or a hulk). Three varied runs: a heavy gunship 150-300
    // u off and a light webifier (60 hull) at another VaryAngle bearing, both inside 460 u; under CIWS no mount ever
    // takes the gunship, the light dies inside 2.5 s, and then the mounts stay idle while the gunship loses nothing.
    async Task LaneA6aCiwsPreyChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle(), a1 = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
            s.Sl("ciws").Left = 0; s.Sl("ciws").Cool = 0;
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var heavyAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1) * Vary(150f, 300f);
            var lightAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1 + Vary(1.2f, 2.4f)) * Vary(120f, 200f);
            var heavy = H.SpawnRaider(heavyAt, Enemies.Gunship); heavy.Hp = 9000; heavy.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            var light = H.SpawnRaider(lightAt, Enemies.Webifier); light.Hp = 60; light.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            s.UseAbility("ciws", 0);
            double tp = s.Clock; bool onHeavy = false; double diedAt = -1;
            while (s.Clock < tp + 4.0)
            {
                Hold(); heavy.Position = heavyAt; await Frame();
                onHeavy |= s.PdTurrets.Any(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, heavy));
                if (diedAt < 0 && (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(light) || !light.Alive)) diedAt = s.Clock - tp;
            }
            Check(!onHeavy && diedAt > 0 && diedAt < 2.5 && heavy.Hp == 9000 && s.PdTurrets.All(t => t.Target == null || !ReferenceEquals(t.Target, heavy)),
                  $"CIWS prey run {run}: a gunship {heavyAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off never taken ({!onHeavy}, lost {9000 - heavy.Hp:0.0}); a 60-hull webifier {lightAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off down at {diedAt:0.00} s (< 2.5)");
            heavy.TakeDamage(1e12);
            s.Sl("ciws").Left = 0; s.Sl("ciws").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE CARRIER'S ROW (v1: hull 425, turn radius 140, two PD mounts -- the stern one gone, D8 --, fighters
    // 3.5 a shot = 25.0 DPS on the sheet, bombers 2 x 4 torpedoes of 60). The sheet, then three varied live runs
    // (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, a light raider at a VaryAngle bearing 150-300 u off): the hull at 425, exactly
    // two PD mounts, both abreast amidships (|local y| < 5, |local x| 25-35), and both take the raider.
    async Task LaneA6aCarrierRowChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var cv = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Carrier);
        double sustained = 3 * (3.5 / 0.35) * (15.0 / 18.0) + 4 * 2 * 60 / 27.5 + 2 * 0.5 / 0.5;
        Check(cv["hull"] == 425 && cv["turn_radius"] == 140 && cv["turn_rate"] == 0.9 && cv["pd_count"] == 2 && cv["fighter_damage"] == 3.5
              && cv["torpedo_damage"] == 60 && cv["bomber_ammo"] == 4 && cv["bomber_count"] == 2 && Classes.Of(ShipClass.Carrier).Art.Pds.Length == 2
              && Math.Abs(3 * cv.FighterDpsEach * 15.0 / 18.0 - 25.0) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(cv.SustainedDps - sustained) < 1e-6,
              $"the carrier's sheet (v1): hull {cv["hull"]:0} (425), turn radius {cv["turn_radius"]:0} (140), {cv["pd_count"]:0} PD mounts (2), fighters {cv["fighter_damage"]:0.0} a shot = {3 * cv.FighterDpsEach * 15.0 / 18.0:0.00} DPS (25), "
              + $"{cv["bomber_count"]:0} bombers x {cv["bomber_ammo"]:0} torpedoes of {cv["torpedo_damage"]:0} (60); sustained {cv.SustainedDps:0.00} ({sustained:0.00})");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var prey = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 300f));
            prey.Hp = 9000; prey.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            for (int i = 0; i < 240 && !s.PdTurrets.All(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, prey)); i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            var locals = s.PdTurrets.Select(t => s.ToLocal(t.GlobalPosition)).ToList();
            bool abreast = locals.All(l => Mathf.Abs(l.Y) < 5f && Mathf.Abs(l.X) > 25f && Mathf.Abs(l.X) < 35f);
            Check(s.MaxHp == 425 && s.PdTurrets.Count == 2 && abreast && s.PdTurrets.All(t => ReferenceEquals(t.Target, prey)),
                  $"carrier run {run} at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(head):0} deg: hull {s.MaxHp:0} (425), {s.PdTurrets.Count} PD mounts (2) at {string.Join(", ", locals.Select(l => $"({l.X:0},{l.Y:0})"))} (abreast amidships: {abreast}), both on a raider {prey.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off");
            prey.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: WARP GUNSHIPS (the Carrier's E, kits_v2 + W5: two craft a pick, 240 u orbit, 12 s, 3000 u leash at the
    // launch, 25 s from the press; the CV's ability 2). Three varied runs with {1, 2, 3} picks, each a held gunship-kind
    // raider 800-2600 u off the carrier at a VaryAngle bearing: E with the picks -- {2, 4, 6} craft, every pick with
    // two on a 240 +- 25 u circle 3 s on; the slot running 12 s and cooling 25.0 from the press; E again refused
    // COOLING; 12.6 s after the press none is left. Then, cooled: a lone pick 3050-3400 u off is refused OUT OF RANGE
    // and sends nothing, and nothing picked nor selected is refused NO TARGET.
    async Task LaneA6aGunshipChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var cv = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Carrier);
        Check(cv["gunship_cooldown"] == 25 && cv["gunship_count"] == 2 && cv["gunship_orbit"] == 240 && cv["gunship_time"] == 12 && cv["gunship_leash"] == 3000
              && Ab.Gunships.Default == global::Godot.Key.E && Ab.Gunships.TakesTargets && Ab.Gunships.Sends == WingKind.Gunship
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Carrier, 1) == Ab.Bombers && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Carrier, 2) == Ab.Gunships && Classes.Of(ShipClass.Carrier).Targets == 3,
              $"the gunships' rows: {cv["gunship_count"]:0} a pick, {cv["gunship_orbit"]:0} u, {cv["gunship_time"]:0} s, {cv["gunship_leash"]:0} u, {cv["gunship_cooldown"]:0} s (25); E; the carrier's ability 2 ({Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Carrier, 2)?.Name}), 3 picks");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        List<Wing> Gs() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == s && w.Kind == WingKind.Gunship && !w.Done).ToList();
        Raider Held(Vector2 p) { var r = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Gunship); r.Hp = 1e9; r.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return r; }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
            s.Sl("gunships").Left = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Cool = 0;
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            int n = run + 1;
            var spots = Enumerable.Range(0, n).Select(k => at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(800f, 2600f)).ToArray();
            var picks = spots.Select(Held).ToArray();
            await Frame(); Hold();
            H.ClearSelection(); foreach (var p in picks) H.AddTarget(p);
            s.UseAbility("gunships", 0, picks.Select(p => p.NetId).ToArray());
            await Frame();
            double tp = s.Clock, cool = s.Sl("gunships").Cool, left = s.Sl("gunships").Left;
            s.UseAbility("gunships", 0, picks.Select(p => p.NetId).ToArray()); await Frame();
            string again = s.FailNote("gunships");
            while (s.Clock < tp + 3.0) { Hold(); for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) picks[k].Position = spots[k]; await Frame(); }
            int craft = Gs().Count;
            var perPick = picks.Select(p => Gs().Count(w => Mathf.Abs(w.Position.DistanceTo(p.Position) - 240f) <= 25f)).ToArray();
            string line = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Carrier, "gunships").State(s, null).Line;
            while (s.Clock < tp + 12.6) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            int after = Gs().Count;
            Check(craft == 2 * n && perPick.All(c => c == 2) && Math.Abs(left - 12) < 0.1 && Math.Abs(cool - 25) < 0.1 && again == "COOLING" && line.StartsWith("GUNSHIPS") && after == 0,
                  $"gunships run {run}: {n} pick(s) at {string.Join(", ", spots.Select(p => $"{p.DistanceTo(at):0}"))} u -- {craft} craft ({2 * n}), on the 240 u circles {string.Join("/", perPick)} (2 each); up {left:0.0} s (12), cooling {cool:0.0} (25); E again {again} (COOLING); the bar '{line}'; {after} left 12.6 s on (0)");
            foreach (var p in picks) p.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Sl("gunships").Cool = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Left = 0;
            await Frame();
            var far = Held(s.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(3050f, 3400f));
            await Frame();
            H.ClearSelection(); H.AddTarget(far);
            s.UseAbility("gunships", 0, new[] { far.NetId }); await Frame(); await Frame();
            string outSaid = s.FailNote("gunships"); int outSent = Gs().Count;
            H.ClearSelection();
            s.UseAbility("gunships", 0, System.Array.Empty<int>()); await Frame();
            string noneSaid = s.FailNote("gunships");
            Check(outSaid == "OUT OF RANGE" && outSent == 0 && noneSaid == "NO TARGET" && s.Sl("gunships").Cool == 0,
                  $"gunships refused: a lone pick {far.Position.DistanceTo(s.Position):0} u off -- {outSaid} (OUT OF RANGE), {outSent} sent; nothing picked or selected -- {noneSaid} (NO TARGET); nothing spent");
            far.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
        {   // NO PICK BUT A SELECTED TARGET (carrier.md E: "else the selected one"): two craft on its 240 u circle
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Sl("gunships").Cool = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Left = 0;
            await Frame();
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(800f, 2600f);
            var sel = Held(spot);
            await Frame();
            H.ClearSelection(); H.SelectTarget(sel);
            s.UseAbility("gunships", sel.NetId, System.Array.Empty<int>());
            double tp = s.Clock;
            while (s.Clock < tp + 3.0) { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sel.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            int on = Gs().Count(w => Mathf.Abs(w.Position.DistanceTo(sel.Position) - 240f) <= 25f);
            Check(Gs().Count == 2 && on == 2 && Math.Abs(s.Sl("gunships").Cool - 25 + 3) < 0.3,
                  $"gunships with no pick but a selected target {sel.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off: {Gs().Count} craft (2), {on} on its 240 u circle (2); cooling {s.Sl("gunships").Cool:0.0} (22 after 3 s)");
            sel.TakeDamage(1e12); H.ClearSelection();
            foreach (var w in Gs()) w.SendOut(null, s.Clock);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE GUNSHIPS' FIRE (W5: 2.5 a shot every 0.25 s = 10 DPS each, two a pick = 20 DPS) and the leash at the
    // launch only (W5 / kits_v2: "the 3000 u leash at launch only"). Three varied runs: a held gunship 1500-2800 u off
    // at a VaryAngle bearing; E; from the first blow after both are on their circle, 3.0 s takes 60 +- 10; in run 1
    // the carrier then sails 3200-3600 u away and the craft stay on their circle; in run 2 the pick dies and the
    // craft leave it (none on its circle 1.0 s on).
    async Task LaneA6aGunshipFireChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        List<Wing> Gs() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == s && w.Kind == WingKind.Gunship && !w.Done).ToList();
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Sl("gunships").Left = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1500f, 2800f);
            var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Gunship); tgt.Hp = 1e9; tgt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            await Frame();
            H.ClearSelection(); H.AddTarget(tgt);
            s.UseAbility("gunships", 0, new[] { tgt.NetId });
            await RealTime(() => Gs().Count == 2 && Gs().All(w => w.OrbitPhase == "Orbit"), 6);
            double was = tgt.Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 120 && tgt.Hp >= was; i++) { tgt.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            double hp0 = tgt.Hp, c0 = s.Clock;
            while (s.Clock - c0 < 3.0) { tgt.Position = spot; if (run == 1) s.Position = at + (at - spot).Normalized() * Vary(3200f, 3600f) * (float)((s.Clock - c0) / 3.0); await Frame(); }
            double got = hp0 - tgt.Hp;
            bool stayed = Gs().Count == 2 && Gs().All(w => Mathf.Abs(w.Position.DistanceTo(tgt.Position) - 240f) <= 30f);
            bool left = true;
            if (run == 2)
            {
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
                await Wait(1.0);
                left = Gs().All(w => Mathf.Abs(w.Position.DistanceTo(spot) - 240f) > 30f || w.OrbitPhase != "Orbit");
            }
            Check(Math.Abs(got - 60) <= 10 && stayed && left,
                  $"gunships' fire run {run}: a gunship {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u off takes {got:0.0} in 3.0 s from the first blow (2 x 10 DPS: 60 +- 10); {(run == 1 ? $"the carrier {s.Position.DistanceTo(spot):0} u off and " : "")}both still on the circle ({stayed}){(run == 2 ? $"; the pick dead, they leave it ({left})" : "")}");
            if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(tgt) && tgt.Alive) tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            foreach (var w in Gs()) w.SendOut(null, s.Clock);
            await Wait(0.5);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE SUPERCARRIER (the Carrier's Q, kits_v3 §3.1 + v31 §3.2, decision 10 at its default: 20 s up, 30 s from
    // the END; the fighter's own numbers, 3 craft 0.83 s apart; anything within 600 u of the carrier, missiles included).
    // Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading; a held webifier 250-450 u off and another 850-1100 u off at
    // other VaryAngle bearings): Q -- three patrol craft leave 0.83 +- 0.05 s apart; the near one is taken by the patrol
    // (a craft's Target, its hull falling), the far one never; the slot up 20.0 s and cooling 50.0 (20 + 30) at the press;
    // Q again refused RUNNING. Run 0 is held to the end: at 20.4 s the cooldown reads 29.4-30.0 and Q is refused COOLING,
    // and the patrol flies home and docks (kits_v3 §3.1 "At 20 s they fly home and dock"): all 3 still out at 19.7 s, every
    // one docked by 26 s. Between runs the patrol is sent home and waited in, so a run counts only its own craft. The bar reads
    // SUPER while it runs.
    async Task LaneA6aSuperChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var cv = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Carrier);
        Check(cv["super_cooldown"] == 30 && cv["patrol_time"] == 20 && cv["patrol_range"] == 600 && cv["fighter_count"] == 3 && Ab.Supercarrier.Id == "super"
              && Ab.Supercarrier.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q && Ab.Supercarrier.CoolAfter && Ab.Supercarrier.Sends == WingKind.Patrol
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Carrier, 3) == Ab.Supercarrier && Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol).LaunchInterval == 0.83,
              $"the Supercarrier's rows: {cv["patrol_time"]:0} s up (20), {cv["super_cooldown"]:0} s after (30), {cv["patrol_range"]:0} u (600), {cv["fighter_count"]:0} craft 0.83 s apart; Q; the carrier's ability 3 ({Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Carrier, 3)?.Name})");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var s = Me; var q = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Carrier, "super");
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        List<Wing> Ps() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == s && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Done).ToList();
        double was = PdReachOff(s);
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle(), a1 = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
                s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0;
                Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
                var nearAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1) * Vary(250f, 450f);
                var farAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1 + Vary(1.5f, 3.0f)) * Vary(850f, 1100f);
                Raider Held(Vector2 p) { var r = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Webifier); r.Hp = 1e9; r.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return r; }
                var near = Held(nearAt); var far = Held(farAt);
                await Frame(); Hold();
                Key(q); await Frame();
                double tp = s.Clock, left = s.Sl("super").Left, cool = s.Sl("super").Cool;
                Key(q); await Frame();
                string again = s.FailNote("super"), line = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Carrier, "super").State(s, null).Line;
                var outAt = new Dictionary<Wing, double>();
                double nearHp = near.Hp; bool farTaken = false, nearTaken = false;
                while (s.Clock < tp + 8.0)
                {
                    Hold(); near.Position = nearAt; far.Position = farAt; await Frame();
                    foreach (var w in Ps()) if (!w.Inside && !outAt.ContainsKey(w)) outAt[w] = s.Clock;
                    farTaken |= far.Hp < 1e9;
                    nearTaken |= near.Hp < nearHp;
                }
                var times = outAt.Values.OrderBy(x => x).ToList();
                bool spaced = times.Count == 3 && Math.Abs(times[1] - times[0] - 0.83) <= 0.05 && Math.Abs(times[2] - times[1] - 0.83) <= 0.05;
                Check(Ps().Count == 3 && spaced && nearTaken && !farTaken && Math.Abs(left - 20) < 0.1 && Math.Abs(cool - 50) < 0.1 && again == "RUNNING" && line.StartsWith("SUPER"),
                      $"Supercarrier run {run}: {Ps().Count} patrol craft (3) out {string.Join(" / ", times.Select(t => $"{t - tp:0.00}"))} s after the press (0.83 apart: {spaced}); a webifier {nearAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off taken ({nearTaken}), one {farAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off never ({!farTaken}); "
                      + $"up {left:0.0} s (20), cooling {cool:0.0} (50 = 20 + 30); Q again {again} (RUNNING); the bar '{line}'");
                if (run == 0)
                {
                    while (s.Clock < tp + 19.7) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
                    bool leftLate = Ps().Count == 3;
                    while (s.Clock < tp + 20.4) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
                    Key(q); await Frame();
                    string cooling = s.FailNote("super"); double coolEnd = s.Sl("super").Cool;
                    while (Ps().Count > 0 && s.Clock < tp + 30.0) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
                    double docked = s.Clock - tp;
                    Check(leftLate && Ps().Count == 0 && docked <= 26.0 && coolEnd >= 29.4 && coolEnd <= 30.0 && cooling == "COOLING" && s.Sl("super").Left <= 0,
                          $"Supercarrier at 20.4 s: cooling {coolEnd:0.0} s (30 from the end), Q {cooling} (COOLING); the patrol flies home and docks: 3 still out at 19.7 s ({leftLate}), the last docked at {docked:0.0} s (by 26)");
                }
                near.TakeDamage(1e12); far.TakeDamage(1e12);
                foreach (var w in Ps()) w.SendOut(null, s.Clock);
                s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0;
                for (double home = s.Clock; Ps().Count > 0 && s.Clock < home + 10.0;) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
                await Wait(0.5);
            }
        }
        finally { s.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", was); }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE PATROL THROUGH A WARP (carrier.md Identity: "the patrol is leashed to the carrier and flies back
    // after a jump (~7 s from 2400 u)"). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading): Q, three patrol craft
    // circling; V held until the charge has run 3.6-3.95 s (2080-2360 u, inside the 2400 u safe ring: no disable) and
    // let go; from the frame the carrier is 1500 u from where it was, within 9.0 s by its clock all three are back within
    // 340 u (the 300 u circle + 40) of its NEW position and stay 0.5 s, none Done, the Supercarrier still up.
    async Task LaneA6aSuperWarpChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var old = new HashSet<Wing>();                                      // craft an earlier run sent out: never this run's
        List<Wing> Ps() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == s && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Done && !old.Contains(w)).ToList();
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }
            s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0; s.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            H.ClearSelection();
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            old.Clear(); old.UnionWith(Ps());
            s.UseAbility("super", 0);
            double c0 = s.Clock;
            while (s.Clock < c0 + 12 && Ps().Count(w => w.FighterPhase == "Circle") < 3) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            int circling = Ps().Count(w => w.FighterPhase == "Circle");
            Hold();
            double held = Vary(3.6f, 3.95f);
            var (reach, _, _) = await WarpHold(s, held, () => { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = head; }, driver: true);
            double j0 = s.Clock;
            while (s.Clock < j0 + 2 && s.Position.DistanceTo(at) <= 1500f) await Frame();
            var landed = s.Position; double t0 = s.Clock, back = -1, onSince = -1;
            bool disabled = s.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled);
            while (s.Clock < t0 + 9.5 && back < 0)
            {
                s.Position = landed; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame();
                bool on = Ps().Count == 3 && Ps().All(w => w.Position.DistanceTo(s.Position) <= 300f + 40f);
                if (!on) onSince = -1;
                else if (onSince < 0) onSince = s.Clock;
                else if (s.Clock - onSince >= 0.5) back = onSince - t0;
            }
            int n = Ps().Count; double up = s.Sl("super").Left;
            Check(circling == 3 && landed.DistanceTo(at) > 1500f && !disabled && back >= 0 && back <= 9.0 && n == 3 && up > 0,
                  $"patrol through a warp run {run}: {circling} circling (3); charged {held:0.00} s, reach {reach:0} u, landed {landed.DistanceTo(at):0} u off (> 1500), disabled {disabled} (False); "
                  + $"all 3 back on the 300 u circle round the new spot {back:0.00} s on (<= 9.0), {n} craft (3), the Supercarrier up {up:0.0} s (> 0)");
            foreach (var w in Ps()) w.SendOut(null, s.Clock);
            s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0; s.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            await Wait(0.5);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE PATROL TAKES MISSILES (kits_v31 §3.2 and §7: "CV patrol vs BB CIWS vs FR sentries vs PD -- all four
    // take missiles, all rank by one Turret.Rank"). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, the seeker fired at the carrier from
    // 480-560 u at a VaryAngle bearing, the carrier's point defence out of reach so the patrol is on trial, a held
    // webifier 200-350 u off at another bearing so the rank has a choice): Q, three craft circling; the seeker is taken
    // before the webifier (a craft's Target is the seeker within 1.5 s of its launch), downed before it lands (the hull
    // untouched), credited "patrol".
    async Task LaneA6aSuperMissileChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        List<Wing> Ps() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == s && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Done).ToList();
        double was = PdReachOff(s);
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float a1 = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
                s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0; s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
                Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
                var webAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1 + Vary(1.5f, 3.0f)) * Vary(200f, 350f);
                var web = H.SpawnRaider(webAt, Enemies.Webifier); web.Hp = 1e9; web.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
                s.UseAbility("super", 0);
                await RealTime(() => Ps().Count(w => w.FighterPhase == "Circle") >= 3, 12);
                Hold();
                var from = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1) * Vary(480f, 560f);
                double c0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol"); int down0 = Shot.Intercepted; double hull0 = s.Hp;
                var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, from, s.Position - from, 135f, 4000f, 25, targetId: s.NetId, turnRate: 2f);
                double fired = s.Clock, takenAt = -1;
                while (sk != null && sk.Alive && s.Clock < fired + 10)
                {
                    Hold(); web.Position = webAt; await Frame();
                    if (takenAt < 0 && Ps().Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, sk))) takenAt = s.Clock - fired;
                }
                Check(sk != null && !sk.Alive && takenAt >= 0 && takenAt <= 1.5 && Shot.Intercepted > down0 && s.Hp >= hull0 && s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") > c0,
                      $"patrol vs missile run {run}: a seeker fired at the carrier from {from.DistanceTo(at):0} u, a webifier {webAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off beside it -- taken at {takenAt:0.00} s (<= 1.5, before the webifier), downed ({!sk.Alive}), the hull untouched ({s.Hp >= hull0}), credited \"patrol\" ({s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") - c0:0.0})");
                web.TakeDamage(1e12);
                foreach (var w in Ps()) w.SendOut(null, s.Clock);
                s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0;
                await Wait(0.5);
            }
        }
        finally { s.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", was); }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE CARRIER'S THREE WINGS AT ONCE (kits_v31 §7: "CV patrol vs CV gunships -- split by anchor"; kits_v3
    // §3.1: the first wing keeps its orders). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot; a held gunship 1300-1450 u off, safely
    // inside the fighters' 1500 u control_range (Stats.cs:186), at a
    // VaryAngle bearing, attacked by the fighters and picked for the gunships): Space (attack), E, Q -- 3 s on, the three
    // fighters away on it, two gunships on its 240 u circle, three patrol craft within 700 u of the carrier; 6 fighters
    // and patrol craft out together.
    async Task LaneA6aSuperWingsChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var s = Me;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        List<Wing> Of(WingKind k) => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == s && w.Kind == k && !w.Done).ToList();
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
            s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Left = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Cool = 0;
            Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1300f, 1450f);   // inside control_range 1500 (Stats.cs:186)
            var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Gunship); tgt.Hp = 1e9; tgt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            await Frame();
            H.ClearSelection(); H.AddTarget(tgt);
            s.OrderAttack(tgt);
            s.UseAbility("gunships", tgt.NetId, new[] { tgt.NetId });
            s.UseAbility("super", 0);
            // poll, never a blind clock: settle until every fighter has left (or a generous cap), so a
            // slower-than-usual launch queue (the recalled wing docking and resting before it flies
            // again) is never mistaken for one that never launched
            double tp = s.Clock, cap = tp + 20.0;
            while (s.Clock < tp + Vary(5.0f, 6.0f) || (Of(WingKind.Fighter).Count(w => !w.Inside) < 3 && s.Clock < cap))
            { Hold(); tgt.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            int fightersOut = Of(WingKind.Fighter).Count(w => !w.Inside), guns = Of(WingKind.Gunship).Count(w => Mathf.Abs(w.Position.DistanceTo(spot) - 240f) <= 30f);
            int patrolHome = Of(WingKind.Patrol).Count(w => !w.Inside && w.Position.DistanceTo(at) <= 700f);
            Check(ReferenceEquals(s.WingTarget, tgt) && fightersOut == 3 && guns == 2 && patrolHome == 3 && fightersOut + patrolHome == 6,
                  $"three wings run {run}: a gunship {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u off -- {fightersOut} fighters away on it (3), {guns} gunships on its circle (2), {patrolHome} patrol craft within 700 u of the carrier (3): 6 fighters and patrol out together");
            tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            foreach (var w in Of(WingKind.Patrol).Concat(Of(WingKind.Gunship))) w.SendOut(null, s.Clock);
            s.RecallWing();
            s.Sl("super").Left = 0; s.Sl("super").Cool = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Left = 0; s.Sl("gunships").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(1.0);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE DIRECTOR BATTERY (the Destroyer's primary, v1): 2 x 11.25 every 0.5 s = 45.0 DPS at 700 u, shells
    // 760 u/s; with a hostile SELECTED within 840 u (main_range x director_lead 1.2) the guns lead it by themselves, else
    // they follow the cursor. PART 1, the aim itself (PlayerShip.Directed, fed frame by frame with the target moved by
    // hand): lateral speeds {0, 100-150, 250-300} u/s on a VaryAngle course at VaryNear ranges {150-300, 600-690, 800-835}
    // u -- the aim within 2 u of where a 760 u/s shell meets it; 845-900 u, nothing selected, or a hull with no director
    // (the battleship): the cursor. PART 2, live (three runs, a held gunship crossing at 150-250 u/s 480-580 u off at a
    // VaryAngle bearing, the cursor on the target): selected, at least 6 of the shells fired in 2.5 s land; unselected,
    // the cursor's shells trail it and at most 2 land.
    async Task LaneA6aDirectorChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        var dd = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        Check(dd["main_count"] == 2 && dd["main_damage"] == 11.25 && dd["main_interval"] == 0.5 && dd["main_range"] == 700 && dd["shell_speed"] == 760
              && Math.Abs(dd["director_lead"] - 1.2) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(dd["main_turn"] - 2.09) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(dd.MainDps - 45.0) < 1e-9
              && new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship)["director_lead"] == 0,
              $"the director's rows (v1): 2 x 11.25 every 0.5 s = {dd.MainDps:0.0} DPS, 700 u, 760 u/s, turrets 2.09 rad/s, a lead within 1.2 x its range; no other hull leads");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        // where a shell at c from `from` meets a body at p moving at v: the positive root of |p - from + v t| = c t
        static Vector2 Meet(Vector2 from, Vector2 p, Vector2 v, double c)
        {
            var d = p - from;
            double a = v.Dot(v) - c * c, b = 2 * d.Dot(v), k = d.Dot(d);
            double t = Math.Abs(a) < 1e-9 ? -k / b : (-b - Math.Sqrt(b * b - 4 * a * k)) / (2 * a);
            return p + v * (float)t;
        }
        // PART 1: the aim, computed on the owner from what it watched
        var probe = H.SpawnRaider(VaryNear(yonder, 900f), Enemies.Webifier); probe.Hp = 1e9; probe.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 120);
        await Frame();
        s.Position = yonder; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        var cursor = yonder + new Vector2(0, 2000);
        var bands = new[] { (0f, 0f, 150f, 300f), (100f, 150f, 600f, 690f), (250f, 300f, 800f, 835f) };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var (vLo, vHi, rLo, rHi) = bands[run];
            float bearing = VaryAngle(), range = Vary(rLo, rHi), speed = Vary(vLo, vHi);
            var los = Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing);
            var vel = los.Orthogonal() * (Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f) * speed;
            var p = s.Position + los * range;
            Vector2 aim = cursor;
            s.Directed(cursor, null, 1 / 60.0);                           // forgets whatever it led before
            for (int f = 0; f < 12; f++) { p += vel / 60f; probe.Position = p; aim = s.Directed(cursor, probe, 1 / 60.0); }
            var want = Meet(s.Position, p, vel, 760);
            var far = s.Position + los * Vary(845f, 900f); probe.Position = far;
            var beyond = s.Directed(cursor, probe, 1 / 60.0);
            var none = s.Directed(cursor, null, 1 / 60.0);
            Check(aim.DistanceTo(want) < 2f && (speed > 0 || aim.DistanceTo(p) < 0.01f) && beyond == cursor && none == cursor,
                  $"director aim run {run}: a target {range:0} u off crossing at {speed:0} u/s -- the guns lead it to {aim.DistanceTo(p):0.0} u ahead, {aim.DistanceTo(want):0.00} u from where a 760 u/s shell meets it (< 2); at {s.Position.DistanceTo(far):0} u (past 840) and with nothing selected, the cursor");
        }
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var bb = Me; probe.Position = bb.Position + new Vector2(0, -400);
        Check(bb.Directed(cursor, probe, 1 / 60.0) == cursor, "the battleship (no director_lead) aims at its cursor with a hostile selected 400 u off");
        probe.TakeDamage(1e12);
        // PART 2: live -- the host fires at the aim the owner sent, selected or not. The battleship left STAGGERED: the
        // destroyer, which has no fire mode, comes up firing salvoes
        bb.Staggered = true;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        Check(!s.Staggered && Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Destroyer, "firemode") == null,
              "a battleship left staggered, refitted as a destroyer (no fire mode): its director fires salvoes");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float bearing = VaryAngle(), range = Vary(480f, 580f), speed = Vary(150f, 250f);
            var los = Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing);
            var side = los.Orthogonal() * (run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f);
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 200f);
            int landedLed = 0, landedCursor = 0;
            for (int led = 1; led >= 0; led--)
            {
                void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = bearing + Mathf.Pi / 2f; }
                Hold();
                var start = at + los * range - side * 500f;
                var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(start, Enemies.Gunship); tgt.Hp = 1e9; tgt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
                await Frame();
                if (led == 1) H.SelectTarget(tgt); else H.ClearSelection();
                double c0 = s.Clock;
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 1.6) { Hold(); tgt.Position = start; AimWorld(tgt.Position); await Frame(); }
                var p = start; c0 = s.Clock;
                double hp0 = tgt.Hp; bool down = false; double downAt = 0;
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 4.5)
                {
                    double t = s.Clock - c0;
                    p = start + side * (float)(speed * t); tgt.Position = p; Hold(); AimWorld(p);
                    if (!down && t >= 1.0) { KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Space); down = true; downAt = s.Clock; }
                    if (down && s.Clock - downAt >= 2.5) KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space);
                    await Frame();
                }
                KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space);
                int landed = (int)Math.Round((hp0 - tgt.Hp) / 11.25);
                if (led == 1) landedLed = landed; else landedCursor = landed;
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
                H.ClearSelection();
                await Wait(0.3);
            }
            Check(landedLed >= 6 && landedCursor <= 2,
                  $"director live run {run}: a gunship {range:0} u off crossing at {speed:0} u/s, 2.5 s of Space with the cursor on it -- selected, {landedLed} shells land (>= 6 of 10); not selected, {landedCursor} (<= 2)");
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE LONG LANCE (the Destroyer's F, v1): one torpedo straight off the bow along the heading, 300, 170 u/s,
    // a 3000 u run, stopping on the first hostile it touches; 18 s from the press, never refused but COOLING. Three
    // runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, a held gunship 400-900 u down the bow): F -- exactly one Lance, unguided, its
    // course the heading (0.01 rad) at 170 +- 3 u/s; the gunship takes exactly 300, credited "longlance"; the slot cools
    // 18.0 s and a second F is refused COOLING with nothing fired; nothing was selected, so none is needed.
    async Task LaneA6aLanceChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        var dd = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        Check(dd["lance_damage"] == 300 && dd["lance_speed"] == 170 && dd["lance_range"] == 3000 && dd["lance_cooldown"] == 18
              && Ab.LongLance.Default == global::Godot.Key.F && Ab.LongLance.Bow.Kind == Shots.LongLance && Shots.Of(Shots.LongLance).Stops == 1 && !Shots.Of(Shots.LongLance).Guided
              && Unlocks.AbilityAt(Classes.Of(ShipClass.Destroyer).Abilities, Ab.LongLance) == 1,
              "the Long Lance's rows (v1): 300, 170 u/s, 3000 u, 18 s on F, one unguided round that stops on the first body; ability 1, open at level 1");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        List<Shot> Lances() => Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.LongLance && x.Source == s).ToList();
        H.ClearSelection();
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float heading = VaryAngle();
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = heading; }
            s.Sl("longlance").Cool = 0; Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(heading);
            var spot = at + nose * Vary(400f, 900f);
