            var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(spot, Enemies.Gunship); tgt.Hp = 1e9; tgt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            await Frame();
            double hp0 = tgt.Hp, credit0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("longlance");
            s.UseAbility("longlance", 0);
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            var ls = Lances();
            var l = ls.FirstOrDefault();
            var p0 = l?.GlobalPosition ?? Vector2.Zero;
            double t0 = s.Clock;                                              // the speed timed by the clock, not by frames
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { Hold(); tgt.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            float spd = l != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(l) && s.Clock > t0 ? (float)((l.GlobalPosition - p0).Length() / (s.Clock - t0)) : 0f;
            double cool = s.Sl("longlance").Cool;
            string refused = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Destroyer, "longlance").Refuse(s, null);
            s.UseAbility("longlance", 0); await Frame(); await Frame();
            int after = Lances().Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 7 && tgt.Hp >= hp0; i++) { Hold(); tgt.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            await Frame();
            Check(ls.Count == 1 && l.TargetId == 0 && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(l.Dir.Angle(), nose.Angle())) < 0.01f && Math.Abs(spd - 170) <= 3
                  && Math.Abs(hp0 - tgt.Hp - 300) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("longlance") - credit0 - 300) < 1e-6
                  && Math.Abs(cool - 18) < 0.3 && refused == "COOLING" && after <= 1,
                  $"Lance run {run}: F with nothing selected, heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(heading):0} deg -- {ls.Count} Lance off the bow at {spd:0.0} u/s (170), a gunship {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u down the bow takes {hp0 - tgt.Hp:0.0} (300) credited \"lance\"; cooling {cool:0.0} s (18), a second F {refused} with {after} Lance in flight");
            tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            s.Sl("longlance").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.6);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: WHAT THE LANCE MEETS (v1: "stops on the first hostile it touches, never a missile"; kits_v2: a light in
    // front of the boss takes it). Three runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading; point defence out of reach so only the
    // Lance can touch the seeker): a hostile seeker 150-250 u down the bow, a webifier 350-500 u, the target dummy 650-800 u
    // -- the seeker is passed (still flying, no intercept), the webifier takes exactly 300 and the dummy behind it nothing.
    async Task LaneA6aLanceHitChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var dm = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1"); var dmHome = dm.Position;
        double was = PdReachOff(s);
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float heading = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = heading; }
                s.Sl("longlance").Cool = 0; Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
                var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(heading);
                var skAt = at + nose * Vary(150f + 106f, 250f + 106f);
                var webAt = at + nose * Vary(350f + 106f, 500f + 106f);
                var dmAt = at + nose * Vary(650f + 106f, 800f + 106f);
                var web = H.SpawnRaider(webAt, Enemies.Webifier); web.Hp = 1e9; web.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
                dm.Position = dmAt; await Wait(TargetDummy.IdleReset + 0.2); dm.ResetMeter(); Hold();
                int down0 = Shot.Intercepted;
                // crossing the line slowly, aimed at nothing: only the Lance could strike it
                var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, skAt, nose.Orthogonal(), 2f, 4000f, 25);
                double hp0 = web.Hp;
                s.UseAbility("longlance", 0);
                double c0 = s.Clock;
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 4.5) { Hold(); web.Position = webAt; dm.Position = dmAt; await Frame(); }
                bool skFlying = sk != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(sk) && sk.Alive;
                Check(skFlying && Shot.Intercepted == down0 && Math.Abs(hp0 - web.Hp - 300) < 1e-6 && dm.Total == 0,
                      $"Lance meets run {run}: down a bow {Mathf.RadToDeg(heading):0} deg -- a seeker {skAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u out passed (still flying {skFlying}, {Shot.Intercepted - down0} intercepted), a webifier at {webAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u takes {hp0 - web.Hp:0.0} (300), the dummy behind at {dmAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u {dm.Total:0.0} (0)");
                if (sk != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(sk)) sk.Intercept();
                web.TakeDamage(1e12);
                s.Sl("longlance").Cool = 0;
                await Wait(0.6);
            }
        }
        finally { s.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", was); dm.Position = dmHome; }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: SUPPRESSING FIRE (the Destroyer's Q, kits_v2): for 6 s every hostile a director shell hits is Suppressed
    // until 3 s after its last hit, a grey chevron over it; 20 s from the press. The rows once (6 / 3 / 20, Q, ability 2
    // at level 3). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot; a held webifier, gunship, lancerkin 300-600 u off at a VaryAngle
    // bearing; the first shell 0.5-5.4 s into the window, a second 0.15-0.35 s later): Q engages the slot (SUPPRESS on
    // the bar, cooling 20.0 from the press) and nothing is suppressed until a shell lands; after it the target is
    // Suppressed with its guns at x0.5, ONE chevron on its hull the size of its hit circle; 2.8-2.9 s after the LAST
    // shell it still is, 3.05-3.2 s after it is not and its guns are whole; Q again is refused COOLING.
    async Task LaneA6aSuppressChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        var dd = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        Check(dd["suppress_window"] == 6 && dd["suppress_time"] == 3 && dd["suppress_cooldown"] == 20 && Ab.Suppress.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Destroyer, 2) == Ab.Suppress && Unlocks.AbilityAt(Classes.Of(ShipClass.Destroyer).Abilities, Ab.Suppress) == 3
              && new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship)["suppress_window"] == 0 && Fx.All[Fx.Chevron].Id == "chevron" && Fx.All[Fx.Chevron].Cap == 1,
              $"Suppressing fire's rows (kits_v2): {dd["suppress_window"]:0} s window (6), held {dd["suppress_time"]:0} s after the last hit (3), {dd["suppress_cooldown"]:0} s (20); Q; the destroyer's ability 2, open at level 3; no other hull has it; the chevron row, one on a hull");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        var q = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Destroyer, "suppress");
        string shell = Shots.Of(Shots.Shell).Id;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        async Task Until(double t) { while (s.Clock < t) await Frame(); }
        var kinds = new[] { Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Gunship, Enemies.Lancerkin };
        H.ClearSelection();
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
            s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0; Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 600f);
            var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(spot, kinds[run]); tgt.Hp = 1e9; tgt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            await Frame();
            int Chevrons() => Nodes<FxNode>(tgt).Count(f => f.Id == Fx.Chevron && !f.IsQueuedForDeletion());
            Key(q);
            int frames = 0;
            for (; frames < 6 && s.Sl("suppress").Left <= 0; frames++) await Frame();
            double t0 = s.Clock, cool = s.Sl("suppress").Cool;
            var state = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.Destroyer, "suppress").State(s, null);
            await Until(t0 + Vary(0.5f, 5.4f));
            bool before = tgt.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed);
            Dealt.Deal(tgt, 1, s, shell);
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            bool on = tgt.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed); double gun = tgt.Statuses.Out(1.0, OutKind.Gun);
            int marks1 = Chevrons();
            float markR = Nodes<FxNode>(tgt).FirstOrDefault(f => f.Id == Fx.Chevron)?.Radius ?? -1f;
            await Wait(Vary(0.15f, 0.35f));
            Dealt.Deal(tgt, 1, s, shell);
            double last = s.Clock;
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            int marks2 = Chevrons();
            Key(q); await Frame(); await Frame();
            string again = s.FailNote("suppress");
            await Until(last + Vary(2.8f, 2.9f));
            bool still = tgt.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed); double gunStill = tgt.Statuses.Out(1.0, OutKind.Gun);
            await Until(last + Vary(3.05f, 3.2f));
            bool gone = !tgt.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed); double gunAfter = tgt.Statuses.Out(1.0, OutKind.Gun);
            Check(frames <= 3 && Math.Abs(cool - 20) < 0.1 && state.Lit && state.Line.StartsWith("SUPPRESS") && !before && on && Math.Abs(gun - 0.5) < 1e-9
                  && marks1 == 1 && marks2 == 1 && Math.Abs(markR - tgt.HitRadius) < 0.01f && again == "COOLING"
                  && still && Math.Abs(gunStill - 0.5) < 1e-9 && gone && Math.Abs(gunAfter - 1.0) < 1e-9,
                  $"suppress run {run} ({Enemies.Of(kinds[run]).Id} {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u off): Q -- the bar '{state.Line}' (SUPPRESS, lit), cooling {cool:0.00} (20); suppressed before a shell {before} (False); a shell -- suppressed {on}, its guns x{gun:0.00} (0.5), {marks1} chevron of radius {markR:0.0} ({tgt.HitRadius:0.0}); a second shell, {marks2} chevron (1); Q again {again} (COOLING); "
                  + $"2.8-2.9 s after the last shell {still} x{gunStill:0.00} (0.5), 3.05-3.2 s after gone {gone} x{gunAfter:0.00} (1.0)");
            tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        // STEADY FIRE (kits_v2 "a grey chevron shows"; PlayerShip.Afflict's clock per hull): three varied runs (a held
        // gunship / lancerkin / webifier 300-600 u off at a VaryAngle bearing): Q, then a shell every 0.25-0.5 s (each gap
        // drawn afresh) from 0.1-0.3 s into the window for 4.0-5.4 s of it. At every frame the hostile is Suppressed,
        // exactly ONE chevron rides its hull; while the shells land the one up is never older than 1.1 s (raised again
        // every Remark, 0.5 s, and a gap); 2.8-2.9 s after the last shell it is Suppressed under one chevron, 3.05-3.2 s
        // after the status is gone, and 3.6-3.7 s after the chevron too (it outlasts the status by under 0.5 s).
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
            s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0; Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 600f);
            var tgt = H.SpawnRaider(spot, kinds[(run + 1) % 3]); tgt.Hp = 1e9; tgt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            await Frame();
            List<FxNode> Marks() => Nodes<FxNode>(tgt).Where(f => f.Id == Fx.Chevron && !f.IsQueuedForDeletion()).ToList();
            Key(q);
            for (int i = 0; i < 6 && s.Sl("suppress").Left <= 0; i++) await Frame();
            double t0 = s.Clock, fireFor = Vary(4.0f, 5.4f), next = t0 + Vary(0.1f, 0.3f), first = -1, last = -1, oldest = 0;
            int shells = 0, samples = 0, wrong = 0, worstCount = 1;
            void Sample(bool firing)
            {
                if (first < 0 || s.Clock - first < 0.04 || !tgt.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed)) return;
                var m = Marks(); samples++;
                if (m.Count != 1) { wrong++; worstCount = m.Count; }
                else if (firing) oldest = Math.Max(oldest, m[0].Elapsed);
            }
            while (s.Clock < t0 + fireFor)
            {
                Hold();
                if (s.Clock >= next) { Dealt.Deal(tgt, 1, s, shell); last = s.Clock; if (first < 0) first = last; shells++; next = last + Vary(0.25f, 0.5f); }
                await Frame();
                Sample(true);
            }
            double stillAt = last + Vary(2.8f, 2.9f), goneAt = last + Vary(3.05f, 3.2f), clearAt = last + Vary(3.6f, 3.7f);
            while (s.Clock < stillAt) { Hold(); await Frame(); Sample(false); }
            bool still = tgt.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed); int stillMarks = Marks().Count;
            while (s.Clock < goneAt) { Hold(); await Frame(); Sample(false); }
            bool gone = !tgt.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed);
            while (s.Clock < clearAt) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            int clearMarks = Marks().Count;
            Check(shells >= 8 && samples > 0 && wrong == 0 && oldest <= 1.1 && still && stillMarks == 1 && gone && clearMarks == 0,
                  $"suppress steady run {run} ({Enemies.Of(kinds[(run + 1) % 3]).Id} {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u off): {shells} shells over {last - first:0.0} s, 0.25-0.5 s apart -- {samples} frames Suppressed, {wrong} of them not under exactly one chevron (0; {worstCount} seen); "
                  + $"the chevron up while they land never older than {oldest:0.00} s (1.1); 2.8-2.9 s after the last shell suppressed {still} under {stillMarks} (1); 3.05-3.2 s after gone {gone}; 3.6-3.7 s after, {clearMarks} chevrons (0)");
            tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: WHAT SUPPRESSES (kits_v2 Proves: "a director shell, a Lance and a PD round each hit a webifier; only the
    // shell suppresses"; "a shell at 6.1 s applies nothing"; "two DDs give x0.5"). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, the
    // webifier 300-600 u off at a VaryAngle bearing):
    //   LIVE -- Q, the webifier selected, Space held with the cursor on it: within 3 s the director's own shells have
    //   landed ("shell" credit up) and it is Suppressed, one chevron on it;
    //   a gunship 300-600 u off the other way: a Lance blow and a PD blow (in a varied order) land through the door and
    //   suppress nothing, no chevron; a shell does; a second shell and a second application keep its guns at x0.5, not
    //   x0.25 (a status: two destroyers do not stack);
    //   a lancerkin never hit in the window takes a shell 6.1-6.6 s after the press: nothing (the window is over), and a
    //   shell with no press at all before it: nothing.
    async Task LaneA6aSuppressWeaponChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        string shell = Shots.Of(Shots.Shell).Id, lance = Shots.Of(Shots.LongLance).Id;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
            s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0; Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
            float bearing = VaryAngle();
            var webAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * Vary(300f, 600f);
            var gunAt = at - Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * Vary(300f, 600f);
            var kinAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing + Mathf.Pi / 2f) * Vary(300f, 600f);
            var web = H.SpawnRaider(webAt, Enemies.Webifier); web.Hp = 1e9; web.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            var gun = H.SpawnRaider(gunAt, Enemies.Gunship); gun.Hp = 1e9; gun.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            var kin = H.SpawnRaider(kinAt, Enemies.Lancerkin); kin.Hp = 1e9; kin.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            await Frame();
            int Chevrons(Node n) => Nodes<FxNode>(n).Count(f => f.Id == Fx.Chevron && !f.IsQueuedForDeletion());
            // before any press: a shell suppresses nothing
            Dealt.Deal(kin, 1, s, shell); await Frame();
            bool unpressed = kin.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed);
            // LIVE: the director's own shells
            H.SelectTarget(web);
            double shot0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(shell);
            s.UseAbility("suppress", 0); await Frame(); await Frame();
            double t0 = s.Clock;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Space);
            while (s.Clock - t0 < 3.0 && !web.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed)) { Hold(); web.Position = webAt; AimWorld(webAt); await Frame(); }
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space);
            bool live = web.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed); double landed = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(shell) - shot0; int liveMarks = Chevrons(web);
            H.ClearSelection();
            // the Lance and the PD through the same door
            bool lanceFirst = run != 1;
            if (lanceFirst) { Dealt.Deal(gun, 1, s, lance); Dealt.Deal(gun, 1, s, Dealt.Pd); }
            else { Dealt.Deal(gun, 1, s, Dealt.Pd); Dealt.Deal(gun, 1, s, lance); }
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            bool byOthers = gun.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed); int otherMarks = Chevrons(gun);
            Dealt.Deal(gun, 1, s, shell); await Frame();
            bool byShell = gun.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed);
            Dealt.Deal(gun, 1, s, shell); gun.ApplyStatus(Status.Suppressed, 3); await Frame();
            double twice = gun.Statuses.Out(1.0, OutKind.Gun);
            // the window over
            while (s.Clock - t0 < Vary(6.1f, 6.6f)) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double left = s.Sl("suppress").Left;
            Dealt.Deal(kin, 1, s, shell); await Frame(); await Frame();
            bool late = kin.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed); int lateMarks = Chevrons(kin);
            Check(!unpressed && live && landed >= 11.25 - 1e-9 && liveMarks == 1 && !byOthers && otherMarks == 0 && byShell && Math.Abs(twice - 0.5) < 1e-9
                  && left <= 0 && !late && lateMarks == 0,
                  $"suppress weapons run {run}: a shell before any press suppresses {unpressed} (False); LIVE, Q and Space on a selected webifier {webAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off -- {landed:0.00} of shells landed, suppressed {live}, {liveMarks} chevron (1); "
                  + $"a gunship {gunAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off takes a {(lanceFirst ? "Lance then a PD" : "PD then a Lance")} blow -- suppressed {byOthers} (False), {otherMarks} chevrons (0); a shell {byShell} (True); twice over, guns x{twice:0.00} (0.5); "
                  + $"after the window ({left:0.0} s left) a shell on a lancerkin -- suppressed {late} (False), {lateMarks} chevrons (0)");
            foreach (var r in new[] { web, gun, kin }) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: A SUPPRESSED FOE STILL WEBS, AT HALF ITS GUN (kits_v2: "it still moves, turns and webs"; "a suppressed
    // pinner still pins") -- Suppress meeting the webifier's pin on the destroyer itself. Three varied runs (VaryNear spot,
    // the webifier 250-400 u off at a VaryAngle bearing, the destroyer still / turning / full ahead; PD out of reach):
    // latched, it lands a blow on the destroyer (its full blow read off the tally); Q and ONE director shell on it; every
    // blow in the next 2.8 s lands half of the full one, the web still holds and the destroyer is still Pinned; 3.3 s past
    // the shell the next blow is whole again.
    async Task LaneA6aSuppressGunChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        string shell = Shots.Of(Shots.Shell).Id;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double was = PdReachOff(s);
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
                s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0;
                await Wait(0.2);
                var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f), Enemies.Webifier); w.Hp = 1e9; w.Quarry = s;
                void Hold() { if (run == 0) { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; } s.Hp = s.MaxHp; }
                if (run == 1) KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.D);
                if (run == 2) KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !w.Latched; i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
                double Tally() => s.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault($"raider:{w.NetId}");
                // the full blow, as it lands
                double t = Tally(), full = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && full <= 0; i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); double n = Tally(); if (n > t + 1e-9) full = n - t; t = n; }
                s.UseAbility("suppress", 0); await Frame();
                Dealt.Deal(w, 1, s, shell);
                double c0 = s.Clock; var held = new List<double>(); bool pinned = true; int frames = 0, latchedFrames = 0;
                t = Tally();
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 2.8)
                {
                    Hold(); await Frame();
                    double n = Tally(); if (n > t + 1e-9) held.Add(n - t); t = n;
                    pinned &= s.Statuses.Has(Status.Pinned); frames++; if (w.Latched) latchedFrames++;
                }
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 3.3) { Hold(); await Frame(); t = Tally(); }
                double whole = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && whole <= 0; i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); double n = Tally(); if (n > t + 1e-9) whole = n - t; t = n; }
                KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.D); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                Check(full > 0 && held.Count >= 1 && held.All(h => Math.Abs(h - full * 0.5) < 1e-6) && pinned && latchedFrames >= frames * 0.9 && Math.Abs(whole - full) < 1e-6,
                      $"suppressed web run {run} ({(run == 0 ? "still" : run == 1 ? "turning" : "full ahead")}): a webifier latched {w.Position.DistanceTo(s.Position):0} u off lands {full:0.00}; one shell under Q -- the next {held.Count} blows land [{string.Join(", ", held.Select(h => h.ToString("0.00")))}] (x0.5), web held {latchedFrames} of {frames} frames (>= 90%), the destroyer pinned every frame {pinned}; 3.3 s on the next is {whole:0.00} (whole)");
                w.TakeDamage(1e12); s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
                s.Sl("suppress").Left = 0; s.Sl("suppress").Cool = 0;
                await Wait(0.3);
            }
        }
        finally { s.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", was); }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE GRAPNEL'S PULL AND SWING (kits_v3 §3.2 Proves; the Destroyer's E) on the practice dummy, through the
    // pilot's own press. The rows once (700 u, 0.15 s bite, 450 u/s, 250 / 150 u off the hull, 100 u/s reel, 5 s, 16 s,
    // x0.01 + 10; E, ability 3 at level 6). The refusals: past 700 u OUT OF RANGE, webbed WEBBED, nothing selected NO
    // TARGET, a hostile seeker NO HOLD -- none starts a move or a cooldown. Three varied runs (VaryAngle bearing; pressed
    // 380-420 / 560-620 / 680-699 u off the dummy's centre): the host marks the slot (up, on the dummy's id), the pull lands
    // 250 +- 10 u off its hull within 0.05 s of 0.15 + (distance - stop) / 450 with the bow within 5 deg, a second of A or D
    // swings it round on its line (within 15 u) bow-on (5 deg); then it is cast off by a second E, by its 5 s (the owner's

    // under ONE torn chunk on its id; the slot cools 16.0 from the cast-off and E is refused COOLING.
    async Task LaneA6aGrapnelPullChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var dd = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        Check(dd["grapnel_reach"] == 700 && dd["grapnel_bite"] == 0.15 && dd["grapnel_pull"] == 450 && dd["grapnel_stop"] == 250 && dd["grapnel_clear"] == 150
              && dd["grapnel_reel"] == 100 && dd["grapnel_swing"] == 5 && dd["grapnel_cooldown"] == 16 && dd["grapnel_rip_share"] == 0.01 && dd["grapnel_rip_flat"] == 10
              && Ab.Grapnel.Default == global::Godot.Key.E && Ab.Grapnel.Hook.Move == HelmMoves.Tether && Ab.Grapnel.Hook.Tow == Towing.Grapnel
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.Destroyer, 3) == Ab.Grapnel && Unlocks.AbilityAt(Classes.Of(ShipClass.Destroyer).Abilities, Ab.Grapnel) == 6
              && new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship)["grapnel_reach"] == 0,
              "the Grapnel's rows (kits_v2 / v3 / v31): 700 u, a 0.15 s bite, 450 u/s to 250 u off the hull, never under 150 u off it, reel 100 u/s, 5 s, 16 s from the cast-off; the rip x0.01 of the anchor's hull + 10; E, the destroyer's ability 3, open at level 6; no other hull has it");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var dm = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
        float r0 = dm.HitRadius;
        void Place(float d) { s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); s.Position = dm.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * d; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); }
        void Reset() { s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").N = 0; }
        // the refusals
        {
            Reset(); Place(Vary(705f, 800f)); await Frame();
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", dm.NetId); await Frame();
            string far = s.FailNote("grapnel"); bool farOn = s.Helm.On || s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0;
            Place(Vary(350f, 650f)); s.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 2.0); await Frame();
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", dm.NetId); await Frame();
            string webbed = s.FailNote("grapnel"); bool webOn = s.Helm.On || s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0;
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", 0); await Frame();
            string none = s.FailNote("grapnel");
            var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, s.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 500f), Vector2.Right, 1f, 4000f, 25);
            await Frame();
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", sk?.NetId ?? 0); await Frame();
            string hold = s.FailNote("grapnel");
            if (sk != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(sk)) sk.Intercept();
            Check(far == "OUT OF RANGE" && webbed == "WEBBED" && none == "NO TARGET" && hold == "NO HOLD" && !farOn && !webOn && !s.Helm.On
                  && s.Sl("grapnel").Cool == 0 && s.Sl("grapnel").Left == 0,
                  $"grapnel refusals: past 700 u {far}, webbed {webbed}, nothing selected {none}, a seeker {hold}; none starts a move or a cooldown");
        }
        var bands = new[] { (380f, 420f), (560f, 620f), (680f, 699f) };
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Reset();
            float d0 = Vary(bands[run].Item1, bands[run].Item2);
            Place(d0); await Frame();
            d0 = s.Position.DistanceTo(dm.Position);                               // re-taken after the frame
            await Wait(TargetDummy.IdleReset + 0.2); dm.ResetMeter();
            Place(d0); await Frame(); d0 = s.Position.DistanceTo(dm.Position);
            double credit0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel");
            H.SelectTarget(dm);
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", dm.NetId);
            await Frame();
            bool marked = s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0 && s.Sl("grapnel").N == dm.NetId;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && s.Helm.On && s.Helm.Pulling; i++) await Frame();
            double taut = s.Helm.T, want = 0.15 + (d0 - (r0 + 250f)) / 450.0;
            float off = s.Position.DistanceTo(dm.Position) - r0, bow = BowOff(s.Rotation, s.Position, dm.Position);
            var key = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? global::Godot.Key.A : global::Godot.Key.D;
            float drift = 0, bowWorst = 0;
            KeyDown(key);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && s.Helm.On; i++)
            {
                await Frame();
                drift = Math.Max(drift, Math.Abs(s.Position.DistanceTo(dm.Position) - s.Helm.Line));
                bowWorst = Math.Max(bowWorst, BowOff(s.Rotation, s.Position, dm.Position));
            }
            KeyUp(key);
            bool swinging = s.Helm.On && s.Velocity.Length() > 20f;
            double took0 = dm.Total;
            var endWant = run == 0 ? HelmEnd.Pressed : run == 1 ? HelmEnd.Time : HelmEnd.Webbed;
            if (run == 0) s.UseAbility("grapnel", dm.NetId);
            else if (run == 2) s.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 1.0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && (s.Helm.On || s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0); i++) await Frame();
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            int rips = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == dm.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3);
            double took = dm.Total - took0, credit = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel") - credit0, cool = s.Sl("grapnel").Cool;
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", dm.NetId); await Frame();
            string again = s.FailNote("grapnel");
            Check(marked && Math.Abs(off - 250f) <= 10f && Math.Abs(taut - want) <= 0.05 && bow <= 5f && drift <= 15f && bowWorst <= 5f && swinging
                  && (s.Helm.Ended == endWant || (run == 1 && s.Helm.Ended == HelmEnd.Host && Math.Abs(s.Helm.T - 5) < 0.05)) && rips == 1 && Math.Abs(took - 10) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(credit - 10) < 1e-6
                  && cool > 15.8 && cool <= 16.0 + 1e-6 && again == "COOLING",
                  $"grapnel run {run}: pressed {d0:0} u off the dummy -- marked by the host {marked}; hauled to {off:0.0} u off its hull (250 +- 10) at {taut:0.00} s (want {want:0.00}), bow {bow:0.0} deg; {key} swings it round, {drift:0.0} u off its line, bow {bowWorst:0.0} deg; "
                  + $"cast off by {s.Helm.Ended} ({endWant}) -- {rips} chunk (1), the dummy took {took:0.00} (10) credited {credit:0.00} to \"grapnel\"; cooling {cool:0.0} (16); E again {again} (COOLING)");
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; H.ClearSelection();
            Reset();
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        // THE ENDS THAT DO NOT RIP (HookWatch; kits_v3 §3.2 "an anchor that dies or warps leaves no rip", kits_v31 §3.3
        // "nothing when the anchor dies first", §3.4 "an anchor that warps casts off with none"). Three varied runs each:
        // WARPED -- the destroyer pressed 380-650 u off the dummy at a VaryAngle bearing, and 0.3-0.8 s into the swing the
        // dummy set down 650-900 u from where it stood (past Drives.SnapAt, 600) at a VaryAngle bearing; DIED -- a lone
        // shield pylon raised near yonder with its level's hull (no base: nothing shields it, and its fall is nothing to a
        // mission), the destroyer pressed 430-690 u off it at a VaryAngle bearing, and 0.3-0.8 s into the swing the pylon
        // shot down. Either way, within 0.1 s: the move ends (AnchorWarped / AnchorLost), the line is released (the slot
        // down, on no id), no chunk rides the anchor's id, the dummy's meter and the "grapnel" credit are unchanged, and
        // the slot cools 16.0 from that frame.
        Check(Drives.SnapAt == 600f, $"an anchor that moves over {Drives.SnapAt:0} u in a frame has warped (600)");
        var dmHome = dm.Position;
        var pylonRow = Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Pylon);
        for (int end = 0; end < 6; end++)
        {
            bool warp = end < 3;
            Reset(); s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
            IHittable anchor = dm; Emplacement py = null;
            if (warp) Place(Vary(380f, 650f));
            else
            {
                double hull = Emplacements.Of(pylonRow).Hull(Missions.Level) * Missions.HullMult(Missions.Level, 1);
                py = H.Spawn(Spawns.Emplacement, VaryNear(yonder, 300f), pylonRow, hull, hull) as Emplacement;
                await Frame();
                if (py == null) { Check(false, $"grapnel died run {end - 3}: no pylon raised"); continue; }
                anchor = py;
                s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
                s.Position = py.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(430f, 690f); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            }
            await Frame();
            float d0 = s.Position.DistanceTo(anchor.Position);                     // re-taken after the frame
            H.SelectTarget(anchor);
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", anchor.NetId);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && s.Helm.On && s.Helm.Pulling; i++) await Frame();
            double c0 = s.Clock, swingFor = Vary(0.3f, 0.8f);
            while (s.Clock - c0 < swingFor && s.Helm.On) { s.Hp = s.MaxHp; await Frame(); }
            bool swung = s.Helm.On && s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0 && s.Sl("grapnel").N == anchor.NetId;
            int anchorId = anchor.NetId;
            double took0 = dm.Total, credit0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel");
            int rips0 = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == anchorId);
            Vector2 movedTo = Vector2.Zero;
            if (warp) { movedTo = dmHome + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(650f, 900f); dm.Position = movedTo; }
            else py.TakeDamage(py.MaxHp * 2);
            double endedAt = s.Clock;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6 && (s.Helm.On || s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0); i++) await Frame();
            double within = s.Clock - endedAt, cool = s.Sl("grapnel").Cool;
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            int rips = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == anchorId) - rips0;
            double took = dm.Total - took0, credit = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel") - credit0;
            var endWant = warp ? HelmEnd.AnchorWarped : HelmEnd.AnchorLost;
            bool released = !s.Helm.On && s.Sl("grapnel").Left == 0 && s.Sl("grapnel").N == 0;
            if (warp) dm.Position = dmHome;
            else if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(py) && py.Alive) H.Down(Spawns.Emplacement, py, false, 0f);
            Check(swung && s.Helm.Ended == endWant && released && within <= 0.1 && rips == 0 && Math.Abs(took) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(credit) < 1e-9
                  && cool > 16.0 - within - 0.02 && cool <= 16.0 + 1e-6 && (warp || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(py) || !py.Alive),
                  $"grapnel {(warp ? $"warped run {end}: the dummy set down {movedTo.DistanceTo(dmHome):0} u away" : $"died run {end - 3}: a lone pylon shot down")} mid-swing (pressed {d0:0} u off, swinging {swung}) -- "
                  + $"ended {s.Helm.Ended} ({endWant}) within {within:0.00} s (0.1), the line released {released}; {rips} chunks (0), the dummy took {took:0.00} (0), \"grapnel\" credited {credit:0.00} (0); cooling {cool:0.00} (16 from that frame)");
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; H.ClearSelection();
            Reset();
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE RIP ON A REAL ANCHOR (kits_v31 §3.3 Proves: "on {Lancer, Drake, pylon, base} the anchor's hull drops by
    // exactly 0.01 x MaxHp + 10 at cast-off"; the scaled MaxHp, so a party's is a party's). Run from each anchor's own
    // fight (the boss, a pylon, the pirate base), as a destroyer, three varied runs (VaryAngle bearing; pressed 80-120 u
    // inside the stop, or 30-80 u outside it): the pull on a real anchor (kits_v3 §3.2 Proves, "on each of {Lancer, Drake,
    // pylon, base, dummy}") -- pressed outside the stop, the centre ends 250 +- 10 u off the hull within 0.05 s of
    // 0.15 + (distance - stop) / 450 with the bow within 5 deg; pressed inside it, no pull, a line never under the
    // distance it had, and the destroyer never 15 u nearer ("moves the DD no nearer"); then cast off by a second E, by
    // the 5 s, or by the destroyer's own warp charge -- the anchor's hull drops by exactly 0.01 x its MaxHp + 10,
    // credited "grapnel", ONE chunk raised on its id whose Size is 0.16 x the anchor's length (`chunk`, the literal
    // FieldsRipChecks holds for that anchor, NaN where it holds none); its cooldown 16.0 from then.
    async Task LaneA6aGrapnelRipChecks(IHittable anchor, string what, float chunk)
    {
        if (anchor is not IQuarry q || anchor is not Node2D an) { Check(false, $"grapnel rip on the {what}: not a hulled anchor"); return; }
        var classWas = Character.Class;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        float stop = anchor.HitRadius + 250f;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3 && anchor.Alive; run++)
        {
            s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").N = 0; s.Sl("warp").Cool = 0;
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            float d0 = Math.Min(run == 0 ? stop - Vary(80f, 120f) : stop + Vary(30f, 80f), 690f);
            s.Position = an.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * d0; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
            await Frame();
            d0 = s.Position.DistanceTo(anchor.Position);                           // re-taken after the frame
            double credit0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel");
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", anchor.NetId);
            double c0 = s.Clock, swingFor = Vary(0.9f, 1.4f), taut = -1;
            await Frame();
            bool pulledAtPress = s.Helm.On && s.Helm.Pulling; float line0 = s.Helm.Line, nearest = s.Position.DistanceTo(anchor.Position);
            float off = float.NaN, bow = float.NaN;
            while (s.Clock - c0 < swingFor && s.Helm.On)
            {
                s.Hp = s.MaxHp; await Frame();
                if (!s.Helm.On) break;
                nearest = Math.Min(nearest, s.Position.DistanceTo(anchor.Position));
                if (taut < 0 && !s.Helm.Pulling)
                { taut = s.Helm.T; off = s.Position.DistanceTo(anchor.Position) - anchor.HitRadius; bow = BowOff(s.Rotation, s.Position, anchor.Position); }
            }
            double pullWant = 0.15 + (d0 - stop) / 450.0;
            bool pullOk = run == 0 ? !pulledAtPress && line0 >= d0 - 1e-3f && nearest >= d0 - 15f
                                   : pulledAtPress && Math.Abs(off - 250f) <= 10f && Math.Abs(taut - pullWant) <= 0.05 && bow <= 5f;
            bool swung = s.Helm.On && s.Sl("grapnel").N == anchor.NetId;
            if (run == 1) while (s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0.05 && s.Helm.On) { s.Hp = s.MaxHp; await Frame(); }
            double hp0 = q.Hp, max = q.MaxHp;
            if (run == 0) s.UseAbility("grapnel", anchor.NetId);
            else if (run == 2) { s.DriveHeld = true; s.PressDrive(); }
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0; i++) await Frame();
            if (run == 2) s.DriveHeld = false;
            await Frame();
            double drop = hp0 - q.Hp, credit = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel") - credit0, cool = s.Sl("grapnel").Cool;
            var chunks = Nodes<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3).ToList();
            int rips = chunks.Count;
            float size = chunks.Count > 0 ? chunks[0].Radius : -1f, sizeWant = 0.16f * Fx.LengthOf(anchor);
            bool sizeOk = Fx.ChunkShare == 0.16f && Math.Abs(size - sizeWant) < 0.01f && (float.IsNaN(chunk) || Math.Abs(size - chunk) < 0.5f);
            double want = 0.01 * max + 10;
            Check(swung && pullOk && Math.Abs(drop - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(credit - want) < 1e-6 && rips == 1 && sizeOk && cool > 15.8 && cool <= 16.0 + 1e-6,
                  $"grapnel rip on the {what} run {run}: hooked {d0:0} u off (the stop {stop:0}) -- "
                  + (run == 0 ? $"inside it: pulled {pulledAtPress} (False), its line {line0:0.0} (>= {d0:0.0}), never nearer than {nearest:0.0} (>= {d0 - 15f:0.0}); "
                              : $"hauled to {off:0.0} u off the hull (250 +- 10) at {taut:0.00} s (want {pullWant:0.00} +- 0.05), bow {bow:0.0} deg (5); ")
                  + $"cast off by {(run == 0 ? "a second E" : run == 1 ? "its 5 s" : "the destroyer's warp")} -- its hull dropped {drop:0.00} (0.01 x {max:0} + 10 = {want:0.00}), credited {credit:0.00}; {rips} chunk (1) of Size {size:0.0} (0.16 x {Fx.LengthOf(anchor):0} = {sizeWant:0.0}{(float.IsNaN(chunk) ? "" : $"; {chunk:0.0}")}); cooling {cool:0.0} (16)");
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && s.Charging; i++) await Frame();
            s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("warp").Cool = 0;
        if (classWas != ShipClass.Destroyer) await SetClass(classWas);
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a: THE TOW AND THE HURL (kits_v2 Proves), and the craft that is never ripped. Three varied runs (VaryNear
    // spot; a webifier, a talon, a gunship hooked 150-250 / 350-450 / 600-699 u off at a VaryAngle bearing, PD out of
    // reach): E -- the craft is reeled 160 +- 10 u off the bow within 0.6 s, its laser tally flat while hauled; a held
    // gunship posted 300 u down the bow: a second E hurls it, and the gunship and the thrown craft each take 60 (120 when
    // the thrown one is a heavy), credited "hurl"; no chunk on the craft; the cooldown 16.0 from the hurl. And a webifier
    // latched on the destroyer: hooking it clears Pinned within 0.35 s (towing while pinned is allowed).
    async Task LaneA6aGrapnelTowChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double was = PdReachOff(s);
        try
        {
            var kinds = new[] { Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Talon, Enemies.Gunship };
            var bands = new[] { (150f, 250f), (350f, 450f), (600f, 699f) };
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").N = 0;
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float heading = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = heading; s.Hp = s.MaxHp; }
                Hold(); await Wait(0.2); Hold();
                var craftAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(bands[run].Item1, bands[run].Item2);
                var craft = H.SpawnRaider(craftAt, kinds[run]); craft.Hp = 1e9;
                await Frame();
                double laser0 = s.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault($"raider:{craft.NetId}");
                H.SelectTarget(craft);
                s.UseAbility("grapnel", craft.NetId);
                double c0 = s.Clock; float heldOff = float.MaxValue;
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 0.6) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
                heldOff = craft.Position.DistanceTo(Towing.Bow(s, 160f));
                bool towed = craft.Towed != null && s.Sl("grapnel").N == craft.NetId && !s.Helm.On;
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 1.5) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
                double laser = s.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault($"raider:{craft.NetId}") - laser0;
                var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(heading);
                var victimAt = Towing.Bow(s, 160f) + nose * Vary(280f, 320f);
                var victim = H.SpawnRaider(victimAt, Enemies.Gunship); victim.Hp = 1e9; victim.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
                await Frame();
                double v0 = victim.Hp, k0 = craft.Hp, hurl0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Towing.Of(Towing.Grapnel).Id);
                int rips0 = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip);
                s.UseAbility("grapnel", craft.NetId);
                c0 = s.Clock;
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 1.2 && victim.Hp >= v0) { Hold(); victim.Position = victimAt; await Frame(); }
                await Frame();
                double hit = v0 - victim.Hp, self = k0 - craft.Hp, want = craft.Heavy ? 120 : 60;
                double hurl = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Towing.Of(Towing.Grapnel).Id) - hurl0, cool = s.Sl("grapnel").Cool;
                int rips = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip) - rips0;
                Check(towed && heldOff <= 10f && laser == 0 && Math.Abs(hit - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(self - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(hurl - 2 * want) < 1e-6
                      && rips == 0 && cool > 14.5 && cool <= 16.0 + 1e-6,
                      $"grapnel tow run {run}: a {Enemies.Of(kinds[run]).Id} hooked {craftAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off -- towed {towed}, {heldOff:0.0} u from 160 off the bow at 0.6 s (10), its laser landed {laser:0.0} while hauled (0); "
                      + $"E again hurls it into a gunship {victimAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u down the bow -- it takes {hit:0} and the thrown {Enemies.Of(kinds[run]).Id} {self:0} (want {want:0} each), \"hurl\" {hurl:0}; {rips} chunks (0); cooling {cool:0.0} (16 from the hurl)");
                craft.TakeDamage(1e12); victim.TakeDamage(1e12); H.ClearSelection();
                await Wait(0.3);
            }
            // the pinner hooked: its web drops
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").N = 0;
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                s.Position = at; s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Hp = s.MaxHp;
                await Wait(0.2);
                var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f), Enemies.Webifier); w.Hp = 1e9; w.Quarry = s;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !(w.Latched && s.Pinned); i++) { s.Hp = s.MaxHp; await Frame(); }
                bool pinned = s.Pinned;
                s.UseAbility("grapnel", w.NetId);
                double c0 = s.Clock, freeAt = -1;
                while (s.Clock - c0 < 1.0 && freeAt < 0) { s.Hp = s.MaxHp; await Frame(); if (!s.Pinned) freeAt = s.Clock - c0; }
                Check(pinned && w.Towed != null && freeAt >= 0 && freeAt <= 0.35,
                      $"grapnel on its own pinner run {run}: webbed {pinned}, the webifier hooked (towed {w.Towed != null}) -- the web drops at {freeAt:0.00} s (0.35)");
                w.TakeDamage(1e12); s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
                s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").N = 0;
                await Wait(0.3);
            }
        }
        finally { s.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", was); }
    }

    async Task LaneA6cBladeChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var sh = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        Check(sh["blade_damage"] == 26 && Math.Abs(sh["blade_interval"] - 0.40) < 1e-9 && sh["blade_reach"] == 160 && Melee.Blade.Arc == 55f
              && Melee.Blade.Stops == 0 && Math.Abs(sh.SustainedDps - 65.0) < 1e-6 && sh["hull"] == 300 && !sh.Def.Has(Fit.Guns)
              && !sh.All.Any(r => r.Id == "main_damage") && Abilities.TriggerOf(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior) == Ab.Blade
              && Items.IdsOf("@primary", ShipClass.HeavyWarrior).Contains("blade_damage")
              && Items.IdsOf("@primary_rate", ShipClass.HeavyWarrior).Contains("blade_interval")
              && Items.IdsOf("@primary_range", ShipClass.HeavyWarrior).Contains("blade_reach"),
              $"the Warrior's sheet: hull {sh["hull"]:0} (300), no guns, the blade {sh["blade_damage"]:0} every {sh["blade_interval"]:0.00} s inside {sh["blade_reach"]:0} u and ±{Melee.Blade.Arc:0} deg = {sh.SustainedDps:0.0} DPS (65), and the blade is the primary the items reach");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        var w = Me; var key = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, "blade");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            float side = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var spots = new[] {
                at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-40f, 40f))) * Vary(70f, 130f),               // in the arc
                at - nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-40f, 40f))) * Vary(70f, 130f),               // behind
                at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-20f, 20f))) * Vary(260f, 340f),              // past 160 u
                at + nose.Rotated(side * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(65f, 80f))) * Vary(70f, 110f) };       // off the arc
            var foes = spots.Select(p => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            void Pose() { w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Rotation = rot; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k]; }
            Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); Pose();
            var hp0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt0 = w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("blade", out var dv0) ? dv0 : 0;
            KeyDown(key);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && foes[0].Hp == hp0[0]; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double first = w.Clock;                                   // timed from the first blow, not the key
            while (w.Clock - first < 1.0) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            var lost = Enumerable.Range(0, 4).Select(k => hp0[k] - foes[k].Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt = (w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("blade", out var dv1) ? dv1 : 0) - dealt0;
            Check(Math.Abs(lost[0] - 78) < 1e-6 && lost[1] == 0 && lost[2] == 0 && lost[3] == 0 && Math.Abs(dealt - 78) < 1e-6,
                  $"the blade held at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: in its arc {spots[0].DistanceTo(at):0} u off loses {lost[0]:0.##} in the 1.0 s from the first blow (3 x 26 = 78); behind {lost[1]:0.##}, {spots[2].DistanceTo(at):0} u out {lost[2]:0.##}, {Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(nose.Angle(), (spots[3] - at).Angle()))):0} deg off {lost[3]:0.##} (all 0); DealtBy[blade] +{dealt:0.##}");
            // released: nothing more lands
            KeyUp(key);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double rel0 = foes[0].Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 45; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            // DISABLED: held again, and nothing lands while the status runs
            w.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 1.0);
            KeyDown(key);
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            KeyUp(key);
            Check(foes[0].Hp == rel0, $"the blade released, and then held while DISABLED, lands nothing more ({rel0 - foes[0].Hp:0.##})");
            w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        w.Position = yonder; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE WARRIOR'S LUNGE (kits_v2 card; kits_v31 §3.4: a fixed 420 u in 0.3 s, never priced
    // from speed; 40 a body; half damage taken; cooldown 7 s). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle
    // heading): at rest, already at top speed ahead, and on the V boost (x1.5, the drive interaction).
    // Each: the hull goes 420 +- 5 u along its nose (sideways under 5) in 0.3 s +- 0.05, whatever it was
    // doing (measured on the frame the dash ends); two or three gunships on the line (70-380 u ahead, under 20 u off it) lose 40 each, ONCE,
    // and one 150-250 u off the line nothing; DealtBy["lunge"] grows 40 a body; a 100 blow inside the dash
    // lands for 50 and one after it for 100; the cooldown reads 7.0 and a second press inside it is
    // refused and goes nowhere.
    // 2 THE SLIDE HELD THROUGH IT (kits_v31 §7, strafe vs the lunge): three more runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle
    // heading), Shift + A or Shift + D (a seeded side) held 0.3-0.6 s before the press and through the dash: the
    // hull already sliding (over 20 u/s across) goes 420 +- 5 u along its nose, under 5 u sideways, its heading kept,
    // in 0.3 s +- 0.05 -- the carry replaces the helm, so the slide adds nothing.
    // 3 THE WEB (kits_v31 §7, the Lunge is one of the nine's web answers): three more runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle
    // heading, the webifier 250-400 u off at a VaryAngle bearing): Pinned by a latched webifier, E still carries the
    // hull 420 +- 5 u along its nose (under 5 sideways) -- the carry runs before the pin's forced thrust -- and the
    // pin is gone within 0.3 s of the dash's end (the latch left behind, its last 0.25 s hold spent).
    // 4 DISABLED INSIDE THE DASH (review hv-R6c-6): three more runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading), Disabled
    // 0.08-0.15 s into the dash: the row's Left reads 0 and the hardening is off within a frame, the hull stays within
    // 15 u of where it stopped, a gunship 40-90 u down the line took its 40 before and one 330-400 u down it takes 0.
    async Task LaneA6cLungeChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        var w = Me;
        var sh = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        Check(sh["lunge_reach"] == 420 && Math.Abs(sh["lunge_time"] - 0.3) < 1e-9 && sh["lunge_damage"] == 40 && sh["lunge_guard"] == 0.5
              && sh["lunge_cooldown"] == 7 && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, 1) == Ab.Lunge && Ab.Lunge.Default == global::Godot.Key.E,
              $"the lunge's rows: {sh["lunge_reach"]:0} u in {sh["lunge_time"]:0.0} s, {sh["lunge_damage"]:0} a body, x{sh["lunge_guard"]:0.0} taken, {sh["lunge_cooldown"]:0} s; the Warrior's ability 1, on E");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            w.Sl("lunge").Left = 0; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0; w.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            w.Position = at; w.Velocity = run == 1 ? nose * 190f : Vector2.Zero; w.Rotation = rot;
            if (run == 2)
            {
                w.DriveHeld = true; w.PressDrive();
                for (int i = 0; i < 30 && w.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                w.DriveHeld = false;
            }
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            at = w.Position; rot = w.Rotation; nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);          // re-taken after the wait
            var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
            int onLine = run < 2 ? 2 : 3;
            var spots = Enumerable.Range(0, onLine).Select(k => at + nose * Vary(70f + 110f * k, 150f + 110f * k) + side * Vary(-20f, 20f))
                                  .Append(at + nose * Vary(120f, 300f) + side * (run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f) * Vary(150f, 250f)).ToArray();
            var foes = spots.Select(p => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            for (int k = 0; k < foes.Length; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k];
            var hp0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt0 = w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("lunge", out var dv0) ? dv0 : 0;
            var from = w.Position; double cPress = w.Clock;
            w.UseAbility("lunge", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && w.Sl("lunge").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double cool0 = w.Sl("lunge").Cool;
            double inHp = w.Hp;
            w.Hit(100, w.Position - nose * 200f, "test:lunge_in");                     // inside the dash: half of it
            double inTook = inHp - w.Hp;
            // the carry runs in lockstep with the row's Left (the owner's LocalFlight, then the tick), so
            // the hull stands where the dash ended on the first frame Left is spent -- before any coast
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && w.Sl("lunge").Left > 0; i++)
            {
                for (int k = 0; k < foes.Length; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k];
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            var endAt = w.Position; double took = w.Clock - cPress;
            var moved = endAt - from;
            float along = moved.Dot(nose), across = Mathf.Abs(moved.Dot(side));
            var lost = Enumerable.Range(0, foes.Length).Select(k => hp0[k] - foes[k].Hp).ToArray();
            double dealt = (w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("lunge", out var dv1) ? dv1 : 0) - dealt0;
            Check(Math.Abs(along - 420f) < 5f && across < 5f && Math.Abs(took - 0.3) < 0.05,
                  $"the lunge {(run == 0 ? "from rest" : run == 1 ? "at top speed" : "on the boost")} at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: {along:0.0} u along the nose (420), {across:0.0} u sideways, over {took:0.00} s from the press (0.3)");
            Check(lost.Take(onLine).All(l => Math.Abs(l - 40) < 1e-6) && lost[onLine] == 0 && Math.Abs(dealt - 40 * onLine) < 1e-6,
                  $"the lunge strikes each of the {onLine} gunships on its line once for 40 ({string.Join(" / ", lost.Take(onLine).Select(l => l.ToString("0.##")))}) and the one {Mathf.Abs((spots[onLine] - at).Dot(side)):0} u off it nothing ({lost[onLine]:0.##}); DealtBy[lunge] +{dealt:0.##}");
            await Wait(0.1);
            double outHp = w.Hp;
            w.Hit(100, w.Position - nose * 200f, "test:lunge_out");
            double outTook = outHp - w.Hp;
            w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var still = w.Position;
            string refused = Abilities.Find(w.Class, "lunge").Refuse?.Invoke(w, null);
            w.UseAbility("lunge", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(Math.Abs(inTook - 50) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(outTook - 100) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(cool0 - 7.0) < 0.05 && refused == "COOLING"
                  && w.Sl("lunge").Left <= 0 && w.Position.DistanceTo(still) < 20f,
                  $"a 100 blow inside the lunge lands for {inTook:0.#} (50), after it {outTook:0.#} (100); cooldown {cool0:0.00} s (7.0); pressed again it says {refused ?? "nothing"} and goes {w.Position.DistanceTo(still):0} u");
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }

        // 2 -- the slide held through it
        w.AutopilotTo = null;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            w.Sl("lunge").Left = 0; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0; w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Rotation = rot;
            var sideKey = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? global::Godot.Key.D : global::Godot.Key.A;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyDown(sideKey);
            await Wait(Vary(0.3f, 0.6f));                                              // already sliding
            float slid = Mathf.Abs(w.SpeedAcross);
            var from = w.Position; rot = w.Rotation;                                    // re-taken after the wait
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot); var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
            double cPress = w.Clock;
            w.UseAbility("lunge", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && w.Sl("lunge").Left > 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var moved = w.Position - from; double took = w.Clock - cPress;
            float along = moved.Dot(nose), across = Mathf.Abs(moved.Dot(side)), turned = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, w.Rotation));
            KeyUp(sideKey); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Shift);
            Check(slid > 20f && Math.Abs(along - 420f) < 5f && across < 5f && turned < 0.01f && Math.Abs(took - 0.3) < 0.05,
                  $"the lunge with Shift + {(sideKey == global::Godot.Key.D ? "D" : "A")} held at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg, sliding {slid:0} u/s: {along:0.0} u along the nose (420), {across:0.0} u sideways (under 5), turned {Mathf.RadToDeg(turned):0.0} deg, over {took:0.00} s (0.3)");
            w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }

        // 3 -- the web
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            w.Sl("lunge").Left = 0; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0; w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Rotation = rot;
            var web = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f), Enemies.Webifier);
            web.Hp = 1e9; web.Quarry = w;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !(w.Pinned && web.Latched); i++) { w.Position = at; w.Rotation = rot; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            bool took = w.Pinned && web.Latched;
            var from = w.Position; rot = w.Rotation;                                    // re-taken after the wait
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot); var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
            w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            w.UseAbility("lunge", 0);
            double tFree = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && w.Sl("lunge").Left > 0; i++)
            {
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                if (tFree < 0 && !w.Pinned) tFree = w.Clock;
            }
            var moved = w.Position - from; double tEnd = w.Clock;
            float along = moved.Dot(nose), across = Mathf.Abs(moved.Dot(side));
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && tFree < 0 && w.Clock < tEnd + 0.6; i++)
            {
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                if (!w.Pinned) tFree = w.Clock;
            }
            Check(took && Math.Abs(along - 420f) < 5f && across < 5f && tFree >= 0 && tFree - tEnd <= 0.3,
                  $"the lunge Pinned by a webifier {web.Position.DistanceTo(from):0} u off (latched {took}) at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: {along:0.0} u along the nose (420), {across:0.0} u sideways; the pin gone {(tFree < 0 ? "never" : $"{tFree - tEnd:0.00} s")} from the dash's end (0.3 at most)");
            web.TakeDamage(1e12);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && w.Pinned; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0;
        }

        // 4 -- DISABLED inside the dash
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            w.Sl("lunge").Left = 0; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0; w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Rotation = rot;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            at = w.Position; rot = w.Rotation;                                            // re-taken after the wait
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot); var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
            var nearAt = at + nose * Vary(40f, 90f) + side * Vary(-15f, 15f);
            var farAt = at + nose * Vary(330f, 400f) + side * Vary(-15f, 15f);
            var near = H.SpawnRaider(nearAt, Enemies.Gunship); near.Hp = 1e9;
            var far = H.SpawnRaider(farAt, Enemies.Gunship); far.Hp = 1e9;
            void Hold() { near.Position = nearAt; far.Position = farAt; }
            Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); Hold();
            double nearHp = near.Hp, farHp = far.Hp;
            w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            w.UseAbility("lunge", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && w.Sl("lunge").Left <= 0; i++) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double tp = w.Clock, cut = Vary(0.08f, 0.15f);                                // timed from the first frame the dash runs
            while (w.Clock - tp < cut && w.Sl("lunge").Left > 0) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            bool running = w.Sl("lunge").Left > 0;
            w.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 1.0);
            var stopAt = w.Position; float gone0 = (stopAt - at).Dot(nose);
            Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double leftNext = w.Sl("lunge").Left; bool hardNext = w.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened);
            while (w.Clock - tp < 0.6) { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            float drift = w.Position.DistanceTo(stopAt);
            double nearTook = nearHp - near.Hp, farTook = farHp - far.Hp;
            Check(running && leftNext <= 0 && !hardNext && drift < 15f && Math.Abs(nearTook - 40) < 1e-6 && farTook == 0,
                  $"the lunge DISABLED {cut:0.00} s in, {gone0:0} u along: the row ends within a frame (Left {leftNext:0.00}, hardened {hardNext}), the hull stays within 15 u of where it stopped ({drift:0.0}), a gunship {(nearAt - at).Dot(nose):0} u down the line took {nearTook:0.##} before it (40), one {(farAt - at).Dot(nose):0} u down it {farTook:0.##} (0)");
            near.TakeDamage(1e12); far.TakeDamage(1e12);
            for (int i = 0; i < 90 && w.Disabled; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0;
        }
        w.Position = yonder; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE WARRIOR'S WHIRLWIND (kits_v2 card: 2 s, 210 u all round, 40 DPS, clears and blocks
    // webs, cooldown 14 s). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, the bodies' bearings and
    // reaches varied): 1 four gunships all round inside 210 u (front, behind, both beams) each lose exactly
    // 8 x 10 = 80 over the spin, one 280-340 u out nothing; the cooldown reads 14.0 and a second press is
    // refused. 2 the web: a webifier latched on the hull (Pinned) -- the press frees it within two frames,
    // it stays free for the whole spin, no web latches on it (nor lasers it: the hull loses nothing) for
    // the spin, and the web takes it again after.
    // 3 the blade held all through the spin swings nothing (DealtBy["blade"] still) and swings again
    // once the spin is over.
    async Task LaneA6cWhirlChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        var w = Me;
        var sh = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        Check(sh["whirl_damage"] == 10 && Math.Abs(sh["whirl_interval"] - 0.25) < 1e-9 && sh["whirl_reach"] == 210 && sh["whirl_time"] == 2
              && sh["whirl_cooldown"] == 14 && Melee.Whirl.Arc == 180f && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, 2) == Ab.Whirlwind
              && Ab.Whirlwind.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q && Ab.Whirlwind.Stills,
              $"the whirlwind's rows: {sh["whirl_damage"]:0} every {sh["whirl_interval"]:0.00} s ({sh["whirl_damage"] / sh["whirl_interval"]:0} DPS) inside {sh["whirl_reach"]:0} u all round for {sh["whirl_time"]:0} s, {sh["whirl_cooldown"]:0} s; the Warrior's ability 2, on Q");
        var bladeKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, "blade");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            w.Sl("whirlwind").Left = 0; w.Sl("whirlwind").Cool = 0;
            w.Position = at; w.Rotation = rot; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            at = w.Position; rot = w.Rotation;                                            // re-taken after the wait
            // 1 -- all round
            var bearings = new[] { 0f, 90f, 180f, 270f }.Select(b => rot + Mathf.DegToRad(b + Vary(-30f, 30f))).ToArray();
            var spots = bearings.Select(b => at + Vector2.Up.Rotated(b) * Vary(70f, 150f))
                                .Append(at + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(280f, 340f)).ToArray();
            var foes = spots.Select(p => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            void Pose() { w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Rotation = rot; for (int k = 0; k < foes.Length; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k]; }
            Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); Pose();
            var hp0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            w.UseAbility("whirlwind", 0);
            double cool0 = w.Sl("whirlwind").Cool;
            string again = Abilities.Find(w.Class, "whirlwind").Refuse?.Invoke(w, null);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && w.Sl("whirlwind").Left > 0; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            var lost = Enumerable.Range(0, foes.Length).Select(k => hp0[k] - foes[k].Hp).ToArray();
            Check(lost.Take(4).All(l => Math.Abs(l - 80) < 1e-6) && lost[4] == 0 && Math.Abs(cool0 - 14.0) < 0.05 && again == "SPINNING",
                  $"the whirlwind at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: the four all round lose {string.Join(" / ", lost.Take(4).Select(l => l.ToString("0.##")))} (8 x 10 = 80 each, 40 DPS for 2 s), the one {spots[4].DistanceTo(at):0} u out {lost[4]:0.##}; cooldown {cool0:0.00} s (14); pressed again: {again ?? "nothing"}");
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);

            // 2 -- the web
            w.Sl("whirlwind").Cool = 0;
            var web = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f), Enemies.Webifier);
            web.Hp = 1e9; web.Quarry = w;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !w.Pinned; i++) { w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            bool took = w.Pinned;
            w.Hp = w.MaxHp;
            w.UseAbility("whirlwind", 0);
            int freeIn = -1; bool heldFree = true, unlatched = true; double t = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && t < 1.9; i++)
            {
                w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                t += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (freeIn < 0 && !w.Pinned) freeIn = i + 1;
                if (freeIn >= 0 && w.Pinned) heldFree = false;
                if (t > 0.5) unlatched &= !web.Latched;
            }
            double hpSpin = w.Hp, hpMax = w.MaxHp;                                        // the spin's end, before the web takes it again
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && !w.Pinned; i++) { w.Position = at; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); t += GetProcessDeltaTime(); }
            Check(took && freeIn >= 1 && freeIn <= 2 && heldFree && unlatched && hpSpin == hpMax && w.Pinned && t >= 1.95,
                  $"a webifier latched {web.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off: the whirlwind frees the hull in {freeIn} frame(s) (1-2), no web latches for the spin (free throughout {heldFree}, unlatched {unlatched}, the hull {hpSpin:0.##} of {hpMax:0.##}), and the web takes it again {t:0.00} s after the press (after 2)");
            web.TakeDamage(1e12);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && w.Pinned; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);

            // 3 -- the blade holds while it spins
            w.Sl("whirlwind").Cool = 0;
            var mark = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot + Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-30f, 30f))) * Vary(70f, 130f), Enemies.Gunship);
            mark.Hp = 1e9; var markAt = mark.Position;
            w.UseAbility("whirlwind", 0);
            double blade0 = w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("blade", out var bv0) ? bv0 : 0;
            KeyDown(bladeKey);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && w.Sl("whirlwind").Left > 0; i++) { w.Position = at; w.Rotation = rot; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; mark.Position = markAt; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double bladeSpin = (w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("blade", out var bv1) ? bv1 : 0) - blade0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { w.Position = at; w.Rotation = rot; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; mark.Position = markAt; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            KeyUp(bladeKey);
            double bladeAfter = (w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("blade", out var bv2) ? bv2 : 0) - blade0 - bladeSpin;
            Check(bladeSpin == 0 && bladeAfter >= 26,
                  $"the blade held through the spin swings {bladeSpin:0} (0) and, the spin over, {bladeAfter:0} (26 or more)");
            mark.TakeDamage(1e12);
            w.Sl("whirlwind").Cool = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        w.Position = yonder; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S LUNGE. The guest (LaneA6cLungeGuestChecks, after lane B's drives and
    // before its freighter) flies a WARRIOR, turns to a varied heading at rest and presses E: its own hull
    // goes 420 +- 5 u along the nose, it reads the host's HARDENED bit and the host's 7 s cooldown on its
    // slot. The host (LaneA6cLungeHostWatch from before lane B's window, LaneA6cLungeHostChecks after it)
    // sees its copy of the guest start the lunge HARDENED with the cooldown at 7, and 0.8 s later stand
    // within 20 u of 420 u along the heading it pressed at -- the owner's carry and the host's line agree.
    sealed class LaneA6cLungeSeen { public bool Started, Done, Hard; public Vector2 From, End; public float Rot; public double Cool, T; }
    LateSampler LaneA6cLungeHostWatch(LaneA6cLungeSeen seen)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.HeavyWarrior } g || seen.Done) return false;
            if (!seen.Started)
            {
                if (g.Sl("lunge").Left <= 0) return false;
                seen.Started = true; seen.From = g.Sl("lunge").At; seen.Rot = (float)g.Sl("lunge").Own;
                seen.Cool = g.Sl("lunge").Cool; seen.Hard = g.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened);
                return false;
            }
            seen.T += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            if (seen.T < 0.8) return false;
            seen.End = g.Position; seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6cLungeHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6cLungeSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 10 : 5);
        watch.QueueFree();
        var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(seen.Rot);
        var want = seen.From + nose * 420f;
        Check(seen.Done && seen.Hard && Math.Abs(seen.Cool - 7.0) < 0.1 && seen.End.DistanceTo(want) < 20f,
              $"arena host: the guest's lunge -- HARDENED here at its press ({seen.Hard}), cooling {seen.Cool:0.00} s (7), and its hull 0.8 s later {seen.End.DistanceTo(want):0.0} u from 420 u along the heading it pressed at (under 20)");
    }
    async Task LaneA6cLungeGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 300) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);           // the host's word for the hull
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
        await Wait(0.4);
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        var from = me.Position; var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(me.Rotation); var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
        bool sawHard = false;
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () => { sawHard |= Me is { } m && m.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened); return false; } };
        AddChild(watch);
        me.UseAbility("lunge", 0);
        await RealTime(() => me.Sl("lunge").Left > 0, Wan ? 4 : 2);
        double coolHere = me.Sl("lunge").Cool;
        await Wait(0.8);
        watch.QueueFree();
        var moved = me.Position - from;
        Check(Math.Abs(moved.Dot(nose) - 420f) < 5f && Mathf.Abs(moved.Dot(side)) < 5f && sawHard && coolHere > 6.0,
              $"arena guest: its own E -- the hull carried {moved.Dot(nose):0.0} u along its nose (420), {Mathf.Abs(moved.Dot(side)):0.0} sideways; the host's HARDENED bit read here ({sawHard}); the host's cooldown on its slot {coolHere:0.0} s");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE WARRIOR'S PRISM STANCE (kits_v2 Warrior card: 2.0 s, F again drops it, Q or E ends
    // it, the cooldown 12 s from its END, top speed x0.5 (boosted x0.75), no swings, a split every 0.75 s
    // at most 3 a stance). The bands, the children and the reflections are slice 5's (LaneAPrism*Checks);
    // these are the stance's own. Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, the guard on the nose):
    // 1 the whole stance, a SQUARE 50 tick caught every frame of it: the catcher takes 0 of every one, the
    //   gunship on the guard loses exactly 3 x 37.5 = 112.5 (one stance's worth), the tick at 1.85-1.9 s is
    //   still caught and one walked through at 2.1-2.2 s lands 50; the cooldown reads 12.0 on the frame it
    //   ends; held x0.5 all through (x1.5 x 0.5 = x0.75 on the boost, run 2); the blade held through it
    //   lands nothing on a gunship in its arc.
    // 2 the end: at Vary 0.3-1.7 s, F again (run 0), E the lunge (run 1) or Q the whirlwind (run 2) ends it
    //   on the next frame -- no guard, the cooldown 12.0 from then, the other ability running -- and F is
    //   refused COOLING.
    async Task LaneA6cPrismStanceChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        var w = Me;
        var sh = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        Check(sh["prism_time"] == 2 && sh["prism_cooldown"] == 12 && Math.Abs(sh["prism_split"] - 0.75) < 1e-9 && sh["prism_splits"] == 3
              && Ab.PrismStance.Hold == 0.5 && Ab.PrismStance.Stills && Ab.PrismStance.Stance?.Holds == Status.Parrying
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, 3) == Ab.PrismStance && Ab.PrismStance.Default == global::Godot.Key.F,
              $"the prism stance's rows: {sh["prism_time"]:0.0} s, a split every {sh["prism_split"]:0.00} s at most {sh["prism_splits"]:0}, {sh["prism_cooldown"]:0} s from its end, held x{Ab.PrismStance.Hold:0.0}, no blade; the Warrior's ability 3, on F");
        var bladeKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, "blade");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var id in new[] { "prism", "lunge", "whirlwind", "boost" }) { w.Sl(id).Left = 0; w.Sl(id).Cool = 0; }
