            w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Parrying); w.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            w.Position = at; w.Rotation = rot; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.Hp = w.MaxHp;
            if (run == 2)
            {
                w.DriveHeld = true; w.PressDrive();
                for (int i = 0; i < 30 && w.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                w.DriveHeld = false;
            }
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            at = w.Position; rot = w.Rotation;                                            // re-taken after the wait
            var g = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            float sign = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var uSq = -g.Rotated(sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(1f, 12f)));
            var guardSpot = at + g * Vary(300f, 900f);
            var armSpot = at + g.Rotated(-sign * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(40f, 50f))) * Vary(90f, 130f);   // in the blade's arc, off the guard's line
            var onGuard = H.SpawnRaider(guardSpot, Enemies.Gunship); onGuard.Hp = 1e9;
            var inArc = H.SpawnRaider(armSpot, Enemies.Gunship); inArc.Hp = 1e9;
            void Pose() { w.Position = at; w.Rotation = rot; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; w.AimPoint = at + g * 600f; onGuard.Position = guardSpot; inArc.Position = armSpot; }
            Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); Pose();

            // 1 -- the whole stance
            double guard0 = onGuard.Hp, arc0 = inArc.Hp;
            double blade0 = w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("blade", out var bv0) ? bv0 : 0;
            w.UseAbility("prism", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && !w.Prismatic; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            double t0 = w.Clock;                                                           // timed from the first frame the guard is up
            float heldMin = 1f, heldMax = 0f, liftHeld = w.SpeedMult * w.Held;
            bool boosted = w.Sl("boost").Left > 0;
            bool tookNone = true;
            double late = Vary(1.85f, 1.9f), after = Vary(2.1f, 2.2f), coolAtEnd = -1;
            KeyDown(bladeKey);
            while (w.Clock - t0 < late)
            {
                Pose();
                heldMin = Mathf.Min(heldMin, w.Held); heldMax = Mathf.Max(heldMax, w.Held);
                double hull = w.Hp;
                bool caught = Prism.Catch(w, BlowKind.Beam, at - uSq * 800f, at + uSq * 500f, 50, $"test:stance#{run}");
                tookNone &= caught && w.Hp == hull;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            Pose();
            double hullLate = w.Hp;
            bool lateCaught = Prism.Catch(w, BlowKind.Beam, at - uSq * 800f, at + uSq * 500f, 50, $"test:stance#{run}late") && w.Hp == hullLate;
            while (w.Clock - t0 < after)
            {
                Pose();
                if (coolAtEnd < 0 && w.Sl("prism").Left <= 0) coolAtEnd = w.Sl("prism").Cool;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            KeyUp(bladeKey);
            Pose();
            double hullAfter = w.Hp;
            Prism.Walk(at - uSq * 800f, at + uSq * 500f, 30f, 50, at - uSq * 800f, $"test:stance#{run}after", new[] { w });
            double landed = hullAfter - w.Hp;
            double guardLost = guard0 - onGuard.Hp, arcLost = arc0 - inArc.Hp;
            double bladeIn = (w.DealtBy.TryGetValue("blade", out var bv1) ? bv1 : 0) - blade0;
            Check(tookNone && Math.Abs(guardLost - 112.5) < 1e-6,
                  $"a stance at heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg catching a SQUARE 50 tick every frame: the Warrior takes none of them ({tookNone}), the gunship on the guard {guardSpot.DistanceTo(at):0} u out loses {guardLost:0.##} (3 splits x 37.5 = 112.5: one every 0.75 s, at most 3)");
            Check(lateCaught && Math.Abs(landed - 50) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(coolAtEnd - 12.0) < 0.05,
                  $"...a tick at {late:0.00} s is caught ({lateCaught}), one at {after:0.00} s lands {landed:0.##} (50); the cooldown on the frame it ends reads {coolAtEnd:0.00} s (12.0, from the end)");
            Check(Math.Abs(heldMin - 0.5f) < 1e-3f && Math.Abs(heldMax - 0.5f) < 1e-3f && (!boosted || Math.Abs(liftHeld - 0.75f) < 1e-3f)
                  && (run != 2 || boosted) && arcLost == 0 && bladeIn == 0,
                  $"...held x{heldMin:0.00}-x{heldMax:0.00} all through (0.5){(boosted ? $", x{liftHeld:0.00} on the boost (1.5 x 0.5 = 0.75)" : "")}; the blade held through it lands {bladeIn:0} and the gunship in its arc loses {arcLost:0.##} (0)");

            // 2 -- the end, by F, E or Q
            w.Sl("prism").Cool = 0; w.Sl("lunge").Cool = 0; w.Sl("whirlwind").Cool = 0;
            Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            w.UseAbility("prism", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && !w.Prismatic; i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            t0 = w.Clock;
            double dropAt = Vary(0.3f, 1.7f);
            while (w.Clock - t0 < dropAt) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            string how = run == 0 ? "prism" : run == 1 ? "lunge" : "whirlwind";
            w.UseAbility(how, 0);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            double coolDrop = w.Sl("prism").Cool;
            bool otherRan = run == 0 || w.Sl(how).Left > 0;
            string refused = Abilities.Find(w.Class, "prism").Refuse?.Invoke(w, null);
            Check(!w.Prismatic && w.Sl("prism").Left == 0 && Math.Abs(coolDrop - 12.0) < 0.05 && otherRan && refused == "COOLING",
                  $"...{(run == 0 ? "F again" : run == 1 ? "E (the lunge)" : "Q (the whirlwind)")} at {dropAt:0.00} s ends the stance: guard {(w.Prismatic ? "STILL UP" : "down")}, cooldown {coolDrop:0.00} s (12.0 from the end){(run == 0 ? "" : $", the {how} running {otherRan}")}; F then says {refused ?? "nothing"} (COOLING)");
            onGuard.TakeDamage(1e12); inArc.TakeDamage(1e12);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && (w.Sl("lunge").Left > 0 || w.Sl("whirlwind").Left > 0); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            foreach (var id in new[] { "prism", "lunge", "whirlwind", "boost" }) { w.Sl(id).Left = 0; w.Sl(id).Cool = 0; }
            w.Hp = w.MaxHp;
        }
        w.Position = yonder; w.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S PRISM STANCE. The guest (LaneA6cPrismGuestChecks, right after its lunge)
    // presses F at a varied heading: it reads the host's PARRYING bit and holds its own hull x0.5; at Vary
    // 0.4-1.0 s it presses F again, the bit goes and its slot cools 12 s from the drop; F is then refused
    // COOLING. The host (LaneA6cPrismHostWatch, beside the lunge's watch) sees its copy of the guest Parrying
    // with the stance's slot up and held x0.5, then dropped with its cooldown at 12: the host decides, the
    // guest draws it from the same slot and bit.
    sealed class LaneA6cPrismSeen { public bool Up, Held, Dropped; public double Cool; }
    LateSampler LaneA6cPrismHostWatch(LaneA6cPrismSeen seen)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.HeavyWarrior } g || seen.Dropped) return false;
            if (g.Prismatic && g.Sl("prism").Left > 0)
            {
                seen.Up = true; seen.Held |= Math.Abs(g.Held - 0.5f) < 1e-3f;
                return false;
            }
            if (!seen.Up || g.Sl("prism").Cool <= 0) return false;
            seen.Dropped = true; seen.Cool = g.Sl("prism").Cool;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6cPrismHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6cPrismSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Dropped, Wan ? 10 : 5);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Up && seen.Held && seen.Dropped && seen.Cool > 11.5 && seen.Cool <= 12.0 + 1e-6,
              $"arena host: the guest's prism stance -- Parrying here with its slot up ({seen.Up}), held x0.5 ({seen.Held}), then dropped with its cooldown at {seen.Cool:0.00} s (12, from the drop)");
    }
    async Task LaneA6cPrismGuestChecks()
    {
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null;
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
        await Wait(0.3);
        me.UseAbility("prism", 0);
        await RealTime(() => me.Prismatic, Wan ? 4 : 2);
        bool up = me.Prismatic; float held = me.Held; double left = me.Sl("prism").Left;
        await Wait(Vary(0.4f, 1.0f));
        me.UseAbility("prism", 0);
        await RealTime(() => !me.Prismatic && me.Sl("prism").Cool > 0, Wan ? 4 : 2);
        double cool = me.Sl("prism").Cool;
        string refused = Abilities.Find(me.Class, "prism").Refuse?.Invoke(me, null);
        Check(up && Math.Abs(held - 0.5f) < 1e-3f && left > 0 && !me.Prismatic && cool > 11.0 && cool <= 12.0 + 1e-6 && refused == "COOLING",
              $"arena guest: its own F -- the host's PARRYING bit read here ({up}), its hull held x{held:0.00} (0.5) with the slot up {left:0.0} s; F again drops it (guard {(me.Prismatic ? "STILL UP" : "down")}), cooling {cool:0.0} s (12 from the drop), and F then says {refused ?? "nothing"}");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE ACTIVE RELOAD'S JUDGEMENT, pure (sniper_active_reload.md §3.2, §3.5; ActiveReload.Judged
    // and Give). The spot is 40-60% of the reload (the owner's 0.6 s of 3 s, opening at 1.2 s). Three varied
    // draws each: 1 an honest claim on the host's own clock inside the spot (0.43-0.57) is PERFECT, one before
    // it (0.30-0.37) or after it (0.63-0.90) MISSED. 2 a lie is clamped to the host's clock: at 0.3 s of 3 s a
    // claim of 0.5 (or 7.0) with the 0.10 s cap is judged at 0.133 -- MISSED; the give is the leeway over the
    // length (0.033 of 3 s) but never past a quarter of the spot (0.05 of an anchored 1.2 s); NaN and infinity
    // are judged on the host's clock; with no leeway (the host's own ship) the claim is the host's share
    // exactly. 3 the leeway: 0.10 s at most, 0 offline and for the host's own ship.
    void LaneA6cReloadJudgeChecks()
    {
        const double open = 0.40, close = 0.60;
        var r = ActiveReload.Rail;
        Check(r.Id == "railgun" && r.Reload == "rail_reload" && r.SpotAt == "rail_spot_at" && r.Spot == "rail_spot" && r.Perfect == "rail_perfect" && r.Charge == "rail_charge"
              && Net.LeewayCap == 0.10 && Net.Leeway(Net.LocalId) == 0,
              $"the active reload's row names the railgun's slot and its five stats; the leeway is at most {Net.LeewayCap:0.00} s and {Net.Leeway(Net.LocalId):0.00} for this ship");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            double inside = Vary(0.43f, 0.57f), before = Vary(0.30f, 0.37f), after = Vary(0.63f, 0.90f);
            double give = ActiveReload.Give(Vary(0f, 0.10f), 3.0, open, close);
            Check(ActiveReload.Judged(inside, inside, give, open, close) == Verdict.Perfect
                  && ActiveReload.Judged(before, before, give, open, close) == Verdict.Missed
                  && ActiveReload.Judged(after, after, give, open, close) == Verdict.Missed,
                  $"an honest press judged on its own share: {inside:0.000} PERFECT, {before:0.000} and {after:0.000} MISSED (the spot 0.40-0.60)");
            double early = Vary(0.05f, 0.15f);                          // 0.15-0.45 s into a 3 s reload
            double g3 = ActiveReload.Give(Net.LeewayCap, 3.0, open, close), g12 = ActiveReload.Give(Net.LeewayCap, 1.2, open, close);
            var lie = ActiveReload.Judged(early, 0.5, g3, open, close);
            var seven = ActiveReload.Judged(early, 7.0, g3, open, close);
            var nanIn = ActiveReload.Judged(inside, double.NaN, g3, open, close);
            var infIn = ActiveReload.Judged(inside, double.PositiveInfinity, g3, open, close);
            var nanOut = ActiveReload.Judged(before, double.NaN, g3, open, close);
            Check(Math.Abs(g3 - 0.10 / 3.0) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(g12 - 0.05) < 1e-9 && lie == Verdict.Missed && seven == Verdict.Missed
                  && nanIn == Verdict.Perfect && infIn == Verdict.Perfect && nanOut == Verdict.Missed,
                  $"a lie is clamped to the host's clock: at {early * 3:0.00} s of 3 s a claim of 0.5 is {lie}, of 7.0 {seven}; the give {g3:0.000} of 3 s, {g12:0.000} of an anchored 1.2 s (a quarter of the spot); NaN / infinity judged on the host's clock: {nanIn} / {infIn} inside, {nanOut} before");
            double edge = Vary(0.36f, 0.39f);                           // a hair before the spot, on the host's clock
            var honestNoGive = ActiveReload.Judged(edge, 0.5, ActiveReload.Give(0, 3.0, open, close), open, close);
            var withGive = ActiveReload.Judged(edge, 0.5, g3, open, close);
            Check(honestNoGive == Verdict.Missed && withGive == (edge + g3 >= open ? Verdict.Perfect : Verdict.Missed),
                  $"with no leeway (the host's own ship) the claim is the host's share: at {edge:0.000} a claim of 0.5 is {honestNoGive}; with the cap's give it may reach {edge + g3:0.000}: {withGive}");
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c HELPERS (kits6c-J6) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // THE RAILGUN THROUGH ITS KEY: the chamber seated plain (it may be anywhere in a reload), Space held
    // `hold` seconds (a full charge and 0.1 s by default) and let go; returns once the chamber is spent.
    async Task RailFire(PlayerShip sn, double hold = -1)
    {
        var key = Abilities.KeyFor(sn.Class, "railgun");
        KeyUp(key); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        sn.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; sn.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated; sn.ReloadView = default;
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        KeyDown(key);
        await Wait(hold >= 0 ? hold : sn.Cadence("rail_charge") + 0.1);
        KeyUp(key);
        for (int i = 0; i < 30 && !ActiveReload.Reloading(sn.Sl("railgun")); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
    }
    // THE SNIPER'S HOLD OF x0 IS ITS ANCHOR (the railgun's locked charge is gone; the row lands in kits6c-J8):
    // dropped (on) waits for the row to run; weighed (off) presses it again and waits out its release.
    async Task SniperAnchor(PlayerShip sn, bool on)
    {
        if (on) { sn.Sl("anchor").Left = 0; sn.Sl("anchor").Cool = 0; }
        sn.UseAbility("anchor", 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 && (sn.Sl("anchor").Left > 0) != on; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        if (!on) sn.Sl("anchor").Cool = 0;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE SNIPER'S RAILGUN AND ITS ACTIVE RELOAD, through Space (sniper_active_reload.md §6) ──
    // S1 the table against the ruling, once: reload 3.0 s, the spot 0.6 s from 1.2 to 1.8 s, x1.5, 120, a 0.8 s
    //   charge, 40% at once; hull 240, no guns, Space is the railgun, 180 every 3.8 s = 47.4 on the sheet.
    // Then three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, three gunships on the line 250-1000 u ahead),
    // each timed on the host's own reload from the frame it shows, never on the key:
    //   a fresh plain round let go after 0.4 s deals the ramp's 84 (40% + 60% x 0.5 of 120; S6), within two
    //   frames of the hold;
    //   A a timing stroke pressed at Vary(1.30, 1.70) s is PERFECT on the owner's view and the host's chamber
    //     with one rail_perfect cue (S2, S8); held on to 3.4 s it fires nothing; the chamber is not seated at
    //     2.95 s and is ENHANCED at 3.05 s (S5, S6); the next full charge deals 180 +- 0.5 to each of the three
    //     with one rail_enhanced report (S2, S6, S8);
    //   B run 0 a press at 1.15 s then one at 1.5 s, run 1 one at 0.9 s then 1.5 s, run 2 one at 1.85 s:
    //     MISSED and still MISSED, one rail_miss and no rail_perfect; seated plain, a full charge deals 120 (S3, S4, S8);
    //   C a perfect at 1.5 s and another press at 1.6 s: still PERFECT, one rail_perfect; ENHANCED, 180 (S4);
    //   D no press (runs 0, 1), or a press at 1.5 s from a wreck (run 2: the chamber stays EMPTY): seated
    //     plain, a full charge deals 120 (S9).
    // S7 (the Anchor's x2.5 on the whole bar) is LaneA6cAnchorChecks' (kits6c-J8).
    async Task LaneA6cReloadChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var r = ActiveReload.Rail;
        var (open, close) = ActiveReload.Spot(st, r);
        Check(st["rail_reload"] == 3.0 && Math.Abs(open * 3.0 - 1.2) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(close * 3.0 - 1.8) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs((close - open) * 3.0 - 0.6) < 1e-9
              && st["rail_perfect"] == 1.5 && st["rail_damage"] == 120 && Math.Abs(st["rail_charge"] - 0.8) < 1e-9 && st["rail_tap"] == 40
              && st["hull"] == 240 && !st.Def.Has(Fit.Guns) && !st.All.Any(x => x.Id == "rail_cooldown" || x.Id == "main_damage")
              && Abilities.TriggerOf(ShipClass.HeavySniper) == Ab.Railgun && Ab.Railgun.Default == global::Godot.Key.Space && Ab.Railgun.Reload == r
              && Math.Abs(st.SustainedDps - 120 * 1.5 / 3.8) < 1e-6,
              $"the Sniper's railgun rows: reload {st["rail_reload"]:0.0} s, the spot {(close - open) * 3.0:0.00} s from {open * 3.0:0.00} to {close * 3.0:0.00} s (0.6 of 3.0), x{st["rail_perfect"]:0.0}, {st["rail_damage"]:0} a line, a {st["rail_charge"]:0.0} s charge, {st["rail_tap"]:0}% at once; hull {st["hull"]:0} (240), no guns, Space; {st.SustainedDps:0.0} DPS (47.4)");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var sn = Me; var key = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "railgun");
        double full = sn.Cadence("rail_charge") + 0.1;
        Chamber Ch() => (Chamber)sn.Sl("railgun").N;
        bool Loading() => ActiveReload.Reloading(sn.Sl("railgun"));
        bool Seat() => ActiveReload.Seated(sn.Sl("railgun"));
        double El() => sn.Sl("railgun").Own - sn.Sl("railgun").Left;            // seconds into this reload, the host's own
        int Heard(string k) => Sfx.Played.GetValueOrDefault(k);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var spots = new[] { Vary(250f, 450f), Vary(520f, 720f), Vary(800f, 1000f) }
                .Select(d => at + nose * d + nose.Orthogonal() * Vary(-4f, 4f)).ToArray();
            var foes = spots.Select(p => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            void Pose() { sn.Position = at; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sn.Rotation = rot; for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k]; }
            async Task Until(Func<bool> done, int cap = 400) { for (int i = 0; i < cap && !done(); i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); } }
            async Task Hold(double secs) { double t0 = sn.Clock; await Until(() => sn.Clock - t0 >= secs); }
            // a charge stroke on the seated round, Space held `secs` and let go: what each foe lost, once the reload shows
            async Task<double[]> Shoot(double secs)
            {
                KeyUp(key); Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                var hp0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
                KeyDown(key); await Hold(secs); KeyUp(key);
                await Until(Loading, 30); Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                return foes.Select((f, k) => hp0[k] - f.Hp).ToArray();
            }
            // a timing stroke `t` s into the reload, held 0.05 s
            async Task PressAt(double t) { await Until(() => El() >= t || !Loading()); KeyDown(key); await Hold(0.05); KeyUp(key); Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            bool Each(double[] lost, double want, double tol) => lost.All(x => Math.Abs(x - want) <= tol);
            string L(double[] lost) => string.Join(" / ", lost.Select(x => x.ToString("0.0")));

            // a fresh plain round, let go after 0.4 s (24 frames): the ramp's 84 (two frames either way: +- 3.75)
            sn.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; sn.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated; sn.ReloadView = default;
            Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var tap = await Shoot(0.4);
            Check(Each(tap, 84, 3.75) && Loading() && Ch() == Chamber.Empty && Math.Abs(sn.Sl("railgun").Own - 3.0) < 1e-6,
                  $"a plain round let go after 0.4 s of its 0.8 s charge, heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: {L(tap)} to the three on the line (84: 40% + 60% x 0.5 of 120); the chamber EMPTY, a {sn.Sl("railgun").Own:0.00} s reload (3.0)");

            // A: the perfect press, held through the seat
            double p = Vary(1.30f, 1.70f); int tick0 = Heard("rail_perfect");
            await Until(() => El() >= p || !Loading());
            var hpA = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            KeyDown(key);
            await Until(() => Ch() != Chamber.Empty, 10);
            var verdict = Ch(); var said = sn.ReloadView.Said; double pressed = El();
            int ticks = Heard("rail_perfect") - tick0;
            double shotAt = sn.Clock - El();
            await Until(() => sn.Clock - shotAt >= 2.95); bool early = Seat();
            await Until(() => sn.Clock - shotAt >= 3.05); bool seated = Seat() && Ch() == Chamber.Enhanced;
            await Until(() => sn.Clock - shotAt >= 3.4); KeyUp(key);
            Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var heldLost = foes.Select((f, k) => hpA[k] - f.Hp).ToArray();
            Check(verdict == Chamber.Perfect && said == Verdict.Perfect && ticks == 1 && !early && seated && Ch() == Chamber.Enhanced && heldLost.All(x => x == 0),
                  $"a timing stroke at {pressed:0.00} s of the 3.0 s reload (drawn 1.30-1.70): the host's chamber {verdict}, the owner's view {said}, {ticks} rail_perfect cue; seated at 2.95 s: {early} (no), ENHANCED at 3.05 s: {seated}; held to 3.4 s it fired nothing ({L(heldLost)}), the round still {Ch()}");
            int rep0 = Heard("rail_enhanced");
            var hot = await Shoot(full);
            Check(Each(hot, 180, 0.5) && Heard("rail_enhanced") - rep0 == 1 && Ch() == Chamber.Empty,
                  $"the next stroke, a full charge on the enhanced round: {L(hot)} to each on the line (180 = 120 x 1.5), one rail_enhanced report ({Heard("rail_enhanced") - rep0}), the chamber spent");

            // B: outside the spot, and one press a reload
            double miss = run == 0 ? 1.15 : run == 1 ? 0.9 : 1.85;
            int click0 = Heard("rail_miss"), tickB = Heard("rail_perfect");
            await PressAt(miss); var first = Ch();
            if (run < 2) await PressAt(1.5);
            var second = Ch();
            await Until(Seat);
            var seatB = Ch();
            var plainB = await Shoot(full);
            Check(first == Chamber.Missed && second == Chamber.Missed && Heard("rail_miss") - click0 == 1 && Heard("rail_perfect") == tickB
                  && seatB == Chamber.Seated && Each(plainB, 120, 0.5),
                  $"a press at {miss:0.00} s is {first}{(run < 2 ? $", and one at 1.5 s after it leaves it {second}" : "")}; {Heard("rail_miss") - click0} rail_miss, {Heard("rail_perfect") - tickB} rail_perfect; it seats {seatB} and deals {L(plainB)} (120)");

            // C: a perfect, then another press: still one
            int tickC = Heard("rail_perfect");
            await PressAt(1.5); var c1 = Ch();
            await PressAt(1.6); var c2 = Ch();
            int ticksC = Heard("rail_perfect") - tickC;
            await Until(Seat);
            var seatC = Ch();
            var hotC = await Shoot(full);
            Check(c1 == Chamber.Perfect && c2 == Chamber.Perfect && ticksC == 1 && seatC == Chamber.Enhanced && Each(hotC, 180, 0.5),
                  $"a perfect at 1.5 s ({c1}) and a second press at 1.6 s ({c2}): {ticksC} rail_perfect; it seats {seatC} and deals {L(hotC)} (180)");

            // D: the round after an enhanced one, no press (or pressed from a wreck): plain
            var wreckSaid = Chamber.Empty;
            if (run == 2)
            {
                await Until(() => El() >= 1.0 || !Loading());
                sn.Restore(0, false, 50);
                await PressAt(1.5); wreckSaid = Ch();
                typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(sn, 0.0);
                sn.UseAbility("reboard", 0); await Wait(0.1); sn.Hp = sn.MaxHp;
            }
            await Until(Seat);
            var seatD = Ch();
            var plainD = await Shoot(full);
            Check(wreckSaid == Chamber.Empty && seatD == Chamber.Seated && Each(plainD, 120, 0.5) && sn.Alive,
                  $"the round after the enhanced one{(run == 2 ? $", pressed at 1.5 s from a wreck (the chamber stayed {wreckSaid})" : ", no press")}: seats {seatD}, deals {L(plainD)} (120)");

            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            KeyUp(key);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        sn.Position = yonder; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S ACTIVE RELOAD (sniper_active_reload.md §6 G1-G3). The guest
    // (LaneA6cReloadGuestChecks, right after its prism stance) flies a SNIPER at rest on a varied heading;
    // the host (LaneA6cReloadHostWatch, beside the lunge's watch) holds dummy 1 a varied 300-500 u down its
    // copy of the guest's nose and counts every blow. The guest fires five full charges: 1 plain; then G1
    // an honest press at Vary(1.35, 1.60) s on its own clock is PERFECT on its view at once, and the host's
    // report shows ENHANCED after the seat; G2 two lies of 0.5 sent straight to the host at 0.3 s and 1.5 s
    // into a reload are MISSED (clamped to the host's clock, one press a reload), so it seats plain; G3 a
    // claim of 7.0 at 0.3 s is MISSED, and on the next reload one of NaN at 1.5 s is judged on the host's
    // clock, PERFECT. The host asserts the five blows: 120, 180, 120, 120, 180, and saw ENHANCED on its copy.
    // G4 / G5 (a third pilot's claim on the guest's ship; what it sees and hears) need the host / guest /
    // guest2 scenario: owed (ledger kits6c).
    sealed class LaneA6cReloadSeen { public readonly List<double> Blows = new(); public bool Enhanced; public TargetDummy Dummy; public Vector2 Home; public float Off; public double Last; }
    LateSampler LaneA6cReloadHostWatch(LaneA6cReloadSeen seen)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.HeavySniper } g || seen.Blows.Count >= 5) return false;
            if (seen.Dummy == null)
            {
                seen.Dummy = H.GetNodeOrNull<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
                if (seen.Dummy == null) return false;
                seen.Home = seen.Dummy.Position; seen.Off = Vary(300f, 500f); seen.Last = seen.Dummy.Total;
            }
            seen.Dummy.Position = g.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(g.Rotation) * seen.Off;
            if (seen.Dummy.Total > seen.Last + 1e-6) seen.Blows.Add(seen.Dummy.Total - seen.Last);
            seen.Last = seen.Dummy.Total;
            seen.Enhanced |= g.Sl("railgun").N == (int)Chamber.Enhanced;
            return seen.Blows.Count >= 5;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6cReloadHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6cReloadSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Blows.Count >= 5, Wan ? 60 : 40);
        watch.QueueFree();
        if (seen.Dummy != null) seen.Dummy.Position = seen.Home;
        var want = new[] { 120.0, 180, 120, 120, 180 };
        bool ok = seen.Blows.Count >= 5 && want.Select((w, k) => Math.Abs(seen.Blows[k] - w) < 0.5).All(x => x);
        Check(ok && seen.Enhanced,
              $"arena host: the guest's railgun, {seen.Off:0} u down its nose -- blows {string.Join(" / ", seen.Blows.Select(b => b.ToString("0.0")))} (want 120 plain, 180 after its honest perfect press, 120 after two lies of 0.5, 120 after a claim of 7.0, 180 after a NaN claim at 1.5 s); ENHANCED read on this copy ({seen.Enhanced})");
    }
    async Task LaneA6cReloadGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 240) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);           // the host's word for the hull
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
        await Wait(Wan ? 1.5 : 0.8);
        var key = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "railgun");
        bool Ready() => ActiveReload.Seated(me.Sl("railgun")) && !me.ReloadView.Running;
        async Task Shot()
        {
            await RealTime(Ready, Wan ? 8 : 5);
            me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            KeyDown(key); await Wait(me.Cadence("rail_charge") + (Wan ? 0.35 : 0.25)); KeyUp(key);
            await RealTime(() => me.ReloadView.Running, 2);
        }
        async Task At(double t) => await RealTime(() => me.ReloadView.Since >= t || !me.ReloadView.Running, 4);
        await Shot();                                                                     // 1: plain, 120
        // G1: an honest press on its own clock
        double p = Vary(1.35f, 1.60f);
        await At(p);
        KeyDown(key);
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var said = me.ReloadView.Said; double since = me.ReloadView.Since;
        KeyUp(key);
        await RealTime(() => me.Sl("railgun").N == (int)Chamber.Enhanced, Wan ? 6 : 4);
        var g1 = (Chamber)me.Sl("railgun").N;
        Check(said == Verdict.Perfect && g1 == Chamber.Enhanced,
              $"arena guest: its own Space {since:0.00} s into the reload (drawn 1.35-1.60) is {said} on its bar at once, and the host's report seats it {g1}");
        await Shot();                                                                     // 2: enhanced, 180
        // G2: two lies of 0.5, straight to the host
        await At(0.3); me.AskReloadPress("railgun", 0.5f);
        await At(1.5); me.AskReloadPress("railgun", 0.5f);
        await RealTime(Ready, Wan ? 8 : 5);
        var g2 = (Chamber)me.Sl("railgun").N;
        await Shot();                                                                     // 3: plain, 120
        // G3: a claim of 7.0 early, then NaN in the spot on the next reload
        await At(0.3); me.AskReloadPress("railgun", 7.0f);
        await RealTime(Ready, Wan ? 8 : 5);
        var g3a = (Chamber)me.Sl("railgun").N;
        await Shot();                                                                     // 4: plain, 120
        await At(1.5); me.AskReloadPress("railgun", float.NaN);
        await RealTime(() => me.Sl("railgun").N == (int)Chamber.Enhanced, Wan ? 6 : 4);
        var g3b = (Chamber)me.Sl("railgun").N;
        await Shot();                                                                     // 5: enhanced, 180
        Check(g2 == Chamber.Seated && g3a == Chamber.Seated && g3b == Chamber.Enhanced,
              $"arena guest: two claims of 0.5 at 0.3 s and 1.5 s seat it {g2} (plain: clamped to the host's clock, one press a reload); 7.0 at 0.3 s seats it {g3a}; NaN at 1.5 s, judged on the host's clock, {g3b}");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE RELOAD BAR (sniper_active_reload.md §4.1-4.2), kits6c-J7 ──────────────────────────
    // Pure: Drop is half the hull on screen and 20 px (80 at zoom 1 for a 120 u hull) at three zooms; Wanted
    // through a reload, a charge, an enhanced round, under 0.6 s after the seat, and not past it. Then three varied
    // runs as the Sniper (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, Vary zoom 0.7-1.2): a round seated long ago shows no bar;
    // after a real shot the bar shows, 180 x 22, centred under the hull (+- 2 px) with its top Drop below the ship's
    // centre on screen, clear of the hull panel and the ability bar; still shown Vary(0.1, 0.45) s after the seat,
    // gone Vary(0.75, 1.1) s after it; shown again while an enhanced round waits. A Warrior (its Space row has no
    // Reload) holding Space never shows it.
    async Task LaneA6cReloadBarChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        bool dropOk = Math.Abs(ReloadBar.Drop(120f, 1f) - 80f) < 1e-4; string drops = "";
        foreach (var (len, z) in new[] { (120f, 1f), (Vary(60f, 100f), Vary(0.5f, 0.9f)), (Vary(130f, 200f), Vary(1.0f, 1.4f)) })
        { float d = ReloadBar.Drop(len, z); dropOk &= Math.Abs(d - (len * 0.5f * z + 20f)) < 1e-4; drops += $" {len:0} u at {z:0.00} -> {d:0.0} px;"; }
        var running = new ActiveReload.View { Running = true, Length = 3, Since = Vary(0.1f, 2.9f) };
        var charging = new ActiveReload.View { Charge = Vary(0.05f, 0.7f) };
        var idle = new ActiveReload.View();
        float soon = Vary(0.05f, 0.55f), late = Vary(0.65f, 9f);
        bool wantOk = ReloadBar.Wanted(running, (int)Chamber.Empty, 0) && ReloadBar.Wanted(charging, (int)Chamber.Seated, 5)
                   && ReloadBar.Wanted(idle, (int)Chamber.Enhanced, Vary(1f, 9f)) && ReloadBar.Wanted(idle, (int)Chamber.Seated, soon)
                   && !ReloadBar.Wanted(idle, (int)Chamber.Seated, late);
        Check(dropOk && wantOk, $"reload bar, pure: its top half the hull on screen and 20 px under the ship's centre ({drops} 80 at zoom 1 for 120 u); wanted reloading, charging, enhanced, {soon:0.00} s after the seat, not {late:0.00} s after (0.6)");

        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var sn = Me; var bar = Nodes<ReloadBar>().FirstOrDefault();
        Check(bar != null && bar.MouseFilter == Control.MouseFilterEnum.Ignore && bar.GetParent() is CanvasLayer, "reload bar: one on the HUD layer, taking no input");
        if (bar == null) return;
        float z0 = H.ZoomLevel;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); float zoom = Vary(0.7f, 1.2f);
            H.SetZoom(zoom);
            void Pose() { sn.Position = at; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sn.Rotation = rot; }
            async Task Until(Func<bool> done, int cap = 400) { for (int i = 0; i < cap && !done(); i++) { Pose(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); } }
            async Task Hold(double secs) { double t0 = sn.Clock; await Until(() => sn.Clock - t0 >= secs); }
            sn.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; sn.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated; sn.ReloadView = default;
            await Hold(0.9);
            bool quiet = !bar.Visible;
            await RailFire(sn);
            await Hold(0.2);                                                             // the camera settles on the held ship
            var ct = bar.GetViewport().GetCanvasTransform(); var sp = ct * sn.GlobalPosition;
            float drop = ReloadBar.Drop(sn.MyArt.Length, ct.Scale.Y);
            var r = bar.GetGlobalRect();
            var hull = Nodes<HullHud>().First().GetGlobalRect(); var ab = Nodes<AbilityBar>().First().GetGlobalRect();
            bool shown = bar.Visible && ActiveReload.Reloading(sn.Sl("railgun"));
            bool placed = Math.Abs(r.Size.X - 180) < 0.5f && Math.Abs(r.Size.Y - 22) < 0.5f && Math.Abs(r.GetCenter().X - sp.X) < 2f
                       && Math.Abs(r.Position.Y - (sp.Y + drop)) < 2f && r.Position.Y > sp.Y + sn.MyArt.Length * 0.5f * ct.Scale.Y;
            bool clearHud = !hull.Intersects(r) && !ab.Intersects(r);
            await Until(() => !ActiveReload.Reloading(sn.Sl("railgun")));
            float stay = Vary(0.1f, 0.45f), gone = Vary(0.75f, 1.1f);
            await Hold(stay); bool lingers = bar.Visible;
            await Hold(gone - stay); bool after = bar.Visible;
            sn.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Enhanced; await Hold(0.1); bool waits = bar.Visible;
            sn.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated;
            Check(quiet && shown && placed && clearHud && lingers && !after && waits,
                  $"reload bar run {run}, heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg, zoom {zoom:0.00}: hidden long seated {quiet}; shown reloading {shown}, {r.Size.X:0} x {r.Size.Y:0} (180 x 22) centred {r.GetCenter().X - sp.X:0.0} px off, top {r.Position.Y - sp.Y:0.0} px under the ship (want {drop:0.0}); clear of the hull panel and ability bar {clearHud}; {stay:0.00} s after the seat {lingers}, {gone:0.00} s after {after} (gone past 0.6); enhanced waiting {waits}");
        }
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
        var wk = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, "blade"); bool ever = false;
        KeyDown(wk);
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) { ever |= bar.Visible; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        KeyUp(wk);
        Check(!ever && Abilities.TriggerOf(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior)?.Reload == null, "reload bar: a Warrior holding Space (its blade row has no Reload) never shows it");
        H.SetZoom(z0);
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE SNIPER'S ANCHOR (the v1 Anchor, kits_v3 3.4; D50), kits6c-J8 ──────────────────────────
    // The rows once: up to 8 s, x2.5, reach x1.4, 0.3 s to weigh, 12 s; F, a hold of x0; the Sniper's ability 1.
    // Then three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading, a gunship Vary 3300-3450 u and one 2200-2400 u down
    // the nose), all through the keys:
    //   a reload started Vary(0.3, 1.2) s before the drop keeps its 3.0 s (seated 3.0 +- 0.05 s after its shot);
    //   anchored, W + Shift + D held 2 s move it under 1 u and turn it under 0.3 deg, and V is refused ANCHORED;
    //   S7: an anchored shot reloads in 1.2 s with the spot 0.48-0.72 s and a 0.32 s charge; a press at Vary 0.52-0.68 s
    //   is PERFECT (runs 0, 1), one at Vary 0.78-0.95 s MISSED (run 2); the full charge reaches the far gunship (3500 u);
    //   F again at a varied moment weighs it in 0.3 +- 0.05 s, still rooted inside the release (runs 0, 1), or it runs
    //   out 8.0 +- 0.05 s after the drop (run 2); either way the cooldown reads 12.0 and F is refused COOLING;
    //   weighed, a full charge reaches the near gunship (120) and not the far one (0: 2500 u).
    // The flares and the tether keeping it are theirs (kits6c-J9 / J10).
    async Task LaneA6cAnchorChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        Check(st["anchor_time"] == 8 && st["anchor_rate"] == 2.5 && Math.Abs(st["anchor_reach"] - 1.4) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(st["anchor_release"] - 0.3) < 1e-9
              && st["anchor_cooldown"] == 12 && Ab.Anchor.Default == global::Godot.Key.F && Ab.Anchor.Hold == 0 && Ab.Anchor.Stance is { Keeps: true }
              && Abilities.For(ShipClass.HeavySniper).Take(2).SequenceEqual(new[] { Ab.Railgun, Ab.Anchor }) && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavySniper, 1) == Ab.Anchor
              && Math.Abs(st["rail_range"] * st["anchor_reach"] - 3500) < 1e-6,
              $"the Anchor's rows: {st["anchor_time"]:0} s (8), x{st["anchor_rate"]:0.0} (2.5), reach x{st["anchor_reach"]:0.0} = {st["rail_range"] * st["anchor_reach"]:0} u (3500), weighs in {st["anchor_release"]:0.0} s (0.3), cooldown {st["anchor_cooldown"]:0} s (12); F, x0; ability 1 {Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavySniper, 1)?.Name}");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var sn = Me; sn.AutopilotTo = null;
        var key = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "railgun"); var fkey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "anchor");
        Chamber Ch() => (Chamber)sn.Sl("railgun").N;
        bool Loading() => ActiveReload.Reloading(sn.Sl("railgun"));
        double El() => sn.Sl("railgun").Own - sn.Sl("railgun").Left;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            sn.Position = at; sn.Rotation = rot; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            sn.Sl("anchor").Left = 0; sn.Sl("anchor").Cool = 0; sn.Sl("boost").Cool = 0;
            var spots = new[] { at + nose * Vary(3300f, 3450f) + nose.Orthogonal() * Vary(-4f, 4f), at + nose * Vary(2200f, 2400f) + nose.Orthogonal() * Vary(-4f, 4f) };
            var foes = spots.Select(p => { var f = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Gunship); f.Hp = 1e9; return f; }).ToArray();
            void Pin() { for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) foes[k].Position = spots[k]; }
            async Task Until(Func<bool> done, int cap = 600) { for (int i = 0; i < cap && !done(); i++) { Pin(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); } }
            async Task Hold(double secs) { double t0 = sn.Clock; await Until(() => sn.Clock - t0 >= secs); }
            double[] Hp() => foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToArray();
            string L(double[] a, double[] b) => $"{a[0] - b[0]:0.0} far / {a[1] - b[1]:0.0} near";
            // the rail through its key, the gunships held on the line every frame (RailFire's stroke)
            async Task Fire()
            {
                KeyUp(key); Pin(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                sn.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; sn.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated; sn.ReloadView = default;
                Pin(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                KeyDown(key); await Hold(sn.Cadence("rail_charge") + 0.1); KeyUp(key);
                await Until(Loading, 30);
            }
            sn.Hp = sn.MaxHp;
            await Hold(0.2);

            // a reload started before the drop keeps its length
            await Fire(); double shot = sn.Clock;
            await Hold(Vary(0.3f, 1.2f));
            await SniperAnchor(sn, true); double drop = sn.Clock; double ownThen = sn.Sl("railgun").Own;
            // rooted: W + Shift + D, 2 s
            var p0 = sn.Position; float r0 = sn.Rotation;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.D);
            await Hold(2.0);
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.D); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
            float moved = sn.Position.DistanceTo(p0), turned = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(r0, sn.Rotation)));
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var vSaid = sn.FailNote("boost"); bool vRan = sn.Sl("boost").Left > 0;
            await Until(() => !Loading());
            double seatedAfter = sn.Clock - shot;
            Check(Math.Abs(ownThen - 3.0) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(seatedAfter - 3.0) < 0.05 && moved < 1f && turned < 0.3f && vSaid == "ANCHORED" && !vRan && sn.Held == 0f,
                  $"anchor run {run} at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: the reload shot before the drop keeps {ownThen:0.00} s and seats {seatedAfter:0.00} s after its shot (3.0); W + Shift + D 2 s move it {moved:0.00} u and turn it {turned:0.00} deg (none); V is refused {vSaid} (ANCHORED), boost running {vRan}");

            // S7: the anchored reload, its spot and its charge; the reach
            var hp0 = Hp();
            await Fire();
            await Hold(0.05);
            var hp1 = Hp();
            double own = sn.Sl("railgun").Own, charge = sn.Cadence("rail_charge");
            var (open, close) = ActiveReload.Spot(sn.Stats, ActiveReload.Rail);
            double press = run < 2 ? Vary(0.52f, 0.68f) : Vary(0.78f, 0.95f);
            await Until(() => El() >= press || !Loading());
            double pressedAt = El();
            KeyDown(key); await Hold(0.05); KeyUp(key); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var verdict = Ch();
            await Until(() => !Loading());
            Check(Math.Abs(own - 1.2) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(open * own - 0.48) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(close * own - 0.72) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(charge - 0.32) < 1e-6
                  && verdict == (run < 2 ? Chamber.Perfect : Chamber.Missed) && Math.Abs(hp0[0] - hp1[0] - 120) < 0.5 && Math.Abs(hp0[1] - hp1[1] - 120) < 0.5,
                  $"anchored (S7): the reload {own:0.00} s (1.2), the spot {open * own:0.00}-{close * own:0.00} s (0.48-0.72), the charge {charge:0.00} s (0.32); a press at {pressedAt:0.00} s is {verdict} ({(run < 2 ? "PERFECT" : "MISSED")}); the full charge deals {L(hp0, hp1)} (120 / 120: 3500 u)");

            // the release (runs 0, 1) or the 8 s cap (run 2), then the cooldown from there
            bool rootedInRelease = true; double took, cool;
            if (run < 2)
            {
                await Hold(Vary(0f, 1.5f));
                Key(fkey); await Until(() => sn.Sl("anchor").Left <= 0.3 + 1e-6, 10);
                double rel = sn.Clock; bool cut = sn.Sl("anchor").Left <= 0.3 + 1e-6 && sn.Sl("anchor").Left > 0;
                await Until(() => { rootedInRelease &= sn.Sl("anchor").Left <= 0 || sn.Held == 0f; return sn.Sl("anchor").Left <= 0; });
                took = sn.Clock - rel; cool = sn.Sl("anchor").Cool;
                rootedInRelease &= cut;
            }
            else
            {
                await Until(() => sn.Sl("anchor").Left <= 0, 900);
                took = sn.Clock - drop; cool = sn.Sl("anchor").Cool;
            }
            Key(fkey); await Until(() => sn.FailNote("anchor") != null, 10);
            var fSaid = sn.FailNote("anchor");
            Check((run < 2 ? Math.Abs(took - 0.3) < 0.05 && rootedInRelease : Math.Abs(took - 8.0) < 0.05) && Math.Abs(cool - 12.0) < 0.05 && fSaid == "COOLING" && sn.Held == 1f,
                  run < 2 ? $"F again weighs the Anchor in {took:0.00} s (0.3), rooted through it {rootedInRelease}; the cooldown {cool:0.00} s from the release (12.0); F is refused {fSaid}"
                          : $"left alone the Anchor runs out {took:0.00} s after the drop (8.0); the cooldown {cool:0.00} s (12.0); F is refused {fSaid}");

            // weighed: the rail reaches 2500 u again
            await Until(() => ActiveReload.Seated(sn.Sl("railgun")));
            var hp2 = Hp();
            await Fire();
            await Hold(0.05);
            var hp3 = Hp();
            Check(hp2[0] - hp3[0] == 0 && Math.Abs(hp2[1] - hp3[1] - 120) < 0.5 && Math.Abs(sn.Sl("railgun").Own - 3.0) < 1e-6,
                  $"weighed, a full charge deals {L(hp2, hp3)} (0 past 2500 u / 120) and reloads in {sn.Sl("railgun").Own:0.00} s (3.0)");
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            sn.Sl("anchor").Cool = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        sn.Position = yonder; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: ZONES (Zones.cs), pure: a zone takes a body within its row's Reach of where it was laid, from
    // three varied spots and bearings, 1 u inside and 1 u outside the tether's 170 u (never on the edge itself).
    void LaneA6cZoneChecks()
    {
        var d = Zones.Of(Zones.Tether);
        Check(d.Id == "tether" && d.Reach == 170f && d.Arm == 0.5 && d.Holds == Status.Disabled && d.HoldFor == "tether_hold" && d.Most == "tether_most"
              && Zones.RowOf(d) == Zones.Tether && Spawns.All[Spawns.Zone].Id == "Zone" && Spawns.All[Spawns.Zone].Space == NetIds.Zone,
              $"the tether's zone row: {d.Reach:0} u (170), live {d.Arm:0.0} s after the drop (0.5), holds {d.Holds} for {d.HoldFor}; spawn row {Spawns.All[Spawns.Zone].Id}");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = new Vector2(Vary(-4000f, 4000f), Vary(-4000f, 4000f)); var way = Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float inside = Vary(165f, 169f), outside = Vary(171f, 176f);
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            bool a = Zones.Inside(d, at, rot, at + way * inside), b = Zones.Inside(d, at, rot, at + way * outside), c = Zones.Inside(d, at, rot, at);
            Check(a && !b && c, $"zone run {run}: a body {inside:0.0} u off is inside ({a}), {outside:0.0} u off is not ({b}), the centre is ({c})");
            // the curtain's BAR: 500 u along Right.Rotated(rot), 40 u either side, round at its ends
            var cz = Zones.Of(Zones.Curtain); var ax = Vector2.Right.Rotated(rot); var nrm = ax.Orthogonal();
            float along = Vary(-240f, 240f), side = Vary(35f, 39f), past = Vary(41f, 46f);
            bool bIn = Zones.Inside(cz, at, rot, at + ax * along + nrm * side), bOut = Zones.Inside(cz, at, rot, at + ax * along - nrm * past);
            bool capIn = Zones.Inside(cz, at, rot, at + ax * (250f + side)), capOut = Zones.Inside(cz, at, rot, at - ax * (250f + past));
            Check(bIn && !bOut && capIn && !capOut,
                  $"bar run {run} at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg: {side:0.0} u off its line is inside ({bIn}), {past:0.0} u is not ({bOut}); {side:0.0} u past an end inside ({capIn}), {past:0.0} u not ({capOut})");
        }
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE SNIPER'S TETHER MINE (kits_v2's card, v1; D45), through Q. The rows once (2 charges, 12 s
    // each, holds 3 s, 2 out, 170 u, Q, ability 2); then three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading; runs 1
    // and 2 anchored first, kits_v31 §7's "the flares and the tether keep it"):
    //   the mine lands at the stern; a boss inside it and a gunship 171-176 u off, 0.9 s after the drop, set nothing
    //   off; a gunship moved to 150-169 u sets it off in one frame, is held (DISABLED) 3.0 s and sits still, the
    //   boss and the far gunship are not held;
    //   a second mine laid over a gunship already inside goes off when it arms (0.5 s after the drop, not before);
    //   a third press is refused NO CHARGES; the first charge comes back 12.0 s after the first press (run 0 on
    //   the clock, runs 1-2 with the running recharge cut short) and the second starts its own 12 s;
    //   three mines laid with none set off leave two out, the oldest gone.
    async Task LaneA6cTetherChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        Check(st["tether_charges"] == 2 && st["tether_recharge"] == 12 && st["tether_hold"] == 3 && st["tether_most"] == 2 && Zones.Of(Zones.Tether).Reach == 170f
              && Ab.Tether.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q && Ab.Tether.Lays == Zones.Of(Zones.Tether)
              && Abilities.For(ShipClass.HeavySniper).Take(3).SequenceEqual(new[] { Ab.Railgun, Ab.Anchor, Ab.Tether }) && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavySniper, 2) == Ab.Tether,
              $"the tether's rows: {st["tether_charges"]:0} charges (2), {st["tether_recharge"]:0} s each (12), holds {st["tether_hold"]:0} s (3), {st["tether_most"]:0} out (2), {Zones.Of(Zones.Tether).Reach:0} u (170); Q; ability 2 {Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavySniper, 2)?.Name}");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var sn = Me; sn.AutopilotTo = null;
        var qkey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "tether");
        float half = Classes.Of(ShipClass.HeavySniper).Art.Length * 0.5f;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        void Clear() { foreach (var z in H.Laid.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Zone, z, burst: false, float.NaN); }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            Clear();
            sn.Position = at; sn.Rotation = rot; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sn.Hp = sn.MaxHp;
            sn.Sl("tether").N = 0; sn.Sl("tether").Cool = 0;
            await Frame();
            at = sn.Position; rot = sn.Rotation;                                   // re-taken after the wait
            void Still() { sn.Position = at; sn.Rotation = rot; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sn.Hp = sn.MaxHp; }
            bool anchored = run > 0;
            if (anchored) { await SniperAnchor(sn, true); Still(); }
            var stern = at + Vector2.Down.Rotated(rot) * half;

            double pressed = sn.Clock;                                              // timed from the frame the mine shows

            bool keptAnchor = !anchored || (sn.Sl("anchor").Left > 0 && sn.Sl("anchor").Cool == 0);
            float sternOff = mineA == null ? -1f : mineA.At.DistanceTo(stern);
            int spent1 = sn.Sl("tether").N; double cool1 = sn.Sl("tether").Cool;
            var aAt = mineA?.At ?? stern;
            var bossAt = aAt + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(40f, 120f);
            var farAt = aAt + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(171f, 176f);

            var post = new Boss { Hub = H, Position = bossAt,
                                  Type = new Missions.BossType { Id = "post", Name = "POST", Hull = 100000, Texture = bt.Texture, Length = bt.Length, HalfWidth = bt.HalfWidth,
                                                                 CloseSpeed = 0f, TurnRate = 0f, Moves = System.Array.Empty<BossMove>() } };
            AddChild(post);
            var far = H.SpawnRaider(farAt, Enemies.Gunship); far.Hp = 1e9;

            var nearAt = near.Position;
            void Pin() { Still(); post.Position = bossAt; far.Position = farAt; near.Position = nearAt; }
            for (int i = 0; i < 600 && mineA != null && mineA.Age < 0.9; i++) { Pin(); await Frame(); }
            bool aStill = mineA != null && H.Laid.Contains(mineA);
            bool bossHeld0 = post.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled), farHeld0 = far.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled);
            Check(mineA != null && sternOff < 2f && spent1 == 1 && Math.Abs(cool1 - 12.0) < 0.05 && keptAnchor && aStill && !bossHeld0 && !farHeld0,
                  $"tether run {run} at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg{(anchored ? ", anchored" : "")}: Q lays a mine {sternOff:0.0} u from the stern (0), 1 charge spent ({spent1}), the recharge {cool1:0.00} s (12.0); the Anchor kept {keptAnchor}; 0.9 s on, a boss {bossAt.DistanceTo(aAt):0} u in and a gunship {farAt.DistanceTo(aAt):0} u off leave it laid ({aStill}), held: boss {bossHeld0}, gunship {farHeld0}");

            // 2 -- a gunship at 150-169 u sets it off: held 3.0 s, still; the boss and the far one are not
            nearAt = aAt + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 169f);
            int frames = 0;
            for (; frames < 10 && mineA != null && H.Laid.Contains(mineA); frames++) { Pin(); await Frame(); }
            double t0 = sn.Clock; var heldAt = near.Position;
            bool held = near.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled), bossHeld = post.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled), farHeld = far.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled);
            for (int i = 0; i < 400 && near.Statuses.Has(Status.Disabled); i++)
            { Still(); post.Position = bossAt; far.Position = farAt; await Frame(); }
            double heldFor = sn.Clock - t0; float drift = near.Position.DistanceTo(heldAt);
            Check(frames <= 2 && held && !bossHeld && !farHeld && Math.Abs(heldFor - 3.0) < 0.05 && drift < 2f,
                  $"...a gunship {nearAt.DistanceTo(aAt):0.0} u off sets it off in {frames} frame(s) and is held {heldFor:0.00} s (3.0), drifting {drift:0.0} u; held: boss {bossHeld}, the one {farAt.DistanceTo(aAt):0.0} u off {farHeld}");
            post.QueueFree(); near.TakeDamage(1e12); far.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Frame();

            // 3 -- a mine laid over a gunship already inside goes off as it arms, not before
            Still(); stern = at + Vector2.Down.Rotated(rot) * half;
            var inAt = stern + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(30f, 150f);
            var sitter = H.SpawnRaider(inAt, Enemies.Gunship); sitter.Hp = 1e9;

                  $"...a second mine over a gunship {inAt.DistanceTo(stern):0} u in goes off at {lastAge:0.00} s (arms at 0.5), holding it {sat}; 2 spent ({spent2}); a third Q is refused {said} (NO CHARGES), {laid3} laid");
            sitter.TakeDamage(1e12);

                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 14 && sn.Sl("tether").N > 1; i++) { Still(); await Frame(); }

            double back = sn.Clock - pressed + (12.0 - cool1); int spent3 = sn.Sl("tether").N; double cool3 = sn.Sl("tether").Cool;
            Check(spent3 == 1 && Math.Abs(back - 12.0) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(cool3 - 12.0) < 0.05,
                  $"...the first charge back {back:0.00} s after the first press (12.0), 1 spent ({spent3}); the second recharging {cool3:0.00} s (12.0)");

            if (anchored) await SniperAnchor(sn, false);

            Check(oldestGone && H.Laid.Count == 2,
                  $"...three mines laid ({laid.Count}) leave {H.Laid.Count} out (2), the oldest gone {oldestGone}");
            Clear(); sn.Sl("tether").N = 0; sn.Sl("tether").Cool = 0;
            await Frame();
        }
        sn.Position = yonder; sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE SNIPER'S FLARES THROUGH E (kits_v2's card and Proves; D51). The rows once (16 s, E, ability 3);
    // then three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle heading; runs 1 and 2 anchored first -- kits_v31 §7, the
    // flares keep the Anchor, and kits_v2's "anchored, every flare is 180 u off the hull"): a seeker launched at the
    // pilot 700-900 u off, E pressed 0-0.4 s later: the salvo stands on the hull, the first flare astern, the
    // cooldown 16.0 s, E again refused COOLING with one salvo out, the Anchor still down; a raid missile marked on
    // the pilot 0.7 s after the pop moves onto a flare; a held webifier 130-148 u out from a flare is DAZZLED;
    // the seeker bursts on a flare; the pilot takes 0 from all of it.
    async Task LaneA6cFlaresChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        Check(st["flare_cooldown"] == 16 && Ab.Flares.Default == global::Godot.Key.E && Ab.Flares.Pops == Decoys.Of(Decoys.Flares)
              && Abilities.For(ShipClass.HeavySniper).Take(4).SequenceEqual(new[] { Ab.Railgun, Ab.Anchor, Ab.Tether, Ab.Flares }) && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavySniper, 3) == Ab.Flares,
              $"the flares' rows: cooldown {st["flare_cooldown"]:0} s (16); E; the flares row; ability 3 {Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavySniper, 3)?.Name}");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var pm = Me; bool demo = pm.Demo; pm.Demo = true; pm.AutopilotTo = null;
        var ekey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "flares");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        foreach (var sv in H.Salvos.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Decoy, sv, burst: false, float.NaN);
        await Wait(0.3);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            pm.Position = at; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
            pm.Sl("flares").Cool = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            at = pm.Position; rot = pm.Rotation;                                   // re-taken after the wait
            bool anchored = run > 0;
            if (anchored) await SniperAnchor(pm, true);
            double hp0 = pm.Hp, low = pm.Hp;
            var from = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(700f, 900f);
            var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, from, at - from, 135f, 4000f, 25, targetId: pm.NetId, turnRate: 2f, hull: 1e9);
            async Task Frames(double seconds)
            {
                double t = pm.Clock + seconds;
                do { pm.Position = at; pm.Rotation = rot; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; low = Math.Min(low, pm.Hp); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                while (pm.Clock < t);
            }
            await Frames(Vary(0f, 0.4f));
            Key(ekey);
            DecoySalvo salvo = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < 10 && salvo == null; i++) { await Frames(0); salvo = H.Salvos.LastOrDefault(); }
            double cool = pm.Sl("flares").Cool;
            bool kept = !anchored || pm.Sl("anchor").Left > 0;
            Key(ekey); await Frames(0); await Frames(0);
            string again = pm.FailNote("flares"); int salvos = H.Salvos.Count;
            var rest = salvo?.Resting ?? System.Array.Empty<Vector2>();
            bool onHull = salvo != null && salvo.At.DistanceTo(at) < 1f && Math.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(salvo.Rot, rot)) < 0.01f
                          && rest.Length == 6 && (rest[0] - at).Normalized().Dot(Vector2.Down.Rotated(rot)) > 0.999f && rest.All(p => Math.Abs(p.DistanceTo(at) - 180f) < 5f);
            Check(onHull && Math.Abs(cool - 16.0) < 0.05 && again == "COOLING" && salvos == 1 && kept,
                  $"flares run {run} at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0} deg{(anchored ? ", anchored" : "")}: E pops 6 flares 180 u round the hull, the first astern ({onHull}); cooldown {cool:0.00} s (16.0); E again {again} (COOLING), {salvos} salvo out; the Anchor kept {kept}");

            await Frames(0.7);
            int k = (int)Vary(0f, 5.99f);
            var outK = rest.Length == 6 ? (rest[k] - at).Normalized() : Vector2.Up;
            var web = H.SpawnRaider((rest.Length == 6 ? rest[k] : at) + outK * Vary(130f, 148f)); web.Hp = 1e9; web.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            int m1 = H.ThrowMissile(new MissileSpec { Side = Missiles.Raid, Damage = 42, Blast = 90f, Flight = Vary(2f, 3f) },
                                    at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 1500f, at, 0);
            await Frames(0.1);
            var markAt = H.Blasts.Where(b => b.id == m1).Select(b => b.at).DefaultIfEmpty(new Vector2(float.NaN, float.NaN)).First();
            bool moved = rest.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(markAt) < 1f), dazzled = web.Statuses.Has(Status.Dazzled);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && (sk.Alive || H.BlastsPending > 0); i++) await Frames(0);
            bool lured = !sk.Alive && sk.DecoyPoint is { } lp && rest.Any(p => p.DistanceTo(lp) < 1f);
            Check(moved && dazzled && lured && low >= hp0 - 1e-6,
                  $"...a raid missile marked on the pilot moves onto a flare ({moved}); a held webifier {web.Position.DistanceTo(rest.Length == 6 ? rest[k] : at):0} u from one is dazzled ({dazzled}); the seeker from {from.DistanceTo(at):0} u bursts on a flare ({lured}); the pilot took {hp0 - low:0.0} (0)");
            web.TakeDamage(1e12);
            if (anchored) await SniperAnchor(pm, false);
            foreach (var sv in H.Salvos.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Decoy, sv, burst: false, float.NaN);
            pm.Sl("flares").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        pm.Demo = demo; pm.Position = yonder; pm.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; pm.Hp = pm.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S FLARES (kits_v31 §8's second-run list). The guest, still a Sniper, turned to a
