    // ── SLICE 6c: THE WARDEN'S PROXIMITY FLAK (kits_v2's card; D43). The rows once: hull 270, 22.5 every 0.5 s (45 DPS
    // on the sheet), 700 u, the class fires Shots.All "flak" (fuse 70 u, x0.75 on a Boss tag). Then three varied runs
    // (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle bearing), each round the class's own spec through Combat.Fire (Turret.Shoot's call):
    //   a gunship whose hull passes 62-69 u off the line takes 22.5 and the round goes no further; one 71-78 u off,
    //   nearer along the line, takes 0; a round with nothing near bursts 700 u out (within one step);
    //   a boss post's hull 30-60 u off the line takes 16.875 (22.5 x 0.75);
    //   and through the key: Space held on a held gunship 300-450 u off deals 22.5 a burst, the fifth burst 2.0 s
    //   after the first (timed from the first burst that lands).
    async Task LaneA6cFlakChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavyWarden); var fk = Shots.Of(Shots.Flak);
        Check(st["hull"] == 270 && st["main_damage"] == 22.5 && st["main_interval"] == 0.5 && st["main_range"] == 700 && Math.Abs(st["main_damage"] / st["main_interval"] - 45) < 1e-9
              && Classes.Of(ShipClass.HeavyWarden).Shot == Shots.Flak && fk.Id == "flak" && fk.Fuse == 70f && fk.Resists == Tag.Boss && fk.ResistShare == 0.75,
              $"the Warden's rows: hull {st["hull"]:0} (270), {st["main_damage"]:0.0} every {st["main_interval"]:0.0} s = {st["main_damage"] / st["main_interval"]:0} DPS (45), {st["main_range"]:0} u (700); flak fuse {fk.Fuse:0} u (70), x{fk.ResistShare:0.00} on a {fk.Resists} (0.75)");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        var wd = Me; bool demo = wd.Demo; wd.Demo = true; wd.AutopilotTo = null;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.2);
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        Raider Held(Vector2 at) { var g = H.SpawnRaider(at, Enemies.Gunship); g.Hp = 1e9; g.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return g; }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
            await Frame();
            at = wd.Position;                                                      // re-taken after the wait
            void Still() { wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; }
            var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()); var side = way.Orthogonal() * (Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? 1f : -1f);
            var gun = wd.Spec(false);
            // 1 -- the fuse: 62-69 u off the hull bursts, 71-78 u does not
            var probe = Held(at + way * 5000f); float r0 = probe.HitRadius; probe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            float offNear = Vary(71f, 78f), offFar = Vary(62f, 69f);
            var passAt = at + way * Vary(200f, 280f) + side * (r0 + offNear);
            var hitAt = at + way * Vary(450f, 560f) - side * (r0 + offFar);
            var pass = Held(passAt); var hit = Held(hitAt);
            await Frame();
            double p0 = pass.Hp, h0 = hit.Hp;
            var round = Combat.Fire(gun.Kind, at, way, gun.ShellSpeed, gun.Range, gun.Damage, source: wd);
            Vector2 last = at;
            for (int i = 0; i < 120 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(round) && round.Alive; i++) { last = round.GlobalPosition; Still(); pass.Position = passAt; hit.Position = hitAt; await Frame(); }
            float burstAlong = (last - at).Dot(way);
            Check(Math.Abs(h0 - hit.Hp - 22.5) < 1e-6 && p0 == pass.Hp && burstAlong < (hitAt - at).Dot(way) + 1f,
                  $"flak run {run}: a gunship {offFar:0.0} u off the line takes {h0 - hit.Hp:0.00} (22.5), the round bursting {burstAlong:0} u out beside it; one {offNear:0.0} u off takes {p0 - pass.Hp:0.00} (0)");
            pass.TakeDamage(1e12); hit.TakeDamage(1e12);

            // 2 -- nothing near: it bursts at its 700 u
            var lone = Combat.Fire(gun.Kind, at, way.Rotated(Vary(2.2f, 4.0f)), gun.ShellSpeed, gun.Range, gun.Damage, source: wd);
            Vector2 lonely = at;
            for (int i = 0; i < 150 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(lone) && lone.Alive; i++) { lonely = lone.GlobalPosition; Still(); await Frame(); }
            float flew = lonely.DistanceTo(at);
            // 3 -- a boss x0.75
            var bt = Missions.Bosses[0];
            float bossOff = Vary(30f, 60f);
            var bossAt = at + way * Vary(380f, 480f) + side * (bt.HalfWidth + bossOff);
            var post = new Boss { Hub = H, Position = bossAt, Rotation = Aim.Along(way),
                                  Type = new Missions.BossType { Id = "post", Name = "POST", Hull = 100000, Texture = bt.Texture, Length = bt.Length, HalfWidth = bt.HalfWidth,
                                                                 CloseSpeed = 0f, TurnRate = 0f, Moves = System.Array.Empty<BossMove>() } };
            AddChild(post);
            await Frame();
            double b0 = post.Hp;
            var atBoss = Combat.Fire(gun.Kind, at, way, gun.ShellSpeed, gun.Range, gun.Damage, source: wd);
            for (int i = 0; i < 120 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(atBoss) && atBoss.Alive; i++) { Still(); post.Position = bossAt; post.Rotation = Aim.Along(way); await Frame(); }
            double bossTook = b0 - post.Hp;
            post.QueueFree();
            Check(flew >= 700f - 1e-3f && flew < 700f + gun.ShellSpeed / 30f && Math.Abs(bossTook - 16.875) < 1e-6,
                  $"...a round with nothing near bursts {flew:0} u out (700, within a step); a boss whose side lies about {bossOff:0} u off the line takes {bossTook:0.000} (16.875 = 22.5 x 0.75)");

            // 4 -- through the key: 22.5 a burst, 0.5 s apart
            var mark = Held(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 450f)); var markAt = mark.Position;
            wd.AimPoint = markAt;
            for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++) { Still(); mark.Position = markAt; wd.AimPoint = markAt; await Frame(); }   // the barrel swings on
            var gunKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, "guns");
            double m0 = mark.Hp; var hits = new List<(double t, double took)>();
            KeyDown(gunKey);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && hits.Count < 5; i++)
            {
                Still(); mark.Position = markAt; wd.AimPoint = markAt;
                await Frame();
                if (mark.Hp < m0 - 1e-9) { hits.Add((wd.Clock, m0 - mark.Hp)); m0 = mark.Hp; }
            }
            KeyUp(gunKey);
            double span = hits.Count == 5 ? hits[4].t - hits[0].t : -1;
            Check(hits.Count == 5 && hits.All(h => Math.Abs(h.took - 22.5) < 1e-6) && Math.Abs(span - 2.0) < 0.05,
                  $"...Space on a gunship {markAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off: {hits.Count} bursts of {string.Join("/", hits.Select(h => h.took.ToString("0.0")))} (22.5 each), the fifth {span:0.00} s after the first (2.0: 45 DPS)");
            mark.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Frame();
        }
        wd.Demo = demo; wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE HUNTERS' PREY ORDER (kits_v2's Warden card): raiders latched on a friendly hull (the Warden
    // included) first, then the nearest. Three varied runs: a webifier 250-400 u off latches on the Warden; two held
    // gunships stand nearer (120-200 u); the cell's prey reads the webifier first, then the gunships nearest first,
    // and F puts two of the six on the webifier (6 over 3, the first on it).
    async Task LaneA6cHunterPreyChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        var wd = Me; wd.AutopilotTo = null;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.2);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; wd.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            at = wd.Position;                                                      // re-taken after the wait
            var web = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 400f), Enemies.Webifier);
            web.Hp = 1e9; web.Quarry = wd;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !web.Latched; i++) { wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            var gs = new[] { Vary(120f, 150f), Vary(160f, 200f) }.Select(d => { var g = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * d, Enemies.Gunship); g.Hp = 1e9; g.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30); return g; }).ToArray();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var prey = wd.SeekerPrey();                                           // taken after the wait
            bool order = web.Latched && prey.Count == 3 && ReferenceEquals(prey[0], web)
                         && prey[1].Position.DistanceTo(at) <= prey[2].Position.DistanceTo(at) && prey.Skip(1).All(p => gs.Contains(p));
            wd.UseAbility("hunters", 0);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var cell = InFlight().Where(t => !t.HostileFire && t.Source == wd).ToList();
            int onWeb = cell.Count(t => t.TargetId == web.NetId);
            Check(order && cell.Count == 6 && onWeb == 2,
                  $"hunter prey run {run}: a webifier latched {web.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off ({web.Latched}) comes before gunships at {gs[0].Position.DistanceTo(at):0} / {gs[1].Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u, nearest next ({order}); F puts {onWeb} of {cell.Count} on it (2 of 6)");
            web.TakeDamage(1e12); foreach (var g in gs) g.TakeDamage(1e12);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && InFlight().Any(t => !t.HostileFire && t.Source == wd); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            wd.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
        }
        wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE WARDEN'S TAUNT THROUGH Q (kits_v2's Beacon Proves under the new name, kits_v3's 33% guard; D52).
    // The rows once (6 s, 1000 u, x1.5, x0.67, 20 s, Q, ability 2). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle
    // bearings), two sentries of no gun standing as other quarries (one 2400-2800 u off, one 850-950 u off):
    //   a webifier standing 975-995 u off, hunting the far sentry, is called within 3 frames of the press and
    //   comes for the Warden; one 1005-1025 u off hunting the same stays on it; one 1300-1500 u off hunting the near
    //   sentry is called; the cooldown is 20.0 s and Q again is refused TAUNTING;
    //   a 30 blow 0.3-0.7 s in and 5.7-5.9 s in takes 20.1 off the hull, one 6.1-6.4 s in takes 30;
    //   a flak round deals 33.75 to the called webifier and 22.5 to the one not called;
    //   6.1-6.4 s in the called one is back on its own quarry.
    async Task LaneA6cTauntChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        Check(st["taunt_time"] == 6 && st["taunt_reach"] == 1000 && st["taunt_mult"] == 1.5 && st["taunt_guard"] == 0.67 && st["taunt_cooldown"] == 20
              && Ab.Taunt.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, 1) == Ab.Hunters && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, 2) == Ab.Taunt
              && new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper)["taunt_mult"] == 0,
              $"the Taunt's rows: {st["taunt_time"]:0} s (6), {st["taunt_reach"]:0} u (1000), x{st["taunt_mult"]:0.0} on the called (1.5), x{st["taunt_guard"]:0.00} taken (0.67), {st["taunt_cooldown"]:0} s (20); Q; ability 2 {Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, 2)?.Name}; a class without the row has none");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        var wd = Me; bool demo = wd.Demo; wd.Demo = true; wd.AutopilotTo = null;
        var qkey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, "taunt");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.2);
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0;
            wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            await Frame();
            at = wd.Position;                                                      // re-taken after the wait
            float a1 = VaryAngle();
            var farS = H.Drop(wd, at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1 + Mathf.Pi + Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f)) * Vary(2400f, 2800f), 1e9);
            var nearS = H.Drop(wd, at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1 + Mathf.Pi / 2 + Vary(-0.3f, 0.3f)) * Vary(850f, 950f), 1e9);
            var inAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1) * Vary(975f, 995f);
            var outAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1 + Vary(0.5f, 0.9f)) * Vary(1005f, 1025f);
            var huntAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a1 - Mathf.Pi / 2 + Vary(-0.3f, 0.3f)) * Vary(1300f, 1500f);
            Raider Web(Vector2 p, Node2D quarry) { var w = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Webifier); w.Hp = 1e9; w.Quarry = quarry; return w; }
            var inW = Web(inAt, farS); var outW = Web(outAt, farS); var huntW = Web(huntAt, nearS);
            void Pin() { wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; inW.Position = inAt; outW.Position = outAt; huntW.Position = huntAt; }
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { Pin(); await Frame(); }
            bool before = inW.CalledBy == null && ReferenceEquals(inW.Target, farS) && ReferenceEquals(huntW.Target, nearS);
            Key(qkey);
            int frames = 0;
            for (; frames < 6 && !wd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened); frames++) { Pin(); await Frame(); }
            double tp = wd.Clock;                                                  // timed from the frame the guard shows
            Pin(); await Frame();
            bool inCalled = ReferenceEquals(inW.CalledBy, wd) && ReferenceEquals(inW.Target, wd), outFree = outW.CalledBy == null && ReferenceEquals(outW.Target, farS);
            bool huntCalled = ReferenceEquals(huntW.CalledBy, wd);
            double cool = wd.Sl("taunt").Cool, left = wd.Sl("taunt").Left;
            Key(qkey); Pin(); await Frame(); Pin(); await Frame();
            string again = wd.FailNote("taunt");
            Check(before && frames <= 3 && inCalled && outFree && huntCalled && Math.Abs(cool - 20.0) < 0.1 && left > 5.8 && again == "TAUNTING",
                  $"taunt run {run}: Q -- a webifier {inAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off is called ({inCalled}), one {outAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off stays on its quarry ({outFree}), one {huntAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off hunting a sentry {nearS.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off is called ({huntCalled}); guard in {frames} frame(s); cooldown {cool:0.00} s (20), {left:0.00} s up; Q again {again} (TAUNTING)");

            async Task Until(double t) { while (wd.Clock < t) { Pin(); await Frame(); } }
            double Blow(string tag) { double h0 = wd.Hp; wd.Hit(30, wd.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 200f, "taunt_probe:" + tag + run); return h0 - wd.Hp; }
            await Until(tp + Vary(0.3f, 0.7f));
            double early = Blow("early"); wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
            // the x1.5, through a flak round each: the called takes 33.75, the free one 22.5
            var gun = wd.Spec(false);
            double i0 = inW.Hp, o0 = outW.Hp;
            var way1 = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()); var way2 = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            var r1 = Combat.Fire(gun.Kind, inAt - way1 * 250f, way1, gun.ShellSpeed, gun.Range, gun.Damage, source: wd);
            var r2 = Combat.Fire(gun.Kind, outAt - way2 * 250f, way2, gun.ShellSpeed, gun.Range, gun.Damage, source: wd);
            for (int i = 0; i < 90 && ((GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r1) && r1.Alive) || (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r2) && r2.Alive)); i++) { Pin(); await Frame(); }
            double inTook = i0 - inW.Hp, outTook = o0 - outW.Hp;
            await Until(tp + Vary(5.7f, 5.9f));
            double late = Blow("late"); wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
            await Until(tp + Vary(6.1f, 6.4f));
            double after = Blow("after"); wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
            bool back = inW.CalledBy == null && ReferenceEquals(inW.Target, farS) && !wd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened);
            Check(Math.Abs(early - 20.1) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(late - 20.1) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(after - 30) < 0.01
                  && Math.Abs(inTook - 33.75) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(outTook - 22.5) < 1e-6 && back,
                  $"...a 30 blow takes {early:0.00} early and {late:0.00} late (20.1), {after:0.00} after 6 s (30); a flak round deals {inTook:0.00} to the called (33.75) and {outTook:0.00} to the free one (22.5); after 6 s the called is back on its quarry ({back})");
            foreach (var w in new[] { inW, outW, huntW }) w.TakeDamage(1e12);
            H.DeployedTaken(farS); H.DeployedTaken(nearS);
            wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        // PART 2 -- A STANDOFF HEAVY (cards/warden.md Taunt: "standoff heavies boost in at once instead of waiting at
        // range"). Three varied runs: a Gunship 600-900 u off at a bearing within 0.5 rad of a sentry 2400-2800 u off (its
        // Quarry), held there until its squad has committed on that sentry and 2.2-2.6 s have run (its first throw's
        // clock is spent); Q -- within 3.0 s of the frame the guard shows a raider missile is thrown at the Warden
        // although no web ever pins it, and on the frame its squad re-commits on the Warden that commit burns.
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0;
            wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            await Frame();
            at = wd.Position;                                                      // re-taken after the wait
            var farS = H.Drop(wd, at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(2400f, 2800f), 1e9);
            var gAt = at + (farS.Position - at).Normalized().Rotated(Vary(-0.5f, 0.5f)) * Vary(600f, 900f);
            var g = H.SpawnRaider(gAt, Enemies.Gunship); g.Hp = 1e9; g.Quarry = farS;
            void Hold() { wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; }
            double t0 = wd.Clock, settle = Vary(2.2f, 2.6f);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12 && !(g.Squad != null && g.Squad.Posted(g) && ReferenceEquals(g.Squad.Target, farS) && wd.Clock - t0 >= settle); i++)
            { Hold(); g.Position = gAt; await Frame(); }
            var sq = g.Squad;                                                      // taken after the wait
            // A RAIDER'S MISSILE IS A THROW (Hub.ThrowMissile): a blast predicted onto where the Warden will be, marked by the
            // Raid row's warning circle there -- the held Warden's own spot
            int Thrown() => Fx.Warnings.Count(fw => fw.Id == Missiles.Of(Missiles.Raid).Mark && fw.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 60f);
            int thrown0 = Thrown();
            bool onSentry = sq != null && sq.Posted(g) && ReferenceEquals(sq.Target, farS) && thrown0 == 0;
            float gOff = g.Position.DistanceTo(at);
            Key(qkey);
            int frames = 0;
            for (; frames < 6 && !wd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened); frames++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double tp = wd.Clock;                                                  // timed from the frame the guard shows
            bool pinnedEver = false, missile = false; int burnt = -1;              // -1: never re-committed on the Warden
            double missileAt = -1;
            while (wd.Clock - tp < 3.0 && !(missile && burnt >= 0))
            {
                Hold(); await Frame();
                pinnedEver |= wd.Pinned;
                sq = g.Squad;
                if (burnt < 0 && sq != null && sq.Posted(g) && ReferenceEquals(sq.Target, wd)) burnt = sq.Burning ? 1 : 0;
                if (!missile && Thrown() > thrown0) { missile = true; missileAt = wd.Clock - tp; }
            }
            Check(onSentry && frames <= 3 && missile && !pinnedEver && burnt == 1,
                  $"taunt standoff run {run}: a gunship {gOff:0} u off, committed on a sentry {farS.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off ({onSentry}); Q -- a missile at the Warden {(missile ? $"{missileAt:0.00} s" : "never")} after the guard (within 3.0 s), the Warden never pinned ({!pinnedEver}); the re-commit on the Warden burns ({(burnt < 0 ? "never re-committed" : (burnt == 1).ToString())})");
            g.TakeDamage(1e12); H.DeployedTaken(farS);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && Thrown() > 0; i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        wd.Demo = demo; wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE TAUNT PULLS A LATCHED WEBBER OFF, AND ITS SLOT (kits_v31 §7: the Taunt is the Warden's web answer;
    // kits_v3 §3.5: "webbers let go and post on the Warden", "The slot reads TAUNT 4.2 s -33%"; kits_v2 Proves: a raider
    // latched on an ally lets go within 0.25 s). Three varied runs (VaryNear spot; a sentry dropped 450-750 u off at a
    // VaryAngle bearing, the webifier 200-350 u from it at another): the webifier LATCHED on the sentry (its Target, no
    // call on it); Q -- the guard in 3 frames, Latched false within 0.25 s of the frame the guard shows, then CalledBy and
    // Target the Warden; the slot lit and reading "TAUNT <Left>s  -33%" on the guard's frame and 0.3-0.6 s later.
    async Task LaneA6cTauntLatchChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        var wd = Me; bool demo = wd.Demo; wd.Demo = true; wd.AutopilotTo = null;
        var qkey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, "taunt");
        var taunt = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, "taunt");
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await Wait(0.2);
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        bool Reads(SlotState st, double left) => st.Lit && st.Line == $"TAUNT {left:0.0}s  -33%";
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0;
            wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            await Frame();
            at = wd.Position;                                                      // re-taken after the wait
            var sentryAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(450f, 750f);
            var sentry = H.Drop(wd, sentryAt, 1e9);
            var web = H.SpawnRaider(sentryAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 350f), Enemies.Webifier);
            web.Hp = 1e9; web.Quarry = sentry;
            void Hold() { wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !web.Latched; i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            bool latched = web.Latched && ReferenceEquals(web.Target, sentry) && web.CalledBy == null;
            float off = web.Position.DistanceTo(at);
            Key(qkey);
            int frames = 0;
            for (; frames < 6 && !wd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened); frames++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double tp = wd.Clock;                                                  // timed from the frame the guard shows
            var st0 = taunt.State(wd, null); double left0 = wd.Sl("taunt").Left;
            double letGo = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++)
            {
                if (!web.Latched) { letGo = wd.Clock - tp; break; }
                Hold(); await Frame();
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            bool called = ReferenceEquals(web.CalledBy, wd) && ReferenceEquals(web.Target, wd);
            double tMid = tp + Vary(0.3f, 0.6f);
            while (wd.Clock < tMid) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            var st1 = taunt.State(wd, null); double left1 = wd.Sl("taunt").Left;
            Check(latched && frames <= 3 && letGo >= 0 && letGo <= 0.25 && called,
                  $"taunt latch run {run}: a webifier latched on a sentry {sentryAt.DistanceTo(at):0} u off, itself {off:0} u off ({latched}); Q -- the guard in {frames} frame(s), the latch let go {(letGo < 0 ? "never" : $"{letGo:0.000} s")} after it (0.25 at most); called onto the Warden and its target ({called})");
            Check(Reads(st0, left0) && Reads(st1, left1) && left1 < left0,
                  $"taunt slot run {run}: '{st0.Line}' on the guard's frame ({left0:0.00} s up), '{st1.Line}' {tMid - tp:0.00} s on ({left1:0.00} s up): lit, TAUNT <time>s  -33%");
            web.TakeDamage(1e12);
            H.DeployedTaken(sentry);
            wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0; wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        wd.Demo = demo; wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c: THE TAUNT DRAWS THE EMPLACEMENT GUNS (kits_v3 §3.5 card: "emplacement guns prefer the Warden"; kits_v2
    // Beacon engine: the preference reused for emplacement choosers). A running row that Draws (the Taunt) makes its pilot
    // the one an emplacement's gun takes first in its reach (Emplacement.Prefer). Three varied placements: a pirate base
    // at a VaryNear spot, the Warden 1800-2600 u off it at a VaryAngle bearing, and a second pilot (another seat's ship, as
    // this peer draws one) nearer, 700-1300 u off at a bearing 0.8-2.4 rad away. With no taunt the base's warning goes up
    // for the nearer pilot; with the Taunt up its Prefer is the Warden and the warning goes up for it; the Taunt over, the
    // nearer one again. Run 3 also stands the taunting Warden 4700-5200 u off (past the gun's 4500 u): no Prefer, and the
    // warning goes to the nearer pilot.
    async Task LaneA6cTauntEmplacementChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var gun = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Base)).Gun.GetValueOrDefault();
        Check(gun.Range == 4500f && Ab.Taunt.Draws && Classes.All.Sum(c => Abilities.For(c.Id).Count(d => d.Draws)) == 1,
              $"the Taunt is the one row that Draws ({Ab.Taunt.Draws}); the base's gun reaches {gun.Range:0} u (4500)");
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        var wd = Me; bool demo = wd.Demo; wd.Demo = true; wd.AutopilotTo = null;
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        var lf = BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance;
        var cdF = typeof(Emplacement).GetField("_cd", lf); var markedF = typeof(Emplacement).GetField("_marked", lf);
        var netPosF = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netPos", lf); var netVelF = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netVel", lf);
        var mate = new PlayerShip { Name = "TauntMate" };
        H.AddChild(mate);
        mate.Init(2, yonder + new Vector2(0, 3000));
        mate.SetIdentity("Mate", Colors.Gray, Colors.Gray, ShipClass.Carrier);
        mate.Hp = mate.MaxHp;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var baseAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            var pbase = H.Spawn(Spawns.Emplacement, baseAt, Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Base), 1e9, 1e9) as Emplacement;
            float aW = VaryAngle(), aM = aW + Vary(0.8f, 2.4f);
            var wAt = baseAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(aW) * Vary(1800f, 2600f);
            var mAt = baseAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(aM) * Vary(700f, 1300f);
            var farAt = baseAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(aW) * Vary(4700f, 5200f);
            var wNow = wAt;
            void Hold()
            {
                wd.Position = wNow; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                mate.Position = mAt; netPosF.SetValue(mate, mAt); netVelF.SetValue(mate, Vector2.Zero);
            }
            // the warning the base raises next, and whom for: any one up dropped (no round follows it), its clock due
            async Task<int> Mark()
            {
                markedF.SetValue(pbase, 0); cdF.SetValue(pbase, 0.0);
                Hold(); await Frame();
                int m = (int)markedF.GetValue(pbase);
                markedF.SetValue(pbase, 0);
                return m;
            }
            wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0; wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            Hold(); await Frame(); Hold(); await Frame();
            int plain = await Mark();
            wd.UseAbility("taunt", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 6 && !wd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened); i++) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            Hold();
            var pref = pbase?.Prefer;
            int drawn = await Mark();
            IHittable farPref = null; int farMark = mate.NetId;
            if (run == 2)
            {
                wNow = farAt; Hold(); await Frame();
                farPref = pbase?.Prefer; farMark = await Mark();
                wNow = wAt;
            }
            wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0;                                               // the row over: it draws nothing
            Hold(); await Frame();
            var afterPref = pbase?.Prefer; int after = await Mark();
            Check(pbase != null && plain == mate.NetId && ReferenceEquals(pref, wd) && drawn == wd.NetId
                  && farPref == null && farMark == mate.NetId && afterPref == null && after == mate.NetId,
                  $"taunt emplacement run {run}: the base's warning with no taunt goes to the pilot {mAt.DistanceTo(baseAt):0} u off ({(plain == mate.NetId ? "yes" : plain.ToString())}), not the Warden {wAt.DistanceTo(baseAt):0} u off; taunting, Prefer is the Warden ({ReferenceEquals(pref, wd)}) and the warning goes to it ({drawn == wd.NetId})"
                  + (run == 2 ? $"; taunting {farAt.DistanceTo(baseAt):0} u off (past 4500) no Prefer ({farPref == null}), the warning to the nearer ({farMark == mate.NetId})" : "")
                  + $"; the taunt over, the nearer again ({after == mate.NetId})");
            if (pbase != null) H.Down(Spawns.Emplacement, pbase, false, 0f);
            wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened); wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0;
            await Frame();
        }
        mate.QueueFree();
        await Frame();
        wd.Demo = demo; wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S GUNSHIPS (kits_v31 §8's second-run list). The guest refits to the Carrier (the host's 425
    // hull on it), stands 1200-2200 u off the practice dummy at a varied bearing and presses E with the dummy as its pick
    // (the picks ride WITH the press): the host's two gunships come to this carrier's list, and are drawn on their 240 u
    // circle round the dummy here; the host's 25 s cooldown and 12 s arrive, and E again is refused COOLING.
    async Task LaneA6aGunshipGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 425) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);
        var d = H.GetNodeOrNull<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");

    // ── SLICE 6a, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S SUPPRESSING FIRE (kits_v2 Proves: "a guest DD suppresses (the host decides), and the
    // chevron shows"; kits_v31 §8's second-run list). The guest (LaneA6aSuppressGuestChecks, after its curtain) refits to
    // the Destroyer and presses Q at a varied heading: the host's slot arrives (up 4-6 s, cooling 18.5-20) and Q again is
    // refused COOLING. The host (LaneA6aSuppressHostWatch, beside the lunge's watch) sees the guest's slot up and posts a
    // held webifier 380-520 u off the guest's bow (within 35 deg of it); the guest selects it and fires with the cursor on
    // it: the host puts Suppressed on it from the guest's own shells (the host decides; the status never goes on the
    // wire) and raises the chevron, which is drawn on the webifier HERE within 4 s. The host frees it 2 s later.
    sealed class LaneA6aSuppressSeen { public Raider Mark; public bool Up, Suppressed, Done; public double At; }
    LateSampler LaneA6aSuppressHostWatch(LaneA6aSuppressSeen seen)
    {
        float off = Vary(380f, 520f), turn = Vary(-0.6f, 0.6f);
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H == null || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.Destroyer } g) return seen.Done;
            if (seen.Mark == null)
            {
                if (g.Sl("suppress").Left <= 0) return false;
                seen.Up = true; seen.At = g.Clock;
                var m = H.SpawnRaider(g.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(g.Rotation + turn) * off, Enemies.Webifier);
                m.Hp = 1e9; m.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
                seen.Mark = m;
                return false;
            }
            if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(seen.Mark)) { seen.Done = true; return true; }
            if (!seen.Suppressed && seen.Mark.Statuses.Has(Status.Suppressed)) { seen.Suppressed = true; seen.At = g.Clock; }
            if ((seen.Suppressed && g.Clock - seen.At > 2.0) || g.Clock - seen.At > 12.0) { seen.Mark.TakeDamage(1e12); seen.Done = true; return true; }
            return false;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6aSuppressHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6aSuppressSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 120 : 90);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Up && seen.Suppressed,
              $"arena host: the guest's Suppressing fire -- its slot up here ({seen.Up}), and the webifier posted off its bow Suppressed here by the guest's own shells ({seen.Suppressed}): the host decides");
    }
    async Task LaneA6aSuppressGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null;
        await RealTime(() => me.Class == ShipClass.Destroyer && me.MaxHp >= 395 - 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
        var at = me.Position;
        void Hold() { me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
        H.ClearSelection();
        await Wait(Vary(0.3f, 0.6f));
        Key(Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Destroyer, "suppress"));
        await RealTime(() => me.Sl("suppress").Left > 0, Wan ? 6 : 3);
        double left = me.Sl("suppress").Left, cool = me.Sl("suppress").Cool;
        Key(Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.Destroyer, "suppress")); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        string said = me.FailNote("suppress");
        Raider Posted() => H.Raiders.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Alive && r.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 700f);
        await RealTime(() => Posted() != null, Wan ? 6 : 3);
        var mk = Posted();
        int Chevrons() => mk == null ? 0 : Nodes<FxNode>(mk).Count(f => f.Id == Fx.Chevron && !f.IsQueuedForDeletion());
        bool before = Chevrons() > 0;
        if (mk != null) H.SelectTarget(mk);
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Space);
        double c0 = me.Clock;
        while (mk != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(mk) && me.Clock - c0 < 4.0 && Chevrons() == 0)
        { Hold(); AimWorld(mk.Position); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Space);
        int marks = mk != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(mk) ? Chevrons() : -1;
        H.ClearSelection();
        Check(left > 4.0 && left <= 6.0 + 1e-6 && cool > 18.5 && cool <= 20.0 + 1e-6 && said == "COOLING" && mk != null && !before && marks == 1,
              $"arena guest: its own Q -- the host's slot here, up {left:0.0} s (6), cooling {cool:0.0} (20); Q again {said} (COOLING); the host's webifier {(mk == null ? "NEVER POSTED" : $"{mk.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u off")}, no chevron before a shell ({!before}); "
              + $"with Space on it the host's chevron is drawn on it here ({marks}, want 1)");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S GRAPNEL, ITS HOST HALF (kits_v31 §8: "the Grapnel rip (host damage, the chunk on a
    // guest)"). Started with the suppress watch; the guest destroyer (re-read every frame) hooks the practice dummy
    // (LaneA6aGrapnelGuestChecks): its slot up here on the dummy's id; when that slot drops (the guest's E cast-off) the
    // dummy has taken 10 HERE (the flat; a dummy has no hull to share) and the guest's own tally credits "grapnel" >= 10.
    // The meter restarts after 5 s idle: a rip that restarts it reads its whole total.
    sealed class LaneA6aGrapnelSeen { public bool Hooked, Done; public double Before, Credit0, Took = double.NaN, Credit = double.NaN; }
    LateSampler LaneA6aGrapnelHostWatch(LaneA6aGrapnelSeen seen)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H == null || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.Destroyer } g) return seen.Done;
            var dm = H.GetNodeOrNull<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
            if (dm == null) return false;
            var sl = g.Sl("grapnel");
            if (!seen.Hooked)
            {
                if (sl.Left <= 0 || sl.N != dm.NetId) return false;
                seen.Hooked = true; seen.Before = dm.Total; seen.Credit0 = g.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel");
                return false;
            }
            if (sl.Left > 0) return false;
            seen.Took = dm.Total >= seen.Before ? dm.Total - seen.Before : dm.Total;
            seen.Credit = g.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel") - seen.Credit0;
            seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6aGrapnelHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6aGrapnelSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 120 : 90);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Hooked && Math.Abs(seen.Took - 10) < 1e-6 && seen.Credit >= 10 - 1e-6,
              $"arena host: the guest's grapnel on the dummy, hooked here ({seen.Hooked}), cast off -- the dummy took {seen.Took:0.###} here (10), credited to the guest's \"grapnel\" {seen.Credit:0.###} (>= 10)");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6a, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S GRAPNEL (kits_v2 / v3 Rung 5: "a guest's swing is drawn on the host"; kits_v31 §8's

    // ── SLICE 6a, RUNG 5: THE RIP IN A PARTY OF TWO (kits_v31 §3.3 Proves: "in a party of 2, the rip is 1% of the
    // party-scaled hull"). In the level-1 siege the host raised its pylons for the party of two it hosts
    // (Emplacements.Raise: 403 x 1.6 = 644.4 hull each, where one pilot's are 402.75). The host refits to the destroyer
    // and, three varied runs on three of them (VaryAngle bearing, pressed 430-690 u off), hooks one and casts it off by
    // E 0.3-0.6 s into its swing: its hull drops by exactly 0.01 x 644.4 + 10 = 16.444 (a lone pilot's pylon would
    // lose 14.03), credited "grapnel" on the host, ONE chunk on its id. Then back to the hull it flew.
    async Task LaneA6aGrapnelPartyRipChecks()
    {
        var row = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Pylon));
        double party = row.Hull(1) * Missions.HullMult(1, 2), lone = row.Hull(1) * Missions.HullMult(1, 1);
        var pylons = H.Emplacements.Where(e => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(e) && e.Alive && e.Def.Id == Emplacements.Pylon).Take(3).ToList();
        Check(H.PartySize == 2 && Missions.Level == 1 && Math.Abs(party - 644.4) < 0.05 && Math.Abs(party - 1.6 * lone) < 1e-9
              && pylons.Count == 3 && pylons.All(p => Math.Abs(p.MaxHp - party) < 1e-6),
              $"arena host: the siege's pylons raised for a party of {H.PartySize} (2) at level {Missions.Level} (1) -- {string.Join(", ", pylons.Select(p => p.MaxHp.ToString("0.0")))} hull (403 x 1.6 = 644.4, one pilot's {lone:0.00})");
        var classWas = Character.Class;
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var s = Me; s.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        void Calm() { foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r); s.Hp = s.MaxHp; }
        for (int run = 0; run < pylons.Count; run++)
        {
            var p = pylons[run];
            if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(p) || !p.Alive) { Check(false, $"arena host: party rip run {run} -- its pylon is down"); continue; }
            s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").N = 0;
            s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); s.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled); Calm();
            s.Position = p.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(430f, 690f); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; s.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            await Frame();
            float d0 = s.Position.DistanceTo(p.Position);                            // re-taken after the frame
            double hp0 = p.Hp, credit0 = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel"), hold = Vary(0.3f, 0.6f), c0 = s.Clock, swingAt = -1;
            H.SelectTarget(p);
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", p.NetId);
            while (s.Clock - c0 < 3.0 && s.Helm.On)
            {
                Calm(); await Frame();
                if (swingAt < 0 && s.Helm.On && !s.Helm.Pulling) swingAt = s.Clock;
                if (swingAt >= 0 && s.Clock - swingAt >= hold) break;
            }
            bool swung = s.Helm.On && s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0 && s.Sl("grapnel").N == p.NetId;
            s.UseAbility("grapnel", p.NetId);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && s.Sl("grapnel").Left > 0; i++) await Frame();
            await Frame();
            double drop = hp0 - p.Hp, credit = s.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("grapnel") - credit0, want = 0.01 * p.MaxHp + 10;
            int rips = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == p.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3);
            Check(swung && s.Helm.Ended == HelmEnd.Pressed && Math.Abs(want - 16.444) < 0.001 && Math.Abs(drop - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(credit - want) < 1e-6 && rips == 1,
                  $"arena host: party rip run {run} -- hooked a pylon {d0:0} u off, swinging {swung}, cast off by {s.Helm.Ended} (Pressed): its hull dropped {drop:0.000} (0.01 x {p.MaxHp:0.0} + 10 = {want:0.000}, want 16.444; one pilot's {0.01 * lone + 10:0.000}), credited {credit:0.000}; {rips} chunk (1)");
            H.ClearSelection(); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        s.Sl("grapnel").Left = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").Cool = 0; s.Sl("grapnel").N = 0;
        if (classWas != ShipClass.Destroyer) await SetClass(classWas);
    }

        await Wait(0.2);
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
            wd.Sl("curtain").Cool = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0;

            var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float aimed = run == 0 ? Vary(100f, 140f) : run == 1 ? Vary(800f, 1000f) : Vary(300f, 600f);
            float want = Mathf.Clamp(aimed, 150f, 700f);
            var cursor = at + dir * aimed;
            var mid = at + dir * want; var axis = dir.Orthogonal();
            var probe = H.SpawnRaider(at + dir * 5000f, Enemies.Gunship); float r0 = probe.HitRadius; probe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            Raider Held(Vector2 p) { var g = H.SpawnRaider(p, Enemies.Gunship); g.Hp = 1e9; g.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return g; }
            float inOff = 40f + r0 - Vary(1f, 5f), outOff = 40f + r0 + Vary(1f, 5f);
            var inAt = mid + axis * Vary(-200f, 200f) + dir * inOff * (Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? 1f : -1f);
            var outAt = mid + axis * Vary(-200f, 200f) - dir * outOff * (Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? 1f : -1f);
            var inG = Held(inAt); var outG = Held(outAt);
            var bt = Missions.Bosses[0];
            var bossAt = mid + axis * Vary(-150f, 150f);
            var post = new Boss { Hub = H, Position = bossAt,
                                  Type = new Missions.BossType { Id = "post", Name = "POST", Hull = 100000, Texture = bt.Texture, Length = bt.Length, HalfWidth = bt.HalfWidth,
                                                                 CloseSpeed = 0f, TurnRate = 0f, Moves = System.Array.Empty<BossMove>() } };
            AddChild(post);
            var inSpot = inAt;                                                     // where the in-gunship is held (moved out and back below)
            void Pin() { wd.Position = at; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.AimPoint = cursor; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp; inG.Position = inSpot; outG.Position = outAt; post.Position = bossAt; }
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { Pin(); await Frame(); }
            bool taunted = run == 2;
            if (taunted) { wd.UseAbility("taunt", 0); Pin(); await Frame(); }
            bool called = !taunted || ReferenceEquals(inG.CalledBy, wd);
            double mult = taunted ? 1.5 : 1.0;
            double i0 = inG.Hp, o0 = outG.Hp, b0 = post.Hp, credit0 = wd.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("curtain");
            Key(ekey);
            ZoneNode bar = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6 && bar == null; i++) { Pin(); await Frame(); bar = H.Laid.FirstOrDefault(z => z.Row == Zones.Curtain); }
            double cool = wd.Sl("curtain").Cool;
            Key(ekey); Pin(); await Frame(); Pin(); await Frame();
            string again = wd.FailNote("curtain");
            float placed = bar == null ? -1f : bar.At.DistanceTo(at);
            float across = bar == null ? 1f : Mathf.Abs(Vector2.Right.Rotated(bar.Rot).Dot(dir));
            Check(bar != null && Math.Abs(placed - want) < 1f && across < 0.01f && Math.Abs(cool - 18.0) < 0.05 && again == "COOLING" && called,
                  $"curtain run {run}{(taunted ? ", taunted" : "")}: E with the cursor {aimed:0} u off lays the bar {placed:0.0} u out ({want:0}), across the aim ({across:0.000} along it); cooldown {cool:0.00} s (18.0); E again {again} (COOLING)");
            // before it arms: nothing; then 20 (30 called) and 10 (15) every 0.5 s, sampled between ticks
            async Task UntilAge(double age) { while (bar != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(bar) && bar.Age < age) { Pin(); await Frame(); } }
            await UntilAge(Vary(0.3f, 0.45f));
            double early = i0 - inG.Hp;
            int k = (int)Vary(1f, 3.99f);
            await UntilAge(0.5 + 0.5 * k + Vary(0.1f, 0.4f));
            double took = i0 - inG.Hp, want2 = (20 + 10 * k) * mult;
            double outTook = o0 - outG.Hp, bossTook = b0 - post.Hp;
            double credit = wd.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("curtain") - credit0;
            Check(early == 0 && Math.Abs(took - want2) < 1e-6 && outTook == 0 && bossTook == 0 && Math.Abs(credit - took) < 1e-6,
                  $"...a gunship {inOff - r0:0.0} u from the bar's line (its hull 1-5 u in) takes {early:0} before it arms, then {took:0.00} by tick {k} ({want2:0.00}); one {outOff - r0:0.0} u off takes {outTook:0} (0); a boss astride it {bossTook:0} (0); credited to the curtain {credit:0.00}");
            // OUT AND BACK IN: the gunship held outside the bar for 1.0-1.5 s, then back inside -- its clock restarts
            // from the return (one tick of 10, 15 called, on it), never the ticks it missed all at once
            {
                inSpot = outAt; Pin(); await Frame();
                double outFor = Vary(1.0f, 1.5f), leftAge = bar != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(bar) ? bar.Age : 0;
                await UntilAge(leftAge + outFor);
                inSpot = inAt; Pin();
                double reHp = inG.Hp, reAge = bar != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(bar) ? bar.Age : 0;
                await Frame();
                double s1 = Vary(0.1f, 0.4f), s2 = Vary(0.6f, 0.9f);
                await UntilAge(reAge + s1);
                double back1 = reHp - inG.Hp;
                await UntilAge(reAge + s2);
                double back2 = reHp - inG.Hp;
                bool oneTick = back1 == 0 || Math.Abs(back1 - 10 * mult) < 1e-6;
                Check(oneTick && Math.Abs(back2 - back1 - 10 * mult) < 1e-6,
                      $"...out of the bar {outFor:0.00} s and back in: {back1:0.00} in the first {s1:0.00} s (0 or {10 * mult:0.00}, never the missed ticks at once), {back2 - back1:0.00} more by {s2:0.00} s ({10 * mult:0.00})");
            }
            await UntilAge(Vary(5.8f, 5.95f));
            bool stands = bar != null && H.Laid.Contains(bar);
            double seen = wd.Clock, standAge = bar != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(bar) ? bar.Age : -1;
            while (wd.Clock - seen < 6.1 - standAge) { Pin(); await Frame(); }
            bool gone = bar != null && !H.Laid.Contains(bar);
            Check(stands && gone,
                  $"...the bar stands {standAge:0.00} s after the press ({stands}) and is gone 6.1 s after it ({gone})");
            inG.TakeDamage(1e12); outG.TakeDamage(1e12); post.QueueFree();
            wd.Sl("curtain").Cool = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Left = 0; wd.Sl("taunt").Cool = 0; wd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Hardened);
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        wd.Demo = demo; wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wd.Hp = wd.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S CURTAIN (kits_v31 §8: the Curtain drawn on every peer). The guest, a Warden, holds
    // its cursor 300-600 u off at a varied bearing and presses E: the host's bar arrives here where the host laid it --
    // within 20 u of the cursor (its aim on the host a report old), across the aim -- and the host's 18 s cooldown; the
    // bar is gone here 6.5 s on.
    async Task LaneA6cCurtainGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
        await RealTime(() => Me.Class == ShipClass.HeavyWarden && Math.Abs(Me.MaxHp - 270) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = true;
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        var at = me.Position; var dir = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()); float aimed = Vary(300f, 600f);
        me.AimPoint = at + dir * aimed;
        await Wait(0.4);
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; at = me.Position; me.AimPoint = at + dir * aimed;
        await Wait(0.2);
        Key(Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarden, "curtain"));
        await RealTime(() => H.Laid.Any(z => z.Row == Zones.Curtain) && me.Sl("curtain").Cool > 0, Wan ? 6 : 3);
        var bar = H.Laid.FirstOrDefault(z => z.Row == Zones.Curtain);
        float off = bar == null ? -1f : bar.At.DistanceTo(at + dir * aimed);
        float across = bar == null ? 1f : Mathf.Abs(Vector2.Right.Rotated(bar.Rot).Dot(dir));
        double cool = me.Sl("curtain").Cool;
        await Wait(6.5);
        bool gone = !H.Laid.Any(z => z.Row == Zones.Curtain);
        me.Demo = demo;
        Check(bar != null && off < 20f && across < 0.05f && cool > 16.5 && cool <= 18.0 + 1e-6 && gone,
              $"arena guest: its own E -- the host's curtain drawn here {off:0.0} u from its cursor ({bar != null}), across its aim ({across:0.000}); the cooldown {cool:0.0} s (18, a report late); gone 6.5 s on ({gone})");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6c, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S ANCHOR (kits_v31 §7: the boost refused ANCHORED). The guest, right after its
    // active reload, presses F through the key: once the host's word lands on its slot its own helm is rooted --
    // W + Shift + A or D (varied) held a varied 0.8-1.4 s move it under 1 u -- and V is refused ANCHORED; F again
    // weighs it (the slot runs out within 1 s, the host's cooldown over 11 s on it), and W then moves it.
    async Task LaneA6cAnchorGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 240) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
        await Wait(0.5);
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        var fkey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "anchor");
        Key(fkey);
        await RealTime(() => me.Sl("anchor").Left > 0, Wan ? 4 : 2);
        bool dropped = me.Sl("anchor").Left > 0;
        await Wait(0.1);
        var p0 = me.Position; var side = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? global::Godot.Key.A : global::Godot.Key.D; double secs = Vary(0.8f, 1.4f);
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyDown(side);
        await Wait(secs);
        KeyUp(side); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
        float moved = me.Position.DistanceTo(p0);
        Key(global::Godot.Key.V); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var vSaid = me.FailNote("boost");
        Key(fkey);
        await RealTime(() => me.Sl("anchor").Left <= 0, Wan ? 4 : 2);
        await Wait(Wan ? 0.6 : 0.3);
        double cool = me.Sl("anchor").Cool;
        var p1 = me.Position;
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); await Wait(0.6); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
        float after = me.Position.DistanceTo(p1);
        Check(dropped && moved < 1f && vSaid == "ANCHORED" && me.Sl("anchor").Left <= 0 && cool > 11.0 && after > 5f,
              $"arena guest: its own F -- the host's Anchor on its slot ({dropped}); W + Shift + {side} {secs:0.0} s move it {moved:0.00} u (none); V refused {vSaid} (ANCHORED); F again weighs it, the host's cooldown {cool:0.0} s (12, a report late); then W moves it {after:0} u");
    }

    // ── THE BUILD A PLAYER READS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // One check, about a trap in THIS game's protocol hash that a build string can fall into.
    void BuildChecks()
    {
        // THE PILOT IS NOT THE BUILD: nothing a run changes about the pilot enters the fingerprint. The
        // bought upgrades were a readonly int[] -- Plain to the fingerprint -- so every purchase moved it,
        // and a peer whose Net was first touched after a pilot loaded would have hashed that pilot's
        // purchases. Character itself DOES contribute a few parts -- a save path, a kept-kills cap, the
        // bounds a stat off disk is clamped to -- every one `const`, the same for every peer on this
        // build whichever pilot is loaded; named here rather than asserted away. What must never show
        // up is anything a PLAYER decided -- Bought chief among them -- asserted by construction (no
        // such part) and by effect (purchases made, the fingerprint is still the build's).
        var buildConst = new[] { "Character.Dir=", "Character.MaxBonus=", "Character.MaxStock=",
                                  "Character.PaidKept=", "Character.SaveDelay=" };
        var pilotParts = FingerprintParts().Where(p => p.StartsWith("Character.", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                                                      && !buildConst.Any(c => p.StartsWith(c, StringComparison.Ordinal))).ToList();
        var boughtWas = Character.Bought.ToArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < Character.Bought.Length; i++) Character.Bought[i] = Rng.RandiRange(0, Progression.MaxPerUpgrade);
        int bought = FingerprintNow();
        boughtWas.CopyTo(Character.Bought, 0);
        Check(pilotParts.Count == 0 && bought == Net.Protocol && typeof(Character).GetField(nameof(Character.Bought), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static) == null,
              $"nothing about the pilot is part of the build's fingerprint: its bought upgrades are a property over a mutable field, and buying moves nothing ({bought:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {(pilotParts.Count == 0 ? "no Character part" : string.Join(" | ", pilotParts))}{Moved(bought)})");
        // THE FINGERPRINT NEVER HASHES ITSELF, and it is whole when it is taken: Net.Protocol is a property
        // set by Net's static constructor, after every Net static is set. As a readonly field initializer
        // it hashed itself as 0 and every Net static below it as unset, so it differed from every
        // fingerprint taken later in the same process (R1's first runs: 3724c77b against 7991f5f3).
        var selfParts = FingerprintParts().Where(p => p.StartsWith("Net.Protocol", StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();
        int now = FingerprintNow();
        Check(typeof(Net).GetField(nameof(Net.Protocol), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static) == null && selfParts.Count == 0 && _hashAtStart == Net.Protocol && now == Net.Protocol,
              $"the build's fingerprint never hashes itself and is whole when it is taken: at the harness's start and now it is the build's ({_hashAtStart:x8} at the start, {now:x8} now, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}{(selfParts.Count == 0 ? "" : "; " + string.Join(" | ", selfParts))})");
        // A STRUCT ROW IS HASHED: any game value type or System.ValueTuple`N whose public fields are
        // Plain or delegates, readonly or not (a site's post) is written out field by field -- an array
        // of them was not hashed at all -- so one field of one row, moved, moves the fingerprint, and
        // put back it is the build's again
        var posts = Emplacements.PirateBase;
        int at = Rng.RandiRange(0, posts.Length - 1);
        var post = posts[at];
        posts[at] = new Post(post.Row, post.At + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1f, 50f));
        int shifted = FingerprintNow();
        posts[at] = post;
        string postPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Emplacements.PirateBase=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(shifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && postPart.Contains("Post{At=", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"a struct row is part of the build's fingerprint: one pirate-base post moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (post {at}: {shifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {postPart[..Math.Min(90, postPart.Length)]})");
        // A MUTABLE STRUCT ROW IS HASHED TOO: StatusGuard and TurretSpec carry no IsReadOnlyAttribute
        // (a mount's gun has settable fields) -- StructRow used to demand it, so a StatusGuard[] and
        // an EmplacementDef's TurretSpec? printed as their bare type name no matter their numbers, and
        // two builds that differed only there still shook hands.
        int gi = Rng.RandiRange(0, StatusSet.Guards.Length - 1);
        var guardWas = StatusSet.Guards[gi];
        StatusSet.Guards[gi] = new StatusGuard { Status = guardWas.Status, Share =guardWas.Share + Vary(0.05f, 0.4f) };
        int guardShifted = FingerprintNow();
        StatusSet.Guards[gi] = guardWas;
        string guardPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("StatusSet.Guards=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(guardShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && guardPart.Contains("Share=", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"a mutable struct row is part of the build's fingerprint: one status guard's share moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (guard {gi}: {guardShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {guardPart[..Math.Min(90, guardPart.Length)]})");
        var baseDef = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Base));
        var gunWas = baseDef.Gun.GetValueOrDefault();
        var gun = gunWas; gun.Damage = gunWas.Damage + Vary(1f, 50f);
        baseDef.Gun = gun;
        int gunShifted = FingerprintNow();
        baseDef.Gun = gunWas;
        string gunPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Emplacements.All=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(gunShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && gunPart.Contains("Damage=", StringComparison.Ordinal) && !gunPart.Contains("Gun=TurretSpec}", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"the pirate base's mutable gun is part of the build's fingerprint: its damage moved moves it, put back it is the build's again ({gunShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8})");
        // A VALUE-TUPLE ROW IS HASHED TOO: Hub.PracticeTargets and Hub.Outposts are
        // System.ValueTuple`N tables, a different assembly than the game's own -- StructRow only ever
        // looked at the game's assembly, so an array of them was skipped whole, not merely printed
        // wrong. One practice target moved, moves the fingerprint; put back it is the build's again.
        int pi = Rng.RandiRange(0, Hub.PracticeTargets.Length - 1);
        var targetWas = Hub.PracticeTargets[pi];
        Hub.PracticeTargets[pi] = (targetWas.number, targetWas.at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1f, 50f), targetWas.armed, targetWas.fighter);
        int targetShifted = FingerprintNow();
        Hub.PracticeTargets[pi] = targetWas;
        string targetPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Hub.PracticeTargets=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(targetShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && targetPart != "none",
              $"a value-tuple row is part of the build's fingerprint: one practice target moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (target {pi}: {targetShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {targetPart[..Math.Min(90, targetPart.Length)]})");
        // A ROW WITH A DELEGATE FIELD IS HASHED TOO: WaveCrew.Count is a Func<WaveBrief,int> --
        // StructRow used to demand every field Plain, so a WaveCrew[] printed as its bare type name
        // ("WaveCrew"), and the private static readonly rows built from it (Waves.Patrol, Waves.HuntPin)
        // never entered the fingerprint at all. One crew's Step moved, moves it; put back it is the
        // build's again, and the printed row shows the struct written out, not a bare type name.
        var w = Waves.All.First(x => x.Id == "raid");
        int ci = Rng.RandiRange(0, w.Crew.Length - 1);
        var c = w.Crew[ci];
        w.Crew[ci] = new WaveCrew(c.Kind, c.Way, c.Nth, c.Count, c.At, c.Step + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1f, 50f));
        int crewShifted = FingerprintNow();
        string crewPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Waves.All=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        try
        {
            Check(crewShifted != Net.Protocol && crewPart.Contains("WaveCrew{", StringComparison.Ordinal),
                  $"a row with a delegate field is part of the build's fingerprint: one wave crew's step moved moves it, and it is written out, not bare ({crewShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {crewPart[..Math.Min(90, crewPart.Length)]})");
        }
        finally { w.Crew[ci] = c; }
        Check(FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol,
              $"a wave crew row put back is the build's fingerprint again ({FingerprintNow():x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8})");
        // THE KITS LANE'S TABLES ARE PART OF THE BUILD (lane A, K2): the outgoing door's rows
        // (StatusSet.OutGuards, a struct row with an enum field), a heavy raider row's F20 fields
        // (Barrels, MissileFlight, MissileDamage, the Status? Cc, Exp) and an ability row's F1 Add and
        // Ramp (a RampSpec table inside a table). Each field moved moves the fingerprint, and the part
        // that moved is the table's own; put back, it is the build's again. A skipped table would
        // leave two builds that differ only there shaking hands.
        {
            int oi = Rng.RandiRange(0, StatusSet.OutGuards.Length - 1);
            var ogWas = StatusSet.OutGuards[oi];
            var heavies = Enemies.All.Where(e => e.Barrels > 1).ToArray();
            var ed = heavies[Rng.RandiRange(0, heavies.Length - 1)];
            var (barWas, flWas, mdWas, ccWas, exWas) = (ed.Barrels, ed.MissileFlight, ed.MissileDamage, ed.Cc, ed.Exp);
            var ab = Ab.Broadside;
            var (addWas, rampWas) = (ab.SpeedAdd, ab.Ramp);
            var moves = new (string what, string part, Action set, Action back)[]
            {
                ($"outgoing door row {oi}'s gun share", "StatusSet.OutGuards=",
                    () => { var g = ogWas; g.Gun += Vary(0.05f, 0.4f); StatusSet.OutGuards[oi] = g; }, () => StatusSet.OutGuards[oi] = ogWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s barrels", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.Barrels = barWas + Rng.RandiRange(1, 3), () => ed.Barrels = barWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s missile flight", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.MissileFlight = flWas + Vary(0.5f, 4f), () => ed.MissileFlight = flWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s missile damage", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.MissileDamage = mdWas + Vary(1f, 20f), () => ed.MissileDamage = mdWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s Cc", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.Cc = ccWas == null ? Status.Pinned : null, () => ed.Cc = ccWas),
                ($"{ed.Id}'s Exp", "Enemies.All=", () => ed.Exp = exWas + Vary(1f, 20f), () => ed.Exp = exWas),
                ("an ability row's SpeedAdd", "Ab.Broadside=", () => ab.SpeedAdd = "max_speed", () => ab.SpeedAdd = addWas),
                ("an ability row's Ramp", "Ab.Broadside=", () => ab.Ramp = new RampSpec { Build = "max_speed", Cap = "max_speed", Bleed = "max_speed" }, () => ab.Ramp = rampWas),
            };
            var unseen = new List<string>();
            foreach (var (what, part, set, back) in moves)
            {
                string before = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith(part, StringComparison.Ordinal));
                string after;
                int moved;
                try { set(); moved = FingerprintNow(); after = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith(part, StringComparison.Ordinal)); }
                finally { back(); }
                if (moved == Net.Protocol || before == null || after == before) unseen.Add($"{what} ({part} {(before == null ? "absent" : "unmoved")})");
            }
            Check(unseen.Count == 0 && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && ab.Ramp == rampWas && ed.MissileFlight == flWas,
                  $"the kits lane's tables are part of the build's fingerprint: an outgoing door row, a heavy's barrels / missile flight / missile damage / Cc / Exp, an ability row's SpeedAdd and Ramp each move it, and put back it is the build's again ({(unseen.Count == 0 ? "all 8 seen" : "unseen: " + string.Join("; ", unseen))}{Moved(FingerprintNow())})");
        }
        // A BARE BELL TABLE IS HASHED: Nozzle was a positional record struct -- no public fields, so
        // not a row to StructRow -- and Lanes.CourierBells / Gatherer.DroneBells, Nozzle[] fields of
        // their own, never entered the fingerprint. One courier bell moved moves it; put back it is
        // the build's again, and the part shows the bell written out field by field.
        var bells = (Nozzle[])typeof(Lanes).GetField("CourierBells", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static).GetValue(null);
        int bi = Rng.RandiRange(0, bells.Length - 1);
        var bellWas = bells[bi];
        bells[bi] = new Nozzle(bellWas.X + Vary(0.5f, 5f), bellWas.Y, bellWas.Bell);
        int bellShifted = FingerprintNow();
        bells[bi] = bellWas;
        string bellPart = FingerprintParts().FirstOrDefault(p => p.StartsWith("Lanes.CourierBells=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) ?? "none";
        Check(bellShifted != Net.Protocol && FingerprintNow() == Net.Protocol && bellPart.Contains("Nozzle{Bell=2.11", StringComparison.Ordinal),
              $"a bare bell table is part of the build's fingerprint: one courier bell moved moves it, put back it is the build's again (bell {bi}: {bellShifted:x8}, the build's {Net.Protocol:x8}; {bellPart[..Math.Min(90, bellPart.Length)]})");
        // Net.Fingerprint() folds in every static field of every null-namespace type that is
        // IsLiteral or IsInitOnly with a Plain field type -- and string is Plain. A
        // `public static readonly string Build` would therefore enter the hash two peers are
        // matched on, and two BYTE-IDENTICAL builds packed a minute apart would refuse each other
        // at the handshake. Asserted STRUCTURALLY, the way the trap is laid: the member must be a
        // property, and the static field behind it must be neither literal nor init-only.
        var buildProp = typeof(Game).GetProperty("Build", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static);
        var buildFields = typeof(Game).GetFields(BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
                                      .Where(f => f.FieldType == typeof(string) && (f.IsLiteral || f.IsInitOnly)).ToList();
        Check(buildProp != null && buildProp.PropertyType == typeof(string)
              && typeof(Game).GetField("Build", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static) == null
              && buildFields.All(f => f.Name != "_build")
              && Game.Build == "dev",
              $"the build a player reads is a property over a mutable static, so it cannot enter the protocol hash two peers are matched on -- and outside a release it says so ({Game.Build}; {buildFields.Count} frozen strings on Game, none of them the build)");
    }

    // ── A BOSS KEEPS UP WITH THE PILOT IT IS FIGHTING ───────────────────────────────────────────
    // Its hull and damage have always climbed 10% a level; its WIND-UPS and its REACH never moved,
    // so a pilot whose gear and points lengthen its own reach every level would fight each boss
    // from further out and dodge it more easily than the last. One percent a level, compounding:
    // quicker to wind up, faster in flight, longer-armed. The burn of a beam and how often that
    // burn is judged are left alone, because those are the damage and it has a scale of its own.
    void BossScaleChecks()
    {
        var row = Missions.ForLevel(1).Moves.First(m => m.Windup > 0 && m.Reach > 0);
        Check(Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(1) - 1.0) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(2) - 1.01) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(11) - Math.Pow(1.01, 10)) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Missions.Quicken(51) - Math.Pow(1.01, 50)) < 1e-9,
              $"a boss gains 1% a level on its wind-ups and its reach: x{Missions.Quicken(2):0.000} at level 2, x{Missions.Quicken(11):0.000} at 11, x{Missions.Quicken(51):0.000} at 51");

    }

    // ── THE CURVE (lane F): Par, the chip-free reference pilot's rows ──
    // THE ONE PLACE PAR IS PROVED AGAINST LITERALS (numbers_curve_raids_items.md §1.3). Every other
    // check reads Par rather than repeating a figure the item pass will re-literal.
    void CurveParChecks()
    {
        bool at(int L, double h, double d, double c) =>
            Math.Abs(Par.HullScale(L) - h) < 0.0006 && Math.Abs(Par.DamageScale(L) - d) < 0.0006 && Math.Abs(Par.CraftScale(L) - c) < 0.0006;
        Check(at(1, 1, 1, 1) && at(10, 1.418, 1.636, 1.376) && at(20, 1.642, 2.004, 1.593) && at(40, 2.216, 3.131, 2.151) && at(80, 2.341, 3.259, 2.272),
              $"Par: hull x{Par.HullScale(10):0.000} / x{Par.HullScale(20):0.000} / x{Par.HullScale(40):0.000}, damage x{Par.DamageScale(10):0.000} / x{Par.DamageScale(20):0.000} / x{Par.DamageScale(40):0.000}, craft x{Par.CraftScale(40):0.000} at L10 / 20 / 40 (1.418 / 1.642 / 2.216, 1.636 / 2.004 / 3.131, 2.151)");
        // THE PLATEAU: flat past L40 (tiers stop at T10, the gate at g26), and never falling.
        bool rising = Enumerable.Range(1, 79).All(L => Par.HullScale(L + 1) >= Par.HullScale(L) && Par.DamageScale(L + 1) >= Par.DamageScale(L) && Par.CraftScale(L + 1) >= Par.CraftScale(L));
        bool whole = Enumerable.Range(0, Par.Rows.Length).All(i => Par.Rows[i].Level == i + 1) && Par.Rows.Length == 80;
        Check(rising && whole && Par.HullScale(80) / Par.HullScale(40) <= 1.1 && Par.HullScale(200) == Par.HullScale(80) && Par.HullScale(0) == 1,
              $"Par never falls, has a row for every level 1-80, and is flat past L40: x{Par.HullScale(80) / Par.HullScale(40):0.000} from L40 to L80, the same at L200, and x1 under L1");
        // THE L1 ANCHOR: the Lancer's 60 s hull is 3222 (the fleet's walled L1 median), the Drake's x700/760.
        Check(Math.Abs(Par.Rows[0].Boss - 3222) < 0.5 && Math.Abs(Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760 - 2968) < 0.5,
              $"the Lancer's L1 hull on par's 60 s is 3222 and the Drake's 2968 ({Par.Rows[0].Boss:0}, {Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760:0})");
        // THE BOSS ROWS MOVE WITH PAR: when the item pass re-literals the table, the two L1 hulls in
        // Missions.Bosses (read by id) must move with Rows[0].Boss, or this goes red.
        {
            double lanHull = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "silver_lancer").Hull, draHull = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "drake_bastion").Hull;
            Check(Math.Abs(lanHull - Par.Rows[0].Boss) < 0.5 && Math.Abs(draHull - Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760) < 0.5,
                  $"the boss rows stand on Par's anchor: silver_lancer {lanHull} = Rows[0].Boss {Par.Rows[0].Boss:0.0}; drake_bastion {draHull} = x700/760 of it ({Par.Rows[0].Boss * 700 / 760:0.0})");
        }
        // TIME TO DIE holds at every level (a pilot who stops dodging): par's hull against the cut
        // sheet x DamageScale, less the 0.5% a second it regenerates -- 31.0 s against the Lancer's 15.76,
        // 42.0 s against the Drake's 12.19, at three varied levels anywhere on the table (fractional too).
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            double L = Vary(1f, 80f), H = Par.DamageScale(L) * Par.Rows[0].Hull;
            double lancer = H / (15.76 * Par.DamageScale(L) - 0.005 * H), drake = H / (12.19 * Par.DamageScale(L) - 0.005 * H);
            Check(Math.Abs(lancer - 31.0) < 0.2 && Math.Abs(drake - 42.0) < 0.3,
                  $"at L{L:0.0} par lives {lancer:0.0} s against the Lancer's sheet (31.0) and {drake:0.0} s against the Drake's (42.0)");
        }
        // A FRACTIONAL LEVEL is read between its two rows, and LevelAtHull is DamageScale's inverse,
        // at three varied levels inside the rising part of the table (L1-40).
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            double L = Vary(1.2f, 39.8f); int lo = (int)Math.Floor(L);
            double t = L - lo, mid = Par.HullScale(lo) + (Par.HullScale(lo + 1) - Par.HullScale(lo)) * t;
            Check(Math.Abs(Par.HullScale(L) - mid) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Par.LevelAtHull(Par.DamageScale(L)) - L) < 1e-6,
                  $"L{L:0.00}: hull x{Par.HullScale(L):0.0000} between L{lo} and L{lo + 1}, and a hull x{Par.DamageScale(L):0.000} of par's L1 stands at L{Par.LevelAtHull(Par.DamageScale(L)):0.00}");
        }
    }

    // THE CUT (lane F, numbers §1.2): with no chips, par lives 31 s against the Lancer and 42 s against
    // the Drake at every level, so every boss move but the two 250 supers (the Lancer's burn, the
    // Drake's rock) is its old row x0.744 / x0.787 -- the ram and the scrap included, though the
    // code flags them Super. The old rows are literals here, so a row moved back fails.
    void CurveBossRowChecks()
    {
        var lan = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "silver_lancer"); var dra = Missions.Bosses.First(b => b.Id == "drake_bastion");
        double Dmg(Missions.BossType b, string id) => b.Moves.First(m => m.Id == id).Damage;
        var cut = new (Missions.BossType b, string id, double was, double k, double now)[]
        {
            (lan, "guns", 3.6, 0.744, 2.68), (lan, "trident", 15, 0.744, 11.2), (lan, "wave", 45, 0.744, 33.5), (lan, "ram", 40, 0.744, 29.8),
            (dra, "gun", 6, 0.787, 4.72), (dra, "shotgun", 18.75, 0.787, 14.76),
        };
        foreach (var (b, id, was, k, now) in cut)
            Check(Math.Abs(Dmg(b, id) - now) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Dmg(b, id) / was - k) < 0.003,
                  $"{b.Name}'s {id}: {Dmg(b, id)} = {was} x{Dmg(b, id) / was:0.000} (the cut is x{k})");
        var beam = lan.Moves.First(m => m.Id == "beam");
        Check(beam.Damage == 50 && beam.Damage * 5 == 250 && Dmg(dra, "throw") == 250
              && lan.Moves.Length == 5 && dra.Moves.Length == 3,
              $"the two supers are kept: the burn {beam.Damage} a tick (250 over its five landings) and the rock {Dmg(dra, "throw")}; no other move on either row");
        // A SIEGE READS THE LANCER'S ROW BY ID, not by its place in Missions.Bosses (whose order sets
        // which boss holds odd and even levels): with the two rows swapped for the length of this
        // check, the base is still 3222 and a pylon 402.75, at three varied levels.
        var order = Missions.Bosses.ToArray();
        try
        {
            (Missions.Bosses[0], Missions.Bosses[1]) = (Missions.Bosses[1], Missions.Bosses[0]);
            var pb = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Base)); var py = Emplacements.Of(Emplacements.RowOf(Emplacements.Pylon));
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                int L = (int)Vary(1f, 40f);
                Check(Missions.Bosses[0].Id == "drake_bastion" && Math.Abs(pb.Hull(L) - 3222) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(py.Hull(L) - 402.75) < 1e-9,
                      $"with the boss rows reordered, the siege still stands on silver_lancer at L{L}: base {pb.Hull(L)} (3222), pylon {py.Hull(L)} (402.75)");
            }
        }
        finally { order.CopyTo(Missions.Bosses, 0); }
    }

    // A RAIDER'S STRENGTH IS A LEVEL (lane F): its hull on Par's craft scale, its laser volley on
    // Par's damage scale, its missile the row's flat figure -- a light and a heavy at three varied
    // levels, whole and fractional, spawned the way every wave spawns them (Hub.SpawnRaider).
    void CurveRaiderChecks()
    {
        foreach (int kind in new[] { Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Gunship })
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                double L = k == 0 ? (int)Vary(2f, 20f) : Vary(20f, 70f);
                var r = H.SpawnRaider(Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(Vary(-2500f, 2500f), -3900f), kind, null, L);
                if (r == null) { Check(false, $"a level-{L:0.0} raider could not be spawned"); continue; }
                var d = Enemies.Of(kind);
                Check(Math.Abs(r.Strength - L) < 1e-12 && Math.Abs(r.MaxHull - d.Hull * Par.CraftScale(L)) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(r.Hp - r.MaxHull) < 1e-9
                      && Math.Abs(r.Volley - d.Dps * d.Barrels * d.ShotEvery * Par.DamageScale(L)) < 1e-9 && r.Volley > d.Dps * d.Barrels * d.ShotEvery,
                      $"a level-{L:0.00} {(r.Heavy ? "heavy" : "light")}: hull {r.MaxHull:0.0} ({d.Hull} x{Par.CraftScale(L):0.000}), a volley of {r.Volley:0.00} (x{Par.DamageScale(L):0.000}); its missile stays the row's {d.MissileDamage:0}");
                H.RaiderDown(r);
            }
    }

    // ── FIELDS (lane D, F9): what a ship draws round itself while a slot runs is a ROW (Fields.All) ──
    // The rule, with no ship: a row is up only on a hull that HAS its slot, only while the slot's Left
    // runs, and a row with a pool only while its Own is unspent, fading as Own / pool. The bubble is
    // proved against its literals (260 u, a 400 pool) off the freighter's real sheet, from three
    // seeded draws of what is left of the pool -- never on the pool's edge.
    void FieldsContractChecks()
    {
        var fs = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        Check(Math.Abs(fs["bubble_radius"] - 260) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(fs["bubble_pool"] - 400) < 1e-9 && Fields.Of("bubble")?.Slot == "bubble",
              $"fields: the bubble row reads the freighter's own sheet, 260 u over a 400 pool ({fs["bubble_radius"]:0} u, {fs["bubble_pool"]:0})");
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
