            double own = Vary(20f, 380f), left = Vary(0.5f, 7.5f);
            float len = Vary(80f, 260f);
            var up = Fields.Up(id => id == "bubble", id => (left, own), id => fs[id], len).ToList();
            var b = up.FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            Check(up.Count == 1 && b.Row != null && Math.Abs(b.Radius - 260f) < 1e-3 && Math.Abs(b.Left - own / 400) < 1e-4 && b.Tag == null,
                  $"fields: a bubble with {own:0} of 400 left and {left:0.0} s to run is up at 260 u, drawn at {own / 400:0.00} strength ({b.Radius:0} u, {b.Left:0.00})");
            Check(!Fields.Up(id => id == "bubble", id => (0.0, own), id => fs[id], len).Any()
                  && !Fields.Up(id => id == "bubble", id => (left, 0.0), id => fs[id], len).Any()
                  && !Fields.Up(id => false, id => (left, own), id => fs[id], len).Any(),
                  $"fields: and none at all once its time is out, once its pool is spent, or on a hull with no bubble slot (run {run})");
        }
    }
    // THE BUBBLE ON A LIVE FREIGHTER: pressed still, pressed while moving, pressed turned and then
    // spent -- Fields.Up(ship) shows it at the sheet's 260 u from the first frame the slot runs, fades
    // with the pool, and is gone the moment the pool is.
    async Task FieldsBubbleChecks(PlayerShip fr, Vector2 yonder)
    {
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            fr.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); fr.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            fr.Velocity = run == 1 ? Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(30f, 70f) : Vector2.Zero;
            fr.Sl("bubble").Cool = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Left = 0; fr.Sl("bubble").Own = 0;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool downBefore = !Fields.Up(fr).Any(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            fr.UseAbility("bubble", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && !fr.BubbleUp; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var b = Fields.Up(fr).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            Check(downBefore && b.Row != null && Math.Abs(b.Radius - 260f) < 1e-3 && Math.Abs(b.Left - 1f) < 1e-4,
                  $"fields: a live freighter's bubble is drawn from its slot, at 260 u and full strength ({(run == 1 ? "moving" : "still")}, {b.Radius:0} u, {b.Left:0.00})");
            if (run != 2) continue;
            double spent = Vary(100f, 300f);
            fr.Hit(spent, fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 200f), "test:fieldspend");
            var half = Fields.Up(fr).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
            fr.Hit(400 - spent + Vary(5f, 20f), fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 200f), "test:fieldspent");   // just past the pool: the hull keeps nearly all it had
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(half.Row != null && Math.Abs(half.Left - (400 - spent) / 400) < 1e-3 && !Fields.Up(fr).Any(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble"),
                  $"fields: {spent:0} spent of the pool draws it at {(400 - spent) / 400:0.00} ({half.Left:0.00}); spent out, it is gone though its clock runs ({fr.Sl("bubble").Left:0.0} s)");
            await Wait(0.6);
        }
        fr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }
    // THE KITS' FIELD ROWS, by their literals and with no ship (their abilities are other lanes'):
    // the Supercarrier's ring is its sheet's patrol_range (600 u stock, 648 u under a common
    // Targeting Chip's +8%), the Taunt's tag reads its guard (0.67 is "−33%"), and the boost's plume
    // is up exactly while its slot runs. Each from three seeded draws of what is left of the slot.
    void FieldsRowChecks()
    {
        var want = new[] { ("patrol", "super"), ("taunt", "taunt"), ("boost", "boost") };
        Check(want.All(w => Fields.Of(w.Item1)?.Slot == w.Item2),
              $"fields: the kits' rows are there, each on its slot ({string.Join(", ", want.Select(w => $"{w.Item1}:{Fields.Of(w.Item1)?.Slot ?? "MISSING"}"))})");
        foreach (var (reach, guard) in new[] { (600.0, 0.67), (648.0, 0.67), (600.0, 0.5) })
        {
            double left = Vary(0.5f, 19.5f);
            float len = Vary(80f, 260f);
            double Stat(string id) => id == "patrol_range" ? reach : id == "taunt_guard" ? guard : 0;
            var up = Fields.Up(id => id != "bubble", id => (left, 0.0), Stat, len).ToDictionary(u => u.Row.Id);
            string tag = guard == 0.67 ? "−33%" : "−50%";
            Check(up.TryGetValue("patrol", out var pr) && Math.Abs(pr.Radius - reach) < 1e-3 && pr.Row.Look == FieldLook.Dashed,
                  $"fields: the patrol ring is drawn at the carrier's patrol_range, {reach:0} u ({(up.ContainsKey("patrol") ? up["patrol"].Radius : -1):0})");
            Check(up.TryGetValue("taunt", out var tg) && tg.Tag == tag && tg.Row.Look == FieldLook.Shimmer && Math.Abs(tg.Radius - len * 0.55f) < 1e-3,
                  $"fields: the taunt shimmers over the hull and its tag reads {tag} for a guard of {guard} ({(up.ContainsKey("taunt") ? up["taunt"].Tag : "none")})");
            Check(up.ContainsKey("boost") && up["boost"].Row.Look == FieldLook.Plume
                  && !Fields.Up(id => id != "bubble", id => (0.0, 0.0), Stat, len).Any(),
                  $"fields: the boost's plume burns while its slot runs ({left:0.0} s left) and none of the three is up once it is out");
        }
    }
    // ── LANE A SLICE 4 · F8 THE PRESS'S POINT (kits_v3 §3.3: the sentry throw's cursor, 600 u clamp) ────
    // Pure (Abilities.Toward) at the throw's three distances, and live: a row that takes a point finds the
    // cursor of its press in its own slot; a row that does not is left alone; a point that is not a
    // number presses nothing. No row takes a point yet (6b's throw), so the bubble is lent the flag for
    // the check and given it back in a finally.
    async Task LaneA4PayloadChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (float far in new[] { Vary(150f, 250f), Vary(540f, 590f), Vary(760f, 900f) })
        {
            var from = VaryNear(yonder, 400f); float ang = VaryAngle();
            var got = Abilities.Toward(from, from + Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang) * far, 600f);
            float want = Math.Min(far, 600f);
            Check(Math.Abs(from.DistanceTo(got) - want) < 0.01f && Math.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference((got - from).Angle(), ang)) < 1e-3f,
                  $"F8: a point {far:0} u out at {Mathf.RadToDeg(ang):0} deg, held to a 600 u reach, lands {from.DistanceTo(got):0.0} u out on its own bearing (want {want:0})");
        }
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
        var fr = Me; fr.AutopilotTo = null;
        var doAb = typeof(PlayerShip).GetMethod("DoAbility", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        void Ready() { ref var b = ref fr.Sl("bubble"); b.Cool = 0; b.Left = 0; b.Own = 0; b.At = new Vector2(-1, -1); }
        Ab.Bubble.TakesPoint = true;
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                fr.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); fr.Rotation = VaryAngle();
                fr.Velocity = run == 1 ? Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(30f, 70f) : Vector2.Zero;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                Ready();
                var cursor = fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 900f);
                fr.AimPoint = cursor;
                fr.UseAbility("bubble", 0);
                Check(fr.BubbleUp && fr.Sl("bubble").At.DistanceTo(cursor) < 0.01f,
                      $"F8: a press that takes a point lands its cursor in the row's own slot ({(run == 1 ? "moving" : "still")}, {fr.Position.DistanceTo(cursor):0} u off: slot at {fr.Sl("bubble").At.DistanceTo(cursor):0.00} u from it, pressed {fr.BubbleUp})");
                // NOT A NUMBER: nothing is pressed, the slot keeps what it had
                Ready();
                var bad = run == 0 ? new Vector2(float.NaN, cursor.Y) : run == 1 ? new Vector2(cursor.X, float.PositiveInfinity)
                                   : new Vector2(float.NegativeInfinity, float.NaN);
                doAb.Invoke(fr, new object[] { "bubble", 0, bad, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                Check(!fr.BubbleUp && fr.Sl("bubble").At == new Vector2(-1, -1),
                      $"F8: a press whose point is not a number ({bad}) presses nothing and writes nothing (pressed {fr.BubbleUp})");
            }
        }
        finally { Ab.Bubble.TakesPoint = false; }
        // A ROW THAT TAKES NO POINT: its slot's At is its own, whatever the cursor
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Ready();
            fr.AimPoint = fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(100f, 900f);
            fr.UseAbility("bubble", 0);
            Check(fr.BubbleUp && fr.Sl("bubble").At == new Vector2(-1, -1),
                  $"F8: a row that takes no point is pressed and its slot's At is untouched by the cursor ({fr.Sl("bubble").At})");
        }
        Ready();
    }

    // ── LANE A SLICE 4 · F8 THE TETHER (kits_v3 §3.2: the Grapnel's pull, then its swing) ─────────────
    // The grapnel's numbers as its 6a rows will hold them: a 0.15 s bite, a 450 u/s pull to 250 u off the
    // hull, the line never under 150 u off it nor over 700 u, W/S reel at 100 u/s, 5 s from the press.
    static HelmNums GrapnelNums(string slot) =>
        new() { Slot = slot, Bite = 0.15f, Pull = 450f, Stop = 250f, Clear = 150f, Reach = 700f, Reel = 100f, Time = 5 };
    const float TetherTop = 117f;                             // the destroyer's top (kits_v31 §3.5)
    static float BowOff(float rot, Vector2 from, Vector2 anchor) =>
        Mathf.RadToDeg(Math.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, HelmMoves.Bow(anchor - from))));

    // Pure (HelmMoves.TetherStep, 60 frames a second): the pull onto five hulls, a press inside the stop,
    // and the swing on A/D with W/S.
    void LaneA4TetherChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        var n = GrapnelNums("grapnel");
        const float Dt = 1f / 60f;
        Check(HelmMoves.All.Length > 0 && HelmMoves.All.All(m => m.Law != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(m.Id))
              && HelmMoves.All.Select(m => m.Id).Distinct().Count() == HelmMoves.All.Length && HelmMoves.All.Contains(HelmMoves.Tether),
              $"F8: every helm move row has an id of its own and a law ({string.Join(", ", HelmMoves.All.Select(m => m.Id))})");
        float thrust = (float)new ShipStats(ShipClass.Destroyer)["thrust"];
        // THE PULL: 250 u off each hull (the card's 320 / 340 / 400 / 580 / 296 u from the keel), in the bite
        // plus the haul at 450 u/s, the bow on it; still, and sliding round it (the slide kept)
        var anchors = new (string name, float r, float stop)[] { ("Lancer", 70f, 320f), ("Drake", 90f, 340f), ("pylon", 150f, 400f), ("base", 330f, 580f), ("dummy", 46f, 296f) };
        foreach (var (name, r, stop) in anchors)
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
            {
                var anchor = VaryNear(yonder, 500f); float ang = VaryAngle();
                float d0 = k == 0 ? Vary(stop + 60f, stop + 100f) : Vary(685f, 698f);
                float v0 = k == 1 ? Vary(20f, 60f) : 0f;
                var b = new HelmBody { Pos = anchor + Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang) * d0, Rot = VaryAngle(),
                                       Vel = Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang + Mathf.Pi / 2) * v0 };
                float line = HelmMoves.LineFor(d0, r, n), side = float.NaN; bool pulling = d0 > HelmMoves.StopAt(r, n);
                double t = 0, taut = -1; float bowWorst = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && pulling; i++)
                {
                    t += Dt;
                    b = HelmMoves.TetherStep(b, anchor, r, n, ref line, ref pulling, ref side, t, 0f, 0f, TetherTop, thrust, Dt);
                    if (t >= n.Bite) bowWorst = Math.Max(bowWorst, BowOff(b.Rot, b.Pos, anchor));
                    if (!pulling) taut = t;
                }
                float off = b.Pos.DistanceTo(anchor) - r;
                double want = 0.15 + (d0 - stop) / 450.0;
                Check(Math.Abs(HelmMoves.StopAt(r, n) - stop) < 1e-3f && Math.Abs(off - 250f) <= 10f && Math.Abs(taut - want) <= 0.05
                      && Math.Abs(HelmMoves.PullTime(d0, r, n) - want) < 1e-5 && bowWorst <= 5f
                      && Math.Abs(b.Vel.Length() - v0) <= Math.Max(1f, 0.1f * v0),
                      $"F8 tether: pulled from {d0:0} u at {Mathf.RadToDeg(ang):0} deg onto a {name} ({r:0} u hull){(k == 1 ? $", sliding {v0:0} u/s" : "")}: taut {off:0.0} u off its hull (250 ±10) at {taut:0.00} s (want {want:0.00} ±0.05), the bow within {bowWorst:0.0} deg, left with {b.Vel.Length():0.0} u/s round it (want {v0:0})");
            }
        // PRESSED INSIDE THE STOP: no pull; the swing keeps the line it has, and one under 150 u off the
        // hull is let out to 150 -- a second of it brings the hull no nearer
        foreach (var (name, r, stop) in new[] { anchors[0], anchors[2], anchors[4] })
        {
            var anchor = VaryNear(yonder, 500f); float ang = VaryAngle();
            float d0 = name == "pylon" ? Vary(r + 60f, r + 130f) : Vary(r + 170f, stop - 20f);
            var b = new HelmBody { Pos = anchor + Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang) * d0, Rot = VaryAngle() };
            float line = HelmMoves.LineFor(d0, r, n), side = float.NaN; bool pulling = d0 > HelmMoves.StopAt(r, n);
            bool pulled = pulling; float nearest = float.MaxValue; double t = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++)
            {
                t += Dt;
                b = HelmMoves.TetherStep(b, anchor, r, n, ref line, ref pulling, ref side, t, 0f, 0f, TetherTop, thrust, Dt);
                nearest = Math.Min(nearest, b.Pos.DistanceTo(anchor));
            }
            float want = Math.Max(d0, r + 150f);
            Check(!pulled && Math.Abs(line - want) < 1e-3f && nearest >= want - 0.5f,
                  $"F8 tether: pressed {d0:0} u from a {name}'s keel, inside its {stop:0} u stop: no pull, the line {line:0.0} (want {want:0.0}), the nearest in a second {nearest:0.0} u");
        }
        // THE SWING: 5 s round a hull on A or D, with W (in), S (out) or neither for part of it: the line
        // the reel's (100 u/s, held to 150 u off the hull and 700 u), the hull on it and the bow on the
        // anchor every frame, and round at the destroyer's top, never past it
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            var (name, r, _) = anchors[k * 2];
            var anchor = VaryNear(yonder, 500f); float ang = VaryAngle();
            float line = Vary(r + 250f, 550f), side = float.NaN; bool pulling = false;
            var b = new HelmBody { Pos = anchor + Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang) * line, Rot = HelmMoves.Bow(-Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang)) };
            float rudder = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f, reel = k == 0 ? 0f : k == 1 ? 1f : -1f;
            int reelFrames = (int)(Vary(0.5f, 1.0f) * 60);
            float line0 = line, drift = 0, bowWorst = 0, fastest = 0; double t = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++)
            {
                t += Dt;
                b = HelmMoves.TetherStep(b, anchor, r, n, ref line, ref pulling, ref side, t, i < reelFrames ? reel : 0f, rudder, TetherTop, thrust, Dt);
                drift = Math.Max(drift, Math.Abs(b.Pos.DistanceTo(anchor) - line));
                bowWorst = Math.Max(bowWorst, BowOff(b.Rot, b.Pos, anchor));
                fastest = Math.Max(fastest, Math.Abs(side));
            }
            float wantLine = line0 - reel * 100f * reelFrames * Dt;
            Check(drift <= 15f && bowWorst <= 5f && Math.Abs(line - wantLine) < 2.5f && Math.Abs(Math.Abs(side) - TetherTop) < 0.5f
                  && fastest <= TetherTop + 1e-3f && Math.Sign(side) == Math.Sign(rudder) && Math.Abs(b.Vel.Length() - TetherTop) < 0.5f,
                  $"F8 tether: 5 s round a {name} on {(rudder > 0 ? "D" : "A")}{(k == 0 ? "" : k == 1 ? ", W" : ", S")} for {reelFrames * Dt:0.00} s: the line {line0:0} -> {line:0.0} (want {wantLine:0.0}), off it by {drift:0.00} u at worst, the bow within {bowWorst:0.0} deg, round at {side:0.0} u/s (top {TetherTop:0})");
        }
        // AND THE LINE'S ENDS: W for the whole 5 s stops at 150 u off the hull, S at 700 u
        foreach (float reel in new[] { 1f, -1f, 1f })
        {
            var (name, r, _) = anchors[(int)Vary(0f, 4.99f)];
            var anchor = VaryNear(yonder, 500f); float ang = VaryAngle();
            float line = Vary(r + 200f, 600f), side = float.NaN; bool pulling = false; double t = 0;
            var b = new HelmBody { Pos = anchor + Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang) * line, Rot = HelmMoves.Bow(-Vector2.Right.Rotated(ang)) };
            for (int i = 0; i < 300; i++) { t += Dt; b = HelmMoves.TetherStep(b, anchor, r, n, ref line, ref pulling, ref side, t, reel, 0f, TetherTop, thrust, Dt); }
            float want = reel > 0 ? r + 150f : 700f;
            Check(Math.Abs(line - want) < 1e-3f && Math.Abs(b.Pos.DistanceTo(anchor) - want) < 0.5f,
                  $"F8 tether: {(reel > 0 ? "W" : "S")} held 5 s round a {name}: the line stops at {line:0.0} (want {want:0})");
        }
    }

    // LIVE, on the destroyer round a practice dummy (46 u hull: the stop is 296 u from its keel): the owner
    // casts off a move the host never marks after 0.5 s; a marked one pulls, swings, and casts off with
    // its speed kept; a web, a disable or a warp charge ends it at once; the press's refusals.
    async Task LaneA4HelmLiveChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var dd = Me; dd.AutopilotTo = null;
        var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
        const string Mark = "open6";                           // a slot the destroyer has and nothing reads
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        void Place(float d, float v)
        {
            float a = VaryAngle();
            dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            dd.Position = dummy.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a) * d; dd.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            dd.Velocity = Vector2.Right.Rotated(a + Mathf.Pi / 2) * v;
            dd.Sl(Mark).Left = 0; dd.Sl(Mark).N = 0;
        }
        // THE PRESS'S REFUSALS: out of reach, webbed, nothing to hook
        {
            Place(Vary(705f, 800f), 0f);
            string far = dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, dummy, GrapnelNums(Mark));
            Place(Vary(350f, 650f), 0f); dd.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 2.0);
            string webbed = dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, dummy, GrapnelNums(Mark));
            dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            string none = dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, null, GrapnelNums(Mark));
            Check(far == "OUT OF RANGE" && webbed == "WEBBED" && none == "NO TARGET" && !dd.Helm.On,
                  $"F8 helm: a press past 700 u is {far}, webbed {webbed}, with nothing selected {none}; none of them starts a move");
        }
        // UNMARKED: the owner casts off at 0.5 s (still, sliding, pressed inside the stop)
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            Place(k == 2 ? Vary(220f, 280f) : Vary(400f, 690f), k == 1 ? Vary(30f, 60f) : 0f);
            await Frame();
            string why = dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, dummy, GrapnelNums(Mark));
            for (int i = 0; i < 90 && dd.Helm.On; i++) await Frame();
            Check(why == null && !dd.Helm.On && dd.Helm.Ended == HelmEnd.Unconfirmed && dd.Helm.T > 0.5 && dd.Helm.T < 0.56,
                  $"F8 helm: a move the host never marks is cast off by its owner at {dd.Helm.T:0.00} s (0.5; {dd.Helm.Ended}, {(k == 1 ? "sliding" : k == 2 ? "pressed inside the stop" : "still")})");
        }
        // MARKED: the pull lands 250 u off the hull in its time, the swing holds its line on A or D, and
        // the move ends by a second press, the host's release, or its own time -- the speed kept
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            float d0 = Vary(400f, 690f);
            Place(d0, 0f);
            await Frame();
            var n = GrapnelNums(Mark);
            if (k == 2) n.Time = Vary(2.6f, 3.0f);
            string why = dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, dummy, n);
            HelmMoves.Confirm(dd, dummy, n, n.Time + 1);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && dd.Helm.On && dd.Helm.Pulling; i++) await Frame();
            double taut = dd.Helm.T, want = 0.15 + (d0 - 296f) / 450.0;
            float off = dd.Position.DistanceTo(dummy.Position) - dummy.HitRadius;
            float bow = BowOff(dd.Rotation, dd.Position, dummy.Position);
            Check(why == null && dd.Helm.On && Math.Abs(off - 250f) <= 10f && Math.Abs(taut - want) <= 0.1 && bow <= 5f,
                  $"F8 helm: a marked pull from {d0:0} u lands the destroyer {off:0.0} u off the dummy's hull (250 ±10) at {taut:0.00} s (want {want:0.00}), the bow within {bow:0.0} deg");
            var key = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? global::Godot.Key.A : global::Godot.Key.D;
            float drift = 0, bowWorst = 0;
            KeyDown(key);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && dd.Helm.On; i++)
            {
                await Frame();
                drift = Math.Max(drift, Math.Abs(dd.Position.DistanceTo(dummy.Position) - dd.Helm.Line));
                bowWorst = Math.Max(bowWorst, BowOff(dd.Rotation, dd.Position, dummy.Position));
            }
            KeyUp(key);
            Check(dd.Helm.On && drift <= 15f && bowWorst <= 5f && dd.Velocity.Length() > 20f,
                  $"F8 helm: a second on {key} swings the destroyer round at {dd.Velocity.Length():0} u/s, off its line by {drift:0.0} u at worst (15), the bow within {bowWorst:0.0} deg (5)");
            float v0 = dd.Velocity.Length();
            var endWant = k == 0 ? HelmEnd.Pressed : k == 1 ? HelmEnd.Host : HelmEnd.Time;
            if (k == 0) dd.CastOff();
            else if (k == 1) HelmMoves.Release(dd, Mark);
            else { for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && dd.Helm.On; i++) { v0 = dd.Velocity.Length(); await Frame(); } }
            for (int i = 0; i < 3 && dd.Helm.On; i++) await Frame();
            await Frame();
            float v1 = dd.Velocity.Length();
            Check(!dd.Helm.On && dd.Helm.Ended == endWant && Math.Abs(v1 - v0) <= 0.05f * v0 && (k != 2 || Math.Abs(dd.Helm.T - n.Time) < 0.05),
                  $"F8 helm: cast off by {endWant}{(k == 2 ? $" at {dd.Helm.T:0.00} s (want {n.Time:0.00})" : "")}, the destroyer keeps its speed: {v0:0.0} -> {v1:0.0} u/s (within 5%)");
            dd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
        // AT ONCE, whatever the mark: a web lands, the hull is disabled, V begins a warp charge
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            Place(Vary(400f, 690f), 0f);
            await Frame();
            dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, dummy, GrapnelNums(Mark));
            HelmMoves.Confirm(dd, dummy, GrapnelNums(Mark), 6);
            await Wait(Vary(0.3f, 0.9f));
            var want = k == 0 ? HelmEnd.Webbed : k == 1 ? HelmEnd.Disabled : HelmEnd.Drive;
            if (k == 0) dd.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 1.0);
            else if (k == 1) dd.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 1.0);
            else { dd.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; dd.DriveHeld = true; dd.PressDrive(); }
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            if (k == 2) { dd.DriveHeld = false; for (int i = 0; i < 10 && dd.Charging; i++) await Frame(); }
            Check(!dd.Helm.On && dd.Helm.Ended == want, $"F8 helm: {want} ends the move within two frames ({dd.Helm.Ended}, on {dd.Helm.On})");
            dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            dd.Sl(Mark).Left = 0; dd.Sl("warp").Cool = 0; dd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
    }

    // ── F8 WARDS: while the host's mark runs, a guest's reports may claim the move's speed ──────────────
    // Through the host's own reading of a report, PlayerShip.ApplyState, fed to the host's own destroyer
    // as a guest's report would reach it (where it is, at a pull's speed; its drive's last report put
    // back after each, so nothing is priced): what the host keeps (_netVel) and whether its clamp cut
    // (_drive.Clamped). With no mark the hull's own top holds it, 117 x 1.1; marked, the grapnel's 450 u/s
    // pull, or hypot(top, reel) for a slower pull, stands; released or run out, it is cut again.
    async Task LaneA4WardChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var dd = Me; dd.AutopilotTo = null;
        var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
        const string Mark = "open6";
        var nf = BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance;
        var run = (DriveRun)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_drive", nf).GetValue(dd);
        var netVel = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netVel", nf);
        float top = dd.TopNow;
        (Vector2 kept, int cut) Report(Vector2 v)
        {
            int c0 = run.Clamped; var from = run.From; bool bit = run.Bit, remote = run.Remote;
            dd.ApplyState(dd.Position.X, dd.Position.Y, v.X, v.Y, dd.Rotation, dd.AimPoint.X, dd.AimPoint.Y, dd.Trigger, dd.Staggered,
                          dd.Position.X, dd.Position.Y, dd.Rotation, false);
            run.From = from; run.Bit = bit; run.Remote = remote;
            return ((Vector2)netVel.GetValue(dd), run.Clamped - c0);
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            HelmMoves.Release(dd, Mark);
            var n = GrapnelNums(Mark);
            if (k == 2) n.Pull = Vary(60f, 110f);                // a pull slower than the swing: the ward is the swing's
            float ward = k == 2 ? new Vector2(top, 100f).Length() : 450f;
            var v = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * (k == 2 ? Vary(top * 1.2f, ward * 0.98f) : Vary(150f, 450f));
            var (bare, bareCut) = Report(v);                     // no mark: the hull's own top
            HelmMoves.Confirm(dd, dummy, n, Vary(0.4f, 0.8f));
            float wardNow = dd.ReportTop;
            var (during, duringCut) = Report(v);
            if (k == 1) await Wait(1.0); else HelmMoves.Release(dd, Mark);
            var (after, afterCut) = Report(v);
            Check(bareCut == 1 && Math.Abs(bare.Length() - top * 1.1f) < 0.01f
                  && Math.Abs(wardNow - ward) < 0.01f && duringCut == 0 && during == v
                  && afterCut == 1 && Math.Abs(after.Length() - top * 1.1f) < 0.01f,
                  $"F8 ward: a report at {v.Length():0} u/s read by the host (ApplyState): unmarked, cut to {bare.Length():0.0} ({bareCut}); marked, it stands at {during.Length():0.0} ({duringCut} cut; ward {wardNow:0.0}, want {ward:0.0}); {(k == 1 ? "the mark run out" : "released")}, cut to {after.Length():0.0} ({afterCut}) -- the hull's {top:0} x 1.1");
        }
        Report(Vector2.Zero);
    }

    // ── F8 THE PRESS'S PICKS (kits_v2 §5: the gunships' targets[], 1-3 of them) ─────────────────────────
    // On the host's own destroyer (ClassDef.Targets 3), its F (the Long Lance) lent TakesTargets for the check (the
    // destroyer carries no row that takes targets) and given it back in a finally, among six disabled gunship raiders 2500 u
    // and more out: the host holds the picks a press sends, in the order sent (one, two, three of them,
    // through the owner's own UseAbility); a claim past the three is cut, and a repeat counted once; a dead
    // or unknown id is dropped.
    async Task LaneA4TargetsChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var dd = Me; dd.AutopilotTo = null;
        var doAb = typeof(PlayerShip).GetMethod("DoAbility", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        var far = yonder + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(2500f, 3200f);
        var foes = new List<Raider>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        {
            var r = H.SpawnRaider(VaryNear(far, 500f), Enemies.Gunship);
            r.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            foes.Add(r);
        }
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        int[] Seen() => dd.Picked.Select(h => h.NetId).ToArray();
        int[] Shuffled(int count) => foes.Where(r => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r) && r.Alive).OrderBy(_ => Vary(0f, 1f)).Take(count).Select(r => r.NetId).ToArray();
        string Ids(int[] ids) => "{" + string.Join(",", ids) + "}";
        Ab.LongLance.TakesTargets = true;
        try
        {
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {   // ONE, TWO, THREE picked: the host holds them, in order
                var picks = Shuffled(k + 1);
                dd.Sl("longlance").Cool = 0;                                  // each press past the refusal: the first set 18 s
                dd.UseAbility("longlance", 0, picks);
                Check(picks.Length == k + 1 && Seen().SequenceEqual(picks),
                      $"F8 picks: {k + 1} picked {Ids(picks)}, the host holds {Ids(Seen())}");
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {   // PAST THE CAP: four, or six, or a repeat among four -- the first three, each once
                var some = Shuffled(6);
                var sent = k == 0 ? some.Take(4).ToArray() : k == 1 ? some : new[] { some[0], some[0], some[1], some[2], some[3] };
                var want = sent.Distinct().Take(3).ToArray();
                doAb.Invoke(dd, new object[] { "longlance", 0, Vector2.Zero, sent });
                Check(Seen().SequenceEqual(want),
                      $"F8 picks: {Ids(sent)} claimed on a 3-pick hull: the host holds {Ids(Seen())} (want {Ids(want)})");
            }
            var dead = foes[5];
            int deadId = dead.NetId;
            dead.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {   // DEAD OR UNKNOWN: dropped, the living kept in order
                var live = Shuffled(2);
                int unknown = 0x7FFF0000 + (int)Vary(1f, 9999f);
                var sent = k == 0 ? new[] { deadId, live[0] } : k == 1 ? new[] { live[0], unknown, live[1] } : new[] { unknown, deadId, live[0] };
                var want = k == 1 ? live : new[] { live[0] };
                doAb.Invoke(dd, new object[] { "longlance", 0, Vector2.Zero, sent });
                Check((!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(dead) || !dead.Alive) && Seen().SequenceEqual(want),
                      $"F8 picks: {Ids(sent)} with a dead ({deadId}) or unknown id among them: the host holds {Ids(Seen())} (want {Ids(want)})");
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            Ab.LongLance.TakesTargets = false; dd.Sl("longlance").Cool = 0;
            foreach (var r in foes) if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r) && r.Alive) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
    }

    // ── A CAMERA THAT IS NOT A NUMBER (round a2, a2-pd-release): Hub.MoveCamera cuts it back to the ship. Left lost,
    // the cursor read NaN, every main gun threw in Turret.Swing, and the battleship's point defence (mounted after its
    // mains) never ticked: a light 60-90% of its reach out was never taken. Three varied runs (VaryNear spot, VaryAngle
    // heading and bearing; the camera put at NaN, +Inf, -Inf): two frames on the camera is within 1 u of the ship, the
    // aim is a number, and a PD mount takes a held light 0.60-0.90 of pd_range out within 8 frames.
    async Task CameraNanChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
        var bb = Me; var cam = (Camera2D)typeof(Hub).GetField("_cam", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(H);
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            bb.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); bb.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; bb.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            await Frame();
            var bad = run == 0 ? new Vector2(float.NaN, bb.Position.Y) : run == 1 ? new Vector2(bb.Position.X, float.PositiveInfinity)
                               : new Vector2(float.NegativeInfinity, float.NaN);
            cam.Position = bad;
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            float camOff = cam.Position.DistanceTo(bb.ViewPosition);
            bool aimOk = bb.AimAt.IsFinite();
            var mount = bb.PdTurrets.First();
            var lightAt = mount.GlobalPosition + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * (float)(bb.Stats["pd_range"] * Vary(0.60f, 0.90f));
            var light = H.SpawnRaider(lightAt, Enemies.Webifier); light.Hp = 1e9; light.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
            for (int f = 0; f < 8 && !ReferenceEquals(mount.Target, light); f++) { light.Position = lightAt; await Frame(); }
            bool taken = ReferenceEquals(mount.Target, light);
            Check(camOff < 1f && aimOk && taken,
                  $"a camera put at {bad} cuts back to the ship: {camOff:0.0} u off it (1) two frames on, the aim a number ({aimOk}), and the battleship's point defence takes a light {mount.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(lightAt):0} u out ({taken})");
            light.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Frame();
        }
    }

    // ── F8 AN ANCHOR THAT WARPS casts the move off with none (kits_v31 §3.4) ─────────────────────────────
    // The destroyer on TargetDummy1, marked; the dummy relocated 1500-3000 u (over Drives.SnapAt, 600) in
    // the bite, mid-pull and mid-swing (on A or D): the move ends THAT frame, AnchorWarped (not Drive: the
    // ship's own warp is the one that rips), and the destroyer is never dragged across with it.
    async Task LaneA4AnchorWarpChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var dd = Me; dd.AutopilotTo = null;
        var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
        const string Mark = "open6";
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var home = dummy.Position;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)                             // 0 in the bite, 1 mid-pull, 2 mid-swing
        {
            dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            float a = VaryAngle(), d0 = k == 2 ? Vary(400f, 690f) : Vary(560f, 690f);
            dd.Position = dummy.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a) * d0; dd.Rotation = VaryAngle(); dd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            dd.Sl(Mark).Left = 0; dd.Sl(Mark).N = 0;
            await Frame();
            var n = GrapnelNums(Mark);
            string why = dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, dummy, n);
            HelmMoves.Confirm(dd, dummy, n, n.Time + 1);
            var key = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? global::Godot.Key.A : global::Godot.Key.D;
            if (k == 0) { int f = (int)Vary(1f, 3.99f); for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) await Frame(); }
            else if (k == 1) { await Wait(Vary(0.2f, 0.3f)); await Frame(); }
            else
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && dd.Helm.On && dd.Helm.Pulling; i++) await Frame();
                KeyDown(key);
                await Wait(Vary(0.3f, 0.8f)); await Frame();
            }
            // (a timer resumes AFTER the frame's ships have flown, a frame BEFORE: the Frame after each Wait puts the
            // jump's one Frame below round exactly one flight of the hull, as the bite's frames already do)
            bool inPhase = dd.Helm.On && (k == 0 ? dd.Helm.T < n.Bite : k == 1 ? dd.Helm.Pulling && dd.Helm.T > n.Bite : !dd.Helm.Pulling);
            var shipAt = dd.Position; double t0 = dd.Helm.T;
            float jump = Vary(1500f, 3000f);
            dummy.Position = home + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * jump;
            await Frame();
            if (k == 2) KeyUp(key);
            float moved = dd.Position.DistanceTo(shipAt);
            Check(why == null && inPhase && !dd.Helm.On && dd.Helm.Ended == HelmEnd.AnchorWarped && dd.Helm.T - t0 < 0.05 && moved < 40f,
                  $"F8 helm: the anchor warped {jump:0} u {(k == 0 ? "in the bite" : k == 1 ? "mid-pull" : $"mid-swing on {key}")} (in phase {inPhase}): the move ends that frame ({dd.Helm.Ended}, on {dd.Helm.On}, {dd.Helm.T - t0:0.000} s on) and the destroyer moved {moved:0.0} u, not with it");
            dummy.Position = home;
            HelmMoves.Release(dd, Mark);
            dd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Frame();
        }
    }

    // ── F8 A WRECK ENDS THE MOVE: wrecked 0.1-0.4 s after an unmarked press (still, sliding, pressed inside
    // the stop), the run is off that frame, Wrecked; re-boarded, nothing flies the hull from where it lay.
    // ── SLICE 6d, THE DART'S PEPPERBOX (kits_v2's card; numbers §8 R6). Its rows and its price on literals; then,
    // from 3 varied situations each: 45 DPS landed on a still hostile at 300-700 u within 90° of the nose; 12 +- 1
    // launches in 2 s; the launch = nose x 520 + the ship's own velocity after a sideways slide; a target inside 750 u
    // is reached and one past it is not; a cursor switched mid-flight lands the dart on the new mark; a wrecked
    // launcher's darts fly straight and end; the first body on the line takes it and a seeker is flown through; the
    // price x1.5 on the ship at a boosted 390 u/s. The Dart's hull 200 and its weapon row never walled.
    void LaneA6dPepperRowChecks()
    {
        var sh = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightDart);
        Check(sh["hull"] == 200 && sh["pepper_damage"] == 7.5 && Math.Abs(sh["pepper_interval"] - 1.0 / 6) < 1e-9 && sh["pepper_speed"] == 520
              && sh["pepper_range"] == 750 && sh["pepper_turn"] == 6 && sh["pepper_cap"] == 1.5 && sh["price_top"] == 260
              && Ab.Pepperbox.Weapon && Ab.Pepperbox.Kind == AbilityKind.Hold && Abilities.TriggerOf(ShipClass.LightDart) == Ab.Pepperbox
              && Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightDart).Abilities[0] == Ab.Pepperbox && !Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightDart).Has(Fit.Guns),
              $"the Dart: hull {sh["hull"]:0} (200); the pepperbox {sh["pepper_damage"]:0.0} a dart every {sh["pepper_interval"]:0.000} s, {sh["pepper_speed"]:0} u/s, {sh["pepper_range"]:0} u, {sh["pepper_turn"]:0} rad/s, up to x{sh["pepper_cap"]:0.0} from {sh["price_top"]:0}; its trigger, never walled, no turret");
        // THE PRICE on the request's literals, and 3 varied tops between them
        var lit = new[] { (260.0, 7.5), (325.0, 9.375), (390.0, 11.25), (450.0, 11.25) };
        bool litOk = lit.All(p => Math.Abs(Bores.Price(7.5, p.Item1, 260, 1.5) - p.Item2) < 1e-9);
        string seen = "";
        bool varOk = true;
        foreach (var (lo, hi) in new[] { (100f, 259f), (261f, 389f), (391f, 600f) })
        {
            double top = Vary(lo, hi), got = Bores.Price(7.5, top, 260, 1.5), want = 7.5 * Math.Clamp(top / 260, 1, 1.5);
            varOk &= Math.Abs(got - want) < 1e-9; seen += $"{top:0}->{got:0.000}; ";
        }
        Check(litOk && varOk, $"a dart's price: 7.5 / 9.375 / 11.25 / 11.25 at 260 / 325 / 390 / 450 u/s; varied: {seen}");
        // THE LAUNCH: nose x 520 + the ship's own velocity, from 3 varied headings and slides (sideways included)
        int launchOk = 0; string ls = "";
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot); var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
            var shipV = k == 0 ? side * Vary(80f, 130f) : k == 1 ? nose * Vary(150f, 260f) : -side * Vary(40f, 120f) + nose * Vary(50f, 100f);
            var (from, v) = Bores.Muzzle(Vector2.Zero, rot, 35f, 5f, 520f, shipV);
            bool ok = (v - (nose * 520f + shipV)).Length() < 1e-3f && from.DistanceTo(nose * 35f + side * 5f) < 1e-3f;
            if (ok) launchOk++;
            ls += $"{Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0}° slide {shipV.Length():0} -> {v.Length():0} u/s; ";
        }
        Check(launchOk == 3, $"a dart leaves the nose rail at 520 along the nose plus the ship's own velocity, from 3 varied slides ({ls})");
    }

    // One dart's worth of trigger: held for exactly one frame, so the bore fires once (its clock was spent).
    async Task<Shot> LaneA6dOneDart(PlayerShip dt)
    {
        var before = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Pepper).ToHashSet();
        dt.Sl("pepperbox").Own = 0;
        dt.Trigger = true;
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        dt.Trigger = false;
        return Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Pepper && !before.Contains(x));
    }

    async Task LaneA6dPepperChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dt = Me; bool demo = dt.Demo; dt.Demo = true; dt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double Landed() => dt.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("pepper");

        // 45 DPS LANDED, timed from the first dart to land: 6 s of trigger at a still hostile 300-700 u off, within 90°
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var off = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot + Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-85f, 85f)));
            var foe = HeldI(at + off * Vary(300f, 700f), Enemies.Gunship);
            var spot = foe.Position;
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.AimPoint = spot;
            await Frame();
            double d0 = Landed();
            dt.Trigger = true;
            int launches = 0; var seenShots = new HashSet<Shot>();
            double tFirst = -1, landed0 = 0, clock = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12 && (tFirst < 0 || clock - tFirst < 6.0); i++)
            {
                dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.AimPoint = foe.Position = spot;
                await Frame();
                clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                foreach (var x in Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Pepper && x.Source == dt)) if (seenShots.Add(x) && clock <= 2.0) launches++;
                if (tFirst < 0 && Landed() > d0) { tFirst = clock; landed0 = Landed(); }
            }
            dt.Trigger = false;
            // the dart that landed at tFirst is the window's first; 36 more land in the 6 s after it
            double got = Landed() - landed0, want = 45.0 * 6.0;
            Check(tFirst >= 0 && Math.Abs(got - want) <= want * 0.03 && launches >= 11 && launches <= 13,
                  $"the pepperbox at a still hostile {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u off, {Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, (spot - at).Angle() + Mathf.Pi / 2))):0}° off the nose: {got:0.0} landed in the 6 s after the first ({want:0} = 45 DPS, +-3%); {launches} launches in 2 s (12 +- 1)");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.8);
        }

        // THE LAUNCH ON THE SHIP: after a sideways slide the dart's velocity is nose x 520 + the ship's own
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot); var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
            var slide = side * (run == 1 ? -1f : 1f) * Vary(90f, 130f) + nose * (run == 2 ? Vary(100f, 200f) : 0f);
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = slide;
            var want = nose * 520f + slide;
            dt.AimPoint = dt.Position + want.Normalized() * 700f;
            var shot = await LaneA6dOneDart(dt);
            var v = shot == null ? Vector2.Zero : shot.Dir * shot.Speed;
            Check(shot != null && Math.Abs(v.Length() - want.Length()) <= want.Length() * 0.01f && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(v.Angle(), want.Angle())) < 0.03f,
                  $"a dart fired sliding {slide.Length():0} u/s: it leaves at {v.Length():0.0} u/s on {Mathf.RadToDeg(v.Angle()):0}° (nose x 520 + the ship's = {want.Length():0.0} on {Mathf.RadToDeg(want.Angle()):0}°)");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(1.6);
        }

        // ITS REACH: a hostile whose near edge is inside 750 u of the rail is struck; one past it is not
        foreach (var (lo, hi, lands) in new[] { (690f, 735f, true), (765f, 810f, false), (700f, 740f, true) })
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var muzzle = at + nose * (dt.MyArt.Length * 0.5f);
            var foe = HeldI(at, Enemies.Gunship);
            float edge = Vary(lo, hi);
            var spot = muzzle + nose * (edge + foe.HitRadius);
            foe.Position = spot; dt.AimPoint = spot;
            await Frame();
            double h0 = foe.Hp;
            await LaneA6dOneDart(dt);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3; i++) { dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; foe.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            bool hit = foe.Hp < h0;
            Check(hit == lands, $"a still hostile whose near edge is {edge:0} u from the rail is {(hit ? "struck" : "not reached")} ({(lands ? "inside" : "past")} 750 u)");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }

        // THE CURSOR SWITCHED MID-FLIGHT: aimed at A, the cursor moved onto B 0.1-0.2 s later; B takes the dart, A nothing
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            float sgn = run % 2 == 0 ? 1f : -1f;
            var aSpot = at + nose.Rotated(sgn * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(25f, 40f))) * Vary(380f, 460f);
            var bSpot = at + nose.Rotated(-sgn * Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(25f, 40f))) * Vary(380f, 460f);
            var a = HeldI(aSpot, Enemies.Gunship); var b = HeldI(bSpot, Enemies.Gunship);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.AimPoint = aSpot;
            await Frame();
            double a0 = a.Hp, b0 = b.Hp;
            await LaneA6dOneDart(dt);
            double sw = Vary(0.1f, 0.2f), t = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3; i++)
            {
                dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; a.Position = aSpot; b.Position = bSpot;
                dt.AimPoint = t < sw ? aSpot : bSpot;
                await Frame(); t += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            }
            Check(Math.Abs(b0 - b.Hp - 7.5) < 1e-6 && a.Hp == a0,
                  $"a dart aimed at A with the cursor moved onto B {sw:0.00} s into its flight: B takes {b0 - b.Hp:0.0} (7.5), A {a0 - a.Hp:0.0}");
            a.TakeDamage(1e12); b.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }

        // THE LAUNCHER WRECKED: its darts fly straight on down the heading they had, and end at their reach
        var stasis = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            dt.AimPoint = at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(50f, 80f) * (run == 1 ? -1f : 1f))) * Vary(500f, 700f);
            var shot = await LaneA6dOneDart(dt);
            await Wait(Vary(0.05f, 0.12f));
            dt.Restore(0, false, Vary(20f, 40f));
            await Frame();
            var dir0 = shot?.Dir ?? Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.3);
            var dir1 = shot != null && IsInstanceValid(shot) ? shot.Dir : dir0;
            await Wait(1.5);
            bool gone = !Nodes<Shot>().Any(x => x.Kind == Shots.Pepper && x.Alive);
            Check(shot != null && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(dir0.Angle(), dir1.Angle())) < 1e-3f && gone,
                  $"a dart whose Dart is wrecked flies straight ({Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.AngleDifference(dir0.Angle(), dir1.Angle())):0.00}° turned in 0.3 s) and ends at its reach, no dart left ({gone})");
            stasis.SetValue(dt, 0.0); dt.Reboard(); dt.Hp = dt.MaxHp;
            await Frame();
        }

        // THE FIRST BODY ON THE LINE takes it, whatever stands behind; a seeker in the way is flown through
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var nearSpot = at + nose * Vary(260f, 340f); var farSpot = at + nose * Vary(480f, 560f);
            var nearFoe = HeldI(nearSpot, Enemies.Gunship); var farFoe = HeldI(farSpot, run == 2 ? Enemies.Webifier : Enemies.Gunship);
            var seekerAt = at + nose * Vary(120f, 180f);
            var seeker = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, seekerAt, -nose.Rotated(Mathf.Pi / 2), 1f, 5000f, 1, hitSource: $"test:6d_seeker#{run}");
            dt.AimPoint = farSpot;
            await Frame();
            double n0 = nearFoe.Hp, f0 = farFoe.Hp;
            await LaneA6dOneDart(dt);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2; i++) { dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; nearFoe.Position = nearSpot; farFoe.Position = farSpot; if (IsInstanceValid(seeker)) seeker.Position = seekerAt; await Frame(); }
            bool seekerLives = IsInstanceValid(seeker) && seeker.Alive;
            Check(Math.Abs(n0 - nearFoe.Hp - 7.5) < 1e-6 && farFoe.Hp == f0 && seekerLives,
                  $"the first hostile on the dart's line takes it ({n0 - nearFoe.Hp:0.0}), the one behind nothing ({f0 - farFoe.Hp:0.0}), and the seeker it passed through still flies ({seekerLives})");
            nearFoe.TakeDamage(1e12); farFoe.TakeDamage(1e12); if (IsInstanceValid(seeker)) seeker.Intercept();
        }

        // THE PRICE ON THE SHIP: at rest x1 (7.5); boosted (top 390) x1.5 = 11.25; each from a varied heading
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            dt.AimPoint = dt.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * 600f;
            string boost = dt.Drive.Id;
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = run == 0 ? 0 : Vary(1.5f, 2.5f);
            await Frame();
            float top = dt.TopNow;
            var shot = await LaneA6dOneDart(dt);
            double want = 7.5 * Math.Clamp(top / 260.0, 1, 1.5);
            Check(shot != null && Math.Abs(shot.Damage - want) < 1e-6 && (run == 0 ? Math.Abs(want - 7.5) < 1e-9 : Math.Abs(want - 11.25) < 1e-9),
                  $"a dart fired at a top speed of {top:0} u/s ({(run == 0 ? "at rest" : "boosted")}) carries {shot?.Damage:0.000} ({want:0.000}: 7.5 at 260, 11.25 at 390)");
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 0;
            await Wait(1.6);
        }
        dt.Demo = demo; dt.Trigger = false; dt.Position = yonder; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, THE DART'S ROD FROM GOD (kits_v2's card; v31 §3.4 and §7: the speed lifts add). Its rows and the
    // price on literals (249.2 at the sprint's 360, 339.2 at a boosted 490, 360 at the cap); then from 3 varied
    // situations each: the sprint from rest with S held -- thrust x3 (the water's own curve at 0.25 s), S dead, the rudder
    // free, the top 360 and never past it, 3.0 s +- a frame, the rod as it ends priced at 360, 30% +- 2% of the speed
    // kept, 12 s from the press and a second press refused; the rod through {1, 3, 3} held hostiles once each, a seeker
    // on its line flown through, one past 1400 u untouched; a boosted sprint's thrust x3.5, top 490 and rod 339.2;
    // wrecked mid-sprint: no rod.
    void LaneA6dRodRowChecks()
    {
        var sh = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dart = Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightDart);
        Check(sh["sprint_time"] == 3 && sh["sprint_thrust"] == 3 && sh["sprint_add"] == 100 && sh["rod_damage"] == 180 && sh["rod_cap"] == 2
              && sh["rod_speed"] == 300 && sh["rod_range"] == 1400 && Math.Abs(sh["rod_recoil"] - 0.30) < 1e-9 && sh["rod_cooldown"] == 12
              && dart.Abilities.Length >= 2 && dart.Abilities[1] == Ab.Rod && Ab.Rod.Forces && Ab.Rod.Parting?.Shot == Shots.Rod
              && Ab.Rod.ThrustStat == "sprint_thrust" && Ab.Rod.SpeedAdd == "sprint_add" && Ab.Rod.SpeedStat == null
              && Shots.Of(Shots.Rod).Stops == 0 && !Shots.Of(Shots.Rod).Guided && !Shots.Of(Shots.Rod).AtPlayers,
              $"the rod's rows: a {sh["sprint_time"]:0.0} s sprint at thrust x{sh["sprint_thrust"]:0.0} and +{sh["sprint_add"]:0} u/s, forced; the rod {sh["rod_damage"]:0} up to x{sh["rod_cap"]:0.0}, {sh["rod_speed"]:0} u/s + the ship's, {sh["rod_range"]:0} u through everything; {sh["rod_recoil"]:0.00} kept; {sh["rod_cooldown"]:0} s; the Dart's ability 1");
        // THE PRICE on literals, and 3 varied tops; the lifts ADD (x3 thrust with the boost's +50% is x3.5; the top 490)
        var lit = new[] { (360.0, 249.2), (490.0, 339.2), (520.0, 360.0), (640.0, 360.0) };
        bool litOk = lit.All(p => Math.Abs(Bores.Price(180, p.Item1, 260, 2) - p.Item2) < 0.05);
        string seen = ""; bool varOk = true;
        foreach (var (lo, hi) in new[] { (150f, 259f), (261f, 519f), (521f, 800f) })
        {
            double top = Vary(lo, hi), got = Bores.Price(180, top, 260, 2);
            varOk &= Math.Abs(got - 180 * Math.Clamp(top / 260, 1, 2)) < 1e-9; seen += $"{top:0}->{got:0.0}; ";
        }
        bool adds = Math.Abs(Stat.Scale(PlayerShip.LiftShares(new[] { 3.0 })) - 3.0) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Stat.Scale(PlayerShip.LiftShares(new[] { 3.0, 1.5 })) - 3.5) < 1e-9
                    && Math.Abs(PlayerShip.TopSpeed(260, 1f, 100, 1f) - 360f) < 1e-3f && Math.Abs(PlayerShip.TopSpeed(260, 1.5f, 100, 1f) - 490f) < 1e-3f;
        Check(litOk && varOk && adds, $"the rod's price: 249.2 / 339.2 / 360 / 360 at 360 / 490 / 520 / 640 u/s; varied: {seen}the sprint's thrust x3, x3.5 boosted; top 360, 490 boosted");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dRodChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dt = Me; bool demo = dt.Demo; dt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        HashSet<Shot> Rods() => Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod).ToHashSet();
        Shot NewRod(HashSet<Shot> was) => Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod && !was.Contains(x));
        var stasis = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        double rodDmg = dt.Stats["rod_damage"];
        float drag = (float)dt.Stats["water_drag"], push = (float)(dt.Stats["thrust"] * 3);

        // THE SPRINT FROM REST, S held all the way (dead), the rudder held on one run (free); timed from the press
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            dt.Demo = false;
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0; dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0;
            await Frame();
            var was = Rods();
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.S);
            if (run == 1) KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.A);
            dt.UseAbility("rod", 0);
            double clock = 0, fr = 1.0 / 60, coolAtRod = -1, left1 = -1, cool1 = -1, relLeft = -1, relCool = -1, tRod = -1;
            float at25 = -1, want25 = 0, peak = 0, last = 0, lastAtRod = 0, after = -1; Shot rod = null; float rotAtRod = rot;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && after < 0; i++)
            {
                last = dt.Velocity.Length();
                await Frame();
                fr = GetProcessDeltaTime(); clock += fr;
                if (rod != null) { after = dt.Velocity.Length(); break; }
                if (at25 < 0 && clock >= 0.25) { at25 = dt.SpeedAhead; want25 = push / drag * (1 - Mathf.Exp(-drag * (float)clock)); }
                peak = Mathf.Max(peak, dt.Velocity.Length());
                if (left1 < 0 && clock >= 1.0)
                {   // a second press mid-sprint is refused: neither its time nor its cooldown goes up
                    left1 = dt.Sl("rod").Left; cool1 = dt.Sl("rod").Cool;
                    dt.UseAbility("rod", 0);
                    relLeft = dt.Sl("rod").Left; relCool = dt.Sl("rod").Cool;
                }
                if ((rod = NewRod(was)) != null) { coolAtRod = dt.Sl("rod").Cool; rotAtRod = dt.Rotation; tRod = clock; lastAtRod = dt.Velocity.Length(); }
            }
            KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.S); if (run == 1) KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.A);
            double priced = Bores.Price(rodDmg, 360, 260, 2);
            float kept = lastAtRod > 0 ? after / lastAtRod : 0;
            bool turned = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, rotAtRod)) > 0.3f;
            Check(rod != null && want25 > 0 && Math.Abs(at25 - want25) <= want25 * 0.06f && peak >= 355f && peak <= 361f
                  && Math.Abs(tRod - 3.0) <= 1.5 * fr + 1e-3 && Math.Abs(rod.Damage - priced) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(priced - 249.23) < 0.01
                  && Math.Abs(kept - 0.30f) <= 0.02f && Math.Abs(coolAtRod - (12 - 3)) <= 0.1 && relLeft <= left1 && relCool <= cool1 && turned == (run == 1),
                  $"a sprint from rest with S held{(run == 1 ? " and the rudder hard over" : "")}: {at25:0} u/s at 0.25 s (thrust x3: {want25:0}), peak {peak:0} (360), the rod at {tRod:0.00} s (3.0) carrying {rod?.Damage:0.0} (249.2 at 360), {kept * 100:0}% of the speed kept (30), the cooldown {coolAtRod:0.0} (9: 12 from the press), a second press refused ({relLeft:0.00}<={left1:0.00}), turned {Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, rotAtRod)):0}°");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.5);
        }

        // THROUGH EVERYTHING ON ITS LINE, ONCE EACH: {1, 3, 3} held hostiles, a seeker on the line flown through, one past
        // 1400 u untouched. The sprint's last moment is set by hand (its Left 0.02 s), the ship held still: priced at 360.
        dt.Demo = true;
        foreach (int bodies in new[] { 1, 3, 3 })
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0;
            var spots = new List<Vector2>(); var foes = new List<Raider>();
            for (int b = 0; b < bodies; b++) { var sp = at + nose * (Vary(250f, 330f) + b * Vary(280f, 330f)); spots.Add(sp); foes.Add(HeldI(sp, Enemies.Gunship)); }
            var farSpot = at + nose * Vary(1560f, 1640f); var far = HeldI(farSpot, Enemies.Gunship);
            var seekerAt = at + nose * Vary(130f, 190f);
            var seeker = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, seekerAt, -nose.Rotated(Mathf.Pi / 2), 1f, 5000f, 1, hitSource: $"test:6d_rodseeker#{bodies}{Vary(0f, 1f):0.0000}");
            await Frame();
            var h0 = foes.Select(f => f.Hp).ToList(); double far0 = far.Hp;
            dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0.02;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6; i++)
            {
                dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                for (int b = 0; b < bodies; b++) foes[b].Position = spots[b];
                far.Position = farSpot; if (IsInstanceValid(seeker)) seeker.Position = seekerAt;
                await Frame();
            }
            double want = Bores.Price(rodDmg, 360, 260, 2);
            var took = foes.Select((f, b) => h0[b] - f.Hp).ToList();
            bool seekerLives = IsInstanceValid(seeker) && seeker.Alive;
            Check(took.All(d => Math.Abs(d - want) < 1e-6) && far.Hp == far0 && seekerLives,
                  $"the rod through {bodies} held hostile(s) on its line: each took {string.Join(" / ", took.Select(d => d.ToString("0.0")))} ({want:0.0}, once); one {farSpot.DistanceTo(at):0} u off nothing ({far0 - far.Hp:0}); the seeker it passed still flies ({seekerLives})");
            foreach (var f in foes) f.TakeDamage(1e12);
            far.TakeDamage(1e12); if (IsInstanceValid(seeker)) seeker.Intercept();
        }

        // THE BOOST ADDS (v31 §3.4, §7): a boosted sprint pushes x3.5, tops out at 490, and its rod carries 339.2
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0;
            var spot = at + nose * Vary(300f, 700f); var foe = HeldI(spot, Enemies.Gunship);
            string boost = dt.Drive.Id;
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = Vary(1.0f, 2.5f); dt.Sl("rod").Left = Vary(0.4f, 0.9f);
            float thrustX = dt.ThrustMult, top = dt.TopNow;
            await Frame();
            double h0 = foe.Hp; var was = Rods();
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 3; dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0.02;
            Shot rod = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4; i++)
            {
                dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; foe.Position = spot;
                if (dt.Sl(boost).Left < 1) dt.Sl(boost).Left = 1;
                await Frame();
                rod ??= NewRod(was);
            }
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 0;
            double want = Bores.Price(rodDmg, 490, 260, 2);
            Check(Math.Abs(thrustX - 3.5f) < 1e-3f && Math.Abs(top - 490f) < 0.5f && rod != null && Math.Abs(rod.Damage - want) < 1e-6
                  && Math.Abs(want - 339.23) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(h0 - foe.Hp - want) < 1e-6,
                  $"a boosted sprint: thrust x{thrustX:0.00} (3.5), top {top:0} (490); its rod carries {rod?.Damage:0.0} and lands {h0 - foe.Hp:0.0} (339.2)");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }

        // WEBBED (dart.md: "The Dart has no web-breaker at all -- only hull"): pinned from rest, the sprint runs held -- the web
        // stays on, the hull never past 0.2 x 360 + 3 u/s, the heading frozen (the rudder held hard over on one run) -- and the
        // rod leaves at 3.0 s down the frozen nose, priced at the sprint's 360 all the same (249.23)
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            dt.Demo = false;
            float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0; dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0;
            dt.Statuses.Apply(Status.Pinned, 6.0);
            await Frame();
            var was = Rods();
            if (run == 1) KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.D);
            dt.UseAbility("rod", 0);
            double clock = 0, fr = 1.0 / 60, tRod = -1; bool held = true, frozen = true; float fastest = 0; Shot rod = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && rod == null; i++)
            {
                await Frame();
                fr = GetProcessDeltaTime(); clock += fr;
                held &= dt.Pinned; fastest = Mathf.Max(fastest, dt.Velocity.Length());
                frozen &= Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rot, dt.Rotation)) < 1e-3f;
                if ((rod = NewRod(was)) != null) tRod = clock;
            }
            if (run == 1) KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.D);
            double priced = Bores.Price(rodDmg, 360, 260, 2);
            bool down = rod != null && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(rod.Dir.Angle(), nose.Angle())) < 1e-3f;
            Check(rod != null && held && frozen && fastest <= 0.2f * 360f + 3f && Math.Abs(tRod - 3.0) <= 1.5 * fr + 1e-3 && down
                  && Math.Abs(rod.Damage - priced) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(priced - 249.23) < 0.01,
                  $"webbed{(run == 1 ? " with the rudder hard over" : "")} on {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0}°: the web held ({held}), at most {fastest:0.0} u/s (75 = 0.2 x 360 + 3), the heading frozen ({frozen}); the rod at {tRod:0.00} s (3.0) down the nose ({down}) carrying {rod?.Damage:0.00} (249.23)");
            dt.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        dt.Demo = true;

        // WRECKED MID-SPRINT: no rod leaves the wreck
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = VaryAngle(); dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0; dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0;
            await Frame();
            var was = Rods();
            dt.UseAbility("rod", 0);
            float wreckAt = Vary(0.3f, 2.6f);
            await Wait(wreckAt);
            dt.Restore(0, false, 30);
            await Wait(3.6 - wreckAt);
            var rod = NewRod(was);
            Check(rod == null, $"a Dart wrecked {wreckAt:0.00} s into its sprint fires no rod ({(rod == null ? "none" : "one left")})");
            stasis.SetValue(dt, 0.0); dt.Reboard(); dt.Hp = dt.MaxHp; dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0;
            await Frame();
        }
        dt.Demo = demo; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Position = yonder; dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0;
    }

    // RULING R6 WITH GEAR ON (numbers_curve_raids_items.md §8: "every top-speed lift prices the Pepperbox and the rod, the
    // boost and gear included"): the price reads the live top, so a part on max_speed or the boost's lift reaches it.
    // (a) Combat Chip T1 (max_speed -4%): top 249.6, a dart at the x1 floor (its own +8% on the dart's row: 8.1), and a
    // boosted sprint's rod 180 x (249.6 x 1.5 + 100) / 260 = 328.43; (b) Burner Drive T1 (the boost's excess +25%: x1.625)
    // boosted: top 422.5, a dart 11.25, the rod 360 (the cap: 522.5); (c) Combat Chip T10 boosted: the price is as written
    // at every tier (Items.Build), so the top is 249.6 again and the rod 328.43, while the dart carries T10's tiered lift
    // (7.5 x (1 + 0.08 x P(10))) at the boosted top's price. Each at a varied spot and heading.
    async Task LaneA6dPepperGearChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        ShipStats Sheet(string id)
        {
            var lo = Equipment.Default(ShipClass.LightDart); var it = Equipment.ById(id);
            lo[it.Slot == GearSlot.Chip ? Equipment.CoreSlots : Array.IndexOf(Equipment.Core, it.Slot)] = id;
            return new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightDart, Equipment.Bonuses(ShipClass.LightDart, lo, 14, NoLevels));
        }
        double t10 = Sheet("chip_combat_t10")["max_speed"];
        foreach (var (id, boosted) in new[] { ("chip_combat_t1", false), ("burner_drive_t1", true), ("chip_combat_t10", true) })
        {
            var was = await WearI(ShipClass.LightDart, id);
            var dt = Me; bool demo = dt.Demo; dt.Demo = true; dt.AutopilotTo = null;
            string boost = dt.Drive.Id;
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.AimPoint = at + Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * 600f;
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = boosted ? Vary(1.5f, 2.5f) : 0;
            await Frame();
            float top = dt.TopNow;
            var dart = await LaneA6dOneDart(dt);
            double pepper = dt.Stats["pepper_damage"];
            // the rod at the end of a sprint, the boost lit through it (a sprint's top is the boosted top + 100)
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 1.5;
            var was2 = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod).ToHashSet();
            dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0.02;
            Shot rod = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < 20 && rod == null; i++)
            {
                dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; if (dt.Sl(boost).Left < 1) dt.Sl(boost).Left = 1;
                await Frame();
                rod = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod && !was2.Contains(x));
            }
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 0; dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0;
            double sheet = dt.Stats["max_speed"];
            bool ok; string want;
            if (id == "chip_combat_t1")
            {
                ok = NearI(top, 249.6, 1e-2) && NearI(pepper, 8.1, 1e-6) && dart != null && NearI(dart.Damage, 8.1, 1e-6)
                     && rod != null && NearI(rod.Damage, 328.43, 0.05);
                want = "top 249.6, the dart 8.1 (x1), the rod 328.43";
            }
            else if (id == "burner_drive_t1")
            {
                ok = NearI(top, 422.5, 1e-2) && dart != null && NearI(dart.Damage, 11.25, 1e-9) && rod != null && NearI(rod.Damage, 360, 1e-9);
                want = "top 422.5, the dart 11.25, the rod 360 (the cap)";
            }
            else
            {
                double pepWant = 7.5 * (1 + 0.08 * Tiers.P(10));
                ok = NearI(t10, 249.6, 1e-2) && NearI(sheet, t10, 1e-6) && NearI(top, 249.6 * 1.5, 1e-2) && rod != null && NearI(rod.Damage, 328.43, 0.05)
                     && NearI(pepper, pepWant, 1e-6) && dart != null && NearI(dart.Damage, Bores.Price(pepWant, 249.6 * 1.5, 260, 1.5), 1e-3);
                want = $"top 249.6 (the price as written: {t10:0.00}), the rod 328.43, the dart {Bores.Price(pepWant, 249.6 * 1.5, 260, 1.5):0.000}";
            }
            Check(ok, $"{id} on the Dart{(boosted ? ", boosted" : "")}: top {top:0.00} u/s, a dart {dart?.Damage:0.000}, a sprint's rod {rod?.Damage:0.00} ({want})");
            dt.Demo = demo; dt.Trigger = false; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.3);
            await WornOffI(ShipClass.LightDart, was);
        }
    }

    // THE RECOIL ON THE OWNER'S OWN FALLING EDGE (kits6d-J13, the gate's fix): a sprint whose Left is zeroed from
    // outside its countdown -- as a guest's is when the host's packet lands before its own countdown crosses zero
    // (ApplyHostState) -- still keeps 30% of its speed on the next helm frame, and only once. Three situations: from
    // rest, already sliding sideways, the boost lit; each at a varied heading and moment into the 3 s run.
    async Task LaneA6dRodRecoilChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dt = Me; bool demo = dt.Demo; dt.AutopilotTo = null; dt.Demo = true;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        string boost = dt.Drive.Id;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = rot;
            dt.Velocity = run == 1 ? Vector2.Right.Rotated(rot) * Vary(80f, 160f) : Vector2.Zero;
            dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0; dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0;
            await Frame();
            dt.UseAbility("rod", 0);
            float cut = Vary(0.8f, 2.4f);
            double clock = 0; bool forced = false;
            while (clock < cut)
            {
                if (run == 2) dt.Sl(boost).Left = 1;
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime(); forced |= dt.Forced;
            }
            dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0;                              // the host's word, with no countdown crossing zero
            float before = dt.Velocity.Length();
            await Frame();
            float after = dt.Velocity.Length();
            await Frame();
            float next = dt.Velocity.Length();
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 0;
            float kept = before > 0 ? after / before : 0;
            Check(forced && before > 150f && Math.Abs(kept - 0.30f) <= 0.02f && next >= after * 0.9f && !dt.Forced,
                  $"a sprint {(run == 0 ? "from rest" : run == 1 ? "begun sliding sideways" : "with the boost lit")} whose Left is zeroed {cut:0.00} s in, not counted down: {kept * 100:0}% of its {before:0} u/s kept (30) on the next helm frame, and once ({next:0} after {after:0})");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.2);
        }
        dt.Demo = demo; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Position = yonder; dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, THE DART'S RAMJET (kits_v3 §3.6; v31 §3.4 and §7: the speed lifts add). Its rows; then from 3 varied
    // headings each: lit at the top with W held, the top {286, 338, 390, 390} +- 3 at {1, 3, 5, 7} s, a dart priced 11.25
    // at +50%, 0 by 9.0 s, 20 s from the press and a second press refused; a full turn for 1 s (timed from the first frame
    // at the full rate) takes 26 +- 3 off the top; the slide held 1 s takes nothing; a web holds it (no build); the rod
    // at the end of a lit sprint 339.2; the boost on top x2.0 = 520, and the build pausing while the hull climbs to it.
    void LaneA6dRamjetRowChecks()
    {
        var sh = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dart = Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightDart);
        Check(sh["ramjet_time"] == 8 && sh["ramjet_build"] == 0.10 && sh["ramjet_cap"] == 0.50 && sh["ramjet_bleed"] == 0.20 && sh["ramjet_cooldown"] == 20
              && dart.Abilities.Length >= 3 && dart.Abilities[2] == Ab.Ramjet && Ab.Ramjet.Ramp is { Build: "ramjet_build", Cap: "ramjet_cap", Bleed: "ramjet_bleed" }
              && Ab.Ramjet.Ramp.Condition != null && Ab.Ramjet.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q,
              $"the ramjet's rows: lit {sh["ramjet_time"]:0} s, +{sh["ramjet_build"]:0.00} a second to +{sh["ramjet_cap"]:0.00}, a full turn -{sh["ramjet_bleed"]:0.00} a second, {sh["ramjet_cooldown"]:0} s; the Dart's ability 2, on Q");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dRamjetChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dt = Me; bool demo = dt.Demo; dt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var W = global::Godot.Key.W;
        async Task AtTop(float rot)
        {   // flat out on a varied heading until the keel speed is at the sheet's top
            dt.Demo = false; dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 0; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0; dt.Sl("ramjet").Cool = 0;
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * 250f;
            KeyDown(W);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && dt.SpeedAhead < 259f; i++) await Frame();
        }
        double pepper = dt.Stats["pepper_damage"];

        // THE BUILD, timed from the press, the hull held straight and flat out
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            await AtTop(rot);
            dt.UseAbility("ramjet", 0);
            double cool0 = dt.Sl("ramjet").Cool;
            double l0 = dt.Sl("ramjet").Left; dt.UseAbility("ramjet", 0);
            bool refused = dt.Sl("ramjet").Left <= l0 && dt.Sl("ramjet").Cool <= cool0;
            var tops = new float[4]; var at = new[] { 1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 7.0 }; int k = 0;
            double clock = 0, zeroAt = -1, dart7 = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 11 && zeroAt < 0; i++)
            {
                dt.Rotation = rot;
                await Frame();
                clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (k < 4 && clock >= at[k]) { tops[k] = dt.TopNow; if (k == 3) dart7 = Bores.DamageOf(dt, Ab.Pepperbox.Bore); k++; }
                if (clock > 8.2 && dt.Sl("ramjet").Own <= 0) zeroAt = clock;
            }
            KeyUp(W);
            var want = new[] { 286f, 338f, 390f, 390f };
            bool ok = Enumerable.Range(0, 4).All(j => Mathf.Abs(tops[j] - want[j]) <= 3f);
            Check(ok && Math.Abs(dart7 - 11.25) < 0.02 && Math.Abs(pepper - 7.5) < 1e-9 && zeroAt > 0 && zeroAt <= 9.0 + 2.0 / 60 && Math.Abs(cool0 - 20) < 0.1 && refused,
                  $"the ramjet lit flat out on {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0}°: top {string.Join(" / ", tops.Select(x => x.ToString("0")))} at 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 s (286 / 338 / 390 / 390 +- 3), a dart then {dart7:0.00} (11.25), out and 0 by {zeroAt:0.00} s (9.0), cooldown {cool0:0.0} (20 from the press), a second press refused ({refused})");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Frame();
        }

        // A FULL TURN BLEEDS IT, THE SLIDE NEVER: at +50%, lit, flat out; the rudder hard over (timed from the first frame
        // the yaw reaches the hull's full rate) 1 s takes 26 +- 3 off the top; the slide held 1 s takes nothing
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            await AtTop(rot);
            dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = Vary(5f, 6.5f); dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0.5;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && dt.SpeedAhead < 385f; i++) await Frame();
            var rudder = run == 1 ? global::Godot.Key.A : global::Godot.Key.D;
            KeyDown(rudder);
            float turn = (float)dt.Stats["turn_rate"], lastRot = dt.Rotation, top0 = -1; double t = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && t < 1.0; i++)
            {
                await Frame();
                double d = GetProcessDeltaTime();
                float yaw = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(lastRot, dt.Rotation)) / (float)d; lastRot = dt.Rotation;
                if (top0 < 0 && yaw >= turn * 0.99f) top0 = dt.TopNow;
                else if (top0 >= 0) t += d;
            }
            float bled = top0 - dt.TopNow;
            KeyUp(rudder);
            // the slide: Shift + A/D, the nose held
            dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0.5; dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 3;
            await Frame();
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyDown(rudder);
            double own0 = dt.Sl("ramjet").Own;
            await Wait(1.0);
            double slid = dt.Sl("ramjet").Own;
            KeyUp(rudder); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.Shift); KeyUp(W);
            Check(top0 > 0 && Mathf.Abs(bled - 26f) <= 3f && slid >= own0 - 1e-6,
                  $"at +50% a full {(run == 1 ? "port" : "starboard")} turn for 1 s takes {bled:0.0} off the top (26 +- 3: -0.20 + 0.10 a second); a slide held 1 s leaves it at +{slid * 100:0.0}% (+50)");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 0; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0;
            await Frame();
        }

        // A WEB HOLDS IT: pinned (the throttle forced, the speed held under the pin's share of the top), 1.5 s lit builds nothing
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            await AtTop(rot);
            dt.Statuses.Apply(Status.Pinned, 3.0);
            await Wait(Vary(0.3f, 0.6f));
            dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 4; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0;
            await Wait(1.5);
            double own = dt.Sl("ramjet").Own;
            KeyUp(W); dt.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned);
            Check(own <= 1e-6, $"webbed at {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0}°, 1.5 s lit builds +{own * 100:0.0}% (nothing)");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 0; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0;
            await Frame();
        }

        // THE LIFTS ADD (v31 §3.4, §7): a rod at the end of a lit sprint at +50% carries 339.2; the boost on +50% is x2.0 =
        // 520; and the boost struck mid-build pauses it while the hull climbs to the new top
        dt.Demo = true;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0.5; dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 5;
            string boost = dt.Drive.Id;
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = Vary(1.0f, 2.5f);
            float boosted = dt.TopNow;
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 0;
            var was = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod).ToHashSet();
            dt.Sl("rod").Left = 0.02;
            Shot rod = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < 20 && rod == null; i++)
            {
                dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0.5;
                await Frame();
