                rod = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod && !was.Contains(x));
            }
            Check(Mathf.Abs(boosted - 520f) < 0.5f && rod != null && Math.Abs(rod.Damage - 339.23) < 0.01,
                  $"at +50%: boosted the top is {boosted:0} (520 = x2.0); a rod at the end of a lit sprint carries {rod?.Damage:0.0} (339.2 at 490)");
            dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 0; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0;
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle();
            await AtTop(rot);
            dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 6; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = Vary(0.10f, 0.25f);
            await Wait(0.8);                                          // flat out at the lit top
            string boost = dt.Drive.Id;
            double own0 = dt.Sl("ramjet").Own;
            dt.Sl(boost).Left = 3;
            await Wait(0.25);
            double own1 = dt.Sl("ramjet").Own;
            float gap = dt.TopNow - dt.SpeedAhead;
            KeyUp(W); dt.Sl(boost).Left = 0;
            Check(own1 - own0 < 0.005 && gap > 0.05f * dt.TopNow,
                  $"the boost struck at +{own0 * 100:0}%: 0.25 s later +{own1 * 100:0.0}% (paused: the hull {gap:0} u/s under its new top)");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 0; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0;
            await Frame();
        }
        dt.Demo = demo; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Position = yonder;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S RAMJET, PRICED ON THE HOST. The guest (LaneA6dRamjetGuestChecks) flies flat out and
    // straight on a varied heading, lights the ramjet and holds on 6 s: its own total +50%. The host (LaneA6dRamjetHostWatch)
    // steps ITS copy from the guest's reports and prices from it: 5.5 s into the lit run its copy reads +50% and a dart of
    // the guest's is 11.25 within 1%.
    sealed class LaneA6dRamjetSeen { public double Own = -1, Dart = -1; public bool Done; }
    LateSampler LaneA6dRamjetHostWatch(LaneA6dRamjetSeen seen)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightDart } g) return false;
            ref var sl = ref g.Sl("ramjet");
            if (sl.Left <= 0 || sl.Left > g.Stats["ramjet_time"] - 5.5) return false;
            seen.Own = sl.Own; seen.Dart = Bores.DamageOf(g, Ab.Pepperbox.Bore); seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dRamjetHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dRamjetSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 60 : 40);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Done && Math.Abs(seen.Own - 0.5) <= 0.005 && Math.Abs(seen.Dart - 11.25) <= 11.25 * 0.01,
              $"arena host: its own copy of the guest's ramjet 5.5 s lit reads +{seen.Own * 100:0.0}% (50), and prices the guest's dart at {seen.Dart:0.00} (11.25 within 1%)");
    }
    async Task LaneA6dRamjetGuestChecks()
    {
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = false;
        float rot = VaryAngle();
        me.Rotation = rot; me.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * 250f;
        KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && me.SpeedAhead < 259f; i++) { me.Rotation = rot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        me.UseAbility("ramjet", 0);
        double own = 0;
        for (double t = 0; t < 6.5; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
        {
            me.Rotation = rot;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            own = me.Sl("ramjet").Own;
        }
        KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
        me.Demo = demo; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Check(Math.Abs(own - 0.5) <= 0.005, $"arena guest: its ramjet flown flat out and straight on {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0}° builds its own total to +{own * 100:0.0}% (50)");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S SLINGSHOT ON A LIT RAMJET (dart.md Interactions: "a snap, not a turn, so it never bleeds a
    // lit Ramjet"; DL5: the host's copy skips the report). The guest (LaneA6dSlingGuestChecks), its ramjet cooled after the
    // ramjet pair, flies flat out on a varied heading, lights it again and, 4.5 s lit, slings 120-170° to a varied side: its
    // own total kept and its nose on the cursor. The host (LaneA6dSlingHostWatch) reads ITS copy 4.5 s into that lit run
    // (+45%, at least +44%), then the last frame before the sling reaches it and 0.6 s after: the snap bled nothing (within
    // 0.005), whichever of the reliable press and the unreliable report that carries the snapped heading landed first.
    sealed class LaneA6dSlingSeen { public double At45 = -1, Last = -1, Before = -1, After = -1, T; public int Stage; public bool Done; }
    LateSampler LaneA6dSlingHostWatch(LaneA6dSlingSeen seen, LaneA6dRamjetSeen ramjet)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || !ramjet.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightDart } g) return false;
            ref var sl = ref g.Sl("ramjet");
            double lit = g.Stats["ramjet_time"];
            switch (seen.Stage)
            {
                case 0: if (sl.Left > lit - 1.0) seen.Stage = 1; return false;          // a fresh light, after the ramjet pair's
                case 1:
                    if (sl.Left <= 0) { seen.Stage = 0; return false; }
                    if (sl.Left <= lit - 4.5) { seen.At45 = seen.Last = sl.Own; seen.Stage = 2; }
                    return false;
                case 2:
                    if (g.Sl("slingshot").Cool > 0) { seen.Before = seen.Last; seen.T = 0; seen.Stage = 3; }
                    else seen.Last = sl.Own;
                    return false;
                default:
                    seen.T += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                    if (seen.T < 0.6) return false;
                    seen.After = sl.Own; seen.Done = true;
                    return true;
            }
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dSlingHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dSlingSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 90 : 60);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Done && seen.At45 >= 0.44 && seen.After >= seen.Before - 0.005,
              $"arena host: its copy of the guest's ramjet 4.5 s lit reads +{seen.At45 * 100:0.0}% (at least 44); slung, +{seen.Before * 100:0.00}% before and +{seen.After * 100:0.00}% 0.6 s after (kept within 0.5: a snap, not a turn)");
    }
    async Task LaneA6dSlingGuestChecks()
    {
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = false;
        var W = global::Godot.Key.W;
        await RealTime(() => me.Sl("ramjet").Left <= 0 && me.Sl("ramjet").Cool <= 0 && me.Sl("slingshot").Cool <= 0, Wan ? 40 : 30);
        await Wait(0.5);                                                    // the host's copy has cooled a report before this one
        float rot = VaryAngle();
        me.Rotation = rot; me.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * 250f;
        KeyDown(W);
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && me.SpeedAhead < 259f; i++) { me.Rotation = rot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        me.UseAbility("ramjet", 0);
        double lit = me.Stats["ramjet_time"];
        for (double t = 0; t < 8 && !(me.Sl("ramjet").Left > 0 && me.Sl("ramjet").Left <= lit - 4.5); t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
        { me.Rotation = rot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        double own0 = me.Sl("ramjet").Own;
        float side = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f, off = Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(120f, 170f)) * side;
        var from = me.Position;
        var aim = from + Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot + off) * 500f;
        me.AimPoint = aim;
        me.UseAbility("slingshot", 0);
        bool onIt = Vector2.Up.Rotated(me.Rotation).Dot((aim - from).Normalized()) > 0.9999f;
        float rot2 = me.Rotation; double own1 = own0;
        for (double t = 0; t < 0.6; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
        { me.Rotation = rot2; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); own1 = me.Sl("ramjet").Own; }
        KeyUp(W);
        me.Demo = demo; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Check(own0 >= 0.44 && onIt && own1 >= own0 - 0.005,
              $"arena guest: its ramjet 4.5 s lit at +{own0 * 100:0.0}%, slung {Mathf.RadToDeg(off):0}° onto its cursor ({onIt}): +{own1 * 100:0.0}% 0.6 s on (kept)");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S SLIPSTREAM, JUDGED ON THE HOST FROM ITS REPORT (PlayerShip.SlipShare: a guest's speed is
    // its report's, held to SlipSpeed's ceiling). The guest (LaneA6dSlipGuestChecks) sits still, then flies flat out on a
    // varied heading and presses V. The host (LaneA6dSlipHostWatch) strikes ITS copy with 10 at rest (x1: 10), then once
    // the boost is lit and its judged speed has held past 325 u/s for 0.15 s (x0.7: 7.0); the guest's own hull falls by
    // the host's figures.
    sealed class LaneA6dSlipSeen { public double Rest = -1, Fast = -1, Held; public int Stage; public bool Done; }
    LateSampler LaneA6dSlipHostWatch(LaneA6dSlipSeen seen, LaneA6dSlingSeen sling)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || !sling.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightDart } g) return false;
            string boost = g.Drive.Id;
            if (seen.Stage == 0)
            {   // at rest, the ramjet and the boost out: the whole blow
                if (g.Sl("ramjet").Left > 0 || g.Sl(boost).Left > 0 || g.Velocity.Length() > 5f || g.SlipShare() < 1) { seen.Held = 0; return false; }
                if ((seen.Held += GetProcessDeltaTime()) < 0.5) return false;
                double h0 = g.Hp; g.Hit(10, g.Position + Vector2.Right * 60f, "test:6d_slip5#0"); seen.Rest = h0 - g.Hp;
                seen.Stage = 1; seen.Held = 0;
                return false;
            }
            if (g.Sl(boost).Left <= 0 || g.SlipShare() >= 1) { seen.Held = 0; return false; }
            if ((seen.Held += GetProcessDeltaTime()) < 0.15) return false;
            double h1 = g.Hp; g.Hit(10, g.Position + Vector2.Right * 60f, "test:6d_slip5#1"); seen.Fast = h1 - g.Hp;
            seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dSlipHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dSlipSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 60 : 40);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Done && Math.Abs(seen.Rest - 10) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(seen.Fast - 7.0) < 1e-6,
              $"arena host: a blow of 10 on its copy of the guest's Dart lands {seen.Rest:0.00} at rest (10) and {seen.Fast:0.00} boosted past 325 u/s by its report (7.0: x0.7)");
    }
    async Task LaneA6dSlipGuestChecks()
    {
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = false;
        var W = global::Godot.Key.W; string boost = me.Drive.Id;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 200) < 1e-6 && me.Sl("ramjet").Left <= 0 && me.Sl(boost).Left <= 0 && me.Sl(boost).Cool <= 0, Wan ? 20 : 12);
        double rest = -1, prev = me.Hp;
        for (double t = 0; t < (Wan ? 20 : 12) && rest < 0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
        {
            me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            if (prev - me.Hp > 0.5) rest = prev - me.Hp;
            prev = me.Hp;
        }
        float rot = VaryAngle();
        me.Rotation = rot; me.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * 250f;
        KeyDown(W);
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && me.SpeedAhead < 259f; i++) { me.Rotation = rot; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        me.DriveHeld = true; me.PressDrive();
        double fast = -1, tLit = -1, tHit = -1; prev = me.Hp;
        for (double t = 0; t < (Wan ? 6 : 4) && fast < 0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
        {
            me.Rotation = rot;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            if (tLit < 0 && me.Sl(boost).Left > 0) tLit = t;
            if (prev - me.Hp > 0.5) { fast = prev - me.Hp; tHit = t; }
            prev = me.Hp;
        }
        me.DriveHeld = false; KeyUp(W);
        me.Demo = demo; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Check(Math.Abs(rest - 10) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(fast - 7.0) < 0.01 && tLit >= 0,
              $"arena guest: its own hull fell {rest:0.00} under the host's blow at rest (10) and {fast:0.00} boosted flat out on {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0}° (7.0: the host judged it past 325), {tHit - tLit:0.00} s after its boost showed");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, THE DART'S SLINGSHOT (kits_v2's card; v31 §3.4). From 3 varied situations each: the nose and the whole
    // velocity (a slide included) onto the cursor's bearing at up to 180°, the size kept +- 1%, 6 s and a second press
    // refused; a lit Ramjet keeps its total through the snap; a sprint slung mid-run fires its rod down the new nose.
    async Task LaneA6dSlingChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dt = Me; bool demo = dt.Demo; dt.Demo = true; dt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        Check(Ab.Slingshot.TakesPoint && Ab.Slingshot.AtOnce != null && Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightDart).Abilities.Length >= 4
              && Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightDart).Abilities[3] == Ab.Slingshot && dt.Stats["sling_cooldown"] == 6,
              $"the slingshot: the Dart's ability 3 (E), it takes the cursor, snaps on the owner at once, {dt.Stats["sling_cooldown"]:0} s (6)");
        // THE SNAP ON THE SHIP: forward, a slide, and nearly dead astern (170-179°), each onto a varied cursor
        foreach (var (lo, hi, slide) in new[] { (20f, 80f, false), (90f, 150f, true), (170f, 179f, true) })
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot); var side = new Vector2(-nose.Y, nose.X);
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            var v0 = nose * Vary(150f, 300f) + (slide ? side * Vary(-130f, 130f) : Vector2.Zero);
            float off = Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(lo, hi)) * (Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f);
            var cursor = at + nose.Rotated(off) * Vary(200f, 600f);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = v0; dt.AimPoint = cursor; dt.Sl("slingshot").Cool = 0;
            dt.UseAbility("slingshot", 0);
            var bearing = (cursor - at).Normalized();
            var noseNow = Vector2.Up.Rotated(dt.Rotation);
            bool onIt = noseNow.Dot(bearing) > 0.9999f && dt.Velocity.Normalized().Dot(bearing) > 0.9999f
                        && Mathf.Abs(dt.Velocity.Length() - v0.Length()) <= v0.Length() * 0.01f;
            double cool = dt.Sl("slingshot").Cool; float rotWas = dt.Rotation;
            dt.AimPoint = at + nose * 400f;
            dt.UseAbility("slingshot", 0);
            bool refused = Mathf.Abs(dt.Rotation - rotWas) < 1e-6f && dt.Sl("slingshot").Cool <= cool;
            Check(onIt && Math.Abs(cool - 6) < 0.05 && refused,
                  $"slung {Mathf.RadToDeg(off):0}° off the nose{(slide ? " while sliding" : "")}: nose and velocity on the cursor ({onIt}), {dt.Velocity.Length():0} u/s kept ({v0.Length():0}), cooldown {cool:0.0} (6), a second press refused ({refused})");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Frame();
        }
        // THE RAMJET KEPT: lit at a varied total, slung 60-179° off, a frame on it holds what it had
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = nose * Vary(250f, 350f); dt.Sl("slingshot").Cool = 0;
            dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = Vary(3f, 6f); double own0 = Vary(0.2f, 0.5f); dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = own0;
            dt.AimPoint = at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(60f, 179f)) * (run == 1 ? -1f : 1f)) * Vary(300f, 600f);
            dt.UseAbility("slingshot", 0);
            await Frame(); await Frame();
            double own1 = dt.Sl("ramjet").Own;
            Check(own1 >= own0 - 1e-6, $"a lit ramjet at +{own0 * 100:0.0}% slung {(run == 1 ? "to port" : "to starboard")}: +{own1 * 100:0.0}% after (kept: a snap is not a turn)");
            dt.Sl("ramjet").Left = 0; dt.Sl("ramjet").Own = 0; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Frame();
        }
        // THE ROD RE-AIMED: slung in the sprint's last moments, the rod leaves down the new nose
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
            dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = nose * Vary(300f, 360f); dt.Sl("slingshot").Cool = 0;
            var was = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod).ToHashSet();
            dt.Sl("rod").Left = Vary(0.15f, 0.3f);
            var cursor = at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(60f, 170f)) * (run == 1 ? -1f : 1f)) * Vary(400f, 700f);
            dt.AimPoint = cursor;
            dt.UseAbility("slingshot", 0);
            var newNose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(dt.Rotation);
            Shot rod = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < 40 && rod == null; i++) { await Frame(); rod = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod && !was.Contains(x)); }
            bool down = rod != null && rod.Dir.Dot(newNose) > 0.999f;
            Check(down, $"a sprint slung {Mathf.RadToDeg(nose.AngleTo(newNose)):0}° in its last moments: the rod leaves down the new nose ({(rod == null ? "no rod" : Mathf.RadToDeg(rod.Dir.AngleTo(newNose)).ToString("0.0") + "° off it")})");
            dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        dt.Demo = demo; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Position = yonder; dt.Sl("slingshot").Cool = 0; dt.Sl("rod").Cool = 0;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, THE DART'S SLIPSTREAM (a stat row, never the class). The host's ceiling on a reported speed on literals
    // (hypot(260, 130) x 1.1 = 319.8 u/s; a boosted slide's 436 is under its 479.6, from 3 varied boosted slides); then a
    // blow from 3 sources (a hit with a side, a plain one, a boss's slug) at a speed varied just under 325 and just over:
    // x1 and x0.7; an Echo past 325 takes x1.
    async Task LaneA6dSlipChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        bool litOk = Mathf.Abs(PlayerShip.SlipSpeed(new Vector2(500, 0), 260f, 130f) - 319.8f) < 0.1f
                     && Mathf.Abs(PlayerShip.SlipSpeed(new Vector2(0, 436f), 390f, 195f) - 436f) < 1e-3f;
        string ls = ""; bool boostedOk = true;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            float along = Vary(200f, 390f), across = Vary(-195f, 195f);
            var v = new Vector2(across, -along).Rotated(VaryAngle());
            float got = PlayerShip.SlipSpeed(v, 390f, 195f);
            boostedOk &= Mathf.Abs(got - v.Length()) < 1e-3f; ls += $"{v.Length():0}->{got:0}; ";
        }
        Check(litOk && boostedOk, $"the host's ceiling on a reported speed: 500 -> 319.8 at 260 / 130; a boosted slide never clamped ({ls})");

        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var dt = Me; bool demo = dt.Demo; dt.Demo = true; dt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        Check(dt.Stats["slip_guard"] == 0.7 && dt.Stats["slip_speed"] == 325, $"the Dart's slipstream: x{dt.Stats["slip_guard"]:0.00} (0.7) at {dt.Stats["slip_speed"]:0} u/s (325)");
        int n = 0;
        for (int src = 0; src < 3; src++)
        {
            foreach (bool fast in new[] { false, true })
            {
                float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
                // a direct blow is judged at once; the slug a frame later, after the water's drag: a wider margin
                float speed = src < 2 ? (fast ? Vary(325.5f, 326.5f) : Vary(323.5f, 324.5f)) : (fast ? Vary(335f, 350f) : Vary(295f, 315f));
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = nose * speed; dt.Hp = dt.MaxHp;
                double hp0 = dt.Hp, blow = Vary(8f, 20f);
                if (src == 0) dt.Hit(blow, at + nose * 60f, $"test:6d_slip#{++n}");
                else if (src == 1) dt.TakeDamage(blow);
                else
                {
                    var from = at + nose.Rotated(Mathf.Pi / 2) * 40f;
                    Combat.Fire(Shots.Slug, from, at - from, 300f, 200f, blow, hitSource: $"test:6d_slipslug#{++n}");
                    for (int i = 0; i < 20 && dt.Hp == hp0; i++) { dt.Position = at; dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = nose * speed; await Frame(); }
                }
                double took = hp0 - dt.Hp, want = blow * (fast ? 0.7 : 1.0);
                Check(Math.Abs(took - want) < 1e-6, $"a {(src == 0 ? "blow with a side" : src == 1 ? "plain blow" : "boss's slug")} of {blow:0.0} at {speed:0.0} u/s: {took:0.00} taken ({want:0.00}: x{(fast ? "0.7" : "1")})");
            }
        }
        // THE BOOST INTERACTION (dart.md: "Boost pushes a Dart above 325 u/s (Slipstream) within 0.4 s"): flat out at the
        // sheet's top a blow of 10 lands whole; V, and from the first frame the boost shows the hull is past 325 within 0.4 s;
        // a frame on, the same blow lands 7.0 (x0.7) -- 3 varied headings and sides of the blow
        var W = global::Godot.Key.W; string drive = dt.Drive.Id;
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            float rot = VaryAngle(); var nose = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot);
            dt.Demo = false; dt.Sl(drive).Left = 0; dt.Sl(drive).Cool = 0;
            dt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); dt.Rotation = rot; dt.Velocity = nose * 250f; dt.Hp = dt.MaxHp;
            KeyDown(W);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && dt.SpeedAhead < 259f; i++) { dt.Rotation = rot; await Frame(); }
            float flat = dt.Velocity.Length();
            var side = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 60f;
            double h0 = dt.Hp; dt.Hit(10, dt.Position + side, $"test:6d_slipv#{++n}"); double whole = h0 - dt.Hp;
            Key(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && dt.Sl(drive).Left <= 0; i++) { dt.Rotation = rot; await Frame(); }
            bool lit = dt.Sl(drive).Left > 0;
            double t = 0;
            while (lit && dt.Velocity.Length() < 325f && t < 1.5) { dt.Rotation = rot; await Frame(); t += GetProcessDeltaTime(); }
            await Frame();
            float fast = dt.Velocity.Length();
            h0 = dt.Hp; dt.Hit(10, dt.Position + side, $"test:6d_slipv#{++n}"); double cut = h0 - dt.Hp;
            KeyUp(W);
            Check(lit && flat < 325f && Math.Abs(whole - 10) < 1e-6 && t <= 0.4 && fast >= 325f && Math.Abs(cut - 7.0) < 1e-6,
                  $"flat out at {flat:0} u/s on {Mathf.RadToDeg(rot):0}°: a blow of 10 lands {whole:0.00} (10); boosted ({lit}), past 325 u/s {t:0.00} s after the boost showed (within 0.4), and at {fast:0} u/s the blow lands {cut:0.00} (7.0)");
            dt.Sl(drive).Left = 0; dt.Sl(drive).Cool = 0; dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Hp = dt.MaxHp;
            await Frame();
        }
        dt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; dt.Demo = demo; dt.Hp = dt.MaxHp;
        // BY THE STAT, NEVER THE CLASS: an Echo past 325 takes the whole blow
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var ec = Me; bool ecDemo = ec.Demo; ec.Demo = true;
        float fastEcho = Vary(330f, 360f); double b2 = Vary(8f, 20f);
        ec.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(ec.Rotation) * fastEcho; ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp;
        double e0 = ec.Hp; ec.TakeDamage(b2);
        Check(Math.Abs(e0 - ec.Hp - b2) < 1e-6, $"an Echo at {fastEcho:0} u/s takes {e0 - ec.Hp:0.00} of {b2:0.00} (x1: no slipstream row)");
        ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.Demo = ecDemo; ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE ECHO'S REPEATER (kits_v2's card): 22 every 0.5 s, and each round again at 11 from the muzzle it
    // left, along its bearing, 0.6 s later, straight (Shots row "echo") = 66 DPS; hull 180; Reverb learned first.
    void LaneA6dRepeaterRowChecks()
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var row = Shots.Of(Shots.Echo);
        var kit = Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightEcho).Abilities.Select(a => a.Id).ToArray();
        Check(st["hull"] == 180 && st["main_damage"] == 22 && st["main_interval"] == 0.5 && st["main_range"] == 500 && st["shell_speed"] == 620
              && st["echo_share"] == 0.5 && st["echo_delay"] == 0.6 && Math.Abs(st.MainDps - 44) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Dps.Repeat.Rate(st) - 22) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Dps.Main.Rate(st) + Dps.Repeat.Rate(st) - 66) < 1e-9
              && row.Id == "echo" && !row.Guided && row.Stops == 1 && row.Command == 0 && !row.AtPlayers && row.Look == ShotLook.Ghost
              && kit.SequenceEqual(new[] { "guns", "firemode", "reverb" }),
              $"the Echo row: hull {st["hull"]:0} (180), 22 every 0.5 s to 500 u at 620 u/s, its echo x{st["echo_share"]:0.00} after {st["echo_delay"]:0.00} s = 44 + {Dps.Repeat.Rate(st):0} = 66 DPS; row echo straight, one body, a ghost; learns {string.Join(",", kit)}");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dRepeaterChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var ec = Me; bool demo = ec.Demo; ec.Demo = true; ec.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double Landed() => ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell") + ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("echo");
        bool Mine(Shot x, int kind) => x.Kind == kind && x.Source == ec;

        // 66 DPS LANDED on a still hostile 200-450 u off at a varied bearing: the 6.25 s from the first round to land
        // hold 12 rounds (22) and 12 echoes (11) = 396, a quarter second clear of every edge
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 450f);
            var foe = HeldI(spot, Enemies.Gunship);
            ec.Position = at; ec.Rotation = rot; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.AimPoint = spot;
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.2; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; foe.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            double d0 = Landed(), tFirst = -1, landed0 = 0, clock = 0;
            ec.Trigger = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12 && (tFirst < 0 || clock - tFirst < 6.25); i++)
            {
                ec.Position = at; ec.Rotation = rot; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.AimPoint = foe.Position = spot;
                await Frame();
                clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (tFirst < 0 && Landed() > d0) { tFirst = clock; landed0 = Landed(); }
            }
            ec.Trigger = false;
            double got = Landed() - landed0, echoes = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("echo");
            Check(tFirst >= 0 && Math.Abs(got - 396) <= 396 * 0.03 && echoes > 0,
                  $"the repeater at a still hostile {spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u off: {got:0.0} landed in the 6.25 s after the first round (396 = 12 x 22 + 12 x 11: 66 DPS, +-3%), echoes among it");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(1.0);
        }

        // THE ECHO LEAVES THE RECORDED MUZZLE ALONG THE RECORDED BEARING, 0.6 s after its round, at 11 of its 22 -- the
        // Echo having slid 150-250 u and turned since, a raider jinking across its path: the echo does not curve
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var aim = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 450f);
            ec.Position = at; ec.Rotation = rot; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.AimPoint = aim;
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.2; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); }
            var before = Nodes<Shot>().ToHashSet();
            ec.Trigger = true; await Frame(); ec.Trigger = false;
            var shell = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => Mine(x, Shots.Shell) && !before.Contains(x));
            Vector2 shellAt = shell?.Position ?? Vector2.Zero, shellDir = shell?.Dir ?? Vector2.Zero; double shellDmg = shell?.Damage ?? 0;
            var side = new Vector2(-(aim - at).Y, (aim - at).X).Normalized();
            var jinker = HeldI(at + (aim - at) * 0.5f + side * 120f, Enemies.Gunship);
            var moveTo = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 250f); float turnTo = rot + Vary(0.6f, 2.4f);
            Shot echo = null; double clock = 0, echoT = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 90 && echo == null; i++)
            {
                ec.Position = at.Lerp(moveTo, (float)Math.Min(1, clock / 0.3)); ec.Rotation = turnTo; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                jinker.Position += side * (clock > 0.3 ? -6f : 6f);
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                echo = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => Mine(x, Shots.Echo) && !before.Contains(x));
                if (echo != null) echoT = clock;
            }
            var eDir0 = echo?.Dir ?? Vector2.Zero; var eAt = echo?.Position ?? Vector2.Zero; double eDmg = echo?.Damage ?? 0;
            for (double t = 0; t < 0.3 && echo != null && IsInstanceValid(echo); t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
            { jinker.Position += side * 5f; await Frame(); }
            var eDir1 = echo != null && IsInstanceValid(echo) ? echo.Dir : eDir0;
            float across = Mathf.Abs((eAt - shellAt).Cross(shellDir)), along = (eAt - shellAt).Dot(shellDir);
            Check(shell != null && echo != null && Math.Abs(echoT - 0.6) <= 0.035 && across < 1f && along > -1f && along < 14f
                  && eDir0.DistanceTo(shellDir) < 1e-3f && eDir1.DistanceTo(eDir0) < 1e-4f && Math.Abs(eDmg - 11) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(shellDmg - 22) < 1e-9
                  && eAt.DistanceTo(ec.Position) > 100f,
                  $"an echo after the Echo slid {at.DistanceTo(moveTo):0} u and turned: {echoT:0.000} s after its round (0.6), {across:0.00} u off the round's line and {along:0.0} u along it from where the round was first seen, on the round's bearing ({Mathf.RadToDeg(eDir0.AngleTo(shellDir)):0.00}°), straight past a jinking raider ({Mathf.RadToDeg(eDir1.AngleTo(eDir0)):0.000}°), {eDmg:0.0} of the round's {shellDmg:0} (11 of 22)");
            jinker.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(1.2);
        }
        ec.Demo = demo; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE ECHO'S REVERB (kits_v2's card): 5 s of guns at x1.2 while it stores what they deal (their echoes
    // included), then 35% of the store on every hostile within 220 u of the last hit; 18 s from the press.
    async Task LaneA6dReverbChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var ec = Me; bool demo = ec.Demo; ec.Demo = true; ec.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        void Ready() { ec.Sl("reverb").Left = 0; ec.Sl("reverb").Cool = 0; ec.Sl("reverb").Own = 0; }
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var rv = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.LightEcho, "reverb");
        Check(st["reverb_time"] == 5 && st["reverb_rate"] == 1.2 && st["reverb_share"] == 0.35 && st["reverb_radius"] == 220 && st["reverb_cooldown"] == 18
              && rv?.RateStat == "reverb_rate" && rv?.Default == global::Godot.Key.F,
              $"the Reverb row: {st["reverb_time"]:0} s (5), x{st["reverb_rate"]:0.0} rate (1.2), {st["reverb_share"]:0.00} of the store (0.35) in {st["reverb_radius"]:0} u (220), {st["reverb_cooldown"]:0} s (18), on F");

        // THE RATE: 6 rounds in the 2.3 s from the first while it runs (every 0.4167 s), 5 with it down (every 0.5 s)
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); var aim = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 450f);
            int[] got = new int[2];
            foreach (bool lit in new[] { true, false })
            {
                Ready();
                ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.AimPoint = aim;
                await Wait(0.8);
                if (lit) { ec.UseAbility("reverb", 0); for (int i = 0; i < 30 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left <= 0; i++) await Frame(); }
                var seen = Nodes<Shot>().ToHashSet(); double clock = 0, tFirst = -1;
                ec.Trigger = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5 && (tFirst < 0 || clock - tFirst < 2.3); i++)
                {
                    ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                    foreach (var x in Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Shell && x.Source == ec && seen.Add(x)).ToList())
                    { if (tFirst < 0) tFirst = clock; if (clock - tFirst < 2.3) got[lit ? 0 : 1]++; }
                }
                ec.Trigger = false;
            }
            Check(got[0] == 6 && got[1] == 5,
                  $"the reverb's x1.2: {got[0]} rounds in the 2.3 s from the first while it runs (6, every 0.417 s), {got[1]} with it down (5, every 0.5 s)");
            Ready(); await Wait(1.0);
        }

        // THE BLAST: 35% of a varied store on the last hit's mark and on a hostile 219 u from it; nothing 221 u off;
        // the cooldown 18 from the press, a second press inside it refused
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            var markAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 350f);
            float a = VaryAngle();
            var inAt = markAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a) * 219f; var outAt = markAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a + Vary(1.2f, 2.0f)) * 221f;
            var mark = HeldI(markAt, Enemies.Gunship); var inner = HeldI(inAt, Enemies.Gunship); var outer = HeldI(outAt, Enemies.Gunship);
            await Frame();
            ec.UseAbility("reverb", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left <= 0; i++) await Frame();
            double cool0 = ec.Sl("reverb").Cool, left0 = ec.Sl("reverb").Left;
            double store = Vary(60f, 200f);
            ec.NoteDealt(store * 0.4, outer, "shell"); ec.NoteDealt(store * 0.6, mark, "shell");   // the last hit is the mark's
            ec.UseAbility("reverb", 0); await Frame();
            bool refused = ec.Sl("reverb").Left < left0 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left > 4.5;
            double m0 = mark.Hp, i0 = inner.Hp, o0 = outer.Hp;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 7 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left > 0; i++) { mark.Position = markAt; inner.Position = inAt; outer.Position = outAt; await Frame(); }
            await Wait(0.1);
            double want = store * 0.35;
            Check(Math.Abs(m0 - mark.Hp - want) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(i0 - inner.Hp - want) < 1e-6 && o0 == outer.Hp && Math.Abs(cool0 - 18) < 0.1 && refused,
                  $"the reverb's blast of a {store:0.0} store: {m0 - mark.Hp:0.00} on the last hit's mark, {i0 - inner.Hp:0.00} at 219 u ({want:0.00} = 35%), {o0 - outer.Hp:0.00} at 221 u (0); cooling {cool0:0.00} s at the press (18), a second press refused ({refused})");
            mark.TakeDamage(1e12); inner.TakeDamage(1e12); outer.TakeDamage(1e12);
            Ready(); await Wait(0.3);
        }

        // THE REPEATER THROUGH THE REVERB: the rounds AND their echoes that land while it runs are what it stores, and the
        // blast is 35% of exactly that -- at a still hostile 200-450 u off, 3 bearings
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 450f);
            var foe = HeldI(spot, Enemies.Gunship);
            ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.AimPoint = spot;
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.2; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { ec.Position = at; foe.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            ec.UseAbility("reverb", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left <= 0; i++) await Frame();
            double s0 = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell"), e0 = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("echo");
            ec.Trigger = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3; i++) { ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; foe.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            ec.Trigger = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left > 0.3; i++) { foe.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            double stored = ec.Sl("reverb").Own;
            double shells = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("shell") - s0, echoes = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("echo") - e0;
            double r0 = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Reverb);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left > 0; i++) { foe.Position = spot; await Frame(); }
            await Wait(0.1);
            double blast = ec.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Reverb) - r0;
            Check(echoes > 0 && Math.Abs(stored - (shells + echoes)) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(blast - stored * 0.35) < 1e-6,
                  $"the reverb over the repeater {at.DistanceTo(spot):0} u off: stored {stored:0.0} = rounds {shells:0.0} + their echoes {echoes:0.0}; its blast {blast:0.00} = 35%");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            Ready(); await Wait(1.0);
        }
        ec.Demo = demo; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE ECHO'S REWIND (kits_v2's card, the README ruling): back 8 s -- position, heading, velocity AND hull
    // -- to the mark nearest 8 s ago (a mark every 0.5 s; the oldest with less history); the speed held to the top it has
    // now; the boost's time not rewound; every web let go; 30 s; refused wrecked or disabled.
    void LaneA6dRewindRowChecks()
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var kit = Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightEcho).Abilities.Select(a => a.Id).ToArray();
        // THE TRAIL ON ITS OWN, at 60 frames a second from three varied clocks: the mark nearest now - 8, and with 2-4 s of
        // history the oldest
        bool pure = true; string ps = "";
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            var tr = new Trail(); double now = Vary(9f, 20f), t = 0;
            for (; t <= now; t += 1.0 / 60) tr.Note(t, 0.5, 8, new Mark(0, new Vector2((float)t, 0), 0, Vector2.Zero, t));
            var m = tr.Back(t, 8);
            var sh = new Trail(); double start = Vary(0f, 5f), span = Vary(2f, 4f), u = start;
            for (; u <= start + span; u += 1.0 / 60) sh.Note(u, 0.5, 8, new Mark(0, Vector2.Zero, 0, Vector2.Zero, u));
            var o = sh.Back(u, 8);
            bool ok = m is { } mm && Math.Abs(mm.T - (t - 8)) <= 0.25 + 1.0 / 60 && mm.Hull == mm.T && o is { } oo && Math.Abs(oo.T - start) < 1e-9;
            pure &= ok; ps += $" {t:0.0}s -> {m?.T:0.00} / {span:0.0}s of history -> {o?.T - start:0.00}";
        }
        Check(st["rewind_back"] == 8 && st["rewind_every"] == 0.5 && st["rewind_cooldown"] == 30 && Trail.Size(8, 0.5) >= 17
              && kit.SequenceEqual(new[] { "guns", "firemode", "reverb", "rewind" }) && Ab.Rewind.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q && pure,
              $"the Rewind row: {st["rewind_back"]:0} s back (8), a mark every {st["rewind_every"]:0.0} s (0.5), {st["rewind_cooldown"]:0} s (30), on Q, learned second; the trail:{ps} (nearest now - 8 within 0.25 s; the oldest)");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dRewindChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var ec = Me; bool demo = ec.Demo; ec.Demo = true; ec.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var stasis = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        var log = new List<(double T, Vector2 At, float Rot, Vector2 V, double Hp)>();
        // flies a circle for `secs` (speed well under the top), a varied blow every 1.3 s, logging each frame's end
        async Task<double> Fly(double secs, float speed, bool hits)
        {
            log.Clear(); ec.Past.Clear();
            var centre = ec.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 300f);
            float r = ec.Position.DistanceTo(centre), w = speed / r * (Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f);
            double clock = 0, nextHit = Vary(0.4f, 1.0f);
            while (clock < secs)
            {
                var radial = (ec.Position - centre).Normalized();
                var tangent = new Vector2(-radial.Y, radial.X) * Mathf.Sign(w);
                ec.Velocity = tangent * speed; ec.Rotation = tangent.Angle() + Mathf.Pi / 2;
                if (hits && clock >= nextHit) { ec.TakeDamage(Vary(4f, 9f)); nextHit += 1.3; }
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                log.Add((clock, ec.Position, ec.Rotation, ec.Velocity, ec.Hp));
            }
            return clock;
        }
        (int i, float d) Nearest(Vector2 at)
        {
            int bi = -1; float bd = float.MaxValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < log.Count; i++) { float d = log[i].At.DistanceTo(at); if (d < bd) { bd = d; bi = i; } }
            return (bi, bd);
        }

        // THE EFFECT: after 9-20 s of flight with blows taken, the press puts position, heading, velocity and hull where
        // one frame 8 s ago (+-0.25 s) had them -- three clocks, three circles
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            ec.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp; ec.Sl("rewind").Cool = 0;
            double now = await Fly(Vary(9f, 20f), Vary(80f, 180f), true);
            ec.UseAbility("rewind", 0);
            var (i, d) = Nearest(ec.Position);
            var e = i >= 0 ? log[i] : default;
            Check(i >= 0 && d < 0.01f && Math.Abs(e.T - (now - 8)) <= 0.25 + 2.0 / 60 && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(e.Rot, ec.Rotation)) < 1e-4f
                  && e.V.DistanceTo(ec.Velocity) < 0.01f && Math.Abs(e.Hp - ec.Hp) < 1e-6 && ec.Hp <= ec.MaxHp && Math.Abs(ec.Sl("rewind").Cool - 30) < 0.05,
                  $"a rewind after {now:0.0} s of flight: back to the frame {now - e.T:0.00} s ago (8 +- 0.25), {d:0.000} u off it, its heading, its velocity ({e.V.Length():0} u/s) and its hull {ec.Hp:0.0} of {ec.MaxHp:0}; cooling {ec.Sl("rewind").Cool:0.0} s (30)");
            await Frame();
        }

        // WITH LESS HISTORY, THE OLDEST: 2-4 s since the trail began, the press goes back to its first frame
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            ec.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp; ec.Sl("rewind").Cool = 0;
            double now = await Fly(Vary(2f, 4f), Vary(80f, 180f), true);
            ec.UseAbility("rewind", 0);
            var (i, d) = Nearest(ec.Position);
            Check(i == 0 && d < 0.01f && Math.Abs(log[0].Hp - ec.Hp) < 1e-6,
                  $"a rewind {now:0.00} s after the trail began goes back to its oldest mark (frame {i}, {d:0.000} u off; hull {ec.Hp:0.0})");
            await Frame();
        }

        // THE SPEED HELD TO THE TOP IT HAS NOW, THE BOOST'S TIME NOT REWOUND: 2.5 s at 330-370 u/s under the boost, then
        // 6.5-8 s at 120 with the boost down; the press restores the fast mark's bearing at 260, and the boost's clocks
        // are what they were before the press
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            ec.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp; ec.Sl("rewind").Cool = 0;
            ec.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; ec.Sl("boost").Left = 0;
            log.Clear(); ec.Past.Clear();
            float rot = VaryAngle(), fast = Vary(330f, 370f); double clock = 0;
            ec.DriveHeld = true;
            while (clock < 2.5)
            {
                ec.Rotation = rot; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * fast;
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                log.Add((clock, ec.Position, ec.Rotation, ec.Velocity, ec.Hp));
            }
            ec.DriveHeld = false;
            var slowDir = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot + Vary(1.0f, 2.0f));
            double until = clock + Vary(6.5f, 8f);
            while (clock < until || ec.Sl("boost").Left > 0)
            {
                ec.Rotation = slowDir.Angle() + Mathf.Pi / 2; ec.Velocity = slowDir * 120f;
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                log.Add((clock, ec.Position, ec.Rotation, ec.Velocity, ec.Hp));
            }
            double bLeft = ec.Sl("boost").Left, bCool = ec.Sl("boost").Cool; float top = ec.TopNow;
            ec.UseAbility("rewind", 0);
            var (i, d) = Nearest(ec.Position);
            var e = i >= 0 ? log[i] : default;
            bool clamped = e.V.Length() > top + 1f && Math.Abs(ec.Velocity.Length() - top) < 0.5f && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(ec.Velocity.Angle(), e.V.Angle())) < 1e-3f;
            Check(i >= 0 && d < 0.01f && clamped && ec.Sl("boost").Left == bLeft && ec.Sl("boost").Cool == bCool,
                  $"a rewind to a mark flown at {e.V.Length():0} u/s under the boost: {ec.Velocity.Length():0.0} u/s on its bearing (the top now, {top:0}); the boost's clocks {ec.Sl("boost").Left:0.00} / {ec.Sl("boost").Cool:0.00} as they were ({bLeft:0.00} / {bCool:0.00})");
            await Frame();
        }

        // EVERY WEB LET GO: pinned 2-6 s, the press frees it, and it stays free; three varied spots
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            ec.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp; ec.Sl("rewind").Cool = 0;
            await Fly(Vary(9f, 11f), Vary(80f, 180f), false);
            ec.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, Vary(2f, 6f));
            await Frame();
            bool held = ec.Pinned;
            ec.UseAbility("rewind", 0);
            bool freed = !ec.Pinned;
            for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) await Frame();
            Check(held && freed && !ec.Pinned, $"a webbed Echo ({held}) rewinds free of it ({freed}), and is still free 10 frames on ({!ec.Pinned})");
        }

        // REFUSED: a second press inside the 30 s, a press while disabled, a press from a wreck -- none moves it
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            ec.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp; ec.Sl("rewind").Cool = run == 0 ? Vary(1f, 29f) : 0;
            await Fly(Vary(9f, 10f), Vary(80f, 180f), false);
            if (run == 1) ec.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 2);
            if (run == 2) ec.Restore(0, false, 30);
            var was = ec.Position; double hp = ec.Hp;
            ec.UseAbility("rewind", 0);
            string why = new[] { "cooling", "disabled", "wrecked" }[run];
            Check(ec.Position == was && ec.Hp == hp && (run == 0 || ec.Sl("rewind").Cool == 0),
                  $"a rewind pressed {why}: refused, the hull where it was ({ec.Position.DistanceTo(was):0.0} u moved, cooldown {ec.Sl("rewind").Cool:0.0})");
            if (run == 1) ec.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            if (run == 2) { stasis.SetValue(ec, 0.0); ec.Reboard(); ec.Hp = ec.MaxHp; }
            ec.Sl("rewind").Cool = 0;
            await Frame();
        }
        ec.Demo = demo; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.Position = yonder;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S REWIND. The guest (LaneA6dRewindGuestChecks) flies an ECHO round a slow circle for
    // 10-12 s and rewinds; the host (LaneA6dRewindHostWatch) strikes its hull 5 every second, keeps its own log of the
    // guest's copy, and sees the press land: its hull back to what its own log had 8 s before (+-0.3 s), and 0.8 s
    // later the copy within 20 u of where its log had it then. The guest: back to its own frame of 8 s ago.
    sealed class LaneA6dRewindSeen { public double Hull = -1, HullThen = -1, HullBefore = -1, Miss = -1; public bool Done; }
    LateSampler LaneA6dRewindHostWatch(LaneA6dRewindSeen seen)
    {
        var log = new List<(double T, Vector2 At, double Hp)>();
        double since = -1, pressedAt = -1, struck = 0;
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightEcho, Alive: true } g || Math.Abs(g.MaxHp - 180) > 1e-6) return false;
            double now = Time.GetTicksMsec() / 1000.0;
            if (since < 0) since = now;
            if (pressedAt < 0 && now - since > struck + 1.0) { g.TakeDamage(5); struck += 1.0; }
            log.Add((now, g.Position, g.Hp));
            if (pressedAt < 0 && g.Sl("rewind").Cool > 0)
            {
                pressedAt = now; seen.Hull = g.Hp; seen.HullBefore = log.Count > 1 ? log[^2].Hp : -1;
                var then = log.Where(e => Math.Abs(e.T - (now - 8)) <= 0.3).ToList();
                seen.HullThen = then.Count == 0 ? -1 : then.OrderBy(e => Math.Abs(e.Hp - g.Hp)).First().Hp;
            }
            if (pressedAt >= 0 && now - pressedAt >= 0.8)
            {
                var then = log.Where(e => Math.Abs(e.T - (pressedAt - 8)) <= 0.3).ToList();
                seen.Miss = then.Count == 0 ? -1 : then.Min(e => e.At.DistanceTo(g.Position));
                seen.Done = true;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dRewindHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dRewindSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 90 : 60);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Done && seen.HullThen >= 0 && Math.Abs(seen.Hull - seen.HullThen) < 0.5 && seen.Hull - seen.HullBefore >= 20 && seen.Miss >= 0 && seen.Miss <= 20,
              $"arena host: the guest Echo's rewind puts its hull from {seen.HullBefore:0.0} back to {seen.Hull:0.0} (its own log 8 s before: {seen.HullThen:0.0}, 5 a second struck since) and its copy {seen.Miss:0.0} u from where the log had it (20)");
    }
    async Task LaneA6dRewindGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = true;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 180) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);           // the host's word for the hull
        me.Sl("rewind").Cool = 0;
        var log = new List<(double T, Vector2 At)>();
        var centre = me.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 300f);
        float speed = Vary(40f, 60f), sign = Vary(0f, 1f) < 0.5f ? -1f : 1f;
        double clock = 0, secs = Vary(10f, 12f);
        while (clock < secs)
        {
            var radial = (me.Position - centre).Normalized();
            var tangent = new Vector2(-radial.Y, radial.X) * sign;
            me.Velocity = tangent * speed; me.Rotation = tangent.Angle() + Mathf.Pi / 2;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            log.Add((clock, me.Position));
        }
        me.UseAbility("rewind", 0);
        var back = me.Position;
        var (t, d) = log.Select(e => (e.T, e.At.DistanceTo(back))).OrderBy(e => e.Item2).First();
        for (double w = 0; w < 1.5; w += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
        Check(d < 0.01f && Math.Abs(t - (clock - 8)) <= 0.25 + 2.0 / 60 && me.Position.DistanceTo(back) < 20f,
              $"arena guest: its Echo's rewind after {clock:0.0} s puts it at its own frame {clock - t:0.00} s ago (8 +- 0.25; {d:0.000} u off), and it is still there 1.5 s on ({me.Position.DistanceTo(back):0.0} u)");
        me.Demo = demo; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE ECHO'S EMP (kits_v2's card): every hostile craft within 300 u JAMMED 4.0 s (no strikes, no launches,
    // the turret held, a web let go), a second pulse 0.6 s later from the press point refreshing it (4.6 s in all); a
    // boss, a structure, a practice target and a missile immune; no damage; 18 s.
    void LaneA6dEmpRowChecks()
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var kit = Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightEcho).Abilities.Select(a => a.Id).ToArray();
        var f = Targeting.Jammable;
        var jam = new StatusSet(); jam.Apply(Status.Jammed, 1);
        var others = new StatusSet(); others.Apply(Status.Dazzled, 1); others.Apply(Status.Suppressed, 1);
        Check(st["emp_range"] == 300 && st["emp_jam"] == 4.0 && st["emp_echo"] == 0.6 && st["emp_cooldown"] == 18 && Ab.Emp.Default == global::Godot.Key.E
              && kit.SequenceEqual(new[] { "guns", "firemode", "reverb", "rewind", "emp" })
              && f.Require == (Tag.Light | Tag.Heavy) && f.Forbid == (Tag.Boss | Tag.Structure | Tag.Dummy | Tag.Missile | Tag.Hulled)
              && jam.HoldsAim && !others.HoldsAim && Raider.FlagJam == 16,
              $"the EMP row: {st["emp_range"]:0} u (300), jammed {st["emp_jam"]:0.0} s (4.0), the second pulse {st["emp_echo"]:0.0} s on (0.6), {st["emp_cooldown"]:0} s (18), on E, learned third ({string.Join(",", kit)}); it jams light and heavy craft, never a boss, structure, dummy, missile or hulled round; Jammed alone holds the aim; the mark is wire bit 16");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dEmpChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var ec = Me; bool demo = ec.Demo; ec.Demo = true; ec.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        int[] kinds = { Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Gunship, Enemies.Talon, Enemies.Pod, Enemies.Cross, Enemies.Lancerkin };
        double Jam(Raider r) => r.Statuses.Left(Status.Jammed);

        // 299 IN, 301 OUT, six kinds, no damage; the refresh at 0.6 s; jammed at 4.4 s, free at 4.8 s; 18 s, refused inside it
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.Sl("emp").Cool = 0; ec.Sl("emp").Left = 0;
            var inside = kinds.Select(k => HeldI(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 299f, k)).ToList();
            var outside = kinds.Select(k => HeldI(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 301f, k)).ToList();
            var hp0 = inside.Concat(outside).Select(r => r.Hp).ToArray();
            await Frame();
            ec.UseAbility("emp", 0);
            double clock = 0, cool0 = ec.Sl("emp").Cool;
            bool first = inside.All(r => Jam(r) > 3.9) && outside.All(r => Jam(r) == 0);
            await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            double c1 = ec.Sl("emp").Cool;
            ec.UseAbility("emp", 0);
            bool refused = c1 < cool0 && ec.Sl("emp").Cool == c1;
            double at08 = -1; bool at44 = false, at48 = true;
            while (clock < 4.8)
            {
                ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (at08 < 0 && clock >= 0.8) at08 = inside.Min(Jam);
                if (!at44 && clock >= 4.4) at44 = inside.All(r => r.Statuses.Has(Status.Jammed));
            }
            at48 = inside.All(r => !r.Statuses.Has(Status.Jammed));
            bool unhurt = inside.Concat(outside).Select(r => r.Hp).SequenceEqual(hp0);
            Check(first && Math.Abs(at08 - (4.0 - (0.8 - 0.6))) <= 0.06 && at44 && at48 && unhurt && outside.All(r => !r.Statuses.Has(Status.Jammed)) && Math.Abs(cool0 - 18) < 0.05 && refused,
                  $"an EMP among six kinds at 299 u and six at 301: jammed {first} / free; 0.8 s on {at08:0.00} s left (3.80: the second pulse refreshed it); jammed at 4.4 s {at44}, free at 4.8 s {at48}; hulls untouched {unhurt}; cooling {cool0:0.0} (18), a second press refused {refused}");
            foreach (var r in inside.Concat(outside)) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }

        // THE SECOND PULSE IS THE PRESS POINT'S: the Echo moved 400-500 u off at once; a craft arriving 250 u from the press
        // point at 0.3 s is jammed by 0.8 s, one 250 u from where the Echo is now (past 300 of the press point) is not
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); ec.Position = at; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.Sl("emp").Cool = 0; ec.Sl("emp").Left = 0;
            await Frame();
            ec.UseAbility("emp", 0);
            var away = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 500f);
            double clock = 0; Raider there = null, here = null;
            while (clock < 0.8)
            {
                ec.Position = away; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                if (there == null && clock >= 0.3)
                {
                    var back = (at - away).Normalized();
                    there = HeldI(at + back.Rotated(Vary(-1.2f, 1.2f)) * 250f, kinds[run % kinds.Length]);
                    here = HeldI(away - back.Rotated(Vary(-1.0f, 1.0f)) * 250f, kinds[(run + 3) % kinds.Length]);
                }
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            }
            Check(there != null && Jam(there) > 3.7 && Jam(here) == 0 && here.Position.DistanceTo(at) > 300f,
                  $"the second pulse from where it was pressed: a craft that came {there?.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u from the press point is jammed ({Jam(there):0.00} s left), one {here?.Position.DistanceTo(ec.Position):0} u from the Echo {here?.Position.DistanceTo(at):0} u from the press point is not ({Jam(here):0.00})");
            there?.TakeDamage(1e12); here?.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }

        // ON A WEB: three webifiers latched and a gunship on the Echo; the press lets every web go within 0.3 s, and over
        // the next 3.5 s nothing strikes it, nothing is launched, and the gunship's turret stays where it was
        var me = ec;
        var turretField = typeof(Raider).GetField("_turret", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            me.Sl("emp").Cool = 0; me.Sl("emp").Left = 0; me.Hp = me.MaxHp;
            var webs = new List<Raider>();
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) { var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 280f)); w.Quarry = me; webs.Add(w); }
            var gun = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 280f), Enemies.Gunship); gun.Quarry = me;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !webs.All(w => w.Latched); i++) { me.Position = at; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); }
            bool latched = webs.All(w => w.Latched) && me.Pinned;
            double Struck() => webs.Concat(new[] { gun }).Sum(w => me.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault($"raider:{w.NetId}"));
            me.UseAbility("emp", 0);
            double clock = 0, freedAt = -1;
            while (freedAt < 0 && clock < 0.5) { me.Position = at; await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime(); if (!me.Pinned && webs.All(w => !w.Latched)) freedAt = clock; }
            double s0 = Struck(); var seekers0 = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Seeker).ToHashSet();
            float aim0 = (turretField.GetValue(gun) as Node2D)?.Rotation ?? float.NaN;          // on its hull: a held turret keeps it
            float circle = VaryAngle();
            for (double t = 0; t < 3.5; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
            {   // the Echo swings round the gunship: a tracking turret would follow it
                me.Position = gun.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(circle + (float)t * 0.8f) * 240f; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await Frame();
            }
            float aim1 = (turretField.GetValue(gun) as Node2D)?.Rotation ?? float.NaN;
            bool launched = Nodes<Shot>().Any(x => x.Kind == Shots.Seeker && !seekers0.Contains(x));
            Check(latched && freedAt >= 0 && freedAt <= 0.3 && Struck() == s0 && !launched && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(aim0, aim1)) < 1e-3f,
                  $"an EMP on three latched webs and a gunship: every web let go {freedAt:0.00} s on (0.3); in the next 3.5 s {Struck() - s0:0.0} struck (0), a launch {launched}, the gunship's turret moved {Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.AngleDifference(aim0, aim1)):0.00}° while the Echo went round it");
            foreach (var r in webs) r.TakeDamage(1e12); gun.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        ec.Demo = demo; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; ec.Position = yonder; ec.Sl("emp").Cool = 0;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S EMP. The host (LaneA6dEmpHostWatch) holds two craft 150-250 u off the guest's Echo; the
    // guest presses its EMP: on the host both are Jammed, hulls untouched; on the guest (LaneA6dEmpGuestChecks) both
    // carry the jam mark (Raider.FlagJam) within 0.5 s, and it is gone by 5.2 s.
    sealed class LaneA6dEmpSeen { public bool Jammed, Unhurt, Done; public int Ids; public readonly List<Raider> Held = new(); }
    LateSampler LaneA6dEmpHostWatch(LaneA6dEmpSeen seen)
    {
        var held = seen.Held; var hp0 = new List<double>();
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightEcho, Alive: true } g || Math.Abs(g.MaxHp - 180) > 1e-6) return false;
            if (g.Sl("rewind").Cool <= 0) return false;                               // after its rewind (LaneA6dRewindGuestChecks)
            if (held.Count == 0)
                for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) { var r = HeldI(g.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(k * 2.5f + 0.3f) * (150f + 100f * k), k == 0 ? Enemies.Webifier : Enemies.Gunship); held.Add(r); hp0.Add(r.Hp); }
            foreach (var r in held) r.Position = g.Position + (r.Position - g.Position).Normalized() * Mathf.Clamp(r.Position.DistanceTo(g.Position), 150f, 250f);
            if (g.Sl("emp").Cool <= 0) return false;
            seen.Jammed = held.All(r => r.Statuses.Has(Status.Jammed));
            seen.Unhurt = held.Select(r => r.Hp).SequenceEqual(hp0);
            seen.Ids = held.Count; seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dEmpHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dEmpSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 90 : 60);
        watch.QueueFree();
        await Wait(6.5);                                                            // the guest reads the marks off for 5.6 s
        foreach (var r in seen.Held) if (IsInstanceValid(r)) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        Check(seen.Done && seen.Ids == 2 && seen.Jammed && seen.Unhurt,
              $"arena host: the guest Echo's EMP jams the {seen.Ids} craft held 150-250 u off it ({seen.Jammed}), their hulls untouched ({seen.Unhurt})");
    }
    async Task LaneA6dEmpGuestChecks()
    {
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = true;
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        List<Raider> Near() => H.Raiders.Where(r => r.Position.DistanceTo(me.Position) <= 260f).ToList();
        await RealTime(() => Near().Count >= 2, Wan ? 20 : 10);                     // the host's two craft, on this peer
        me.Sl("emp").Cool = 0;
        me.UseAbility("emp", 0);
        double clock = 0, markedAt = -1; bool cleared = false;
        while (clock < 5.6)
        {
            me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            var near = Near();
            if (markedAt < 0 && near.Count >= 2 && near.All(r => r.JamMarked)) markedAt = clock;
            if (clock >= 5.2 && !cleared) cleared = near.All(r => !r.JamMarked);
        }
        Check(markedAt >= 0 && markedAt <= 0.5 && cleared,
              $"arena guest: its Echo's EMP puts the jam mark on the host's craft beside it {markedAt:0.00} s on (0.5), and it is gone by 5.2 s ({cleared})");
        me.Demo = demo;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE WRAITH'S AMBUSH SCATTERGUN (DL3): 7 pellets of 7 every 0.75 s fanned +-10 deg out to 320 u (65.3 DPS
    // point blank; fewer land at range), hull 220; BACKSTAB x1.5 on a blow landed within 60 deg of a heading target's tail.
    void LaneA6dScatterRowChecks()
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var ec = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightEcho);
        var row = Shots.Of(Shots.Pellet);
        var gun = Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightWraith).Kit.FirstOrDefault(k => k.Slot == GearSlot.Weapon);
        Check(st["hull"] == 220 && st["main_damage"] == 7 && st["main_interval"] == 0.75 && st["main_range"] == 320 && st["shell_speed"] == 620
              && st["scatter_pellets"] == 7 && st["scatter_spread"] == 10 && Math.Abs(st.MainDps - 49 / 0.75) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(st.MainDps - 65.33) < 0.01
              && st["backstab_mult"] == 1.5 && st["backstab_arc"] == 60 && Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightWraith).Shot == Shots.Pellet
              && row.Id == "pellet" && !row.Guided && row.Stops == 1 && !row.AtPlayers && Items.PrimaryShots.Contains("pellet")
              && gun?.Id == "light_scattergun" && ec["scatter_pellets"] == 0 && ec["backstab_mult"] == 0 && Math.Abs(ec.MainDps - 44) < 1e-9,
              $"the Wraith row: hull {st["hull"]:0} (220), {st["scatter_pellets"]:0} pellets (7) of {st["main_damage"]:0} (7) every {st["main_interval"]:0.00} s (0.75) +-{st["scatter_spread"]:0} deg to {st["main_range"]:0} u = {st.MainDps:0.00} DPS (65.33); backstab x{st["backstab_mult"]:0.0} in {st["backstab_arc"]:0} deg; row pellet straight, one body; its gun {gun?.Id}; the Echo's sheet one round, no backstab ({ec.MainDps:0} DPS)");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dScatterChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var wt = Me; bool demo = wt.Demo; wt.Demo = true; wt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double Landed() => wt.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("pellet");
        bool Mine(Shot x) => x.Kind == Shots.Pellet && x.Source == wt;
        // hold the Wraith still, aimed, and the raider's NOSE on the Wraith: in front of it, no backstab
        void Hold(Vector2 at, float rot, Raider r, Vector2 spot)
        { wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = rot; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = spot; if (r != null) { r.Position = spot; r.Rotation = Aim.Face(spot, at); } }

        // SEVEN PELLETS A VOLLEY, 7 each, fanned evenly from -10 to +10 deg about the barrel, at a varied bearing
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var aim = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 300f);
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(at, rot, null, aim); await Frame(); }
            var before = Nodes<Shot>().ToHashSet();
            wt.Trigger = true; await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false;
            var vol = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => Mine(x) && !before.Contains(x)).ToList();
            var mid = (aim - at).Normalized();
            var offs = vol.Select(x => Mathf.RadToDeg(mid.AngleTo(x.Dir))).OrderBy(a => a).ToList();
            bool even = offs.Count == 7 && Enumerable.Range(0, 7).All(k => Math.Abs(offs[k] - (-10 + k * 20.0 / 6)) < 1.0);
            Check(vol.Count == 7 && vol.All(x => Math.Abs(x.Damage - 7) < 1e-9) && even,
                  $"one volley at {Mathf.RadToDeg(mid.Angle()):0} deg: {vol.Count} pellets (7) of {vol.FirstOrDefault()?.Damage:0.0} (7), fanned {string.Join(" ", offs.Select(a => a.ToString("0.0")))} (-10 .. +10, 3.33 apart)");
            await Wait(1.0);
        }

        // 65.3 DPS POINT BLANK: a held gunship 60-100 u off at a varied bearing, the Wraith in front of it; the 6.375 s after
        // the first volley lands hold 8 more (at 0.75 s .. 6.0 s, clear of both edges), every pellet landing: 8 x 49 = 392
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(60f, 100f);
            var foe = HeldI(spot, Enemies.Gunship);
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(at, rot, foe, spot); await Frame(); }
            double d0 = Landed(), tFirst = -1, landed0 = 0, clock = 0;
            wt.Trigger = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 12 && (tFirst < 0 || clock - tFirst < 6.375); i++)
            {
                Hold(at, rot, foe, spot); await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (tFirst < 0 && Landed() > d0) { await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime(); tFirst = clock; landed0 = Landed(); }
            }
            wt.Trigger = false;
            double got = Landed() - landed0;
            Check(tFirst >= 0 && Math.Abs(got - 392) <= 392 * 0.03 && Math.Abs(landed0 - d0 - 49) < 1e-6,
                  $"point blank ({spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u): the first volley {landed0 - d0:0.0} (49: all seven), then {got:0.0} in the 6.375 s after (392 = 8 x 49: 65.3 DPS, +-3%)");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(1.0);
        }

        // FEWER AT RANGE: at 250-300 u the fan is wider than the gunship (+-44 .. 53 u against its 43): 3-6 of 7 land a
        // volley; at 360-420 u (past 320) none do
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle(); float bearing = VaryAngle();
            var near = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * Vary(250f, 300f);
            var far = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * Vary(360f, 420f);
            var got = new double[2];
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
            {
                var spot = k == 0 ? near : far;
                var foe = HeldI(spot, Enemies.Gunship);
                for (double t = 0; t < 1.0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(at, rot, foe, spot); await Frame(); }
                double d0 = Landed();
                wt.Trigger = true; Hold(at, rot, foe, spot); await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false;
                for (double t = 0; t < 0.9; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(at, rot, foe, spot); await Frame(); }
                got[k] = Landed() - d0;
                foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
                await Wait(0.8);
            }
            double pellets = got[0] / 7;
            Check(pellets >= 3 - 1e-6 && pellets <= 6 + 1e-6 && Math.Abs(pellets - Math.Round(pellets)) < 1e-6 && got[1] == 0,
                  $"at range: {pellets:0} of 7 pellets landed at {near.DistanceTo(at):0} u (3-6), {got[1]:0} at {far.DistanceTo(at):0} u (0: past its 320)");
        }
        wt.Demo = demo; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    async Task LaneA6dBackstabChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var wt = Me; bool demo = wt.Demo; wt.Demo = true; wt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double Landed() => wt.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("pellet");
        float D(float deg) => Mathf.DegToRad(deg);
        // one volley from `off` radians about the raider's TAIL (0: dead astern) at 70-100 u, every pellet landing
        async Task<double> Volley(Raider r, float rrot, float off)
        {
            var tail = -Vector2.Up.Rotated(rrot);
            var at = r.Position + tail.Rotated(off) * Vary(70f, 100f);
            void Hold() { wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = Aim.Face(at, r.Position); wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = r.Position; r.Rotation = rrot; }
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double d0 = Landed();
            wt.Trigger = true; Hold(); await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false;
            for (double t = 0; t < 0.5; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            return Landed() - d0;
        }

        // x1.5 INSIDE THE REAR ARC (up to 55 deg off the tail), x1 JUST OUTSIDE IT (62-75 deg) and FROM THE FRONT, at a
        // varied raider heading each run; the multiplier read and the volley landed (49 x1, 73.5 x1.5)
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var r = HeldI(VaryNear(yonder, 300f), Enemies.Gunship); float rrot = VaryAngle();
            float inside = D(Vary(-55f, 55f)), outside = D(Vary(62f, 75f) * (Rng.Randf() < 0.5f ? -1 : 1)), front = D(180f + Vary(-60f, 60f));
            double gIn = await Volley(r, rrot, inside); double mIn = wt.Backstab(r);
            double gOut = await Volley(r, rrot, outside); double mOut = wt.Backstab(r);
            double gFront = await Volley(r, rrot, front); double mFront = wt.Backstab(r);
            Check(NearI(mIn, 1.5) && NearI(gIn, 73.5) && NearI(mOut, 1) && NearI(gOut, 49) && NearI(mFront, 1) && NearI(gFront, 49),
                  $"backstab at a raider heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rrot):0}: {Mathf.RadToDeg(inside):0} deg off its tail x{mIn:0.0} ({gIn:0.0}, 73.5), {Mathf.RadToDeg(outside):0} deg x{mOut:0.0} ({gOut:0.0}, 49), from the front x{mFront:0.0} ({gFront:0.0}, 49)");
            r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.5);
        }

        // NO HEADING, NO BEHIND: the practice dummy takes x1 from any side; and BY THE STAT: an Echo behind a raider x1
        {
            var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
            string ls = ""; bool ok = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                var at = dummy.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(70f, 100f);
                for (double t = 0; t < 1.0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = dummy.Position; await Frame(); }
                double t0 = dummy.Total;
                wt.Trigger = true; await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false;
                for (double t = 0; t < 0.5; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); }
                double took = dummy.Total - t0;
                ok &= NearI(wt.Backstab(dummy), 1) && NearI(took, 49); ls += $"{took:0.0} ";
            }
            Check(ok && ((IHittable)dummy).Facing == null, $"the practice dummy (no heading) takes x1 from three sides: {ls}(49 each)");
            wt.Demo = demo; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
            var ec = Me; var r = HeldI(VaryNear(yonder, 300f), Enemies.Gunship);
            string es = ""; bool eok = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                r.Rotation = VaryAngle();
                ec.Position = r.Position - Vector2.Up.Rotated(r.Rotation).Rotated(D(Vary(-50f, 50f))) * Vary(70f, 300f);
                eok &= NearI(ec.Backstab(r), 1); es += $"{ec.Backstab(r):0.0} ";
            }
            Check(eok, $"an Echo behind a raider: x{es}(1: no backstab row)");
            r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
            wt = Me; demo = wt.Demo; wt.Demo = true; wt.AutopilotTo = null;
        }

        // STRAFE HOLDS THE REAR ARC (v31 §3.4): the Wraith slides sideways at its strafe speed across the raider's tail,
        // nose on it, from one side of the arc to the other over 2.4 s, the gun held down: every volley lands whole at x1.5
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var r = HeldI(VaryNear(yonder, 300f), Enemies.Gunship); float rrot = VaryAngle();
            var tail = -Vector2.Up.Rotated(rrot); float dist = Vary(75f, 95f), from = D(Vary(-45f, -35f)), to = D(Vary(35f, 45f));
            Vector2 Spot(float a) => r.Position + tail.Rotated(a) * dist;
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
            { wt.Position = Spot(from); wt.Rotation = Aim.Face(wt.Position, r.Position); wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = r.Position; r.Rotation = rrot; await Frame(); }
            var seen = new HashSet<Shot>(); double d0 = Landed(), clock = 0; bool inArc = true;
            wt.Trigger = true;
            while (clock < 2.4)
            {
                float a = Mathf.Lerp(from, to, (float)(clock / 2.4));
                var p = Spot(a); var tangent = tail.Rotated(a + Mathf.Pi / 2) * (float)wt.Stats["strafe_speed"];
                wt.Position = p; wt.Rotation = Aim.Face(p, r.Position); wt.Velocity = tangent; wt.AimPoint = r.Position; r.Rotation = rrot;
                inArc &= NearI(wt.Backstab(r), 1.5);
                await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                foreach (var x in Nodes<Shot>()) if (x.Kind == Shots.Pellet && x.Source == wt) seen.Add(x);
            }
            wt.Trigger = false;
            for (double t = 0; t < 0.5; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; r.Rotation = rrot; await Frame(); }
            double got = Landed() - d0; int volleys = seen.Count / 7;
            Check(inArc && volleys >= 3 && seen.Count % 7 == 0 && NearI(got, volleys * 73.5),
                  $"a strafe across the tail {Mathf.RadToDeg(from):0} .. {Mathf.RadToDeg(to):0} deg at {wt.Stats["strafe_speed"]:0} u/s: {volleys} volleys ({seen.Count} pellets), {got:0.0} landed ({volleys * 73.5:0.0}: every one x1.5)");
            r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.5);
        }
        wt.Demo = demo; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE WRAITH'S VEIL (DL3): 5 s nothing hostile can pick it (still hit), x1.35 top (x1.85 = 481 with the
    // boost), the next volley x3 -- fired inside it, which ends it, or the first after; 18 s; learned first (F).
    void LaneA6dVeilRowChecks()
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var vl = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.LightWraith, "veil");
        Check(st["veil_time"] == 5 && st["veil_speed"] == 1.35 && st["veil_break"] == 3 && st["veil_cooldown"] == 18
              && vl?.SpeedStat == "veil_speed" && vl?.RateStat == null && vl?.OnFire != null && vl?.Default == global::Godot.Key.F
              && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.LightWraith, 1) == Ab.Veil && Items.IdsOf("@duration", ShipClass.LightWraith).Contains("veil_time"),
              $"the Veil row: {st["veil_time"]:0} s (5), top x{st["veil_speed"]:0.00} (1.35), the volley out of it x{st["veil_break"]:0} (3), {st["veil_cooldown"]:0} s (18), on F, ability 1");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dVeilChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var wt = Me; bool demo = wt.Demo; wt.Demo = true; wt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double Landed() => wt.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("pellet");
        void Ready() { wt.Sl("veil").Left = 0; wt.Sl("veil").Cool = 0; wt.Unveil(); wt.Prime(1); }
        int n = 0;

        // UNPICKABLE 5 s, STILL HIT, x1.35 TOP, 18 s: at a varied spot, a boss's slug from a varied side lands in full on
        // the veiled hull; hidden at 4.7 s, seen at 5.3 s; top 351 while it runs, 260 after; a press while cooling refused
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
