            wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = rot; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.Hp = wt.MaxHp;
            await Wait(0.3);
            wt.UseAbility("veil", 0); await Frame();
            double clock = 0; bool hidden = true; float topIn = wt.TopNow;
            var from = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(40f, 70f); double blow = Vary(8f, 20f), hp0 = wt.Hp;
            Combat.Fire(Shots.Slug, from, at - from, 300f, 200f, blow, hitSource: $"test:6d_veil#{++n}");
            for (; clock < 4.7; clock += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; hidden &= Targeting.Hidden(wt); await Frame(); }
            double took = hp0 - wt.Hp;
            for (; clock < 5.3; clock += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); }
            bool seen = !Targeting.Hidden(wt); float topOut = wt.TopNow; double cool = wt.Sl("veil").Cool;
            wt.UseAbility("veil", 0); await Frame();
            Check(hidden && seen && Math.Abs(took - blow) < 1e-6 && Mathf.Abs(topIn - 351f) < 0.5f && Mathf.Abs(topOut - 260f) < 0.5f
                  && Math.Abs(cool - (18 - clock)) < 0.1 && !Targeting.Hidden(wt) && wt.Sl("veil").Left <= 0,
                  $"veiled at {at.DistanceTo(yonder):0} u off: hidden to 4.7 s {hidden}, seen at 5.3 s {seen}; a slug of {blow:0.0} from {from.DistanceTo(at):0} u landed {took:0.00}; top {topIn:0.0} (351) veiled, {topOut:0.0} (260) after; cooling {cool:0.0} s (18 from the press), a press refused");
            wt.Hp = wt.MaxHp;
        }

        // WITH THE BOOST: the shares add, x1.85 = 481, at three varied spots and headings
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready(); wt.Sl("boost").Left = 0; wt.Sl("boost").Cool = 0;
            wt.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); wt.Rotation = VaryAngle(); wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.3);
            wt.UseAbility("veil", 0); Key(global::Godot.Key.V);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && wt.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await Frame();
            float top = wt.TopNow;
            Check(wt.Sl("boost").Left > 0 && wt.Sl("veil").Left > 0 && Mathf.Abs(top - 481f) < 0.5f,
                  $"veiled and boosted: top {top:0.0} (481 = 260 x (1 + 0.5 + 0.35))");
            wt.Sl("boost").Left = 0; wt.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }

        // THE VOLLEY OUT OF IT, x3 ONCE: a held gunship 60-100 u off, nose on the Wraith (no backstab), a varied bearing.
        // Fired INSIDE the veil (run 0 and 2: the veil ends on that volley) or the first AFTER it lapsed (run 1): the
        // first volley lands 147 (49 x3), the next 49
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(60f, 100f);
            var foe = HeldI(spot, Enemies.Gunship);
            void Hold() { wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = rot; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = spot; foe.Position = spot; foe.Rotation = Aim.Face(spot, at); }
            bool inside = run != 1;
            wt.UseAbility("veil", 0);
            for (double t = 0; t < (inside ? 1.0 : 5.4); t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            bool veiledAtFire = Targeting.Hidden(wt);
            double d0 = Landed(), clock = 0, tFirst = -1; bool endedOnShot = false;
            var before = Nodes<Shot>().ToHashSet();
            wt.Trigger = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && tFirst < 0; i++)
            {
                Hold(); await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (!endedOnShot && Nodes<Shot>().Any(x => x.Kind == Shots.Pellet && x.Source == wt && !before.Contains(x)))
                    endedOnShot = !Targeting.Hidden(wt) && wt.Sl("veil").Left <= 0;
                if (Landed() > d0) tFirst = clock;
            }
            for (; clock < tFirst + 0.35; clock += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double first = Landed() - d0;
            for (; clock < tFirst + 1.1; clock += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double second = Landed() - d0 - first;
            wt.Trigger = false;
            Check(tFirst >= 0 && NearI(first, 147) && NearI(second, 49) && veiledAtFire == inside && endedOnShot && wt.Primed == 1,
                  $"the volley {(inside ? "fired inside the veil" : "fired after it lapsed")} ({spot.DistanceTo(at):0} u): {first:0.0} (147 = 49 x3), the next {second:0.0} (49); veiled when fired {veiledAtFire}, unveiled by the shot {endedOnShot}");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.8);
        }

        // THE VEIL AND THE BACKSTAB MULTIPLY: from inside the rear arc (up to 50 deg off the tail) the volley out of the veil
        // lands 220.5 (49 x3 x1.5), at three varied headings
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var r = HeldI(VaryNear(yonder, 300f), Enemies.Gunship); float rrot = VaryAngle();
            var at = r.Position + (-Vector2.Up.Rotated(rrot)).Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-50f, 50f))) * Vary(70f, 100f);
            void Hold() { wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = Aim.Face(at, r.Position); wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = r.Position; r.Rotation = rrot; }
            wt.UseAbility("veil", 0);
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.0; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double d0 = Landed();
            wt.Trigger = true; Hold(); await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false;
            for (double t = 0; t < 0.5; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double got = Landed() - d0;
            Check(NearI(got, 220.5), $"the volley out of the veil from behind a raider heading {Mathf.RadToDeg(rrot):0}: {got:0.0} (220.5 = 49 x3 x1.5)");
            r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.5);
        }
        Ready();
        wt.Demo = demo; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE WRAITH'S VENOM (DL3, DoseRows.Venom): 6 s coated; each landed pellet a stack on what it hit, up to 10,
    // 1.25 a second each (ticked every 0.5 s, credit "venom"), for 5 s after the last; never on a round in flight; 22 s.
    void LaneA6dVenomRowChecks()
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var vn = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.LightWraith, "venom");
        var row = DoseRows.Venom;
        Check(st["venom_time"] == 6 && st["venom_cap"] == 10 && st["venom_dps"] == 1.25 && st["venom_last"] == 5 && st["venom_cooldown"] == 22
              && row.Id == "venom" && row.Every == 0.5 && row.Fx == Fx.Venom && Fx.Of(Fx.Venom).Id == "venom"
              && vn?.Default == global::Godot.Key.Q && vn?.OnDealt != null && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.LightWraith, 2) == Ab.Venom
              && Items.Repeats.Contains(Dealt.Venom) && Math.Abs(Dps.Venom.Rate(st) - 6.25) < 1e-9
              && Math.Abs(Dps.Veil.Rate(st) - 98.0 / 18) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(st.SustainedDps - (65 + 1.0 / 3 + 98.0 / 18 + 6.25)) < 1e-6,
              $"the Venom row: {st["venom_time"]:0} s coat (6), {st["venom_cap"]:0} doses (10) of {st["venom_dps"]:0.00}/s (1.25) for {st["venom_last"]:0} s after (5), {st["venom_cooldown"]:0} s (22), on Q, ability 2; on the sheet {Dps.Venom.Rate(st):0.00} (6.25 = 12.5 x 11 / 22), the veil's volley {Dps.Veil.Rate(st):0.00} (5.44 = 2 x 49 / 18), the Wraith {st.SustainedDps:0.00} (77.03: the signed 77.1)");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dVenomChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var wt = Me; bool demo = wt.Demo; wt.Demo = true; wt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double Pellets() => wt.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("pellet");
        double Venom() => wt.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("venom");
        void Ready() { foreach (var id in new[] { "venom", "veil" }) { wt.Sl(id).Left = 0; wt.Sl(id).Cool = 0; } wt.Unveil(); wt.Prime(1); }

        // STACKS TO 10, 12.5 A SECOND, ENDS 5 s AFTER THE LAST: a held gunship 60-100 u off at a varied bearing, fired on
        // from its front (run 0), from inside its rear arc (run 1: the ticks take no backstab) and out of the Veil from
        // behind (run 2: the x3 volley is still 7 doses, and its ticks take no multiple); the gun held till 10 doses
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var foe = HeldI(VaryNear(yonder, 300f), Enemies.Gunship); float rrot = VaryAngle();
            float off = run == 0 ? Mathf.Pi + Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-40f, 40f)) : Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-45f, 45f));
            var at = foe.Position + (-Vector2.Up.Rotated(rrot)).Rotated(off) * Vary(60f, 100f);
            void Hold() { wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = Aim.Face(at, foe.Position); wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = foe.Position; foe.Rotation = rrot; }
            if (run == 2) wt.UseAbility("veil", 0);
            wt.UseAbility("venom", 0);
            for (double t = 0; t < 0.9; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double clock = 0, lastLand = -1, p0 = Pellets(), v0 = Venom(); int firstVolley = -1, most = 0;
            wt.Trigger = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && wt.DosedOn(foe, DoseRows.Venom) < 10; i++)
            {
                Hold(); double p = Pellets(); await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (Pellets() > p) lastLand = clock;
                if (firstVolley < 0 && Pellets() > p0) { for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) { Hold(); await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime(); } firstVolley = wt.DosedOn(foe, DoseRows.Venom); }
            }
            wt.Trigger = false;
            var ticks = new List<(double t, double d)>();
            double vPrev = Venom();
            while (clock < lastLand + 5.6)
            {
                Hold(); double p = Pellets(); await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (Pellets() > p) lastLand = clock;
                most = Math.Max(most, wt.DosedOn(foe, DoseRows.Venom));
                if (Venom() > vPrev) ticks.Add((clock, Venom() - vPrev));
                vPrev = Venom();
            }
            bool even = ticks.Count >= 9 && ticks.All(k => NearI(k.d, 6.25))
                        && Enumerable.Range(1, ticks.Count - 1).All(k => Math.Abs(ticks[k].t - ticks[k - 1].t - 0.5) < 0.04);
            double lastTick = ticks.Count > 0 ? ticks[^1].t : -1;
            Check(firstVolley == 7 && most == 10 && even && lastTick <= lastLand + 5.04 && lastTick >= lastLand + 4.4 && wt.DosedOn(foe, DoseRows.Venom) == 0
                  && Venom() - v0 > 0,
                  $"venom {(run == 0 ? "from the front" : run == 1 ? "from behind" : "out of the veil, from behind")}: {firstVolley} doses after the first volley (7), {most} held (10); {ticks.Count} ticks of {string.Join("/", ticks.Select(k => k.d.ToString("0.00")).Distinct())} (6.25 = 10 x 1.25 x 0.5) every 0.5 s; the last {lastTick - lastLand:0.00} s after the last pellet (4.4 .. 5.0), none after");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.5);
        }

        // THE COAT LASTS 6 s, AND COOLS 22: at 6.3 s after the press a volley doses nothing and no tick follows; a second press
        // is refused while it cools -- at three varied bearings and ranges
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); var spot = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(60f, 100f);
            var foe = HeldI(spot, Enemies.Gunship);
            void Hold() { wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = Aim.Face(at, spot); wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = spot; foe.Position = spot; foe.Rotation = Aim.Face(spot, at); }
            wt.UseAbility("venom", 0);
            double clock = 0;
            for (; clock < 6.3; clock += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); }
            double p0 = Pellets(), v0 = Venom();
            wt.Trigger = true; Hold(); await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false; clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            for (double t = 0; t < 1.2; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { Hold(); await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime(); }
            double cool = wt.Sl("venom").Cool;
            wt.UseAbility("venom", 0); await Frame();
            Check(Pellets() - p0 > 0 && wt.DosedOn(foe, DoseRows.Venom) == 0 && Venom() == v0 && wt.Sl("venom").Left <= 0
                  && Math.Abs(cool - (22 - clock)) < 0.1,
                  $"a volley {clock - 1.2:0.0} s after the press ({Pellets() - p0:0} landed): {wt.DosedOn(foe, DoseRows.Venom)} doses, {Venom() - v0:0.00} venom (0: the coat is 6 s); cooling {cool:0.0} s (22 from the press), a press refused");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.5);
        }

        // NEVER ON A ROUND IN FLIGHT, AND ONLY FROM THE PRIMARY: coated pellets that strike a cruise missile's hull put no
        // dose on it; a blow credited to anything but a primary round doses nothing; the practice dummy (a body, no
        // heading) takes the doses and their ticks, credited "venom" -- from three varied sides
        {
            var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
            string ls = ""; bool ok = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                Ready();
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); var cmAt = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(60f, 100f);
                var cm = Combat.Fire(Shots.Cruise, cmAt, Vector2.Down, 0.001f, 4000f, 1, size: 3f, hull: 30);
                wt.UseAbility("venom", 0);
                for (double t = 0; t < 0.9; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = cmAt; await Frame(); }
                wt.Trigger = true; wt.Position = at; await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false;
                for (double t = 0; t < 0.5; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); }
                bool struck = !IsInstanceValid(cm) || !cm.Alive || cm.Hull < 30;
                int onCm = IsInstanceValid(cm) ? wt.DosedOn(cm, DoseRows.Venom) : 0;
                wt.Dose(DoseRows.Venom, dummy, Dealt.Reverb);
                int byOther = wt.DosedOn(dummy, DoseRows.Venom);
                var dAt = dummy.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(70f, 100f);
                for (double t = 0; t < 0.9; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = dAt; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.AimPoint = dummy.Position; await Frame(); }
                double v0 = Venom(), t0 = dummy.Total, p0 = Pellets();
                wt.Trigger = true; wt.Position = dAt; await Frame(); wt.Trigger = false;
                for (double t = 0; t < 1.8; t += GetProcessDeltaTime()) { wt.Position = dAt; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); }
                double venom = Venom() - v0, took = dummy.Total - t0, pel = Pellets() - p0;
                int onDummy = wt.DosedOn(dummy, DoseRows.Venom);
                ok &= struck && onCm == 0 && byOther == 0 && onDummy == 7 && venom > 0 && NearI(took, pel + venom) && NearI(venom % 4.375, 0, 1e-6);
                ls += $"[cruise struck {struck}, {onCm} doses; by a blast {byOther}; the dummy {onDummy} doses, {venom:0.00} venom of {took:0.00}] ";
                if (IsInstanceValid(cm)) cm.TakeDamage(1e12);
                await Wait(5.5);
            }
            Check(ok, $"venom never on a round in flight or from a blow that is not a pellet, and on the dummy credited venom (7 doses: 4.375 a tick): {ls}");
        }
        Ready();
        wt.Demo = demo; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d: THE WRAITH'S SHADOW STEP (DL3): 140 u behind the selected hostile (its tail; no heading: the far side),
    // up to 900 u off, nose on it, the speed kept; refused NO TARGET / OUT OF REACH / COOLING; any web lets go; 14 s.
    void LaneA6dStepRowChecks()
    {
        var st = new ShipStats(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var sp = Abilities.Find(ShipClass.LightWraith, "step");
        var kit = Classes.Of(ShipClass.LightWraith).Abilities.Select(a => a.Id).ToArray();
        Check(st["step_reach"] == 900 && st["step_behind"] == 140 && st["step_cooldown"] == 14 && sp?.Default == global::Godot.Key.E
              && sp?.AtOnce != null && Unlocks.Nth(ShipClass.LightWraith, 3) == Ab.Step && Items.IdsOf("@output", ShipClass.LightWraith).Contains("venom_dps")
              && kit.SequenceEqual(new[] { "guns", "firemode", "veil", "venom", "step" }),
              $"the Shadow step row: {st["step_behind"]:0} u behind (140), up to {st["step_reach"]:0} u (900), {st["step_cooldown"]:0} s (14), on E, ability 3; the Wraith learns {string.Join(",", kit)}");
    }

    async Task LaneA6dStepChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var wt = Me; bool demo = wt.Demo; wt.Demo = true; wt.AutopilotTo = null;
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        void Ready() { wt.Sl("step").Left = 0; wt.Sl("step").Cool = 0; }
        bool NoseOn(IHittable t) => Vector2.Up.Rotated(wt.Rotation).Dot((t.Position - wt.Position).Normalized()) > 0.9999f;

        // THE BLINK: a held gunship at a varied heading, the Wraith 300-880 u off at a varied bearing moving 100-250 u/s: it
        // lands 140 u off the gunship's tail, nose on it, its speed kept along the new nose, x1.5 there (Backstab); 14 s
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var foe = HeldI(VaryNear(yonder, 300f), Enemies.Gunship); float rrot = VaryAngle(); foe.Rotation = rrot;
            var at = foe.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 880f); float rot = VaryAngle(); float v = Vary(100f, 250f);
            wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = rot; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot) * v;
            await Frame(); foe.Rotation = rrot;
            float speed0 = wt.Velocity.Length(); var from = wt.Position;
            wt.UseAbility("step", foe.NetId);
            var want = foe.Position - Vector2.Up.Rotated(rrot) * 140f;
            float off = wt.Position.DistanceTo(want); bool nose = NoseOn(foe); float speed1 = wt.Velocity.Length();
            bool along = wt.Velocity.Normalized().Dot(Vector2.Up.Rotated(wt.Rotation)) > 0.9999f;
            double mult = wt.Backstab(foe);
            await Frame();
            Check(off < 1f && nose && Mathf.Abs(speed1 - speed0) < 0.5f && along && NearI(mult, 1.5) && Math.Abs(wt.Sl("step").Cool - 14) < 0.1,
                  $"a step from {from.DistanceTo(foe.Position):0} u at {speed0:0} u/s: {off:0.00} u from the spot 140 u off the tail, nose on it {nose}, {speed1:0} u/s along the new nose; there x{mult:0.0} (1.5); cooling {wt.Sl("step").Cool:0.0} (14)");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }

        // NO HEADING: the practice dummy -- the far side from where the Wraith pressed, 140 u from its middle (clear of its
        // 46), at three varied bearings and ranges
        {
            var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
            string ls = ""; bool ok = true;
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
            {
                Ready();
                var at = dummy.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(250f, 850f);
                wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame();
                wt.UseAbility("step", dummy.NetId);
                var want = dummy.Position + (dummy.Position - at).Normalized() * 140f;
                float off = wt.Position.DistanceTo(want);
                ok &= off < 1f && NoseOn(dummy); ls += $"{at.DistanceTo(dummy.Position):0} u -> {off:0.00}; ";
                await Frame();
            }
            Check(ok, $"a step on the practice dummy (no heading) lands on its far side 140 u from its middle, nose on it: {ls}");
        }

        // REFUSED: no target, a target 905-960 u off (past 900), and while it cools -- the Wraith stays where it was, its
        // speed and heading its own, at three varied spots
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            var foe = HeldI(VaryNear(yonder, 300f), Enemies.Gunship);
            var at = foe.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(905f, 960f); float rot = VaryAngle();
            wt.Position = at; wt.Rotation = rot; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame();
            wt.UseAbility("step", 0); bool none = wt.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 1e-3f && wt.Sl("step").Cool <= 0;
            wt.UseAbility("step", foe.NetId); bool far = wt.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 1e-3f && wt.Sl("step").Cool <= 0;
            var near = foe.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 600f);
            wt.Position = near; await Frame();
            wt.UseAbility("step", foe.NetId); var landed = wt.Position;
            await Frame();
            wt.Position = near; wt.Rotation = rot; await Frame();
            wt.UseAbility("step", foe.NetId); bool cooling = wt.Position.DistanceTo(near) < 1e-3f && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(wt.Rotation, rot)) < 1e-4f;
            Check(none && far && landed.DistanceTo(near) > 100f && cooling,
                  $"refused with no target ({none}), at {at.DistanceTo(foe.Position):0} u ({far}: past 900); stepped from {near.DistanceTo(foe.Position):0} u, then refused while it cools ({cooling})");
            foe.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }

        // A WEB LETS GO: two webifiers latched on the Wraith, a step onto one of them or onto a held gunship 400-800 u off:
        // pinned no longer and every web off within 0.3 s, at three varied spots
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            Ready();
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            var webs = new List<Raider>();
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) { var w = H.SpawnRaider(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 280f)); w.Quarry = wt; webs.Add(w); }
            var gun = HeldI(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 800f), Enemies.Gunship);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && !webs.All(w => w.Latched); i++) { wt.Position = at; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); }
            bool latched = webs.All(w => w.Latched) && wt.Pinned;
            IHittable onto = run == 1 ? webs[0] : gun;
            wt.UseAbility("step", onto.NetId);
            double clock = 0, freedAt = -1;
            while (freedAt < 0 && clock < 0.5) { wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Frame(); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime(); if (!wt.Pinned && webs.All(w => !w.Latched)) freedAt = clock; }
            Check(latched && freedAt >= 0 && freedAt <= 0.3,
                  $"a step onto {(run == 1 ? "one of the two webifiers on it" : "a gunship")} from under two webs: every web let go {freedAt:0.00} s on (0.3)");
            foreach (var r in webs) r.TakeDamage(1e12); gun.TakeDamage(1e12);
            await Wait(0.3);
        }
        Ready();
        wt.Demo = demo; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wt.Position = yonder;
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S SHADOW STEP. The host (LaneA6dStepHostWatch) holds a gunship 400-600 u off the guest's
    // Wraith at a varied heading; the guest (LaneA6dStepGuestChecks) steps onto it: on the guest it lands 140 u off the
    // tail; on the host the step is counted (14 s) and the guest's hull, 1 s on, is within 30 u of the host's own spot.
    sealed class LaneA6dStepSeen { public bool Done, Counted; public float Off = -1; public double Since = -1; public Raider Held; }
    LateSampler LaneA6dStepHostWatch(LaneA6dStepSeen seen)
    {
        float rrot = VaryAngle();
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightWraith, Alive: true } g || Math.Abs(g.MaxHp - 220) > 1e-6) return false;
            if (seen.Held == null) { seen.Held = HeldI(g.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 600f), Enemies.Gunship); }
            seen.Held.Rotation = rrot;
            if (g.Sl("step").Cool <= 0) return false;
            if (seen.Since < 0) { seen.Since = 0; seen.Counted = g.Sl("step").Cool > 13; }
            seen.Since += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            if (seen.Since < 1.0) return false;
            seen.Off = g.Position.DistanceTo(seen.Held.Position - Vector2.Up.Rotated(rrot) * 140f);
            seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dStepHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dStepSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 90 : 60);
        watch.QueueFree();
        await Wait(1.0);
        if (seen.Held != null && IsInstanceValid(seen.Held)) seen.Held.TakeDamage(1e12);
        Check(seen.Done && seen.Counted && seen.Off >= 0 && seen.Off <= 30f,
              $"arena host: the guest Wraith's shadow step is counted ({seen.Counted}: 14 s) and its hull lands {seen.Off:0.0} u from the host's own spot 140 u off the gunship's tail (30)");
    }

    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = true;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 220) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);           // the host's word for the hull
        // the host's gunship, 400-600 u off (the EMP's craft, still about, were held 150-250 u off)
        Raider Near() => H.Raiders.Where(r => r.Position.DistanceTo(me.Position) is >= 330f and <= 700f).OrderBy(r => r.Position.DistanceTo(me.Position)).FirstOrDefault();
        await RealTime(() => Near() != null, Wan ? 20 : 10);                                // the host's gunship, spawned for this Wraith

        me.Sl("step").Cool = 0; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;

        Check(foe != null && off < 1f,

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S PEPPERBOX. The guest (LaneA6dPepperGuestChecks) flies a DART at rest, its cursor
    // on a varied point 400-600 u off the nose, and holds the trigger 2 s: its own world shows the host's darts
    // (cosmetic copies, Commanded onto ITS cursor) -- 12 +- 2 of them, each within 10° of the bearing to the cursor
    // 0.3 s into its flight. The host (LaneA6dPepperHostWatch) sees its OWN copies of those darts leave the guest's
    // nose, 7.5 each (at rest, x1), and steer onto the cursor the guest reports.
    sealed class LaneA6dPepperSeen { public int Darts, Priced, Steered; public bool Done; public double T; }
    LateSampler LaneA6dPepperHostWatch(LaneA6dPepperSeen seen)
    {
        var counted = new HashSet<Shot>();   // every dart once (a steered one leaves `mine` and must not be counted again)
        var mine = new HashSet<Shot>();      // the counted darts not yet seen steering
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightDart } g) return false;
            foreach (var x in Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Pepper && x.Source == g && x.Alive))
                if (counted.Add(x)) { mine.Add(x); seen.Darts++; if (Math.Abs(x.Damage - 7.5) < 1e-6) seen.Priced++; }
            foreach (var x in mine.Where(x => IsInstanceValid(x) && x.Alive).ToList())
                if (Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(x.Dir.Angle(), (g.AimPoint - x.GlobalPosition).Angle())) < Mathf.DegToRad(10f)) { seen.Steered++; mine.Remove(x); }
            if (seen.Darts > 0) seen.T += GetProcessDeltaTime();
            if (seen.T < 3.0) return false;
            seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dPepperHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dPepperSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 120 : 80);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Done && seen.Darts >= 10 && seen.Priced == seen.Darts && seen.Steered >= seen.Darts - 2,
              $"arena host: the guest's pepperbox -- {seen.Darts} darts of the host's own (12 +- 2), {seen.Priced} of them 7.5 (at rest), {seen.Steered} steering onto the cursor the guest reports");
    }
    async Task LaneA6dPepperGuestChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.LightDart);
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = true;
        await RealTime(() => Math.Abs(me.MaxHp - 200) < 1e-6, Wan ? 20 : 10);           // the host's word for the hull
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
        await Wait(0.4);
        var at = me.Position; float rot = me.Rotation;
        var aim = at + Vector2.Up.Rotated(rot + Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-40f, 40f))) * Vary(400f, 600f);
        var copies = new Dictionary<Shot, double>();
        int steered = 0, judged = 0;
        me.Trigger = true;
        for (double t = 0; t < 2.6; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
        {
            me.Position = at; me.Rotation = rot; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.AimPoint = aim;
            if (t > 2.0) me.Trigger = false;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            foreach (var x in Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Pepper && x.Cosmetic)) if (!copies.ContainsKey(x)) copies[x] = 0;
            foreach (var x in copies.Keys.ToList())
            {
                if (copies[x] < 0) continue;
                copies[x] += GetProcessDeltaTime();
                if (copies[x] < 0.3 || !IsInstanceValid(x) || !x.Alive) continue;
                judged++;
                if (Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(x.Dir.Angle(), (aim - x.GlobalPosition).Angle())) < Mathf.DegToRad(10f) || x.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(aim) < 30f) steered++;
                copies[x] = -1;
            }
        }
        me.Trigger = false; me.Demo = demo;
        Check(copies.Count >= 10 && copies.Count <= 14 && steered >= judged - 1 && judged >= 8,
              $"arena guest: its pepperbox held 2 s -- {copies.Count} of the host's darts in its world (12 +- 2), {steered} of {judged} within 10° of the bearing to its cursor 0.3 s into their flight");
    }

    // ── SLICE 6d, RUNG 5: A GUEST'S SPRINT AND ROD. The guest (LaneA6dRodGuestChecks), after its pepperbox, presses F
    // on a varied heading: its own copy is forced open within 0.5 s of the press (one round trip) and flies it past
    // 300 u/s; its world shows the rod, and its own copy keeps at most 32% of its peak after (the recoil, on its own falling
    // edge whichever of its countdown or the host's packet ends the run). The host (LaneA6dRodHostWatch) fires the rod from ITS copy of the guest's Dart,
    // priced at the sprint's 360 from its own lifts: 249.2 within 1%.
    sealed class LaneA6dRodSeen { public double Damage = -1; public bool Done; }
    LateSampler LaneA6dRodHostWatch(LaneA6dRodSeen seen)
    {
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (seen.Done || H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => !s.Mine) is not { Class: ShipClass.LightDart } g) return false;
            if (Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod && x.Source == g) is not { } rod) return false;
            seen.Damage = rod.Damage; seen.Done = true;
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return watch;
    }
    async Task LaneA6dRodHostChecks(LateSampler watch, LaneA6dRodSeen seen)
    {
        await RealTime(() => seen.Done, Wan ? 60 : 30);
        watch.QueueFree();
        Check(seen.Done && Math.Abs(seen.Damage - 249.23) <= 249.23 * 0.01,
              $"arena host: the guest's rod leaves the host's copy of its Dart carrying {seen.Damage:0.0} (249.2 at the sprint's 360, within 1%)");
    }
    async Task LaneA6dRodGuestChecks()
    {
        var me = Me; me.AutopilotTo = null; bool demo = me.Demo; me.Demo = true;
        me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; me.Rotation = VaryAngle();
        await Wait(0.3);
        var was = Nodes<Shot>().Where(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod).ToHashSet();
        me.UseAbility("rod", 0);
        double t = 0, tForced = -1; float peak = 0; bool sawRod = false;
        for (; t < 5.0 && !sawRod; t += GetProcessDeltaTime())
        {
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            if (tForced < 0 && me.Forced) tForced = t;
            peak = Mathf.Max(peak, me.SpeedAhead);
            sawRod = Nodes<Shot>().Any(x => x.Kind == Shots.Rod && !was.Contains(x));
        }
        // ITS RECOIL, on its own copy: timed from the first frame its sprint reads over there (its own countdown or the
        // host's packet, whichever got there first), two frames on it keeps no more than 32% of the peak
        double tOver = 0;
        while (sawRod && me.Forced && tOver < 1.0) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); tOver += GetProcessDeltaTime(); }
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        float kept = me.SpeedAhead; bool over = !me.Forced;
        me.Demo = demo; me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        Check(tForced >= 0 && tForced <= 0.5 && peak > 300f && sawRod && over && kept <= 0.32f * peak,
              $"arena guest: its sprint forced open {tForced:0.00} s after the press (within 0.5), flown to {peak:0} u/s (past 300), the host's rod seen in its world ({sawRod}), and after it {kept:0} u/s kept (at most 0.32 x the peak: {0.32f * peak:0}; its sprint over: {over})");
    }

    async Task LaneA4WreckChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Destroyer);
        var dd = Me; dd.AutopilotTo = null;
        var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
        const string Mark = "open6";
        var stasis = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        async Task Frame() => await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Pinned); dd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Disabled);
            float a = VaryAngle(), d0 = k == 2 ? Vary(220f, 280f) : Vary(400f, 690f);
            dd.Position = dummy.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(a) * d0; dd.Rotation = VaryAngle();
            dd.Velocity = Vector2.Right.Rotated(a + Mathf.Pi / 2) * (k == 1 ? Vary(30f, 60f) : 0f);
            dd.Sl(Mark).Left = 0; dd.Sl(Mark).N = 0;
            await Frame();
            string why = dd.BeginHelm(HelmMoves.Tether, dummy, GrapnelNums(Mark));
            await Wait(Vary(0.1f, 0.4f));
            bool onBefore = dd.Helm.On; double tAt = dd.Helm.T;
            dd.Restore(0, false, Vary(20f, 40f));                // wrecked where it lies
            await Frame();
            bool off = !dd.Helm.On && dd.Helm.Ended == HelmEnd.Wrecked;
            stasis.SetValue(dd, 0.0);
            dd.Reboard();
            bool back = dd.Alive;
            await Frame();
            var at = dd.Position;
            await Wait(Vary(0.6f, 1.0f));
            float moved = dd.Position.DistanceTo(at);
            Check(why == null && onBefore && tAt < 0.5 && off && back && !dd.Helm.On && moved < 5f,
                  $"F8 helm: wrecked {tAt:0.00} s after an unmarked press ({(k == 1 ? "sliding" : k == 2 ? "pressed inside the stop" : "still")}): the move is off ({off}: {dd.Helm.Ended}); re-boarded ({back}), the hull moved {moved:0.0} u");
            dd.Hp = dd.MaxHp; dd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        }
    }

    // ── F8 THE PRESS'S POINT AND PICKS ON THE WIRE (kits_v31 §8, rung 5): the arena guest's F, its bubble
    // lent TakesPoint and TakesTargets on both peers, sends its cursor and its picks with the press; the host
    // keeps the cursor in its copy's slot and the living picks in its copy's Picked. The cursor is a LITERAL
    // off the pair's rendezvous (each process seeds its own draws). The picks are the home range's practice
    // hulks 3 then 1 (Hub.PracticeTargets: in Combat.Hostiles on every peer, never down, the same NetId
    // everywhere) around an id nothing holds; Combat.ById reads the hostiles only, so a hull or a turret
    // would be dropped on every run. The freighter holds 1 target: the host lends its row a cap of 3.
    static Vector2 LaneA4MpCursor => Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(2400 + 310, 2400 - 170);
    const int LaneA4MpUnknown = NetIds.Dummy + 900;                  // no range has a 901st hulk
    static readonly int[] LaneA4MpHulks = { 3, 1 };                 // PracticeTargets numbers, in the order sent
    int _laneA4CapWas = -1;
    static int LaneA4HulkId(int n) => Combat.Hostiles.OfType<TargetDummy>().FirstOrDefault(d => d.Number == n)?.NetId ?? -1;
    void LaneA4GuestPointPress(PlayerShip fgm)
    {
        Ab.Bubble.TakesPoint = true; Ab.Bubble.TakesTargets = true;
        int[] picks = { LaneA4HulkId(LaneA4MpHulks[0]), LaneA4MpUnknown, LaneA4HulkId(LaneA4MpHulks[1]) };
        try { fgm.AimPoint = LaneA4MpCursor; fgm.UseAbility("bubble", 0, picks); }
        finally { Ab.Bubble.TakesPoint = false; Ab.Bubble.TakesTargets = false; }
    }
    void LaneA4HostPointLend(PlayerShip fg)
    {
        Ab.Bubble.TakesPoint = true; Ab.Bubble.TakesTargets = true;
        if (fg == null) return;
        fg.Sl("bubble").At = new Vector2(-1, -1);
        _laneA4CapWas = Classes.Of(fg.Class).Targets;
        Classes.Of(fg.Class).Targets = 3;
    }
    void LaneA4HostPointCheck(PlayerShip fg)
    {
        Ab.Bubble.TakesPoint = false; Ab.Bubble.TakesTargets = false;
        if (fg != null && _laneA4CapWas >= 0) Classes.Of(fg.Class).Targets = _laneA4CapWas;
        var at = fg == null ? new Vector2(-1, -1) : fg.Sl("bubble").At;
        Check(fg != null && fg.BubbleUp && at.DistanceTo(LaneA4MpCursor) < 0.01f,
              $"arena host: the guest's Q, its row taking a point, lands the guest's cursor in this copy's slot ({at}, want {LaneA4MpCursor}; bubble up {fg?.BubbleUp})");
        var want = LaneA4MpHulks.Select(LaneA4HulkId).ToArray();
        var got = fg == null ? System.Array.Empty<int>() : fg.Picked.Select(h => h.NetId).ToArray();
        Check(fg != null && fg.BubbleUp && want.All(id => id > 0) && Combat.ById(LaneA4MpUnknown) == null && got.SequenceEqual(want),
              $"arena host: the guest's Q, its row taking targets, sends 3 picks and this copy holds the 2 living ones in the order sent, the unknown {LaneA4MpUnknown} dropped ({string.Join(",", got)}, want {string.Join(",", want)})");
    }

    // ── LANE A SLICE 4 · F10 MEND: the one heal door (the Tender's lance and Repair field are 6b's rows) ──
    // Synchronous on the host's own tender (no frame between, so regeneration adds nothing): a heal lands
    // exactly and is credited to its source; it stops at the hull's maximum and credits only what landed;
    // a wreck, or an amount that is not a positive number, takes nothing.
    async Task LaneA4MendChecks()
    {
        await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightTender);
        var te = Me; te.AutopilotTo = null;
        double Cr(string id) => te.MendedBy.GetValueOrDefault(id);
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            te.Hp = te.MaxHp * (k == 0 ? Vary(0.15f, 0.35f) : k == 1 ? Vary(0.45f, 0.65f) : Vary(0.75f, 0.85f));
            double amount = k == 0 ? Vary(5f, 30f) : k == 1 ? Vary(30f, 60f) : Vary(0.5f, 0.1f * (float)te.MaxHp);
            string src = k == 1 ? "repair" : "lance";
            double hp0 = te.Hp, cr0 = Cr(src), other0 = Cr(src == "lance" ? "repair" : "lance");
            double got = Mend.Give(te, amount, te, src);
            Check(Math.Abs(got - amount) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(te.Hp - hp0 - amount) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Cr(src) - cr0 - amount) < 1e-9
                  && Cr(src == "lance" ? "repair" : "lance") == other0,
                  $"F10: {amount:0.0} mended on a hull at {hp0 / te.MaxHp * 100:0}% lands whole ({got:0.00}), credited to {src} alone");
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        {
            double gap = k == 2 ? 0 : k == 0 ? Vary(2f, 10f) : Vary(15f, 40f);
            te.Hp = te.MaxHp - gap;
            double amount = gap + Vary(10f, 60f), cr0 = Cr("lance");
            double got = Mend.Give(te, amount, te, "lance");
            Check(Math.Abs(got - gap) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(te.Hp - te.MaxHp) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Cr("lance") - cr0 - gap) < 1e-9,
                  $"F10: {amount:0.0} mended on a hull {gap:0.0} short of full stops at full ({te.Hp:0.0} / {te.MaxHp:0}) and credits {got:0.00}, only what landed");
        }
        te.Hp = te.MaxHp * Vary(0.3f, 0.7f);
        foreach (double bad in new[] { double.NaN, -Vary(5f, 50f), double.PositiveInfinity, 0.0 })
        {
            double hp0 = te.Hp, cr0 = Cr("lance");
            double got = Mend.Give(te, bad, te, "lance");
            Check(got == 0 && te.Hp == hp0 && Cr("lance") == cr0, $"F10: an amount of {bad} mends nothing ({got})");
        }
        {   // A WRECK (in stasis), then re-boarded and put back whole
            te.Restore(0, false, Vary(20f, 40f));
            double hp0 = te.Hp, cr0 = Cr("lance");
            double got = Mend.Give(te, Vary(10f, 50f), te, "lance");
            bool wreck = !te.Alive;
            typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_stasis", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(te, 0.0);
            te.UseAbility("reboard", 0); await Wait(0.1);
            te.Restore(te.MaxHp, true, 0);
            Check(wreck && got == 0 && te.Hp == te.MaxHp && hp0 == 0 && Cr("lance") == cr0 && te.Alive,
                  $"F10: a wreck takes nothing ({got}); re-boarded, whole again");
        }
        te.Hp = te.MaxHp;
    }

    // THE SAME ROWS ON A LIVE SHIP, for every class that owns the slot: its slot running draws the
    // field from its OWN sheet. A slot no class owns yet is another lane's ability still to merge
    // (lane E's Supercarrier, the Warden's Taunt, lane B's boost): said as a NOTE, never a pass.
    async Task FieldsLiveRowChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var row in new[] { "patrol", "taunt", "boost" })
        {
            var def = Fields.Of(row);
            var owners = Enum.GetValues<ShipClass>().Where(c => Abilities.For(c).Any(a => a.Id == def.Slot)).ToList();
            if (owners.Count == 0) { GD.Print($"NOTE unbound field row {row}: no class owns slot '{def.Slot}' yet"); continue; }
            foreach (var c in owners.Take(3))
            {
                await SetClass(c);
                var s = Me; s.Position = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); s.Rotation = VaryAngle(); s.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                s.Sl(def.Slot).Left = Vary(1.5f, 3f);
                var f = Fields.Up(s).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == row);
                bool radiusOk = row != "patrol" || (Math.Abs(f.Radius - s.Stats["patrol_range"]) < 1e-3 && s.Stats["patrol_range"] >= 600 - 1e-6);
                bool tagOk = row != "taunt" || f.Tag == $"−{Mathf.RoundToInt((float)(1 - s.Stats["taunt_guard"]) * 100)}%";
                Check(f.Row != null && radiusOk && tagOk,
                      $"fields: a live {c} with its '{def.Slot}' slot running draws the {row} field ({f.Radius:0} u{(f.Tag != null ? ", " + f.Tag : "")})");
                s.Sl(def.Slot).Left = 0;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                Check(!Fields.Up(s).Any(u => u.Row.Id == row), $"fields: ...and none once the {c}'s '{def.Slot}' slot is out");
            }
        }
    }
    // THE TAUNT'S FLASH IS AN EFFECT ROW: raised at three seeded spots with its 1000 u reach, one
    // node each, that ring at that size, and gone after its 0.8 s.
    async Task FieldsTauntRingChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
        {
            var at = VaryNear(yonder, 600f);
            Fx.Raise(Fx.TauntRing, at, 1000f);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            var n = Nodes<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.TauntRing).ToList();
            Check(Fx.All[Fx.TauntRing].Id == "taunt_ring" && n.Count == 1 && Math.Abs(n[0].Radius - 1000f) < 1e-3 && n[0].GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(at) < 0.5f,
                  $"fields: the taunt's ring goes up once, 1000 u round where it was pressed ({n.Count} up)");
            await Wait(1.0);
            Check(!Nodes<FxNode>().Any(x => x.Id == Fx.TauntRing), "fields: ...and is gone after its 0.8 s");
        }
    }
    // ── THE TORN CHUNK (lane D, F9; kits_v3 §3.2, kits_v31 §3.3): ONE raise per tear, riding the
    // anchor's NetId, Size 0.16 x the hull's length; with it the sparks, the smoke and a scar on the
    // hull at the hook. The chunk leaves at 260 u/s within ±25° of the line to the destroyer and is
    // at rest at 2 s; the node follows the pure Fx.Tumble of its raise, which is what lets every peer
    // draw the same chunk. `size` is the spec's literal (kits_v3 §3.2: dummy 14.72 -- its "15 u", 0.16
    // x 2 x its 46 u hit radius --, Lancer 57.6, pylon 35.2, base 89.6), NaN only for a boss the spec
    // gives no figure for. Once up the chunk has left its hull for the world (Combat.World), so a hull
    // killed under it does not take it along. The hook, the bearing and the distance to the destroyer
    // are seeded, and re-taken for every tear.
    async Task FieldsRipChecks(IHittable anchor, string what, float size, bool timed)
    {
        var n = (Node2D)anchor;
        float len = Fx.LengthOf(anchor);
        var hookLocal = new Vector2(Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * anchor.HitRadius, Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * len);
        var hook = n.ToGlobal(hookLocal);
        var toward = hook + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 700f);
        int scars0 = n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion());
        Fx.Tear(anchor, hook, toward);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var rips = Nodes<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3).ToList();
        var chunk = rips.FirstOrDefault();
        float want = float.IsNaN(size) ? 0.16f * len : size;
        Check(rips.Count == 1 && chunk.Anchor == anchor.NetId && chunk.GetParent() == Combat.World && Math.Abs(chunk.Radius - want) < 0.05f && Math.Abs(0.16f * len - want) < 0.05f
              && chunk.Start.DistanceTo(hook) < 0.5f,
              $"rip on the {what}: ONE chunk rides its id, out in the world ({chunk?.GetParent()?.Name}), {want:0.0} u (0.16 of its {len:0} u), cut where the hook was ({rips.Count} raised, {chunk?.Radius:0.0} u, {chunk?.Start.DistanceTo(hook):0.0} u off)");
        int sparks = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.RipSparks && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3);
        int smoke = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.RipSmoke && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId && x.Elapsed < 0.3);
        var scars = n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion()).ToList();
        var fresh = scars.OrderBy(x => x.Elapsed).FirstOrDefault();
        Check(sparks == 1 && smoke == 1 && scars.Count == Math.Min(scars0 + 1, 3) && fresh != null && fresh.Position.DistanceTo(hookLocal) < 0.5f
              && Fx.All[Fx.RipSparks].Count == 28 && Fx.All[Fx.RipSmoke].Count == 6,
              $"rip on the {what}: 28 sparks and 6 puffs go with it, and a scar on the hull at the hook ({sparks}, {smoke}, {scars.Count} scars)");
        if (chunk == null) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && chunk.Elapsed < 0.5; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        if (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk)) { Check(false, $"rip on the {what}: the chunk is gone before 0.5 s"); return; }
        double e = chunk.Elapsed;
        var moved = chunk.GlobalPosition - chunk.Start;
        float off = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(moved.AngleTo(toward - chunk.Start)));
        float run = 260f * (float)(e - e * e / 4);
        var (pure, _) = Fx.Tumble(chunk.Seed, chunk.Start, toward, e);
        Check(off <= 25.01f && Math.Abs(moved.Length() - run) < 1f && chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(pure) < 0.01f,
              $"rip on the {what}: {e:0.00} s on, the chunk is {moved.Length():0} u out (260 u/s slowing to rest in 2 s: {run:0}), {off:0.0} degrees off the line to the destroyer, exactly where its raise says");
        if (!timed) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && chunk.Elapsed < 2.2; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        var still = chunk.GlobalPosition;
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        bool atRest = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(still) < 0.01f;
        await Wait(1.1);
        bool gone = !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) || chunk.IsQueuedForDeletion();
        bool loose = !Nodes<FxNode>().Any(x => (x.Id == Fx.RipSparks || x.Id == Fx.RipSmoke) && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId);
        bool scarOn = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(fresh) && !fresh.IsQueuedForDeletion();
        Check(atRest && gone && loose && scarOn,
              $"rip on the {what}: the chunk lies still past 2 s and is gone by 3.3 s with its sparks and smoke; the scar stays (still {atRest}, gone {gone}, sprays gone {loose}, scar {scarOn})");
        await Wait(7.0);
        Check(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(fresh) || fresh.IsQueuedForDeletion(), $"rip on the {what}: ...and the scar is gone by 10.3 s");
    }
    // AT MOST 3 SCARS ON ONE HULL: four tears in a row leave three, the first one gone.
    async Task FieldsScarCapChecks(IHittable anchor)
    {
        var n = (Node2D)anchor;
        FxNode first = null;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
        {
            var hook = n.ToGlobal(new Vector2(Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * anchor.HitRadius, Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * Fx.LengthOf(anchor)));
            Fx.Tear(anchor, hook, hook + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 700f));
            await Wait(Vary(0.08f, 0.15f));
            first ??= n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion());
        }
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        int scars = n.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Count(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar && !x.IsQueuedForDeletion());
        Check(scars == 3 && (!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(first) || first.IsQueuedForDeletion()),
              $"four tears in a row leave 3 scars on the hull, the oldest gone ({scars})");
    }
    // A HULL KILLED UNDER ITS OWN CHUNK: torn at a seeded hook, then killed 0.2 s later by its caller
    // (the real kill: an emplacement is freed the frame it dies). The chunk was cut and has left for
    // the world, so at 1 s it is still drawn, where its raise says, with its sparks and smoke -- a
    // chunk that stayed its hull's child went with it (the gate's finding, kits_v3 §3.2's 3 s life).
    async Task<FxNode> FieldsTearAhead(IHittable anchor)
    {
        var n = (Node2D)anchor;
        var hook = n.ToGlobal(new Vector2(Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * anchor.HitRadius, Vary(-0.4f, 0.4f) * Fx.LengthOf(anchor)));
        Fx.Tear(anchor, hook, hook + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(400f, 700f));
        await Wait(0.2);
        return Nodes<FxNode>().Where(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip && x.Anchor == anchor.NetId).OrderBy(x => x.Elapsed).FirstOrDefault();
    }
    async Task FieldsRipOutlivesChecks(FxNode chunk, Node2D hull, string what)
    {
        int id = chunk?.Anchor ?? -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && !chunk.IsQueuedForDeletion() && chunk.Elapsed < 1.0; i++)
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        bool hullGone = !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(hull) || hull.IsQueuedForDeletion();
        bool drawn = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(chunk) && !chunk.IsQueuedForDeletion() && chunk.IsVisibleInTree()
                     && chunk.GetParent() == Combat.World && chunk.Elapsed >= 1.0
                     && chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(Fx.Tumble(chunk.Seed, chunk.Start, chunk.To, chunk.Elapsed).At) < 0.01f;
        int sprays = Nodes<FxNode>().Count(x => (x.Id == Fx.RipSparks || x.Id == Fx.RipSmoke) && x.Anchor == id);
        Check(hullGone && drawn && sprays == 2,
              $"a {what} killed 0.2 s after a tear leaves its chunk flying: at 1 s it is still drawn where its raise says, with its sparks and smoke (hull gone {hullGone}, chunk {drawn}, {sprays} sprays)");
    }
    // THE YARD'S DUMMIES: three tears -- the two hulks (TargetDummy1, TargetDummy3, the spec's 14.72 u
    // literal) and the first practice fighter (PracticeFighter1, row 4: a fighter, not a fourth hulk,
    // so its chunk is sized off its OWN length, not the hulk literal) -- the last one watched to the end,
    // then the cap.
    async Task FieldsRipYardChecks()
    {
        var names = new[] { "TargetDummy1", "TargetDummy3", "PracticeFighter1" };
        var sizes = new[] { 14.72f, 14.72f, float.NaN };
        float dummyLen = Fx.LengthOf(H.GetNode<TargetDummy>(names[0]));
        Check(Math.Abs(0.16f * dummyLen - 15f) < 0.3f, $"a dummy's chunk is the spec's 15 u: 0.16 of its {dummyLen:0.0} u is {0.16f * dummyLen:0.00} u");
        for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
            await FieldsRipChecks(H.GetNode<TargetDummy>(names[i]), $"the {names[i]}", sizes[i], timed: i == names.Length - 1);
        await FieldsScarCapChecks(H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1"));
    }
    // A GUEST SEES THE HOST'S TEAR (rung 5). The host tears a chunk from the boss's nose, at the
    // literal hook FieldsRipHook, thrown at the guest's ship; this watches every frame, from before
    // the arena, for the first chunk to go up here, and reads it once it has flown 30 u: riding the
    // boss's id at the Lancer's 57.6 u, gone up within 20 u of where the boss's nose is on THIS
    // peer, flying down its SEEDED line -- the line to this ship turned by this peer's own
    // Fx.U(seed, 0) x 25 degrees -- and its scar on the boss here too. The line is to where this ship
    // is NOW and the host aimed at where it was, so the budget is what the ship has moved since (20 u,
    // plus its speed over the chunk's flight and the wire) seen from where the chunk went up; it
    // never rests on the spec's 25 degree bound.
    static Vector2 FieldsRipHook(float len) => new(0, -0.4f * len);
    void FieldsHostTears(Boss boss, PlayerShip at)
    {
        if (boss == null || at == null) return;
        Fx.Tear(boss, boss.ToGlobal(FieldsRipHook(boss.Length)), at.Position);
    }
    string _guestRip;
    LateSampler FieldsGuestRipWatch()
    {
        _guestRip = null;
        var w = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (_guestRip != null) return true;
            var b = H?.Boss; var me = Me;
            var chunk = Nodes<FxNode>().FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == Fx.Rip);
            if (b == null || me == null || chunk == null || chunk.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(chunk.Start) < 30f) return false;
            float fromNose = chunk.Start.DistanceTo(b.ToGlobal(FieldsRipHook(b.Length)));
            var line = me.Position - chunk.Start;
            var seeded = line.Normalized().Rotated(Mathf.DegToRad((Fx.U(chunk.Seed, 0) * 2 - 1) * 25f));
            float off = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs((chunk.GlobalPosition - chunk.Start).AngleTo(seeded)));
            float moved = 20f + me.Velocity.Length() * (float)(chunk.Elapsed + (Wan ? 0.6 : 0.25));
            float budget = Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Atan2(moved, Mathf.Max(1f, line.Length())));
            bool scar = b.GetChildren().OfType<FxNode>().Any(x => x.Id == Fx.Scar);
            bool ok = chunk.Anchor == b.NetId && Math.Abs(chunk.Radius - 57.6f) < 0.05f && fromNose < 20f && off < budget && scar;
            _guestRip = $"{(ok ? "ok" : "BAD")}: rides {chunk.Anchor} (boss {b.NetId}), {chunk.Radius:0.0} u, {fromNose:0.0} u from the nose here, {off:0.0} degrees off its seeded line to this ship (budget {budget:0.0}), scar {scar}";
            return true;
        } };
        AddChild(w);
        return w;
    }
    async Task FieldsGuestRipChecks(LateSampler w)
    {
        await RealTime(() => w.Seen, Wan ? 20 : 12);
        Check(_guestRip != null && _guestRip.StartsWith("ok"), $"arena guest: the host's torn chunk is drawn here, the same chunk ({_guestRip ?? "never seen"})");
        w.QueueFree();
    }

    // A GUEST DRAWS THE HOST'S BUBBLE: the same row, from the slot the host's report carried.
    void FieldsGuestBubbleChecks(PlayerShip fgm)
    {
        var b = Fields.Up(fgm).FirstOrDefault(u => u.Row.Id == "bubble");
        Check(b.Row != null && Math.Abs(b.Radius - 260f) < 1e-3 && Math.Abs(b.Left - 250f / 400f) < 1e-3,
              $"arena guest: its bubble FIELD is drawn from the host's slot, 260 u at 250 of 400 ({b.Radius:0} u, {b.Left:0.000})");
    }

    // ── THE RECYCLER: a hold turned back into salvage, and a lock so it cannot eat what you fly ──
    // A part could not be got rid of at all before this: a hold filled with commons a pilot would
    // never fit again, and salvage had nothing to buy but a refit and gear levels.
    // ── LANE E · WINGS (F13 widened, kits_v31 §3.2 / kits_v3 §3.1): the gunship and patrol rows, the
    // Orbit way, the ring pick. The keys that send them are 6a's (the Carrier's E and Q); these checks
    // send them through PlayerShip.Sortie, the one door those keys will use.
    void WingsRowsChecks()
    {
        var gs = Wings.Of(WingKind.Gunship); var pt = Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol); var fi = Wings.Of(WingKind.Fighter);
        var cv = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Carrier);
        // the wire id is the index: gunship 2, then patrol 3 (kits_v3 §3.1)
        Check(Wings.All.Length == 4 && Wings.All[2].Id == "gunship" && Wings.All[3].Id == "patrol"
              && gs.Way == WingWay.Orbit && gs.Sortie && pt.Sortie && !fi.Sortie && !Wings.Of(WingKind.Bomber).Sortie,
              $"Wings.All: fighter 0, bomber 1, gunship 2 (the Orbit way), patrol 3 -- both sorties, the fitted two not ({string.Join(" ", Wings.All.Select(w => w.Id))})");
        Check(cv["gunship_count"] == 2 && cv["gunship_orbit"] == 240 && cv["gunship_time"] == 12 && cv["gunship_leash"] == 3000
              && Math.Abs(cv["gunship_damage"] / cv["gunship_interval"] - 10) < 1e-9,
              $"warp gunships: 2 a target, a 240 u orbit, 12 s, sent inside 3000 u, 10 DPS each ({cv["gunship_damage"]} / {cv["gunship_interval"]} s)");
        // "Every number is the fighter's": the patrol reads the fighter's own stat ids, so what lifts one lifts both
        Check(cv["patrol_range"] == 600 && cv["patrol_orbit"] == 300 && cv["patrol_time"] == 20
              && pt.CountStat == fi.CountStat && pt.SpeedStat == fi.SpeedStat && pt.DamageStat == fi.DamageStat
              && pt.IntervalStat == fi.IntervalStat && pt.TurnStat == fi.TurnStat && pt.RangeStat == fi.RangeStat
              && pt.BurstStat == null && pt.EngageStat == "patrol_range" && pt.ToHull
              && Classes.Of(ShipClass.Carrier).Reach.ContainsKey("patrol_range"),
              "the patrol: a 600 u ring measured to the hull, circling 300 u out, 20 s, on the fighter's own count, gun, speed and turn, no rest -- and its ring on the carrier's Reach list");
        // THE PATROL'S ORDER IS THE TURRET'S: in flight 0, small craft 1, the rest 2, a dummy 3 (a fallback)
        var f = Targeting.Patrol;
        var mis = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Missile }; var lt = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Light };
        var hv = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Heavy }; var dm = new StandIn { Tags = Tag.Dummy };
        Check(f.Chooses(mis) && f.Chooses(hv) && f.Chooses(dm) && f.IsFallback(dm) && !f.IsFallback(mis)
              && Turret.RankIn(f, mis) == 0 && Turret.RankIn(f, lt) == 1 && Turret.RankIn(f, hv) == 2 && Turret.RankIn(f, dm) == 3
              && !Targeting.WingPrey.Chooses(mis),
              $"Targeting.Patrol takes a missile (WingPrey never does), ranked missile {Turret.RankIn(f, mis)} < light {Turret.RankIn(f, lt)} < heavy {Turret.RankIn(f, hv)} < dummy {Turret.RankIn(f, dm)}, the dummy a fallback");
    }

    // THE PATROL, flown: from three seeded spots and headings, a carrier parked with its point defence
    // out of reach (the patrol on trial). Launched 0.83 s apart, fighter_count of them; circling
    // 300 u out; a light whose hull edge is inside 600 u engaged, one outside not; +8% on the ring
    // takes one at 612-640; a seeker coming in is taken OVER the light it is on and downed before it
    // lands, credited "patrol"; the fitted fighters attack a target 1400 u out with the patrol up (6
    // craft out); the sortie ends at its LifeStat and every patrol craft is home and freed.
    async Task WingsPatrolChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var cv = Me; double pdWas = PdReachOff(cv);
        var ringStat = cv.Stats.All.First(x => x.Id == "patrol_range");
        List<Wing> Patrol() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Done).ToList();
        Raider Mark(Vector2 at) { var l = H.SpawnRaider(at); l.Hp = 9000; l.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return l; }
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { cv.Position = at; cv.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; cv.Rotation = head; }
                async Task Frame() { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                Hold(); await Wait(0.2);
                cv.RecallWing();
                if (run == 1) cv.Stats.SetBase("fighter_count", 4);          // a Hangars part's +1: the patrol reads the fighter's count
                int want = (int)cv.Stats["fighter_count"];
                int sent = cv.Sortie(WingKind.Patrol);
                var pat = Patrol();
                // sent for the row's LifeStat: its end read in the frame it was sent
                double life = pat.Count > 0 ? pat.Max(w => w.Until) - cv.Clock : -1;
                bool lifeAll = pat.Count > 0 && pat.All(w => Math.Abs(w.Until - cv.Clock - 20) < 1e-6);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && pat.Any(w => w.LaunchedAt < 0); i++) await Frame();
                var outs = pat.Select(w => w.LaunchedAt).Where(t => t >= 0).OrderBy(t => t).ToList();
                double gap = 99; for (int g = 1; g < outs.Count; g++) gap = Math.Min(gap, outs[g] - outs[g - 1]);
                Check(sent == want && pat.Count == want && outs.Count == want && gap >= 0.83 - 1e-9 && gap < 0.83 + 0.05 && lifeAll,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the patrol is fighter_count craft ({want}), out of the hangar 0.83 s apart ({sent} sent, smallest gap {gap:0.000} s), sent for 20 s ({life:0.###} s)");
                if (run == 1) cv.Stats.SetBase("fighter_count", 3);
                // circling the carrier 300 u out: the frames after every craft has settled into the circle
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !pat.All(w => w.FighterPhase == "Circle"); i++) await Frame();
                await Wait(1.5); Hold();
                float lo = 9999f, hi = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++) { await Frame(); foreach (var w in pat) { float d = w.Position.DistanceTo(at); lo = Mathf.Min(lo, d); hi = Mathf.Max(hi, d); } }
                Check(pat.All(w => w.FighterPhase == "Circle") && lo > 300 - 40 && hi < 300 + 40,
                      $"run {run + 1}: with nothing in its ring the patrol circles the carrier 300 u out ({lo:0}-{hi:0} u)");
                // THE RING, measured to the hull's edge: one light well inside, then one well outside
                var bearing = VaryAngle();
                var inL = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * 1f);
                inL.Position = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * (Vary(560f, 590f) + inL.HitRadius);
                bool took = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && !took; i++) { await Frame(); took = pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, inL)); }
                Check(took, $"run {run + 1}: a light whose hull edge is {Wings.Reach(cv, Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol), inL):0} u from the carrier (inside 600) is engaged");
                inL.TakeDamage(1e12);
                var outL = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing + Vary(1.2f, 2.4f)) * 1f);
                outL.Position = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing + Vary(1.2f, 2.4f)) * (Vary(612f, 640f) + outL.HitRadius);
                bool touched = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2; i++) { await Frame(); touched |= pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, outL)); }
                Check(!touched, $"run {run + 1}: one whose hull edge is {Wings.Reach(cv, Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol), outL):0} u out (past 600) is not");
                // a Targeting Chip's +8% (648 u) takes that one in
                ringStat.Bonus += 0.08;
                bool chip = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && !chip; i++) { await Frame(); chip = pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, outL)); }
                ringStat.Bonus -= 0.08;
                Check(chip && Math.Abs(cv.Stats["patrol_range"] - 600) < 1e-9,
                      $"run {run + 1}: with +8% on the ring (648 u) the one at {Wings.Reach(cv, Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol), outL):0} u is engaged");
                // MISSILES COME FIRST: a light engaged inside the ring, then a seeker from inside it at the carrier
                outL.Position = at + (outL.Position - at).Normalized() * (Vary(250f, 450f) + outL.HitRadius);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && !pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, outL)); i++) await Frame();
                double credit0 = cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol"); int down0 = Shot.Intercepted; double hull0 = cv.Hp;
                var from = at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(480f, 560f);
                var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, from, at - from, 135f, 4000f, 25, targetId: cv.NetId, turnRate: 2f);
                int turnedIn = -1; float downAt = -1f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && sk.Alive; i++)
                {
                    await Frame();
                    if (turnedIn < 0 && pat.Any(w => ReferenceEquals(w.Engaging, sk))) turnedIn = i + 1;
                    if (sk.Alive) downAt = sk.Position.DistanceTo(at);
                }
                Check(turnedIn > 0 && turnedIn <= 2 && !sk.Alive && Shot.Intercepted > down0 && cv.Hp >= hull0
                      && cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") > credit0,
                      $"run {run + 1}: a seeker fired at the carrier from {from.DistanceTo(at):0} u is taken over the light the patrol was on (in {turnedIn} frames) and brought down {downAt:0} u out, before it lands, credited \"patrol\" ({cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") - credit0:0.0}; hull {hull0:0.#} -> {cv.Hp:0.#})");
                outL.TakeDamage(1e12);
                // THE FITTED WING WITH IT: the fighters still attack a target 1400 u out, so 6 craft are out
                if (run == 0)
                {
                    var far = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1350f, 1420f));
                    cv.OrderAttack(far);
                    int outNow = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && outNow < 6; i++)
                    { await Frame(); outNow = Nodes<Wing>().Count(w => w.Carrier == cv && (w.Kind == WingKind.Fighter || w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol) && !w.Inside); }
                    bool fightersAt = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 8 && !fightersAt; i++)
                    { await Frame(); fightersAt = Nodes<Wing>().Any(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Fighter && w.Position.DistanceTo(far.Position) < 400f); }
                    bool patrolHome = Patrol().All(w => w.Position.DistanceTo(at) < 600f + 150f);
                    Check(outNow == 6 && fightersAt && patrolHome && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Fighter) == 3,
                          $"the first wing still attacks a target {at.DistanceTo(far.Position):0} u out with the patrol up: {outNow} craft out, the fighters at it ({fightersAt}), the patrol still round the carrier ({patrolHome})");
                    cv.RecallWing(); far.TakeDamage(1e12);
                }
                // THE END: at its LifeStat (cut to 3 s from here, the row's 20 being proved above) every patrol craft flies
                // home and is freed; the fitted fighters are untouched
                foreach (var w in Patrol()) w.SendOut(null, cv.Clock + 3);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2; i++) await Frame();
                bool stillOut = Patrol().Count == want;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && Patrol().Count > 0; i++) await Frame();
                Check(stillOut && Patrol().Count == 0 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol) == 0 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Fighter) == 3,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the sortie ends at its time -- out 2 s before it, then home and freed ({cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol)} left); the 3 fitted fighters are kept");
                // ENDED WITH CRAFT STILL IN THE HANGAR (the carrier lost in the launch spread, or a short
                // LifeStat): `run` of them out when it ends -- none, one, two -- the rest never go and
                // are freed at once; the ones out come home and are freed as ever
                int crew = (int)cv.Stats["fighter_count"];
                cv.Sortie(WingKind.Patrol);
                var early = Patrol();
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && early.Count(w => w.LaunchedAt >= 0) < run; i++) await Frame();
                var inside = early.Where(w => w.LaunchedAt < 0).ToList();
                foreach (var w in early) w.SendOut(null, cv.Clock);
                int innerFrames = 0;
                for (; innerFrames < 60 && inside.Any(w => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(w) && !w.Done); innerFrames++) await Frame();
                bool innerFreed = inside.All(w => !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(w) || (w.Done && w.LaunchedAt < 0));
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol) > 0; i++) await Frame();
                Check(early.Count == crew && inside.Count == crew - run && innerFreed && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol) == 0,
                      $"run {run + 1}: a sortie ended with {inside.Count} of {early.Count} still in the hangar: those never launch and are freed within 1 s ({innerFrames} frames), and none is left ({cv.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol)})");
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            cv.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", pdWas); cv.Stats.SetBase("fighter_count", 3);
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
    }

    // THE GUNSHIPS, flown: from three seeded spots, gunship_count warped onto a 240 u circle round a
    // target the carrier sent them at (inside 3000 u; one past it refused), 10 DPS each landed on it,
    // credited "gunship", gone at their time; and, with the patrol up at once, split by anchor --
    // the gunships on their far target, the patrol still round the carrier.
    async Task WingsGunshipChecks(Vector2 yonder)
    {
        foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
        var cv = Me; double pdWas = PdReachOff(cv);
        List<Wing> Guns() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Gunship && !w.Done).ToList();
        Raider Mark(Vector2 at, double hp) { var l = H.SpawnRaider(at, Enemies.Gunship); l.Hp = hp; l.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60); return l; }
        try
        {
            for (int run = 0; run < 3; run++)
            {
                var at = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float head = VaryAngle();
                void Hold() { cv.Position = at; cv.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; cv.Rotation = head; }
                async Task Frame() { Hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                Hold(); await Wait(0.2);
                var bearing = VaryAngle();
                var past = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing) * Vary(3080f, 3400f), 9000);
                int refused = cv.Sortie(WingKind.Gunship, past);
                past.TakeDamage(1e12);
                var tgt = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing + Vary(0.8f, 2.0f)) * Vary(900f, 2900f), 1e9);
                await Frame();
                int sent = cv.Sortie(WingKind.Gunship, tgt);
                var gs = Guns();
                double life = gs.Count > 0 ? gs.Max(w => w.Until) - cv.Clock : -1;
                bool lifeAll = gs.Count > 0 && gs.All(w => Math.Abs(w.Until - cv.Clock - 12) < 1e-6);
                bool warped = false; float firstOff = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && !warped; i++)
                {
                    await Frame();
                    warped = gs.Count == 2 && gs.All(w => w.OrbitPhase == "Orbit");
                    if (warped) firstOff = gs.Max(w => Mathf.Abs(w.Position.DistanceTo(tgt.Position) - 240f));
                }
                Check(refused == 0 && sent == 2 && warped && firstOff < 30f && lifeAll,
                      $"run {run + 1}: gunships at a target {at.DistanceTo(past.Position):0} u out refused ({refused}); at one {at.DistanceTo(tgt.Position):0} u out, 2 warp onto its 240 u circle (off it by {firstOff:0.0} u), sent for 12 s ({life:0.###} s)");
                // the landed DPS, timed from the frame both were on their circle: 2 x 10 over 4 s
                double hp0 = tgt.Hp, c0 = cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("gunship"); float lo = 9999f, hi = 0f;
                for (int i = 0; i < 240; i++) { await Frame(); foreach (var w in gs) { float d = w.Position.DistanceTo(tgt.Position); lo = Mathf.Min(lo, d); hi = Mathf.Max(hi, d); } }
                double lost = hp0 - tgt.Hp, credited = cv.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("gunship") - c0;
                Check(Math.Abs(lost - 80) <= 12 && Math.Abs(credited - lost) < 1e-6 && lo > 240 - 40 && hi < 240 + 40,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the two land {lost:0.0} in 4 s (2 x 10 DPS = 80), all credited \"gunship\" ({credited:0.0}), holding {lo:0}-{hi:0} u round it");
                if (run == 0)
                {   // SPLIT BY ANCHOR: the patrol up at once stays round the carrier while the gunships hold theirs
                    cv.Sortie(WingKind.Patrol);
                    float patrolFar = 0f, gunNear = 9999f;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 5; i++)
                    {
                        await Frame();
                        foreach (var w in Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Inside)) patrolFar = Mathf.Max(patrolFar, w.Position.DistanceTo(at));
                        foreach (var w in Guns()) gunNear = Mathf.Min(gunNear, w.Position.DistanceTo(tgt.Position));
                    }
                    Check(patrolFar > 0 && patrolFar < 600 + 150 && gunNear > 240 - 40 && Guns().Count == 2,
                          $"gunships and the patrol at once, split by anchor: the patrol never past {patrolFar:0} u of the carrier, the gunships never nearer their target than {gunNear:0} u");
                    foreach (var w in Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == cv && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol)) w.SendOut(null, cv.Clock);
                }
                // THE END: at their time (cut to 2 s from here, the row's 12 being proved above) they warp out
                foreach (var w in gs) w.SendOut(tgt, cv.Clock + 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) await Frame();
                bool stillThere = Guns().Count == 2;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && Guns().Count > 0; i++) await Frame();
                Check(stillThere && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) == 0,
                      $"run {run + 1}: the gunships are on station until their time, then gone ({cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship)} left)");
                // ...and a target that dies takes them with it
                if (run == 2)
                {
                    var t2 = Mark(at + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(900f, 1500f), 9000);
                    await Frame();
                    cv.Sortie(WingKind.Gunship, t2);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 && !Guns().All(w => w.OrbitPhase == "Orbit"); i++) await Frame();
                    t2.TakeDamage(1e12);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 10 && cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) > 0; i++) await Frame();
                    Check(cv.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) == 0, "a gunship's target dies: they warp out with it");
                }
                tgt.TakeDamage(1e12);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            cv.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", pdWas);
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) r.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
    }

    async Task RecyclerChecks()
    {
        var yard = H.Yard;
        // THE RECYCLER BELONGS TO THE EQUIPMENT BASE, and serves only a pilot over it and calm
        // (Landmarks.Serves). The ship is set down on the pad at a seeded spot with its combat clock
        // run out, for everything below, and put back after.
        var me = Me; if (me == null) { Check(false, "the recycler checks need a ship to set down on the equipment base"); return; }
        var keepAt = me.Position; var pad = Landmarks.ById("equipment");
        me.Position = pad.At + new Vector2(Vary(-0.8f, 0.8f) * pad.Half.X, Vary(-0.8f, 0.8f) * pad.Half.Y); me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_combatT", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(me, 0.0);
        Character.GearHold.Clear(); Character.GearLocked.Clear();
        Character.Stow("director_suite_t1"); Character.Stow("director_suite_t1"); Character.Stow("salvo_core_t10");
        yard.SetStock("salvage", 0);

        // A KIT PART IS NOT LOOT and is refused outright; a LOCKED part is refused too.
        Character.Stow("bs_main_battery");
        bool kitRefused = !yard.QueueScrap("bs_main_battery");
        Character.ToggleGearLock("salvo_core_t10");
        bool lockedRefused = !yard.QueueScrap("salvo_core_t10") && Character.GearLocked.Contains("salvo_core_t10");

        // QUEUED: out of the hold at once, so it cannot be fitted or queued twice while it waits.
        bool queued = yard.QueueScrap("director_suite_t1");
        bool goneFromHold = Character.GearHold.GetValueOrDefault("director_suite_t1") == 1 && yard.ScrapPending == 1;
        // ...and TAKE BACK puts it straight back.
        bool back = yard.UnqueueScrap("director_suite_t1") && Character.GearHold.GetValueOrDefault("director_suite_t1") == 2 && yard.ScrapPending == 0;
        Check(kitRefused && lockedRefused && queued && goneFromHold && back,
              $"the recycler takes loot and nothing else: a hull's own mount refused, a locked part refused, a queued part out of the hold at once and back again when taken back ({yard.ScrapPending} queued)");

        // IT PAYS, one part every Economy.ScrapEvery, in salvage, by TIER (Tiers.Scrap, §3.4:
        // 100 x 1.25^(t-1)). ONE T10, because the pile will not hold still: the salvagers fill it and
        // the hauler takes loads off it while this runs, so the payment has to be big enough to read
        // through that. 745 against a fleet that moves tens either way in five seconds.
        Character.ToggleGearLock("salvo_core_t10");                      // unlocked, to be scrapped
