                              && Moved("hull")[0] == ("hull", 5.0) && Moved("speed")[0] == ("max_speed", 1.0)
                              && reachOf.Any(t => t.stat == "main_range" && Math.Abs(t.per - 0.01) < 1e-9)
                              && Progression.All.Count(u => u.Share) == 4 && Progression.All.First(u => u.Id == "damage").Share
                              && coolOf.Length == 1 && coolOf[0].stat == "cooldown_share" && Math.Abs(coolOf[0].per - 0.005) < 1e-9
                              && rofOf.Any(t => t.stat == "main_interval" && Math.Abs(t.per - 0.005) < 1e-9),
                              $"all 7 upgrade rows move at least one stat on each of the {Classes.All.Count(x => x.Ready)} flyable classes -- a degree of rudder, 5 hull, 1 u/s, the weapons the class names, 1% of its reach, half a percent off its cooldowns and half a percent off its gun's cycle ({(silent.Count == 0 ? "none silent" : string.Join(" ", silent))})");
                        // ...AND THEY MOVE THE RIGHT WAY. An interval and the cooldown share are INVERSE
                        // stats, which a share divides: twenty Gunnery points are a 2 s battleship reload
                        // of 2 / 1.1 s, and twenty Cooling points cooldowns x1/1.1. Written negative, both
                        // went UP, and the table check above passed.
                        {
                            int[] twenty = new int[Progression.All.Length];
                            twenty[System.Array.FindIndex(Progression.All, u => u.Id == "rof")] = 20;
                            twenty[System.Array.FindIndex(Progression.All, u => u.Id == "cool")] = 20;
                            var drilled = new ShipStats(ShipClass.Battleship, Progression.Shares(twenty, ShipClass.Battleship));
                            Check(Math.Abs(drilled["main_interval"] - 2.0 / 1.1) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(drilled["cooldown_share"] - 1 / 1.1) < 1e-9,
                                  $"twenty Gunnery points shorten a battleship's 2 s reload to {drilled["main_interval"]:0.000} s and twenty Cooling points take its cooldowns to x{drilled["cooldown_share"]:0.000} -- down, both of them");
                        }
                    }
                    // ── WHAT A TARGET IS CALLED, AND WHAT COMING FOR IT IS WORTH ──
                    // Both were type tests in Hub: `Selected is TargetDummy td` for the HUD's
                    // target line and `quarry is Hauler h ? h.Payout : 0` to size an escort, so a
                    // second kind with a name or a load of its own meant a second arm on each.
                    // They are contracts on IHittable and IRaidTarget now, with the default that
                    // everything nameless and empty-handed takes.
                    Check(((IHittable)Me).Label == $"#{Me.NetId}"
                          && H.Yard.Gatherers.All(g => ((IRaidTarget)g).Payout == 0),
                          $"a target names itself and says what it is worth: this ship is {((IHittable)Me).Label}, and a miner is worth 0 credits to the raid that comes for it");
                    System.Array.Copy(keepBought, Character.Bought, keepBought.Length);
                }

                // ── EVERYTHING THAT FLIES IS ONE FLYER WITH A ROW ──
                // Three classes (Shell, Slug, Torpedo) with one copy each of the same sweep,
                // lifetime, cosmetic-copy rule and hit. Eight rows and one node now, and ONE launch
                // on the wire where there were three. The eighth is the round a prism turns back
                // (Shots.Reflect): straight, unguided, at the base's enemies.
                Check(Shots.All.Length == 15 && Shots.Reflect == 7 && Shots.Flak == 8 && Shots.Spotter == 9 && Shots.Buster == 10
                      && Shots.Pepper == 11 && Shots.Rod == 12 && Shots.Echo == 13 && Shots.Pellet == 14
                      && Shots.Of(Shots.Buster).Stops == 1 && Shots.Of(Shots.Buster).VersusMult == 2 && Shots.Of(Shots.Buster).Through == 0.25
                      && Shots.Of(Shots.Buster).Versus == (Tag.Boss | Tag.Structure) && Shots.All.Count(x => x.Through > 0) == 1
                      && !Shots.Of(Shots.Reflect).AtPlayers && !Shots.Of(Shots.Reflect).Guided && Shots.Of(Shots.Reflect).Sweep == 6f
                      && !Shots.Of(Shots.Reflect).Smoke
                      && !Shots.Of(Shots.Shell).AtPlayers && Shots.Of(Shots.Shell).Sweep == 6f && Shots.Of(Shots.Shell).Burst == 0
                      && Shots.Of(Shots.Slug).AtPlayers && Shots.Of(Shots.Scrap).AtPlayers
                      && Shots.Of(Shots.Slug).Burst == 0.25 && Shots.Of(Shots.Scrap).Look == ShotLook.Shard
                      && Shots.Of(Shots.LongLance).Heavy && !Shots.Of(Shots.Torpedo).Heavy && !Shots.Of(Shots.LongLance).Guided && Shots.Of(Shots.LongLance).Id == "longlance"
                      && Shots.Of(Shots.Seeker).Interceptable && !Shots.Of(Shots.LongLance).Interceptable
                      && Shots.All.Count(x => x.Smoke) == 4
                      && Shots.All.Count(x => x.Tags == Tag.Hulled) == 1 && Shots.Of(Shots.Cruise).Tags == Tag.Hulled,
                      "fifteen kinds of shot, each a row: a shell, a boss's slug and its scrap, a torpedo, a heavy missile, the seeker point defence exists for, the cruise missile anything may shoot down, the round a prism reflects (straight, unguided, sweep 6, at the base's enemies), the Warden's flak, the freighter's spotter, the bastion's bunker buster (stops on the first body, x2 on a boss or structure, 0.25 through a shield), and the dart's pepperbox and rod, the echo's ghost round and the wraith's pellet (kits6d)");
                // ── A BODY IN FLIGHT WITH A HULL OF ITS OWN (Tag.Hulled) ──
                // A missile is point defence's alone: a shell passes through it, a blow skips it, Tab
                // and a wing cannot have it, and one hit deletes it. A row that gives its body a hull
                // (the cruise missile) is a target like any hull instead -- worn down, not deleted --
                // and keeps one rule from a missile: nothing throws it. (30, 10, 19 and 1 are this
                // check's own inputs, not a row's.) Three seeded spots, the shells coming from a seeded
                // side each time, the seeker 400 u off their line so the one that passes through it
                // never reaches the cruise missile.
                {
                    int hPass = 0; string hLast = "";
                    for (int hk = 0; hk < 3; hk++)
                    {
                        var hulledAt = fr.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1500f, 2000f);
                        var hFrom = Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle());          // the side the shells come from
                        var hcm = Combat.Fire(Shots.Cruise, hulledAt, Vector2.Down, 0.001f, 4000f, 1, size: 3f, hull: 30);
                        var hsk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, hulledAt + hFrom.Orthogonal() * 400f, Vector2.Down, 0.001f, 4000f, 1);
                        await Wait(0.1);
                        bool hTagged = TagExt.Is(hcm, Tag.Hulled) && !TagExt.Is(hcm, Tag.Missile) && TagExt.Is(hsk, Tag.Missile) && !TagExt.Is(hsk, Tag.Hulled);
                        bool hFilters = Targeting.PointDefence.Chooses(hcm) && Turret.Rank(hcm) == 0
                                        && Targeting.Attackable.Chooses(hcm) && Targeting.WingPrey.Chooses(hcm) && !Targeting.Throwable.Hits(hcm)
                                        && !Targeting.Attackable.Chooses(hsk) && !Targeting.Throwable.Hits(hsk)
                                        && Combat.Pickable(hcm) && !Combat.Pickable(hsk) && ((IHittable)hcm).Label == "CRUISE MISSILE"
                                        && Combat.Hostiles.Contains(hcm) && Combat.Hostiles.Contains(hsk);
                        // a shell strikes the one and passes through the other (both taken where they
                        // stand after the wait, not where they were fired)
                        Combat.Fire(Shots.Shell, hcm.Position + hFrom * 300f, -hFrom, 650f, 1000f, 10, source: fr);
                        Combat.Fire(Shots.Shell, hsk.Position + hFrom * 300f, -hFrom, 650f, 1000f, 10, source: fr);
                        await Wait(0.8);
                        bool hShelled = hcm.Alive && Math.Abs(hcm.Hull - 20) < 1e-9 && hsk.Alive;
                        int hDown0 = Shot.Intercepted;
                        hcm.TakeDamage(19); bool hStood = hcm.Alive && Shot.Intercepted == hDown0;
                        hcm.TakeDamage(1); bool hFell = !hcm.Alive && Shot.Intercepted == hDown0 + 1 && !Combat.Hostiles.Contains(hcm);
                        hsk.TakeDamage(0.5); bool hSeeker = !hsk.Alive && Shot.Intercepted == hDown0 + 2;
                        if (hTagged && hFilters && hShelled && hStood && hFell && hSeeker) hPass++;
                        else hLast = $"spot {hk + 1}: tags {hTagged}, filters {hFilters}, shelled {hShelled} ({hcm.Hull:0.#} hull left), stood {hStood}, fell {hFell}, seeker {hSeeker}";
                        await Wait(0.8);          // the shell that passed the seeker spent (1000 u at 650 u/s) before the next spot
                    }
                    Check(hPass == 3,
                          $"a cruise missile's body is HULLED, not a missile: point defence first, a blow, a wing and a seeker may have it, a throw may not, Tab picks it by name; a shell takes 10 of its 30 and passes the seeker beside it; 19 more and it stands, 1 more and it falls -- where the seeker falls to its first 0.5 ({hPass} of 3 seeded spots{(hLast.Length > 0 ? "; " + hLast : "")})");
                }
                // AND EVERY EFFECT AND EVERY WARNING IS ONE NODE WITH A ROW. Telegraph was a
                // second node for the same sentence -- a shape, at a place, for a time, with a
                // sound -- with a `bool Line` where this has a shape and an RPC of its own beside
                // the one that already carried effects. Two warning rows, a lane and a zone; how
                // long, how wide and what it sounds like are the MOVE's and come with the raise,
                // because one boss move plays its cue with no warning at all.
                var warnLane = Fx.Of(Fx.WarnLane); var warnZone = Fx.Of(Fx.WarnZone); var aimZone = Fx.Of(Fx.AimZone);
                Check(Fx.All.Length == 19 && Fx.RailEnhanced == 15 && Fx.Tot == 16 && Fx.Venom == 17 && Fx.Chevron == 18 && warnLane.Warn && warnZone.Warn && aimZone.Warn
                      && warnLane.Shape == FxShape.Lane && warnZone.Shape == FxShape.Zone && aimZone.Shape == FxShape.Zone
                      && warnLane.Sound == null && warnZone.Sound == null && aimZone.Sound == null
                      && new[] { Fx.Burst, Fx.Lost, Fx.Rebuilt, Fx.Wave, Fx.Emp, Fx.Reverb, Fx.Rail, Fx.Tot, Fx.Venom }.All(i => !Fx.Of(i).Warn)
                      && Fx.All.Count(x => x.Warn) == 3 && Fx.World == 0 && Fx.Flash == 0.35
                      // ...and the friendly one is the SAME telegraph in another colour: where one
                      // of YOUR shots will land reads nothing like where one of THEIRS will.
                      && aimZone.Tint != warnZone.Tint && warnLane.Tint == warnZone.Tint,
                      $"nineteen rows of Fx.All (the freighter's time on target, kits6b, then the wraith's venom, kits6d, then the chevron, slice 6a; the bastion's gravity well is a zone, Zones.All), sixteen effects and three telegraphs: a red lane and a red zone whose clock and sounds are the raise's, and the same zone in your own colours for where your own shot lands ({Fx.All.Length} rows, {Fx.All.Count(x => x.Warn)} telegraphs)");
                // the sweep the shell and the rock share: a step longer than a hull is how a shot
                // passes through it between frames
                {
                    int seen = 0;
                    bool struck = Shots.Sweep(Vector2.Zero, new Vector2(60, 0), 6f, _ => { seen++; return false; });
                    bool stops = Shots.Sweep(Vector2.Zero, new Vector2(60, 0), 6f, _ => true);
                    int once = 0;
                    Shots.Sweep(Vector2.Zero, new Vector2(600, 0), 0f, _ => { once++; return false; });
                    Check(seen == 10 && !struck && stops && once == 1,
                          $"Shots.Sweep walks a 60 u step in ten 6 u tests, stops at the first touch, and tests only the end point when a row asks for no sweep ({seen}, {once})");
                }

                Check(Fx.All.Length == 18 && Fx.Of(Fx.Wave).Shape == FxShape.Ring
                      && Fx.Of(Fx.Emp).Shape == FxShape.Spokes && Fx.Of(Fx.Reverb).Shape == FxShape.Spokes
                      && Fx.Of(Fx.Rail).Shape == FxShape.Bar && Fx.Of(Fx.Tot).Shape == FxShape.Bar && Fx.Of(Fx.Burst).Shape == FxShape.Burst
                      && Fx.Of(Fx.Rebuilt).Tint != Fx.Of(Fx.Lost).Tint,
                      "the effects, each a row: a burst, a fleet craft lost and rebuilt, a wave, an EMP, a reverb and a railgun's bar -- and beside them the three telegraphs, which were their own node until they became rows too");
                int fxBefore = Nodes<FxNode>().Count();
                Fx.Raise(Fx.Wave, fr.Position + new Vector2(0, -600), 400f);
                await Wait(0.1);
                var raised = Nodes<FxNode>().Where(f => f.Id == Fx.Wave).ToList();
                Check(raised.Count == 1 && Nodes<FxNode>().Count() == fxBefore + 1 && Math.Abs(raised[0].Radius - 400f) < 1e-3,
                      $"Fx.Raise puts one up in the live world, at the reach it was given ({raised.Count} up)");
                await Wait(1.0);
                Check(!Nodes<FxNode>().Any(f => f.Id == Fx.Wave), "and it takes itself away when its life is up");
            }

            // ── BASTION: everything within 1000 u thrown a thousand units clear ──
            await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightBastion);
            var bs = Me; bs.Position = yonder; bs.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
            var near = H.SpawnRaider(yonder + new Vector2(300, 0)); near.Hp = 2000;
            var far = H.SpawnRaider(yonder + new Vector2(1600, 0)); far.Hp = 2000;
            await Wait(0.1);
            float nd0 = near.Position.DistanceTo(yonder), fd0 = far.Position.DistanceTo(yonder);
            bs.UseAbility("shockwave", 0); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            float nd1 = near.Position.DistanceTo(yonder), fd1 = far.Position.DistanceTo(yonder);
            Check(Nodes<FxNode>().Any(f => f.Id == Fx.Wave), "the shockwave puts its ring up where it went off");
            Check(nd1 - nd0 > 950 && nd1 - nd0 < 1050 && Math.Abs(fd1 - fd0) < 60,
                  $"the shockwave throws what is within 1000 u a thousand units clear, and nothing beyond it ({nd1 - nd0:0} u / {fd1 - fd0:0} u)");
            near.TakeDamage(99999); far.TakeDamage(99999); await Wait(0.2);

            // ── SNIPER: a 0.8 s charge on Space, the hull free, then 120 down a 2500 u line ──
            await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
            var sn = Me; var dTgt = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
            // A Weapons point on this hull is 3% of its railgun. The L window printed a single
            // "next +1", because it read the row's Per and not what the purchase actually does
            // (Progression.StatsFor).
            Key(global::Godot.Key.L); await Wait(0.15);
            var spw = Nodes<PilotWindow>().FirstOrDefault();
            var sRow = spw == null ? null : Nodes<Label>(Nodes<HBoxContainer>(spw).First(r => r.Name == "Pilot_damage")).First();
            // A SHARE READS AS A PERCENTAGE: +3% of each weapon the class names, where the window
            // used to advertise a step of +1 the purchase never actually gave.
            Check(sRow != null && !sRow.Text.Contains("Damage per shot") && sRow.Text.Contains("+3% a level")
                  && sRow.Text.Contains("Railgun · Damage") && !sRow.Text.Contains("+0.03"),
                  $"the sniper's Weapons row prints what a point really buys -- 3% of its railgun (it has no gun now), as a percentage rather than three hundredths of a damage ({sRow?.Text.Replace('\n', '|')})");
            Key(global::Godot.Key.L); await Wait(0.1);
            float railAt = Vary(900f, 2200f);                     // anywhere inside its 2500 u reach
            sn.Position = dTgt.Position + new Vector2(0, railAt); sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sn.Rotation = 0f; await Wait(0.3);
            double dmg0 = dTgt.Total;
            var railKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "railgun");
            sn.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; sn.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated; sn.ReloadView = default;
            KeyDown(railKey); await Wait(0.2);
            var wasAt = sn.Position;
            KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W); await Wait(0.5); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
            float charging = sn.Position.DistanceTo(wasAt);
            bool free = sn.Held == 1f && dTgt.Total == dmg0;
            sn.Position = dTgt.Position + new Vector2(0, railAt); sn.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; sn.Rotation = 0f;
            await Wait(0.3);                                      // 1.0 s held: past the 0.8 s charge
            KeyUp(railKey);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 && dTgt.Total == dmg0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(free && charging > 5f,
                  $"the railgun charges with the hull free (no lock: the Anchor is the Sniper's hold): W moves it {charging:0} u while Space is held, and nothing fires until it is let go");
            Check(Math.Abs(dTgt.Total - dmg0 - sn.Stats["rail_damage"]) < 0.01
                  && Math.Abs(new ShipStats(ShipClass.HeavySniper)["rail_damage"] - 120) < 1e-9 && ActiveReload.Reloading(sn.Sl("railgun")),
                  $"let go, its railgun's whole {sn.Stats["rail_damage"]:0.0} lands {railAt:0} u away, on the line, and the chamber reloads ({dTgt.Total - dmg0:0.0})");

            await Lane("LaneAHoldChecks", () => LaneAHoldChecks(sn));
            await Lane("LaneADisabledChecks", () => LaneADisabledChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneAPassivePdChecks", () => LaneAPassivePdChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneAPdRepickChecks", () => LaneAPdRepickChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneAOutDoorChecks", () => LaneAOutDoorChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneADamageDoorChecks", () => LaneADamageDoorChecks(yonder));
            LaneARampChecks();
            await Lane("LaneARampWiringChecks", () => LaneARampWiringChecks(yonder));
            LaneASpeedAddChecks();
            await Lane("LaneAHeavyRowsChecks", () => LaneAHeavyRowsChecks(yonder));
            FollowLeadRetargetChecks();
            await Lane("FollowHeavyRetargetLeadChecks", () => FollowHeavyRetargetLeadChecks(yonder));
            WingsRowsChecks();
            await Lane("WingsPatrolChecks", () => WingsPatrolChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("WingsGunshipChecks", () => WingsGunshipChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneAShotStopsChecks", () => LaneAShotStopsChecks(yonder));
            LaneALinesChecks();
            LaneALinesAtTargetChecks();
            await Lane("LaneAMissileIdsChecks", () => LaneAMissileIdsChecks(yonder));
            LaneAChargeBandChecks();
            LaneAChargeTableHashedChecks();
            FollowFingerprintCollectionChecks();
            LaneAMeleeArcChecks();

            LaneAPrismBandChecks();
            LaneAPrismResolveChecks();

            await Lane("LaneAPrismWalkChecks", () => LaneAPrismWalkChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneAPrismReflectChecks", () => LaneAPrismReflectChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneAPrismRayChecks", () => LaneAPrismRayChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneASentryPreferChecks", () => LaneASentryPreferChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneASentryThrowChecks", () => LaneASentryThrowChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6bSpotterChecks", () => LaneA6bSpotterChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6bTotChecks", () => LaneA6bTotChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6bBubbleCoverChecks", () => LaneA6bBubbleCoverChecks(yonder));

            await Lane("LaneA6bResupplyChecks", () => LaneA6bResupplyChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneARaiderCallChecks", () => LaneARaiderCallChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneADecoyChecks", () => LaneADecoyChecks(yonder));

            await Lane("LaneALatchGateChecks", () => LaneALatchGateChecks(yonder));

            LaneA4TetherChecks(yonder);
            await Lane("LaneA4HelmLiveChecks", () => LaneA4HelmLiveChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA4AnchorWarpChecks", () => LaneA4AnchorWarpChecks());
            await Lane("CameraNanChecks", () => CameraNanChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA4WreckChecks", () => LaneA4WreckChecks());

            // ── BATTLESHIP: the arcs and the broadside (slice 6a) ──
            await Lane("LaneA6aArcChecks", () => LaneA6aArcChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aBroadsideChecks", () => LaneA6aBroadsideChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aBraceChecks", () => LaneA6aBraceChecks(yonder));

            await Lane("LaneA6aCiwsPreyChecks", () => LaneA6aCiwsPreyChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aCarrierRowChecks", () => LaneA6aCarrierRowChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aGunshipChecks", () => LaneA6aGunshipChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aGunshipFireChecks", () => LaneA6aGunshipFireChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aSuperChecks", () => LaneA6aSuperChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aSuperWarpChecks", () => LaneA6aSuperWarpChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aSuperMissileChecks", () => LaneA6aSuperMissileChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aSuperWingsChecks", () => LaneA6aSuperWingsChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aDirectorChecks", () => LaneA6aDirectorChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aLanceChecks", () => LaneA6aLanceChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aLanceHitChecks", () => LaneA6aLanceHitChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aSuppressChecks", () => LaneA6aSuppressChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aSuppressWeaponChecks", () => LaneA6aSuppressWeaponChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aSuppressGunChecks", () => LaneA6aSuppressGunChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aGrapnelPullChecks", () => LaneA6aGrapnelPullChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6aGrapnelTowChecks", () => LaneA6aGrapnelTowChecks(yonder));

            // ── WARRIOR: the blade (slice 6c) ──
            await Lane("LaneA6cBladeChecks", () => LaneA6cBladeChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cLungeChecks", () => LaneA6cLungeChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cWhirlChecks", () => LaneA6cWhirlChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cPrismStanceChecks", () => LaneA6cPrismStanceChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6cReloadJudgeChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6cReloadChecks", () => LaneA6cReloadChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cReloadBarChecks", () => LaneA6cReloadBarChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cAnchorChecks", () => LaneA6cAnchorChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6cZoneChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6cTetherChecks", () => LaneA6cTetherChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cFlaresChecks", () => LaneA6cFlaresChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cFlakChecks", () => LaneA6cFlakChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cHunterPreyChecks", () => LaneA6cHunterPreyChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cTauntChecks", () => LaneA6cTauntChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cTauntLatchChecks", () => LaneA6cTauntLatchChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cTauntEmplacementChecks", () => LaneA6cTauntEmplacementChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6cCurtainChecks", () => LaneA6cCurtainChecks(yonder));
            // ── DART: the pepperbox (slice 6d) ──
            LaneA6dPepperRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dPepperChecks", () => LaneA6dPepperChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dRodRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dRodChecks", () => LaneA6dRodChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6dRodRecoilChecks", () => LaneA6dRodRecoilChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6dPepperGearChecks", () => LaneA6dPepperGearChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dRamjetRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dRamjetChecks", () => LaneA6dRamjetChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6dSlingChecks", () => LaneA6dSlingChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6dSlipChecks", () => LaneA6dSlipChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dRepeaterRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dRepeaterChecks", () => LaneA6dRepeaterChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6dReverbChecks", () => LaneA6dReverbChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dRewindRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dRewindChecks", () => LaneA6dRewindChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dEmpRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dEmpChecks", () => LaneA6dEmpChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dScatterRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dScatterChecks", () => LaneA6dScatterChecks(yonder));
            await Lane("LaneA6dBackstabChecks", () => LaneA6dBackstabChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dVeilRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dVeilChecks", () => LaneA6dVeilChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dVenomRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dVenomChecks", () => LaneA6dVenomChecks(yonder));
            LaneA6dStepRowChecks();
            await Lane("LaneA6dStepChecks", () => LaneA6dStepChecks(yonder));
            await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
            var wr = Me; wr.Position = yonder; wr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
            // A SPEED LIFT LIFTS THE PUSH AS WELL AS THE TOP SPEED (PlayerShip.Steer). The water holds a
            // hull to thrust / drag, so a lift on the cap alone stopped there: 130 against 0.35 is 371
            // u/s. Measured, not read, on the V boost (x1.5 of 190): from rest, the same short spell on
            // the throttle without the boost and with it, and then the whole boost on it.
            {
                var runAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float runHeading = VaryAngle();
                double spell = Vary(0.4f, 0.8f);                       // short of either top speed
                async Task<(double gathered, double top)> Gather(bool boosting)
                {
                    wr.Sl("boost").Left = 0; wr.Sl("boost").Cool = 0; wr.DriveHeld = false;
                    wr.Position = runAt; wr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wr.Rotation = runHeading;
                    if (boosting) { wr.DriveHeld = true; wr.PressDrive(); }
                    for (int i = 0; boosting && i < 30 && wr.Sl("boost").Left <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    wr.Position = runAt; wr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wr.Rotation = runHeading;
                    // TIMED FROM THE FIRST FRAME THE HULL MOVES, not from the key.
                    double boostTop = 0;
                    KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 30 && wr.SpeedAhead <= 0.01f; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    double heldFrom = wr.Clock, v0 = wr.SpeedAhead;
                    while (wr.Clock - heldFrom < spell) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    double gathered = (wr.SpeedAhead - v0) / (wr.Clock - heldFrom);        // u/s gathered a second
                    while (boosting && wr.Sl("boost").Left > 0)
                    { boostTop = Math.Max(boostTop, wr.SpeedAhead); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                    KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W); wr.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; wr.DriveHeld = false;
                    return (gathered, boostTop);
                }
                var plain = await Gather(false);
                var boosted = await Gather(true);
                Check(Math.Abs(wr.Stats["max_speed"] - 190) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(boosted.gathered / plain.gathered - 1.5) < 0.05
                      && boosted.top >= 0.98 * 1.5 * 190,
                      $"a speed lift lifts the push with the top speed: from rest a Warrior gathers way 1.5x as fast on the boost ({plain.gathered:0} -> {boosted.gathered:0} u/s a second), and before it ends it reaches its whole 1.5x of 190 ({boosted.top:0} of 285 u/s)");
                wr.Sl("boost").Cool = 0;
            }

            // ── WARDEN: point defence at 1 DPS a mount (README ruling), and six hunters on six targets ──
            await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
            var wd = Me; wd.Position = yonder; wd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
            Check(wd.PdOnline && Math.Abs(wd.Spec(true).Damage - 0.5) < 1e-9 && wd.Stats["pd_count"] == 1
                  && Math.Abs(wd.Stats["pd_interval"] - 0.5) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(wd.Stats.PdDps - 1) < 1e-9,
                  $"the warden's point defence is on with nothing pressed -- 0.5 a shot every 0.5 s from its one mount, 1 DPS ({wd.Stats.PdDps:0.0} DPS)");
            // and it fires on its own: one light raider inside its 420 u, nothing else firing. The clock
            // starts on the first frame a shot lands; the next ~4.2 s carry eight more 0.5 s cycles.
            {
                var pdMark = H.SpawnRaider(VaryNear(wd.Position, 300f)); pdMark.Hp = 400; pdMark.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);   // inside 420 u, any bearing, held there
                double pdHp0 = pdMark.Hp, pdSpawn = wd.Clock;
                while (pdMark.Hp >= pdHp0 && wd.Clock - pdSpawn < 4) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double pdFirst = wd.Clock, pdAt = pdMark.Hp, pdSpan = Vary(4.1f, 4.4f);
                while (wd.Clock - pdFirst < pdSpan) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double pdTook = pdAt - pdMark.Hp;
                Check(pdAt < pdHp0 && pdTook >= 3.5 - 1e-6 && pdTook <= 4.5 + 1e-6,
                      $"...and it fires on its own, with nothing pressed: {pdTook:0.0} in {pdSpan:0.00} s after its first shot landed (8 or 9 shots of 0.5 = 4.0-4.5, 1 DPS)");
                pdMark.TakeDamage(1e12); await Wait(0.1);
            }
            var marks = new List<Raider>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { var m = H.SpawnRaider(yonder + new Vector2(300 + 60 * i, -200 + 90 * i)); m.Hp = 3000; marks.Add(m); }
            await Wait(0.2);
            int torp0 = InFlight().Count();
            wd.UseAbility("hunters", 0); await Wait(0.2);
            var fired = InFlight().Where(t => !t.HostileFire && t.TargetId != 0).ToList();
            Check(fired.Count >= 6 - torp0 && fired.Select(t => t.TargetId).Distinct().Count() >= 4,
                  $"six hunter-seekers away, each on a target of its own ({fired.Count} out, {fired.Select(t => t.TargetId).Distinct().Count()} targets)");
            foreach (var m in marks) m.TakeDamage(99999);
            await Wait(0.3);

            // ── DART: its pepperbox is proved in LaneA6dPepperChecks (slice 6d; the barrel roll it replaced is gone) ──
            // RATE BUFFS ADD, THEY DO NOT MULTIPLY (the owner's ruling, and the rule a sheet's bonuses
            // already follow): two x2 lifts at once are x3, not x4; x1.25 with x1.6 is x1.85, not
            // x2.0; a cut to x0.85 is x0.85; a row the sheet has not got lifts nothing; and a stack of
            // cuts stops at the sheet's floor of a tenth, never at a standstill. And a lift ADDS TO A
            // PART: a +100% rate part under a x2 lift ticks the tender's 0.1 s lance every third of a
            // tenth of a second, not every quarter. No class carries two lifts of one kind and no check wears a
            // rate part, so the rule is proved here, on literals.
            {
                double Lifted(params double[] mults) => Stat.Scale(PlayerShip.LiftShares(mults));
                var partWorn = new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightTender, new Dictionary<string, double> { ["main_interval"] = 1.0 });   // on the lance's 0.1 s tick
                double partAndLift = partWorn.With("main_interval", PlayerShip.LiftShares(new[] { 2.0 }));
                Check(Math.Abs(Lifted(2.0, 2.0) - 3) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Lifted(1.25, 1.6) - 1.85) < 1e-9
                      && Math.Abs(Lifted(0.85) - 0.85) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Lifted(2.0, 0.0) - 2) < 1e-9
                      && Math.Abs(Lifted(0.3, 0.3) - 0.1) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(Lifted() - 1) < 1e-9
                      && Math.Abs(new ShipStats(ShipClass.FreightTender)["main_interval"] - 0.1) < 1e-9
                      && Math.Abs(partWorn["main_interval"] - 0.05) < 1e-9 && Math.Abs(partAndLift - 0.1 / 3) < 1e-9,
                      $"rate buffs add: x2 with x2 is x{Lifted(2.0, 2.0):0.00} (not x4), x1.25 with x1.6 is x{Lifted(1.25, 1.6):0.00}, two cuts to x0.3 stop at x{Lifted(0.3, 0.3):0.00}, nothing running is x{Lifted():0.00} "
                      + $"-- and a +100% part under a x2 lift ticks the tender's 0.1 s lance every {partAndLift:0.0000} s (x3), not every 0.0250 s");
            }

            // ── ECHO: what it deals for five seconds, all at once at the end ──
            await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
            var ec = Me; ec.Position = yonder; ec.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
            var mark = H.SpawnRaider(yonder + new Vector2(150, 0)); mark.Hp = 4000;
            var near2 = H.SpawnRaider(yonder + new Vector2(260, 0)); near2.Hp = 4000;
            await Wait(0.1);
            ec.UseAbility("reverb", 0); await Wait(0.1);
            ec.NoteDealt(90, mark, "shell");                       // as a shell of its own would
            Check(Math.Abs(ec.Sl("reverb").Own - 90) < 1e-6, $"the echo remembers what it deals ({ec.Sl("reverb").Own:0})");
            double m0 = mark.Hp, n0 = near2.Hp;
            var markHome = mark.Position; var nearHome = near2.Position;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && ec.Sl("reverb").Left > 0; i++)
            { mark.Position = markHome; near2.Position = nearHome; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            await Wait(0.1);
            Check(Math.Abs(m0 - mark.Hp - 31.5) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(n0 - near2.Hp - 31.5) < 0.01,
                  $"and puts 35% of it (31.5 of 90) down where the last of it landed, on everything within 220 u ({m0 - mark.Hp:0.0} / {n0 - near2.Hp:0.0})");
            mark.TakeDamage(99999); near2.TakeDamage(99999); await Wait(0.2);

            // ── WRAITH: five seconds nothing hostile can pick it ──
            await SetClass(ShipClass.LightWraith);
            var wt = Me; wt.Position = yonder; wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.2);
            var hunter = H.SpawnRaider(VaryNear(yonder, 500f)); hunter.Hp = 4000;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && hunter.Target != wt; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(hunter.Target == wt, "a raider comes for the wraith");
            wt.UseAbility("veil", 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && hunter.Target == wt; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(wt.Statuses.Has(Status.Untargetable) && hunter.Target != wt && Targeting.Hidden(wt),
                  "and the moment it goes dark the raider lets go of it");
            // ...AND WHAT A RAID THROWS STILL LANDS. Stealth stops a raider CHOOSING the ship; it
            // never stopped a burst falling where the ship is. The raid's blast was resolved over
            // Hub.RaiderTargets, which left every hidden ship out, so a dark ship sat in a burst
            // untouched. One thrown by hand, as a raid's own row, onto a spot inside its 90 u.
            {
                string burstKey = $"heavy:{hunter.NetId}:missile";
                double burst0 = wt.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault(burstKey);
                var burstAt = VaryNear(wt.Position, 40f);
                H.ThrowMissile(new MissileSpec { Side = Missiles.Raid, Damage = 42, Blast = 90f, Flight = 0.5 },
                               hunter.Position, burstAt, hunter.NetId);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && wt.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault(burstKey) == burst0; i++)
                { wt.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                double burstTook = wt.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault(burstKey) - burst0;
                Check(Targeting.Hidden(wt) && hunter.Target != wt && Math.Abs(burstTook - 42) < 1e-6,
                      $"...and a raid's 42-damage burst {burstAt.DistanceTo(wt.Position):0} u from the dark wraith lands on it in full, while the raider still has not picked it ({burstTook:0} taken)");
            }
            await Wait(5.2);
            Check(!wt.Statuses.Has(Status.Untargetable), "five seconds later it is visible again");
            // AND THE HUNT COMES BACK. A raider re-decides only when its target stops being valid,
            // so the miner it took while the wraith was dark stayed valid for ever: one press of
            // stealth used to hand the whole wave to the base's fleet permanently.
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && hunter.Target != wt; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(hunter.Target == wt,
                  $"...and the raider takes the wraith back the moment it can see it again (now after {(hunter.Target == wt ? "it" : Raider.Up(hunter.Target) ? "something else" : "nothing")})");
            hunter.TakeDamage(99999); await Wait(0.2);

            // ── EVERY WEAPON A PILOT CARRIES, AGAINST THE CRUISE MISSILE ─────────────
            // The filters say a rail, an EMP, an echo, a seeker, a wing, a dropped turret and point
            // defence may each have a body with a hull of its own (Tag.Hulled); these fire the real
            // thing at one. Each at a seeded spot out here, at a cruise missile of 30 hull standing
            // still (0.001 u/s, homing on nothing), and each reads the first blow the frame it lands:
            // the hull comes off by THAT weapon's own damage, off the ship's live sheet (the class
            // checks above pin each sheet to its literal).
            {
                Shot XCruise(Vector2 at) => Combat.Fire(Shots.Cruise, at, Vector2.Down, 0.001f, 4000f, 1, size: 3f, hull: 30);
                async Task<double> XFirstBlow(Shot cm, double seconds, System.Action hold)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(60 * seconds) && cm.Alive && cm.Hull >= 30; i++)
                    { hold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                    return 30 - cm.Hull;
                }

                // THE RAILGUN: on its line, anywhere inside its 2500 u
                await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavySniper);
                {
                    var xrShip = Me; var xrAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float xrHead = VaryAngle();
                    void XrHold() { xrShip.Position = xrAt; xrShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; xrShip.Rotation = xrHead; }
                    XrHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); XrHold();
                    var xrCm = XCruise(xrAt + Vector2.Up.Rotated(xrHead) * Vary(600f, 2200f));
                    xrShip.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; xrShip.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated;
                    var xrKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavySniper, "railgun");
                    KeyDown(xrKey);
                    double xrHeld = await XFirstBlow(xrCm, xrShip.Cadence("rail_charge") + 0.1, XrHold);   // nothing lands while it charges
                    KeyUp(xrKey);
                    double xrDrop = await XFirstBlow(xrCm, 2, XrHold);
                    Check(xrHeld == 0 && Math.Abs(xrDrop - xrShip.Stats["rail_damage"]) < 1e-6 && !xrCm.Alive,
                          $"the railgun brings a cruise missile down: {xrDrop:0.0} off its 30 hull, the rail's own {xrShip.Stats["rail_damage"]:0}, {xrCm.Position.DistanceTo(xrAt):0} u down its line");
                    xrCm.Intercept();
                }
                // THE BLADE: a cruise missile in its arc, 70-140 u off the nose's line, takes the blade's own
                // 26 as its first blow (4 of its 30 hull left), and the next swing brings it down
                await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior);
                {
                    var xeShip = Me; var xeAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float xeHead = VaryAngle();
                    void XeHold() { xeShip.Position = xeAt; xeShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; xeShip.Rotation = xeHead; }
                    XeHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); XeHold();
                    var xeCm = XCruise(xeAt + Vector2.Up.Rotated(xeHead + Mathf.DegToRad(Vary(-40f, 40f))) * Vary(70f, 140f));
                    var xeKey = Abilities.KeyFor(ShipClass.HeavyWarrior, "blade");
                    KeyDown(xeKey);
                    double xeDrop = await XFirstBlow(xeCm, 3, XeHold);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 && xeCm.Alive; i++) { XeHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                    KeyUp(xeKey);
                    Check(Math.Abs(xeDrop - xeShip.Stats["blade_damage"]) < 1e-6 && !xeCm.Alive,
                          $"the warrior's blade cuts a cruise missile {xeCm.Position.DistanceTo(xeAt):0} u off for its own {xeShip.Stats["blade_damage"]:0}: {xeDrop:0.0} off its 30 hull, then down on the next swing");
                    xeCm.Intercept();
                }
                // THE ECHO: what it remembers, put down where the last of it landed -- on the missile
                await SetClass(ShipClass.LightEcho);
                {
                    var xcShip = Me; var xcAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                    void XcHold() { xcShip.Position = xcAt; xcShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
                    XcHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); XcHold();
                    var xcCm = XCruise(xcAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(150f, 400f));
                    xcShip.UseAbility("reverb", 0); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    xcShip.NoteDealt(24, xcCm, "shell");                 // a hit of its own landing there, as a shell's would
                    double xcDrop = await XFirstBlow(xcCm, 7, XcHold);
                    Check(Math.Abs(xcDrop - 24 * xcShip.Stats["reverb_share"]) < 1e-6,
                          $"the echo puts down what it remembered on a cruise missile: 24 dealt where it stands, {xcDrop:0.0} off its 30 hull at the echo's x{xcShip.Stats["reverb_share"]:0.00}");
                    xcCm.Intercept();
                }
                // A SEEKER HOMING ON IT: the warden's cell, past its own point defence's 420 u
                await SetClass(ShipClass.HeavyWarden);
                {
                    var xhShip = Me; var xhAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                    void XhHold() { xhShip.Position = xhAt; xhShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
                    XhHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); XhHold();
                    var xhCm = XCruise(xhAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(600f, 1000f));
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    xhShip.UseAbility("hunters", 0); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    var xhAway = InFlight().Where(t => !t.HostileFire && t.Source == xhShip).ToList();
                    double xhDrop = await XFirstBlow(xhCm, 8, XhHold);
                    Check(xhAway.Count == (int)xhShip.Stats["hunter_count"] && xhAway.All(t => t.TargetId == xhCm.NetId)
                          && Math.Abs(xhDrop - xhShip.Stats["hunter_damage"]) < 1e-6 && !xhCm.Alive,
                          $"the warden's seekers home on a cruise missile {xhCm.Position.DistanceTo(xhAt):0} u off: {xhAway.Count(t => t.TargetId == xhCm.NetId)} of {xhAway.Count} on it, and the first to arrive takes {xhDrop:0.0} off its 30 hull, one seeker's {xhShip.Stats["hunter_damage"]:0}, and brings it down");
                    xhCm.Intercept();
                }
                // A CARRIER WING RETARGETING TO IT: sent at a light raider that then dies, the wing
                // takes the nearest other hostile for itself -- the missile
                await SetClass(ShipClass.Carrier);
                {
                    var xwShip = Me; var xwAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float xwWay = VaryAngle();
                    void XwHold() { xwShip.Position = xwAt; xwShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
                    XwHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); XwHold();
                    double xwReach = PdReachOff(xwShip);    // the WING on trial: the carrier's passive point defence out of reach (test only)
                    var xwFirst = H.SpawnRaider(xwAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(xwWay) * Vary(350f, 500f));
                    xwFirst.Hp = 9000; xwFirst.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
                    var xwCm = XCruise(xwAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(xwWay + Vary(-0.8f, 0.8f)) * Vary(550f, 800f));
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    xwShip.UseAbility("attack", xwFirst.NetId);
                    bool xwSent = ReferenceEquals(xwShip.WingTarget, xwFirst);
                    xwFirst.TakeDamage(1e9);
                    double xwDrop = await XFirstBlow(xwCm, 15, XwHold);
                    Check(xwSent && ReferenceEquals(xwShip.WingTarget, xwCm) && Math.Abs(xwDrop - xwShip.Stats["fighter_damage"]) < 1e-6,
                          $"a carrier's wing sent at a raider that dies takes the cruise missile {xwCm.Position.DistanceTo(xwAt):0} u off for itself (sent {xwSent}; now on {(ReferenceEquals(xwShip.WingTarget, xwCm) ? "the missile" : xwShip.WingTarget?.Label ?? "nothing")}), and its first pass takes {xwDrop:0.0} off the 30 hull, one fighter's shot of {xwShip.Stats["fighter_damage"]:0.0}");
                    xwShip.RecallWing(); xwCm.Intercept(); xwShip.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", xwReach);
                }
                // A DROPPED TURRET PICKS IT BEFORE A LIGHT RAIDER: the light nearer, the missile further
                // round, both in its reach, and nothing else here
                await SetClass(ShipClass.FreightHauler);
                {
                    var xsShip = Me; var xsAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f);
                    xsShip.Position = xsAt; xsShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    xsShip.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0; SentryAt(xsShip, xsAt); await Wait(0.9);
                    var xsGun = H.Deployed.FirstOrDefault(t => t.OwnerId == xsShip.OwnerId);
                    var xsOff = xsAt + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * 1500f;   // the freighter well clear of it
                    void XsHold() { xsShip.Position = xsOff; xsShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }
                    XsHold();
                    float xsReach = xsGun?.Spec(true).Range ?? 500f, xsWay = VaryAngle();
                    var xsCentre = xsGun?.Position ?? xsAt;
                    var xsLight = H.SpawnRaider(xsCentre + Vector2.Right.Rotated(xsWay) * xsReach * Vary(0.3f, 0.45f));
                    xsLight.Hp = 9000; xsLight.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
                    var xsCm = XCruise(xsCentre + Vector2.Right.Rotated(xsWay + Vary(1.6f, 2.4f)) * xsReach * Vary(0.7f, 0.85f));
                    for (int i = 0; i < 30 && xsGun != null && xsGun.Aimed == null; i++) { XsHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                    bool xsTook = xsGun != null && ReferenceEquals(xsGun.Aimed, xsCm);
                    double xsDrop = await XFirstBlow(xsCm, 4, XsHold);
                    Check(xsTook && Math.Abs(xsDrop - xsShip.Stats["deploy_damage"]) < 1e-6 && xsLight.Hp == 9000,
                          $"a dropped turret picks a cruise missile {xsCentre.DistanceTo(xsCm.Position):0} u off before a light raider {xsCentre.DistanceTo(xsLight.Position):0} u off (aiming at {xsGun?.Aimed?.Label ?? "nothing"} first), and its first shot takes {xsDrop:0.0} off the 30 hull -- the turret's own {xsShip.Stats["deploy_damage"]:0.0} -- with the raider untouched ({xsLight.Hp:0})");
                    xsLight.TakeDamage(1e9); xsCm.Intercept();
                    foreach (var dpl in H.Deployed.ToList()) H.DeployedTaken(dpl);
                }
                // A WARSHIP'S POINT DEFENCE PICKS IT BEFORE A LIGHT RAIDER: off its first mount, both
                // astern of it (so the missile stands clear of the hull it would otherwise strike), the
                // light nearer and the missile further, both in reach of either mount. The mount that
                // chooses first takes the missile; the other, finding it held, takes the light. Point
                // defence is passive, so its reach is 0 (test only) until both are in the world: the
                // first choice is made with both there to choose from.
                await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);
                {
                    var xpShip = Me; var xpAt = VaryNear(yonder, 300f); float xpHead = VaryAngle();
                    void XpHold() { xpShip.Position = xpAt; xpShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; xpShip.Rotation = xpHead; }
                    XpHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); XpHold();
                    double xpReach = PdReachOff(xpShip);
                    var xpFirst = xpShip.PdTurrets[0]; var xpFrom = xpFirst.GlobalPosition; var xpAft = Vector2.Down.Rotated(xpHead);
                    var xpLight = H.SpawnRaider(xpFrom + xpAft.Rotated(Vary(-1.0f, -0.3f)) * Vary(140f, 200f));
                    xpLight.Hp = 9000; xpLight.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 30);
                    var xpCm = XCruise(xpFrom + xpAft.Rotated(Vary(0.3f, 1.0f)) * Vary(300f, 380f));
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    xpShip.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", xpReach);
                    for (int i = 0; i < 30 && xpShip.PdTurrets.All(t => t.Target == null); i++) { XpHold(); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                    bool xpTook = ReferenceEquals(xpFirst.Target, xpCm);
                    double xpDrop = await XFirstBlow(xpCm, 5, XpHold);
                    Check(xpTook && Math.Abs(xpDrop - xpShip.Spec(true).Damage) < 1e-6,
                          $"a battleship's point defence picks a cruise missile {xpFrom.DistanceTo(xpCm.Position):0} u off before a light raider {xpFrom.DistanceTo(xpLight.Position):0} u off: the first mount to choose takes the missile (on {xpFirst.Target?.Label ?? "nothing"}; the other on {xpShip.PdTurrets[^1].Target?.Label ?? "nothing"}), and its first shot takes {xpDrop:0.00} off the 30 hull, one point-defence shot of {xpShip.Spec(true).Damage:0.00}");
                    xpLight.TakeDamage(1e9); xpCm.Intercept();
                    await Wait(0.2);
                }
            }

            // ── EVERY TIMED ROW TICKS, WHATEVER CLASS CARRIES IT ────────────────────
            // A timed ability was a row everywhere except the tick: PlayerShip kept a string[]
            // of the nine ids that had timers, so a tenth added as a row compiled, bound, drew
            // on the bar and its Left never moved, with nothing to say so. Put 5 s of Left and
            // 5 s of Cool on EVERY slot of every flyable class and watch all of them fall. This
            // FAILS the moment one row is dropped from the tick again.
            {
                var stuck = new List<string>();
                int rows = 0;
                foreach (var cd in Classes.All.Where(x => x.Ready).ToList())
                {
                    await SetClass(cd.Id);
                    var tk = Me; tk.Position = yonder; tk.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    foreach (var ab in Abilities.For(cd.Id)) { tk.Sl(ab.Id).Left = 5.0; tk.Sl(ab.Id).Cool = 5.0; rows++; }
                    await Wait(0.5);
                    foreach (var ab in Abilities.For(cd.Id))
                        if (tk.Sl(ab.Id).Left > 4.7 || tk.Sl(ab.Id).Cool > 4.7) stuck.Add($"{cd.Name}.{ab.Id}");
                    foreach (var ab in Abilities.For(cd.Id)) { tk.Sl(ab.Id).Left = 0; tk.Sl(ab.Id).Cool = 0; }
                }
                Check(stuck.Count == 0 && rows >= 12 * 6,
                      $"every ability row of every class runs its own timers down: 5 s put on all {rows} of them, none above 4.7 s half a second later ({(stuck.Count == 0 ? "none stuck" : string.Join(", ", stuck))})");
            }

            // ── EVERY ABILITY ON EVERY BAR, AND HOW FAR EVERY CLASS REACHES ──────────
            // The blocks above take ONE class at a time and prove the one thing it is for. These
            // two take all twelve and sweep them: every ability each of them carries, pressed --
            // and every reach each of them declares, measured from just inside it and from just
            // outside it. Both are driven from the TABLES (Classes.All, ClassDef.Abilities,
            // ClassDef.Reach), so a thirteenth class, a new ability or a new reach id is swept
            // the moment it is a row -- and one with nothing here to witness it FAILS rather
            // than passing silently, which is the whole point of a sweep.
            {
                // Somewhere with nothing in it: past the outposts (3000 u) and past the edge a
                // raid comes in from (4200 u), so nothing can wander into a measurement. Every
                // placement below is drawn from the run's own SEED around this one spot.
                var afield = Hub.BasePos + new Vector2(4200, 3900);
                // A HOSTILE HELD EXACTLY WHERE IT IS PUT. Disabled is the shockwave's own hold on
                // a boss, and a raider under it sits still -- so no marker can fly off on an
                // errand mid-measurement and no check below is a check on the clock.
                async Task<Raider> Marker(Vector2 at)
                {
                    var born = H.SpawnRaider(at);
                    born.Hp = 9000; born.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 20);
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    return born;
                }
                void Sink(Raider mk1) { if (mk1 != null && mk1.Alive) mk1.TakeDamage(99999); }

                // ── A. EVERY ABILITY, PRESSED -- AND THE SECOND PRESS REFUSED ─────────────
                // WHAT COUNTS AS DONE, one row per ability id: a slot lit, a cooldown set, a
                // status applied, bodies launched, a turret dropped. Reached BY ID, never by
                // class, so two classes carrying the same ability share the one witness -- and an
                // ability added to the catalogue with nothing here to see it fails the coverage
                // check below. (The trigger's own path from key to shell is proved by the
                // battleship and destroyer DPS checks earlier in this run; what is asked of a
                // HOLD row here is that its own key reaches the ship at all.)
                int sweepShots = 0, sweepTurrets = 0;
                string sweepCut = null;          // a row a press that Cuts is given cooling (kits6b-J8: what resupply needs)
                bool sweepMode = false;
                Raider sweepMark = null;
                var witness = new Dictionary<string, Func<PlayerShip, bool>>
                {
                    ["guns"]      = sp => sp.Trigger && Abilities.Find(sp.Class, "guns").State(sp, null).Lit,
                    // the Tender's lance: held, its first tick lands at once and the slot is up (kits6b-J7)
                    ["lance"]     = sp => sp.Trigger && sp.Sl("lance").Left > 0 && Abilities.Find(sp.Class, "lance").State(sp, null).Lit,
                    // LOCAL: the owner's own intent, which never leaves this machine. It flips,
                    // and it engages no slot at all.
                    ["firemode"]  = sp => sp.Staggered != sweepMode && sp.Sl("firemode").Left == 0 && sp.Sl("firemode").Cool == 0,
                    ["broadside"] = sp => sp.BroadsideTracking && sp.Sl("broadside").Left > sp.Stats["broadside_windup"] - 0.1,
                    ["longlance"]     = sp => sp.Sl("longlance").Cool > sp.Stats["lance_cooldown"] - 0.1 && InFlight().Any(x => x.Kind == Shots.LongLance && x.Source == sp),
                    ["suppress"]  = sp => sp.Sl("suppress").Left > sp.Stats["suppress_window"] - 0.1 && sp.Sl("suppress").Cool > sp.Stats["suppress_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    // the sweep's mark is a raider: the grapnel TOWS it (the swing round an anchor is LaneA6aGrapnelPullChecks')
                    ["grapnel"]   = sp => sp.Sl("grapnel").Left > Towing.Of(Towing.Grapnel).Haul - 0.1 && sp.Sl("grapnel").N == sweepMark.NetId && sweepMark.Towed != null,
                    ["attack"]    = sp => ReferenceEquals(sp.WingTarget, sweepMark),
                    ["recall"]    = sp => sp.WingTarget == null,
                    ["bombers"]   = sp => ReferenceEquals(sp.StrikeTarget, sweepMark),
                    ["deploy"]    = sp => sp.TurretsOut == sweepTurrets + 1 && sp.Sl("deploy").Cool > 0,
                    ["bubble"]    = sp => sp.BubbleUp && Math.Abs(sp.BubbleLeft - sp.Stats["bubble_pool"]) < 0.5,
                    // time on target: the mark painted before the press (below), a line landed on it and the clock set
                    ["redeploy"]  = sp => sp.Sl("redeploy").Cool > 0 && sp.OwnLanded().Count == 0 && sp.TurretsOut >= 1,
                    ["tot"]       = sp => sp.Sl("tot").Cool > 0 && sp.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault(Dealt.Tot) > 0 && Nodes<FxNode>().Any(fx3 => fx3.Id == Fx.Tot),
                    ["overdrive"] = sp => Math.Abs(sp.FireRate - (float)sp.Stats["overdrive_mult"]) < 1e-3f && Math.Abs(sp.Stats["overdrive_mult"] - 1.5) < 1e-9,
                    // the Tender's repair field (kits6b-J8): up for its time, its cooldown set, and its ring up (Fields)
                    ["repair"]    = sp => sp.Sl("repair").Left > sp.Stats["repair_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Sl("repair").Cool > 0 && Fields.Up(sp).Any(f => f.Row.Id == "repair"),
                    // resupply (D45): the other ability the sweep set cooling (sweepCut) is 8 s lower, and its own cooldown set
                    ["resupply"]  = sp => sp.Sl("resupply").Cool > 0 && sweepCut != null && Math.Abs(sp.Sl(sweepCut).Cool - 12) < 0.1,
                    ["shockwave"] = sp => sp.Sl("shockwave").Cool > 0 && Nodes<FxNode>().Any(fx3 => fx3.Id == Fx.Wave),
                    ["buster"]    = sp => sp.Sl("buster").Cool > 0 && Nodes<Shot>().Any(x => x.Kind == Shots.Buster && ReferenceEquals(x.Source, sp)),
                    ["well"]      = sp => sp.Sl("well").Cool > sp.Stats["well_cooldown"] - 0.1 && H.Laid.Any(z => z.OwnerId == sp.OwnerId && z.Row == Zones.Well),
                    ["railgun"]   = sp => sp.Trigger && ActiveReload.Seated(sp.Sl("railgun")) && sp.ReloadView.Charge > 0
                                          && Abilities.Find(sp.Class, "railgun").State(sp, null).Line.StartsWith("CHARGE"),
                    ["blade"]     = sp => sp.Trigger && Abilities.Find(sp.Class, "blade").State(sp, null).Lit,
                    ["lunge"]     = sp => sp.Sl("lunge").Left > sp.Stats["lunge_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened)
                                          && sp.Sl("lunge").Cool > sp.Stats["lunge_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["whirlwind"] = sp => sp.Sl("whirlwind").Left > sp.Stats["whirl_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Stilled && sp.Statuses.Has(Status.Unwebbed),
                    ["prism"]     = sp => sp.Sl("prism").Left > sp.Stats["prism_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Prismatic && sp.Stilled && Math.Abs(sp.Held - 0.5f) < 1e-3f,
                    ["hunters"]   = sp => sp.Sl("hunters").Cool > 0 && InFlight().Count() >= sweepShots + (int)sp.Stats["hunter_count"],
                    ["pepperbox"] = sp => sp.Trigger && Abilities.Find(sp.Class, "pepperbox").State(sp, null).Lit,
                    ["rod"]       = sp => sp.Sl("rod").Left > sp.Stats["sprint_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Forced && sp.Sl("rod").Cool > sp.Stats["rod_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["ramjet"]    = sp => sp.Sl("ramjet").Left > sp.Stats["ramjet_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Sl("ramjet").Cool > sp.Stats["ramjet_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["slingshot"] = sp => sp.Sl("slingshot").Cool > sp.Stats["sling_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["reverb"]    = sp => sp.Sl("reverb").Left > sp.Stats["reverb_time"] - 0.1,
                    ["rewind"]    = sp => sp.Sl("rewind").Cool > sp.Stats["rewind_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["emp"]       = sp => sp.Sl("emp").Cool > sp.Stats["emp_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["veil"]      = sp => sp.Statuses.Has(Status.Untargetable) && sp.Sl("veil").Left > sp.Stats["veil_time"] - 0.1,
                    ["venom"]     = sp => sp.Sl("venom").Left > sp.Stats["venom_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Sl("venom").Cool > sp.Stats["venom_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["step"]      = sp => sp.Sl("step").Cool > sp.Stats["step_cooldown"] - 0.1,
                    ["anchor"]    = sp => sp.Sl("anchor").Left > sp.Stats["anchor_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Held == 0f,
                    ["tether"]    = sp => sp.Sl("tether").N == 1 && sp.Sl("tether").Cool > sp.Stats["tether_recharge"] - 0.1 && H.Laid.Any(z => z.OwnerId == sp.OwnerId),
                    ["flares"]    = sp => sp.Sl("flares").Cool > sp.Stats["flare_cooldown"] - 0.1 && H.Salvos.Any(sv2 => sv2.At.DistanceTo(sp.Position) < 5f),
                    ["taunt"]     = sp => sp.Sl("taunt").Left > sp.Stats["taunt_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened),
                    ["brace"]     = sp => sp.Sl("brace").Left > sp.Stats["brace_time"] - 0.1 && sp.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened) && Math.Abs(sp.Held - 0.5f) < 1e-3f,
                    ["ciws"]      = sp => sp.Sl("ciws").Left > sp.Stats["ciws_time"] - 0.1 && Math.Abs(sp.Spec(true).Damage - sp.Stats["pd_damage"] * 3) < 1e-9,
                    ["gunships"]  = sp => sp.Sl("gunships").Left > sp.Stats["gunship_time"] - 0.1 && sp.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) == (int)sp.Stats["gunship_count"],
                    ["super"]     = sp => sp.Sl("super").Left > sp.Stats["patrol_time"] - 0.1 && sp.WingCount(WingKind.Patrol) == (int)sp.Stats["fighter_count"],
                    ["curtain"]   = sp => sp.Sl("curtain").Cool > sp.Stats["curtain_cooldown"] - 0.1 && H.Laid.Any(z => z.OwnerId == sp.OwnerId && z.Row == Zones.Curtain),
                };
                var onBars = Classes.All.Where(cd2 => cd2.Ready).SelectMany(cd2 => cd2.Abilities)
                                        .Where(ab3 => !ab3.Open).Select(ab3 => ab3.Id).Distinct().ToList();
                var unwitnessed = onBars.Where(id2 => !witness.ContainsKey(id2)).ToList();
                Check(unwitnessed.Count == 0 && witness.Count == onBars.Count,
                      $"every ability on every bar has a witness in this sweep: {onBars.Count} ids across the twelve flyable classes against {witness.Count} rows "
                      + $"({(unwitnessed.Count == 0 ? "none missing" : "MISSING " + string.Join(", ", unwitnessed))})");

                // WHAT A FITTING BRINGS. A class carries an ability because of a fitting; where it
                // has NOT got the fitting, that ability must not be on its bar at all. One row per
                // fitting, so a new ability of an existing kind is covered by adding its id here.
                var fitRows = new (Fit fit, string[] ids)[] {
                    (Fit.Guns,      new[] { "guns|lance" }),               // a gun hull's trigger: its guns, or the Tender's lance
                    (Fit.Broadside, new[] { "broadside" }),
                    (Fit.Wing,      new[] { "attack", "recall", "bombers" }),
                    (Fit.Deploy,    new[] { "deploy" }),
                };

                foreach (var cls in Classes.All.Where(cd2 => cd2.Ready).ToList())
                {
                    await SetClass(cls.Id);
                    var sweepShip = Me;
                    sweepShip.Position = VaryNear(afield, 700f); sweepShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    sweepShip.Rotation = VaryAngle();
                    await Wait(0.15);

                    // ...and the ABSENCE where that is the fact. Point defence is the one fitting
                    // with no ability at all: it is passive, so a hull that HAS the fitting mounts
                    // its turrets, carries no key for it and is online with nothing pressed; a hull
                    // without it (a light) mounts none.
                    var wrongFit = fitRows.Where(fr2 => fr2.ids.Any(id3 => id3.Split('|').Any(alt => Abilities.Find(cls.Id, alt) != null) != cls.Has(fr2.fit)))
                                          .Select(fr2 => fr2.fit.ToString()).ToList();
                    // the fire mode is a gun hull's choice (the destroyer's director has none), never carried without main
                    // guns; the freighters left it (kits 6b)
                    if (Abilities.Find(cls.Id, "firemode") != null && !cls.Has(Fit.Guns)) wrongFit.Add("firemode");
                    if (cls.Id is ShipClass.FreightHauler && Abilities.Find(cls.Id, "firemode") != null) wrongFit.Add("firemode on the freighter");
                    bool pdRight = Abilities.Find(cls.Id, "pd") == null && sweepShip.PdOnline
                                   && (sweepShip.PdTurrets.Count > 0) == cls.Has(Fit.Pd);
                    Check(wrongFit.Count == 0 && pdRight,
                          $"{cls.Name}: every ability on its bar is one of its fittings, and every fitting it has NOT got takes its abilities with it -- "
                          + $"point defence {(cls.Has(Fit.Pd) ? $"always on, no key, {sweepShip.PdTurrets.Count} mounts" : "not carried at all")}"
                          + $"{(wrongFit.Count == 0 ? "" : ", WRONG: " + string.Join(", ", wrongFit))}");

                    // THE SIX OPEN HOTKEYS after its own abilities: bound, shown, and they do
                    // nothing. Pressing every one of them must engage no slot -- they are where
                    // the next ability goes, and until then a press is a press on nothing.
                    var opens = Abilities.For(cls.Id).Where(ab4 => ab4.Open).ToList();
                    foreach (var openAb in opens) doAbility.Invoke(sweepShip, new object[] { openAb.Id, 0, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    Check(opens.Count == 6 && opens.All(openAb => openAb.Press == null
                                                        && sweepShip.Sl(openAb.Id).Left == 0 && sweepShip.Sl(openAb.Id).Cool == 0),
                          $"{cls.Name}: {opens.Count} open hotkeys after its {cls.Abilities.Length} own, and pressing every one of them engages no slot");

                    // the one target every press that wants one is given, put back before each
                    sweepMark = await Marker(VaryNear(sweepShip.Position, 320f));
                    var markAt = sweepMark.Position;

                    foreach (var abil in cls.Abilities)
                    {
                        sweepMark.Position = markAt;                  // back where it was, whatever moved it
                        sweepShots = InFlight().Count();
                        sweepTurrets = sweepShip.TurretsOut;
                        sweepMode = sweepShip.Staggered;
                        var abKey = Abilities.KeyFor(cls.Id, abil.Id);
                        bool isHold = abil.Kind == AbilityKind.Hold;
                        sweepShip.PaintOn(sweepMark, 5);             // every press is given the mark painted (what time on target needs)
                        // ...and a hull that throws sentries one standing (what redeploy needs), 200-300 u off its cursor (never recalled by R)
                        if (cls.Has(Fit.Deploy) && sweepShip.OwnLanded().Count == 0)
                            H.Drop(sweepShip, sweepShip.AimPoint + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 300f), sweepShip.Stats["deploy_hull"]);
                        // ...and a row that Cuts cooling another of its class's rows cooling 20 s (what resupply needs)
                        sweepCut = abil.Cuts != null ? cls.Abilities.Where(o => o != abil && !o.Weapon).Select(o => o.Id).FirstOrDefault() : null;
                        if (sweepCut != null) sweepShip.Sl(sweepCut).Cool = 20;
                        if (isHold)
                        {   // a HOLD row has no Press at all: its own key goes down and stays down
                            KeyDown(abKey);
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                        }
                        else if (abil.Local) sweepShip.UseAbility(abil.Id, 0);
                        else doAbility.Invoke(sweepShip, new object[] { abil.Id, sweepMark.NetId, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                        bool didIt = witness.TryGetValue(abil.Id, out var sawIt) && sawIt(sweepShip);
                        if (isHold) { KeyUp(abKey); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }

                        // THE SECOND PRESS. A row that engaged its slot must refuse it: neither
                        // the time it has left nor its cooldown may go UP -- except a STANCE, whose
                        // second press drops it: nothing left, and its cooldown from then. (A row that engages no
                        // slot -- the carrier's attack and recall -- has
                        // nothing to refuse, and its witness is the whole of it; the bombers'
                        // refusal of a second strike is measured with strike_range below.)
                        var slotWas = sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id);
                        bool engaged = slotWas.Left > 0 || slotWas.Cool > 0;
                        bool refusedAgain = true;
                        if (engaged)
                        {
                            doAbility.Invoke(sweepShip, new object[] { abil.Id, sweepMark.NetId, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            var slotNow = sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id);
                            // (a stance with a Release -- the anchor -- is let go over it: its time cut to the release, not to 0)
                            // (a HOOK's second press casts off: the line gone, and its cooldown from then)
                            refusedAgain = abil.Hook != null
                                ? slotNow.Left == 0 && Math.Abs(slotNow.Cool - sweepShip.Cooling(sweepShip.Stats[abil.Hook.Cooldown])) < 0.1
                                : abil.Stance is { Release: { } rel }
                                ? slotNow.Left > 0 && slotNow.Left <= sweepShip.Stats[rel] + 1e-9 && slotNow.Cool == 0
                                : abil.Stance != null
                                ? slotNow.Left == 0 && Math.Abs(slotNow.Cool - sweepShip.Stats[abil.Stance.Cooldown]) < 0.1
                                : slotNow.Left <= slotWas.Left + 1e-9 && slotNow.Cool <= slotWas.Cool + 1e-9;
                        }
                        string told = engaged
                            ? refusedAgain ? $"a second press while it is engaged is refused ({slotWas.Left:0.0} s up, {slotWas.Cool:0.0} s cooling)"
                                           : $"a second press RESTARTED it ({slotWas.Left:0.0} s up, {slotWas.Cool:0.0} s cooling)"
                            : $"it engages no slot, so there is nothing to refuse (controls locked: {Hub.ControlsLocked})";
                        Check(didIt && refusedAgain,
                              $"{cls.Name} {abil.Short}: the press {(didIt ? "did" : "did NOT do")} what its row says, and {told}");

                        // nothing this press started may run on into the next one
                        sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id).Left = 0; sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id).Cool = 0; sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id).Own = 0;
                        if (sweepCut != null) sweepShip.Sl(sweepCut).Cool = 0;
                    }

                    // THE WORLD PUT BACK, so the class after this one starts where this one did:
                    // every slot at rest, the magazine full, every status this class's abilities
                    // put on the hull cleared, the wing called home, and whatever it dropped or
                    // was aiming at gone.
                    foreach (var abil in Abilities.For(cls.Id))
                    {
                        sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id).Left = 0; sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id).Cool = 0;
                        sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id).Own = 0; sweepShip.Sl(abil.Id).N = 0;
                    }
                    foreach (var flag in new[] { Status.Disabled, Status.Hardened, Status.Untargetable, Status.Parrying })
                        sweepShip.Statuses.Clear(flag);
                    sweepShip.RecallWing();
                    sweepShip.Forget(sweepMark);
                    foreach (var standing in H.Deployed.ToList())
                        if (standing.OwnerId == sweepShip.OwnerId) H.DeployedTaken(standing);
                    foreach (var laid in H.Laid.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Zone, laid, burst: false, float.NaN);   // a well (kits 6b) pulls nothing into the next sweep
                    foreach (var sweptSalvo in H.Salvos.ToList()) H.Down(Spawns.Decoy, sweptSalvo, burst: false, float.NaN);
                    Sink(sweepMark);
                    await Wait(0.1);
                }

                // ── B. MINIMUM AND MAXIMUM RANGE, CLASS BY CLASS AND REACH BY REACH ──────
                // ClassDef.Reach is what a class says its weapons REACH, by stat id: the list a
                // pilot's REACH points and the Targeting Chip both lift. Nothing proved that any
                // of those figures was the distance the weapon actually stops at -- so a reach
                // could be raised by a purchase and change nothing a pilot could see. For every
                // flyable class and EVERY id it declares, a target stands just inside and a second
                // just outside, on bearings this run drew, and the weapon must engage the one and
                // not the other. The `default` arm FAILS: a reach nothing measures cannot be added
                // quietly.
                //
                // THE THREE THAT ARE FLOWN, NOT FIRED, and so are not here: a fighter opens up at
                // fighter_range only after it has launched and flown its approach; a bomber turns
                // to launch after a run out to launch_range at 190 u/s; and the torpedo's own run
                // is that flight again. Each is about ten seconds in the air for one figure, and
                // the carrier's block above already flies a whole strike.
                var flownNotFired = new[] { "fighter_range", "launch_range", "torpedo_range" };
                var skipped = new List<string>();

                async Task ProveReach(PlayerShip pilot, ClassDef cdef, string stat)
                {
                    double reach = pilot.Stats[stat];
                    float bearing = VaryAngle();
                    var way = Vector2.Right.Rotated(bearing);
                    var wide = way.Rotated(Vary(1.2f, 2.4f));      // a second bearing, well clear of the first
                    bool proved = false; string told = "";
                    switch (stat)
                    {
                        case "main_range" when cdef.Primary == Primary.Lob:
                        {
                            // A LOB'S REACH (kits6b-J4) is where its landing is clamped: a cursor 1.25-1.45
                            // reaches out lands the blast AT the reach (PlayerShip.LobPoint), catching a mark
                            // standing there, and a mark past the reach and the blast both on that bearing is
                            // untouched. The blast is the pilot's own row and numbers; only its flight is the
                            // harness's (0.25 s, not 1.4).
                            var farCursor = pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(1.25f, 1.45f));
                            var lands = pilot.LobPoint(farCursor);
                            var mkIn = await Marker(lands);
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach + pilot.Stats["mortar_blast"] + Vary(80f, 200f)));
                            double inWas = mkIn.Hp, outWas = mkOut.Hp;
                            H.ThrowMissile(new MissileSpec { Side = cdef.LobSide, Damage = pilot.Stats["main_damage"], Blast = (float)pilot.Stats["mortar_blast"], Flight = 0.25 },
                                           pilot.Position, lands, pilot.NetId);
                            await Wait(0.45);
                            proved = Math.Abs(pilot.Position.DistanceTo(lands) - reach) < 0.5 && mkIn.Hp < inWas && mkOut.Hp == outWas;
                            told = $"a cursor {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(farCursor):0} u out lands the mortar at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(lands):0} u ({inWas - mkIn.Hp:0.0} taken there) and nothing {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u out ({outWas - mkOut.Hp:0.0})";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "main_range" when cdef.Primary == Primary.Beam:
                        {
                            // A BEAM'S REACH (kits6b-J7): one tick of the Tender's lance out of the hull along each
                            // bearing (PlayerShip.LanceTick, the host's own) -- a mark 0.80-0.92 of the reach out takes
                            // the tick, one whose near edge is 1.05-1.3 reaches out on the second bearing nothing.
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.80f, 0.92f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(1.05f, 1.3f)));
                            mkOut.Position = pilot.Position + wide * ((float)reach * Vary(1.05f, 1.3f) + mkOut.HitRadius);
                            double inWas = mkIn.Hp, outWas = mkOut.Hp;
                            int onIn = pilot.LanceTick(pilot.Position, way), onOut = pilot.LanceTick(pilot.Position, wide);
                            proved = onIn == PlayerShip.LanceBurn && mkIn.Hp < inWas && onOut == PlayerShip.LanceNone && mkOut.Hp == outWas;
                            told = $"a lance tick lands {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u out ({inWas - mkIn.Hp:0.0} taken) and touches nothing at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u ({outWas - mkOut.Hp:0.0} taken)";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "main_range":
                        {
