                            // The gun's OWN round, out of the ship's own spec, through Combat.Fire
                            // -- the one door everything that flies comes through, and the exact
                            // call Turret.Shoot makes. Only the SPEED is the harness's (four
                            // reaches a second, so the flight is a quarter of a second rather than
                            // a second and a half); the reach, the damage and the row of Shots.All
                            // are the ship's. The far mark stands a quarter past the reach because
                            // a shell always flies one frame's step past it before it ends.
                            var gun = pilot.Spec(false);
                            var nearAt = pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.80f, 0.92f));
                            var farAt = pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(1.25f, 1.45f));
                            var mkIn = await Marker(nearAt); var mkOut = await Marker(farAt);
                            double inWas = mkIn.Hp, outWas = mkOut.Hp;
                            Combat.Fire(gun.Kind, pilot.Position, way, (float)reach * 4f, gun.Range, gun.Damage, source: pilot);
                            Combat.Fire(gun.Kind, pilot.Position, wide, (float)reach * 4f, gun.Range, gun.Damage, source: pilot);
                            await Wait(0.35);
                            proved = mkIn.Hp < inWas && mkOut.Hp == outWas;
                            told = $"a {gun.Damage:0.0} shell lands {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(nearAt):0} u out ({inWas - mkIn.Hp:0.0} taken) and dies short of {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(farAt):0} u ({outWas - mkOut.Hp:0.0} taken)";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "pd_range":
                        {
                            // Point defence picks its OWN target, so it is the ACQUISITION that
                            // stops at the reach and no shot has to be waited for. It is passive:
                            // nothing to switch on first.
                            var mount = Nodes<Turret>(pilot).FirstOrDefault(tu2 => tu2.PointDefense);
                            if (mount == null) { told = "it declares a point-defence reach and mounts no point-defence turret"; break; }
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            var mountAt = mount.GlobalPosition;
                            var mkIn = await Marker(mountAt + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.60f, 0.90f)));
                            for (int frame = 0; frame < 8 && mount.Target == null; frame++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            bool gotIt = ReferenceEquals(mount.Target, mkIn);
                            float gotAt = mountAt.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position);
                            mkIn.Position = mountAt + way * (float)(reach * Vary(1.30f, 1.70f));
                            for (int frame = 0; frame < 8 && mount.Target != null; frame++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            proved = gotIt && mount.Target == null;
                            told = $"a turret takes a light at {gotAt:0} u and lets it go at {mountAt.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u";
                            Sink(mkIn);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "lance_range":
                        {
                            // A bow shot's OWN round (AbilityDef.Bow): its row of Shots.All, the ship's damage and run, through
                            // Combat.Fire as FireAlong makes it -- only the speed is the harness's (four runs a second).
                            var bow = Abilities.Find(pilot.Class, "longlance").Bow;
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.80f, 0.92f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(1.25f, 1.45f)));
                            double inWas = mkIn.Hp, outWas = mkOut.Hp;
                            Combat.Fire(bow.Kind, pilot.Position, way, (float)reach * 4f, (float)pilot.Stats[bow.Range], pilot.Stats[bow.Damage], source: pilot);
                            Combat.Fire(bow.Kind, pilot.Position, wide, (float)reach * 4f, (float)pilot.Stats[bow.Range], pilot.Stats[bow.Damage], source: pilot);
                            await Wait(0.45);
                            proved = mkIn.Hp < inWas && mkOut.Hp == outWas;
                            told = $"a Lance lands {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u out ({inWas - mkIn.Hp:0.0} taken) and dies short of {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u ({outWas - mkOut.Hp:0.0} taken)";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "control_range":
                        {
                            // The fighters are ordered onto a target only while it is inside the
                            // control range, and the slot itself says so -- which is what a pilot
                            // has to go on before pressing it.
                            var atkRow = Abilities.Find(pilot.Class, "attack");
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.55f, 0.90f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(1.15f, 1.45f)));
                            string nearLine = atkRow.State(pilot, mkIn).Line, farLine = atkRow.State(pilot, mkOut).Line;
                            proved = nearLine == "READY" && farLine == "OUT OF RANGE";
                            told = $"the attack slot reads {nearLine} at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u and {farLine} at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "patrol_range":
                        {
                            // The patrol's ring, to a hull's edge: a light inside it is one the patrol
                            // may take, one past it never is (Wings.Pick, what every patrol craft asks)
                            var prow = Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol);
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.55f, 0.90f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(1.15f, 1.45f)));
                            proved = Wings.Within(pilot, prow, mkIn) && !Wings.Within(pilot, prow, mkOut)
                                     && !ReferenceEquals(Wings.Pick(pilot, prow, null), mkOut);
                            told = $"the patrol may take a light {Wings.Reach(pilot, prow, mkIn):0} u out and never one {Wings.Reach(pilot, prow, mkOut):0} u out";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "strike_range":
                        {
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(1.15f, 1.45f)));
                            doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "bombers", mkOut.NetId, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            bool refusedFar = pilot.StrikeTarget == null;
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.45f, 0.85f)));
                            doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "bombers", mkIn.NetId, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            bool tookNear = ReferenceEquals(pilot.StrikeTarget, mkIn);
                            // ...and a second strike ordered while one is out is refused: the
                            // bombers already called keep the target they were called for.
                            doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "bombers", mkOut.NetId, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            bool stillOne = ReferenceEquals(pilot.StrikeTarget, mkIn);
                            proved = refusedFar && tookNear && stillOne;
                            told = $"a strike at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u is refused, one at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u is taken, and a second order while it is out is refused ({stillOne})";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "rail_range":
                        {
                            // The line goes off the NOSE, so the hull is turned to whatever
                            // heading this run drew and the two marks stand on it. A full charge is
                            // let go on a seated round (its row's Loose): the shot, not the wait.
                            pilot.Rotation = bearing;
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            var railWay = Vector2.Up.Rotated(pilot.Rotation);
                            var railFrom = Aim.Nose(pilot, pilot.MyArt.Length * 0.5f);
                            var mkIn = await Marker(railFrom + railWay * (float)(reach * Vary(0.55f, 0.90f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(railFrom + railWay * (float)(reach * Vary(1.10f, 1.30f)));
                            double inWas = mkIn.Hp, outWas = mkOut.Hp;
                            pilot.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; pilot.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated;
                            Abilities.Find(pilot.Class, "railgun").Loose(pilot, 1.0);
                            await Wait(0.12);
                            proved = Math.Abs(inWas - mkIn.Hp - pilot.Stats["rail_damage"]) < 0.01 && mkOut.Hp == outWas;
                            told = $"the slug takes {inWas - mkIn.Hp:0} off what stands {railFrom.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u down the line and {outWas - mkOut.Hp:0} off what stands {railFrom.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u down it";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            pilot.Sl("railgun").Left = 0; pilot.Sl("railgun").N = (int)Chamber.Seated;
                            break;
                        }
                        case "hunter_range":
                        {
                            // THREE SITUATIONS, because two of them were wrong in the shipped game
                            // and the old check called one of them correct.
                            //   1. NOTHING IN REACH: nothing launches, the cooldown is NOT spent,
                            //      and the slot says so. It used to take the cooldown on the line
                            //      above the search, so a press at an empty sky burned all 14 s and
                            //      fired nothing -- which from the cockpit is the ability being
                            //      broken, and is what the owner reported.
                            //   2. A PRACTICE DUMMY IN REACH: it launches. The cell used
                            //      Targeting.WingPrey, which forbids a dummy because a WING would
                            //      strafe something immortal for ever -- so the one thing a pilot
                            //      tests a hull on was the one thing its missiles refused to fly
                            //      at. A seeker hits once and dies; it uses Attackable now.
                            //   3. SOMETHING REAL IN REACH: it launches and the cooldown IS spent.
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(1.15f, 1.45f)));
                            int flying0 = InFlight().Count();
                            pilot.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
                            doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "hunters", 0, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            int flewNone = InFlight().Count() - flying0;
                            bool keptCool = pilot.Sl("hunters").Cool == 0;
                            string emptySays = Abilities.Find(pilot.Class, "hunters").Refuse?.Invoke(pilot, null);
                            float noneAt = pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position);
                            Sink(mkOut);
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);

                            // 2 -- a DUMMY, the thing a pilot actually practises on
                            var dummy = Nodes<TargetDummy>().FirstOrDefault();
                            int flewDummy = -1;
                            if (dummy != null)
                            {
                                var wasAt = pilot.Position;
                                pilot.Position = dummy.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * (float)(reach * Vary(0.35f, 0.7f));
                                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                                flying0 = InFlight().Count();
                                pilot.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
                                doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "hunters", 0, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                                flewDummy = InFlight().Count() - flying0;
                                pilot.Position = wasAt;
                                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            }

                            // 3 -- something real, and the cooldown goes this time
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(0.40f, 0.85f)));
                            flying0 = InFlight().Count();
                            pilot.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
                            doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "hunters", 0, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            int flew = InFlight().Count() - flying0;
                            bool spentCool = pilot.Sl("hunters").Cool > 0;
                            int want = (int)pilot.Stats["hunter_count"];
                            proved = flewNone == 0 && keptCool && emptySays == "NOTHING IN REACH"
                                     && flewDummy >= want && flew >= want && spentCool;
                            told = $"empty sky: {flewNone} away, cooldown kept ({keptCool}), slot says {emptySays ?? "nothing"}; "
                                 + $"a dummy at hand: {flewDummy} away; a hostile at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u: {flew} away and the cooldown spent ({spentCool})";
                            Sink(mkIn);
                            // ITS OWN SEEKERS DOWN before the next case: one whose mark is gone flies on
                            // down its heading and strikes whatever it meets, and these twelve crossed the
                            // Echo's blast marks three cases later (136 where 80 was stored, twice).
                            foreach (var m in InFlight().Where(x => x.Source == pilot).ToList()) m.Intercept();
                            pilot.Sl("hunters").Cool = 0;
                            break;
                        }
                        case "blade_reach":
                        {
                            // the blade held, the nose on `way`: a mark inside the reach loses a swing,
                            // one well past it on the same line nothing
                            pilot.Rotation = way.Angle() + Mathf.Pi / 2f;
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.45f, 0.80f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(1.8f, 2.4f)));
                            double inWas = mkIn.Hp, outWas = mkOut.Hp;
                            var bladeKey = Abilities.KeyFor(pilot.Class, "blade");
                            KeyDown(bladeKey);
                            for (int i = 0; i < 40 && mkIn.Hp == inWas; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            KeyUp(bladeKey);
                            proved = Math.Abs(inWas - mkIn.Hp - pilot.Stats["blade_damage"]) < 0.01 && mkOut.Hp == outWas;
                            told = $"{inWas - mkIn.Hp:0} at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u and {outWas - mkOut.Hp:0} at {pilot.Position.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            break;
                        }
                        case "reverb_radius":
                        {
                            // The blast goes off where the LAST of the damage landed, not where
                            // the ship is, so both marks are measured from that spot.
                            var landedAt = pilot.Position + way * Vary(60f, 140f);
                            var mkIn = await Marker(landedAt + way.Rotated(1f) * (float)(reach * Vary(0.40f, 0.85f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(landedAt + way.Rotated(-1f) * (float)(reach * Vary(1.20f, 1.60f)));
                            // NOTHING ELSE LANDS ON THE MARKS: a hit while the echo is up is stored and
                            // blasted too, and one before it would read as blast. Twice this read 136
                            // where 80 was stored -- the Warden's seekers, flying on after their mark was
                            // sunk (the hunters case downs its own now). Guns off, a beat for this ship's
                            // own shells, and the hulls read AFTER it, never before the wait.
                            pilot.Trigger = false;
                            await Wait(0.8);
                            double inWas = mkIn.Hp, outWas = mkOut.Hp;
                            int strays = InFlight().Count();
                            pilot.Sl("reverb").Cool = 0;
                            doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "reverb", 0, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            pilot.NoteDealt(80, new StandIn { Position = landedAt }, "shell");  // as a shell of its own would
                            pilot.Sl("reverb").Left = 0.001;
                            await Wait(0.12);
                            double blastWas = 80 * pilot.Stats["reverb_share"];
                            proved = Math.Abs(inWas - mkIn.Hp - blastWas) < 0.01 && mkOut.Hp == outWas;
                            told = $"{blastWas:0} stored puts {inWas - mkIn.Hp:0} on what stands {landedAt.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u from where it landed and {outWas - mkOut.Hp:0} on what stands {landedAt.DistanceTo(mkOut.Position):0} u from it ({strays} missiles in flight at the press)";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            pilot.Sl("reverb").Left = 0; pilot.Sl("reverb").Cool = 0; pilot.Sl("reverb").Own = 0;
                            break;
                        }
                        case "wave_range":
                        {
                            var mkIn = await Marker(pilot.Position + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.40f, 0.85f)));
                            var mkOut = await Marker(pilot.Position + wide * (float)(reach * Vary(1.15f, 1.50f)));
                            float inWas = mkIn.Position.DistanceTo(pilot.Position), outWas = mkOut.Position.DistanceTo(pilot.Position);
                            pilot.Sl("shockwave").Cool = 0;
                            doAbility.Invoke(pilot, new object[] { "shockwave", 0, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>() });
                            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            float inNow = mkIn.Position.DistanceTo(pilot.Position), outNow = mkOut.Position.DistanceTo(pilot.Position);
                            proved = Math.Abs(inNow - inWas - pilot.Stats["wave_push"]) < 2 && Math.Abs(outNow - outWas) < 2;
                            told = $"what stood {inWas:0} u off is thrown {inNow - inWas:0} u and what stood {outWas:0} u off moves {outNow - outWas:0} u";
                            Sink(mkIn); Sink(mkOut);
                            pilot.Sl("shockwave").Cool = 0;
                            break;
                        }
                        case "deploy_range":
                        {
                            // A turret left standing picks its own target with the same component
                            // point defence uses, so again it is the acquisition that stops. R throws
                            // it to the cursor and it lands deploy_flight (0.8 s) later, so it is
                            // thrown at the pilot's own spot and taken once it has landed.
                            pilot.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0;
                            SentryAt(pilot, pilot.Position);
                            DeployedTurret standing = null;
                            for (int frame = 0; frame < 60 * 2 && standing == null; frame++)
                            {
                                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                                standing = H.Deployed.LastOrDefault(tu3 => tu3.OwnerId == pilot.OwnerId);
                            }
                            if (standing == null) { told = "R threw no sentry that landed within 2 s to measure the reach of"; break; }
                            var mountAt = standing.Position;
                            var mkIn = await Marker(mountAt + way * (float)(reach * Vary(0.60f, 0.90f)));
                            for (int frame = 0; frame < 8 && standing.Aimed == null; frame++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            bool gotIt = ReferenceEquals(standing.Aimed, mkIn);
                            float gotAt = mountAt.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position);
                            mkIn.Position = mountAt + way * (float)(reach * Vary(1.30f, 1.70f));
                            for (int frame = 0; frame < 8 && standing.Aimed != null; frame++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                            proved = gotIt && standing.Aimed == null;
                            told = $"the turret it left takes a light at {gotAt:0} u and lets it go at {mountAt.DistanceTo(mkIn.Position):0} u";
                            Sink(mkIn);
                            foreach (var taken2 in H.Deployed.ToList())
                                if (taken2.OwnerId == pilot.OwnerId) H.DeployedTaken(taken2);
                            pilot.Sl("deploy").Cool = 0;
                            break;
                        }
                        default:
                            told = "nothing in this sweep knows how to measure it, and a reach nothing measures is a reach an upgrade can raise for free";
                            break;
                    }
                    Check(proved, $"{cdef.Name} {AllStats.Said(stat)} is {reach:0} u: {told}");
                }

                foreach (var cls in Classes.All.Where(cd2 => cd2.Ready).ToList())
                {
                    await SetClass(cls.Id);
                    var reachShip = Me;
                    reachShip.Position = VaryNear(afield, 700f); reachShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    reachShip.Rotation = VaryAngle();
                    await Wait(0.15);
                    // ...and the STRIKE RANGE with them, LAST. It is the one reach no row
                    // declares: it is defined FROM the control range (twice it) and takes the same
                    // bonus, so a class that declares the one has the other whether it says so or
                    // not. Last because ordering it launches the wing, and a launched wing is not
                    // armed for the next measurement.
                    var reachIds = cls.Reach.Keys.ToList();
                    if (cls.Has(Fit.Wing)) reachIds.Add("strike_range");
                    foreach (var reachId in reachIds)
                    {
                        if (flownNotFired.Contains(reachId)) { skipped.Add($"{cls.Name}.{reachId}"); continue; }
                        await ProveReach(reachShip, cls, reachId);
                        reachShip.Position = VaryNear(afield, 700f); reachShip.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    }
                    foreach (var flag in new[] { Status.Disabled, Status.Hardened, Status.Untargetable, Status.Parrying })
                        reachShip.Statuses.Clear(flag);
                    reachShip.RecallWing();
                }
                Check(skipped.Count == flownNotFired.Length && skipped.All(sk2 => flownNotFired.Any(fn2 => sk2.EndsWith(fn2)))
                      && Classes.All.Where(cd2 => cd2.Ready).SelectMany(cd2 => cd2.Reach.Keys).Distinct().Count() == 14
                      && Classes.All.Where(cd2 => cd2.Ready).Sum(cd2 => cd2.Reach.Count) == 31,
                      $"fourteen reach ids over 31 class-and-id pairs (the patrol's ring the fourteenth), and every one of them measured above except the three that are FLOWN rather than fired "
                      + $"-- the fighters' approach, the bombers' run out and the torpedo's own run ({string.Join(", ", skipped)})");
            }

            await SetClass(ShipClass.Battleship);

            {   // ── A STATUS'S SHARE IS A ROW, AND ITS GAP IS SWEPT ─────────────────
                // Guarded read a hardening row one class carries (then the rush's, now the taunt's
                // taunt_guard) off the hit hull's own sheet, so Hardened on any other hull was a
                // status that did nothing at all. The share is the applier's now.
                var gd = Me; gd.Position = yonder; gd.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
                Check(gd.Stats["taunt_guard"] == 0, "a battleship's sheet has no taunt_guard row of its own at all");

                // The per-source gap kept one entry per attacker that had EVER touched the hull,
                // for the life of the world. Forty in one frame, and none of them a second later.
                var lastHitBy = (Dictionary<string, double>)typeof(PlayerShip)
                    .GetField("_lastHitBy", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(gd);
                for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) gd.Hit(1, gd.Position + new Vector2(0, -200), $"test:swept{i}");
                int keptGap = lastHitBy.Count, tallied = gd.DamageBySource.Count;
                await Wait(1.2);                                       // well past the 0.52 s gap
                int swept = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) if (!lastHitBy.ContainsKey($"test:swept{i}")) swept++;
                Check(keptGap >= 40 && swept == 40 && tallied >= 40 && gd.DamageBySource.Count >= 40,
                      $"forty sources in one frame leave forty entries in the 0.52 s gap and none of them 1.2 s later ({keptGap} held, {swept} of 40 swept), and the tally the HUD reads still has all forty ({gd.DamageBySource.Count})");
                double gap0 = gd.Hp;
                gd.Hit(10, gd.Position + new Vector2(0, -200), "test:gap");
                gd.Hit(10, gd.Position + new Vector2(0, -200), "test:gap");
                Check(Math.Abs(gap0 - gd.Hp - 10) < 1e-6,
                      $"...and the gap itself still holds: the same source twice inside 0.52 s lands once, for 10 ({gap0 - gd.Hp:0})");

                // HARDENED on a hull with no row of its own: half of it, which is what Hardened
                // has always meant.
                gd.ApplyStatus(Status.Hardened, 0.4); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double hd0 = gd.Hp;
                gd.Hit(100, gd.Position + new Vector2(0, -200), "test:hardrow");
                Check(gd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened) && Math.Abs(hd0 - gd.Hp - 50) < 1e-6,
                      $"a 100 blow on a HARDENED battleship -- a class with no taunt_guard row -- lands for 50 ({hd0 - gd.Hp:0})");
                await Wait(0.6);
                await Lane("LaneAHardenedShareChecks", () => LaneAHardenedShareChecks(gd));
                // and a status with NO row of that table (Untargetable, the Wraith's veil) scales nothing: the
                // table's one row is Hardened at 0.5, so a veiled hull takes the 100 whole
                gd.ApplyStatus(Status.Untargetable, 0.4); await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                double ev0 = gd.Hp;
                gd.Hit(100, gd.Position + new Vector2(0, -200), "test:norow");
                Check(StatusSet.Guards.Length == 1 && StatusSet.Guards[0].Status == Status.Hardened && StatusSet.Guards[0].Share == 0.5
                      && gd.Statuses.Has(Status.Untargetable) && !gd.Statuses.Has(Status.Hardened) && Math.Abs(ev0 - gd.Hp - 100) < 1e-6,
                      $"the guard table's one row is Hardened at 0.5 ({StatusSet.Guards.Length} row(s)), and an UNTARGETABLE battleship -- no row of its own -- takes that 100 whole ({ev0 - gd.Hp:0})");
                gd.Statuses.Clear(Status.Untargetable);
                await Wait(0.6);
            }

            {   // ── FIVE WIRE STATUSES, BIT 16 UNASSIGNED, AND NO SIXTH THAT PACKS ────
                // The values that remain ARE the wire format: 1 2 4 8 32, the fifth being Parrying (a
                // prism stance every peer draws). 16 names nothing: a packet carrying it brings nothing
                // back. Suppressed, Dazzled, Jammed and Unwebbed (64/128/256/512) are host-only
                // (StatusSet.HostOnly) and StatusSet.Bits masks them out. The trip wire below counts
                // non-host-only members, not the enum's raw length, so a future host-only addition
                // (never on the wire) does not re-break this check -- only a sixth WIRE status would.
                var put = new StatusSet();
                put.Apply(Status.Pinned, 1); put.Apply(Status.Disabled, 1); put.Apply(Status.Untargetable, 1);
                put.Apply(Status.Hardened, 1); put.Apply(Status.Parrying, 1);
                int bits = put.Bits;
                var got = new StatusSet(); got.FromBits(bits);
                var stray = new StatusSet(); stray.FromBits(16);
                int total = System.Enum.GetValues(typeof(Status)).Length;
                int wireable = System.Enum.GetValues(typeof(Status)).Cast<Status>()
                    .Count(s => s != Status.None && (StatusSet.HostOnly & s) == 0);
                Check(bits == 47 && total == 10 && wireable == 5 && !System.Enum.IsDefined(typeof(Status), 16) && stray.Bits == 0
                      && (int)Status.Pinned == 1 && (int)Status.Disabled == 2 && (int)Status.Untargetable == 4
                      && (int)Status.Hardened == 8 && (int)Status.Parrying == 32
                      && got.Has(Status.Pinned) && got.Has(Status.Disabled) && got.Has(Status.Untargetable)
                      && got.Has(Status.Hardened) && got.Has(Status.Parrying),
                      $"five wire statuses and no sixth: 1 2 4 8 32 pack into {bits} (47) and all five come back out of it; 16 names nothing ({stray.Bits} back from it) ({total} statuses total, {total - 1 - wireable} host-only)");
            }
        }

        // ── buildings open menus; READY -> autopilot -> portal -> ARENA -> home ──
        // (Late in the run on purpose: the trip replaces the whole hub scene, so every
        //  node reference taken before it -- dummies, ships -- is stale afterwards.)
        {
            var tioHome = Me.Position;
            Me.Position = Hub.TioPos + new Vector2(260, 0); Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(1.5);
            Click(Scr(Hub.TioPos)); await Wait(0.1);
            Check(H.TioOpen && Nodes<TioWindow>().Any(), "left-click on the TIO opens WARP TO TARGET");
            var tw = Nodes<TioWindow>().First();
            Check(!Nodes<Button>(tw).Any(b => b.Name == "Warp"), "no WARP button: READY drives the mission");
            H.Yard.Credits = 1000;
            // start well away from where the portal opens, so the autopilot has a real trip
            Me.Position = H.MissionPortalPos + new Vector2(300, 700); Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(0.3);
            Nodes<Button>(tw).First(b => b.Name == "Ready").EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed); await Wait(0.1);
            Check(H.AllReady && H.Mission == Hub.MissionState.Opening && Me.AutopilotTo == H.MissionPortalPos,
                  "READY: the party (just me) is ready, the portal starts opening, and my ship flies itself there");
            await Wait(Hub.PortalOpenTime + 0.2);
            var mp = H.GetNodeOrNull<Node2D>("MissionPortal");
            var tio = H.GetNode<Sprite2D>("TIO"); float halfW = tio.GetRect().Size.X * tio.Scale.X / 2f;
            Check(H.Mission == Hub.MissionState.PortalOpen && mp != null && mp.Position.X > Hub.TioPos.X + halfW && mp.Position.Y < Hub.TioPos.Y - Hub.TioHeight / 2f,
                  "after 3 s the portal opens off the TIO's top-right corner");
            // THE MARK THAT WAS PICKABLE AND INVISIBLE: the open portal is one row of the scope
            // table now, so the glyph and the pick are the same row or neither exists.
            var mpMark = H.ScopeMarks().Where(smk => smk.Name == "MISSION PORTAL").ToList();
            Check(mpMark.Count == 1 && mpMark[0].At.DistanceTo(H.MissionPortalPos) < 0.01f && mpMark[0].Pick > 0f
                  && mpMark[0].Size.X > 0f && mpMark[0].Colour.A > 0f,
                  $"the open mission portal is 1 scope mark with a glyph of its own ({mpMark.Count} row, pick {(mpMark.Count == 1 ? mpMark[0].Pick : -1):0} u)");
            float d0 = Me.Position.DistanceTo(H.MissionPortalPos);
            // The base as it LEAVES, marked: the only thing that can put this figure on disk is the
            // save on the way out (the 30 s autosave is held off). That save used to write nothing --
            // the sector had already become the arena -- and a quit out there lost the difference.
            typeof(Yard).GetField("_saveCd", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(H.Yard, 1e9);
            // ...and a hauler with a load waiting on its pad: the trip must take it home, not lose it
            H.Yard.Hauler.ResetToPad(); H.Yard.Hauler.Cargo = 300;
            double heldAtLeaving = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 45 && !Hub.InArena; i++)
            {
                if (H?.Yard != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(H.Yard))
                {
                    H.Yard.Credits = 424242;
                    heldAtLeaving = H.Yard.Stock("ore") + H.Yard.Stock("salvage") + H.Yard.Hauler.Cargo + H.Yard.Gatherers.Sum(g => g.Cargo);
                }
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            // THE BOSS SPAWNS NOSE-ON: its NOSE on ArenaCentre, facing the party, so its centre stands
            // half a length north of it -- read the first frame the boss exists, before its 30 u/s
            // approach (0.5 u a frame) can have carried it more than a frame or two
            int spawnWait = 0;
            for (; spawnWait < 120 && H?.Boss == null; spawnWait++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            float spawnOff = H?.Boss == null ? -1f : H.Boss.Position.DistanceTo(Hub.ArenaCentre + Vector2.Up * (H.Boss.Length * 0.5f));
            float spawnNose = H?.Boss == null ? -1f : H.Boss.Position.DistanceTo(Hub.ArenaCentre);
            Check(spawnOff >= 0f && spawnOff < 3f && Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(H.Boss.Rotation, Mathf.Pi)) < 0.05f,
                  $"the boss spawns with its nose on the arena's centre: its centre {spawnNose:0} u north of it (half its {H?.Boss?.Length:0} u), {spawnOff:0.0} u off that spot, facing south");
            var tripRec = typeof(Yard).GetField("_trip", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static).GetValue(null);
            // The trip's stock is one figure per resource row now, not two named fields.
            var tripBag = tripRec?.GetType().GetProperty("Stock").GetValue(tripRec) as System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, double>;
            double tripStock = tripBag == null ? -1 : Gathering.Resources.Sum(r => tripBag.GetValueOrDefault(r));
            Check(Math.Abs(tripStock - heldAtLeaving) < 1.0, $"leaving for the arena, the loads come home first: the base set aside holds the hauler's 300 too ({tripStock:0} of {heldAtLeaving:0})");
            await Wait(1.0);
            Check(Hub.InArena, $"the capital-ship autopilot flew {d0:0} u to the portal and the party went through");
            var leftWith = new ConfigFile(); leftWith.Load($"{Character.Dir}/{Character.Id}.cfg");
            Check(Math.Abs((double)leftWith.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0) - 424242) < 1e-6,
                  $"leaving for the arena writes the base to disk on the way out ({(double)leftWith.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0):0} of 424242)");
            var boss = H.Boss;
            Raids.Held = true;                                   // the fight's adds held: the boss's own moves are on trial first
            foreach (var r in H.Raiders.ToList()) H.RaiderDown(r);
            Check(boss != null && boss.Alive && boss.Type.Id == "silver_lancer" && boss.Type.Name == "RUSTY BUCKET" && H.Yard == null && !Nodes<TargetDummy>().Any() && Combat.Hostiles.Contains(boss),
                  "the arena at level 1: the Silver Lancer, and no base or dummies");
            // THE LEVEL'S OWN COPY of every move. At level 1 the scale is exactly 1, so the boss
            // flies the build's rows unaltered -- which is also how this proves the copy is made
            // from them rather than instead of them.
            {
                var flown = boss.Type.Moves.First(m => m.Windup > 0 && m.Reach > 0);
                var slot = boss.S(flown.Id);
                double q1 = Missions.Quicken(Missions.Level);
                Check(Math.Abs(q1 - 1.0) < 1e-9 && slot != null
                      && Math.Abs(slot.M.Windup - flown.Windup / q1) < 1e-6
                      && Math.Abs(slot.M.Reach - flown.Reach * q1) < 0.01
                      && Math.Abs(slot.M.Live - flown.Live) < 1e-9,
                      $"the boss flies the level's own copy of its rows: at level {Missions.Level} the scale is x{q1:0.000}, so its {flown.Id} winds up in {slot?.M.Windup:0.00} s and reaches {slot?.M.Reach:0} u -- its row's own figures");
            }
            // ITS MOVES ARE ROWS, so what follows reads the SLOT a row drives, by that row's id.
            // A beam's phases: Opening -- armed, waiting on a web; Winding -- the red line is charging;
            // Firing -- it is burning down that line. These were five private fields and a
            // reflection handle each.
            Boss.Slot BeamSlot() => boss.S("beam");
            bool BeamArmed() => BeamSlot().At == Boss.Phase.Opening;
            bool BeamCharging() => BeamSlot().At == Boss.Phase.Winding;
            bool BeamLive() => BeamSlot().At == Boss.Phase.Firing;
            bool Ramming() => boss.S("ram").At == Boss.Phase.Firing;
            // -- THE MOVES ARE A TABLE, AND THESE ARE ITS FIGURES --------------------------
            // Every number the two bosses fight with, against the literals of the design rather
            // than against the code's own constants. The behaviour checks below read the rows;
            // this is the one place that says what a row must SAY.
            {
                var lan = Missions.Bosses[0]; var dra = Missions.Bosses[1];
                BossMove L(string id) => lan.Moves.First(m => m.Id == id);
                BossMove D(string id) => dra.Moves.First(m => m.Id == id);
                Check(lan.Moves.Select(m => m.Id).SequenceEqual(new[] { "guns", "trident", "beam", "ram", "wave" })
                      && dra.Moves.Select(m => m.Id).SequenceEqual(new[] { "gun", "shotgun", "throw" }),
                      $"a boss's moves are a table of rows, in the order a frame resolves them ({string.Join(",", lan.Moves.Select(m => m.Id))} / {string.Join(",", dra.Moves.Select(m => m.Id))})");
                // its art, its shape and what it closes on are the row's too, as EnemyDef carries
                // a raider's -- they were abstract members of a boss class each. TWICE THE SIZE
                // (the owner, 2026-09-25): 720 / 140 and 840 / 180, the art's 360 / 70 and 420 / 90
                // doubled, hit size and all. Each closes to the gap it held at its first size --
                // 650 u from the centre of a 360 / 420 u hull, 470 / 440 u off the nose -- measured
                // from the hull now, so the bigger hull stands no nearer the party.
                Check(lan.Hull == 3222 && lan.Length == 720f && lan.HalfWidth == 140f && lan.Texture == "res://boss_raider.png"
                      && dra.Hull == 2968 && dra.Length == 840f && dra.HalfWidth == 180f && dra.Texture == "res://boss_drake.png"
                      && lan.HoldOff == 470f && lan.CloseSpeed == 30f && Math.Abs(lan.TurnRate - 0.3f) < 1e-6
                      && dra.HoldOff == 440f && dra.CloseSpeed == 30f && Math.Abs(dra.TurnRate - 0.3f) < 1e-6,
                      "a boss's hull, art and approach are its row's: 3222 / 720 / 140 and 2968 / 840 / 180 (twice the art's size, hit size and all), closing to 470 / 440 u off the nose at 30 u/s and turning at 0.3 rad/s");
                // THE PACK'S ART ON THE BOSSES: grey art, so each wears a tint -- the owner's red, the
                // swatch's mean RGB 172, 7, 2 = (0.67, 0.03, 0.01), red highlights over black shadows --
                // each texture is trimmed to its drawing, and its bells are listed off the art: the
                // Rusty's two, the Drake's five (four and a shorter one on the keel) -- at the stern of
                // the hull at twice the size: the Rusty's first bell 357.6 u aft (the tool's 178.81 at
                // 360 u, doubled), every one aft of 0.4 of its length and none past its tail.
                Check(lan.Tint == new Color(0.67f, 0.03f, 0.01f) && dra.Tint == new Color(0.67f, 0.03f, 0.01f)
                      && Trimmed(lan.Texture) && Trimmed(dra.Texture) && lan.Nozzles.Length == 2 && dra.Nozzles.Length == 5
                      && Math.Abs(lan.Nozzles[0].Y - 357.62f) < 0.01f
                      && new[] { lan, dra }.All(b => b.Nozzles.All(n => n.Y > b.Length * 0.4f && n.Y <= b.Length * 0.5f + 1f)),
                      $"a boss wears the owner's red on the pack's grey art, trimmed, its bells listed at the stern of the doubled hull (Rusty {lan.Nozzles.Length}, Drake {dra.Nozzles.Length}; the Rusty's first {lan.Nozzles[0].Y:0.00} u aft)");
                var gn = L("guns");
                Check(gn.Way == MoveWay.Bolt && gn.Every == 1.2 && gn.First == 2.0 && gn.Damage == 2.68 && gn.Find == 900f
                      && gn.Waits == MoveWait.Nothing && !gn.Busy && !gn.Super && gn.Source == "boss:guns"
                      && Math.Abs(gn.Damage / gn.Every - 2.68 / 1.2) < 1e-9 && gn.Beam == Beam.Bolt,
                      $"the guns: {gn.Damage} every {gn.Every} s (2.23 DPS) at the nearest ship within 900 u of its hull, they wait on nothing, and they are seen and heard as a boss's bolt ({Beam.Of(gn.Beam).Id})");
                var tr = L("trident");
                Check(tr.Way == MoveWay.Shoot && tr.Shot == Shots.Seeker && tr.Every == 15 && tr.First == 13.5
                      && tr.Count == 3 && tr.Spread == 25f && tr.Damage == 11.2 && tr.Speed == 135f && tr.Range == 1920f
                      && tr.Turn == 1.4f && tr.Size == 2f && tr.Muzzle == 14f && tr.Cue == "boss_trident"
                      && tr.Waits == MoveWait.Nothing && !tr.Busy && tr.Source == "boss:missiles",
                      $"the trident: {tr.Count} seekers at -25 / 0 / +25 degrees, 11.2 each, 135 u/s out to 1920 u, twice the size");
                var bm = L("beam");
                Check(bm.Way == MoveWay.Beam && bm.Every == 30 && bm.First == 6.0 && bm.Windup == 6.0 && bm.Live == 3.0
                      && bm.Tick == 0.25 && bm.Damage == 50 && bm.Reach == 10000f && bm.Width == 70f
                      && bm.Busy && bm.Super && bm.Waits == MoveWait.Itself && bm.Source == "boss:beam"
                      && bm.Cue == "boss_beam_charge" && bm.Strike == "boss_beam"
                      && bm.ArmMax == 5.0 && bm.ArmMax < bm.Windup && bm.Escape == 0.6 && bm.React == 2.0
                      && Math.Abs(bm.StripShare - 55.0 / 46.0) < 1e-12 && Math.Abs(bm.StripDps - 0.7 * 57.6) < 1e-9,
                      $"the beam: wind-up {bm.Windup} s, live {bm.Live} s judged every {bm.Tick} s for {bm.Damage}, 70 u wide down 10000 u; it waits on a web 5 s at most, and its escape floor is 2 s + 55/46 x pinner hull / (0.7 x 57.6) + 0.6 s");
                // THE ESCAPE FLOOR BY LITERAL (numbers_curve_raids_items.md §2.1): 2 webifiers 4.08 s, 3 webifiers
                // 4.82, 3 talons 4.20, 3 pods 7.94 -- the row read once here, against the model's figures
                double FloorFor(double hull) => bm.React + bm.StripShare * hull / bm.StripDps + bm.Escape;
                Check(Math.Abs(FloorFor(2 * Enemies.Of(Enemies.Webifier).Hull) - 4.08) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(FloorFor(3 * Enemies.Of(Enemies.Webifier).Hull) - 4.82) < 0.01
                      && Math.Abs(FloorFor(3 * Enemies.Of(Enemies.Talon).Hull) - 4.20) < 0.01 && Math.Abs(FloorFor(3 * Enemies.Of(Enemies.Pod).Hull) - 7.94) < 0.01,
                      $"the escape floor, priced on the slowest class: 2 webifiers {FloorFor(50):0.00} s, 3 webifiers {FloorFor(75):0.00}, 3 talons {FloorFor(54):0.00}, 3 pods {FloorFor(180):0.00}");
                var rm = L("ram");
                Check(rm.Way == MoveWay.Dash && rm.Every == 30 && rm.First == 21.0 && rm.Windup == 1.5
                      && rm.Damage == 29.8 && rm.Reach == 900f && rm.Speed == 1200f && rm.Width == 0f
                      && rm.Busy && rm.Super && rm.Shifts && rm.Waits == MoveWait.Everything && rm.Source == "boss:charge",
                      $"the ram: wind-up {rm.Windup} s, {rm.Reach} u at {rm.Speed} u/s, {rm.Damage} on contact, its lane the hull's own beam (no Width on the row) -- and a cadence of its OWN ({rm.Every} s, where it read the beam's constant by accident)");
                var wv = L("wave");
                Check(wv.Way == MoveWay.Ring && wv.Every == 17.0 && wv.First == 10.0 && wv.Windup == 1.8
                      && wv.Damage == 33.5 && wv.Reach == 340f && wv.Busy && !wv.Super && !wv.Shifts
                      && wv.Waits == MoveWait.Movers && wv.Source == "boss:wave" && wv.Strike == "boss_shockwave",
                      $"the shockwave: every {wv.Every} s, wind-up {wv.Windup} s, {wv.Damage} within {wv.Reach} u -- the period and the damage were bare literals in a method body");
                var dg = D("gun"); var sg = D("shotgun"); var th = D("throw");
                Check(dg.Way == MoveWay.Shoot && dg.Shot == Shots.Slug && dg.Every == 2.5 && dg.First == 2.0
                      && dg.Find == 1100f && dg.Damage == 4.72 && dg.Speed == 220f && dg.Range == 1300f
                      && dg.Radius == 7f && dg.Waits == MoveWait.Nothing && !dg.Busy && dg.Source == "boss:gun",
                      $"the Drake's main gun: {dg.Damage} a shell (1.89 DPS) every {dg.Every} s at 220 u/s within 1100 u of its hull, through its own specials");
                Check(sg.Way == MoveWay.Shoot && sg.Shot == Shots.Scrap && sg.Every == 15 && sg.First == 17.0
                      && sg.Warp == 1.0 && sg.Standoff == 390f && sg.WarpRing == 1.3f && Math.Abs(sg.WarpRing * dra.HalfWidth - 234f) < 0.01f
                      && sg.WarpSound == "drake_warp"
                      && sg.Windup == 1.875 && sg.Count == 7 && sg.Spread == 10f && sg.Width == 28f
                      && sg.Damage == 14.76 && sg.Speed == 480f && sg.Range == 1400f && sg.Radius == 9f
                      && sg.Busy && sg.Super && sg.Shifts && sg.Waits == MoveWait.Everything && sg.Source == "boss:scrap",
                      $"the scrap shotgun: a {sg.Warp} s ring, a warp to its nose {sg.Standoff} u off (the old 600 u from the 420 u hull's centre), a ring 234 u on the doubled hull, {sg.Windup} s of fan, then {sg.Count} pieces of {sg.Damage} at {sg.Spread} degrees apart");
                // THE BODY IS 180 u and the row carries NO Width, because a thrown body's lane is
                // the body's own width and Boss.Warn works it out. Width == 0 is asserted here so
                // a Width put back on this row fails rather than quietly taking over; that the
                // lane really is twice the body is proved where the throw runs, on this peer and
                // on a guest, because only a live raise can show it.
                // Where it is held is the clearance the row's comment sets out: the hull's own
                // half-width, the body, and the row's 40 u gap -- 180 + 180 + 40 = 400 u off the keel
                // of the doubled hull (310 on the 1x one). It backs its nose off to 1300 u, 200 u past
                // its main gun's 1100 u Find: both are measured from the hull, so the throw leaves
                // nothing in the gun's reach at any hull size.
                Check(th.Way == MoveWay.Throw && th.Every == 30 && th.First == 6.0 && th.Windup == 7.5
                      && th.Flight == 1.2 && th.Damage == 250 && th.Reach == 1800f && th.Width == 0f
                      && th.Warp == 1.0 && th.Standoff == 1300f && th.Standoff - dg.Find == 200f && th.WarpSound == "drake_warp"
                      && th.Radius == 180f && th.Offset == 40f
                      && dra.HalfWidth + th.Radius + th.Offset == 400f && th.Busy && th.Super
                      && th.Waits == MoveWait.Everything && th.Cue == "drake_tractor" && th.Strike == "drake_throw",
                      $"the asteroid throw: a {th.Radius} u body held {dra.HalfWidth + th.Radius + th.Offset} u off the keel ({th.Offset} u clear of the flank), a {th.Windup} s lane {th.Reach} u long and as wide as the body ({th.Radius * 2f} u), {th.Flight} s of flight, {th.Damage} to a ship in it");
                // ...AND A BOSS'S MOVES COME FROM ITS ROW, NOT FROM ITS CLASS. There is one Boss

                Check(!ramDuringBeam && ramAfter, $"the ram, due mid-beam, waits for the beam to end and then comes (during: {ramDuringBeam}, after: {ramAfter})");
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && (boss.Locked || RamLine()); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                me2.Position = boss.Position + new Vector2(0, 500); me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            }
            await Lane("LaneABurnClockChecks", () => LaneABurnClockChecks(boss, me2));
            await Lane("RaidsArenaAddsChecks", () => RaidsArenaAddsChecks(boss, me2));
            await Lane("LaneAOutDoorBossChecks", () => LaneAOutDoorBossChecks(boss, me2));
            await Lane("LaneA6bBusterBossChecks", () => LaneA6bBusterBossChecks(boss, me2));
            await Lane("FieldsRipChecks", () => FieldsRipChecks(boss, "Lancer", boss.Type.Id == "silver_lancer" ? 57.6f : float.NaN, false));
            await Lane("LaneA6aGrapnelRipChecks", () => LaneA6aGrapnelRipChecks(boss, boss.Type.Id, boss.Type.Id == "silver_lancer" ? 57.6f : float.NaN));   // slice 6a: the pull and the rip, 0.01 x its hull + 10
            // ── STEALTH STOPS THE BOSS CHOOSING, NEVER HITTING, AND NEVER STOPS THE FIGHT ──
            // Its pilots were ONE list, the seen one: a solo pilot who went dark emptied it and the
            // boss stopped closing, turning and counting every clock it had until the pilot came
            // back -- and a dark pilot beside a seen one stood in its shockwave untouched. Every
            // clock is held and the beam the last fallback started is stood down, so the only move
            // that runs is the one each check brings round. The pilot is seen once at a seeded spot,
            // goes dark, and is moved a seeded angle round the hull.
            {
                var dkHeld = boss.Type.Moves.ToDictionary(dkMove => dkMove.Id, dkMove => boss.S(dkMove.Id).Due);
                foreach (var dkMove in boss.Type.Moves) { boss.S(dkMove.Id).Due = 999; boss.S(dkMove.Id).At = Boss.Phase.Idle; }
                Fx.ClearWarnings();
                var dkSeen = boss.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(300f, 500f);
                for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { me2.Position = dkSeen; me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                float dkToSeen = Aim.Face(boss.Position, dkSeen);
                me2.ApplyStatus(Status.Untargetable, 10.0);
                float dkOff = Vary(0.8f, 2.4f) * (VaryAngle() < 0 ? -1f : 1f);
                var dkAt = boss.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(dkToSeen + dkOff) * boss.Position.DistanceTo(dkSeen);
                me2.Position = dkAt; me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                // the nose put half-way round from where it saw the pilot toward where the pilot now is
                boss.Rotation = dkToSeen + dkOff * 0.5f;
                double dkDue = boss.S("beam").Due;
                await Wait(1.0);
                double dkRan = dkDue - boss.S("beam").Due;
                Check(Targeting.Hidden(me2) && Math.Abs(dkRan - 1.0) < 0.1,
                      $"its only pilot dark, the boss's clocks run on: the beam's comes {dkRan:0.00} s nearer in 1 s -- it stood still for as long as the pilot was unseen");
                float dkBack = Mathf.Abs(dkOff * 0.5f) - Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference(dkToSeen, boss.Rotation));
                Check(Mathf.Abs(dkBack - 0.3f) < 0.03f,
                      $"...and it comes back round onto where it last saw the pilot at its 0.3 rad/s ({dkBack:0.000} rad in 1 s), not on after the pilot it cannot see, {Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(dkOff)):0} degrees round");

                // A BLOW THAT LANDS IN AN AREA LANDS ON EVERYONE IN IT, SEEN OR NOT
                me2.Position = VaryNear(boss.Position, 300f); me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                double dkWave0 = me2.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:wave");
                int dkWaves0 = boss.S("wave").Fired;
                boss.S("wave").Due = 0.01;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && (boss.S("wave").Fired == dkWaves0 || boss.S("wave").At != Boss.Phase.Idle); i++)
                { me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                double dkWaveHit = me2.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:wave") - dkWave0;
                Check(Targeting.Hidden(me2) && boss.S("wave").Fired == dkWaves0 + 1 && Math.Abs(dkWaveHit - 33.5) < 1e-6,
                      $"a pilot it cannot see, {me2.Position.DistanceTo(boss.S("wave").To):0} u inside its 680 u shockwave, still takes the whole 33.5 ({dkWaveHit:0.0})");

                // ...AND ITS MOVES STILL COME, AIMED WHERE IT LAST SAW ANYONE: not held back for want
                // of a pilot in sight, and not aimed at the one it cannot see
                me2.Position = dkAt; me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                boss.S("ram").Due = 0.01;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && boss.S("ram").At == Boss.Phase.Idle; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                float dkRamOff = Mathf.Abs(Mathf.AngleDifference((boss.S("ram").To - boss.Position).Angle(), (dkSeen - boss.Position).Angle()));
                Check(boss.S("ram").At == Boss.Phase.Winding && dkRamOff < 0.01f,
                      $"with nobody in sight its ram still comes, down the line to where it last saw the pilot ({Mathf.RadToDeg(dkRamOff):0.0} degrees off it; the pilot is {Mathf.RadToDeg(Mathf.Abs(dkOff)):0} degrees round from there)");
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && boss.S("ram").At != Boss.Phase.Idle; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);

                // A SEEKER DOES NOT FOLLOW A PILOT IT CANNOT SEE: thrown square across the line to the
                // dark pilot, beyond its point defence, it flies on straight -- homing at the
                // trident's 1.4 rad/s would swing it 0.7 rad in the half second
                var dkSkFrom = me2.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1000f, 1400f);
                var dkSkDir = (me2.Position - dkSkFrom).Normalized().Rotated(Mathf.Pi / 2f);
                var dkSk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, dkSkFrom, dkSkDir, 135f, 1920f, 0.0, targetId: me2.NetId, turnRate: 1.4f);
                await Wait(0.5);
                float dkSwung = dkSk.Dir.AngleTo(dkSkDir);
                Check(Targeting.Hidden(me2) && dkSk.Alive && Mathf.Abs(dkSwung) < 1e-4f,
                      $"a seeker thrown at a pilot gone dark does not home on it: it flies on straight ({Mathf.RadToDeg(dkSwung):0.000} degrees turned in 0.5 s)");
                dkSk.Intercept();

                foreach (var dkMove in boss.Type.Moves) boss.S(dkMove.Id).Due = dkHeld[dkMove.Id];
                me2.Statuses.Clear(Status.Untargetable);
                me2.Position = boss.Position + new Vector2(0, 500); me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            }
            // -- WHAT IS PLACED ROUND A BOSS IS MEASURED FROM ITS HULL, AND A RAM LANDS ONCE --------
            // The owner's ruling: what is placed around a boss scales with it. So the gap it closes
            // to, how far its guns look and its shockwave's ring are all taken off the doubled hull,
            // and a hull that takes 0.6 s to pass a point still rams a pilot once. Every clock is
            // parked, so the only move that runs is the one each check brings round; the boss's own
            // place is put back after each (a check that moves it owns putting it back). A pilot's
            // hit radius under 60 u keeps every spot below clear of the edges it is placed between.
            {
                var hbHeld = boss.Type.Moves.ToDictionary(hbMv => hbMv.Id, hbMv => boss.S(hbMv.Id).Due);
                foreach (var hbMv in boss.Type.Moves) { boss.S(hbMv.Id).Due = 999; boss.S(hbMv.Id).At = Boss.Phase.Idle; }
                Fx.ClearWarnings();
                var hbHome = boss.Position; float hbHomeRot = boss.Rotation, hbHalf = boss.Length * 0.5f;
                bool hbSmall = me2.HitRadius < 60f;

                // ITS GUNS LOOK Find PAST THE HULL: 900 u off the Rusty's nose, 1260 u from its centre
                // on the 720 u hull. From three bearings, a pilot just inside draws them and one just
                // outside does not (the clock armed either way, so "not" is a choice, not a silence).
                var hbGuns = boss.S("guns");
                float hbReach = hbGuns.M.Find + hbHalf;
                var hbFindBad = new List<string>();
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                    foreach (bool hbIn in new[] { true, false })
                    {
                        boss.Position = hbHome;
                        float hbR = hbReach + (hbIn ? -1f : 1f) * Vary(20f, 60f);
                        me2.Position = boss.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * hbR; me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                        int hbFired = hbGuns.Fired;
                        hbGuns.Due = 0.01;
                        for (int i = 0; i < 30 && hbGuns.Fired == hbFired; i++) { me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                        hbGuns.Due = 999;
                        bool hbDrew = hbGuns.Target == me2;
                        if (hbGuns.Fired != hbFired + 1 || hbDrew != hbIn)
                            hbFindBad.Add($"{boss.Position.DistanceTo(me2.Position):0} u off its centre: {(hbDrew ? "fired on" : "left alone")}, armed {hbGuns.Fired - hbFired}");
                    }
                Check(hbFindBad.Count == 0 && Math.Abs(hbReach - 1260f) < 0.01f,
                      $"its guns look 900 u past its hull, not past its centre: at three bearings a pilot 20-60 u inside {hbReach:0} u draws them and one 20-60 u outside does not{(hbFindBad.Count > 0 ? " -- " + string.Join("; ", hbFindBad) : "")}");

                // ITS SHOCKWAVE LANDS WHERE ITS RING IS DRAWN: 340 x 2 = 680 u round where it stood. A
                // pilot 420-600 u out -- past the row's bare 340, inside the doubled ring -- takes the
                // whole 33.5, placed round the centre the ring was drawn on once it is drawn.
                var hbWave = boss.S("wave");
                var hbRingBad = new List<string>();
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                {
                    boss.Position = hbHome;
                    me2.Position = boss.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(900f, 1100f); me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    double hbW0 = me2.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:wave");
                    int hbWf = hbWave.Fired;
                    hbWave.Due = 0.01;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 && hbWave.At == Boss.Phase.Idle; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    hbWave.Due = 999;
                    float hbOut = Vary(420f, 600f);
                    var hbAt = hbWave.To + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * hbOut;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && hbWave.At != Boss.Phase.Idle; i++) { me2.Position = hbAt; me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                    double hbWHit = me2.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:wave") - hbW0;
                    if (hbWave.Fired != hbWf + 1 || hbWave.At != Boss.Phase.Idle || Math.Abs(hbWHit - 33.5) > 1e-6)
                        hbRingBad.Add($"{hbOut:0} u out: {hbWHit:0.0}");
                }
                Check(hbSmall && hbRingBad.Count == 0 && Math.Abs(hbWave.M.Reach * boss.Type.Size - 680f) < 0.01f,
                      $"its shockwave hits as far as its ring is drawn: at three bearings, a pilot 420-600 u from the centre (past the row's 340, inside the doubled 680) takes the whole 33.5{(hbRingBad.Count > 0 ? " -- " + string.Join("; ", hbRingBad) : "")}");

                // A RAM LANDS ONCE A PASS: a pilot held still in its lane, 360 to 480 u down it from
                // the centre, is reached by the nose within the first 0.1 s of the dash (it starts 0-120 u
                // ahead of it), and the dash ends with the hull
                // still over it (its tail stops 540 u down the lane), so it covers the pilot for the
                // rest of the 0.75 s dash, longer than the 0.52 s a source is blocked for -- and the
                // pilot takes the row's 29.8 once, not twice.
                // The spot is taken off the lane once the lane is drawn, not before the wait.
                var hbRam = boss.S("ram");
                var hbRamBad = new List<string>();
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                {
                    boss.Position = hbHome;
                    me2.Position = boss.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(700f, 1000f); me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    double hbR0 = me2.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:charge");
                    hbRam.Due = 0.01;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 && hbRam.At == Boss.Phase.Idle; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                    hbRam.Due = 999;
                    float hbAlong = Vary(360f, 480f);
                    var hbSpot = boss.Position + (hbRam.To - boss.Position).Normalized() * hbAlong;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 4 && hbRam.At != Boss.Phase.Idle; i++) { me2.Position = hbSpot; me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
                    double hbRHit = me2.DamageBySource.GetValueOrDefault("boss:charge") - hbR0;
                    if (hbRam.At != Boss.Phase.Idle || Math.Abs(hbRHit - 29.8) > 1e-6)
                        hbRamBad.Add($"{hbAlong:0} u down the lane: {hbRHit:0.0}");
                }
                Check(hbSmall && hbRamBad.Count == 0,
                      $"a pilot held still in the ram's lane, at three spots 360-480 u down it, takes the row's 29.8 once a pass, though the doubled hull is over it for the rest of the 0.75 s dash{(hbRamBad.Count > 0 ? " -- " + string.Join("; ", hbRamBad) : "")}");

                // IT CLOSES TO ITS HOLD-OFF OFF THE NOSE: 470 u, so its centre stops 470 + 360 = 830 u
                // from the pilot. From three bearings, 1.3-1.8 times that out, it closes and stops there.
                float hbStop = boss.Type.HoldOff + hbHalf;
                var hbCloseBad = new List<string>();
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
                {
                    boss.Position = hbHome;
                    var hbP = boss.Position + Vector2.Up.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * (Vary(1.3f, 1.8f) * hbStop);
                    int hbStill = 0; var hbWas = boss.Position;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 30 && hbStill < 10; i++)
                    {
                        me2.Position = hbP; me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
                        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
                        hbStill = boss.Position.DistanceTo(hbWas) < 1e-4f ? hbStill + 1 : 0; hbWas = boss.Position;
                    }
                    float hbGap = boss.Position.DistanceTo(hbP);
                    if (hbStill < 10 || Math.Abs(hbGap - hbStop) > 2f) hbCloseBad.Add($"stopped {hbGap:0.0} u off (still {hbStill} frames)");
                }
                Check(hbCloseBad.Count == 0 && Math.Abs(hbStop - 830f) < 0.01f,
                      $"it closes on the pilot and stops with its centre {hbStop:0} u off -- its nose the row's 470 u hold-off away -- from three bearings{(hbCloseBad.Count > 0 ? " -- " + string.Join("; ", hbCloseBad) : "")}");

                foreach (var hbMv in boss.Type.Moves) boss.S(hbMv.Id).Due = hbHeld[hbMv.Id];
                Fx.ClearWarnings();
                boss.Position = hbHome; boss.Rotation = hbHomeRot;
                me2.Position = boss.Position + new Vector2(0, 500); me2.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            }
            // the kill: shared EXP for it and the mission, the bounty's credits, then home
            Character.Exp = 0; Character.Level = 1; Character.BossCleared.Clear(); Character.Points = 0; Character.BossCleared.Clear();
            // (hints off meanwhile: a card starting mid-way would move the batched save these checks time)
            Character.HintsOff = true;
            Raids.Held = false;                                  // the clock free again for every arena after this one
            // clear of where the crates will fall, with adds out (they must go with it)
            Me.Position = boss.Position + new Vector2(0, 1500); Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) H.SpawnRaider(Me.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(900f, 1200f));
            await Wait(0.1);
            int escortsOut = H.Raiders.Count;
            int HoldOnDisk() { var c = new ConfigFile(); if (c.Load($"{Character.Dir}/{Character.Id}.cfg") != Error.Ok || !c.HasSection("gear_hold")) return 0;
                               return c.GetSectionKeys("gear_hold").Sum(k => (int)c.GetValue("gear_hold", k, 0)); }
            int UnclaimedOnDisk() => ((string)OnDisk("loot", "unclaimed", "")).Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Length;
            int hold0 = Character.GearHold.Values.Sum(), disk0 = HoldOnDisk();
            var bossAt = boss.Position;
            // killed mid-wind-up, a lane on its hull and a zone on the ground: its warnings go with
            // it. Raised here rather than by any boss move, because what is being proved is the
            // WARNING -- the raise's anchor puts the lane on the hull and leaves the zone on the
            // ground, and a boss that is down clears both (Fx.ClearWarnings).
            Fx.Warn(new FxRaise { Id = Fx.WarnLane, At = new Vector2(0, -100), To = new Vector2(0, -3000), Size = 70f, Time = 10.0, Anchor = boss.NetId });
            Fx.Warn(new FxRaise { Id = Fx.WarnZone, At = boss.Position + new Vector2(0, 600), To = boss.Position + new Vector2(0, 600), Size = 300f, Time = 10.0 });
            var warnings = Nodes<FxNode>().Where(t => t.Warn && t.Time == 10.0).ToList();
            bool ridesHull = warnings.Count(t => t.GetParent() == boss) == 1 && warnings.Count(t => t.GetParent() == H) == 1;
            // ...and a SEEKER of its own in the air at the pilot, from a seeded side 600-900 u out --
            // 0.6 s at 135 u/s closes 81 u of that, so nothing it could reach is what ends it
            var winFrom = Me.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(600f, 900f);
            var winSeeker = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, winFrom, Me.Position - winFrom, 135f, 1920f, 1, targetId: Me.NetId, turnRate: 1.4f);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool winUp = winSeeker != null && winSeeker.Alive && Combat.Hostiles.Contains(winSeeker);
            int winDown0 = Shot.Intercepted;
            boss.TakeDamage(boss.Hp + 1); await Wait(0.2);
            Check(warnings.Count == 2 && ridesHull && warnings.All(t => !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(t)),
                  $"a warning goes where its raise anchors it -- one on the hull, one on the ground -- and a boss killed mid-wind-up takes both with it: no beam charging over a DEFEATED boss ({warnings.Count(t => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(t))} of {warnings.Count} left)");
            await Wait(0.4);
            Check(winUp && !winSeeker.Alive && !Combat.Hostiles.Contains(winSeeker) && Shot.Intercepted == winDown0,
                  $"a boss's seeker in the air at the kill goes with it: 0.6 s on it is down and out of the hostiles, and counted as nothing shot down (up {winUp}, alive {winSeeker?.Alive}, {Shot.Intercepted - winDown0} counted)");
            var dropped = H.Crates.ToList();
            Check(dropped.Count == 2 && Character.Unclaimed.Count == 2 && UnclaimedOnDisk() == 2
                  && dropped.All(c => c.Position.DistanceTo(bossAt) < 300 && Equipment.ById(c.Item) is { Kit: false, Tier: <= 2 }),
                  $"a level-1 boss drops this pilot 2 crates of T1 or T2 where it died, on disk at once ({dropped.Count} crates, {UnclaimedOnDisk()} on disk)");
            Check(escortsOut >= 2 && H.Raiders.Count == 0 && H.Squads.Count == 0 && H.Posts.Held == 0,
                  $"the fight's adds go with the boss ({escortsOut} out, {H.Raiders.Count} left, {H.Squads.Count} squads, {H.Posts.Held} posts)");
            me2.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", lancerReach);                    // the fight is over: point defence back
            // NO CLOCK any more: the failure timer is not armed on a win, and a RETURN button appears
            double solEndT = (double)typeof(Hub).GetField("_arenaEndT", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(H);
            Check(solEndT < 0 && H.MissionWon && !H.IReturned && H.ReturnTotal == 1 && Nodes<ReturnButton>().Any(),
                  $"after the kill: a RETURN button and no clock sending you home (_arenaEndT {solEndT:0.0}, ready {H.ReturnReady}/{H.ReturnTotal})");
            Priv(H, "ReceiveLoot", new[] { "no_such_part", "std_drive", "aegis_array_t1", "aegis_array_t2", "aegis_array_t3" }, bossAt + new Vector2(0, 400), 1);
            Check(H.Crates.Count == 4 && H.Crates.Skip(2).Select(c => c.Item).SequenceEqual(new[] { "aegis_array_t1", "aegis_array_t2" }),
                  $"a drop off the wire: no unknown part, no kit, and no more than a boss gives -- 2 at level 1 ({string.Join(",", H.Crates.Skip(2).Select(c => c.Item))})");
            // FLY OVER A CRATE: in the hold at once; on disk 2.5 s after the LAST pickup
            var crA = H.Crates[0]; var crB = H.Crates[1];
            Me.Position = crA.Position - Vector2.Right.Rotated(Me.Rotation) * (Me.MyArt.HalfWidth + 38f); Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            await Wait(0.5);
            bool besideLeft = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crA) && Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() == hold0;
            Check(besideLeft, "a ship beside a crate, not over it, leaves it where it lies");
            Me.Position = crA.Position; Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crA); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            bool tookA = !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crA) && Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() == hold0 + 1;
            await Wait(1.5);
            Me.Position = crB.Position; Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crB); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            await Wait(1.5); int diskMid = HoldOnDisk();
            await Wait(1.3); int diskAfter = HoldOnDisk();
            Check(tookA && diskMid == disk0 && diskAfter == disk0 + 2 && UnclaimedOnDisk() == 2,
                  $"flying over a crate takes it into the hold at once; the file follows 2.5 s after the LAST pickup ({disk0}: {diskMid} 1.5 s after the second, {diskAfter} at 2.8 s)");
            // IN STASIS, THE POD COLLECTS: near is not enough -- it has to fly over the crate
            var crC = H.Crates[0]; var cAt = crC.Position;
            Me.TakeDamage(Me.Hp + 1); await Wait(0.3);
            var pod = (EscapePod)typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_pod", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(Me);
            Me.Position = cAt + new Vector2(0, 900);
            pod.Position = cAt + new Vector2(60, 0); pod.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; await Wait(1.0);
            bool stillThere = GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crC) && crC.Position == cAt;
            pod.Position = cAt; pod.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
            for (int i = 0; i < 30 && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crC); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(!Me.Alive && stillThere && !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crC),
                  $"a pilot in stasis collects with its escape pod: 60 u off leaves the crate where it lies, flying over it takes it");
            Check(Hub.InArena, "five seconds and more after the kill, the party is still in the arena");
            var crD = H.Crates[0];
            Check(H.MissionWon && Character.Level == 1 && Character.Exp == 650, $"the kill of a level-1 boss pays a level-1 pilot 300 + 250 first clear + 100 = 650 (exp {Character.Exp})");
            var onKill = new ConfigFile(); onKill.Load($"{Character.Dir}/{Character.Id}.cfg");
            Check(Math.Abs((double)onKill.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0) - (424242 + 2000)) < 1e-6,
                  $"the bounty is on disk at the kill, not on the trip home: a quit out there kept the EXP and lost the credits ({(double)onKill.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0):0})");
            // no clock: RETURN takes you home; solo, the one present pilot is enough
            H.SetMyReturn(true);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && Hub.InArena; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            await Wait(1.0);
            Check(!Hub.InArena && H.Yard != null, "pressing RETURN takes the pilot home (solo: no one else to wait for)");
            // the crate left lying came home too -- into the hold -- and its node stayed behind
            Check(!GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(crD) && Count<LootCrate>() == 0 && Character.Unclaimed.Count == 0 && Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() == hold0 + 4,

                              $"the throw leaves nothing in the gun's reach: at three bearings its nose lands {twThrow.M.Standoff:0} u off a pilot held still, more than 150 u outside the gun's {twReach:0} u from the centre, and the gun fires no shell at it for 2 s{(twBad.Count > 0 ? " -- " + string.Join("; ", twBad) : "")}");
                    }
                }
            }
            // EVERY BOSS SPECIAL HAS ITS OWN SOUND, heard as it happens: the Lancer's beam (its charge, and
            // the growl as it fires), ram, shockwave and trident, fought above; the Drake's gun, warp, scrap
            // blast, tractor, throw and the rock breaking, here
            {
                var bossSounds = new[] { "boss_beam_charge", "boss_beam", "boss_ram", "boss_shockwave", "boss_trident",
                                         "drake_gun", "drake_warp", "drake_scrap", "drake_tractor", "drake_throw", "drake_rock" };
                var unheard = bossSounds.Where(n => Assets.Load<AudioStream>($"res://sfx/{n}.wav") == null || Sfx.Played.GetValueOrDefault(n) == 0).ToList();
                Check(unheard.Count == 0, $"every boss special has its own sound, and each was heard in its fight (unheard: {string.Join(", ", unheard)})");
            }
            // A PILOT IN STASIS RE-BOARDS AT 24 S (the owner's ruling), and while a partner is still
            // flying the mission goes on without it. The partner is a second ship in the party, made by
            // the one door a guest's ship comes through (Hub.SpawnFor), parked far off the boss with a
            // hull nothing here can empty. Timed off this ship's own clock, a frame at a time: not
            // ready on any frame short of 24 s, ready on the first frame at it, F refused at 20 s.
            {
                const int stPeer = 77;
                Priv(H, "SpawnFor", stPeer);
                var stPartner = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.OwnerId == stPeer);
                var stPartnerAt = (H.Boss?.Position ?? Hub.ArenaCentre) + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(2600f, 3200f);
                if (stPartner != null)
                {
                    stPartner.MaxHp = 1e7; stPartner.TakeDamage(-(1e7 - stPartner.Hp));
                    stPartner.Position = stPartnerAt;
                    typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_netPos", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(stPartner, stPartnerAt);
                }
                await Wait(0.2);
                var stShip = Me; var stEndT = typeof(Hub).GetField("_arenaEndT", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                stShip.TakeDamage(stShip.Hp + 1);
                double stDiedAt = stShip.Clock, stWaiting = -1, stReadyAt = -1;
                bool stRefused = false, stPressed = false, stFought = true;
                while (stReadyAt < 0 && stShip.Clock - stDiedAt < 26)
                {
