            Check(!Net.IsOnline && !Hub.InArena && Net.I.Reconnecting, "arena guest: dropped mid-arena, home to its own world, trying to get back in");
            await RealTime(() => Hub.InArena && Net.IsOnline && Net.LocalId != 1, 12);
            Check(Hub.InArena && Net.IsOnline && Net.LocalId != agOldId, "arena guest: back in under a new id -- into the arena, where the party is");
            Check(Session.RejoinFor(Net.I.HostName).Length == 32, $"arena guest: it came back holding the rejoin token its host issued ({Session.RejoinFor(Net.I.HostName).Length} characters for {Net.I.HostName}; P10b)");
            await RealTime(() => Me != null && Me.Position.DistanceTo(new Vector2(900, 300)) < 50, 5);
            Check(Me != null && Me.Position.DistanceTo(new Vector2(900, 300)) < 50,
                  $"arena guest: put back where it was when it dropped ({Me?.Position.DistanceTo(new Vector2(900, 300)):0} u off; at {Me?.Position})");
            // the boss died while it was away: it helped win it, so it is paid on its return -- its EXP
            // (the level-2 Drake at pilot level 3 -- the siege's 1000 took it from 2 with 500 to 3 with
            // 500 -- is 200, +250 its first clear of level 2, +100 = 550 on its 500: 1050, a level and 50
            // over -- level 4) and both its parts (straight to the hold if they reach it at home, else as
            // crates)
            await RealTime(() => Character.Level == 4 && Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() + Character.Unclaimed.Count == agHold1 + 2, 6);
            Check(Character.Level == 4 && Character.Exp == 50 && Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() + Character.Unclaimed.Count == agHold1 + 2,
                  $"arena guest: the kill made while it was away is paid on its return: its EXP and its 2 parts (level {Character.Level}, exp {Character.Exp}; {Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() + Character.Unclaimed.Count - agHold1} parts)");
            await RealTime(() => H.MissionWon && H.Boss != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(H.Boss) && H.Boss.Hp == 0, 5);
            Check(H.MissionWon && H.Boss != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(H.Boss) && H.Boss.Hp == 0, "arena guest: back in an arena already won -- the boss reads zero");
            // A STALL IS NOT A DROP, both ways. This world freezes for 6 s (the host must keep this pilot
            // through it) and parks at stallDone to say it is over; then the HOST's world freezes for 6 s,
            // and this pilot must keep the host through that (Link.QuietMs): the old transport gave a silent peer up after 4 s.
            await Wait(1.0);
            OS.DelayMsec(6000);
            // The next frame carries the whole 6 s as its step, and a remote ship ages by its step: the
            // host's would read 6 s quiet here with the host never quiet at all. So listen only from
            // the host's first report after that frame.
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            await RealTime(() => H?.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.OwnerId == 1) is { } h0 && Quiet(h0) < 0.5, 3);
            int idThroughStall = Net.LocalId; bool keptHost = true; float hostQuiet = 0;
            var hostWatch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
            {
                if (!Net.IsOnline) return false;
                if (Net.LocalId != idThroughStall) keptHost = false;
                if (H?.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.OwnerId == 1) is { } h1) hostQuiet = Math.Max(hostQuiet, Quiet(h1));
                return false;
            } };
            AddChild(hostWatch);
            if (Me != null) { Me.AutopilotTo = null; Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; Me.Position = stallDone; }
            // THE HOST VANISHES (no goodbye) once its stall is over: 3 tries over about 20 s, then RECONNECT
            await RealTime(() => !Net.IsOnline, Wan ? 40 : 20);
            hostWatch.QueueFree();
            Check(hostQuiet >= 5 && keptHost,
                  $"arena guest: the host's world stalled and this pilot heard nothing from it for {hostQuiet:0.0} s (at least 5), and kept it -- the same session, not dropped");
            ulong vanished = Time.GetTicksMsec();
            var tries = new List<double>(); bool wasTrying = false; PlayerShip homeShip = null;
            while (!Net.I.CanReconnect && Time.GetTicksMsec() - vanished < 25000)
            {
                double since = (Time.GetTicksMsec() - vanished) / 1000.0;
                if (Net.I.Connecting && !wasTrying) tries.Add(since);
                wasTrying = Net.I.Connecting;
                if (homeShip == null && since > 1.0 && H != null && H.Yard != null && H.IsNodeReady()) homeShip = Me;
                await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            }
            double toButton = (Time.GetTicksMsec() - vanished) / 1000.0;
            Check(Net.I.CanReconnect && Net.I.Attempt == 3 && tries.Count == 3 && Math.Abs(tries[0] - 2) < 0.3 && Math.Abs(tries[1] - 8) < 0.3 && Math.Abs(tries[2] - 14) < 0.3
                  && Math.Abs(toButton - 19) < 0.7 && !Net.IsOnline,
                  $"arena guest: a vanished host is tried at 2, 8 and 14 s, 5 s each, then RECONNECT is offered at 19 s ({string.Join(", ", tries.Select(t => t.ToString("0.0")))}; {toButton:0.0} s)");
            Check(homeShip != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(homeShip) && Me == homeShip, "arena guest: the failed tries left its own world and ship alone");
            await Wait(1.0);
            // its own base, plus its shares of three clears with two pilots -- the level-1 bounty,
            // 2000 x 1.5 / 2 = 1500; the level-1 siege, the same 1500; the level-2 bounty at the level's
            // scale, 1500 x Par.HullScale(2) = 1646.4 -- the last made while it was away, but split two
            // ways all the same. (Par's scale is proved against its literals once, in CurveParChecks.)
            double want = 12345 + 1500 + 1500 + 1500 * Par.HullScale(2);
            Check(!Hub.InArena && !Net.IsOnline && H.Yard != null && Math.Abs(H.Yard.Credits - want) < 1e-6,
                  $"arena guest: the host gone mid-arena, home offline with its own base and its bounty share ({H.Yard?.Credits:0} of {want:0})");
            // ...AND IT IS ON DISK, in THIS peer's own file. It used to read the host's: every
            // process shares one user:// and only solo made a character, so host and guest wrote
            // the same file and the loser's numbers were simply gone. Each role makes its own now,
            // which is what makes this assertable at all.
            var guestFile = new ConfigFile();
            Check(guestFile.Load($"{Character.Dir}/{Character.Id}.cfg") == Error.Ok
                  && (string)guestFile.GetValue("id", "name", "") == "Arena Guest"
                  && Math.Abs((double)guestFile.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0) - want) < 1e-6,
                  $"arena guest: its own base reached its OWN file ({(string)guestFile.GetValue("id", "name", "?")}, {(double)guestFile.GetValue("base", "credits", -1.0):0} of {want:0})");
            int agDisk2 = guestFile.HasSection("gear_hold") ? guestFile.GetSectionKeys("gear_hold").Sum(k => (int)guestFile.GetValue("gear_hold", k, 0)) : 0;
            Check(agDisk2 == agHold1 + 2 && (int)guestFile.GetValue("progress", "level", 0) == 4 && (int)guestFile.GetValue("progress", "exp", -1) == 50,
                  $"arena guest: the kill paid on its return is on its own file: its EXP, both parts in the hold ({agDisk2 - agHold1} of 2, exp {(int)guestFile.GetValue("progress", "exp", 0)})");
            // PRESSING RECONNECT: a try (5 s: the host was here a moment ago, or it is gone), and when
            // that fails too, the button again
            var rcSm = Nodes<SessionMenu>().First(); var rcB = Nodes<Button>(rcSm).First(b => b.Name == "Reconnect");
            bool offered = rcB.IsVisibleInTree() && !rcB.Disabled;
            rcB.EmitSignal(BaseButton.SignalName.Pressed); await Wait(0.2);
            bool trying = Net.I.Connecting && !rcB.Visible;
            ulong pressedAt = Time.GetTicksMsec();
            await RealTime(() => Net.I.CanReconnect, 9);
            double tryFor = (Time.GetTicksMsec() - pressedAt) / 1000.0 + 0.2;
            await Wait(0.1);
            Check(offered && trying && Net.I.CanReconnect && rcB.IsVisibleInTree() && !Net.IsOnline && Math.Abs(tryFor - 5) < 0.6 && Net.I.LastStatus.Contains("RECONNECT to try again"),
                  $"arena guest: RECONNECT pressed tries once more, for 5 s, and fails back to the button ({offered}, {trying}, {tryFor:0.0} s; {Net.I.LastStatus})");
            Check(joinWatch.Frames > 0 && joinWatch.Online == 0 && joinWatch.Hosting == 0,
                  $"arena guest: through every frame of every join and try it is not online, and its panel does not read hosting, until the host has let it in ({joinWatch.Frames} frames joining; online on {joinWatch.Online}, 'hosting' on {joinWatch.Hosting})");
            joinWatch.QueueFree();
        }
    }

    // WHAT A GUEST IS SHOWN. Both of these were host-only state read by drawing code, so on a
    // guest they were simply wrong -- and nothing said so, because the solo run is the host.
    // ── LANE G (raids v2) ON THE WIRE (N18), the host's half: the level-1 arena's squad wave 1 is up
    // (two webifiers, paying 6 each); once the guest has watched the super bar, a lone webifier webs
    // the GUEST, the beam is made due and must charge on that web (the guest is its nearest pilot:
    // this host stands off), and one of the paying adds is shot down -- the guest is paid by
    // NetKillExp at its own level. First, a gank squad of its own burns onto the guest and latches, for
    // the guest's HUD line. The guest's half (RaidsGuestAddsWire) reads all of it off the wire.
    async Task RaidsHostAddsWire(PlayerShip guest)
    {
        var boss = H.Boss;
        if (guest == null || boss == null) { Check(false, "arena host: no guest or no boss for the adds on the wire"); return; }
        await Wait(3.0);                                           // the guest's super-bar watch is over first
        var paying = H.Raiders.Where(r => r.Worth > 0).ToList();
        boss.S("beam").At = Boss.Phase.Idle; boss.S("beam").Due = 999;   // a beam of its own clock's, stood down
        Me.Position = boss.Position + (Me.Position - boss.Position).Normalized() * 3600f; Me.Velocity = Vector2.Zero;
        // THE GANK LINE ON THE WIRE (§1e): a gank squad -- a gunship and three webifiers -- formed at a
        // seeded bearing inside its commit range of the GUEST (0.55-0.8 of the webifiers' 1600 u) burns
        // onto it and latches; the guest's half reads its HUD line off the packet alone. The beam is
        // stood down, so these webs start nothing; the guest's point defence is out of reach for the
        // while (the SQUAD on trial, test only); the squad is shot down and the web let go before the
        // lone web below
        double guestPd = PdReachOff(guest);
        var gankKinds = new[] { Enemies.Gunship, Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Webifier, Enemies.Webifier };
        float gankFrom = Squads.CommitOf(gankKinds.Select(Enemies.Of)) * Vary(0.55f, 0.8f);
        var gankAt = guest.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * gankFrom;
        float gankFace = Aim.Face(gankAt, guest.Position);
        var gank = H.FormSquad(Squads.Gank, gankAt, gankFace);
        gank.Quarry = guest;
        var ganks = gankKinds.Select((k, i) => H.SpawnRaider(gankAt + new Vector2(70f * (i - 1.5f), 40f * (i % 2)).Rotated(gankFace), k, gank)).ToList();
        bool GankUp() => ganks.All(r => r != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r) && r.Alive);
        await RealTime(() => !GankUp() || ganks.All(r => r.Latched), 6);
        bool gankHeld = GankUp() && ganks.All(r => r.Latched && ReferenceEquals(r.Target, guest));
        await Wait(0.6);                                           // the guest sees every member hold its line
        Check(gankHeld, $"arena host: a gank squad (gunship + 3 webifiers, formed {gankFrom:0} u out) commits on the guest and every member latches ({ganks.Count(r => r != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r) && r.Latched)} of 4)");
        foreach (var r in ganks) if (r != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r)) r.TakeDamage(9999);
        guest.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", guestPd);
        await RealTime(() => !guest.Pinned, 2);
        var web = H.SpawnRaider(guest.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(220f, 360f));
        await RealTime(() => guest.Pinned, 6);
        bool pinned = guest.Pinned;
        boss.S("beam").Due = 0.01;
        await RealTime(() => boss.S("beam").At == Boss.Phase.Winding, 3);
        Check(pinned && boss.S("beam").At == Boss.Phase.Winding && boss.S("beam").Cause == "pinned" && ReferenceEquals(boss.S("beam").Target, guest)
              && paying.Count == 2 && paying.All(r => r.Worth == 6 && ((r.NetFlags >> 8) & 0xFFFF) == paying[0].Squad.Id),
              $"arena host: an add's web on the GUEST starts the beam ({boss.S("beam").Cause}, aimed at the guest {ReferenceEquals(boss.S("beam").Target, guest)}); squad wave 1 is two paying webifiers ({paying.Count})");
        // THE LIVE FLOOR ON THE WIRE: four more webs latch on the guest in the wind-up, so what is
        // left is stretched to their floor and the lane is raised again -- on the guest it must
        // REPLACE the lane it had (Hub.AddFx), not stand beside it and strike at the old end
        double leftAtWeb = boss.WindupLeft("beam");
        var more = Enumerable.Range(0, 4).Select(_ => H.SpawnRaider(guest.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(200f, 320f))).ToList();
        await RealTime(() => more.All(r => r.Latched) || boss.S("beam").At != Boss.Phase.Winding, 5);
        await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double stretched = boss.WindupLeft("beam");
        var hostLanes = Nodes<FxNode>(boss).Where(t => t.Id == Fx.WarnLane && Math.Abs(t.Radius - 70f) < 0.1f && !t.IsQueuedForDeletion()).ToList();
        Check(more.All(r => r.Latched) && boss.S("beam").At == Boss.Phase.Winding && stretched > leftAtWeb + 0.5
              && hostLanes.Count == 1 && Math.Abs(hostLanes[0].Time - hostLanes[0].Elapsed - stretched) < 0.1,
              $"arena host: four more webs latching on the guest stretch the wind-up ({leftAtWeb:0.00} s at the first web -> {stretched:0.00} s left), and the host holds one lane for it ({hostLanes.Count}) ending at the stretched time");
        await Wait(1.0);                                           // the guest sees the lane while it is webbed
        if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(web)) web.TakeDamage(9999);
        foreach (var r in more) if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r)) r.TakeDamage(9999);
        var one = paying.FirstOrDefault(r => GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(r) && r.Alive);
        one?.TakeDamage(1e9);
        await Wait(1.0);
    }

    // ...and the guest's half: the squad's id bits and its one lead, the GANK line while the host's gank
    // squad burns at this ship and none once it holds, this ship webbed by an add while
    // the beam's lane is up at it, the lane REPLACED when the host stretches the wind-up (one lane,
    // ending later, and no strike heard before its end), and the add's kill paid here at this
    // pilot's own level
    async Task RaidsGuestAddsWire()
    {
        int lv0 = Character.Level, exp0 = Character.Exp;
        bool squadSeen = false, beamOnWeb = false, labelOk = false, namesSeen = false; int gained = 0;
        // the beam's lanes on this peer: the first seen while webbed, the one that replaced it, the
        // most standing at once after the replacement, and strikes heard before the live lane's end
        FxNode firstLane = null, lastLane = null; double clock = 0, firstEnd = 0, lastEnd = 0;
        int mostAfter = 0, earlyStrikes = 0; string strike = null; int struck0 = 0;
        List<FxNode> BeamLanes() => H.Boss == null ? new List<FxNode>()
            : Nodes<FxNode>(H.Boss).Where(t => t.Id == Fx.WarnLane && Math.Abs(t.Radius - 70f) < 0.1f && !t.IsQueuedForDeletion()).ToList();
        void Watch()
        {
            var lanes = BeamLanes();
            if (firstLane == null && Me != null && Me.Pinned && lanes.Count > 0)
            {
                firstLane = lanes[0]; firstEnd = clock + firstLane.Time - firstLane.Elapsed;
                strike = firstLane.Strike; struck0 = strike == null ? 0 : Sfx.Played.GetValueOrDefault(strike);
            }
            if (firstLane == null) return;
            var fresh = lanes.FirstOrDefault(t => t != firstLane && t != lastLane);
            if (fresh != null) { lastLane = fresh; lastEnd = clock + fresh.Time - fresh.Elapsed; }
            if (lastLane == null) return;
            mostAfter = Math.Max(mostAfter, lanes.Count);
            if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(lastLane) && clock < lastEnd - 0.05 && strike != null
                && Sfx.Played.GetValueOrDefault(strike) > struck0) earlyStrikes = Sfx.Played.GetValueOrDefault(strike) - struck0;
        }
        // THE GANK LINE here, from the packet alone (FlagLock, the line's end, this ship as its victim):
        // on every frame the host's gank squad -- the one group of four with a heavy -- has a member
        // burning, this ship's HUD line names its crew; once every member holds a line, none. A frame
        // another squad is also burning at this ship is not read (the line names one squad)
        const string GankWant = "GANK: GUNSHIP + 3 WEBIFIER";
        int gankFrames = 0; string gankWrong = null, gankHeld = "unread";
        void WatchGank()
        {
            var me = Me;
            if (me == null || gankHeld != "unread") return;
            var groups = SquadSight.Groups(H.Raiders);
            var gank = groups.FirstOrDefault(g => g.Count == 4 && g.Any(r => (r.Tags & Tag.Heavy) != 0));
            if (gank == null || groups.Any(g => g != gank && g.Any(r => r.Locking && ReferenceEquals(SquadSight.Victim(r, H.Ships), me)))) return;
            if (gank.Any(r => r.Locking))
            {
                gankFrames++;
                var line = SquadSight.GankLine(H.Raiders, H.Ships, me);
                if (line != GankWant) gankWrong ??= line ?? "none";
            }
            else if (gankFrames > 0 && gank.All(r => r.TetherTo != null)) gankHeld = SquadSight.GankLine(H.Raiders, H.Ships, me);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 22 && !H.MissionWon && gained == 0; i++)
        {
            WatchGank();
            var two = H.Raiders.Where(r => r.SquadId != 0).GroupBy(r => r.SquadId).FirstOrDefault(g => g.Count() == 2);
            squadSeen |= two != null && two.Count(r => r.Leads) == 1;
            labelOk |= two != null && SquadSight.Label(two.ToList()) == "2" && SquadSight.Groups(H.Raiders).Any(g => g.Count == 2);
            namesSeen |= two != null && two.Any(r => r.NameLeft > 0);
            beamOnWeb |= Me != null && Me.Pinned && Nodes<FxNode>().Any(t => t.Id == Fx.WarnLane && Math.Abs(t.Radius - 70f) < 0.1f);
            if (!H.MissionWon && (Character.Level != lv0 || Character.Exp != exp0)) gained = Character.Exp - exp0 + 1000 * (Character.Level - lv0);
            Watch();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
        }
        // the stretched lane is watched out to its end (or until the fight is won and it is cleared)
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 10 && !H.MissionWon && lastLane != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(lastLane) && clock < lastEnd + 0.2; i++)
        {
            Watch();
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); clock += GetProcessDeltaTime();
        }
        Check(squadSeen, "arena guest: the adds' squad arrives on the wire as one -- both members under one squad id, exactly one of them its lead");
        Check(labelOk && namesSeen, $"arena guest: drawn from the packet alone, the squad reads as one on the radar (label '2': {labelOk}) and its rows are named under their hulls ({namesSeen})");
        Check(gankFrames > 0 && gankWrong == null && gankHeld == null,
              $"arena guest: the host's gank squad burning at this ship reads '{GankWant}' on its HUD line from the packet alone ({gankFrames} burn frames{(gankWrong == null ? "" : $", one read '{gankWrong}'")}); once every member holds its line, none ('{gankHeld}')");
        Check(beamOnWeb, "arena guest: webbed by an add, this ship sees the beam's lane go up at it (the host charged on an add's web)");
        Check(firstLane != null && lastLane != null && mostAfter == 1 && lastEnd > firstEnd + 0.5 && earlyStrikes == 0,
              $"arena guest: the host's stretched wind-up REPLACES this peer's lane -- one Radius-70 lane standing ({mostAfter}), ending at the stretched time ({firstEnd:0.00} -> {lastEnd:0.00} s), no strike heard before it ({earlyStrikes})");
        Check(gained == Missions.ExpFor(6, 1, lv0),
              $"arena guest: an add shot down on the host pays this pilot at its own level, by NetKillExp ({gained} EXP; {Missions.ExpFor(6, 1, lv0)} due at level {lv0})");
    }

    async Task GuestSeesTheFight()
    {
        Boss boss = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 2 && boss == null; i++)
        {   // InArena goes true before the boss node exists on this peer
            boss = H?.Boss;
            await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        }
        Check(boss != null && !Net.Sim, "arena guest: the boss is here, and this peer is not the host");
        if (boss == null) return;

        // THE SUPER-MOVE BAR. _beam and _charge only tick under Net.Sim, so a guest's bar sat at
        // zero for the whole fight. Watched over time rather than sampled once: the failure was a
        // value that never moved, and a single reading cannot tell a stopped clock from a slow one.
        // Sampled only once a figure has actually ARRIVED. Before the first packet a guest's
        // countdown is -1, which reads as 0 s left, and a first sample of 0 makes "it went down"
        // impossible to tell from "it has not started".
        for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && boss.NextSuperIn <= 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
        double firstFill = boss.SuperFill, firstLeft = boss.NextSuperIn;
        Check(firstLeft > 0, $"arena guest: the host's super-move countdown arrives at all ({firstLeft:0.0} s)");
        await Wait(1.5);
        Check(boss.NextSuperIn > 0 && boss.NextSuperIn < firstLeft - 0.5 && boss.SuperFill > firstFill,
              $"arena guest: the boss's super-move bar runs ({firstLeft:0.0} -> {boss.NextSuperIn:0.0} s, fill {firstFill:0.00} -> {boss.SuperFill:0.00})");
    }

    // ── A GUEST AGAINST ITS OWN WALLS (level_walls checks 13, 14, 16, 17), played by the third player: a
    // battleship at level 1 whose peak is 3. The host decides every press; this ship's slots show only
    // what the host's report says, so what they show here is the host's word. PEND walls until its class
    // carries an ability 2 and 3 (lane A, slice 6). Returns the game seconds it spent.
    async Task<double> GuestWalls()
    {
        var me = Me; var open = Unlocks.Nth(me.Class, 2); var shut = Unlocks.Nth(me.Class, 3);
        if (open == null || shut == null)
        {
            GD.Print($"PEND walls: the {me.Class} has no ability {(open == null ? 2 : 3)} yet (level_walls checks 13, 14 and 17: a guest's press past its own refusal, the peak on the wire)");
            return 0;
        }
        double t0 = me.Clock;
        // 13: ability 3 (level 6) sent past its own refusal, straight to the host: nothing comes back
        string before = Sn(me, shut.Id);
        Net.AskHost(me, "RequestAbility", shut.Id, 0, Vector2.Zero, System.Array.Empty<int>());
        await Wait(0.6);
        string after = Sn(me, shut.Id);
        Check(me.Peak == 3 && after == before,
              $"third player at peak 3: its {shut.Name} (ability 3, level 6) sent past its own refusal is refused by the host -- nothing comes back ({before} -> {after})");
        // 14 and 17: at level 1 with a peak of 3, ability 2 (level 3) acts -- the host reads the peak it was
        // sent, not the level
        string b2 = Sn(me, open.Id);
        me.UseAbility(open.Id, 0);
        double t1 = me.Clock; bool acted = false;
        while (me.Clock - t1 < 0.8 && !acted) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); acted = Sn(me, open.Id) != b2; }
        Check(Character.Level == 1 && acted && me.FailNote(open.Id) == null,
              $"third player at level 1, peak 3: its {open.Name} (ability 2, level 3) acts on the host and comes back -- the wall reads the peak on the wire, not the level ({b2} -> {Sn(me, open.Id)}; {me.FailNote(open.Id)})");
        return me.Clock - t0;
    }

    // 16: a level up and a press in the same frame. The identity (the new peak) and the request go on one
    // reliable channel, in that order, so the host has the peak before the press: ability 3 acts.
    async Task GuestLevelsAndPresses()
    {
        var me = Me; var a3 = me == null ? null : Unlocks.Nth(me.Class, 3);
        if (a3 == null) { GD.Print("PEND walls: no ability 3 to press in the frame its level opens it (level_walls check 16)"); return; }
        int peakBefore = me.Peak;
        string before = Sn(me, a3.Id);
        if (Character.Level < 6) Progression.AddExp((6 - Character.Level) * Progression.ExpToNext - Character.Exp);   // to level 6, exactly
        me.UseAbility(a3.Id, 0);
        double t0 = me.Clock; bool acted = false;
        while (me.Clock - t0 < 1.0 && !acted) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); acted = Sn(me, a3.Id) != before; }
        Check(peakBefore < 6 && Character.Peak == 6 && acted,
              $"third player: levelled from peak {peakBefore} to 6 and {a3.Name} (ability 3) pressed in the same frame -- the identity reaches the host first, so it acts ({before} -> {Sn(me, a3.Id)})");
    }

    // ── LANE E · WINGS ON THE WIRE (kits_v3 §3.1 rung 5; kits_v31 §3.2): the host sends a PATROL out on
    // the guest's carrier -- host-decided, as the Supercarrier's press will be -- and, once three of
    // them circle it, fires a seeker at that carrier from inside the ring, its point defence out of
    // reach so the patrol is on trial. Host side: the seeker is taken and downed before it lands,
    // credited "patrol". Then GUNSHIPS from the same carrier at a target the host sets down 1100-1800 u
    // off it: both on their circle, held there 3 s, sent home, the target left a second longer so the
    // guest measures them against it. Started once the guest's point-defence check has had its flashes (3 s).
    async Task WingsHostSortie(PlayerShip g)
    {
        await Wait(3.0);
        if (g == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(g)) { Check(false, "host: a patrol on the guest's carrier -- no guest ship"); return; }
        double pdWas = PdReachOff(g);
        try
        {
            int sent = g.Sortie(WingKind.Patrol);
            await RealTime(() => Nodes<Wing>().Count(w => w.Carrier == g && w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && w.FighterPhase == "Circle") >= 3, 12);
            var from = g.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(480f, 560f);
            double c0 = g.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol"); int down0 = Shot.Intercepted; double hull0 = g.Hp;
            var sk = Combat.Fire(Shots.Seeker, from, g.Position - from, 135f, 4000f, 25, targetId: g.NetId, turnRate: 2f);
            await RealTime(() => sk == null || !sk.Alive, 10);
            Check(sent == (int)g.Stats["fighter_count"] && sk != null && !sk.Alive && Shot.Intercepted > down0 && g.Hp >= hull0
                  && g.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") > c0,
                  $"host: a patrol of {sent} sent on the guest's carrier takes a seeker fired at it from {from.DistanceTo(g.Position):0} u and downs it before it lands, credited \"patrol\" ({g.DealtBy.GetValueOrDefault("patrol") - c0:0.0})");
            await Wait(1.0);                            // the MissileDown on its way to the guest
            // THE GUNSHIPS: a warp onto the circle and a warp out, their state code's row bringing them
            var gt = H.SpawnRaider(g.Position + Vector2.Right.Rotated(VaryAngle()) * Vary(1100f, 1800f), Enemies.Gunship);
            gt.Hp = 9000; gt.ApplyStatus(Status.Disabled, 60);
            await Wait(0.5);                            // the target reaches the guest before its gunships
            List<Wing> Gs() => Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == g && w.Kind == WingKind.Gunship && !w.Done).ToList();
            int guns = g.Sortie(WingKind.Gunship, gt);
            await RealTime(() => Gs().Count == 2 && Gs().All(w => w.OrbitPhase == "Orbit"), 5);
            bool onStation = Gs().Count == 2 && Gs().All(w => w.OrbitPhase == "Orbit");
            await Wait(3.0);
            foreach (var w in Gs()) w.SendOut(gt, g.Clock);
            await RealTime(() => g.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) == 0, 3);
            bool home = g.WingCount(WingKind.Gunship) == 0;
            await Wait(1.0);                            // the guest drops them while the target is still there
            Check(guns == 2 && onStation && home,
                  $"host: 2 gunships sent from the guest's carrier ({guns}) at a target {gt.Position.DistanceTo(g.Position):0} u off it, both on their circle ({onStation}), then warped out ({home})");
            gt.TakeDamage(1e12);
        }
        finally { g.Stats.SetBase("pd_range", pdWas); }
    }

    // ...and the guest's side, watched at the end of every frame from the moment it gives its
    // orders: its own carrier's patrol craft as the host's report brings them (added to its list by
    // their row in the state code, no new RPC), drawn and amber; the patrol and the fighters out
    // together, 2 x fighter_count (6 on a stock carrier; this guest's hangar flies more); and the
    // host's seeker at this carrier seen, then gone here too while still clear of the hull. Then the
    // host's two GUNSHIPS from this carrier: every frame one is drawn it is on its 240 u circle round
    // the target (the Waiting -> Orbit change is a warp here too, never eased across from the carrier).
    Func<Task> WingsGuestWatch(PlayerShip mine)
    {
        int patrolMost = 0, bothMost = 0; bool amber = true, gone = false; Shot seen = null; float lastD = -1f;
        int gunMost = 0; bool gunsGone = false; float gunLo = 9999f, gunHi = 0f;
        var livery = Wings.Of(WingKind.Patrol).Tint;
        var watch = new LateSampler { Probe = () =>
        {
            if (mine == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(mine)) return false;
            var mineW = Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == mine).ToList();
            var pat = mineW.Where(w => w.Kind == WingKind.Patrol && !w.Inside && w.Visible).ToList();
            patrolMost = Math.Max(patrolMost, pat.Count);
            bothMost = Math.Max(bothMost, pat.Count + mineW.Count(w => w.Kind == WingKind.Fighter && !w.Inside));
            foreach (var w in pat) amber &= Nodes<Sprite2D>(w).First().Modulate == livery;
            var guns = mineW.Where(w => w.Kind == WingKind.Gunship && !w.Inside && w.Visible).ToList();
            gunMost = Math.Max(gunMost, guns.Count);
            if (gunMost >= 2 && !mineW.Any(w => w.Kind == WingKind.Gunship)) gunsGone = true;
            foreach (var w in guns)
            {   // the target: the host's gunship-class raider nearest this craft (none here, a fail)
                var tg = Nodes<Raider>().Where(r => r.Alive && r.Kind == Enemies.Gunship).OrderBy(r => r.Position.DistanceTo(w.Position)).FirstOrDefault();
                float d = tg == null ? -1f : w.Position.DistanceTo(tg.Position);
                gunLo = Mathf.Min(gunLo, d); gunHi = Mathf.Max(gunHi, d);
            }
            if (seen == null) seen = Nodes<Shot>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.Kind == Shots.Seeker && s.TargetId == mine.NetId && s.Alive);
            else if (!gone)
            {
                if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(seen) && seen.Alive) lastD = seen.Position.DistanceTo(mine.Position);
                else gone = true;
            }
            return false;
        } };
        AddChild(watch);
        return async () =>
        {
            int want = mine == null ? -1 : (int)mine.Stats["fighter_count"];
            await RealTime(() => patrolMost >= want && gone && gunsGone, Wan ? 60 : 40);
            watch.QueueFree();
            Check(want > 0 && patrolMost == want && bothMost == 2 * want && amber,
                  $"guest: the patrol the host sent out on this carrier is here, {patrolMost} craft (its fighter_count, {want}), drawn in amber ({amber}); with the fighters, {bothMost} out at once (2 x {want})");
            Check(seen != null && gone && lastD > 160f,
                  $"guest: the host's seeker at this carrier is seen, and brought down here too, {lastD:0} u out -- clear of the hull, not landed");
            Check(gunMost == 2 && gunsGone && gunLo > 240 - 40 && gunHi < 240 + 40,
                  $"guest: the host's 2 gunships from this carrier seen ({gunMost}), on their 240 u circle round the target every frame one is drawn ({gunLo:0}-{gunHi:0} u) -- a warp, never a streak -- then gone ({gunsGone})");
        };
    }

    async Task Mp(string role)
    {
        await Wait(0.1);
        if (role == "host")
        {
            Character.Name = "HostPilot"; Character.Class = ShipClass.Battleship; Priv(H, "ApplyLocalIdentity"); Priv(H, "SendIdentity", 0);
            Drives.PriceSnaps = false;                  // its guests' warp hulls are moved by hand (lane B prices snaps in the arena pair)
            // THIS HOST'S OWN LEVEL for the slot the guest has levelled, at the ceiling: none of it may
            // reach the guest's ship.
            Character.GearLevel["Engines"] = 40;
            H.GetNode<PlayerShip>("Ship_1").Position = new Vector2(-900, 900);   // out of the way
            // THE TWO REFUSALS OF THE THIRD PLAYER, counted apart: its knock as another build, refused over TCP
            // before any connection (named, with both builds), and its connection that passed the knock but
            // not the in-band check (OnAuth)
            int knockRefusals = 0, authRefusals = 0;
            string knockRefused = $"Refused guest2 Base on a different build of the game (theirs {Game.Build} {Net.Protocol ^ 1:x8}, this one {Game.Build} {Net.Protocol:x8}).";
            // THE HOST SENDS A GUEST NOTHING UNRELIABLE UNTIL IT HAS ANSWERED THE WELCOME: read the moment
            // each guest is let in (this handler runs after Net's), and again once both are here
            int heardAtLetIn = 0, letIn = 0;
            void AtLetIn(long id) { letIn++; if (Net.Hears((int)id)) heardAtLetIn++; }
            Multiplayer.PeerConnected += AtLetIn;
            Net.I.Status += s =>
            {
                if (s == knockRefused) knockRefusals++;
                else if (s.StartsWith("Refused a player on a different build of the game")) authRefusals++;
            };
            Net.I.Host(P(27115));
            var courier = R2cHostCourier();
            var fullKnock = R2FullKnockHost(courier);  // once the invite guest's reply is taken: full, the third player's knock refused
            _streaming = true;                         // ten a second to every guest let in, for the guest to count
            // A raider that exists BEFORE either guest joins: they can only learn of it from the
            // catch-up a joining guest is sent (Hub.NetMySector). Far out, and gone at 9 s.
            var early = H.SpawnRaider(new Vector2(-6000, -6000));

            // panel's first address carries it -- proven at 3 slots at once by tools\rungs.ps1's end-of-batch proof.
            Check(Rendezvous.ListenPort == P(27115) && Net.I.Addresses.Count > 0 && Net.I.Addresses[0].StartsWith("Same network: ")
                  && Net.I.Addresses[0].EndsWith(":" + P(27115)),
                  $"hosting starts at once: the listener takes this run's port, and the panel's first address carries it ({Rendezvous.ListenPort}; {string.Join(" / ", Net.I.Addresses)})");

            // the invite guest's join is a person's pace (the courier, a pause, the pickup): waited for, not windowed
            // ...and the third player's own join now waits on its knock on a full session (R2FullKnockHost), so
            // it is waited for too: here, with its identity, and both guests' answers to the welcome
            await RealTime(() => Nodes<PlayerShip>().Count() == 3 && Multiplayer.GetPeers().Length == 2 && Multiplayer.GetPeers().All(Net.Hears)
                                 && Net.I.Players.Values.Any(p => p.Name == "Third" && p.Peak == 3), Wan ? 45 : 35);
            await courier;
            await fullKnock;
            R2cRows();
            GateFixJoinTimes();
            // THE BUILD HANDSHAKE. The save format is versioned (3, as a literal: a check that reads
            // the number it tests cannot catch the number being wrong); a SESSION is matched on the
            // build's fingerprint. The refusal is proved on a real connection by the third player,
            // who first knocks as another build (refused at the knock), then connects as one (refused
            // in-band): one of each here, and no ship for either.
            Check(Game.Version == 3 && Net.Accepts(Net.Protocol) && !Net.Accepts(Net.Protocol ^ 1),
                  $"a session admits this build and refuses any other (save format {Game.Version}, build {Net.Protocol:x8})");
            Check(knockRefusals == 1 && authRefusals == 1,
                  $"the host refused the third player's knock as another build once, naming both builds, and its in-band claim once ({knockRefusals} at the knock, {authRefusals} in-band)");
            var ships = Nodes<PlayerShip>().ToList();
            Check(ships.Count == 3, $"host sees 3 ships: itself and two guests ({ships.Count})");
            LaneAMissileIdsHost();
            Multiplayer.PeerConnected -= AtLetIn;
            // A guest just let in may not have the host's own "done" yet (lost on the way, resent), and
            // Godot throws away with an engine error anything else that reaches it first. Its answer to
            // the welcome, which travels behind that "done", is what opens the unreliable reports to it.
            Check(letIn == 2 && heardAtLetIn == 0 && Multiplayer.GetPeers().All(Net.Hears),
                  $"host: a guest just let in is sent nothing unreliable until it answers the welcome -- neither had at the moment it was let in, both have now ({letIn} let in, {heardAtLetIn} heard at once, {Multiplayer.GetPeers().Count(Net.Hears)} of {Multiplayer.GetPeers().Length} heard)");
            Check(ships.Any(s => s.Pilot == "Third"), "the second guest's identity reached the host");

            // peak 3 -- one chip slot open -- with five chips fitted, and the host's copy of its
            // battleship flies the first alone, an Armour Chip I: 500 x 1.08 = 540 hull (all five would be 530).
            var thirdW = ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Third");
            Check(thirdW != null && thirdW.Peak == 3 && Math.Abs(thirdW.MaxHp - 540) < 1e-6,
                  $"host: a guest at peak 3 with five chips fitted flies one: 540 hull on the host's copy (peak {thirdW?.Peak}, {thirdW?.MaxHp:0.##})");
            // Each guest is known by its CHARACTER: a returning pilot gets a new peer id, not a new self
            var gInfo = Net.I.Players.Values.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == "Guesty"); var tInfo = Net.I.Players.Values.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Name == "Third");
            Check(gInfo != null && gInfo.CharacterId.EndsWith("-guest") && tInfo != null && tInfo.CharacterId.EndsWith("-guest2"),
                  $"the host knows each guest's character, not just its peer id ({gInfo?.CharacterId}, {tInfo?.CharacterId})");
            var tokenWire = S2TokenWireHost();          // both beside what follows; awaited before the third player's drop
            var classWire = GateFixRefitWireHost();
            var third = ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Third");
            third?.Hit(250, third.Position, "test:reconnect");
            if (GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(early)) H.RaiderDown(early);
            // pinned by the HOST, the way a raider's web does it: the guest must feel it (it checks)
            ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty")?.ApplyStatus(Status.Pinned, 3.0);
            // and a salvager lost, the way a raid takes one: the guest must see its rebuild run
            H.Yard.Gatherers.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == GatherKind.Salvager)?.TakeDamage(1e6);
            Character.BossCleared.Clear();

            var rolled = Session.Kills[Session.Kills.Count - 1].Drops;   // Session.Kill is a public record now
            var dropsFile = new ConfigFile();
            foreach (var kv in rolled) dropsFile.SetValue("drops", kv.Key == Net.LocalId ? Character.Id : Net.I.Players[kv.Key].CharacterId, string.Join(",", kv.Value.OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal)));
            dropsFile.Save("user://smoke_drops.cfg");
            Check(rolled.Count == 3 && rolled.Values.All(d => d.Length == 2), $"the host rolls a kill's drops for each of the 3 pilots, 2 each ({rolled.Count})");

            // out of reach (test only) for the rest of the session, as it was when it had to be pressed
            _ = PdReachOff(Me);

                  "every guest has told the host it is home (the yard talks only to guests at home)");

            // THE GUEST'S PEAK, NOT ITS LEVEL: every role's pilot is level 1 with every wall open (peak
            // 14), and the host's copy of its ship is held to the peak it announced (Unlocks).
            Check(g != null && g.Peak == 14 && Net.I.Players.TryGetValue(g.OwnerId, out var gPeakInfo) && gPeakInfo.Peak == 14 && gPeakInfo.Level == 1,
                  $"a guest's highest level reached comes with its identity: the host's copy of its ship reads peak 14 at level 1 (peak {g?.Peak})");

                  $"a guest's slot levels come with its identity, and the host's own do not leak into its ship: rudder limit x{gTop:0.0000} here (level 2: 1 + 0.25 x 1.06 = 1.265; the host's level 40 would be 1.55)");

            var wingsHost = WingsHostSortie(g);         // runs beside what follows; awaited before the host stays up
            // A RAMP ON A GUEST-FLOWN SHIP (D18; the guest branch flies it near its end): the same

            // slot's N marked 4242 every frame -- so the guest can count this host's reports landing on
            // that very slot -- and its stats never given here: this copy has no helm, and must never

            {
                if (H?.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Guesty") is not { } gr) return false;

                return true;
            } };

            // send the hauler on an escort half way through for it to see
            ulong w0 = Time.GetTicksMsec();
            H.Yard.Credits = 100000;                  // enough for AUTO-SELL: only its owner rule can refuse a guest
            GetTree().CreateTimer(3.0).Timeout += () => { if (H?.Yard != null) { H.Yard.Hauler.ResetToPad(); H.Yard.Hauler.Cargo = 300; } };
            GetTree().CreateTimer(6.0).Timeout += () =>
            {
                if (H?.Yard == null) return;
                H.Yard.Hauler.ResetToPad(); H.Yard.Hauler.Cargo = 300; H.Yard.RequestDispatch(escorted: true);
            };
            // two seconds into the escort, on to its fourth leg and just short of the south-west outpost:
            // the guest must see it hold there and offload

            {

                typeof(Hauler).GetField("_leg", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).SetValue(eh, 3);

            };
            await Wait(2.0);
            await tokenWire; await classWire;
            // A DROP: Third's connection cut by the engine, no goodbye -- what a Wi-Fi drop looks like
            var heldD = (System.Collections.IDictionary)Session.Places;
            int thirdOld = third?.OwnerId ?? 0;
            Drop(thirdOld);
            await RealTime(() => !Multiplayer.GetPeers().Contains(thirdOld) && !H.Ships.Any(s => s.OwnerId == thirdOld), 3);
            var hEntry = heldD.Values.Cast<object>().FirstOrDefault();
            int owedOnDrop = hEntry == null ? -1 : ((System.Collections.IList)hEntry.GetType().GetField("Owed").GetValue(hEntry)).Count;
            double hullOnDrop = hEntry == null ? -1 : (double)hEntry.GetType().GetField("Hp").GetValue(hEntry);
            Check(owedOnDrop == 1, $"the kill 2 s before the drop is owed to the dropped pilot too: the host may not have reached it ({owedOnDrop})");
            double holdLeft = hEntry == null ? 0 : ((long)(ulong)hEntry.GetType().GetField("Until").GetValue(hEntry) - (long)Time.GetTicksMsec()) / 1000.0;
            Check(H.PartyIds.Count() == 3 && H.PilotName(thirdOld).Contains("Third") && H.PilotName(thirdOld).Contains("reconnecting") && H.IsReady(thirdOld)
                  && holdLeft > 85 && holdLeft <= 90.5,
                  $"a dropped pilot's place is held for 90 s: still in the party of 3, still READY ({H.PilotName(thirdOld)}, {holdLeft:0.0} s left)");
            await RealTime(() => H.Ships.Any(s => s.Pilot == "Third" && s.OwnerId != thirdOld), Wan ? 25 : 12);
            long thirdBackMs = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
            // the hull as it comes back: its place is restored with its identity, and it regenerates from then on
            double hullBack = H.Ships.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Third" && s.OwnerId != thirdOld)?.Hp ?? -1;
            await Wait(0.5);

                double lvHot = lvShip == null ? 0 : (double)lvClock.GetValue(lvShip);
                if (lvShip != null) { lvShip.Position = Landmarks.ById("equipment").At; lvClock.SetValue(lvShip, 0.0); }
                if (H.Yard.BuyGearLevel(GearSlot.Engines)) levelPaid = had - H.Yard.OwnStock("salvage");
                if (lvShip != null) { lvShip.Position = lvAt; lvClock.SetValue(lvShip, lvHot); }
                H.PilotChanged();
            }
            var midSession = LevelMidSession();
            H.Yard.BuyUpgrade("salvage_rate");            // a request: the host decides
            H.SetMyReady(true);                           // READY for the bounty
            Nodes<PlayerShip>().First(x => x.Mine).AutopilotTo = null;   // stay put: the scene must not change mid-test
            var dummy = H.GetNode<TargetDummy>("TargetDummy1");
            if (mine != null) { mine.Position = dummy.Position + new Vector2(-300, 300); mine.Velocity = Vector2.Zero; }

            Key(global::Godot.Key.Tab); await Wait(0.05);
            Check(H.Selected == dummy, "guest: Tab selects the nearest dummy");
            // its own bombers on its deck, watched every frame: each lift-off and landing placed HERE, in

            // first quarter rolling out to the runway, then up it to 115.5 u ahead; landing in 1 s onto
            // the centre) -- not trailing the host's reports; on the runway and on the centre at deck size
            float gLift = 9f, gLand = 9f, gOff = 0f; bool gBow = false;
            var fDeckT = typeof(Wing).GetField("_deckT", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
            var fTouch = typeof(Wing).GetField("_touch", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);

            {
                if (mine == null || !GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(mine)) return false;
                foreach (var w in Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == mine && w.Def.Parks))
                {
                    var lp = mine.ToLocal(w.Position); var sp = Nodes<Sprite2D>(w).First();
                    float drawn = sp.Scale.Y * sp.Texture.GetHeight() / 28.125f;
                    double dt = (double)fDeckT.GetValue(w); var bay = mine.Bay(w);

                    {
                        float k = (float)(dt / 1.6), u = Mathf.Clamp((k - 0.25f) / 0.75f, 0f, 1f);
                        var want = k < 0.25f ? bay.Lerp(new Vector2(0f, bay.Y), Mathf.SmoothStep(0f, 1f, k / 0.25f))
                                             : new Vector2(0f, bay.Y).Lerp(new Vector2(0f, -110.06f), u * u);
                        gOff = Mathf.Max(gOff, lp.DistanceTo(want));
                        if (Mathf.Abs(lp.X) < 0.01f) gLift = Mathf.Min(gLift, drawn);
                        if (Mathf.Abs(lp.X) < 0.01f && lp.Y < -40f) gBow = true;
                    }
                    if (w.BomberPhase == "Landing")
                    {
                        var want = ((Vector2)fTouch.GetValue(w)).Lerp(Vector2.Zero, Mathf.SmoothStep(0f, 1f, (float)(dt / 1.0)));
                        gOff = Mathf.Max(gOff, lp.DistanceTo(want));
                        if (lp.Length() < 0.5f) gLand = Mathf.Min(gLand, drawn);
                    }
                }
                return true;
            } };
            AddChild(deckWatch);
            // the hits the host resolves show here as damage numbers too, from the figures it sends
            var numberWatch = new LateSampler { Probe = () => Popups.Live?.Figures.Any(f => f.Kind != Pop.Taken && f.Who == dummy.GetInstanceId()) == true };
            AddChild(numberWatch);
            Key(global::Godot.Key.Space);          // fighters attack
            Key(global::Godot.Key.F);              // bomber strike
            await Wait(1.0);
            // POINT DEFENCE IS PASSIVE, and the host's to fire: nothing is pressed for it here. The host
            // sets a light raider down beside this carrier; from now until the check below, watch for a
            // flash leaving one of this ship's OWN mounts -- the host's shot, sent here (a flash lives
            // 0.1 s, so it is sampled every frame, never once).
            bool sawPd = false;
            var pdWatch = new LateSampler { Probe = () => sawPd |= mine != null && GodotObject.IsInstanceValid(mine) && H != null && H.Flashes.Any(f => mine.PdTurrets.Any(t => f.a.DistanceTo(t.GlobalPosition) < 40f)) };
            AddChild(pdWatch);
            var wingsSeen = WingsGuestWatch(mine);
            // WAITED FOR, NOT WINDOWED. The strike is the bombers' flight out to the target and then
            // their release, and over a simulated internet the press, the launch and every report
            // each cost a trip -- a fixed 4 s window opened 1 s after the key (timed from the input,
            // not the effect) closed before the first torpedo on a slow draw. Up to 12 s: the
            // longest run out on this range plus the link's delay, never a figure the check asserts.
            bool sawTorp = false;
            var torpWatch = new LateSampler { Probe = () => sawTorp |= InFlight().Any(x => x.Cosmetic) };
            AddChild(torpWatch);
            await RealTime(() => sawTorp, 12);
            torpWatch.QueueFree();
            Check(sawTorp, "guest sees cosmetic copies of its torpedoes");
            var host = Nodes<PlayerShip>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.OwnerId == 1);
            await RealTime(() => Nodes<PlayerShip>().Count() == 3 && Nodes<PlayerShip>().Any(s => s.Pilot == "Third"), 8);
            Check(Nodes<PlayerShip>().Count() == 3 && Nodes<PlayerShip>().Any(s => s.Pilot == "Third"), "guest sees the other guest too (3 ships)");
            await RealTime(() => Nodes<PlayerShip>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Third") is { } t3 && Math.Abs(t3.MaxHp - 540) < 1e-6, 5);
            var t3w = Nodes<PlayerShip>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.Pilot == "Third");
            Check(t3w != null && Math.Abs(t3w.MaxHp - 540) < 1e-6,
                  $"guest: the other guest's five chips at peak 3 fly as one here too (540 hull; {t3w?.MaxHp:0.##})");
            Check(H.Yard.Level("salvage_rate") == 1, "the upgrade the host granted reached the guest");
            for (int i = 0; i < 480 && Character.Exp != 650; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(Character.Exp == 650, $"the host's kill reached this guest, which took its own 650 (exp {Character.Exp})");
            await RealTime(() => Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() >= 2, 3); await Wait(0.5);
            Check(Character.GearHold.Values.Sum() == 2 && HoldIds() == RolledFor(Character.Id),
                  $"a kill's drops with two guests in the session: this guest gets its own 2 parts, the very ones the host rolled for it ({HoldIds()} / {RolledFor(Character.Id)})");
            Check(Met("equipment") && !Met("loot"), "a kill's parts reaching a guest at home: EQUIPMENT is met (they are in the hold), not LOOT (there are no crates)");
            await RealTime(() => H.Yard.OwnerBoss == 3, 3);
            Check(H.Yard.OwnerBoss == 3 && Missions.HighestBeaten(Missions.Bounty) == 1,
                  $"AUTO-SELL here is judged by the base owner's boss record (3), not this guest's (1) ({H.Yard.OwnerBoss}, {Missions.HighestBeaten(Missions.Bounty)})");
            var ghud = Nodes<HaulerHud>().FirstOrDefault();
            Check(ghud != null && Nodes<Button>(ghud).Any(b => b.Name == "Escort") && Nodes<Button>(ghud).Any(b => b.Name == "Dispatch") && Nodes<Button>(ghud).All(b => !b.Visible),
                  "a guest sees the host's hauler load, but DISPATCH and ESCORT are the base owner's alone");
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 6 && H.Raiders.Count == 0; i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            for (int i = 0; i < 60 * 3 && !H.Raiders.Any(r => r.Heavy); i++) await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame);
            Check(H.Raiders.Count >= 2 && Combat.Hostiles.OfType<Raider>().Any() && H.Raiders.Any(r => r.Heavy),
                  "the host's raiders reached this guest, a heavy as a heavy (hostiles it can target)");
            await Wait(0.1);
            Check(Met("raid"), "RAIDERS: a guest meets a raid from the raiders it is sent (no host involved)");
            var gm = H.Yard.Gatherers.First(x => x.Kind == GatherKind.Miner);
            Check(H.Yard.Gatherers.Any(x => x.Position.DistanceTo(Hub.BasePos) > 400) && H.Yard.Hauler.Position.Y == Hub.LaneY,
                  "guest sees the host's miner out working and the hauler on its lane");
            Check(host != null && host.Pilot == "HostPilot", $"host identity reached guest ({host?.Pilot})");
            Check(H.Yard.Stock("ore") < 1000, $"guest shows host's totals ({H.Yard.Stock("ore"):0})");
            Check(dummy.Total > 0 && dummy.LastSecond > 0, $"dummy readout reached the guest ({dummy.LastSecond:0.00} / {dummy.Total:0.0})");
            int near = Nodes<Wing>().Count(w => w.Carrier == mine && w.Kind == WingKind.Fighter && w.Position.DistanceTo(dummy.Position) < 400);
            Check(near >= 3, $"guest sees its fighters at the target, as the host flies them ({near})");
            await RealTime(() => sawPd, 10);
            pdWatch.QueueFree();
            Check(sawPd && mine != null && mine.PdOnline && Abilities.Find(mine.Class, "pd") == null,
                  "guest sees its own point defence fire with nothing pressed and no key for it: the host's shot, flashed from this ship's mounts");
            await wingsSeen();
            // a flash lives 0.1 s, so watch for one over two seconds rather than sampling once
            var flashes = (System.Collections.IList)H.GetType().GetField("_flashes", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(H);
            int seen = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) { if (flashes.Count > 0) seen++; await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); }
            Check(seen > 0, $"guest sees the host's hit flashes ({seen} of 60 frames)");
            // ...and HEARS them as their own rows. The host sends a flash's row index and nothing
            // else about it; a guest that dropped or misread it would hear every beam as row 0
            // (point defence) and never count a fighter. Nothing on a guest fires a fighter's shot
            // itself (Wing.Tick returns under !Net.Sim), so every one counted since it joined came
            // over the wire.
            int heardFighters = Sfx.Played.GetValueOrDefault("fighter") - heardFighters0;
            Check(heardFighters > 0, $"guest hears its fighters' beams as the fighter's own row, sent by index ({heardFighters} heard since it joined)");
            Check(mine != null && Math.Abs(mine.MaxHp - 527) < 1e-6 && Math.Abs(mine.Hp - 527) < 1e-6,
                  $"hull replicated from the host, which applied this pilot's own gear held to three of a kind (three of its four Armour Chips I: 425 x 1.24 = 527; {mine?.Hp:0})");
            ItemsGuestChecks(mine, "the guest's own copy");
            int streamed0 = _streamGot; ulong streamAt = Time.GetTicksMsec(); _streamGap = 0;
            await Wait(12.0);                      // strike done, bombers home and docked
            // THE HOST'S TEN A SECOND ARRIVE, over the 12 s just waited: nothing thrown away unsent. The
            // floor, from the link: 100 ms apart on a channel of its own, the simulated internet's jitter
            // (+/- 25 ms, +/- 40 on its worst day: 80 ms of spread at most) cannot reorder the stream, so
            // only its loss takes packets -- 2%, 5% on its worst day: 9.8 and 9.5 a second. Under 8 is a
            // fifth of them gone, which the link cannot do and a falling throttle does.
            double streamRate = (_streamGot - streamed0) / ((Time.GetTicksMsec() - streamAt) / 1000.0);
            // PRINTED, NOT ASSERTED (§10.4 R4): no literal exists for them yet
            if (Wan) GD.Print($"  wan: the stream (row {StreamChannel}) waited at most {_streamGap} ms between two over its 12 s; this guest's {R4Backlog()}");
            Check(streamRate >= 8,
                  $"guest: the host's unreliable stream, sent ten a second on a channel of its own, arrives at {streamRate:0.0} a second over 12 s -- at least 8, as the link loses at most 5% and every row is its own stream (a backlog that never drains is the one way under)");
            Check(pinWatch.Seen, "a guest's own ship is pinned when the host pins it (a raider's web works on guests too)");
            var lostSv = H.Yard.Gatherers.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Kind == GatherKind.Salvager);
            Check(lostSv != null && lostSv.Lost && lostSv.RebuildIn > 5 && lostSv.RebuildIn < 29,
                  $"a salvager the host lost is lost here too, its 30 s rebuild counting down -- not stuck at 0 s ({lostSv?.RebuildIn:0.0} s)");
            var gb = Nodes<Wing>().Where(w => w.Carrier == mine && w.Def.Parks).ToArray();
            Check(gb.Length == 2 && gb.All(w => w.Docked && w.GlobalPosition.DistanceTo(mine.ToGlobal(mine.Bay(w))) < 0.5f),
                  "guest sees its bombers parked in their bays on the carrier's deck (the state from the host, placed in its carrier's frame)");
            Check(gLift < 0.67f && gBow && gLand < 0.67f && gOff < 0.05f,
                  $"guest places its own bombers' deck moves on its own clock, in its carrier's frame: on the runway at deck size, up to the bow, down on the centre at deck size ({gLift:0.00}, {gLand:0.00}; {gOff:0.000} u from the deck clock's pose)");
            deckWatch.QueueFree();
            Check(numberWatch.Seen, "guest sees damage numbers where the hits the host resolves land (from the dummy's replicated figures)");
            numberWatch.QueueFree();
            // TAKEN WHEN IT IS TRUE: the host closes its session as soon as the third player has

            bool portalWasOpen = H.GetNodeOrNull("MissionPortal") != null && H.Mission == Hub.MissionState.PortalOpen;
            Check(portalWasOpen, "the host's mission portal opened here too (the party was ready)");
            // AUTO-SELL is the base owner's to buy: this guest's request changes nothing
            double hostCredits = H.Yard.Credits;
            H.Yard.BuyUpgrade("hauler_autosell"); await Wait(1.5);
            Check(H.Yard.Level("hauler_autosell") == 0 && hostCredits >= 4462 && Math.Abs(H.Yard.Credits - hostCredits) < 1e-6,

            // the host put its hauler at the south-west outpost (the last quarter aboard): this guest saw
            // it hold there and the pods drain -- never more than that quarter shown
            await RealTime(() => stopWatch.Seen && shownMin < 0.15, 12);
            Check(stopWatch.Seen && stopLeg == 3 && stopMax > 3 && stopMax <= 4 && shownMin < 0.15 && shownMax <= 0.26
                  && Nodes<Sprite2D>().Count(s => s.Name.ToString().StartsWith("Outpost")) == 4,
                  $"a guest sees the host's hauler hold at the south-west outpost and offload -- its outposts built here too (leg {stopLeg}, {stopMax:0.0} s, shown {shownMax:0.00} -> {shownMin:0.00} of the load)");
            Check(dispatchWatch.Seen && !Met("hauler"), "the hauler hint is the base owner's: a guest watching the host's loaded hauler is not shown buttons it cannot press");
            // A GUEST-FLOWN RAMP (D18): the test-only row on this guest's own carrier (and on the host's
            // copy, held running there, its slot marked 4242 by every report). The ramp is stepped HERE,
            // where the helm is: it builds 0.10 a second on the throttle and bleeds 0.20 x the yaw share
            // on a turn, and the host's reports -- counted as they land on that slot -- never reset it.
            {
                var rampKept = PutTestRampRow(ShipClass.Carrier);
                var gs = H.MyShip;
                var yawF = typeof(PlayerShip).GetField("_yawRate", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
                int reports = 0;
                void CountReports() { if (gs.Sl("open6").N == 4242) { reports++; gs.Sl("open6").N = 0; } }
                GiveRampStats(gs);
                gs.AutopilotTo = null; yawF.SetValue(gs, 0f);
                gs.Sl("open6").Own = 0; gs.Sl("open6").Left = 1e4; gs.Sl("open6").N = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); CountReports(); }
                KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.W);
                for (int i = 0; i < 60 && gs.Sl("open6").Own <= 0; i++) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); CountReports(); }
                double o0 = gs.Sl("open6").Own, c0 = gs.Clock; int rep0 = reports;
                for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++) { await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); CountReports(); }
                double o1 = gs.Sl("open6").Own, took = gs.Clock - c0; int straightReports = reports - rep0;
                Check(Net.IsOnline && o0 > 0 && straightReports >= 5 && Math.Abs((o1 - o0) - 0.10 * took) < 1e-3,
                      $"guest: a ramp on its own ship builds on the throttle, {took:0.00} s straight: +{o1 - o0:0.000} (0.10 a second: {0.10 * took:0.000}), through {straightReports} of the host's reports on that slot");
                KeyDown(global::Godot.Key.A);
                double want = gs.Sl("open6").Own, clock = gs.Clock, shareSum = 0; rep0 = reports;
                for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++)
                {
                    await ToSignal(GetTree(), SceneTree.SignalName.ProcessFrame); CountReports();
                    double dt = gs.Clock - clock; clock = gs.Clock;
                    double yawShare = Math.Min(1, Math.Abs((float)yawF.GetValue(gs)) / gs.Stats["turn_rate"]);
                    shareSum += yawShare * dt;
                    want = Math.Clamp(want + (0.10 - 0.20 * yawShare) * dt, 0, 0.50);
                }
                double got = gs.Sl("open6").Own; int turnReports = reports - rep0;
                KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.A); KeyUp(global::Godot.Key.W);
                Check(Net.IsOnline && shareSum > 0.2 && turnReports >= 3 && Math.Abs(got - want) < 1e-3,
                      $"guest: ...and bleeds on a turn (a yaw share of {shareSum:0.00} over the second, pinned: {gs.Pinned}): {got:0.0000}, its frames' own sum {want:0.0000} -- {turnReports} host reports landed and none reset it");
                gs.Sl("open6").Own = 0;
                PutBackOpenRow(ShipClass.Carrier, rampKept);
            }
            // the host DROPS this guest (no goodbye) once its 15 s are up and the third player has gone (~24.5 s
            // in): by invite there is no knocking again, so it is told how it gets back (§3.9)
            await RealTime(() => !Net.IsOnline, Wan ? 40 : 10);
            Check(!Net.IsOnline && Net.LocalId == 1 && !Net.I.Reconnecting && !Net.I.CanReconnect
                  && Net.I.LastStatus == "Lost the connection to HostPilot. Ask them for a new invite code: your place is held 90 s. Your own world keeps running.",

            Check(heldWatch.Seen, "while the third player was away, this guest's party list showed it as reconnecting");
            // THE WORLD'S NEXT FRAME, not the moment the session ended: the wait above wakes in the very
            // frame the host's hang-up is read, before this world has ticked once, and the portal follows
            // the mission state on the world's own tick (Hub.SyncMissionPortal). Given a second, not a frame.
            await RealTime(() => H.GetNodeOrNull("MissionPortal") == null, 1.0);
            Check(portalWasOpen && H.Mission == Hub.MissionState.Idle && H.GetNodeOrNull("MissionPortal") == null && H.PartyIds.SequenceEqual(new[] { 1 }),
                  $"the host lost, its open portal and its party went with it: this pilot's own world has neither ({H.Mission}; party {string.Join(",", H.PartyIds)}; portal {(H.GetNodeOrNull("MissionPortal") == null ? "gone" : "still up")})");
            // Back to its OWN world, with nothing lost: everything held -- stock, the
            // ships' cargo, and credits from a sale -- is at least the 5000 it had, and
            // nowhere near the host's few hundred.
            await midSession;
            Check(Math.Abs(levelPaid - 605) < 1e-9 && Equipment.LevelOf(GearSlot.Engines) == 3,
                  $"a guest levels a slot mid-session out of its OWN salvage, parked at home: level 2 -> 3 for 605 (500 x 1.10 x 1.10) ({levelPaid:0.##} paid, level {Equipment.LevelOf(GearSlot.Engines)})");
            double own = Held();
            double share = Missions.BountyEach(Missions.Bounty, 1, 3);   // the host's announced kill, a party of three
            // ...and that level is the one thing it spent while away
            Check(own - share + levelPaid >= held0 - 1e-6 && own - share + levelPaid < held0 + 400,
                  $"guest's own totals restored, nothing lost but the {levelPaid:0} salvage its level cost, plus its bounty share ({own:0.00} held, {share:0.00} of it the share, {held0:0.00} on leaving)");
            Check(H.Yard.Level("salvage_rate") == 0, "guest's own upgrade levels restored (the host's level 1 stays in the host's world)");
            Check(H.Yard.Hauler.Cargo <= H.Yard.Capacity && H.Yard.Gatherers.All(x => x.Cargo == 0 || x.State == Gatherer.St.Working),
                  "economy ships restart docked and empty in your own world");
            var ships = Nodes<PlayerShip>().ToList();
            Check(ships.Count == 1 && ships[0].Mine && ships[0].Name == "Ship_1", "guest rebuilt to its own single ship");
            // BACK BY THE HOST'S FRESH INVITE, and then back again while its old link still lived
            await tokenWireG; await classWireG;
            await Lane("R2cGuestReturns", () => R2cGuestReturns());
            // the host closes the session once this pilot is back the second time
            await RealTime(() => !Net.IsOnline, Wan ? 40 : 15);
            Check(!Net.IsOnline && Net.LocalId == 1 && Net.I.LastStatus.Contains("Host closed") && !Net.I.Reconnecting,
                  $"guest fell back offline when host left -- told it was closed, so nothing is retried ({Net.I.LastStatus})");
            Check(joinWatch.Frames > 0 && joinWatch.Online == 0 && joinWatch.Hosting == 0,
                  $"guest: through every frame of its join it is not online, and its panel does not read hosting, until the host has let it in ({joinWatch.Frames} frames joining; online on {joinWatch.Online}, 'hosting' on {joinWatch.Hosting})");
            joinWatch.QueueFree();
        }
    }
}

// Samples at the END of a frame, after every other node's _Process -- the one place a value that
// something overwrites every frame can be seen as it really stands.
public partial class LateSampler : Node
{
    public System.Func<bool> Probe;
    public bool Seen;
    public override void _Ready() => ProcessPriority = int.MaxValue;
    public override void _Process(double delta) { if (Probe?.Invoke() == true) Seen = true; }
}

// A JOIN, EVERY FRAME OF IT, at the end of each frame: while this pilot is joining it is not online,
// and its MULTIPLAYER panel does not read "hosting". Both were true for every frame of the handshake:
// the transport calls a link connected before the host has let the pilot in, and the pilot, still the host of
// its own world until then, sent into a host that threw it all away.
public partial class JoinWatch : Node
{
    public int Frames, Online, Hosting;
    public override void _Ready() => ProcessPriority = int.MaxValue;
    public override void _Process(double delta)
    {
        if (Net.I == null || !Net.I.Connecting) return;
        Frames++;
        if (Net.IsOnline) Online++;
        if (GetTree().Root.FindChild("NetToggle", true, false) is Button b && b.Text.Contains("hosting")) Hosting++;
    }
}

// A third host-spawned replicated kind, registered by the check that proves a third kind is a ROW
// of Spawns.All and not a third copy of the six methods each one used to need. The game builds
// none of these; only the check does.
public partial class SpawnProbe : Node2D { public int NetId; }

// A STAND-IN THAT SAYS WHAT IT IS, for a rule written in tags (Turret.Rank, a TargetFilter): the
// rule reads the tag and nothing else -- never a hit radius -- so the check hands it one.
public class StandIn : IHittable, ITagged
{
    public int NetId => 0;
    public Vector2 Position { get; set; } = Vector2.Zero;
    public float HitRadius => 8f;
    public bool Alive => true;
    public Tag Tags { get; set; }
    public void TakeDamage(double d) { }
}
